definition_uz: Muayyan hududda tabiiy ravishda shakllangan va inson tomonidan boshqa joylardan keltirilmagan mahalliy o‘simlik turlari. Bunday o‘simliklar uzoq evolyutsiya jarayonida o‘sha hududning iqlim, tuproq va boshqa ekologik sharoitlariga moslashgan bo‘lib, tabiiy ekotizimlarning muhim tarkibiy qismi hisoblanadi. Bog‘dorchilik va o‘rmonchilikda aborigen o‘simliklar seleksiya, ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, genetik resurslarni saqlash hamda degradatsiyaga uchragan hududlarni tiklashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Aborigen lotincha aborigines («azaldan yashovchilar», «mahalliy aholi») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Buxoro viloyati florasining kadastr ro‘yxati 340 turkum va 67 oilaga mansub (aborigen o‘simliklar hamda boshqa yerlarga ko‘chirilgan yoki naturalizatsiya qilingan o‘simliklar) 765 turdagi tomir ildizli o‘simliklar haqida ma’lumotlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. («Buxoro viloyati tabiatining geografik xususiyatlari va ularning geoekologik holatining sabab va oqibatlari». Qalandarova D.D., Nuriddinov R.M. Educational Research in Universal Sciences, Vol. 2, Special Issue 4, 2023)
definition_en: Plant species that occur naturally in a particular region without human introduction. Native plants have evolved under local environmental conditions and are well adapted to the climate, soils, and ecological interactions of their natural habitats. They play an important role in biodiversity conservation, ecological restoration, horticulture, and sustainable landscape management.
etymology_en: Late Latin indigenus — "native, born in a country", from indu "in, within" + gignere "to beget"
example_en: Native, indigenous plants occur naturally in a geographic region over long periods (e.g., thousands of years) without human introduction or intervention. (Creating Sustainable School and Home Gardens: Gardening With Native Plants. Utah State University Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Suyuq preparatlarni juda mayda tomchilar (aerozol) holiga keltirib, havo muhitiga purkash uchun mo‘ljallangan qurilma. Bog‘dorchilikda aerozol generatorlari issiqxonalar, bog‘lar va omborxonalarda insektitsidlar, fungitsidlar, dezinfeksiyalovchi vositalar hamda boshqa kimyoviy preparatlarni bir tekis tarqatish uchun qo‘llaniladi. Qurilma preparatning mayda dispers tomchilarini hosil qilib, uning o‘simlik yuzasiga samarali yetib borishini va zararkunandalar hamda kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilariga qarshi ta’sirini oshiradi.
etymology_uz: Aerozol yunoncha aēr («havo») va lotincha solutio («eritma») + generator lotincha («hosil qiluvchi, yaratuvchi»)
example_uz: O‘simliklarga kimyoviy ishlov berishda ventilyatorli OVX-600, shtangali OPShX-12/15 va tirkalma OVM-900/1200 rusumli purkagichlar, OShX-12-1A rusumli gerbitsid purkash moslamalari, OShU-50A changlatgichi, AG-UD-2 aerozol generatori, fumigatorlardan g‘o‘za, bog‘, uzumzor, butazor, sabzavot va texnik ekinlarga kimyoviy ishlov berishda foydalaniladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik ishlab chiqarishini mexanizatsiyalashtirish. Obidov A. va boshq., 2018)
definition_en: A device designed to convert liquid formulations into fine aerosol droplets for uniform dispersion into the air. In horticulture, aerosol generators are used in greenhouses, orchards, and storage facilities to apply pesticides, fungicides, disinfectants, and other crop protection products. Fine droplets improve coverage and increase the effectiveness of pest and disease control.
etymology_en: Aerosol derives from aero- (Greek aēr, “air”) and sol (from Latin solutio, “solution”), while generator derives from Latin generator, meaning “producer” or “creator.”
example_en: “The mechanical aerosol generator uses air-atomizing nozzles with air supplied by an air compressor to disperse the pesticide into small droplets.” (Pesticide Application Equipment for Enclosed Space Production. Newman D., Walker T., Craver J., Colorado State University Extension, 2019)

definition_uz: Suvni maxsus purkagichlar yordamida juda mayda tomchilar holida o‘simliklar ustiga va atrofidagi havoga tarqatish orqali amalga oshiriladigan sug‘orish usuli. Aerozol sug‘orish o‘simliklar atrofida qulay mikroiqlim yaratish, havo namligini oshirish va haroratni pasaytirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Issiqxonalar, ko‘chatxonalar va nam mikroiqlim talab qiladigan ekinlarni yetishtirishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Aerozol (tuman hosil qilib, mayda dispers) sug‘orish usulida qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari uchun qulay mikroiqlim sharoiti yaratiladi. (Sug‘orish melioratsiyasi. Xamidov M., Suvanov B., Isabaev K., 2019)
definition_en: A microirrigation method in which water is applied in very small droplets. Mist irrigation is used to provide water and maintain a humid microclimate around plants and is particularly suitable for crops requiring high relative humidity.
example_en: Mist irrigation is usually followed for crops where maintenance of a humid micro climate is needed for proper growth and development. (Central Water Commission, Documentation and Analysis of Farmers’ Practices in Water Management for Plantation Crops)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning oziqlanishi va o‘sishini, qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini yetishtirishni hamda ularning tuproq va tashqi muhit sharoitlari bilan bog‘liqligini o‘rganadigan fan.
etymology_uz: Agrobiologiya termini yunoncha agros («dala, ekin maydoni»), bios («hayot») va logos («ta’limot, fan») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Agrokimyoning boshqa fanlar o‘rtasida tutgan o‘rni ko‘rsatilgan jadvalda o‘simlikni o‘rganuvchi fanlar qatorida «Agrobiologiya» keltirilib, uning yo‘nalishi «Ko‘payish, rivojlanish» deb ko‘rsatilgan. (Agrokimyo. Xoliqulov Sh.T., Qurvontoyev R.X., 2011)
definition_en: The study of plant nutrition and growth and crop production in relation to soil management.
etymology_en: Agrobiology derives from Greek agros (“field”), bios (“life”), and logos (“study” or “science”).
example_en: Endophytic Bacteria: A Biotechnological Potential in Agrobiology System. (Bacteria in Agrobiology: Crop Productivity. Lacava P.T., Azevedo J.L.; Maheshwari D.K., Saraf M., Aeron A. (eds.), Springer, 2013)

definition_uz: Inson tomonidan ekiladigan yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi ekin maydonlarida o‘sishga moslashgan madaniy va ular bilan bog‘liq o‘simliklar guruhi. Agrofitlar agroekotizimlarning asosiy tarkibiy qismini tashkil etadi hamda oziq-ovqat, yem-xashak, texnik va bog‘dorchilik mahsulotlari yetishtirishda muhim ahamiyatga ega. Botanika va agroekologiyada bu termin tabiiy fitotsenozlardan farqli ravishda inson faoliyati ta’sirida shakllangan o‘simliklar majmuasini ifodalaydi.
etymology_uz: Agrofitlar termini yunoncha agros («dala, ekin maydoni») va phyton («o‘simlik») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Agrofitlar — odam tomonidan madaniy holga keltirilgan hamda maxsus ekilib, parvarish qilinadigan o‘simliklar. (Qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid atamalarning izohli lug‘ati, 2023)
definition_en: Plants growing in agricultural habitats, including cultivated species and plant communities associated with farmland. Agrophytes are characteristic components of agroecosystems and are adapted to environments created and managed by human agricultural activities.
etymology_en: Agrophyte derives from Greek agros (“field”) and phyton (“plant”).
example_en: Gracilaria red algae are notable for their economic importance as agrophytes, sold as salad vegetable, and used as the base for selected food and nonalcoholic beverages. (Hassan R. et al., Scientifica, 2019)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning oziqlanishi, tuproq unumdorligi, o‘g‘itlardan samarali foydalanish hamda o‘simlik, tuproq va o‘g‘it o‘rtasidagi o‘zaro ta’sir qonuniyatlarini o‘rganadigan qishloq xo‘jaligi fani. Agrokimyo oziq elementlarining tuproqdagi aylanishi va o‘simlik tomonidan o‘zlashtirilishi, o‘g‘itlarni qo‘llash hamda ekinlar hosildorligi va mahsulot sifatini oshirish masalalarini tadqiq etadi.
etymology_uz: Agro- yunoncha agros — "dala"; kimyo atamasi arabcha al-kīmiyā orqali o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Agrokimyoda o‘g‘itlashning maqbul, oqilona va eng yuqori me’yorlari farqlanadi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The branch of agricultural science concerned with plant nutrition, soil fertility, fertilizers, and the interactions among plants, soils, and fertilizers in crop production. It studies nutrient cycling and fertilizer use to improve crop yield and quality while maintaining soil fertility.
etymology_en: From agro-, from Greek agros meaning "field", + chemistry.
example_en: Agronomic chemistry, or agrochemistry, is the science of the interaction of plants, soil, and fertilizers in the process of growing crops, the cycle of substances in agriculture, and the use of fertilizers to increase yields, improve their quality, and increase soil fertility. (Agrochemistry. UniversityAgro)

definition_uz: Tuproq, o‘simlik, suv, o‘g‘it va boshqa qishloq xo‘jaligi materiallarining kimyoviy hamda agrokimyoviy ko‘rsatkichlarini aniqlash uchun maxsus jihozlangan laboratoriya. Agrokimyo laboratoriyasida tuproqning pH ko‘rsatkichi, organik moddalar va o‘simliklar o‘zlashtira oladigan oziqa elementlari miqdori, shuningdek o‘simliklarning oziqlanish holati, o‘g‘itlar va sug‘orish suvining ayrim sifat ko‘rsatkichlari tahlil qilinishi mumkin. Tahlil natijalari tuproq unumdorligini baholash va ilmiy asoslangan o‘g‘itlash tizimini ishlab chiqishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Hozirgi kunda O‘zbekistonning barcha viloyatlarida maxsus agrokimyo laboratoriyalari mavjud bo‘lib, ular fermerlar uyushmalari tuproqlarining agrokimyoviy xaritanomalarini tuzish bilan shug‘ullanadi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A laboratory equipped to perform agrochemical and physicochemical analyses of soil and, depending on its scope, analyses of plants, water, fertilizers, and other agricultural materials. Such laboratories determine soil fertility indicators and plant-available nutrients and provide analytical information for nutrient management and fertilizer recommendations.
example_en: The Agrochemical Laboratory of the Department of Agrochemistry of the State Plant Protection Service is an accredited testing laboratory, soil reference laboratory, member of United Nations Food and Agriculture Organisation Global Soil Laboratory network (GLOSOLAN) un Europe and Eurasia Soil Laboratory network (EUROSOLAN). (Soil Testing. State Plant Protection Service of Latvia, 2022)

definition_uz: Tuproq unumdorligini baholash, tuproq, o‘simlik va o‘g‘it namunalarini tahlil qilish, agrokimyoviy tekshiruvlar o‘tkazish, agrokimyoviy xaritalar tuzish hamda o‘g‘itlardan ilmiy asoslangan holda foydalanish bo‘yicha tavsiyalar ishlab chiqish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi xizmatlar tizimi.
example_uz: Agrokimyo xizmati va xaritalar tuzish (yaylov va pichanzorlarda 10–12 yil) ishlari har 4–5 yilda o‘tkazib turish kerak (lalmikorlikda 8–10 yilda bir marta). (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A system of professional and technical services concerned with agrochemical soil surveys, soil fertility assessment, analysis of soils, plants and fertilizers, agrochemical mapping, fertilizer recommendations, and the scientifically based use of fertilizers and other agrochemicals in agricultural production.
example_en: According to this study, agrochemical service assisted methodical agriculture in the period 1956–1990. (Agrochemical Service of Agriculture in the Republic of Moldova: Past and Present. Leah T., Scientific Papers Series Management, Economic Engineering in Agriculture and Rural Development, 2014, 14(3))

definition_uz: Tuproq, o‘simlik, suv, o‘g‘it va boshqa qishloq xo‘jaligi namunalarining kimyoviy tarkibi, oziq elementlari miqdori hamda agrokimyoviy xossalarini laboratoriya usullarida aniqlash jarayoni. Agrokimyoviy tahlil tuproq unumdorligini baholash, o‘simliklarning oziqlanish holatini aniqlash, o‘g‘itlash me’yorlarini belgilash va ekinlardan yuqori hamda sifatli hosil olish uchun ilmiy asos bo‘lib xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Har qanday bog‘larning tuproqlari 4–5 yilda bir marta agrokimyoviy tahlil qilinishi kerak. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The laboratory determination of the chemical composition, nutrient content, and agrochemical properties of soil, plants, water, fertilizers, and other agricultural samples. Agrochemical analysis is used to assess soil fertility, evaluate plant nutritional status, determine fertilizer requirements, and support efficient crop production.
example_en: Adequate use necessitates agrochemical analysis of the soil on a regular basis. (Agrochemical Analysis of Soil from Greenhouse Treated With Organic Fertilizers. Boshevska M., Jankuloski Z., 2021)

definition_uz: Tuproqning agrokimyoviy xususiyatlari va oziq elementlari bilan ta’minlanganlik darajasining hudud bo‘yicha tarqalishini xaritada aks ettiruvchi maxsus tematik xaritanoma. Unda gumus miqdori, tuproq reaksiyasi (pH), harakatchan fosfor, almashinuvchi kaliy va boshqa agrokimyoviy ko‘rsatkichlar ma’lum gradatsiyalar asosida tasvirlanadi. Agrokimyoviy xaritanomalar tuproq unumdorligini baholash, o‘g‘it me’yorlarini belgilash va yer resurslaridan oqilona foydalanishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Albatta, ochiq maydonda yetishtirilganda ham o‘g‘it me’yoriga tuzatish kiritishda agrokimyoviy xaritanoma ko‘rsatkichlaridan foydalaniladi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A thematic cartographic representation showing the spatial distribution of agrochemical properties of soil, such as humus content, soil pH, available phosphorus, exchangeable potassium, and other nutrient indicators. Agrochemical cartograms are used to assess soil fertility and support fertilizer planning and agricultural land management.
example_en: The research aims to leverage Geographic Information System (GIS) technologies to develop digital agrochemical cartograms specifically for irrigated meadow-alluvial soils in Uzbekistan. (Study on Agrochemical Information and Analytical Systems in Irrigated Agriculture. Dauletmuratov M. et al., E3S Web of Conferences, Vol. 563, 2024)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini yetishtirish, qayta ishlash, saqlash, logistika va sotish jarayonlarini yagona tizim asosida birlashtiruvchi xo‘jalik yuritish shakli. Agroklaster tarkibiga fermer xo‘jaliklari, qayta ishlash korxonalari, ilmiy-tadqiqot muassasalari, ta’minot va xizmat ko‘rsatish tashkilotlari kirishi mumkin. U ishlab chiqarish samaradorligini oshirish, resurslardan oqilona foydalanish, mahsulot sifatini yaxshilash va bozor raqobatbardoshligini ta’minlashga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Agroklaster termini agro- (yunoncha agros — «dala, qishloq xo‘jaligi») va inglizcha cluster («guruh, to‘plam») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Tadqiqot natijalariga ko‘ra, meva-sabzavotchilik mahsulotlari yetishtirish jarayoni, saqlash, qayta ishlash va sotish bilan bog‘liq iqtisodiy munosabatlarni kooperatsiya asosida tashkil etish agroklasterlar, dehqon va fermer xo‘jaliklari uchun yuqori daromadli va samarali hisoblanadi. («Meva-sabzavotchilik mahsulotlari kooperatsiyasi va uning samaradorligini oshirish yo‘llari». Ergashev R.X. Innovatsion texnologiyalar, 2024/2(54)-son, 2024, 128–135-b.)
definition_en: An organizational model that integrates agricultural production, processing, storage, logistics, research, and marketing activities into a coordinated system. Agro-clusters may include farms, processing enterprises, research institutions, and service providers. They aim to improve productivity, resource efficiency, product quality, and competitiveness in agricultural markets.
etymology_en: Agro- derives from Greek agros (“field”), while cluster derives from Old English clyster (“group, bunch, collection”).
example_en: An agrocluster is an association of interest partners, such as producers or agro-enterprises, who work in the same agricultural or agro-industrial subsector and cooperate in meeting and implementing common objectives. (Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), 2023)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarining ishlab chiqaruvchidan bozor yoki iste’molchigacha bo‘lgan harakatini tashkil etish va boshqarish bilan bog‘liq logistika sohasi. U mahsulotlarni yig‘ish, tashish, saqlash, qayta ishlash, qadoqlash, taqsimlash va sotish bilan bog‘liq jarayonlarni qamrab oladi hamda mahsulot sifatini saqlash, yo‘qotishlarni kamaytirish va ta’minot zanjiri samaradorligini oshirishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Davlatimiz rahbari buning uchun, avvalo, qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini yig‘ish, tashish, saqlash, qayta ishlash, qadoqlash va eksport qilish jarayonlarini qamrab oladigan zamonaviy agrologistika markazlarini ko‘paytirish zarurligini ta’kidladi. (Zamonaviy agrologistika markazlari barpo etilib, qishloq xo‘jaligida kooperatsiya kengaytiriladi. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Prezidenti rasmiy veb-sayti, 2019)
definition_en: A branch of logistics focused on the agri-food sector and encompassing the activities required to move agricultural products through the supply chain, including production-related logistics, handling, storage, transportation, processing and distribution, in order to meet market demand efficiently.
example_en: Agrologistics may be considered a sub-discipline of logistics specifically focused on the agri-food industry. (National Agrologistics Program, Executive Summary. Wageningen UR Food & Biobased Research)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligida foydalaniladigan yerlarning tuproq, suv va boshqa tabiiy sharoitlarini yaxshilash hamda ularning unumdorligini oshirishga qaratilgan meliorativ va agrotexnik tadbirlar majmuasi. Agromelioratsiya tuproqning agrofizik xususiyatlarini yaxshilash, sho‘rlanish va eroziya kabi salbiy jarayonlarni kamaytirish hamda ekinlar yetishtirish uchun qulay sharoit yaratishga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Agro- yunoncha agros — "dala"; melioratsiya lotincha melioratio — "yaxshilash" ma’nosidagi so‘z bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Agromelioratsiya — yerni dehqonchilikka moslash, undan yuqori hosil yetishtirish maqsadida tuproqning meliorativ holatini yaxshilash, zovurlar qazish yo‘li bilan yer zaxini qochirish va botqoqlarni quritish, suv chiqarish, sug‘orish shoxobchalarini yaxshilash, sho‘r yuvish kabi chora-tadbirlar majmui. (Kimyoviy melioratsiya. Urazkeldiev A.B., 2015)
definition_en: A system of agricultural and land-improvement measures used to improve soil properties and other conditions of agricultural land in order to enhance its suitability and productivity for crop production.
etymology_en: Agro- derives from Greek agros, meaning "field"; melioration derives from Late Latin melioratio, meaning "improvement".
example_en: In this paper, drainage systems and agromelioration measures for arranging the existing soil types of land of the City of Požega are proposed, for the purpose of achieving advanced agriculture. (Soils of the City of Požega and Land Reclamation for Crop Growing in Advancement Agriculture. 2023)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarining o‘sishi, rivojlanishi, hosildorligi va mahsulot sifatiga ta’sir ko‘rsatuvchi atmosfera hamda iqlim sharoitlari majmui. Agrometeorologik omillarga havo harorati, yog‘in miqdori, havo namligi, quyosh radiatsiyasi, shamol, tuproq harorati va namligi kabi meteorologik ko‘rsatkichlar kiradi. Ushbu omillarni o‘rganish ekinlarni joylashtirish, agrotexnik tadbirlarni rejalashtirish va hosilni prognozlashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Qishloq xo‘jalik o‘simliklari va hayvonlari holati va mahsuldorligini aniqlaydigan meteorologik va gidrologik kattaliklar majmuasi agrometeorologik omillar, ularning biror vaqt davomidagi qiymatlari agrometeorologik sharoitlar, olingan joydagi agrometeorologik sharoitlarning ko‘p yillik rejimi agroiqlimiy sharoitlar deb yuritiladi. (Agrometeorologiya. Xolbayev G.X., 2018)
definition_en: The set of atmospheric and climatic conditions that influence the growth, development, yield, and quality of agricultural crops. Agrometeorological factors include air temperature, precipitation, humidity, solar radiation, wind, soil temperature, and soil moisture. Their study is essential for crop planning, agricultural management, and yield forecasting.
example_en: Agrometeorological factors like temperature, rainfall, humidity, sunlight, and wind have great impact on productivity, crop growth, and stability in yield. (International Journal of Research in Agronomy, 2026, 9(4S), pp. 200–209)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari va ularni yetishtirish sharoitlarini agronomik jihatdan o‘rganish hamda baholash jarayoni. Agronomik tahlil tuproq xususiyatlari, o‘simliklarning oziqlanish holati, o‘sishi va rivojlanishi, agrotexnik tadbirlar, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatiga ta’sir qiluvchi omillarni o‘rganishni qamrab olishi mumkin. Uning natijalaridan ekinlarni yetishtirish texnologiyasini takomillashtirish va agronomik qarorlar qabul qilishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Agronomik tahlil yordamida tuproq unumdorligi, jumladan, tuproqdagi gumus va o‘g‘itlar miqdori, kislotalar formasi, «pH» reaksiyasi, tuproqning ishqoriyligi, sho‘rligi va boshqalar belgilanadi. («Agronomik tahlil nimani anglatishini bilasizmi». Milliylik – millat ko‘zgusi, 2025)
definition_en: The analysis and evaluation of crops and their production conditions from an agronomic perspective. It may involve the assessment of soil properties, plant nutritional status, crop growth, management practices, yield, and other factors relevant to crop production and agronomic decision-making.
example_en: Experimental phase: An agronomic analysis and an initial study of the farms where the trials will be conducted, as well as the physicochemical and biological properties of the soil in the selected farms, will be carried out prior to the application of biostimulants. (EU CAP Network, European Commission, 2025)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini yetishtirishda qo‘llaniladigan ilmiy asoslangan usullar, texnologik jarayonlar va agrotexnik tadbirlar majmui. Agrotexnologiya tuproqni tayyorlash, urug‘lik tanlash va ekish, sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, o‘simliklarni himoya qilish, parvarishlash hamda hosilni yig‘ib olish jarayonlarini o‘z ichiga oladi. U ekinlardan yuqori va sifatli hosil olish, resurslardan samarali foydalanish va barqaror qishloq xo‘jaligini ta’minlashga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Agrotexnologiya termini yunoncha agros («dala, qishloq xo‘jaligi») va yunoncha technē («san’at, mahorat, usul») hamda logos («ta’limot, fan») unsurlari asosida shakllangan.
example_uz: Tadqiqotning maqsadi janubiy mintaqa o‘tloqlashib borayotgan taqirsimon va markaziy mintaqa sug‘oriladigan tipik bo‘z tuproqlar sharoitida yerdan yil davomida samarali foydalanish, qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlaridan yiliga 2–3 martagacha hosil yetishtirishning maqbul agrotexnologiya elementlarini ishlab chiqish hamda tuproq sho‘rlanishini masofaviy zondlash va geografik axborot tizimi (GAT) orqali xaritalashdan iborat. («Sug‘oriladigan yerlardan yil davomida samarali foydalanishning ilmiy asoslari». Avliyakulov M.A., 2025)
definition_en: A set of scientifically based methods, technologies, and agricultural practices used for crop production. Agrotechnology includes soil preparation, sowing, irrigation, fertilization, crop protection, plant care, and harvesting operations aimed at improving productivity, resource efficiency, and sustainable agriculture.
etymology_en: Agrotechnology combines agro- from Greek agros (“field”) and technology from Greek technē (“art, skill”) and logos (“study”).
example_en: Farms that implemented intensive agrotechnology, including high-density planting and drip irrigation, achieved a higher average yield. (National-scale evidence for rapid cotton yield gains under sustainable intensification in Uzbekistan. Scientific Reports, 2026)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini zararkunandalar, kasalliklar va begona o‘tlardan himoya qilishda agrotexnik tadbirlardan foydalanishga asoslangan usul. Bunda almashlab ekish, tuproqqa ishlov berish, ekish muddatlarini to‘g‘ri belgilash, sanitariya tadbirlari va ekinlarni tegishli tarzda parvarish qilish orqali zararli organizmlarning rivojlanishi, ko‘payishi va tarqalishi cheklanadi.
example_uz: Agrotexnika usuli yordamida zararkunandalar ko‘payishining oldini olish, ba’zan esa ularni butunlay qirib tashlash mumkin. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A pest management approach that uses agricultural and crop-management practices to prevent or reduce pest, disease, and weed problems by making conditions less favorable for harmful organisms.
example_en: Cultural control practices can reduce pest problems by making the crop environment less favorable for pests. (University of California Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program)

definition_uz: Tuproq xususiyatlari, iqlim, gidrogeologik sharoitlar, relyef, eroziya, sho‘rlanish kabi omillar hamda qishloq xo‘jaligi ishlab chiqarishining o‘ziga xos xususiyatlarini hisobga olib hududlarni agroishlab chiqarish jihatdan bir-biriga yaqin zonalarga ajratish jarayoni. Agrotuproq rayonlashtirish ekinlarni to‘g‘ri joylashtirish, agrotexnik va meliorativ tadbirlarni rejalashtirish, sug‘orish usullarini tanlash hamda tuproq resurslaridan samarali foydalanish uchun amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Agrotuproq rayonlashtirish tuproq-geografik rayonlashtirish asosida o‘tkazilib, lekin bunda tuproqning agronomik xarakteristikasi, joyning tabiiy va ishlab chiqarish sharoitlariga alohida e’tibor beriladi hamda bu xususiyatlar batafsil o‘rganiladi. (Tuproqshunoslik. Xoliqulov Sh., Uzoqov P., Boboxo‘jayev I., 2013)
definition_en: The process of dividing agricultural territories into zones based on soil properties, climate, hydrological conditions, landform characteristics, and agricultural production conditions. Agro-soil zoning is used for crop placement, planning of agronomic and land-reclamation measures, selection of irrigation practices, and sustainable soil resource management.
example_en: Agro-soil zoning of the land fund of Karabakh was carried out on the basis of taxonomic divisions (landscape-natural zone, agro-soil region and soil sub-district). (Agrosoil Zoning of the Land Fund of Karabakh of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Babayev M.P., Nadjafova S.I., Mirzezade R.I., Ramazanova F.M., 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar fiziologiyasini tadqiq qilish usullaridan biri bo‘lib, bunda bitta o‘simlikning ildiz tizimi ikki yoki undan ortiq alohida qismlarga ajratilib, ular tarkibi yoki sharoiti turlicha bo‘lgan oziqa muhitlariga joylashtiriladi. Ushbu usul turli oziq elementlari, suv ta’minoti va boshqa muhit omillarining ildizlar tomonidan o‘zlashtirilishi hamda o‘simlikning fiziologik javob reaksiyalarini o‘rganish imkonini beradi.
example_uz: Ajratilgan muhitda o‘stirishda o‘simlik ildizlari ikki yoki undan ko‘proq qismga taqsimlanib, oziq moddalarining har xil aralashmasidan tashkil topgan eritmaga joylashtiriladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: An experimental technique in which the root system of a single plant is divided into two or more physically separated portions that are exposed to different nutrient or environmental conditions. The technique is used to investigate nutrient and water uptake, root-to-shoot signalling, plant physiological responses, and interactions between roots and their environment.
example_en: The split-root system technique has been used to analyse plant biology for several decades. (Split-root System as a Useful Tool to Study Woody Plant Biology. Giertych M.J., Leski T., 2023)

definition_uz: Burchoqdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub daraxt va butalar turkumi. Acacia turkumining ko‘pchilik vakillari issiq va qurg‘oqchil sharoitlarga moslashgan. Barglari ayrim turlarda ikki karra patsimon murakkab, ko‘pchilik turlarida esa barg bandining o‘zgarishidan hosil bo‘lgan fillodiylar ko‘rinishida bo‘ladi. Gullari mayda, odatda sariq yoki krem rangli bo‘lib, sharsimon boshcha, boshoq yoki shingilsimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevasi dukkak. Ko‘plab turlari manzarali o‘simlik sifatida, ihota daraxtzorlari barpo etish va tuproqni muhofaza qilish maqsadlarida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Akatsiya lotincha Acacia orqali qadimgi yunoncha akakia nomidan kelib chiqqan; bu nom tarixan tikanli akatsiyasimon o‘simlikka nisbatan qo‘llangan.
example_uz: Pitomniklarda yana akatsiya, gledichiya, klen, terak, qayrag‘och, maklyura, tut, ipak tut, yong‘oq mevali daraxtlari ekib yetishtirilgan. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A genus of trees and shrubs in the family Fabaceae. Acacia species are particularly diverse in Australia and other parts of the Australasian and Pacific regions. Their leaves may be bipinnately compound or modified into flattened leaf-like structures called phyllodes. The small flowers are typically arranged in globular heads, spikes, or racemes, and the fruit is a legume. Many species are cultivated as ornamental plants and are also used in shelterbelts, land rehabilitation, and soil conservation.
etymology_en: Acacia derives through Latin from the ancient Greek name akakia, historically applied to a thorny acacia-like plant.
example_en: Acacia is the largest genus of vascular plants in Australia (more than 950 species currently recognised). (Flora of Australia, Volume 11A: Mimosaceae, Acacia Part 1. Maslin B.R., 2001)

definition_uz: Aktinidiyadoshlar (Actinidiaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik yog‘ochlashgan lianalar turkumi. Barglari oddiy va navbat bilan joylashgan, gullari odatda oq yoki oqish rangli. Mevasi ko‘p urug‘li rezavor meva. Turkumning ayrim vakillari iste’mol qilinadigan mevalari uchun yetishtiriladi. Ayniqsa Actinidia chinensis va uning Actinidia chinensis var. deliciosa varieteti kivi yetishtirishda muhim ahamiyatga ega. Ayrim aktinidiya turlari manzarali o‘simlik sifatida ham yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Aktinidiya nomi yunoncha aktis (aktinos) — «nur» so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, gul qismlarining nursimon joylashishiga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: Rezavor mevalar guruhiga zaytun, zemlyanika va qulupnay, malina va maymunjon, krijovnik, smorodina hamda aktinidiya kiritiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A genus of perennial woody climbing plants in the family Actinidiaceae. The plants have simple alternate leaves and usually white or whitish flowers, and they produce fleshy berries containing numerous small seeds. Several species are cultivated for their edible fruits, particularly Actinidia chinensis and Actinidia chinensis var. deliciosa, which are associated with commercial kiwifruit production. Some Actinidia species are also grown as ornamental climbers.
etymology_en: The genus name Actinidia derives from Greek aktis (aktinos), meaning “ray”, referring to the radiating arrangement of floral structures.
example_en: The genus Actinidia, commonly known as kiwifruit, includes several economically important horticultural species. (Draft Genome of the Kiwifruit Actinidia chinensis. Huang S. et al., 2013, Nature Communications, Vol. 4, Article 2640)

definition_uz: Bir irsiy belgining muqobil yoki qarama-qarshi ko‘rinishlari bo‘lib, tarixiy Mendel genetikasida ular bir-biriga allelomorf bo‘lgan belgilar sifatida tavsiflangan. Masalan, no‘xat urug‘ining silliq va burishgan, gulining binafsha va oq kabi muqobil ko‘rinishlari allelomorf belgilar sifatida qaralgan. Zamonaviy genetikada bunday farqlar odatda bir gen lokusidagi turli allellar va ular bilan bog‘liq fenotipik belgilar orqali tushuntiriladi.
etymology_uz: Allelomorf yunoncha allēlōn («bir-biri, o‘zaro») va morphē («shakl, ko‘rinish») unsurlari asosida hosil bo‘lgan; belgi — organizmning irsiy xususiyati.
example_uz: Allelomorf belgilar bir xil allel ta’sirida hosil bo‘lganligini e’tiborga olib, ular bir xil harflar, chunonchi, A–a yoki B–b bilan ifodalanadi. (Genetika va seleksiya asoslari. Raxmatov U.E., G‘ofurov A.T., Fayzullayev S.S., 2022)
definition_en: Alternative or contrasting forms of a hereditary character, historically described in Mendelian genetics as allelomorphic characters. In modern genetics, such contrasting phenotypes are generally explained in terms of different alleles at the same gene locus and their phenotypic expression.
etymology_en: Allelomorphic is formed from allelo-, ultimately from Greek allēlōn («one another»), and -morphic, from Greek morphē («form, shape»). Character denotes a distinguishable hereditary feature.
example_en: The experiments by Gregor Mendel, which formed the background for genetics, were performed with the characters of intraspecific difference (alternative characters). (Ontogenes and the Genetics of Intraspecific Similarity, 2021)

definition_uz: Bir turga mansub genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi individlar o‘rtasida changlanish va urug‘lanish natijasida nasl hosil bo‘lishini ifodalovchi reproduktiv jarayon. O‘simliklarda allogamiya bir individ gulining changi boshqa individ gulining urug‘chisi tumshuqchasiga tushib, keyinchalik urug‘lanish sodir bo‘lishi bilan amalga oshadi. Allogamiya populyatsiyada genetik xilma-xillik va geterozigotalikning saqlanishiga yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Allogamiya termini yunoncha allos («boshqa») va gamos («nikoh, qo‘shilish») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Allogamiya yoki ksenogamiya — chetdan changlanish, urug‘chi tumshuqchasiga boshqa o‘simlikning chang donasini kelib tushishi.” (O‘simliklar sitoembriologiyasi. Davidov M.A., Imirsinova A.A., 2018)
definition_en: A mode of sexual reproduction in which fertilization occurs between genetically distinct individuals of the same species. In plants, allogamy involves the transfer of pollen from a flower of one individual to the stigma of a flower on another individual, followed by fertilization. It contributes to genetic diversity and the maintenance of heterozygosity within plant populations.
etymology_en: Allogamy derives from Greek allos (“other”) and gamos (“marriage, union”).
example_en: Allogamy occurs when fertilization of the flower of a plant is effected by pollen donated by a different plant within the same species. (Principles of Plant Genetics and Breeding. Acquaah G., 2012, 2nd ed.)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini tuproq unumdorligini saqlash va oshirish, oziq elementlaridan oqilona foydalanish, begona o‘tlar, zararkunandalar va kasalliklar tarqalishini kamaytirish maqsadida bir maydonda yillar bo‘yicha ilmiy asoslangan tartibda navbatlab yetishtirish tizimi. Almashlab ekish ekinlarning biologik xususiyatlari, tuproq-iqlim sharoiti va xo‘jalik yo‘nalishini hisobga olgan holda tashkil etiladi.
example_uz: Xo‘jalik hududida dalalar va ma’lum bir davrlar bo‘yicha madaniy ekinlarni ilmiy asosda isbotlangan navbatlab ekish almashlab ekish deb ataladi. (Dehqonchilik va melioratsiya. Norkulov U., Axmurzayev Sh., Sayimbetov A., 2019)
definition_en: The practice of growing different crops in a planned sequence on the same field over successive growing seasons or years. Crop rotation is used to maintain or improve soil fertility, manage nutrients, control weeds, pests and diseases, reduce erosion, and support sustainable crop production.
etymology_en: Crop derives from Old English cropp, while rotation derives from Latin rotatio, from rotare, meaning «to turn or revolve».
example_en: Crop rotation refers to the sequencing of crops over time on a field or planting bed. (Crop Rotation Practice Standard. United States Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Marketing Service)

definition_uz: Almashlab ekish tizimiga kiritilgan dala bo‘yicha tuproq va meliorativ sharoitlar, agrokimyoviy ko‘rsatkichlar, ekinlar tarixi, agrotexnik tadbirlar, hosildorlik hamda boshqa ishlab chiqarish ma’lumotlarini qayd etishga mo‘ljallangan hujjat. Dala pasportidagi ma’lumotlardan ekinlarni joylashtirish, tuproqqa ishlov berish, o‘g‘itlash, sug‘orish va boshqa agrotexnik tadbirlarni ilmiy asosda rejalashtirish hamda dala holatini kuzatishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Almashlab ekish dalalarining agrotexnik pasporti — har bir almashlab ekish dalasini tavsiflovchi hujjat. Brigada kartasi va dala tarixi daftarining tarkibiy qismi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. «Almashlab ekish dalalarining agrotexnik pasporti»)
definition_en: A document containing agronomic and land-reclamation information about a particular agricultural field, including data on soil properties, nutrient status, salinity, field characteristics, crop management, and other information and recommendations required for scientifically based crop production and land management.
example_en: A field passport contains basic agronomical and land reclamation information, relevant data and recommendations that are necessary for applying scientifically-based measures to decrease specific water consumption and to provide the potential productivity. (Integrated Water Resources Management: Experience and Lessons Learned from Central Asia)

definition_uz: Almashlab ekish tizimida ekinlarni belgilangan sxema va tartib asosida har bir dalaga navbat bilan ekib chiqish uchun ketadigan to‘liq davr. Rotatsiya davri odatda yillar bilan ifodalanadi va ko‘pincha almashlab ekishdagi dalalar soniga teng bo‘ladi. Rotatsiya davomida ekinlarning yillar va dalalar bo‘yicha joylashtirilishi rotatsiya jadvalida aks ettiriladi.
example_uz: Ekinlarni tartibi bilan, belgilangan tizimda har bir dalaga ekish uchun ketgan vaqt almashlab ekish rotatsiyasi yoki rotatsiya davri deyiladi. (Dehqonchilik. Djumaboyev Z.B., 2023)
definition_en: The period required to complete a planned sequence of crops grown on the same field as part of a crop rotation system. The length of a rotation cycle is expressed in years and may vary according to the crops included in the rotation, farming objectives, and local conditions.
etymology_en: Rotation derives from Latin rotatio («turning, rotation»), while cycle derives from Greek kyklos («circle»).
example_en: In this case, the farmer has a seven-year rotation cycle. (Soil Health—Importance, Assessment, and Management. New Mexico State University Cooperative Extension Service)

definition_uz: Tuproqdagi organik moddalar, xususan gumus birikmalarining minerallashuvida ishtirok etuvchi mikroorganizmlar majmuasiga asoslangan kompleks bakterial o‘g‘it. AMB dastlab torf asosida tayyorlanib, gumus moddalarini parchalovchi mikroorganizmlar faoliyati orqali o‘simliklar uchun o‘zlashtiriladigan oziq birikmalarining hosil bo‘lishini kuchaytirish va qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari hosildorligini oshirish maqsadida ishlab chiqilgan.
etymology_uz: AMB — «avtoxton mikroflora B» (ruscha «автохтонная микрофлора Б») nomining qisqartmasi.
example_uz: “Bu guruhdagi o‘g‘itlarga mikoriz, nitrogin, azoto-bakterin, fosforobakterin, AMB bakterial o‘g‘itlar kiradi.” (Ko‘chatchilik va gulchilik ishlari. Yuldashov Ya.X., 2013)
definition_en: A complex bacterial fertilizer based on a consortium of soil microorganisms associated with the mineralization of humic substances and the formation of compounds available for plant nutrition. Historically, AMB was produced using peat, mineral fertilizer, and a humate-decomposing microbial inoculum.
etymology_en: AMB is an abbreviation for "autochthonous microflora B".
example_en: Using this concept, the first iteration of the microbial consortium, called AMB (“autochthonous microflora B”), was developed in the 1930s, and was produced by composting peat, mineral fertilizer, and humate-decomposing microbial inoculum isolated from soil. (Taxonomic and Metagenomic Survey of a Peat-Based Straw Degrading Biofertilizer, 2025)

definition_uz: Jinsiy ko‘payishning urug‘lanish orqali amalga oshadigan turi bo‘lib, unda erkak va urg‘ochi gametalarning qo‘shilishi natijasida zigota hosil bo‘ladi. Amfimiksis natijasida ota-ona organizmlarining genetik materiali birlashadi va avlodlarda irsiy xilma-xillik yuzaga keladi. O‘simliklarda bu jarayon changlanish va undan keyingi urug‘lanish orqali sodir bo‘lib, seleksiya va genetikaning asosiy biologik jarayonlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Amfimiksis termini yunoncha amphi («ikki tomondan, har ikki taraf») va mixis («aralashish, qo‘shilish») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Amfimiksis gulli o‘simliklarda qo‘sh urug‘lanish shaklida sodir bo‘ladi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Amfimiksis” maqolasi)
definition_en: A form of sexual reproduction in which male and female gametes fuse to form a zygote. Amphimixis results in the recombination of parental genetic material, producing genetically diverse offspring. In plants, it occurs following pollination and fertilization and forms the basis of sexual reproduction and plant breeding.
etymology_en: Amphimixis derives from Greek amphi (“on both sides, double”) and mixis (“mixing, union”).
example_en: “While amphimixis ensures the continuous genetic variation required for long-term evolutionary adaptation, it also causes the segregation of desirable traits in high-yield heterozygous fruit crops.” (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T. et al., 2011)

definition_uz: Azotni ammiak (NH₃) shaklida saqlovchi mineral azotli o‘g‘it. Ammiakli o‘g‘itlar o‘simliklarni azot bilan ta’minlaydi, vegetativ o‘sishni jadallashtiradi, barg va poyalarning rivojlanishini kuchaytiradi hamda hosildorlikni oshiradi. Ularga suvsiz ammiak va ammiakli suv kabi o‘g‘itlar kiradi.
etymology_uz: Ammiak termini lotincha sal ammoniacum («Amon tuzi») birikmasidan kelib chiqqan + o‘g‘it.
example_uz: Ammiakli o‘g‘itlar qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini azot bilan ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi. (Agrokimyo asoslari)
definition_en: A nitrogen fertilizer that supplies nitrogen primarily in the form of ammonia (NH₃). Ammoniacal fertilizers provide nitrogen for plant nutrition and promote vegetative growth. Common examples include anhydrous ammonia and aqua ammonia.
etymology_en: Ammoniacal derives from ammonia, ultimately from Latin sal ammoniacum (“salt of Ammon”), while fertilizer derives from Latin fertilis (“fruitful, productive”).
example_en: “Applying an ammoniacal fertilizer to alkaline orchard soils requires appropriate management to minimize volatile ammonia loss and optimize root-zone nitrogen uptake.” (Principles of Plant Nutrition. Mengel et al., 2001)

definition_uz: Azotni ammoniy (NH₄⁺) va nitrat (NO₃⁻) shakllarida saqlovchi mineral azotli o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Nitrat shaklidagi azot o‘simliklar tomonidan bevosita o‘zlashtirilishi mumkin, ammoniy shaklidagi azot esa tuproqda ushlanib, nitrifikatsiya jarayonida asta-sekin nitrat shakliga o‘tadi. Bunday o‘g‘itlar turli qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilik ekinlarini azot bilan oziqlantirishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ammiak termini lotincha sal ammoniacum («Amon tuzi») birikmasidan, nitrat esa lotincha nitrum («selitra») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan + o‘g‘it.
example_uz: Oson eruvchan va serharakat bo‘lganligi sababli nitratli va ammiakli-nitratli azotli o‘g‘itlar faqat tuproqni bahorda qayta haydash davrida yoki kultivator-o‘g‘itlagich yordamida kiritiladi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A group of mineral nitrogen fertilizers containing nitrogen in both ammonium (NH₄⁺) and nitrate (NO₃⁻) forms. Nitrate nitrogen is directly available for plant uptake, whereas ammonium nitrogen can be retained in the soil and gradually converted to nitrate through nitrification. These fertilizers are used to supply nitrogen to a wide range of agricultural and horticultural crops.
etymology_en: Ammonium derives from ammonia; nitrate derives from French nitrate and Latin nitrum; fertilizer derives from Latin fertilis (“fruitful”).
example_en: In ammonium nitrate, one-half of the nitrogen is in the nitrate form, and the other half is in the ammonium form. (Nitrogen Fertilizers, University of Nebraska–Lincoln)

definition_uz: Tarkibida azot va fosfor bo‘lgan murakkab mineral o‘g‘it. Asosiy tarkibi monoammoniy fosfat (NH₄H₂PO₄) va ayrim hollarda diammoniy fosfat ((NH₄)₂HPO₄) birikmalaridan iborat bo‘ladi. Ammofos o‘simliklarni azot va fosfor bilan ta’minlaydi, ildiz tizimining rivojlanishini jadallashtiradi, o‘sish va gullashni rag‘batlantiradi hamda hosildorlikni oshiradi. U bog‘dorchilik, sabzavotchilik va dala ekinlarida asosiy hamda qator oralab oziqlantirish uchun keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ammofos nomi ammoniy va fosfat komponentlarini ifodalovchi qisqartirilgan qismlarning birikishidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Ko‘chatlarning yaxshi o‘sib rivojlanishi uchun bodom daraxti 4–5 yoshgacha, tup hisobiga 4–6 kg organik o‘g‘it, 60–80 g ammofos hisobidan o‘g‘it solish tavsiya etiladi.” (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A complex mineral fertilizer containing nitrogen and phosphorus, consisting mainly of monoammonium phosphate (MAP) and, in some formulations, diammonium phosphate (DAP). Ammophos supplies essential nitrogen and phosphorus, promotes root development, enhances plant growth and flowering, and increases crop yield. It is widely used in horticulture, vegetable production, and field crops.
etymology_en: Ammophos is formed from ammo-, representing ammonium, and -phos, representing phosphate or phosphorus.
example_en: “Broadcasting ammophos during seedbed preparation supplies the essential phosphorus starter required for vigorous cell division and uniform seedling emergence in intensive vegetable production.” (Principles of Plant Nutrition. Mengel K., Kirkby E.A., 2001)

definition_uz: Azot (N), fosfor (P) va kaliy (K)ni o‘z ichiga oladigan murakkab mineral o‘g‘it. Ammofoskaning tarkibi va oziq elementlari nisbati mahsulot markasiga qarab farqlanishi mumkin; ayrim formulalarida oltingugurt (S) va boshqa oziq elementlari ham mavjud bo‘ladi. U turli qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari, jumladan bog‘dorchilik va sabzavotchilik ekinlarini asosiy oziq elementlari bilan ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: "Kartoshka, sabzavot va mevali bog‘lar uchun xlorsiz ammofoska o‘g‘itini ekish oldidan yoki asosiy shudgorlashda qo‘llash hosil sifatini oshirib, kraxmal hamda qand miqdorining sezilarli ortishiga olib keladi." (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A complex mineral fertilizer containing nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K). Its nutrient composition and NPK ratio may vary depending on the formulation, and some grades may also contain sulfur (S) or other nutrients. Ammophoska is used to supply major plant nutrients to a range of agricultural crops, including horticultural and vegetable crops.
example_en: “The scheme experiment included 7 variants with the application of ordinary and coated fertilizers: NPK (Ammophoska), NPS (Sulphoammophos) and Urea.” (The effect of slow-release coated fertilizers on the yield of spring wheat. IOP Conference Series: Earth and Environmental Science, Vol. 1212, 2023, 012021)

definition_uz: Kimyoviy formulasi NH₄NO₃ bo‘lgan mineral azotli o‘g‘it. Tarkibidagi azot ammoniy (NH₄⁺) va nitrat (NO₃⁻) shakllarida bo‘lib, odatdagi o‘g‘it mahsulotida umumiy azot miqdori taxminan 34% ni tashkil etadi. Nitrat shaklidagi azot o‘simliklar uchun bevosita o‘zlashtiriladigan shaklda bo‘lsa, ammoniy shaklidagi azot tuproqda ushlanib, nitrifikatsiya jarayonida nitratga aylanishi mumkin. Ammoniy nitrat turli qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilik ekinlarini azot bilan oziqlantirishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ammoniy termini ammiak (lotincha ammoniacum) so‘zidan, nitrat esa lotincha nitrum («selitra») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Ekinlarni ekishdan oldin va jadal o‘sish davrida tuproqqa ammoniy nitratning V markasi kiritilsa, o‘g‘it tarkibidagi 34 foizli sof azot o‘simlikning yerustki massasi tez rivojlanishini ta’minlaydi.” (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A mineral nitrogen fertilizer with the chemical formula NH₄NO₃. Its nitrogen is present in both ammonium (NH₄⁺) and nitrate (NO₃⁻) forms, and commercial fertilizer-grade ammonium nitrate typically contains about 34% nitrogen. Nitrate nitrogen is directly available for plant uptake, whereas ammonium nitrogen can be retained in the soil and subsequently converted to nitrate through nitrification. Ammonium nitrate is used as a nitrogen source for a wide range of agricultural and horticultural crops.
etymology_en: Ammonium derives from ammonia, while nitrate derives from Latin nitrum (“natron, saltpeter”).
example_en: “Ammonium nitrate (34 percent) is 50 percent ammonium N and 50 percent nitrate N when added to the soil.” (Understanding Nitrogen in Soils. Lamb J.A., Fernandez F.G., Kaiser D.E., University of Minnesota Extension, 2014)

definition_uz: Kimyoviy formulasi (NH₄)₂SO₄ bo‘lgan, tarkibida ammoniy shaklidagi azot va oltingugurt saqlovchi mineral o‘g‘it. Ammoniy sulfat o‘simliklarni azot va oltingugurt bilan ta’minlaydi, oqsil sintezi va vegetativ o‘sishni jadallashtiradi hamda oltingugurt tanqis bo‘lgan tuproqlarda ayniqsa samarali hisoblanadi. U bog‘dorchilik, sabzavotchilik va dala ekinlarida asosiy hamda qo‘shimcha oziqlantirish uchun keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ammoniy termini ammiak (lotincha ammoniacum) so‘zidan, sulfat esa lotincha sulfur («oltingugurt») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Kartoshka ekini uchun azotli o‘g‘itlarning eng muvofiq keladigan xili ammoniy sulfat va kaliyli o‘g‘itlardan kaliy sulfat hisoblanadi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A nitrogen and sulfur fertilizer with the chemical formula (NH₄)₂SO₄. It supplies nitrogen in the ammonium form and sulfur as sulfate, promotes vegetative growth and protein synthesis, and is particularly effective in sulfur-deficient soils. It is widely used in horticultural and agricultural crop production.
etymology_en: Ammonium derives from ammonia, while sulfate ultimately derives from Latin sulfur (“sulfur”).
example_en: “The strategic baseline application of ammonium sulfate on high-pH orchard soils drastically improves the bioavailability of micronutrients such as iron and zinc, preventing developmental chlorosis.” (Principles of Plant Nutrition. Mengel K., Kirkby E.A., 2001)

definition_uz: Tok turlari va navlarini o‘rganadigan fan. Ampelografiya tok navlarining sistematikasi, tasnifi, kelib chiqishi va tarqalishini, ularning botanik, agrobiologik va xo‘jalik-texnologik belgilarini o‘rganish, tavsiflash hamda navlarni aniqlash bilan shug‘ullanadi.
etymology_uz: Ampelografiya termini yunoncha ampelos («tok, uzum») va graphia («yozish, tavsiflash») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Ampelografiya, tokshunoslik (yun. ampelos — uzum va grafiya) — tok turlari va navlarini o‘rganadigan fan.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: The scientific discipline concerned with the description, identification and classification of grapevine species and cultivars, traditionally using morphological characteristics and increasingly supplemented by molecular methods.
etymology_en: From Greek ampelos (“vine, grapevine”) and graphia (“writing, description”).
example_en: “Ampelography ... is the science of phenotypically distinguishing grapevines.” (Modern Ampelography: A Genetic Basis for Leaf Shape and Venation Patterning in Grape. Chitwood D.H. et al., Plant Physiology, Vol. 164, No. 1, 2014)

definition_uz: Uzum (Vitis spp.) bargi, novdasi, guli, g‘ujumi, mevasi va boshqa morfologik organlarining o‘lcham hamda nisbatlarini o‘lchash va miqdoriy baholash usullarini o‘rganuvchi ampelografiyaning bo‘limi. Ampelometriya uzum navlarini identifikatsiya qilish, tavsiflash, taqqoslash va seleksiya ishlarida qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ampelometriya termini yunoncha ampelos («tok, uzum») va metron («o‘lchov») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Ampelometriya – ampelografiya ishlari, ya’ni uzum navlari xususiyatlari (belgilari)ni aniqlashda qo‘llaniladigan usul. Variatsion usul bilan qo‘shib olib boriladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid atamalarning izohli lug‘ati. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qishloq xo‘jaligi vazirligi, 2023)
definition_en: A branch of ampelography concerned with the quantitative measurement of grapevine morphological characteristics, including leaves, shoots, clusters, berries, and other plant organs. Ampelometry is used for cultivar identification, characterization, comparison, and grape breeding.
etymology_en: Ampelometry derives from Greek ampelos (“vine, grapevine”) and metron (“measure”).
example_en: “Ampelometry traditionally provides linear and angular data; therefore, primary data is a set of continuous variables: the length of veins, the angles between the veins, the ratio of lengths, etc.” (A Review of Ampelometry: Morphometric Characterization of the Grape (Vitis spp.) Leaf. Bodor-Pesti P., Taranyi D., Deák T., Nyitrainé Sárdy D.Á., Varga Z., Plants, 12(3), 2023, Article 452)

definition_uz: Chirmashib yoki osilib o‘sadigan, uzun va egiluvchan novdalari pastga osilishi yoki yoyilishi mumkin bo‘lgan manzarali o‘simliklar. Ular ko‘pincha osma guldonlar, savatlar va boshqa idishlarda o‘stirilib, xona, balkon, ayvon hamda boshqa joylarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirish va bezashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ampel termini nemischa Ampel («osma chiroq; osma idish») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Uning landshaft bezagida, asosan, ampel o‘simliklaridan foydalaniladi.” (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: Plants with a trailing growth habit whose stems grow along a surface or hang down over the edges of containers. In ornamental horticulture, trailing plants are commonly grown in hanging baskets and containers for their cascading growth habit.
etymology_en: Trailing is derived from the verb trail, referring to growth that extends along a surface or hangs downward; plant derives from Latin planta through Old English and Old French.
example_en: “Some examples of trailing plants that are beautiful in hanging baskets are petunias, million bells, geraniums, Bacopa, torenias, verbenas, portulacas, helichrysums, English ivy, German ivy, potato vines, scaevolas, Bidens, angel wing begonias and Vinca vines.” (Help Your Flowers Thrive in Hanging Baskets. Pennisi B.V., University of Georgia, 2004)

definition_uz: Tokdoshlar (Vitaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik chirmashib o‘suvchi lianalar turkumi. Ampelopsis turlari uzun ingichka novdalari, mo‘ylovlari yordamida tayanchlarga ilashib o‘sishi, oddiy yoki murakkab barglari hamda mayda gullari bilan xarakterlanadi. Mevasi odatda mayda rezavor bo‘lib, ayrim turlari manzarali o‘simlik sifatida bog‘lar, devorlar, pergolalar va vertikal ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Ampelopsis nomi yunoncha ampelos («tok, uzum») va opsis («ko‘rinish, o‘xshashlik») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Ampelopsis (Ampelopsis Michx) — 23 turdan tashkil topgan. Osiyo va Shimoliy Amerikaning mo‘tadil iqlimli rayonlarida, asosan liana, ayrim hollarda buta shaklida o‘sadi.” (Uzumchilik. Temurov Sh., 2005)
definition_en: A genus of perennial climbing vines in the family Vitaceae. Ampelopsis species are characterized by slender climbing shoots with tendrils, simple or compound leaves, small flowers, and small berry-like fruits. They are mainly cultivated as ornamental plants for walls, pergolas, and vertical landscaping.
etymology_en: Ampelopsis derives from Greek ampelos (“vine, grapevine”) and opsis (“appearance, resemblance”), meaning “resembling a vine.”
example_en: “Ampelopsis is a genus of the grape family Vitaceae, discontinuously distributed in the temperate to subtropical zones of the Northern Hemisphere but mostly diversified in East Asia.” (Genomic enrichment data illuminate rapid and reticulate evolution of Ampelopsis (Vitaceae) in East Asia. Wang D., Meng Y., Zhang M.-H., Zhang L., Wen J., Nie Z.-L., TAXON, Vol. 74, 2025)

definition_uz: Uzumchilikda tuproq sharoitlarini o‘rganuvchi fan sohasi bo‘lib, tok (Vitis spp.) o‘sishi va hosildorligiga ta’sir qiluvchi tuproqning kelib chiqishi, tarkibi, fizik-kimyoviy xususiyatlari, unumdorligi hamda agroekologik holatini tadqiq qiladi. Ampelopedologiya uzumzorlarni joylashtirish, tuproqni baholash, navlarni tanlash va tok yetishtirish texnologiyalarini takomillashtirishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha ampelos («tok, uzum»), pedon («tuproq, yer») va logos («ta’limot, fan») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: “Ampelopedologiya – tokzor tuproqlari (tuproq sharoiti) haqidagi ta’limot. Turli agrotexnika usullari ta’sirida (mas. tuproqni chuqur haydash – plantaj) tuproq o‘zgaruvchanligini o‘rganadi va h.k.” (Qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid atamalarning izohli lug‘ati. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qishloq xo‘jaligi vazirligi, 2023)
definition_en: A branch of soil science related to viticulture that studies soil origin, composition, physical and chemical properties, fertility, and ecological conditions affecting grapevine (Vitis spp.) growth and productivity. Ampelopedology is important for vineyard site selection, soil evaluation, cultivar adaptation, and vineyard management.
etymology_en: Ampelopedology derives from Greek ampelos (“vine, grapevine”), pedon (“soil, ground”), and logos (“study, science”).
example_en: “Advanced research in ampelopedology demonstrates that the high calcium carbonate content in hillside soils directly influences the synthesis of aromatic compounds in specific wine grape cultivars.” (Grape Varieties and Rootstock Varieties. Galet P., 2000)

definition_uz: O‘simlik navlarini yaxshilashda mavjud nav va populyatsiyalar tarkibidagi qimmatli belgilarni aniqlash, tanlash va ajratib olishga asoslangan seleksiya usuli. Analitik seleksiyada tabiiy yoki mahalliy populyatsiyalardan xo‘jalik uchun foydali xususiyatlarga ega bo‘lgan o‘simliklar tanlab olinadi va ular asosida yangi navlar yaratiladi. Ushbu usul ko‘pincha individual tanlash va baholash jarayonlariga tayanadi.
etymology_uz: Analitik termini yunoncha analytikos («tahlil qilishga oid, ajratish») so‘zidan, seleksiya esa lotincha selectio («tanlash, saralash») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Tabiiy populyatsiya va mahalliy navlardan qimmatli belgi va xususiyatli o‘simliklarni tanlash, o‘rganish, baholash hamda ular asosida yangi navlar yaratish bilan shug‘ullanadigan seleksiya — analitik seleksiya deyiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., Ergashev I.T., Elmuradov A.A., Lukov M.K., Bekmuradova X.K., 2024)
definition_en: A plant breeding method based on identifying, selecting, and isolating valuable traits from existing varieties or populations. Analytical breeding uses evaluation and selection of superior plants from natural or cultivated populations to develop improved varieties.
etymology_en: Analytical derives from Greek analytikos (“related to analysis”), and breeding refers to the development of plants through controlled selection and reproduction.
example_en: “Through the systematic application of analytical breeding, viticulturists successfully isolated stress-tolerant clones from ancient grapevine landraces without resorting to introductory cross-breeding programs.” (Principles of Plant Breeding. Allard R.W., 1999)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simlik seleksiyasi va genetikasida dominant fenotipli organizmning genotipini aniqlash maqsadida uni gomozigot retsessiv organizm bilan chatishtirish usuli. Olingan avloddagi belgilar ajralishini tahlil qilish orqali tekshirilayotgan organizmning gomozigot yoki geterozigot ekanligi aniqlanadi.
example_uz: “Birinchi bo‘g‘in duragaylar bilan shu bo‘g‘inda belgilari ko‘zga ko‘rinmaydigan ota yoki ona organizmlarni chatishtirishga analitik yoki tahliliy chatishtirish deyiladi.” (Genetika va biotexnologiya (Genetika). Sobirov P.S., Kaxarov A.K., Xushvaqtov A.A., Shatakov E.S., 2019)
definition_en: A genetic cross between an individual showing a dominant phenotype and a homozygous recessive individual, used to determine the genotype of the dominant individual. The segregation pattern in the offspring reveals whether the tested parent is homozygous or heterozygous.
etymology_en: Test derives from Old French test, referring to examination or trial, while cross in genetics refers to mating genetically different individuals.
example_en: “Test crosses are used to study inheritance patterns and genetic variation in breeding populations.” (Principles of Plant Breeding. Allard R.W., 1999)

definition_uz: Bromeliyadoshlar (Bromeliaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik tropik o‘simlik. Ananas daraxt emas, balki qisqa poyali o‘t o‘simlik hisoblanadi. Barglari uzun, qattiq, ensiz va chetlari tikanli bo‘lib, ildiz bo‘g‘zi atrofida zich rozetka hosil qiladi. Gullari poya uchida zich to‘pgul hosil qiladi, gullashdan keyin ko‘plab gullarning qo‘shilishidan yirik murakkab meva shakllanadi. Ananas issiqsevar o‘simlik bo‘lib, tropik va subtropik hududlarda oziq-ovqat ekini sifatida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Ananas nomi Janubiy Amerikadagi tupi-guarani tillariga mansub naná so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Ananasning ildiz bo‘g‘zi barg to‘plamidan novdalar o‘sib, ularning uchida uzunligi 30–60 sm bo‘lgan gulpoya paydo bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial tropical herbaceous plant belonging to the family Bromeliaceae. Pineapple is not a tree but a short-stemmed herb with long, rigid, spiny leaves forming a dense rosette. Its flowers develop into a compact inflorescence, and the fruit is formed by the fusion of many flowers. It is widely cultivated as a tropical fruit crop.
etymology_en: The word pineapple was originally used in Middle English for a pine cone. The name was later applied to the tropical fruit because of its resemblance to a pine cone.
example_en: “Commercial pineapple cultivation relies heavily on modern vegetative propagation methods using slips or suckers to maintain genetic uniformity in high-density fields.” (Tropical Fruits. Samson J.A., 1986)

definition_uz: Ananas o‘simligi (Ananas comosus (L.) Merr.) to‘pgulidagi ko‘plab gullardan rivojlangan meva qismlarining markaziy o‘q bilan birikishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan murakkab to‘pmeva. Mevasi odatda yirik, silindrsimon yoki konussimon bo‘lib, tashqi qismi qattiq tangachasimon tuzilishga ega. Eti sersuv, xushbo‘y, shirin-nordon ta’mli bo‘lib, yangi va qayta ishlangan holda iste’mol qilinadi.
etymology_uz: Ananas nomi Janubiy Amerikadagi tupi-guarani tillariga mansub naná so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Ananas mevasi yangiligicha va qayta ishlanib, sharbat holida iste’mol qilinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The multiple fruit of the pineapple plant (Ananas comosus (L.) Merr.), formed by the fusion of fruitlets developing from numerous flowers with the central axis of the inflorescence. The fruit is usually cylindrical or conical, with a tough, scaly exterior and juicy, aromatic, sweet-acid flesh. It is widely consumed fresh and in processed products.
etymology_en: The word pineapple was originally used in Middle English for a pine cone and was later applied to the tropical fruit because of its visual resemblance to a pine cone.
example_en: “A pineapple is an example of a multiple fruit where several flowers are fused together to make one fruit.” (NC State Extension, Extension Gardener Handbook — Botany.)

definition_uz: Changlanishi asosan shamol yordamida amalga oshadigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Anemofil o‘simliklarda gullar odatda mayda, ko‘rimsiz, nektarsiz bo‘ladi; chang donalari ko‘p miqdorda hosil qilinadi, yengil va quruq bo‘lib, shamol orqali uzoq masofalarga tarqalishga moslashgan. Ularga ko‘plab daraxtlar (yong‘oq, terak, qayin), g‘alla ekinlari va ayrim o‘t o‘simliklari kiradi.
etymology_uz: Anemofil termini yunoncha anemos («shamol») va philos («sevuvchi, moyil») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Anemofil o‘simliklarning gullari mayda va ko‘rimsiz, ko‘pincha kuchala to‘pgulga birlashgan. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Plants in which pollination is mainly carried out by wind. Anemophilous plants usually have small, inconspicuous, nectarless flowers and produce large quantities of light pollen grains adapted for wind dispersal. Many trees, grasses, and cereal crops are anemophilous.
etymology_en: Anemophilous derives from Greek anemos (“wind”) and philos (“loving, attracted to”).
example_en: "Major cereal crops, including maize, wheat, and rice, are classic examples of anemophilous plants, exhibiting specialized floral architectures for wind-borne cross- and self-pollination." (Plant Systematics. Simpson M.G., 2019)

definition_uz: Urug‘lari, mevalari yoki boshqa tarqaluvchi qismlari shamol yordamida tarqaladigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Anemoxor o‘simliklarda shamol orqali tarqalishga moslashgan yengil urug‘lar, qanotchalar, tukchalar yoki parashyutsimon tuzilmalar rivojlangan bo‘ladi. Bunday tarqalish o‘simliklarning yangi hududlarni egallashi va tabiiy ko‘payishida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Anemoxor termini yunoncha anemos («shamol») va choreō («harakatlanmoq, tarqalmoq») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Ko‘pchilik o‘simliklar — tuyaqorin, kermek, saksovul, juzg‘un, chalov, qoqio‘t kabilarning urug‘i shamol yordamida tarqaladi. Bunday o‘simliklar anemoxor o‘simliklar deyiladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Plants whose seeds, fruits, or other propagules are dispersed by wind. Anemochorous plants possess adaptations such as lightweight seeds, wings, hairs, or parachute-like structures that facilitate wind dispersal and colonization of new habitats.
etymology_en: Anemochorous derives from Greek anemos (“wind”) and choreō (“to move, spread”).
example_en: "The evolution of winged samaras in anemochorous plants significantly increases seed dispersal distance by enhancing aerodynamic lift in open-canopy ecosystems." (Plant Systematics. Simpson M.G., 2019)

definition_uz: Tutdoshlar (Moraceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik subtropik meva daraxti. Anjir daraxti odatda 3–10 m balandlikka o‘sadi, shox-shabbasi keng yoyilgan bo‘ladi. Barglari yirik, navbatlashgan, panjasimon bo‘lakli, ustki tomoni dag‘al, ostki tomoni esa mayin tukli. Gullari tashqi ko‘rinishda ko‘rinmaydi, ular go‘shtdor to‘pgul — sikoniy ichida joylashadi. Anjir daraxti issiqsevar bo‘lib, qurg‘oqchilikka nisbatan chidamli va subtropik hududlarda keng yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojik tilidagi anjir (انجیر) so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Anjirning yaxshi pishgan bir yillik novdasidan qalamcha tayyorlanib ko‘paytiriladi va kamdan-kam holatlarda ildiz bachkisidan ko‘paytiriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial subtropical fruit tree belonging to the family Moraceae. The fig tree usually grows 3–10 m tall and has a broad crown with large, lobed leaves. Its flowers are enclosed inside a specialized inflorescence called a syconium. The tree is drought-tolerant and widely cultivated in subtropical regions for fruit production.
etymology_en: Fig derives from Latin ficus through Old French figue.
example_en: “The flowers are very small and contained in a hollow fleshy receptacle that resembles an unripe fig called the synconium.” (Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Edible fig — Ficus carica.)

definition_uz: Anjir daraxti (Ficus carica L.)ning iste’mol qilinadigan murakkab mevasi. Botanika jihatdan anjir mevasi sikoniy (syconium) deb ataladigan maxsus tuzilma bo‘lib, kengaygan go‘shtdor gul o‘rni ichida joylashgan ko‘plab mayda gullardan rivojlangan alohida mevalarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Anjir noksimon yoki dumaloq shaklda, yupqa po‘stli, yumshoq va shirali bo‘ladi. U yangi holda, quritilgan mahsulot sifatida hamda turli qayta ishlangan oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojik tilidagi anjir (انجیر) so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Anjirning yangi terib olingan mevalarini uzoq joyga tashish ham mumkin emas, chunki tez achib qoladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible composite fruit of the fig tree (Ficus carica L.). Botanically, the fig is a syconium, a specialized structure consisting of a fleshy receptacle that encloses numerous small flowers, which develop into individual fruits. It is usually pear-shaped or rounded, with soft, juicy flesh, and is consumed fresh, dried, or processed into various food products.
etymology_en: Fig derives from Latin ficus through Old French figue.
example_en: “The fig fruit is a composite type of fruit and consists of a receptacle tissue enclosing hundreds of individual pedicellate pistillate flowers developing into drupelets.” (Fruit Development in Ficus carica L., Frontiers in Plant Science, 2020.)

definition_uz: Anjir (Ficus carica L.) daraxtlari ekilgan, anjir yetishtirishga mo‘ljallangan bog‘ yoki plantatsiya. Anjirzorlarda daraxtlarni joylashtirish, sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, shakl berish va hosilni parvarishlash ishlari meva yetishtirish texnologiyasiga muvofiq amalga oshiriladi. Anjirzorlar subtropik hududlarda muhim mevali ekin maydonlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Hosilga kirgan anjirzorlarning har gektariga (sof modda hisobida) 120–180 kg azot, 90–120 kg fosfor va 45 kg kaliy beriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An orchard or plantation where fig trees (Ficus carica L.) are cultivated for fruit production. Fig orchards are managed through practices such as irrigation, fertilization, pruning, and crop protection to ensure high yield and fruit quality.
etymology_en: Fig derives from Latin ficus through Old French figue. Orchard comes from Old English orċeard, meaning “fruit garden.”
example_en: “Establish a fig orchard with low-cordon espalier using the Japanese Stepover method.” (Sustainable Agriculture Research and Education (SARE), Project FNE22-003.)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub shaftolining yassi mevali shakli. Daraxti o‘rtacha kuchda o‘sadi, barglari nashtarsimon, gullari pushti rangli bo‘ladi. Mevasi yassi, ikki tomondan siqilgan, likopchasimon shaklda, eti shirali va xushbo‘y. Anjir shaftoli odatda yangi iste’mol qilinadi va o‘ziga xos yassi shakli hamda yuqori ta’m sifati bilan qadrlanadi.
example_uz: Shaftoli 6 turga bo‘linadi, ulardan asosiylari quyidagilar: jaydari shaftoli, Farg‘ona shaftolisi (anjir shaftoli), David shaftolisi, Mir shaftolisi va mongol shaftolisi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A flat-fruited form of peach belonging to the family Rosaceae. The tree has typical peach characteristics, while the fruit is flattened, disc-shaped, juicy, aromatic, and valued for fresh consumption. It is known for its distinctive shape and desirable eating quality.
etymology_en: Flat derives from Old Norse flatr; peach derives from Old French pêche, ultimately from Latin persicum.
example_en: "The flat peach (Prunus persica var. platycarpa), often commercialized as Saturn or donut peach, exhibits a recessive genetic mutation governing its oblate fruit morphology." (Peach Genomics and Breeding. Dirlewanger E. et al., Horticultural Reviews, Vol. 45, 2019)

definition_uz: Anordoshlar (Punicaceae, zamonaviy tasnifda Lythraceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik subtropik meva daraxti yoki butasi. Anor daraxti odatda 3–5 m balandlikka o‘sadi, shoxlari ingichka va ayrim navlarida tikanli bo‘ladi. Barglari mayda, cho‘ziq-tuxumsimon, yaltiroq yashil rangli. Gullari yirik, qizil yoki to‘q qizil rangda bo‘lib, bahor va yoz oylarida gullaydi. Mevasi yumaloq shaklli, qalin po‘stli bo‘lib, ichida shirali urug‘oldi qoplamalari joylashadi. Anor issiqsevar va qurg‘oqchilikka nisbatan chidamli meva ekini hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Anor sovuqqa chidamsiz o‘simlik, shuning uchun ko‘pchilik maydonlarda u tuproqqa ko‘mib o‘stiriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial subtropical fruit tree or shrub belonging to the family Lythraceae. It usually grows 3–5 m tall and has small glossy leaves, attractive red flowers, and round fruits with a thick rind containing numerous juicy arils. The pomegranate tree is valued for its drought tolerance and fruit production.
etymology_en: Pomegranate comes from Old French pome grenate (“apple with many seeds”), from Latin granatum (“seeded, full of grains”).
example_en: "The pomegranate tree (Punica granatum) exhibits high environmental tolerance to drought and salinity, producing a unique multi-seeded leathery pericarp fruit rich in polyphenols." (The Pomegranate: Botany, Production and Uses. Sarkhosh A. et al., 2020)

definition_uz: Anor daraxti (Punica granatum L.)ning iste’mol qilinadigan mevasi. Mevasi dumaloq shaklda, tashqi tomoni qalin va qattiq po‘st bilan qoplangan. Ichki qismi oq pardalar bilan bo‘lingan bo‘lib, ko‘plab shirali, qizil yoki oqish urug‘oldi qoplamalari (arillar)dan tashkil topadi. Anor mevasi shirin-nordon ta’mi, yuqori oziqaviy qiymati va tarkibidagi biologik faol moddalar bilan qadrlanadi. U yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, sharbat, murabbo va boshqa mahsulotlar tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
example_uz: Anor mevasi tarkibida 8–21% gacha shakar, 0,5–5% gacha turli kislotalar, 6 mg% gacha C vitamini bor. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The edible fruit of the pomegranate tree (Punica granatum L.). It is round with a thick outer rind and contains numerous juicy red or whitish arils separated by membranes. Pomegranate fruit is valued for its sweet-tart flavor, nutritional properties, and use in fresh consumption and food processing.
etymology_en: Pomegranate derives from Old French pome grenate (“apple with many seeds”), from Latin granatum (“seeded, full of grains”).
example_en: "The pomegranate fruit is botanically categorized as a balaustium, characterized by an outer pericarp enclosing membranous septa filled with edible fleshy arils." (The Pomegranate: Botany, Production and Uses. Sarkhosh A. et al., 2020)

definition_uz: An’anaviy tasnifda Punicaceae nomi bilan alohida oila sifatida qaralgan, zamonaviy tasnifda esa Lythraceae oilasi tarkibiga kiritiladigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Uning eng mashhur vakili anor (Punica granatum L.) hisoblanadi. Anor daraxt yoki buta shaklida o‘sadi, barglari oddiy, gullari ikki jinsli va yorqin rangli bo‘lib, o‘ziga xos balausta tipidagi meva hosil qiladi.
example_uz: Anordoshlar oilasi – Punicaceae. Bu oila filogenetik jihatdan mirtadoshlar oilasiga yaqin bo‘lib, unga bitta turkumga mansub 2 ta tur kiradi. (Botanika (Yuksak o‘simliklar sistematikasi). Haydarov X.Q., Tashpulatov Y.Sh., 2020)
english: Pomegranate family (Punicaceae; now included in Lythraceae)
definition_en: A traditionally recognized plant family known as Punicaceae, now included within the family Lythraceae in modern botanical classification. Its best-known member is the pomegranate (Punica granatum L.), a tree or shrub with simple leaves, bisexual showy flowers, and a characteristic balausta fruit.
etymology_en: Pomegranate derives from Old French pome grenate, ultimately from Latin granatum (“seeded, full of grains”), while family denotes a taxonomic rank in biological classification.
example_en: “Recent advancements in angiosperm molecular systematics have reassigned the traditional family Punicaceae to a subfamilial position under Lythraceae while retaining its anatomical distinctiveness.” (Flowering Plant Families of the World. Heywood V.H., 2007)

definition_uz: Anor (Punica granatum L.) daraxtlari ekilgan, anor yetishtirishga mo‘ljallangan bog‘ yoki ekin maydoni. Anorzorlarda daraxtlarni parvarishlash, sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, shakl berish, hosilni yig‘ish va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish ishlari amalga oshiriladi. Anorzorlar issiq va subtropik hududlarda muhim mevali ekin maydonlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Yosh anorzorlar bog‘ barpo qilgandan so‘ng uchinchi yildan boshlab gektariga 25–30 t hisobidan go‘ng berilib o‘g‘itlanadi, beshinchi yildan boshlab esa har uch yilda bir marta 35–40 t dan go‘ng beriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An orchard or plantation where pomegranate trees (Punica granatum L.) are cultivated for fruit production. Pomegranate orchards require appropriate management practices, including irrigation, fertilization, pruning, and pest control, to obtain high-quality yields.
etymology_en: Pomegranate comes from Old French pome grenate, ultimately from Latin granatum. Orchard originates from Old English orċeard, meaning “fruit garden.”
example_en: "Modern drip irrigation systems and specialized pruning regimes in a commercial pomegranate orchard significantly enhance aril juice content and prevent fruit splitting." (The Pomegranate: Botany, Production and Uses. Sarkhosh A. et al., 2020)

definition_uz: Gul biologiyasini, xususan, gullarning tuzilishi, rivojlanishi, ochilishi, changlanishi, urug‘lanishi va gulning tashqi muhit hamda changlatuvchilar bilan munosabatini o‘rganuvchi botanika sohasi. Antekologiya o‘simliklarning ko‘payish jarayonlarini, gullash biologiyasini va meva hosil bo‘lishiga ta’sir qiluvchi omillarni tadqiq etadi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha anthos («gul») + oikos («uy, yashash muhiti») + logos («ta’limot, fan»).
example_uz: Antekologiya — gullash va changlanish jarayonini o‘rganadi. (O‘simliklar ko‘payish biologiyasi. Ashurmetov O.A., Qarshiboyev H.Q., 2003)
definition_en: The branch of botany that studies flower biology, including flower structure, development, anthesis, pollination, fertilization, and interactions between flowers, pollinators, and the environment. Antecology is important for understanding plant reproduction and fruit formation.
etymology_en: Ancient Greek anthos (“flower”) + oikos (“house, environment”) + -logia (“study of”).
example_en: "Modern antecology integrates chemical ecology and functional morphology to decipher how floral scent profiles guide nocturnal insect vectors to high-reward nectaries." (Pollination and Floral Ecology. Willmer P., 2011)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda uchraydigan, suvda eruvchi tabiiy pigmentlar guruhi bo‘lib, gullar, mevalar, barglar va boshqa organlarga qizil, binafsha, ko‘k kabi ranglar beradi. Antotsianlar flavonoidlar guruhiga kiradi va o‘simliklarni ultrabinafsha nurlanishdan himoya qilish, changlatuvchilarni jalb etish hamda antioksidant xususiyatlarni namoyon qilishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Mevalardan uzum, anor va rezavor mevalar tarkibida ko‘p uchraydi.
etymology_uz: Antotsian termini yunoncha anthos («gul») va kyanos («ko‘k») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Soyada pishgan mevalarda quyoshda pishganiga nisbatan antotsianlar miqdori deyarli o‘n marta kam bo‘ladi.” (Oziq-ovqat kimyosi. Karimov M., Muhamadiyev N.Q., Karimova Sh.M., 2019)
definition_en: Water-soluble plant pigments belonging to the flavonoid group that produce red, purple, and blue colors in flowers, fruits, and leaves. Anthocyanins play important roles in attracting pollinators, protecting plants from UV radiation, and providing antioxidant activity.
etymology_en: Anthocyanin derives from Greek anthos (“flower”) and kyanos (“blue”).
example_en: "Accumulation of anthocyanins in the outer juice sacs of Punica granatum is strongly governed by night-time temperatures during fruit ripening." (Anthocyanins – Nature, Occurrence and Dietary Burden. Clifford M.N., Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture, Vol. 80, No. 7, 2000)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning barg, poya yoki novda, gul va mevalarida qoramtir yoki qo‘ng‘ir, ko‘pincha botiq nekrotik dog‘ va yaralar hosil bo‘lishi bilan tavsiflanadigan zamburug‘ kasalliklari guruhi.
