Antraknoz turli qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilik ekinlarida uchrab, o‘simlikning rivojlanishi, hosildorligi va mahsulot sifatini pasaytirishi, mevalarda esa chirish va to‘qimalarning nobud bo‘lishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Antraknoz kasalliklarining ko‘pchiligini Colletotrichum turkumiga mansub zamburug‘lar qo‘zg‘atadi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha anthrax — “ko‘mir” va nosos — “kasallik” so‘zlaridan.
example_uz: Antraknoz rivojlanishiga ta’sir qiluvchi asosiy omillar harorat va havoning nisbiy namligidir. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A group of fungal diseases characterized by dark, often sunken necrotic lesions on leaves, stems, shoots, flowers, and fruits. Anthracnose affects a wide range of agricultural and horticultural crops and may reduce plant growth, yield, and product quality or cause fruit decay and tissue death. Many anthracnose diseases are caused by fungi of the genus Colletotrichum.
etymology_en: From Greek anthrax (“coal”) + nosos (“disease”).
example_en: “Anthracnose caused by Colletotrichum species affects many fruit crops worldwide.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: Inson faoliyati natijasida boshqa hududlardan olib kelingan, tarqalishi yoki yashash joylari inson ta’siri bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan o‘simliklar guruhi. Antropofitlar qishloq xo‘jaligi, bog‘dorchilik, savdo va boshqa faoliyatlar orqali yangi hududlarga kirib kelgan o‘simliklarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Ular begona o‘tlar, madaniy o‘simliklardan yovvoyilashgan turlar yoki introduksiya qilingan o‘simliklar bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha anthropos («inson») va phyton («o‘simlik») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Antropofitlar — fitotsenozdagi tasodifiy turlardir. (Botanika asoslari. Tursunboyeva G., Komilova Sh., 2009)
definition_en: Plants whose distribution is associated with human activities, including species introduced intentionally or unintentionally into new regions. Anthropophytes may include cultivated plants, escaped crops, and alien species established in human-modified habitats.
etymology_en: Anthropophyte derives from Greek anthropos (“human”) and phyton (“plant”).
example_en: "The rapid expansion of anthropophytes in agricultural ecosystems often leads to biotic homogenization and displacement of native natural vegetation." (Alien plants in checklists and floras: towards better communication between taxonomists and ecologists. Pyšek P. et al., Taxon, Vol. 53, No. 1, 2004)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organining uchki qismi. Botanika fanida apeks ildiz, poya, novda, barg yoki boshqa organlarning eng yuqori (uchki) qismi bo‘lib, odatda shu joyda apikal meristema joylashadi va organning birlamchi o‘sishi ta’minlanadi.
etymology_uz: Apeks lotincha apex — «uch», «cho‘qqi», «eng yuqori nuqta» ma’nolarini bildiradi.
example_uz: “Poyaning uchki qismida joylashgan apeks birlamchi meristemadan tashkil topgan.” (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Botirova L.A., Ergasheva N.A., 2024)
definition_en: The terminal or distal end of a plant organ. In botany, the apex is the tip of a root, stem, shoot, leaf, or other organ and usually contains the apical meristem responsible for primary growth.
etymology_en: From Latin apex, meaning “tip,” “summit,” or “highest point.”
example_en: "Continuous cell division within the shoot apex regulates both longitudinal axis elongation and regular phyllotactic organ formation." (Esau's Plant Anatomy: Meristems, Cells, and Tissues of the Plant Body: Their Structure, Function, and Development. Evert R.F., 2006)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasining sitrus (Citrus) turkumiga mansub doim yashil subtropik meva daraxti. Daraxti odatda 5–12 m balandlikka o‘sadi, shox-shabbasi zich, barglari oddiy, yaltiroq va xushbo‘y efir moylari saqlovchi bezchalarga ega. Gullari oq rangli, xushbo‘y, ikki jinsli bo‘lib, asosan bahorda gullaydi. Mevasi yumaloq yoki oval shaklli, po‘sti sariq yoki to‘q sariq rangda, eti shirali va vitamin C ga boy. Apelsin dunyoda eng keng yetishtiriladigan sitrus meva ekinlaridan biridir.
etymology_uz: Apelsin so‘zi gollandcha appelsien yoki nemischa Apfelsine («Xitoy olmasi») so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Subtropik o‘simliklardan limon, apelsin, mandarin, kivi, greyfrutlar issiqxonalarda o‘stirilib, yuqori hosil olinmoqda. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: An evergreen subtropical fruit tree belonging to the family Rutaceae. The sweet orange tree typically grows 5–12 m tall, with glossy aromatic leaves and fragrant white flowers. It produces round to oval fruits with orange-colored peel and juicy flesh rich in vitamin C. It is one of the world's most widely cultivated citrus fruit trees.
etymology_en: Orange derives from Old French orenge, ultimately from Sanskrit nāraṅga. The species epithet sinensis means “from China” in Latin.
example_en: “Sweet orange comes up well in tropical zone below 500 m.” (Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Horticulture — Fruits: Sweet Orange.)

definition_uz: Apelsin daraxti (Citrus × sinensis (L.) Osbeck)ning iste’mol qilinadigan mevasi. Mevasi yumaloq yoki oval shaklda, po‘sti sariq yoki to‘q sariq rangli, eti shirali va bo‘laklarga ajralgan bo‘ladi. Tarkibida C vitamini, organik kislotalar, qandlar, pektin moddalar va efir moylari mavjud. Apelsin mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek sharbat, murabbo, marmelad va boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda keng qo‘llaniladi. Botanika jihatdan apelsin mevasi gesperidiy (hesperidium) tipidagi rezavor meva hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Apelsin so‘zi gollandcha appelsien yoki nemischa Apfelsine («Xitoy olmasi») so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Yangi sitrus mevazorlarini barpo etishda navlarni ishlab chiqarish uchun tavsiya etiladigan nisbatda tanlash, ya’ni 70 foiz limon, 15 foiz apelsin, 10 foiz mandarin hamda boshqa sitrus mevalardan 5 foiz miqdorida ekish kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible fruit of the sweet orange tree (Citrus × sinensis (L.) Osbeck). The fruit is round to oval with an orange-colored rind and juicy segmented flesh. It is rich in vitamin C, sugars, organic acids, pectins, and essential oils. Botanically, the fruit is a specialized berry known as a hesperidium. It is widely consumed fresh and processed into juice, marmalade, and other food products.
etymology_en: Orange derives from Old French orenge, ultimately from Sanskrit nāraṅga. The species epithet sinensis means “from China” in Latin.
example_en: "The anatomical partitioning of the orange fruit into flavedo, albedo, and segment walls plays a crucial role in post-harvest processing and juice extraction mechanics." (Citrus Fruit: Biology, Technology and Evaluation. Ladaniya M.S., 2022)

definition_uz: Urug‘chilik va ko‘chatchilikda nav, urug‘lik, ko‘chat yoki boshqa ekish materialining navga xosligi, nav tozaligi, sog‘lomligi va belgilangan talablarga muvofiqligini aniqlash maqsadida o‘tkaziladigan tekshirish va rasmiy baholash jarayoni. Aprobatsiya urug‘lik va ko‘chat materialining nav sifatlarini tasdiqlash hamda sertifikatlashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Aprobatsiya lotincha approbatio («ma’qullash, tasdiqlash») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Novdasi payvandlashga olinadigan mevali daraxt oldindan aprobatsiya qilingan va serhosilligi hamda kasalliklarga chidamliligi aniqlangan bo‘lishi zarur. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The official inspection and assessment conducted in seed production and nursery practice to determine the varietal identity, varietal purity, health status, and conformity with established requirements of a variety, seed, seedling, or other planting material. Inspection is used to verify varietal quality and support the certification of seed and planting material.
etymology_en: From Latin inspectio (“examination, inspection”), from inspicere (“to look into, examine”).
example_en: At least one visual inspection shall be made each year of plants in a nursery increase block, a certified block, and a registered rootstock stool block. (California Code of Regulations, Inspection and Testing Procedures for Pome Fruit Trees)

definition_uz: Ikki yoki undan ortiq ekin turining bir maydonda bir vaqtda birgalikda ekilishi va yetishtirilishiga asoslangan ekinlar tizimi. Aralash ekinlar yer resurslaridan samarali foydalanish, hosildorlikni oshirish, tuproq unumdorligini saqlash, begona o‘tlar, kasallik va zararkunandalar ta’sirini kamaytirish hamda agroekotizim barqarorligini ta’minlashga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Aralash ekinlar nafaqat bahor-yoz faslida, balki yoz-kuz va qisholdi, erta bahor davrida ham, ya’ni yil davomida agrotsenoz mahsuldorligini oshirish va yil davomida bir necha biomassa hosili yetishtirish imkonini beradi. (Suv taqchilligi va ekinlarni aralash ekish. Ishmamatova O.Z., O‘tkirova Sh.B., Olisheva M.Q., Ta’lim innovatsiyasi va integratsiyasi, 19-son, 5-to‘plam, 2024)
definition_en: A cropping system in which two or more crop species are grown simultaneously on the same field. Mixed cropping improves resource use efficiency, enhances biodiversity, reduces pest and disease incidence, and contributes to sustainable agricultural production.
example_en: “The integration of mixed cropping inside young subtropical orchards prevents active soil denudation while improving the microclimate around developing root systems.” (Multiple Cropping Systems. Francis C.A., 1986)

definition_uz: Ikki yoki undan ortiq turdagi mineral o‘g‘itlarni mexanik aralashtirish orqali tayyorlanadigan o‘g‘itlar. Aralash o‘g‘itlar ekinlarning oziqa moddalarga bo‘lgan ehtiyojiga qarab azot, fosfor, kaliy va boshqa elementlarning zarur nisbatini ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi. Ular murakkab (kimyoviy) o‘g‘itlardan farqli ravishda kimyoviy reaksiyasiz, tayyor o‘g‘itlarni aralashtirish yo‘li bilan olinadi.
example_uz: “Aralash o‘g‘itlar bu 2 va undan ortiq oddiy o‘g‘itlarni quruq aralashtirish yo‘li bilan olingan, tarkibida 2–3 oziqa moddasi saqlaydigan o‘g‘itlarga aytiladi.” (O‘simliklar oziqlanishi va o‘g‘itlar. Sidiqov S., Sattorov J., Maxammadiyev S., Ergasheva O., 2022)
definition_en: Fertilizers produced by physically blending two or more individual fertilizer materials without chemical reaction. Mixed fertilizers are formulated to provide specific proportions of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and other nutrients according to crop and soil requirements.
example_en: “Mixed fertilizers allow growers to tailor nutrient applications to crop requirements and soil test recommendations.” (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin J.L. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: Araukariyadoshlar (Araucariaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxtlar turkumi. Vakillari baland bo‘yli, to‘g‘ri tanali, shoxlari qavatma-qavat joylashgan bo‘lib, manzarali va yog‘ochbop daraxt sifatida qadrlanadi. Ayrim turlari bog‘ va xiyobonlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda, issiqxona hamda xona o‘simligi sifatida ham yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Araukariya nomi Janubiy Amerikadagi Chili hududida yashovchi Arauco (Araucano) xalqi nomidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Araucaria – bu doimiy yashil, konifer (koniferli daraxtlar) turkumiga mansub o‘simliklar guruhi bo‘lib, oilasi Araucariaceae ga kiradi va dunyoda 20 dan ortiq yashovchi turi mavjud. (Araukariya (Araucaria) o‘simligining vegetativ ko‘payish usullari. Ishanqulova D.U., Mustafoyeva K.Sh., Latin American Journal of Education, 6(2), 2026)
definition_en: A genus of evergreen coniferous trees belonging to the family Araucariaceae. Species are characterized by tall straight trunks, regularly arranged branches, and persistent needle-like or scale-like leaves. Araucaria species are widely grown as ornamental trees and for timber production.
etymology_en: The genus name Araucaria is derived from Arauco, a region in Chile inhabited by the Araucanian people, where the genus was first described.
example_en: “Several species of Araucaria are cultivated worldwide as ornamental trees in parks and gardens.” (Citrus Fruit: Biology, Technology and Evaluation. Ladaniya M.S., 2022)

definition_uz: Daraxt va buta turlarini to‘plash, saqlash, ilmiy o‘rganish, introduksiya qilish va namoyish etish maqsadida tashkil etilgan maxsus botanika bog‘i yoki dendrologik kolleksiya. Arboretumlarda mahalliy va introduksiya qilingan yog‘ochsimon o‘simliklar sistematik, geografik yoki ekologik tamoyillar asosida joylashtiriladi. Arboretumlar ilmiy tadqiqot, ta’lim, biologik xilma-xillikni saqlash va ko‘kalamzorlashtirish maqsadlarida foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Arboretum lotincha arbor («daraxt») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, -etum qo‘shimchasi «ma’lum turdagi o‘simliklar o‘sadigan joy» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Arboretum — yer sharining turli mintaqalaridan keltirilgan daraxt-buta turlaridan barpo etilgan dendrologik bog‘. (Topiar san’atida innovatsion texnologiyalar. Xolmurotov M.Z., 2022)
definition_en: A specialized botanical garden or living collection devoted primarily to trees and shrubs for scientific research, plant introduction, conservation, education, and display. Arboreta maintain native and introduced woody plant collections arranged according to taxonomic, geographic, or ecological principles.
etymology_en: Derived from the Latin arbor (“tree”) with the suffix -etum, meaning “a place where a particular kind of plant grows.”
example_en: “The establishment of a global network of arboreta has significantly advanced the ex situ conservation of primitive fruit-bearing and coniferous gymnosperm lineages.” (Manual of Woody Landscape Plants: Their Identification, Ornamental Characteristics, Culture, Propagation and Uses. Dirr M.A., 2009)

definition_uz: Keraksiz daraxt va butalarni yo‘q qilish yoki ularning o‘sishini to‘xtatish uchun qo‘llaniladigan kimyoviy vositalar guruhi. Arboritsidlar o‘rmon xo‘jaligi, melioratsiya va qishloq xo‘jaligida daraxtsimon begona o‘simliklarni nazorat qilish maqsadida qo‘llanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha arbor («daraxt») + caedo («o‘ldiraman, yo‘q qilaman»).
example_uz: Arboritsidlar — keraksiz, begona daraxt va butalarni yo‘qotishda qo‘llanadigan kimyoviy moddalar. (Xalqaro terminelementlarning izohli-illyustrativ lug‘ati. Madvaliyev A., 2019)
definition_en: Chemical agents used to kill or suppress unwanted trees and shrubs. Arboricides are applied in forestry, agriculture, and land management to control woody vegetation.
etymology_en: Arboricide derives from Latin arbor (“tree”) and the suffix -cide, from caedere (“to cut, kill”).
example_en: "Selective application of arboricides in utility rights-of-way prevents structural encroachment while maintaining herbaceous plant cover." (Woody Plants and Woody Plant Management: Ecology, Safety, and Environmental Impact. Bovey R.W., 2001)

definition_uz: O‘simlik yoki hayvon turi, turkum yoki boshqa taksonning tabiiy ravishda tarqalgan geografik hududi. Areal tur yoki boshqa biologik birlikning uchraydigan chegaralari va tarqalish maydonini ifodalaydi. U tabiiy omillar, iqlim, tuproq va ekologik sharoitlar ta’sirida shakllanadi.
etymology_uz: Areal lotincha area («maydon, hudud») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Bir arealda uchraydigan o‘simliklarning turlari shu hududda bir tekis bo‘lmay, yashash uchun qulayroq joylarda ko‘proq, noqulay zonalarda esa kamroq uchraydi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The natural geographic area in which a species, genus, or other taxonomic group occurs. A distribution range reflects the spatial limits of occurrence of an organism under natural environmental conditions.
etymology_en: Distribution derives from Latin distribuere (“to divide or spread”), and range refers to the geographic extent of occurrence.
example_en: "Understanding the climate-induced shifts in the distribution range of wild fruit tree species is essential for developing resilient in-situ conservation strategies across mountainous ecosystems." (The Structure and Dynamics of Geographic Ranges. Gaston K.J., 2003)

definition_uz: Yillik yog‘in miqdori bug‘lanishdan ancha kam bo‘lgan, havo namligi past va qurg‘oqchilik ustunlik qiladigan iqlim turi. Arid iqlim sharoitida o‘simliklar o‘sishi asosan sug‘orishga bog‘liq bo‘lib, bog‘dorchilikda suv resurslaridan oqilona foydalanish muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Arid lotincha aridus — «quruq, suvsiz» so‘zidan, iqlim esa yunoncha klima («qiyalik, iqlim») orqali o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: “O‘zbekistonning tog‘ oldi iqlimini I.P. Gerasimov (1948) taklifi bo‘yicha arid iqlim deb atash qabul qilingan.” (Tuproqlar degradatsiyasi. Saidova M., 2023)
definition_en: A climate characterized by very low annual precipitation, high evaporation, and persistent water deficiency. In arid climates, plant growth largely depends on irrigation, making efficient water management essential for horticultural production.
etymology_en: Arid derives from Latin aridus (“dry, parched”), and climate from Greek klima (“inclination, region”).
example_en: “Fruit production in arid climates requires efficient irrigation and careful water management.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Suvni daryo, kanal, soy yoki suv omboridan ekin maydonlari, bog‘lar va boshqa xo‘jalik obyektlariga yetkazib berish uchun qazilgan sun’iy suv yo‘li. Ariqlar sug‘orish tizimining asosiy elementlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Daraxtlar biroz o‘sgandan keyin halqasimon ariqlardan emas, balki egatlardan sug‘oriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An artificial open channel constructed to convey water from a river, canal, stream, or reservoir to agricultural fields, orchards, and other areas requiring irrigation. Irrigation ditches are an important component of irrigation systems.
example_en: Drainage pipes can only be used when the water can be run to a ditch with a water level below that desired in the field. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Bamford K.M., Early M.P., 5th ed., 2008)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Sug‘orish suvi egat yoki alohida o‘simliklarga yetkazilishi uchun qazilgan tor va sayoz sun’iy suv yo‘li. Ariqcha odatda asosiy ariqdan suvni ekin yoki daraxtlarga taqsimlash vazifasini bajaradi.
example_uz: Daraxtlar o‘tqazilgach bir–ikki yil mobaynida daraxt tanasidan 0,75–1 m oraliqda olingan halqasimon ariqchalar sug‘oriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A shallow, narrow artificial channel constructed to convey irrigation water to furrows or individual plants. A small irrigation ditch typically distributes water from a main irrigation ditch or channel to crops, trees, or furrows.
example_en: “Each field is bordered along at least one side by a small irrigation ditch, which connects via one or more channels to the main irrigation channel.” (LSHTM Research Online)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Bosim ostidagi yer osti suv qatlamini ochish uchun burg‘ilangan quduq. Bunday quduqlarda suv suv o‘tkazmaydigan qatlamlar orasida bosim ostida joylashgani sababli, quduq ochilganda suv tabiiy ravishda yuqoriga ko‘tarilishi yoki yer yuzasiga chiqishi mumkin. Artezian quduqlar qishloq xo‘jaligida, ayniqsa sug‘oriladigan bog‘ va ekin maydonlarini suv bilan ta’minlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Artezian atamasi Fransiyaning Artois (lotincha Artesium) viloyati nomidan kelib chiqqan. Bu hududda XII asrda bosimli quduqlardan keng foydalanilgan.
example_uz: “Hozirgi vaqtda, qishloqlarda, ayniqsa, cho‘llarda juda ko‘p artezian (burg‘) quduqlar qazilgan. Ularning suvi aholi, sanoat korxonalari va qishloq xo‘jaliklari ehtiyojlariga sarflanadi.” (Tabiiy geografiya. G‘ulomov P., Qurbonniyozov R., 2011)
definition_en: A well drilled into a confined groundwater aquifer where water is under pressure. When the aquifer is tapped, the pressure may cause water to rise naturally above the level of the aquifer and sometimes flow at the surface.
etymology_en: The term artesian originates from Artois (Latin Artesium), a region in France known for its early artesian wells.
example_en: “Artesian wells provide groundwater resources for irrigation and domestic water supply in many regions.” (Groundwater Hydrology. Todd D.K., Mays L.W., 2005)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik sabzavot va dorivor o‘simlik. Uning iste’mol qilinadigan qismi g‘unchasi (gul to‘pguli) va gul o‘rni hisoblanadi. Artishok oziq-ovqatda, shuningdek dorivor xususiyatlari sababli foydalaniladi. O‘simlik yirik patsimon barglari va yirik gul savatchalari bilan ajralib turadi.
etymology_uz: Artishok nomi italyancha articiocco va undan oldingi arabcha al-kharshūf so‘zlari orqali Yevropa tillariga kirgan.
example_uz: Ko‘p yillik sabzavotlar: shovul, rovoch, xren, artishok va qatron. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: A perennial vegetable plant belonging to the family Asteraceae. The edible parts are the immature flower heads and receptacle. Globe artichoke is cultivated as a vegetable crop and is also valued for medicinal properties.
etymology_en: Artichoke derives from Italian articiocco, ultimately from Arabic al-kharshūf.
example_en: "Commercial cultivation of globe artichoke (Cynara cardunculus) requires precise water management and integrated pest management to maximize bud weight and cynarin yield." (World Vegetables: Principles, Production, and Nutritive Values. Rubatzky V.E., Yamaguchi M., 1997)

definition_uz: Inson faoliyati natijasida qadim zamonlarda o‘zining tabiiy arealidan tashqariga tarqalgan, uzoq vaqt davomida yangi hududlarda moslashib ketgan begona o‘simliklar guruhi. Arxeofitlar odatda qishloq xo‘jaligi, savdo va qadimgi madaniy almashinuvlar orqali tarqalgan o‘simliklarni o‘z ichiga oladi.
etymology_uz: Arxeofit termini yunoncha archaios — «qadimgi» va phyton — «o‘simlik» so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Arxeofitlar – eng qadimgi davrlardan beri o‘sib rivojlanib kelayotgan o‘simliklar. (O‘simliklar geografiyasi. Tog‘ayev I., 2023)
definition_en: Plant species introduced by humans into a region in ancient times and subsequently naturalized. Archaeophytes are alien plants that have been present in a region for a long historical period, usually before the modern era of global plant exchange.
etymology_en: Archaeophyte derives from Greek archaios (“ancient”) and phyton (“plant”).
example_en: “Archaeophytes are an important component of traditional agricultural landscapes in Europe, often introduced during early farming periods.” (Catalogue of alien plants of the Czech Republic. Pyšek P. et al., Preslia, Vol. 74, No. 2, 2002)

definition_uz: Sarvdoshlar (Cupressaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxt va butalar turkumi. Archa turlari uzoq umr ko‘rishi, qurg‘oqchilik va sovuqqa chidamliligi bilan ajralib turadi. Ular tog‘ o‘rmonlari, landshaft bog‘dorchiligi va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Soya qilib turadigan uchastkalarda soyasevar o‘simliklarni joylashtirish zarur (tatar va soxta kashtan, archa, jo‘ka daraxti, chinor, do‘lana, shilvi, kalina va boshqalar). (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A genus of evergreen coniferous trees and shrubs belonging to the family Cupressaceae. Junipers are characterized by their longevity, drought tolerance, and ecological importance. They are used in forestry, landscape gardening, and conservation.
etymology_en: The English name “juniper” comes from Latin juniperus, the classical name of the plant.
example_en: “Junipers are widely used in landscaping due to their hardiness and evergreen foliage.” (A Handbook of the World’s Conifers. Farjon A., 2010)

definition_uz: Archa (Juniperus L.) daraxt va butalari o‘sadigan tabiiy yoki sun’iy o‘rmon maydoni. Archazorlar tog‘ ekotizimlarining muhim qismi bo‘lib, tuproq eroziyasining oldini olish, suv rejimini tartibga solish va biologik xilma-xillikni saqlashda ekologik ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda archazor o‘rmonlar, asosan, uch mintaqada joylashgan: G‘arbiy Tyan-Shan; Turkiston tizmalarining g‘arbiy qismi; Hisor tizmalari va uning yon bag‘irlari. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A natural or planted woodland dominated by juniper species (Juniperus L.). Juniper woodlands are important ecosystems that provide soil protection, regulate water balance, and support biodiversity, especially in mountainous regions.
etymology_en: From juniper (Latin juniperus) + forest (Old French forest, from Latin foris “outside”).
example_en: “Juniper forests are important for preventing soil erosion in mountainous ecosystems.” (A Handbook of the World’s Conifers. Farjon A., 2010)

definition_uz: Ekin ekishdan oldin yoki ekish vaqtida tuproqqa asosiy oziqa elementlarini (azot, fosfor, kaliy va boshqa mineral moddalarni) yetkazib berish maqsadida solinadigan o‘g‘it. Asosiy o‘g‘it o‘simliklarning vegetatsiya davridagi oziqlanishini ta’minlash va tuproq unumdorligini oshirish uchun qo‘llanadi.
example_uz: Meva daraxtlarining qishki navlari asosiy o‘g‘itlarni va qo‘shimcha o‘g‘itlarni, yozgilari esa faqat asosiy o‘g‘itlarni talab qiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A fertilizer applied before planting or at planting to supply essential nutrients and improve soil fertility throughout the crop growing period. Basal fertilizers are usually incorporated into the soil before crop establishment.
etymology_en: Basal derives from Greek basis (“base, foundation”), while fertilizer comes from fertile, meaning “productive or capable of growth.”
example_en: “Basal fertilizers are incorporated into the soil before planting to provide nutrients required for early crop development.” (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin J.L. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda tashqi muhitdan qabul qilingan oddiy anorganik moddalar (asosan karbonat angidrid, suv va mineral elementlar) hisobiga murakkab organik moddalar hosil bo‘lish jarayoni. Assimilatsiya o‘simliklarning oziqlanishi, o‘sishi va rivojlanishining asosiy fiziologik jarayonlaridan biridir.
etymology_uz: Assimilatsiya lotincha assimilatio («o‘xshatish, o‘zlashtirish») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Virus kasalligiga chalingan o‘simliklarda assimilatsiya natijasida hosil bo‘lgan va kraxmalning to‘planishidan barglarning qattiqlashishi yoki mo‘rt bo‘lib qolishi kuzatiladi (lavlagining sarg‘ayishi, kartoshka bargining buralishi). (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The physiological process by which plants convert inorganic substances, such as carbon dioxide and mineral nutrients, into organic compounds. Assimilation is essential for plant growth, development, and metabolism.
etymology_en: Assimilation comes from Latin assimilatio (“making similar, absorption, incorporation”), from assimilare (“to make similar”).
example_en: “Carbon assimilation in green plants primarily occurs through photosynthesis, converting inorganic carbon dioxide into energy-rich carbohydrates like glucose.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

uzbek: Assimilatsion va so‘ruvchi yuzalarning ko‘payish (o‘sish) fazasi
definition_uz: O‘simlik rivojlanishida barglar (assimilatsion yuza) hamda ildizlarning suv va mineral moddalarni o‘zlashtiruvchi qismi (suruvchi yuza) faol ravishda shakllanib, kengayadigan rivojlanish davri. Bu fazada fotosintez intensivligi, oziqa moddalarni o‘zlashtirish va o‘simlikning vegetativ o‘sishi kuchayadi.
example_uz: Assimilyatsion va so‘ruvchi yuzalarning ko‘payish (o‘sish) fazasi — bu bir yillik ekinlarda shu davrning birinchi va yagona fazasi bo‘lib, g‘uncha va to‘pgullar ko‘rinishi, ikki yilliklarda esa jamg‘arma qismlar shakllana boshlashi bilan cheklanadi. (Sabzavotchilik va polizchilik. Zuyev V.I., Qodirxo‘jayev O., Adilov M.M., Akramov U.I., 2016)
english: Growth phase of assimilatory and absorptive surfaces
pronunciation: ɡroʊθ feɪz əv əˌsɪmɪˈleɪʃənri ənd əbˈzɔːptɪv ˈsɜːfɪsɪz
definition_en: The developmental stage in which the assimilatory surface (mainly leaves) and absorptive surface (mainly roots) increase in size and activity. This phase is important for photosynthetic capacity, nutrient uptake, and vegetative growth of plants.
example_en: “During the growth phase of assimilatory and absorptive surfaces, plants exhibit maximum photosynthetic and nutrient uptake activity.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik buta yoki chirmashuvchi manzarali o‘simliklar turkumi. Atirgullar xushbo‘y va rang-barang gullari bilan qadrlanadi hamda bog‘dorchilik, ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, gulchilik va seleksiyada keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Oddiy kurtak payvand — nastarin, atirgul va boshqa ayrim manzarali o‘simliklarning nav ko‘chatlarini olish uchun keng qo‘llaniladi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A genus of perennial flowering shrubs and climbing plants in the family Rosaceae. Roses are among the most important ornamental crops in floriculture, cultivated for cut flowers, garden decoration, greenhouse production, and breeding purposes.
etymology_en: Rose comes from Latin rosa, derived from Greek rhodon, meaning the rose flower.
example_en: “Roses are among the most widely cultivated ornamental plants in the world due to their beauty and fragrance.” (The Rose. Harkness J., 2003)

definition_uz: Fitopatogen mikroorganizmlarning (zamburug‘, bakteriya, virus va boshqalar) o‘simlikda kasallik chaqirish qobiliyatining yo‘qligi yoki juda past darajada bo‘lish xususiyati. Avirulent patogen o‘simlik xo‘jayini bilan mos kelmaydigan munosabatda bo‘lib, kuchli kasallik rivojlanishini yuzaga keltirmaydi.
etymology_uz: Avirulentlik prefiks a- («yo‘qlik, inkor») + virulentlik (lotincha virulentus — «zaharli, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: Virulentlik va avirulentlik patogenning alohida fiziologik irq (patotip, rasa)larini aniqlashda qo‘llaniladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The inability or reduced ability of a pathogen to cause disease in a particular host plant. An avirulent pathogen fails to produce disease symptoms or causes only weak symptoms due to incompatibility with the host.
etymology_en: Avirulence is formed from the prefix a- meaning “without” and virulence, from Latin virulentus (“poisonous, full of disease”).
example_en: “Avirulent strains of pathogens are often used to study plant resistance mechanisms.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: Lavrdoshlar (Lauraceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil mevali daraxt. Avokado daraxti tropik va subtropik hududlarda yetishtiriladi. Daraxtining gullari mayda, oq rangli va ikki jinsli bo‘lib, asosan hasharotlar yordamida changlanadi. Mevasi yirik, bir urug‘li, etli va oziq-ovqatda keng qo‘llaniladi. Avokado daraxti yuqori iqtisodiy ahamiyatga ega meva ekini hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Avokado nomi ispancha aguacate so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, u nahuatl tilidagi āhuacatl («avokado mevasi») so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Avokadoning madaniylashtirilgan 2 ta turi bor: Vest Indiya navlari va Meksikaning tog‘li hududlari — Gvatemaliyadan kelib chiqqan navlari. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An evergreen fruit tree belonging to the family Lauraceae. The avocado tree is cultivated in tropical and subtropical regions. Its flowers are small, white, and bisexual, and are mainly pollinated by insects. The fruit is large, single-seeded, and widely used as a food product.
etymology_en: Avocado comes from Spanish aguacate, derived from the Nahuatl word āhuacatl.
example_en: “Avocado flowers are small and bisexual, with insect pollination contributing to fruit production.” (The Avocado: Botany, Production, and Uses. Whiley A.W. et al., 2002)

definition_uz: Avokado (Persea americana Mill.) daraxtining iste’mol qilinadigan mevasi bo‘lib, shakli noksimon yoki tuxumsimon, uzunligi 10–12 sm, og‘irligi 200–400 g gacha bo‘ladi. Mevasi yumshoq, yog‘simon etli va yirik bir urug‘li bo‘lib, tarkibida naviga qarab 9–30% gacha moy, 2,1% gacha oqsil va kam miqdorda shakar mavjud. U asosan yangiligicha iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek oziq-ovqat va kosmetika sanoatida moy, krem hamda emulsiyalar tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi. Mevalari to‘liq pishmasdan yig‘ib olinadi, so‘ng 4–5 kun davomida pishib, iste’molga yaroqli holga keladi.
etymology_uz: Avokado nomi ispancha aguacate so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, u nahuatl tilidagi āhuacatl («avokado mevasi») so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Avokado uchun eng xarakterli xususiyat mevalarining pishishi uchun uzoq muddat talab etilishi bo‘lib, meva tugunchalari paydo bo‘lgandan ularning pishishigacha 6–8 oy, ayrim navlarida 11–13 oy vaqt ketadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The edible fruit of the avocado tree (Persea americana Mill.), usually pear-shaped or ovoid, 10–12 cm long and weighing 200–400 g. The fruit has soft, oily flesh and a single large seed, containing 9–30% oil, up to 2.1% protein, and a low amount of sugars depending on the cultivar. It is mainly consumed fresh and is also used in the food and cosmetic industries for producing oil, creams, and emulsions. Fruits are harvested before full ripening and soften within 4–5 days after harvest.
etymology_en: Avocado comes from Spanish aguacate, derived from the Nahuatl word āhuacatl.
example_en: “Avocado fruit is valued worldwide for its nutritional quality and is widely used as a fresh food crop.” (The Avocado: Botany, Production, and Uses. Whiley A.W. et al., 2002)

definition_uz: O‘z changi bilan changlanib, urug‘lanish va meva hosil qilish qobiliyatiga ega o‘simlik yoki nav. Avtofertil o‘simliklarda meva hosil bo‘lishi uchun boshqa nav changi talab etilmaydi, biroq ayrim hollarda chetdan changlanish hosildorlikni oshirishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos («o‘z, o‘zi») va fertil lotincha fertilis («unumdor, hosildor») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: “Avtofertil o‘simliklar — o‘zidan meva beruvchi, o‘z changi bilan changlanganda normal meva va urug‘ beruvchi o‘simliklar.” (G‘o‘za genetikasi, seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Xolmurodova G.R., Rasulov I.M., Jo‘rayev S.T., Toreev F.N., 2022)
definition_en: Describing a plant or cultivar capable of producing fruit and seeds through self-pollination without requiring pollen from another variety. However, cross-pollination may improve yield in some crops.
etymology_en: Self derives from Old English self (“one’s own”), and fertile comes from Latin fertilis (“fruitful, productive”).
example_en: “Self-fertile cultivars are valuable in commercial orchards because they do not require cross-pollinizers for fruit set.” (Horticultural Reviews, Vol. 37. Janick J., 2010)

definition_uz: O‘z changi bilan urug‘lanib, boshqa o‘simlik yoki navdan chang kelmasdan ham urug‘ va meva hosil qilish qobiliyatiga ega o‘simliklar. Mevachilikda avtofertil navlar meva hosil qilishi uchun boshqa mos changlatuvchi navning mavjudligi majburiy bo‘lmaydi, biroq ayrim hollarda chetdan changlanish meva tugishi va hosildorlikka ijobiy ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos — “o‘zi, o‘z” va fertil lotincha fertilis — “unumdor, hosildor” so‘zlaridan.
example_uz: “Mevali bog‘larni rejalashtirishda avtofertil o‘simliklar alohida blok qilib ekiladi, chunki ular chetdan changlanuvchi navlar kabi oraliq masofada changlatuvchi navlarning majburiy joylashtirilishini talab qilmaydi.” (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi. Ribakov A.A., Ostrauxova S.A., 1981)
definition_en: Plants capable of fertilization with their own pollen and of producing seeds and fruits without requiring pollen from another plant or cultivar. In fruit production, self-fertile cultivars do not require another compatible cultivar as a pollinizer for fruit production, although cross-pollination may improve fruit set or yield in some cases.
etymology_en: Self derives from Old English self (“one’s own”), and fertile comes from Latin fertilis (“fruitful, productive”).
example_en: Some fruit trees, such as ‘Victoria’ plums and ‘Stella’ cherries are self-fertile. (Fruit Pollination. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS)

definition_uz: Bir gul yoki bir o‘simlikning o‘z changi bilan changlanishi va urug‘lanishi jarayoni. Avtogamiya o‘z-o‘zidan changlanishning asosiy shakllaridan biri bo‘lib, o‘simliklarda genetik jihatdan bir xil individ ichida urug‘ hosil bo‘lishini ta’minlaydi.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos («o‘z, o‘zi») va -gamiya yunoncha gamos («nikoh, qo‘shilish») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: Avtogamiya — urug‘chining tumshuqchasiga shu gulning changdonida yetilgan chang donasining tushishi. Bunday changlanish, asosan, ikki jinsli gullarda sodir bo‘ladi. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: A type of self-pollination in which pollen is transferred from the anther to the stigma of the same flower, resulting in fertilization within the same individual plant.
etymology_en: Autogamy derives from Greek autos (“self”) and gamos (“marriage, union”).
example_en: “In isolated ecological niches, continuous autogamy provides a distinct survival advantage by ensuring seed production regardless of the local density of cross-compatible pollinizer genotypes.” (Principles of Plant Genetics and Breeding. Acquaah G., 2012)

definition_uz: O‘simlik yoki boshqa tirik organizm hujayralarining o‘z fermentlari ta’sirida parchalanishi jarayoni. Avtoliz natijasida hujayra tarkibidagi murakkab organik moddalar oddiy birikmalarga ajraladi va to‘qimalarning yemirilishi yuz beradi. O‘simliklarda bu jarayon qarish, pishish va to‘qimalarning parchalanishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos («o‘z, o‘zi») va liz yunoncha lysis («parchalanish, erish») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: Avtoliz yoki autoliz — to‘qimaning o‘z-o‘zidan parchalanishi bo‘lib, organizmdan ma’lum bir organ yoki to‘qimani ajratib olinganda va boshqarilish jarayonlari yo‘qotilganda kuzatilib, ko‘proq katabolik o‘zgarishlarda kuzatiladi. (Biologik kimyo. Jo‘rayeva A., 2014)
definition_en: The breakdown of cells or tissues by their own enzymes. In plants, autolysis may occur during senescence, fruit ripening, and tissue degradation processes.
etymology_en: Autolysis derives from Greek autos (“self”) and lysis (“loosening, dissolution, breakdown”).
example_en: “Endogenous enzymatic autolysis in postharvest agricultural commodities triggers rapid cell wall degradation and protein solubilization if environmental storage temperatures are not strictly controlled.” (Lehninger Principles of Biochemistry. Nelson D.L. et al., 2021)

definition_uz: O‘z changi bilan changlanganda urug‘lanmaydigan yoki meva hosil qila olmaydigan o‘simlik yoki nav. Avtosteril navlarda normal hosil olish uchun boshqa mos nav changi bilan chetdan changlanish talab etiladi. Bu hodisa ko‘pincha mevali daraxtlarning biologik xususiyatlari bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos («o‘z, o‘zi») va steril lotincha sterilis («naslsiz, hosilsiz») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: Ularning ba’zilari o‘zidan changlanishga salbiy munosabatda bo‘lib, urug‘lar hosil qilmaydi va bepusht yoki avtosteril bo‘ladi. (O‘simliklar sitoembriologiyasi. Davidov M.A., Imirsinova A.A., 2018)
definition_en: Describing a plant or cultivar that cannot set fruit or produce viable seeds through self-pollination and therefore requires compatible pollen from another cultivar for successful fertilization and fruit set.
etymology_en: Self derives from Old English self (“one’s own”), and sterile comes from Latin sterilis (“unfruitful, barren”).
example_en: “Most commercial varieties are self-sterile, and some combinations are incompatible, so it is critical to select varieties that are compatible.” (Growing Cherries in Virginia, Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech.)

definition_uz: Anorganik moddalardan (karbonat angidrid, suv va mineral tuzlar) foydalanib, o‘zlari uchun zarur bo‘lgan organik moddalarni mustaqil sintez qila oladigan organizmlar. O‘simliklarning yashil qismlari fotosintez orqali yorug‘lik energiyasidan foydalanib oziqa moddalar hosil qiluvchi asosiy avtotrof organizmlar hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos («o‘z, o‘zi») va trof yunoncha trophē («oziqlanish, oziqa») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: Barcha yashil o‘simliklar avtotroflar sirasiga kiradi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Organisms that produce their own organic compounds from inorganic substances such as carbon dioxide and water using light or chemical energy. Green plants are the main examples of photoautotrophic organisms.
etymology_en: Autotroph derives from Greek autos (“self”) and trophē (“nourishment, feeding”).
example_en: “Autotrophic organisms form the base of most ecosystems by converting inorganic carbon into organic matter.” (Biology of Plants. Raven P.H. et al., 2013)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organlarining tashqi ta’sir omillarisiz yoki tashqi qo‘zg‘atuvchi ta’siri tugagandan so‘ng o‘zining ichki fiziologik xususiyatlari ta’sirida ma’lum yo‘nalishda o‘sishi yoki holatini tiklashi. Avtotropizm poya va ildizlarning normal o‘sish yo‘nalishini saqlashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Avto- yunoncha autos («o‘z, o‘zi») va tropizm yunoncha tropos («burilish, yo‘nalish») so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: “O‘simlik poyasi tropik harakatlar ta’sirida bukilgandan so‘ng, qo‘zg‘atuvchi omil bartaraf etilsa, avtotropizm hodisasi natijasida o‘sish gorizonti va vertikal o‘q bo‘ylab o‘zining dastlabki tekis holatini tiklaydi.” (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The tendency of plant organs to resume or maintain their normal growth orientation through internal physiological regulation after the removal of an external stimulus. Autotropism helps shoots and roots regain their characteristic growth direction.
etymology_en: Autotropism derives from Greek autos (“self”) and tropos (“turn, direction”).
example_en: “The vegetative restructuring of trained grapevine canopies is consistently influenced by autotropism, as bent shoots naturally execute compensatory straightening to re-orient their apical meristems toward the zenith.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun zarur bo‘lgan asosiy makroelementlardan biri. Azot oqsillar, aminokislotalar, nuklein kislotalar, fermentlar va xlorofill tarkibiga kiradi hamda vegetativ o‘sish, barglarning rivojlanishi va fotosintez jarayonida muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Azot yetishmasa o‘simliklarning o‘sishi sustlashadi va barglari sarg‘ayadi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha azote (yunoncha a- «inkor / holdan toygan» + zōē «hayot» — dastlab «hayotsiz gaz»).
example_uz: Meva daraxtlarining guli, tugunchalari va barglarida azot, fosfor hamda kaliy eng ko‘p, qari tanasi va yo‘g‘on ildizlarida kamroq bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An essential macronutrient required for plant growth and development. Nitrogen is a major component of proteins, amino acids, nucleic acids, enzymes, and chlorophyll, playing a vital role in vegetative growth and photosynthesis. Nitrogen deficiency causes stunted growth and leaf chlorosis.
etymology_en: Nitrogen was coined from French nitrogène, while azote derives from Greek a- (“without”) and zōē (“life”).
example_en: “Nitrogen is the nutrient required in the largest quantities for vigorous vegetative growth in most crops.” (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin J.L. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: O‘simlik yoki tuproqqa azotli o‘g‘itlar (masalan, ammiakli selitra, karbamid va boshqa azot manbalari) berish orqali uni azot bilan ta’minlash jarayoni. Azotlash o‘simliklarning vegetativ o‘sishini kuchaytirish, barg massasini oshirish va hosildorlikni yaxshilash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha azote («hayotsiz») + -lamoq.
example_uz: Tuproqni azotlamoq. (Qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid atamalarning izohli lug‘ati, 2023)
definition_en: To supply plants or soil with nitrogen fertilizers to improve plant nutrition, stimulate vegetative growth, and increase crop productivity.
etymology_en: Nitrogen derives from French azote and Greek roots a- (“without”) + zōē (“life”); fertilization derives from Latin fertilis (“fruitful”).
example_en: “Farmers nitrogenize orchard soils in early spring to stimulate vigorous vegetative growth.” (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin J.L. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: Tarkibida erkin yashovchi Azotobacter bakteriyalari mavjud bo‘lgan mikrobiologik o‘g‘it. Tuproqda atmosfera azotini biologik usulda bog‘lab, o‘simliklarning azot bilan ta’minlanishini yaxshilaydi, tuproq unumdorligini oshiradi va o‘simliklarning o‘sishini rag‘batlantiradi.
etymology_uz: Azotobakterin nomi Azotobacter (azotni bog‘lovchi bakteriyalar turkumi) va biologik preparatlarni bildiruvchi -in qo‘shimchasidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Azotobakterin dukkaksiz o‘simliklarning azotli oziqlanishini yaxshilash uchun madaniylashgan, neytral reaksiyali hamda tarkibida yetarli miqdorda fosfor bo‘lgan tuproqqa urug‘lik bilan birga solinadi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Azotobakterin” maqolasi)
definition_en: A microbial biofertilizer containing free-living Azotobacter species that fix atmospheric nitrogen, improve soil fertility, and promote plant growth.
etymology_en: The term is derived from Azotobacter, a genus of nitrogen-fixing bacteria, and the suffix -in, commonly used in naming biological preparations.
example_en: “Seed inoculation with azotobacter biofertilizer formulations enhances rhizosphere nitrogenase activity and promotes early seedling vigor in cereal cropping systems.” (Soil Microbiology. Subba Rao N.S., 2005)

definition_uz: Tarkibida azot asosiy oziq elementi sifatida mavjud bo‘lgan mineral o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Azotli o‘g‘itlar o‘simliklarning vegetativ o‘sishini, barg va poya rivojlanishini, xlorofill hosil bo‘lishini hamda hosildorlikni oshirish uchun qo‘llaniladi. Bu guruhga ammiakli selitra, karbamid, ammoniy sulfat, ammoniy nitrat va suyuq azotli o‘g‘itlar kiradi.
example_uz: Agar meva daraxtlarining novdalari nimjon, barglari rangsiz bo‘lsa, unda azotli o‘g‘itlarning juda tez ta’sir etadiganlari — mineral o‘g‘itlar, organik o‘g‘itlardan esa najas, go‘ng shaltog‘i solinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A group of mineral fertilizers containing nitrogen as the primary plant nutrient. Nitrogen fertilizers promote vegetative growth, chlorophyll formation, leaf development, and crop productivity. Common examples include urea, ammonium nitrate, ammonium sulfate, and liquid nitrogen fertilizers.
etymology_en: Nitrogen derives from French nitrogène (related to azote), while fertilizer comes from Latin fertilis (“fruitful, productive”).
example_en: “Nitrogen fertilizers are widely used to promote vigorous vegetative growth and increase agricultural yields.” (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin J.L. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: Ekin ekishdan oldin bahor faslida amalga oshiriladigan asosiy yer haydash usuli. Bahorgi shudgor tuproqni yumshatish, namni saqlash, begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotish hamda ekin ekish uchun qulay sharoit yaratish maqsadida bajariladi.
example_uz: Bog‘larda bahorgi shudgor o‘tkazilishi tuproqning havo almashinuvini yaxshilab, daraxtlarning faol o‘sishiga yordam beradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Primary tillage carried out in spring before planting to loosen the soil, conserve moisture, control weeds, and prepare a suitable seedbed for crop establishment.
example_en: “Spring plowing helps prepare the seedbed and improves soil aeration before planting.” (The Nature and Properties of Soils. Brady N.C., Weil R.R., 2017)

definition_uz: Tarkibida o‘simliklarning oziqlanishi va o‘sishiga ijobiy ta’sir ko‘rsatuvchi tirik foydali bakteriyalar mavjud bo‘lgan biologik o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Bunday bakteriyalar atmosfera azotini biologik fiksatsiya qilish, fosfor va boshqa oziq elementlarining o‘simliklar o‘zlashtira oladigan shakllarga o‘tishini yaxshilash hamda o‘simlik o‘sishini rag‘batlantirish orqali ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Bakterial (yun. baktērion — “kichik tayoqcha”) + o‘g‘itlar
example_uz: “Bakterial o‘g‘itlar xilma-xil bo‘ladi: nitragin, azotobakterin, fosfobakterin, AMB va boshqalar.” (Mikrobiologiya va virusologiya. Raximov M.A., 2023)
definition_en: A group of biofertilizers containing beneficial living bacteria that can enhance plant nutrient availability and growth through processes such as biological nitrogen fixation, phosphate solubilization, and other plant growth-promoting activities.
etymology_en: Bacterial derives from Greek baktērion (“small rod”), while fertilizer comes from Latin fertilis (“fruitful, productive”).
example_en: The use of bacterial fertilizers has been considered as an environmentally friendly method to improve cotton yield and soil conditions. (Pulatov et al., “Effect of Biofertilizers on Growth and Yield of Cotton in Different Soil Conditions,” Cotton Genomics and Genetics, Vol. 7, 2016.)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda fitopatogen bakteriyalar ta’sirida yuzaga keladigan yuqumli kasalliklar guruhi. Bakterioz barg, poya, novda, gul, meva va ildizlarda dog‘lanish, chirish, so‘lish, yara hamda nekroz kabi belgilar bilan namoyon bo‘ladi va hosildorlik hamda mahsulot sifatini pasaytiradi.
etymology_uz: Bakterioz yunoncha bakterion («kichik tayoqcha») va -osis (“kasallik, patologik holat”) qo‘shimchasidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Bakterioz o‘simlikning poyasi, barglari va dukkaklarida och qo‘ng‘ir tusdagi moyli dog‘lar hosil qiladi, vaqt o‘tishi bilan ular kattalashib, sekin-asta quriydi. Dukkaklar yopishib ketadi va shakli bujmayib qoladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A group of infectious plant diseases caused by pathogenic bacteria. Bacteriosis affects leaves, stems, shoots, flowers, fruits, and roots, producing symptoms such as spots, rot, wilting, blight, galls, or necrosis. The disease may spread through seeds, planting material, soil, water, insects, or mechanical injuries. Prevention includes the use of healthy planting material, proper cultural practices, and bactericides when necessary.
etymology_en: Bacteriosis derives from Greek bakterion (“small rod”) and the suffix -osis, meaning “disease” or “abnormal condition.”
example_en: “Bacteriosis can lead to significant economic losses in horticultural crops due to reduced yield and fruit quality.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

uzbek: Balxi tut (Morus alba L. var. balkhi)
definition_uz: Tutdoshlar (Moraceae) oilasi, tut (Morus) turkumiga mansub, xalq seleksiyasida yaratilgan serhosil tut navi. Asosan O‘zbekistonda mevasi va bargi uchun yetishtiriladi. Mevasi yirik, oq yoki to‘q pushti, shirin, yangiligicha va quritilgan holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda undan tutmayiz, shinni va boshqa mahsulotlar tayyorlanadi. Barglari ipak qurti uchun qimmatli ozuqa hisoblanadi. Sovuqqa chidamli bo‘lib, asosan payvand qilish yo‘li bilan ko‘paytiriladi.
example_uz: Balxi tut mevasi may oyining oxirlarida pisha boshlaydi va iyun oyining o‘rtalarida tamom bo‘ladi. (Balxi tutni payvandlash usullari orqali ko‘paytirish samaradorligi va shifobaxlik xususiyatlari, 2024)
english: Balkh mulberry (Morus alba L. var. balkhi)
definition_en: Balkh mulberry (Morus alba L. var. balkhi) — a high-yielding cultivar of white mulberry belonging to the family Moraceae. It is widely cultivated in Uzbekistan for its fruits and leaves. The fruits are large, white to dark pink, sweet, and consumed both fresh and dried, and are also processed into syrup, mulberry molasses, and other traditional products. The leaves are an important feed for silkworms. This cultivar is cold-tolerant and is commonly propagated by grafting.
example_en: “The integration of Balkhi mulberry belts around irrigated orchard perimeters significantly mitigates arid wind desiccation while providing high-value organic yields.” (Horticultural Reviews, Vol. 29: Wild Apple and Fruit Trees of Central Asia. Janick J. (Ed.), 2002)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Boshoqdoshlar (Poaceae) oilasining bambuksimonlar (Bambusoideae) kenja oilasiga mansub, asosan tropik, subtropik va mo‘tadil iqlimli hududlarda tarqalgan ko‘p yillik, doimiy yashil, tez o‘suvchi daraxtsimon yoki butasimon o‘simliklar guruhi. Bambuk manzarali o‘simlik sifatida keng yetishtiriladi, shuningdek, poyasi qurilish, mebelsozlik, hunarmandchilik va boshqa xo‘jalik sohalarida qimmatli xomashyo sifatida qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Portugal tilidagi bambu so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, uning asl manbai malay tiliga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Bambuk kabi daraxtsimon o‘simliklar, ajriq kabi o‘tsimon o‘simliklar ildizpoya orqali vegetativ usulda ko‘payadi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Babayeva R.N., 2017)
definition_en: A group of perennial, evergreen, fast-growing woody grasses belonging to the subfamily Bambusoideae of the grass family (Poaceae), distributed mainly in tropical, subtropical, and temperate regions. Bamboo is widely cultivated as an ornamental plant and its culms are extensively used in construction, furniture making, handicrafts, and other industries.
etymology_en: The word bamboo derives from Portuguese bambu, ultimately of Malay origin.
example_en: “The mechanical properties of bamboo culms are dictated by the distribution density of vascular bundles within the parenchymatous matrix.” (Bamboo: The Plant and its Uses. Liese W., Köhl M., 2015)

definition_uz: Banandoshlar (Musaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik tropik o‘tsimon o‘simlik. Tashqi ko‘rinishidan daraxtga o‘xshasa-da, botanika nuqtai nazaridan haqiqiy daraxt emas. Soxta poyasi barg qinlarining zich o‘ralishidan hosil bo‘lib, balandligi odatda 2–9 m ga yetadi. Barglari yirik, cho‘zinchoq, uzunligi 2–3 m, eni 30–60 sm gacha bo‘ladi. Mevasi yirik shingillarda rivojlanadi. Tropik va subtropik hududlarda keng yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Banan atamasi portugal va ispan tillaridagi banana so‘zidan kirgan bo‘lib, uning kelib chiqishi G‘arbiy Afrika tillariga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Banan O‘zbekiston sharoitida issiqxonalarda o‘stiriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Banana plant (Musa × paradisiaca L.) — a perennial tropical herbaceous plant of the family Musaceae. Although commonly called a banana tree, it is not a true tree botanically. Its pseudostem is formed by tightly packed leaf sheaths and typically grows 2–9 m tall. The leaves are large and elongated, usually 2–3 m long and 30–60 cm wide. The fruits develop in large hanging clusters, and the plant is widely cultivated throughout tropical and subtropical regions.
etymology_en: The word banana comes through Portuguese and Spanish from a West African language.
example_en: “Commercial banana production relies heavily on micropropagation to control soil-borne pathogens like Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense.” (Bananas and Plantains. Robinson J.C. et al., 2010)

definition_uz: Banandoshlar (Musaceae) oilasiga mansub banan o‘simligining iste’mol qilinadigan mevasi. Mevasi egilgan, dukkaksimon, cho‘zinchoq va usti qovurg‘ali bo‘lib, uzunligi odatda 15–25 sm ga yetadi. Po‘sti pishish jarayonida yashildan sariq rangga o‘zgaradi. Eti yumshoq, shirin, kraxmal, uglevod, kaliy, vitamin va oziq tolalariga boy. Yangiligicha iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek quritish, sharbat, pyure va boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
etymology_uz: Banan atamasi portugal va ispan tillaridagi banana so‘zidan kirgan bo‘lib, uning kelib chiqishi G‘arbiy Afrika tillariga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Banan mevasi tarkibida 75–76% suv, 20–22% shakar, 1,6% kraxmal, 1,3% azotli moddalar, 0,4% organik kislotalar, 0,5% pektin moddalar, 0,6% kletchatka va 0,8% kul bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The edible fruit of banana plants belonging to the family Musaceae. The fruit is curved, bean-shaped, elongated, and longitudinally ridged, usually reaching 15–25 cm in length. Its peel changes from green to yellow during ripening. The pulp is soft, sweet, and rich in carbohydrates, potassium, vitamins, and dietary fiber. It is consumed fresh and used in various processed food products.
etymology_en: The word banana comes through Portuguese and Spanish from a West African language.
example_en: “Biochemical ripening of the banana fruit involves complex enzymatic degradation of cell wall pectins alongside starch hydrolyzation.” (Postharvest Biology and Technology for Preserving Fruit Quality. Valero D., Serrano M., 2010)

definition_uz: Bir urug‘pallalilar (Liliopsida) sinfi, zanjabilnamolar (Zingiberales) qabilasiga mansub o‘simliklar oilasi. Oilaga Musa va Ensete turkumlari kiradi. Asosan tropik hududlarda tarqalgan bo‘lib, yirik bargli, ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon o‘simliklardan tashkil topgan. Eng muhim vakili — banan (Musa spp.) bo‘lib, mevasi oziq-ovqat sifatida keng foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Musaceae nomi banan turkumi — Musa nomidan kelib chiqqan. Musa nomi qadimgi manbalarda banan o‘simligiga nisbatan qo‘llangan.
example_uz: Banandoshlar oilasining banan va sayyohlar daraxti yoki ravelena kabi turkumlarining vakillari keng tarqalgan. (Botanika asoslari. Tursunboyeva G., Komilova Sh., 2009)
definition_en: A family of monocotyledonous flowering plants in the order Zingiberales. It includes the genera Musa and Ensete, consisting mainly of large perennial herbaceous plants distributed in tropical regions. The family includes banana plants cultivated for their edible fruits.
etymology_en: The family name Musaceae is derived from the genus name Musa, which refers to banana plants.
example_en: “Phylogenetic studies within Musaceae confirm that the genus Musa and Ensete diverged during the Early Eocene, adapting to distinct ecological niches.” (Plant Systematics: A Phylogenetic Approach. Judd W.S. et al., 2016)

definition_uz: O‘simlik bargi, guli yoki mevasini poya bilan biriktirib turuvchi ingichka tayanch qism. Barg bandi barg plastinkasini poyaga bog‘laydi, meva bandi esa mevani novda yoki to‘pgul o‘qiga biriktiradi.
etymology_uz: Band so‘zi fors-tojik tilidan o‘zlashgan bo‘lib, «bog‘langan qism, tutqich» ma’nolarini bildiradi.
example_uz: Barglar – barg shapalog‘i, barg bandi va barg yonligidan iborat. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A slender supporting structure that attaches a leaf, flower, or fruit to the stem or inflorescence axis. A leaf stalk is called a petiole, while a fruit stalk is called a pedicel or fruit stalk.
etymology_en: Stalk derives from Old English stalu (“stem, support”), while petiole comes from Latin petiolus (“little foot”).
example_en: “The fruit remains attached to the branch by a stalk that transports water and nutrients during development.” (Raven Biology of Plants. Evert R.F., Eichhorn S.E., 2013)

definition_uz: Tomatdoshlar (Solanaceae Juss.) (ituzumgullilar) oilasi, ituzum — Solanum L. turkumiga mansub issiqsevar bir yillik sabzavot ekini. Poyasi tik o‘suvchi, barglari yirik, gullari binafsha rangli bo‘lib, mevasi yirik, cho‘zinchoq yoki tuxumsimon shaklda bo‘ladi. Mevasi oziq-ovqatda keng ishlatiladi.
etymology_uz: Baqlajon atamasi fors-tojikcha bādenjān so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Pomidor, kartoshka, qalampir, baqlajonlar −2°C haroratda nobud bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: A warm-season vegetable crop belonging to the family Solanaceae. It is an annual herbaceous plant with erect stems, large leaves, purple flowers, and large oval or elongated edible fruits.
etymology_en: The word eggplant refers to the egg-shaped fruits of some varieties, while aubergine comes from French, ultimately derived from Sanskrit vātiṅgaṇa.
example_en: “The targeted application of potassium-rich biofertilizers to eggplant (Solanum melongena L.) plots enhances internal anthocyanin accumulation, improving the visual density of the exocarp.” (Vegetable Crops. Decoteau D.R., 2000)

definition_uz: Meva morfologiyasida ikki yoki undan ortiq guldan rivojlangan, bir-biri bilan qisman yoki to‘liq qo‘shilib ketgan qo‘shaloq meva shaklini bildiradi.
etymology_uz: Baraka so‘zi arabcha baraka («ko‘payish, mo‘l-ko‘llik») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Baraka novdaning aynan bir bo‘g‘imida hosil bo‘lgan ikki yoki uch gulbandning bir-biriga to‘liq qo‘shilib rivojlanishi oqibatida sodir bo‘ladi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Baraka” maqolasi)
definition_en: A type of fruit structure in fruit morphology and pomology that develops from two or more flowers, with the fruits partially or completely fused together. It results from the fusion of two or more independent pedicels and their associated ovaries formed at the same node of a branch during fruit development.
example_en: The most common physiological disorders seen on stone fruit are split and shattered pits, double fruit and cleft sutures, fruit buttons, blind wood and delayed foliation. (Physiological Disorders and Their Management in Stone Fruits. Khan F.A., Bhat S.A., 2017)

definition_uz: Danagi olinib quritilgan oʻrik qoqi. Bargakning qaysa, kesilgan, boʻlingan, dudlanmagan xillari bor.
etymology_uz: Forscha – danaksiz quruq meva
example_uz: “Ushbu ishda majburiy konveksiyali quyosh quritgichida o‘rikdan yuqori sifatli turshak, bargak (qaysa) va kuraga tayyorlash jarayoni tahlil etildi.” (O‘rik mevasini majburiy konveksiyali quyosh quritgichida quritish vaqtini hisoblash. Ilm-fan va innovatsion rivojlanish, 2-son, 2024)
definition_en: A dried apricot product from which the stone (pit) has been removed before drying. Several types of dried pitted apricots are produced, including qaysa, cut dried apricot, split dried apricot, and unsulfured dried apricot.
example_en: “Dried pitted apricots are widely consumed because of their high nutritional value and storage stability.” (Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops. Kader, 2002)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning vegetativ organi bo‘lib, asosan fotosintez, nafas olish va suv bug‘latish (transpiratsiya) jarayonlarini amalga oshiradi. Barg odatda barg bandi, barg plastinkasi va tomirlar tizimidan tashkil topadi. Shakli, kattaligi va tuzilishi o‘simlik turiga qarab farqlanadi.
example_uz: Barg mevali daraxtlarda fenologik o‘sish davrining (gullash, meva tugish, mevalarning shakllanishi va pishishi, novdalarning o‘sishi) o‘tishi uchun eng muqobili bu havo haroratining 15–30°C darajada bo‘lishidir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A vegetative organ of plants primarily responsible for photosynthesis, respiration, and transpiration. A typical leaf consists of a petiole, leaf blade (lamina), and vascular system. Leaf structure, shape, and size vary among plant species.
example_en: “The leaf is the principal organ responsible for photosynthesis in most vascular plants.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Barg plastinkasining poyaga yoki barg bandiga tutashgan quyi qismi. Barg asosi bargning poyaga birikishini ta’minlaydi va ayrim o‘simliklarda barg qo‘ltig‘i, qin yoki yonbargchalar hosil bo‘lishida ishtirok etadi.
example_uz: Barg asosi bilan novdaga birlashib turadi. Barg bandi barg asosi va yaprog‘ining orasida hosil bo‘ladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The basal part of a leaf where the leaf blade joins the petiole or attaches to the stem. The leaf base may contribute to structures such as leaf sheaths or stipules in some plants.
example_en: “The identification of ambiguous plum cultivars in western nurseries is highly reliant on micro-morphological traits observed specifically at the leaf base and the adjacent petiole glands.” (Biology of Plants. Raven P.H. et al., 2005)

definition_uz: Barg plastinkasini poya bilan biriktirib turuvchi ingichka silindrsimon qism. Barg bandi bargni yorug‘likka yo‘naltirish, barg plastinkasini tutib turish va suv hamda oziq moddalarni o‘tkazishda ishtirok etadi. Ayrim o‘simliklarda barg bandi rivojlanmagan bo‘lib, bunday barglar bandsiz (o‘troq) barglar deyiladi.
example_uz: Payvand uchun kerakli ona daraxtlardan bir yillik novdalar qirqib keltiriladi va payvand qilish uchun 4–5 mm uzunlikda barg bandi qoldirilib, qolgan qismi olib tashlanadi va namlangan lattalarga o‘raladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The slender stalk that connects the leaf blade to the stem. The petiole supports the leaf blade and facilitates the transport of water, minerals, and photosynthates between the leaf and the plant stem.
etymology_en: Petiole comes from Latin petiolus, meaning “little foot” or “small stalk.”
example_en: “The petiole attaches the leaf blade to the stem and may vary in length among plant species.” (Biology of Plants. Raven P.H. et al., 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simlik barglarining shakli va yuzasi buzilib, burishishi, qiyshayishi yoki g‘ijimlanishi bilan namoyon bo‘ladigan fiziologik yoki patologik holat. Barg bujmayishi virus, bakteriya, zamburug‘ kasalliklari, zararkunandalar, oziq moddalar yetishmovchiligi yoki noqulay tashqi muhit ta’sirida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: Shaftoli bargining bujmayishi zamburug' kasalligi shaftoli barglari va mevalarini zararlaydi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A disorder or disease symptom characterized by the curling, twisting, puckering, or distortion of leaves. It may result from pathogens, insect damage, nutrient deficiencies, or environmental stress.
example_en: “Leaf curl is a common symptom of several plant diseases and can significantly reduce photosynthetic efficiency.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simlik barglarida turli shakl, rang va kattalikdagi dog‘larning paydo bo‘lishi bilan namoyon bo‘ladigan kasallik belgisi yoki patologik holat. Barg dog‘lanishi ko‘pincha zamburug‘, bakteriya va viruslar ta’sirida, shuningdek oziqa moddalari yetishmovchiligi yoki noqulay ekologik sharoitlar natijasida yuzaga keladi.
example_uz: “Gilos va olxo‘ri plantatsiyalarida klasterosporioz qo‘zg‘atuvchi zamburug‘lar ta’sirida yuzaga keladigan teshik barg dog‘lanishi vegetatsiya davrining boshida daraxtlarning umumiy quvvatini keskin zaiflashtiradi.” (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A plant disease symptom characterized by the appearance of spots of different shapes, sizes, and colors on leaves. Leaf spots are commonly caused by fungi, bacteria, viruses, nutrient deficiencies, or environmental stresses.
example_en: “Leaf spot diseases are among the most common foliar diseases affecting horticultural crops worldwide.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simlik barglarining chetlari yoki yuzasida qo‘ng‘irlanish, qurish va nekroz belgilari paydo bo‘lishi bilan ifodalanadigan fiziologik yoki patologik holat. Barg kuyishi yuqori harorat, kuchli quyosh nuri, suv tanqisligi, sho‘rlanish, oziqa moddalari yetishmovchiligi yoki ayrim kasalliklar ta’sirida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: “Barg kuyishi. Bu dastlab o‘xshash bo‘lishi tuyg‘usini beradi mayda jigarrang dog‘lar, barglarining qirralariga tarqalgan sariq rangdagi izolalar va boshqalar.” (Sabzi o‘simligiga tushadigan zararkunanda va kasalliklarga qarshi kurash choralari. Turdiyeva M., Sobirov S., Journal of New Century Innovations, Vol. 14, Issue 1, 2022)
definition_en: A physiological or pathological disorder in which leaf margins or surfaces become brown, dry, and necrotic due to heat stress, drought, salinity, nutrient imbalance, or certain diseases.
example_en: “Leaf scorch, nutritional deficiencies, spotting (not related to disease), tip necrosis, and premature shedding of leaves are common symptoms you might be seeing now, especially on newly planted trees and shrubs.” (Leaf Scorch. Clement D., North Carolina Cooperative Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlik barg to‘qimalarining nobud bo‘lishi bilan kechadigan patologik holat. Barg nekrozi barg yuzasida jigarrang yoki qora dog‘lar, qurish va to‘qimalarning o‘lishi ko‘rinishida namoyon bo‘ladi. U zamburug‘, bakteriya, virus kasalliklari, oziqa moddalari yetishmovchiligi, zaharlanish, sovuq, issiq yoki suv stresslari ta’sirida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Nekroz yunoncha nekros («o‘lik, jonsiz») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, to‘qimalarning o‘lishini bildiradi.
example_uz: “Intensiv bog‘larda fungitsidlar me’yoridan ortiq qo‘llanilganda, dori tomchilari tekkan joylarda kimyoviy barg nekrozi shakllanib, barg yuzasining umumiy fotosintez potensialini 25–30 foizga kamaytiradi.” (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The death of leaf tissues, appearing as brown or black lesions, drying, and tissue collapse. Leaf necrosis may result from pathogens, nutrient deficiencies, toxins, temperature extremes, drought, or other environmental stresses.
etymology_en: Necrosis derives from Greek nekros (“dead body, corpse”), referring to the death of cells or tissues.
example_en: “The diagnostic manifestation of manganese toxicity in acidic orchard soils is the appearance of dark brown interveinal leaf necrosis across the older canopy.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: Bargning kengaygan, yassi va asosiy fotosintez jarayoni amalga oshadigan qismi. Barg plastinkasi tomirlar tizimi bilan qoplangan bo‘lib, uning shakli, kattaligi, cheti va yuzasi o‘simlik turiga qarab farqlanadi.
example_uz: Agar barg plastinkasi o‘rta tomirga nisbatan 1/3 qismi qirqilgan bo‘lsa bo‘lakli barg deyiladi. Ularga: chinor, anjir, g‘o‘za, terak barglari. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The broad, flat part of a leaf where most photosynthesis takes place. The leaf blade contains veins and varies in shape, size, margin, and surface among plant species.
etymology_en: Blade derives from Old English blæd (“leaf, blade”), while lamina comes from Latin lamina (“thin plate, layer”).
example_en: “The total surface area of the leaf blade directly influences the net carbon dioxide assimilation rate and overall water-use efficiency of the fruit tree canopy.” (Raven Biology of Plants. Evert R.F. et al., 2013)

definition_uz: Barg plastinkasida joylashgan, ksilema va floema kabi o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalardan tashkil topgan tomirsimon tuzilma. U suv va mineral moddalarni barg to‘qimalariga yetkazish, fotosintez mahsulotlarini bargdan o‘simlikning boshqa qismlariga tashish hamda barg plastinkasiga mexanik tayanch berish vazifalarini bajaradi.
example_uz: G‘o‘za bargida bu tukchalar, asosan, barg tomiri ustiga joylashgan bo‘ladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: A vascular structure in the leaf blade composed primarily of xylem and phloem. It conducts water and mineral nutrients to leaf tissues, transports photosynthetic products from the leaf to other parts of the plant, and provides mechanical support to the leaf blade.
etymology_en: Leaf derives from Old English lēaf, while vein derives from Latin vēna (“vein, blood vessel”).
example_en: “The ‘veins’ in leaves are primary vascular bundles. They transport water and photosynthates via primary xylem and primary phloem.” (Leaves: Venation, University of California, Davis)

definition_uz: O‘simlik barglari umumiy yuzasining shu o‘simlik egallagan yer maydoni yuzasiga nisbatini ifodalovchi ko‘rsatkich. Barg sathi indeksi (BSI) ekinlarning fotosintetik imkoniyati, o‘sish jadalligi, hosildorligi va ekinzorning biologik samaradorligini baholashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Barg sathi indeksi (BSI) fotosintez jarayonining jadal yoki sust borishida muhim rol o‘ynaydigan asosiy ko‘rsatkich hisoblanadi. (Dukkakli ekinlarda barg sathi o‘zgarishini aniqlash va barg sathi indeksining ahamiyati. Isayeva S.R., Oriental Renaissance: Innovative, Educational, Natural and Social Sciences, 5(9), 2025)
definition_en: The ratio of total leaf area of plants to the ground area occupied by the plants. Leaf area index is used to evaluate photosynthetic capacity, crop growth, light interception, and productivity of plant communities.
example_en: “Mathematical optimization of the leaf area index through precise mechanical pruning is crucial for maximizing net primary productivity in intensive apple orchards.” (Plant Physiology. Taiz L., Zeiger E., 2006)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni oziq elementlari eritmasini barg yuzasiga purkash orqali oziqlantirish usuli. Bunda oziq moddalar barg epidermisi va og‘izchalari orqali o‘simlikka singadi. Ushbu usul mikroelementlar yetishmovchiligini tez bartaraf etish va o‘simliklarning o‘sishi hamda hosildorligini oshirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Gilos bog‘larida temir tanqisligi oqibatida kelib chiqadigan xlorozga qarshi xelat shaklidagi mikrog‘itlar bilan bargdan oziqlantirish tadbiri o‘tkazilganda, 3–4 kundan keyin barglarning tabiiy yashil rangi qayta tiklanadi.” (O‘g‘itlar qo‘llash agrotexnologiyasi, 2011)
definition_en: A method of supplying nutrients to plants by applying fertilizer solutions directly to the leaves, where nutrients are absorbed through leaf tissues. It is used to correct nutrient deficiencies and improve plant growth, yield, and quality.
etymology_en: Foliar derives from Latin folium (“leaf”); feeding comes from Old English fēdan (“to nourish, give food”).
example_en: “Foliar feeding is an effective way to correct micronutrient deficiencies in horticultural crops.” (Marschner’s Mineral Nutrition of Higher Plants. Marschner P. (Ed.), 2012)

definition_uz: Barg epidermisida joylashgan, gaz almashinuvi va suv bug‘lanishini boshqaruvchi maxsus tuzilma. Og‘izcha ikki dona loviyasimon qo‘riqchi hujayradan tashkil topadi va ular orasidagi teshik orqali karbonat angidrid kirishi, kislorod hamda suv bug‘ining chiqishi amalga oshadi.
example_uz: “Qurg‘oqchilik sharoitida o‘simlik barglarida abssiz kislotasi sintezi keskin ortadi, bu esa barg og‘izchalarining tezda yopilishini ta’minlab, transpiratsiya orqali suv yo‘qotilishini kamaytiradi.” (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: A microscopic pore in the epidermis of leaves and other plant organs that regulates gas exchange and water loss. Each stoma is surrounded by two guard cells that control the opening and closing of the pore.
etymology_en: Stoma comes from Greek stoma (“mouth”), referring to the mouth-like opening in plant tissues.
example_en: “The dynamic regulation of the stomatal pore by abscisic acid is a critical survival mechanism that coordinates the trade-off between carbon assimilation and transpirational cooling during severe atmospheric droughts.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: O‘simlik barglarining tabiiy ravishda yoki tashqi omillar ta’sirida poyadan ajralib tushishi jarayoni. Barg to‘kilishi (abssiziya) ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarda mavsumiy hodisa bo‘lib, qarish, sovuq, qurg‘oqchilik, kasallik yoki stress omillari ta’sirida ham yuz berishi mumkin.
example_uz: “Barg to‘kilishidan oldin uning asosida ajratuvchi yoki bo‘linuvchi qavati shakllanadi.” (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Tursinbayeva I.S., Duschanova I.M., 2018)
definition_en: The process of leaf detachment and fall from a plant, occurring either as a natural seasonal phenomenon or in response to stress, diseases, pests, or adverse environmental conditions. It is an important adaptive mechanism in many plant species, helping to reduce water loss, improve tolerance to unfavorable conditions, and regulate plant growth and survival.
example_en: “Premature leaf fall can significantly reduce plant vigor and fruit production.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning barg chiqarishi, barg hosil qilishi yoki barg bilan qoplanishi jarayonini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha daraxt va butalarning vegetatsiya davrida yangi barg yozishi ma’nosida qo‘llanadi.
example_uz: O‘simlik past bo‘yli, determinant tipda, o‘rtacha barglaydi. (Takroriy ekin sifatida pomidor Finish navini turli ekish usullarida o‘stirish texnologiyasi va mavzuni o‘qitish uslubi. Saydimusayeva Z.S., 2014)
definition_en: To produce or develop leaves, especially at the beginning of the growing season. The term refers to the emergence and expansion of new leaves on a plant.
example_en: “Fruit trees leaf out rapidly in spring as temperatures rise and growth resumes.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Asosiy iste’mol qilinadigan qismi bargi bo‘lgan sabzavot ekinlari guruhi. Ularga salat, ismaloq, shovul va boshqa bargi uchun yetishtiriladigan sabzavotlar kiradi. Bargli sabzavotlar vitaminlar, mineral moddalar, oziq tolalari va biologik faol birikmalarga boy bo‘lib, yangi yoki qayta ishlangan holda iste’mol qilinadi.
example_uz: Barcha bargli sabzavotlarda, ayniqsa piyoz va bodringda suv miqdori yuqoridir. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A group of vegetable crops grown primarily for their edible leaves. They include lettuce, spinach, sorrel, and other vegetables cultivated mainly for their foliage. Leafy vegetables are rich in vitamins, minerals, dietary fiber, and bioactive compounds and may be consumed fresh or processed.
example_en: “The integration of automated climate controls in vertical farms allows for the precise modulation of secondary metabolites in leafy vegetables, maximizing both yield and antioxidant concentrations.” (Knott’s Handbook for Vegetable Growers. Maynard D.N. et al., 2007)

definition_uz: So‘ri yoki ishkomning tik poyalariga ko‘ndalang o‘rnatiladigan yoki bog‘lanadigan yog‘och yoxud boshqa materialdan tayyorlangan tayanch qism. Bag‘az tok novdalari va ularni tutib turuvchi simlarni joylashtirish hamda so‘ri yoki ishkom konstruksiyasini shakllantirishga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Forscha bag‘az — "pona, yog‘och qoziq" ma’nosidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Tok ishkomi qurilayotganda bag‘azlar mustahkam bog‘lanib, novdalarni tutib turuvchi tayanch vazifasini bajaradi. (Uzumchilik asoslari, Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: A horizontal structural member attached to a trellis post to support and position wires, foliage, shoots, or other components of a grapevine training system.
example_en: Crossarms for foliage support first appeared in California table grape vineyards in the 1930s. (Training-Trellis Systems and Canopy Management of Table Grapes in California. Peacock W.L., Jensen F.L., Dokoozlian N.K., University of California Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning ildiz bo‘yni, ildiz yoki yer osti poyalaridan hosil bo‘ladigan yosh novda. Bachkilar ko‘pincha mevali daraxtlar va tok tuplarida asosiy o‘simlikdan tashqarida o‘sib chiqadi. Ular ba’zan ko‘paytirish uchun foydalaniladi, ba’zan esa o‘simlikning oziqa moddalarini sarflashi sababli olib tashlanadi.
example_uz: Ba’zan tokning shu yil hosil qilgan asosiy novdalari tagidan chiqqan bachki novdalar ko‘payib ketadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
