definition_en: A vigorous shoot arising from the root system, root collar, or underground stem of a plant. Suckers may be used for vegetative propagation or removed because they compete with the main plant for nutrients.
example_en: “Sucker shoots should be removed regularly to improve tree vigor and fruit production.” (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T. et al., 2011)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning ildiz bo‘yni, ildiz yoki yer osti poyalaridan yangi bachkilar (yosh novdalar) hosil qilishi. Bu hodisa ayrim o‘simliklarda tabiiy vegetativ ko‘payish jarayoni sifatida kuzatiladi, ammo mevali daraxt va tokda ortiqcha bachkilar o‘simlik oziqa moddalarini sarflashi sababli olib tashlanadi.
example_uz: Oddiy olchaning turlaridan biri — Samarqand olchasi olchaning madaniy navlari uchun yaxshi payvandtag bo‘ladi, ildiz bachkilari chiqaradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: To develop or produce sucker shoots from roots, the root crown, or the lower stem of a plant. This process is common in many fruit trees and shrubs and may contribute to vegetative propagation.
example_en: “Some plum trees readily produce suckers, forming dense clonal colonies around the parent plant.” (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T. et al., 2011)

definition_uz: Tokdoshlar (Vitaceae) oilasiga mansub, urug‘siz qora kishmish uzum navi va undan tayyorlanadigan mayiz. Bedona uzum mevalari mayda yoki o‘rta kattalikda, shirador, shirin va danaksiz bo‘lib, asosan yangi iste’mol qilish hamda yuqori sifatli mayiz tayyorlash uchun yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha be- («-siz», inkor yuklamasi) va dona («urug‘, danak, don») birikishidan tarkib topgan.
example_uz: Quritiladigan eng yaxshi navlar quyidagilardir: urug‘siz navlardan — Oq kishmish, Qora kishmish, Askari, Bedona, Lo‘nda kishmish, Xishrav kishmish. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch., Merganov A.T., Umidov Sh.E., Abdullayev Z.I., 2022)
definition_en: A cultivated grape variety of the species Vitis vinifera L., valued for its seedless or nearly seedless berries, sweet taste, and suitability for fresh consumption and raisin production.
etymology_en: The name bedona is derived from Persian-Tajik bedona, meaning “without seeds,” referring to the seedless character of the variety.
example_en: “The Central Asian grape cultivar ‘Bedona’ (Vitis vinifera L.) serves as a key genetic resource in breeding programs aiming to combine natural stenospermocarpic seedlessness with high soluble solid content.” (Viticulture in Uzbekistan: A Tradition of Excellence. Jumaniyozov F.Q., Mirzaev M., 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Tutdoshlar (Moraceae) oilasi, tut (Morus) turkumiga mansub oq tut turi yoki navlaridan biri. Mevasi mayda yoki o‘rtacha kattalikda, odatda oq rangli, shirin va urug‘siz yoki kam urug‘li bo‘ladi. Bedona tut mevasi yangiligicha iste’mol qilinadi, quritilib tutmayiz tayyorlanadi. Barglari ipak qurti boqishda ham foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Bedona fors-tojikcha bedona («urug‘siz, donasiz») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Ba’zi navlari (Balxi tut, Bedona tut, Marvarid tut, Xo‘roz tut, Tojikiston urug‘siz tuti)ning mevasi esa puch urug‘li yoki urug‘siz bo‘ladi. (Ipakchilik va tutchilik. Bekkamov Ch.I., Daniyarov U.T., Abdiqayumova N.K., Rajabov N.O., 2018)
definition_en: A cultivar or form of white mulberry (Morus alba L.) belonging to the family Moraceae. It is valued for its sweet, seedless or nearly seedless fruits, which are consumed fresh or dried. Its leaves are also used for silkworm feeding.
etymology_en: The name bedona originates from Persian-Tajik bedona meaning “seedless.”
example_en: “Seedless mulberry cultivars are appreciated for their soft texture and pleasant sweetness.” (Biosystematics and Breeding of Mulberry. Dandin S.B., Giridhar K., 2010)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Ekinlar, bog‘lar, uzumzorlar va boshqa madaniy o‘simliklar orasida o‘z-o‘zidan o‘sib, ulardan oziqa moddalari, suv, yorug‘lik va yashash maydoni uchun raqobat qiladigan yovvoyi o‘simliklar. Begona o‘tlar hosildorlikni pasaytiradi, kasallik va zararkunandalar tarqalishiga sharoit yaratishi mumkin.
example_uz: Ko‘chatlarning ildizi yer yuziga yaqin joylashganidan yerni muntazam o‘g‘itlab, begona o‘tlardan tozalash va o‘z vaqtida sug‘orib turish kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Unwanted plants growing among cultivated crops, orchards, vineyards, or gardens, competing with them for water, nutrients, light, and space. Weeds may reduce crop yield and serve as hosts for pests and diseases.
etymology_en: Weed comes from Old English wēod, meaning a plant or herb, later acquiring the meaning of an unwanted plant.
example_en: “The timely application of pre-emergence herbicides significantly suppresses the germination of broadleaf weeds without affecting the main cereal crop.” (Weed Science: Principles and Practices. Monaco T.J. et al., 2002)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub mevali daraxt. Daraxti uzoq umr ko‘radi, odatda 3–6 m balandlikda o‘sadi, qurg‘oqchilikka nisbatan chidamli. Barglari yirik, gullari bahorda (aprel–may oylarida) barg yozishi bilan bir vaqtda ochiladi. Gullari yirik (diametri 4–5 sm), yakka joylashgan, oq yoki och pushti rangli bo‘ladi. Kech gullashi sababli bahorgi qorasovuqlardan nisbatan kam zararlanadi. Mevasi yirik, sariq rangli, xushbo‘y bo‘lib, yangi holda va qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Behi so‘zi fors-tojikcha bihī so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Behi eng qadimiy o‘simlik bo‘lib, Markaziy Osiyoda keng tarqalgan. Behining balandligi 1,5 metrdan 8 metrgacha yetadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A long-lived fruit tree belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is drought-tolerant and usually grows 3–6 m tall. The flowers appear in spring (April–May) simultaneously with leaf emergence; they are large (4–5 cm in diameter), solitary, white or pale pink. Its late flowering helps reduce damage from spring frosts. The tree produces large, aromatic yellow fruits used for fresh consumption and processing.
etymology_en: Quince derives from Old French coing, from Latin cotoneum malum (“quince apple”).
example_en: “The quince tree (Cydonia oblonga Mill.) exhibits a fibrous root system that responds exceptionally well to vegetative propagation, making it the industry standard rootstock for intensive pear orchards.” (Biology of Apples and Pears. Jackson J.E., 2003)

definition_uz: Behi daraxtining (Cydonia oblonga Mill.) soxta meva tipiga mansub mevasi. Mevasi yirik, olmasimon yoki noksimon shaklda, po‘sti sarg‘ish, yuzasi mayin tukli, eti zich va xushbo‘y bo‘ladi. Ta’mi nordon-shirin bo‘lib, tarkibida pektin, organik kislotalar va biologik faol moddalar mavjud. Asosan yangi holda, shuningdek murabbo, jem, sharbat, kompot va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Behi so‘zi fors-tojikcha bihī so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Yong‘oq, nok va behining mevasi soxta meva, anjir va tut mevasi to‘p mevadir. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The fruit of the quince tree (Cydonia oblonga Mill.). It is large, apple- or pear-shaped, yellow, aromatic, and has firm flesh with a sweet-tart flavor. Quince fruits are consumed fresh and widely used for making jams, jellies, juices, and other processed products.
etymology_en: Quince derives from Old French coing, from Latin cotoneum malum (“quince apple”).
example_en: “Quince fruit is highly valued for its high pectin content, making it particularly suitable for jelly and preserve production.” (The Encyclopedia of Fruit and Nuts. Janick J., Paull R.E. (Eds.), CABI, 2008)

definition_uz: Behi daraxtlari (Cydonia oblonga Mill.) ekilgan bog‘ yoki plantatsiya. Behizorlar meva yetishtirish maqsadida tashkil etilib, ularda behi daraxtlarini parvarishlash, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish va hosil yig‘ib olish ishlari amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: “Hozirgi vaqtda uning bir qator yangidan-yangi navlari yetishtirilib behizorlar tashkil qilingan.” (Behi o‘simligining shifobaxsh xususiyatlarining ilmiy asoslanganligi va xalq tabobatidagi ahamiyati. Ibrohimov A.N., Rahimjonova M.I. Scientific Progress, 2025)
definition_en: An orchard or plantation planted primarily with quince trees (Cydonia oblonga Mill.) for commercial or household fruit production.
etymology_en: Quince comes from Old French coing; orchard derives from Old English ortgeard, meaning a garden or enclosed area for trees.
example_en: “Establishment of commercial quince orchards requires rigorous monitoring for fire blight (Erwinia amylovora) and precise rootstock selection to optimize fruit quality and tree longevity.” (Temperate-Zone Pomology: Physiology and Culture. Westwood M.N., 1993)

definition_uz: O‘rta Osiyoda yaratilgan o‘rtapishar, vinobop uzum navi (Vitis vinifera L. ‘Behishti’). Sharqiy ekologik-geografik guruhga mansub. Uzum boshi yirik, silindr-konussimon, g‘ujumlari dumaloq, sarg‘ish-yashil yoki och qahrabo rangda, sershira va xushta’m. Asosan vino va sharbat tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Behishti nomi fors-tojikcha behisht («jannat, go‘zal maskan») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Xuddi shunday, hovli chor atrofida tokzor barpo qilingan bo‘lib, ayniqsa, serhosil oq-qora kishmishi, toyfi, husayni, behishti uzum navlariga mansub ishkomdagi hosil cho‘g‘i har yilgidan mo‘lroq ko‘rinadi. (Olot: Umidjon Jumayevning mirishkorligi va “yashil xonadoni” — ko‘plarga ibrat. Buxoro viloyati hokimligi Matbuot xizmati, 2025)
definition_en: A mid-season wine grape cultivar developed in Central Asia (Vitis vinifera L. ‘Behishti’). It belongs to the Eastern ecological-geographical group. The bunches are large and cylindrical-conical, with round berries of yellowish-green or light amber colour, juicy and palatable. It is mainly used for wine and juice production.
etymology_en: The cultivar name derives from Persian-Tajik behisht (“paradise”), referring to its desirable qualities.
example_en: “Behishti is a traditional Central Asian grape cultivar used for producing wine and grape juice.” (Viticulture in Uzbekistan: A Tradition of Excellence. Jumaniyozov F.Q., Mirzaev M., 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, bog‘ qulupnayi (Fragaria × ananassa Duch.) turiga kiruvchi nav. Behtar navi yirik va xushbo‘y mevalari, yaxshi ta’mi hamda yuqori hosildorligi bilan qadrlanadi. Mevalari yangiligicha iste’mol qilinadi va qayta ishlash (murabbo, sharbat va boshqa mahsulotlar) uchun foydalaniladi.
example_uz: “Behtar II — qulupnayning yirik bir navi.” (Qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid atamalarning izohli lug‘ati. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qishloq xo‘jaligi vazirligi, 2023)
definition_en: A large-fruited strawberry cultivar valued for its high yield, attractive appearance, pleasant flavor, and suitability for fresh consumption and processing.
example_en: “The locally selected strawberry cultivar ‘Behtar’ (Fragaria × ananassa Duch.) exhibits strong physiological tolerance to high solar radiation and moisture deficit during the peak fruiting phase.” (Study and Acclimatization of Local and Introduced Strawberry Varieties in the Condition of Uzbekistan. Abdullaeva Kh.R., 2021)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Tuproq qazish, ag‘darish, ko‘chat o‘tqazish, chuqur ochish va boshqa bog‘dorchilik ishlarida foydalaniladigan qo‘l mehnati quroli. Belkurak odatda dastasi va keng metall kurak qismidan iborat bo‘lib, tuproqni ko‘tarish va ko‘chirish uchun ishlatiladi.
example_uz: Kuzda, oktabr boshida esa ekilgan urug‘larning asosiy ildizi belkurak bilan qirqiladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A hand tool consisting of a handle and a broad metal blade, used for digging, lifting, turning, and moving soil in gardening and agricultural activities.
etymology_en: Spade comes from Old English spadu (“digging tool”).
example_en: “Manual spading with a sharp garden spade remains an essential soil aeration technique in small-scale horticultural plots and fruit orchards.” (The Biology of Apples and Pears. Jackson J.E., 2003)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasi, Sitruslar (Citrus) turkumiga mansub, bo‘yi 3–10 metrgacha yetadigan doimiy yashil kichik daraxt o‘simlik turi. Daraxti barglari yaltiroq, gullari oq va xushbo‘y. Mevasi yumaloq yoki biroz yassi shaklda, po‘sti qalin va to‘q sariq rangda bo‘ladi. Mevasi nordon-achchiq ta’mli bo‘lib, asosan payvandtag sifatida, shuningdek, manzarali va dorivor o‘simlik sifatida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Bigaradiya nomi fransuzcha bigarade so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, achchiq apelsin mevasini bildiradi.
example_uz: Sitrus mevali ekinlar: apelsin, limon, mandarin, greypfrut, Bigaradiya (achchiq apelsin), trifoliata. Bigaradiyaning botanik nomi — Citrus aurantium L. (O‘zbekistonda intensiv mevachilik va uzumchilikning dolzarb muammolari va zamonaviy yutuqlari. Sattorov O.O., Mamatqulov A.V., 2023)
definition_en: An evergreen citrus tree belonging to the family Rutaceae. The tree has glossy leaves, fragrant white flowers, and round or slightly flattened fruits with thick orange peel. The fruit has a sour-bitter taste and is mainly used as a rootstock for citrus cultivation, as well as for ornamental and medicinal purposes.
etymology_en: The botanical name Citrus aurantium comes from Latin, where aurantium means “golden” or “orange-coloured”.
example_en: “Citrus aurantium L. (sour or bitter orange) serves as a vital genetic resource and rootstock in commercial citriculture due to its adaptability to calcareous soils.” (Citrus. Davies & Albrigo, Crop Production Science in Horticulture, CAB International)

definition_uz: Seleksiyada o‘simliklarning bevosita xo‘jalik belgilarini emas, balki ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan boshqa belgilarni (morfologik, fiziologik, biokimyoviy yoki genetik xususiyatlarni) baholash orqali amalga oshiriladigan tanlash usuli. Ushbu usul qimmatli belgilarni aniqlash qiyin bo‘lgan hollarda, masalan, kasallikka chidamlilik yoki hosildorlik potensialini baholashda qo‘llanadi.
example_uz: Ilmiy tadqiqotlarda qayd etilishicha, belgilar o‘rtasidagi korrelyatsion bog‘liqlik genotiplarni baholashda muhim ko‘rsatkichlardan biri bo‘lib, u seleksiya uchun muhim belgilarni aniqlash va bilvosita tanlash (indirect selection) imkonini beradi. (Sabzavot loviya genotiplarida fenologik belgilar o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlik va korrelyatsion tahlil. Dadaxo‘jayev H.T., Xamidullayev T.X., Agro ilm – O‘zbekiston qishloq va suv xo‘jaligi, Maxsus son 1 [123], 2026)
definition_en: A selection method in plant breeding where individuals are chosen based on traits correlated with the desired character rather than the character itself. It is used when the target trait is difficult or expensive to measure directly.
etymology_en: Indirect comes from Latin indirectus (“not direct”); selection comes from Latin selectio (“a choosing”).
example_en: “Indirect selection based on physiological indicator traits, such as canopy temperature depression, enhances yield stability under drought conditions in perennial fruit crops.” (Introduction to Quantitative Genetics. Falconer D.S., Mackay T.F.C., 1996)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Binafshadoshlar (Violaceae) oilasiga mansub, ko‘p yillik, xushbo‘y gulli o‘simlik. Poyasi qisqa, barglari yuraksimon, gullari binafsha, ko‘kimtir-binafsha yoki oq rangda bo‘ladi. Erta bahorda gullaydi, manzarali o‘simlik sifatida bog‘ va gulzorlarda yetishtiriladi. Gullari tarkibidagi efir moylari sababli parfyumeriya va xalq tabobatida ham qo‘llanadi.
etymology_uz: Binafsha so‘zi fors-tojikcha banafsha so‘zidan o‘zlashgan bo‘lib, o‘simlik nomini va uning rangini bildiradi.
example_uz: Violaning bog‘ shakllari — uch rangli binafsha va ayrim boshqa turlarini gibridlash va tanlash natijasida kelib chiqqan. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A perennial fragrant flowering plant of the family Violaceae. It has heart-shaped leaves and purple, bluish-purple, or white flowers. It is cultivated as an ornamental plant and valued for its fragrance.
etymology_en: The genus name Viola comes from Latin viola, meaning violet.
example_en: “Species of the genus Viola are widely utilized in pharmaceutical research due to their rich accumulation of bioactive cyclotides and antioxidant flavonoids.” (Mabberley’s Plant-Book: A Portable Dictionary of Plants. Mabberley D.J., 2017)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini himoya qilishda foydalaniladigan foydali tirik organizmlar (entomofag hasharotlar, mikroorganizmlar va boshqa biologik vositalar)ni ko‘paytirish va tayyorlash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi maxsus korxona. Biofabrikalarda zararkunandalarga qarshi biologik kurash vositalari ishlab chiqariladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha bios — “hayot” va lotincha fabrica — “ustaxona”, “ishlab chiqarish joyi”.
example_uz: Respublikamizda 700 dan ortiq biolaboratoriya va biofabrikalar mavjud bo‘lib, ularda bir necha xil entomofaglar ko‘paytirilib, ishlab chiqarishga joriy etilmoqda. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: An industrial facility where biological products such as microorganisms, biofertilizers, biopesticides, vaccines, or other biotechnology-based materials are produced on a large scale.
etymology_en: Derived from Greek bios (“life”) and Latin fabrica (“workshop, place of production”).
example_en: “Industrial biofactories utilizing automated mass-rearing protocols have significantly reduced the unit cost of producing parasitoid wasps like Trichogramma spp. for pest control.” (The State of Commercial Augmentative Biological Control: Plenty of Natural Enemies, but a Frustrating Lack of Uptake. van Lenteren J.C., 2012)

definition_uz: Biologik kurash vositalarini, jumladan foydali hasharotlar (entomofaglar), mikroorganizmlar va boshqa biologik preparatlarni ko‘paytirish, o‘rganish hamda tayyorlash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi maxsus laboratoriya. Biolaboratoriyalarda zararkunandalarga qarshi ekologik xavfsiz kurash usullari uchun biologik vositalar yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha bios — “hayot” + lotincha laboratorium (“mehnat qilinadigan joy, ustaxona”).
example_uz: Respublikamizda 700 dan ortiq biolaboratoriya va biofabrikalar mavjud bo‘lib, ularda bir necha xil entomofaglar ko‘paytirilib, ishlab chiqarishga joriy etilmoqda. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A specialized laboratory where biological control agents, such as beneficial insects, microorganisms, or biological preparations, are produced, studied, and maintained for pest management.
etymology_en: Bio- derives from Greek bios (“life”); laboratory comes from Latin laboratorium (“a place for work or experiments”).
example_en: “The establishment of decentralized field biolaboratories has optimized the release schedules of beneficial mites in organic orchard systems.” (Integrated Pest Management in the Tropics. Abrol D.P. (Ed.), 2014)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini zararkunandalardan himoya qilishda tirik organizmlar (entomofaglar, mikroorganizmlar, antagonistlar) va ularning mahsulotlaridan foydalanishga asoslangan kurash usuli. Bu usul zararkunandalar sonini tabiiy dushmanlar yordamida kamaytiradi va ekologik xavfsiz himoya choralaridan biri hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Biologik — yunoncha bios («hayot») va logos («ta’limot») so‘zlaridan; himoya — fors-tojikcha himoya («saqlash, asrash»); usul — arabcha usul («yo‘l, tamoyil»).
example_uz: “G‘o‘za maydonlarida tunlamlarga qarshi biologik himoya usulini qo‘llash, kimyoviy ishlovlar sonini kamaytirish barobarida agrobiotsenozdagi foydali faunani to‘liq saqlab qolish imkonini beradi.” (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A pest management method that uses living organisms or their products to reduce pest populations and protect crops. It includes the use of predators, parasitoids, pathogens, and other biological agents.
etymology_en: Biological comes from Greek bios (“life”) and logos (“study”); control comes from Old French contreroller (“to check, regulate”).
example_en: “Biological control methods reduce pest populations by using natural enemies instead of relying solely on chemical pesticides.” (The State of Commercial Augmentative Biological Control. van Lenteren J.C., 2012)

definition_uz: Ekin yoki o‘simlik tomonidan vegetatsiya davrida hosil qilingan umumiy biomassa miqdori. Biologik hosil iqtisodiy jihatdan foydalaniladigan hosil qismi bilan birga poya, barg va boshqa o‘simlik qismlarini ham qamrab oladi. U odatda quruq modda miqdori asosida baholanadi.
etymology_uz: Biologik — yunoncha bios («hayot»); hosil — arabcha ḥāṣil («olingan narsa, natija») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Dukkakli don ekinlarining biologik hosili maydonning turli joyidan belgilangan namuna maydonchalari (1/4 m²) dan o‘rim-yig‘im oldidan olingan ekin bog‘lari tekshirish yo‘li bilan aniqlanadi.” (O‘simlikshunoslik. Yaqubjonov O., Tursunov S., 2008, 184-b.)
definition_en: The total biomass produced by a crop during its growth period, including the economically useful yield and other plant components such as stems and leaves. Biological yield is commonly expressed on a dry-matter basis.
etymology_en: Biological derives from Greek bios (“life”); yield comes from Old English gieldan (“to give, produce”).
example_en: “The biological yield (t/ha on a dry weight basis) for the ‘high yield’ treatment was 13.6 in rice, 18.6 in winter wheat, 22.4 in maize, 11.5 in soybean, and 17.7 in potato.” (Productivity of High-Yielding Crops, Soil Science and Plant Nutrition, 1991)

definition_uz: Tarkibida tirik organizmlar (bakteriyalar, zamburug‘lar, viruslar), ularning metabolitlari yoki biologik faol moddalar saqlovchi, qishloq xo‘jaligida o‘simliklarni himoya qilish, o‘sishini rag‘batlantirish va oziqlanishini yaxshilash uchun qo‘llaniladigan vositalar. Biologik preparatlarga bioinsektitsidlar, biofungitsidlar, bakterial o‘g‘itlar va o‘sish stimulyatorlari kiradi.
etymology_uz: Biologik — yunoncha bios («hayot») so‘zidan; preparat — lotincha praeparare («tayyorlamoq») fe’lidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Biologik preparatlar, biopreparatlar — qishloq xo‘jaligida [...] o‘simliklarni zararkunanda va kasalliklardan himoya qilish, tuproq unumdorligini oshirishda qo‘llaniladigan biologik vositalar.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Biologik preparatlar” maqolasi)
definition_en: Products containing living organisms, their metabolites, or biologically active substances used in agriculture to protect plants, improve growth, and enhance nutrient availability.
etymology_en: Biological comes from Greek bios (“life”); preparation comes from Latin praeparare (“to prepare”).
example_en: “The integration of microbial biological preparations into the spray schedules of organic apple orchards significantly restricted the proliferation of secondary mite outbreaks.” (The Manual of Biocontrol Agents: A World Compendium. Copping L.G. (Ed.), 2009)

definition_uz: Bir tur, kenja tur yoki populyatsiya doirasida muayyan irsiy, fiziologik yoxud ekologik belgisi bilan boshqa guruhlardan farqlanadigan organizmlar guruhi. O‘simliklarni himoya qilishda biotiplar zararkunandalarning insektitsidlarga chidamliligi yoki xo‘jayin o‘simliklarni zararlash qobiliyati, patogenlarda esa virulentlik kabi belgilar asosida ajratiladi.
etymology_uz: Bio- — yunoncha «bíos» — «hayot», tip — yunoncha «týpos» — «iz, namuna, shakl» so‘zlaridan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Mikroorganizmlarda esa bir hujayrali kulturalarga biotiplar deyiladi. Har qanday biotipda bitta hujayradan yoki bitta sporadan hosil bo‘lgan mikroorganizmlar guruhi tushuniladi. (O‘simliklar immuniteti. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Rahimov U.X., 2007)
definition_en: A subdivision of a species, subspecies, race, or population distinguished by an identifiable biological trait, such as a particular virulence pattern, host response, feeding characteristic, or resistance to a pesticide.
etymology_en: Bio- derives from Greek «bíos», meaning «life»; type derives from Greek «týpos», meaning «impression, model, or form».
example_en: Each aphid biotype has a unique phenotypic fingerprint—the way in which it damages a specific group of resistant and susceptible plants—that allows Burd to tell them apart. (Aphid Collection: A Resource for Researchers. Agricultural Research, USDA Agricultural Research Service, 2010)

definition_uz: Har bir poyasida yoki novdasida odatda bitta gul hosil qiladigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Bunday o‘simliklarda gul yakka holda joylashadi va to‘pgul hosil qilmaydi. Bir gulli o‘simliklarga ayrim manzarali va yovvoyi o‘simlik turlari kiradi.
example_uz: “Bir gulli o‘simliklar — bitta g‘uncha chiqarib, bitta gul va bitta meva hosil qiluvchi o‘simliklar. Bunday o‘simliklarning poyasi shoxlanmay, uchidan yolg‘iz kurtak chiqaradi, masalan, lola, ko‘knor, qizg‘aldoq, parnassiya va boshqalar.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Bir gulli o‘simliklar” maqolasi)
definition_en: Plants that produce individual flowers singly rather than forming an inflorescence. Each flower develops separately on a stem or flower stalk.
etymology_en: Solitary comes from Latin solitarius (“alone”); flower comes from Latin flos (“flower”).
example_en: “In contrast to species displaying complex inflorescences, solitary-flowered plants allocate photosynthetic resources into developing a single, highly conspicuous terminal bloom.” (Plant Form: An Illustrated Guide to Flowering Plant Morphology. Bell A.D., Bryan A., 2008)

definition_uz: Erkak va urg‘ochi gullari bir o‘simlik individining o‘zida, ammo alohida gullar yoki to‘pgullarda joylashgan o‘simliklar guruhi. Bunday o‘simliklarda changlanish ko‘pincha shamol yoki hasharotlar yordamida amalga oshadi. Misol sifatida makkajo‘xori, yong‘oq, qovoqdoshlar oilasining ayrim vakillari keltiriladi.
example_uz: Bir jinsli gullar bitta o‘simlikda bo‘lsa bir uyli o‘simliklar deyiladi, ularga makkajo‘xori, yong‘oq kabi o‘simliklar misol bo‘ladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Hamdamov I.H., Hamdamova E.I., Suvonova G.A., Begmatova M., 2017)
definition_en: Plants in which male and female flowers are produced on the same individual plant but in separate flowers or inflorescences.
etymology_en: Monoecious comes from Greek monos (“one”) and oikos (“house”), meaning “one house.”
example_en: (Raven Biology of Plants. Evert R.F., Eichhorn S.E., Raven P.H., 2013)

definition_uz: Hayot siklini bir vegetatsiya davri (bir yil) ichida tugatadigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Ular urug‘dan unib chiqadi, o‘sadi, gullaydi, meva va urug‘ hosil qiladi hamda vegetatsiya oxirida nobud bo‘ladi. Bir yillik o‘simliklarga ko‘plab sabzavot, don va gul ekinlari kiradi.
example_uz: Shivit — seldereylar oilasiga mansub bir yillik o‘simlik bo‘lib, barglari, poyasi va urug‘larida o‘ziga xos xushbo‘ylik mavjud. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Plants that complete their entire life cycle—from germination to flowering, seed production, and death—within one growing season or one year.
etymology_en: Annual comes from Latin annus (“year”), referring to a one-year period.
example_en: “Annual plants complete their life cycle within a single growing season and must be replanted from seed each year.” (Raven Biology of Plants. Evert R.F., Eichhorn S.E., Raven P.H., 2013)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, o‘rik (Prunus armeniaca L.) turiga kiruvchi qadimiy mahalliy nav. Daraxti kuchli o‘sadi, serhosil va mahalliy sharoitga moslashgan. Mevalari o‘rtacha yirik, shirali, xushbo‘y bo‘lib, yangi iste’mol qilish hamda quritish (turshak tayyorlash) uchun yaroqli. Nav xalq seleksiyasi natijasida shakllangan bo‘lib, mevasining sifati va qayta ishlashga yaroqliligi bilan qadrlanadi.
example_uz: Quritiladigan navlarning eti zich, sariq rangli, tarkibida qand ko‘p va kislota kam bo‘ladi. Bularga, asosan, quyidagi O‘rta Osiyo navlari kiradi: «Subhoni», «Mirsandjali», «Xurmai», «Isfarak», «Qaysi», «Ko‘rsodiq», «Boboi», «Zarafshon kechkisi», «Qandak» va boshqalar. (Tovarshunoslik. Normahmatov R., Otamurodov K., Ahmedjonova F., Maqsudov T., 2004)
definition_en: An ancient local apricot cultivar belonging to the family Rosaceae. The tree is vigorous and productive. Its fruits are medium to large, juicy, and aromatic, suitable for fresh consumption and drying for dried apricots. The cultivar was developed through traditional folk selection and is valued for fruit quality and processing suitability.
etymology_en: ‘Boboyi’ is a traditional Uzbek cultivar name originating from local selection.
example_en: “The ‘Boboyi’ apricot cultivar, originating from traditional Central Asian folk breeding, exhibits excellent soluble solid content and processing characteristics suitable for high-grade sun-drying.” (Diversity and Evaluation of Apricot Cultivars in Uzbekistan. Abdullaev A. et al., 2018)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

uzbek: Bobuna (Matricaria chamomilla L. / Chamomilla recutita (L.) Rauschert)
definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik dorivor va efir moyli o‘simlik. Gullari oq rangli tilchasimon va sariq rangli naychasimon gullardan tashkil topgan bo‘lib, o‘ziga xos xushbo‘y hidga ega. Bobuna xalq tabobati va farmatsevtikada keng qo‘llaniladi. Ayrim hollarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida ham yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Kunjut yog‘idan bir misqol, sariq yo‘ng‘ichqa va yuvib soyada quritilgan bobuna gullarining har biridan ikki uqiyadan olinadi va shisha idishda ivitib, qirq kungacha oftobga qo‘yib qo‘yiladi-da, keyin iste’mol qilinadi.” (Ibn Sino ta’limoti. Nurboyev F., 2010)
english: Chamomile (Matricaria chamomilla L. / Chamomilla recutita (L.) Rauschert)
definition_en: An annual aromatic medicinal plant of the family Asteraceae. It has finely divided leaves and flower heads with white ray florets and yellow disc florets. It is widely used in herbal medicine, cosmetics, and perfumery.
etymology_en: Chamomile comes from Greek chamaimēlon (“ground apple”), referring to its apple-like fragrance.
example_en: “The therapeutic efficacy of German chamomile (Babuna) flower heads is standardly evaluated based on the concentration of chamazulene within its volatile steam-distilled oil.” (Pharmacognosy. Trease G.E., Evans W.C., 2002)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, bodom (Prunus) turkumiga kiruvchi yong‘oqmevali daraxt. Daraxti 4–10 m gacha o‘sadi, shox-shabbasi keng, barglari uzunchoq va chetlari tishli. Erta bahorda barg chiqarishdan oldin gullaydi; gullari oq yoki och pushti rangli. Mevasi quruq danakli bo‘lib, mag‘zi oziq-ovqatda keng ishlatiladi. Bodom daraxti qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli, issiqsevar va uzoq umr ko‘ruvchi daraxt hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Bodom so‘zi forscha bādām so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Bodom daraxti yerga qoqib teriladi. Shoxlarida qolganlari qo‘lda teriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A nut-producing tree of the family Rosaceae. It usually grows 4–10 m tall, blooms early in spring with white or pale pink flowers, and produces dry stone fruits containing edible seeds (almonds). It is drought-tolerant and widely cultivated in warm regions.
etymology_en: Almond comes from Old French almande, from Latin amygdala, derived from Greek amygdalē.
example_en: “Almond trees are widely cultivated in Mediterranean-type climates for their edible kernels.” (The Encyclopedia of Fruit and Nuts. Janick J., Paull R.E. (Eds.), 2008)

definition_uz: Bodom daraxti (Prunus dulcis (Mill.) D.A.Webb)ning quruq danakli mevasi. Meva tashqi yashil, go‘shtdor qobiq (ekzokarp va mezokarp) hamda qattiq danak (endokarp)dan tashkil topadi. Pishish jarayonida tashqi qobig‘i qurib, odatda yoriladi va ichidagi qattiq danak ajraladi. Danak ichida oziq-ovqatda keng foydalaniladigan urug‘ — bodom mag‘zi joylashadi. Bodom mag‘zi yog‘ va boshqa oziq moddalarga boy bo‘lib, bevosita iste’mol qilinadi hamda moy, qandolat va boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
etymology_uz: Bodom so‘zi forscha bādām so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Bodom tamom yetilgandan keyin iyulning oxiri va avgust boshlarida teriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The dry drupe of the almond tree (Prunus dulcis (Mill.) D.A.Webb). The fruit consists of an outer hull and a hard endocarp, commonly called the shell, which encloses the seed or almond kernel. As the fruit matures, the hull dries and usually splits open. The edible kernel is rich in oil and nutrients and is consumed directly or used in the production of oil, confectionery, and other food products.
etymology_en: Almond derives from Old French almande, from Late Latin amandula, ultimately from Greek amygdalē.
example_en: “Almond fruit tissues are the main sink for nutrients in almond trees. They consist of a kernel surrounded by a shell and an outer hull.” (In a nutshell: almond hull and shell organic matter amendments increase soil and tree potassium status. Plant and Soil, 2024.)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub o‘rik navi. Daraxti kuchli o‘sadi, serhosil va mahalliy iqlim sharoitiga moslashgan. Mevalari o‘rtacha yirik, cho‘zinchoq yoki tuxumsimon shaklli, po‘sti sarg‘ish rangli, eti shirali va xushbo‘y. Danagi bodomga o‘xshash cho‘zinchoq shaklda bo‘lib, nav nomining kelib chiqishiga sabab bo‘lgan. Mevalari yangi iste’mol qilish va quritish uchun yaroqli.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda ekiladigan o‘rik navlari uch guruhga: xo‘raki o‘rik navlari — Ruxi juvonon, Axrori, Arzami, Oq o‘rik; quritiladigan o‘rik navlari — Xurmoniy, Isfarak, Subhoniy, Bodomiy hamda konservabop o‘rik navlari — Korolevskiy, Vengerskiy va boshqalarga bo‘linadi. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Iminov I.A., 2021)
definition_en: A local apricot cultivar belonging to the species Prunus armeniaca L. It is characterized by vigorous growth, good productivity, aromatic fruits, and an elongated almond-like stone. The fruits are suitable for fresh consumption and drying.
etymology_en: The cultivar name refers to its elongated almond-like stone.
example_en: “The landrace collection of stone fruits in the Fergana Valley preserves the Bodomiy apricot, highly regarded by traditional breeders for its high-yielding traits and characteristic elongated morphology.” (Evaluation of Apricot (Prunus armeniaca L.) Cultivars in Uzbekistan. Abdullaev A. et al., 2018)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Bodom daraxtlari (Prunus dulcis (Mill.) D.A.Webb) ekilgan bog‘, plantatsiya yoki maydon. Bodomzorlar bodom mag‘zi yetishtirish maqsadida barpo etiladi va qurg‘oqchil hamda tog‘oldi hududlarda keng tarqalgan.
etymology_uz: Bodom — fors-tojikcha bādām so‘zidan; -zor — fors-tojikcha qo‘shimcha bo‘lib, «ko‘p joy, ekilgan maydon» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda 2500 gektar bodomzor mavjud, shundan 1,5 ming/ga yovvoyi bodomzorlardan iborat. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An orchard or plantation planted primarily with almond trees (Prunus dulcis) for commercial or domestic nut production.
etymology_en: Almond comes from Old French almande, from Late Latin amygdala, from Greek amygdalē (“almond tree”). Orchard derives from Old English ortgeard (“garden, enclosed area for plants”).
example_en: “Establishing an almond orchard on sloped terrain requires precise spacing and contour plowing to optimize natural water runoff absorption.” (Almonds: Botany, Production and Uses. Socias i Company R., Gradziel T.M. (Eds.), 2017)

definition_uz: Adoksadoshlar (Adoxaceae) oilasiga (ilgari shilvidoshlar — Caprifoliaceae) mansub, bo‘yi 1,5–3 m gacha yetadigan barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta. Bahor oxiri–yoz boshida oq rangli qalqonsimon to‘pgullar hosil qiladi. Mevasi qizil rangli, sharsimon danaksiz soxta meva bo‘lib, kuzda pishadi. Bodrezak asosan bog‘ va xiyobonlarni bezash uchun yetishtiriladi, ayrim turlari dorivor ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Bodrezak, kalina (Viburnum) — shilvidoshlar oilasiga mansub daraxt yoki buta. (Qomus.info)
definition_en: A deciduous ornamental shrub belonging to the family Adoxaceae (formerly included in Caprifoliaceae). It grows 1.5–3 m tall, produces white corymb-like inflorescences in late spring–early summer, and develops bright red spherical false fruits in autumn. It is mainly cultivated as an ornamental plant in gardens and parks, and some species have medicinal value.
etymology_en: The English name “Guelder rose” refers to the Dutch province of Guelders (Gelderland), where the plant was historically cultivated.
example_en: “Guelder rose is widely planted in parks and gardens for its ornamental flowers and bright red fruits.” (RHS A–Z Encyclopedia of Garden Plants. Brickell C., 2016)

definition_uz: Qovoqdoshlar (Cucurbitaceae) oilasiga mansub, bir yillik issiqsevar, namsevar sabzavot ekini. Poyasi yer bag‘irlab yoki chirmashib o‘sadi, barglari yirik, dag‘al tukli. Gullari sariq rangli, ayrim navlarida erkak va urg‘ochi gullar alohida joylashadi. Mevasi ko‘p urug‘li, cho‘zinchoq silindrsimon shaklli, yashil rangli rezavor meva bo‘lib, yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, tuzlama va konservalar tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
etymology_uz: Bodring so‘zi o‘zbek tiliga fors-tojikcha bōdrang / bōdring shaklidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Ochiq maydonda o‘sgan o‘simliklar quyosh nuridan issiqxonada o‘sgan bodringlarga qaraganda kam foydalanadi. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: An annual vegetable crop of the family Cucurbitaceae. It has creeping or climbing stems, large hairy leaves, yellow flowers, and elongated green fruits used mainly as fresh vegetables and for pickling and processing.
etymology_en: The word cucumber originates from Latin cucumis through Old French cocombre. The species name sativus is Latin for “cultivated”.
example_en: “In high-density greenhouse horticulture, parthenocarpic cucumber cultivars are preferred since they set fruit without the biological necessity of insect pollination.” (Vegetable Crops. Decoteau D.R., 2000)

definition_uz: Mis kuporosi (mis sulfat) va ohak aralashmasidan tayyorlanadigan fungitsid preparat. U mevali daraxtlar, tok va boshqa qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarida zamburug‘ hamda ayrim bakterial kasalliklarning oldini olish va ularga qarshi kurashda qo‘llanadi.
etymology_uz: Bordo nomi Fransiyaning Bordo (Bordeaux) shahri nomidan olingan. Ushbu preparat XIX asr oxirida Bordo hududidagi uzumzorlarda tokning soxta unshudring kasalligiga qarshi qo‘llanilgan.
example_uz: “Kurtaklar yoyilishidan oldin quyidagi preparatlardan biri purkaladi: Bordo suyuqligi, 3–4% li eritma (100 l suvga 3–4 kg mis kuporosi va 3–4 kg so‘ndirilgan ohak), mis kuporosi bo‘yicha 30–60 l/ga me’yorida (daraxt yaxshilab ho‘llangunicha).” (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A fungicide mixture prepared from copper sulfate and lime, used to control fungal and some bacterial diseases of crops, especially grapevines and fruit trees.
etymology_en: The term Bordeaux mixture comes from Bordeaux, France, where this copper-lime fungicide was first used extensively in vineyards in the late 19th century.
example_en: “As a classic protective fungicide, Bordeaux mixture remains a fundamental tool in organic and conventional horticulture for controlling apple scab (Venturia inaequalis) and peach leaf curl (Taphrina deformans).” (Plant Pathology. Agrios G.N., 2005)

definition_uz: Tuproqqa ishlov berishda qo‘llaniladigan qishloq xo‘jaligi quroli. U tuproq yuzasini yumshatish, kesaklarni maydalash, namlikni saqlash, begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotish va urug‘ ekilgan maydonni tekislash maqsadida ishlatiladi. Boronalar tishli, diskli va aylanuvchi turlarga bo‘linadi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha борона (qadimgi slavyancha borna — “qazish, tirnash quroli”) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Agar tuproq zichlanib qolgan bo‘lsa, tuproq kultivatsiya qilingandan keyin yer yuzasidagi kesaklar va hosil bo‘lgan qatqaloq borona bilan yumshatiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A farm implement used for breaking up and smoothing the soil surface, crushing clods, conserving moisture, controlling weeds, and preparing seedbeds. Harrows may be classified as tine, disc, or rotary types.
etymology_en: Derived from Old English hearge and related Germanic words referring to a soil-working implement.
example_en: An experiment was conducted in a silt-clay soil, New Holland tractor as a machinery unit along with three types of plow and harrows. (Study the Impact of Plow and Harrow Type on Some Technical-Economical Indicators of the Machinery Unit. Ali A.M., 2018)

definition_uz: Borona yordamida tuproqqa ishlov bermoq; tuproq yuzasini yumshatmoq, kesaklarni maydalamoq, qatqaloqni buzmoq, namlikni saqlamoq va begona o‘tlarni kamaytirmoq. Boronalash ekishdan oldin, ekishdan keyin yoki vegetatsiya davrida qator oralari ishlovida amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Shudgor qilingan yer bahorda boronalanadi, qatordagi o‘simliklarning yonlari esa o‘suv davri davomida 2–3 marta yumshatiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: To cultivate, break up, level, or smooth the soil using a harrow. Harrowing is commonly performed after plowing to prepare a suitable seedbed and control weeds.
etymology_en: Derived from the noun harrow, which originates from Old English hearge, meaning a soil-working implement.
example_en: “Seedlings of two contrasting species were sown in bins filled with a sandy soil and harrowed by a small model harrow in the laboratory.” (The Selective Soil Covering Mechanism of Weed Harrows on Sandy Soil. Kurstjens D.A.G., Perdok U.D., Soil and Tillage Research, Vol. 55, Issues 3–4, 2000, pp. 193–206)

definition_uz: Sug‘orish usuli bo‘lib, bunda suv tuproq yuzasiga bostirib chiqariladi va ekin maydonida ma’lum vaqt davomida ushlab turilib, tuproqqa shimdiriladi. Bu usul asosan tekislangan yerlarda, sholi va ayrim dala ekinlarini yetishtirishda qo‘llanadi. Suv sarfi yuqori bo‘lishi mumkinligi sababli undan foydalanishda tuproq xususiyatlari va suv ta’minoti hisobga olinadi.
example_uz: Bostirib sug‘orishdan oldin sug‘oriladigan maydonda tayyorgarlik ishlari qilinadi: sug‘oriladigan maydonlar oldin 0,2–0,5 ga kattalikdagi pollarga bo‘linadi, pollarning to‘rt tomoniga uvot olinadi. (Sug‘orish melioratsiyasi. Xamidov M.X. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An irrigation method in which water is distributed over the soil surface and allowed to infiltrate into the root zone. It is commonly used for rice and some field crops on levelled land.
example_en: “Flood irrigation is still used for rice cultivation and soil salt leaching, although it is less efficient than modern irrigation systems.” (Irrigation: Theory and Practice. Michael A.M., 2008)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Daraxtlar, butalar, gullar, mevali, manzarali va boshqa madaniy o‘simliklar ekilib, muntazam parvarish qilinadigan maxsus yer maydoni. Bog‘ oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari yetishtirish, dam olish, ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, manzarali, ilmiy yoki boshqa amaliy maqsadlarda tashkil etilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Bog‘ so‘zi qadimgi fors-tojik tilidagi bāġ (“bog‘, ekilgan yashil maydon”) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Kuchli payvandtagga payvand qilingan olmaning bir yoshli ko‘chati bog‘ tashkil etiladigan yerga ekilganidan keyin yaxshi parvarish qilinganida o‘rta hisobda 40–60 yil yashaydi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An area of land where trees, shrubs, flowers, fruit plants, ornamental plants, or other cultivated plants are grown and maintained. A garden may be established for food production, recreation, landscaping, ornamental display, scientific study, or other practical purposes.
etymology_en: The word garden comes from Old North French gardin, Frankish gardō, and Proto-Germanic gardô, meaning “garden” or “enclosed cultivated ground.”
example_en: “Disease-resistant apples are excellent candidates for the backyard garden as long as you are committed to the attention to detail and pest management that the crop requires.” (University of Maryland Extension, Growing Apple and Pear Trees in a Home Garden, 2026.)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilik bilan shug‘ullanuvchi, bog‘larda daraxt va butalarni ekish, parvarishlash, shakllantirish, sug‘orish hamda hosilni yig‘ish ishlarini bajaruvchi mutaxassis. Bog‘bon mevali, manzarali va boshqa bog‘ o‘simliklarini yetishtirish bo‘yicha amaliy bilim va ko‘nikmalarga ega bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Mevali bog‘larni barpo qilish hamda parvarishlash ishlari agronomlar va ishbilarmon bog‘bonlar rahbarligi ostida olib borilishi lozim. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A person who cultivates and manages gardens or orchards, including planting, pruning, irrigating, protecting plants, and harvesting crops. An orchardist specifically specializes in fruit tree cultivation.
etymology_en: The word gardener derives from Old French gardin (“garden”), from Frankish and Proto-Germanic roots meaning an enclosed place, with the suffix -er denoting a person engaged in a particular activity.
example_en: If the gardener does not pollinate the date palms in the orchard and thus diminishes the yield, the gardener shall measure and deliver a yield of the orchard to the owner of the orchard in accordance with his neighbor’s yield. (The Origins of Fruits, Fruit Growing, and Fruit Breeding. Janick J., 2005)

definition_uz: Bog‘bonlik kasbi va faoliyati; bog‘larni barpo etish, daraxt va butalarni ekish, parvarishlash, hosil yetishtirish hamda bog‘ o‘simliklarini boshqarish bilan bog‘liq amaliy soha. Bog‘bonchilik mevali, manzarali va boshqa ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarni yetishtirishni qamrab oladi.
example_uz: “Dehqonchilik, bog‘bonchilik bilan mashg‘ul bo‘ladi.” (Jahon adabiyoti. Boynazarov F., 2006)
definition_en: The activity of working in a garden, including growing and taking care of plants and maintaining the garden.
example_en: “If the gardener does not pollinate the (date palms in the) orchard and thus diminishes the yield, the gardener shall measure and deliver a yield for the orchard to his neighbor’s yields.” (Law Collections from Mesopotamia and Asia Minor. Roth M.T., 1997)

definition_uz: Mevali, manzarali va boshqa ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarni yetishtirish, bog‘larni barpo etish, parvarishlash, hosil olish hamda ulardan samarali foydalanish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi qishloq xo‘jaligi sohasi. Bog‘dorchilik daraxt va butalarni ekish, shakllantirish, kesish, sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish kabi tadbirlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.
example_uz: Bog‘dorchilik sohasi – biologiya, biotexnologiya, tuproqshunoslik, o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi, melioratsiya, agrokimyo va umumiy dehqonchilik tarmoqlari bilan chambarchas bog‘liqdir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A branch of agriculture concerned with the cultivation, management, and production of fruit trees, ornamental plants, and other perennial crops. It includes orchard establishment, pruning, irrigation, fertilization, and plant protection.
etymology_en: The word horticulture comes from Latin hortus (“garden”) and cultura (“cultivation, tilling”).
example_en: “Horticulture is one of the fastest growing and high-value segments of agriculture worldwide.” (Advances and Emerging Trends in Horticultural Production and Management. Janbandhu M.S. et al., Journal of Experimental Agriculture International, Vol. 46, No. 3, 2024)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilik ishlarini bajarishda foydalaniladigan asbob-uskunalar, moslamalar va jihozlar majmuasi. Bog‘ inventariga belkurak, ketmon, qaychi, arra, purkagich, sug‘orish moslamalari va boshqa parvarish qurollari kiradi. Ular daraxt va butalarni ekish, kesish, shakllantirish, tuproqqa ishlov berish hamda o‘simliklarni himoya qilish ishlarida qo‘llanadi.
example_uz: “Bog‘ inventari — meva daraxtlarini o‘stirish va bog‘ni parvarishlashda ishlatiladigan asbob-anjomlar.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: A set of tools, equipment, and implements used for carrying out gardening and orchard operations, including planting, pruning, soil cultivation, irrigation, and plant protection.
example_en: “Dormant pruning and summer pruning both require equipment such as hand-held clippers, loppers, saws, pole pruners, pole saws, and a power pruner.” (Organic Orchard Equipment. UVM Fruit Program, University of Vermont Extension)

definition_uz: Daraxt va butalarning kesilgan joylari, jarohatlari hamda payvand qilingan qismlarini himoyalash uchun surtiladigan maxsus himoya vositasi. U o‘simlik to‘qimalarini qurib qolishdan, namlik yo‘qotishdan va kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilarining kirishidan saqlaydi. Bog‘ malhami odatda mum, smola, yog‘ va boshqa himoyalovchi moddalar asosida tayyorlanadi.
example_uz: “Biriktirilgan qismlar ochiq joylariga maxsus payvand malhami yoki mum surtiladi hamda biroz quyidan maxsus tasma orqali bog‘lanadi.” (Yashil makon. Respublika ta’lim markazi, 2021)
definition_en: A protective substance applied to pruning cuts, grafting wounds, and damaged parts of trees and shrubs to prevent drying and infection and to promote healing.
example_en: “Well placed pruning cuts are made to maximize the tree’s natural ability to close its wound and defend itself from infection.” (Pruning Sealants. Schalau J., University of Arizona Cooperative Extension, 2022)

definition_uz: O‘simlik navlarini yaratish va saqlash jarayonida dastlabki urug‘lik materiallarini yetishtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi urug‘chilik bosqichi. Unda seleksioner tomonidan olingan yoki tanlab ajratilgan yuqori sifatli boshlang‘ich material ko‘paytiriladi, navning biologik va xo‘jalik belgilarini saqlashga qaratilgan ishlar olib boriladi.
example_uz: “Boshlang‘ich urug‘chilik — yangi hamda rayonlashtirilgan ekin navlari va duragaylari urug‘larining navdorlik va mahsuldorlik sifatlarini saqlab qolgan holda yalpi ko‘paytirish.” (Boshlang‘ich urug‘chilik. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: The early stage of seed production in which initial seed material is multiplied and maintained to preserve the genetic purity and valuable characteristics of a plant variety.
example_en: “Maintaining varietal purity through scientifically based primary seed production is essential for preserving genetic characteristics and producing high-quality elite seeds.” (Primary Seed Production Activities Carried Out on the Maize Variety “Uzbekistan-2018”. Usmanov F.I., Pulatov S.M., Web of Agriculture: Journal of Agriculture and Biological Sciences, Vol. 4, No. 6, 2026)

definition_uz: Buzinadoshlar (Adoxaceae) oilasiga mansub manzarali buta navi. Oddiy kalinaning (Viburnum opulus) sterillashgan gulli navi bo‘lib, may–iyun oylarida qor shariga o‘xshash yirik oq sharsimon to‘pgullar hosil qiladi. Meva tugmaydi va asosan ko‘kalamzorlashtirish hamda manzarali bog‘dorchilikda ekiladi.
etymology_uz: Buldenej nomi fransuzcha Boule de Neige (“qor shari”) iborasidan olingan bo‘lib, nav gullarining dumaloq oq shakliga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: “Bog‘ va xiyobonlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda may oyida sharsimon oppoq gullar ochuvchi buldenej butalaridan soliter ko‘rinishida foydalanish landshaft kompozitsiyasiga alohida nafislik baxsh etadi.” (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An ornamental shrub cultivar belonging to the family Adoxaceae. It is a sterile-flowered cultivar of the common guelder rose (Viburnum opulus), producing large, spherical white inflorescences resembling snowballs during May and June. It does not bear fruit and is cultivated primarily for landscaping and ornamental horticulture.
etymology_en: The cultivar name Boule de Neige is French for “snowball”, referring to the plant’s round white flower clusters.
example_en: “The classic European snowball bush, Viburnum opulus ‘Roseum’, has been a staple of formal estate gardens since the sixteenth century due to its dramatic spring display.” (Manual of Woody Landscape Plants. Dirr M.A., 2009)

definition_uz: O‘simlik to‘qimalarining g‘ayritabiiy o‘sishi natijasida barg, poya, novda, ildiz, gul yoki boshqa organlarda hosil bo‘ladigan shishsimon yoki bo‘rtmasimon tuzilma. Buqoq hasharotlar, kanalar, nematodalar, zamburug‘lar, bakteriyalar, viruslar va boshqa biotik omillar ta’sirida yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Uning shakllanishi zararlangan to‘qimalarda hujayralar soni yoki hajmining ortishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: “Bog‘dorchilikda ildiz buqog‘i va o‘simliklar raki bilan zararlangan ko‘chatlarni aniqlash hamda ularni sog‘lom materiallardan izolyatsiya qilish fitosanitar nazoratning bosh talabidir.” (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: An abnormal swelling or outgrowth of plant tissue that may occur on leaves, stems, twigs, roots, flowers, or other plant organs. Plant galls can be induced by insects, mites, nematodes, fungi, bacteria, viruses, and other biotic agents and may result from abnormal increases in cell size or cell number.
etymology_en: The English word gall comes from Old French gale and Latin galla, originally referring to abnormal plant growths.
example_en: “Galls are abnormal plant growths caused by insects, mites, nematodes, fungi, bacteria and viruses.” (Insect and Mite Galls, University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Yer sathidan shoxlanib o‘sadigan, odatda daraxtga nisbatan past bo‘yli, ko‘p yillik yog‘ochsimon o‘simlik. Butalarning asosiy poyasi qisqa yoki kuchsiz rivojlangan bo‘lib, bir nechta shoxlar tuproq yuzasiga yaqin qismidan o‘sib chiqadi. Ular mevali, dorivor va manzarali o‘simliklar guruhiga kiradi.
example_uz: Butalar mevali o‘simliklar bo‘lib, katta tup shaklida o‘sadi. Deyarli bir xil yo‘g‘onlikdagi bir qancha novdasi bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial woody plant that is usually shorter than a tree and branches from or near the base. Shrubs may be cultivated as ornamental, fruit, or medicinal plants.
etymology_en: The word shrub comes from Middle English shrubbe, meaning a small woody plant or bush.
example_en: Vaccinium vitis-idaea is a circumboreal, woody, dwarf to low-growing, rhizomatous, evergreen shrub. (The Origins of Fruits, Fruit Growing, and Fruit Breeding. Janick J., 2005)

definition_uz: Buta shaklida o‘suvchi, bir necha poya va shoxlarga ega bo‘lgan o‘simliklarga xos belgi. Butasimon o‘simliklar odatda yer yuzasiga yaqin qismidan shoxlanadi va daraxtlarga nisbatan past bo‘yli bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Erkin o‘suvchi shoxlar tana balandligiga nisbatan har xil: butasimon (tanasining balandligi 50 sm dan kam), past tanali (50–70 sm), o‘rtacha tanali (80–100 sm) va baland tanali (150–200 sm) bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Having the form, growth habit, or characteristics of a shrub; producing several stems and branches from near the base.
example_en: “The shrubby growth habit provides enhanced structural resilience in arid ecosystems by distributing hydraulic transport across multiple primary stems.” (Arboriculture: Integrated Management of Landscape Trees, Shrubs, and Vines. Harris R.W., Clark J.R., Matheny N.P., 2004)

definition_uz: Buta o‘simliklari zich o‘sadigan tabiiy yoki sun’iy o‘simlik qoplami. Butazorlarda bir yoki bir necha turdagi butalar uchraydi; ular tuproqni eroziyadan himoya qilish, landshaftni bezash, meva yoki dorivor xomashyo olish uchun ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Tog‘larning pastki, ancha quruq zonasida butazorlar yonida, eng baland o‘rmon poyasida esa o‘rmonzorlarda, yong‘oqzorlarda va aralash o‘rmonlarda o‘sadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An area dominated by shrubs, either naturally occurring or planted. Shrublands play important roles in soil protection, biodiversity conservation, and landscape management.
etymology_en: Derived from shrub and land, meaning an area covered primarily with shrubs.
example_en: “Arid shrublands dominated by deep-rooted xerophytic species exhibit remarkable evolutionary resilience against prolonged multi-year droughts.” (Elements of Ecology. Smith T.M., Smith R.L., 9th ed., 2015)

definition_uz: Daraxt, buta va toklarning ortiqcha, zararlangan yoki keraksiz novdalarini kesib tashlash hamda o‘simlikning o‘sishi, shakllanishi va hosildorligini boshqarishga qaratilgan agrotexnik tadbir. Butash orqali o‘simlik shox-shabbasi shakllantiriladi, yorug‘lik va havo almashinuvi yaxshilanadi, hosil sifati oshiriladi.
example_uz: Daraxtlarning oziqlanish maydonini aniqlashda, ularga shakl berishda va butashda mutaxassislar yaruslilikni hisobga olishi kerak. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The horticultural practice of removing unwanted, damaged, or excessive branches from trees, shrubs, and vines to control growth, improve plant structure, and increase productivity.
etymology_en: Derived from Old French proignier (“to trim, cut back”), which gave rise to the English verb prune.
example_en: Pruning is one of the most important tree maintenance activities which gives a big impact on tree's health and structure. (Knowledge in Tree Pruning for Sustainable Practices in Urban Setting: Improving Our Quality of Life. Badrulhisham N., Othman N., 2016)

definition_uz: Daraxt yoki butaning asosiy tanasi va yirik shoxlaridan o‘sib chiqadigan yon shox. Butoqlar o‘simlikning shox-shabba tuzilishini hosil qiladi, barg, gul va mevalarning joylashishida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning yer ustki qismi bosh poyadan iborat bo‘lib, u tana, butoqlar, shox hamda novdalardan iboratdir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A woody lateral part growing from the trunk or main stems of a tree or shrub. Branches form the plant canopy and support leaves, flowers, and fruits.
etymology_en: The word branch comes from Old French branche, from Late Latin branca, meaning “a branch or claw-like part.”
example_en: The large green leaves are scattered along the stems and more crowded at the branchlet tips. (Arboriculture: Integrated Management of Landscape Trees, Shrubs, and Vines. Harris R.W., Clark J.R., Matheny N.P., 2004)

definition_uz: Daraxt yoki butaning yon shoxlari (butoqlari) rivojlanib, ko‘p shox hosil qilishi. Butoqlanish o‘simlikning shox-shabba tuzilishi, yorug‘likdan foydalanishi va hosildorligiga ta’sir qiladi.
example_uz: Yosh olma ko‘chati ikkinchi yildan boshlab faol butoqlay boshladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To develop branches or side shoots; to form a branching structure. Branching affects the canopy development and growth habit of trees and shrubs.
etymology_en: The verb to branch derives from the noun branch, which comes from Old French branche meaning “a branch or shoot.”
example_en: “The branches branch out from the trunk much higher that I would have liked.” (Ask Extension, “How to train a Kwanzan cherry tree”, 2013.)

definition_uz: Tokdoshlar (Vitaceae) oilasiga mansub, madaniy uzum (Vitis vinifera L.)ning mahalliy, vinobop navlaridan biri. Buvaki navi qadimdan mahalliy uzumchilikda yetishtirib kelinadi. Mevalari sharbat tayyorlash va vinochilikda foydalanish uchun mos bo‘lib, tarkibida qand moddalari hamda xushbo‘y komponentlar yetarli miqdorda to‘planadi. Navning xo‘jalik qiymati uning hosildorligi, meva sifati va qayta ishlashga yaroqliligi bilan belgilanadi.
example_uz: Buvaki — xo‘raki va vinobop mahalliy uzum navi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: A local wine grape cultivar belonging to the species Vitis vinifera L. The Buvaki cultivar has been traditionally cultivated in local viticulture. Its berries are suitable for juice production and winemaking due to their sufficient sugar content and aromatic compounds. The cultivar is valued for its productivity, fruit quality, and processing suitability.
example_en: “The technical profile of the Buvaki grape allows oenologists to extract high-density musts suitable for crafting well-balanced regional dessert wines.” (Description of Grape Varieties Grown in Uzbekistan. Yuldashev R.T., Iminov I.A., 2022)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Kislotali tuproqlarni neytrallash va pH darajasini ko‘tarish uchun qo‘llaniladigan, tarkibida kalsiy yoki magniyning karbonat, oksid yoxud gidroksid shakllari mavjud materiallar. Ularga maydalangan ohaktosh, bo‘r, dolomit, so‘ndirilgan va so‘ndirilmagan ohak kiradi.
example_uz: Bilvosita ishlatiladigan mineral o‘g‘itlar, masalan, ohakli o‘g‘itlar, gips va boshqalar, asosan, tuproqning agrokimyoviy va fizik-kimyoviy xususiyatlarini yaxshilashda qo‘llaniladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. «Mineral o‘g‘itlar»)
definition_en: Materials containing calcium and/or magnesium compounds capable of neutralizing soil acidity. Common liming materials include ground limestone, chalk, dolomite, quicklime and hydrated lime.
example_en: Liming materials include calcium oxide (burnt or quick lime), calcium hydroxide (hydrated or slaked lime), finely-ground limestone, and chalk. (FAO, Agronomic Factors)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organining ayrim qismida to‘qimalarning kattalashishi, ko‘payishi yoki muayyan tuzilmaning tashqariga chiqib turishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan mahalliy qabariq yoki yo‘g‘onlashgan joy. Bo‘rtma tabiiy morfologik belgi, jarohatlanishga javob yoki kasallik va zararkunandalar ta’sirining belgisi bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Kallyus yupqa devorli parenxima hujayralaridan iborat bo‘lib, bo‘rtma, ba’zan yupqa qavat ko‘rinishida bo‘ladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. «Kallyus» maqolasi)
definition_en: A localized enlargement or raised area on a plant organ resulting from tissue enlargement or proliferation. A swelling may be a normal morphological feature or may develop in response to injury, infection, pests or another physiological disturbance.
example_en: Gall or swelling is a localized outgrowth, bump, or protrusion. (Plant Pathology Terms. University of Kentucky Plant Disease Diagnostic Laboratory)

definition_uz: O‘simlik ildizlarida bo‘rtmalar (gallar) hosil qiluvchi Meloidogyne avlodiga mansub parazit nematodalar. Ular ildiz to‘qimalarida oziqlanib, maxsus oziqlanish hujayralarining shakllanishiga va ildizlarning bo‘rtishiga sabab bo‘ladi. Zararlanish natijasida o‘simliklarning suv va oziqa moddalarini o‘zlashtirishi buziladi, o‘sishi susayadi va hosildorligi kamayishi mumkin.
example_uz: “Tadqiqotlar 2025 yil vegetatsiya davrida bo‘rtma nematodalar bilan zararlangan ochiq dala maydonlarida o‘tkazilib, tajribalar karamning ‘Burbon F1’ navida olib borildi.” (Meloidogyne avlodi nematodalariga qarshi karam (Brassica L.) da oksamil preparatining samaradorligini aniqlash. Abduqayumova S.N., To‘xtasinov F.R., Qo‘qon DPI. Ilmiy xabarlar jurnali, 8(2), 2026)
definition_en: Plant-parasitic nematodes of the genus Meloidogyne that induce characteristic galls or root knots on plant roots. Their feeding disrupts normal root function and may impair water and nutrient uptake, reduce plant growth, and cause significant yield losses.
example_en: “Root-knot nematodes (Meloidogyne spp.) are among the most damaging plant-parasitic nematodes worldwide.” (Top 10 Plant-Parasitic Nematodes in Molecular Plant Pathology. Jones J.T. et al., Molecular Plant Pathology, Vol. 14, No. 9, 2013, pp. 946–961)

definition_uz: Uzoq vaqt davomida haydalib yoki ekin ekilmay, foydalanilmay yotgan, o‘zlashtirilmagan yoki yangi o‘zlashtirishga mo‘ljallangan yer maydoni. Bo‘z yerlar qishloq xo‘jaligida o‘zlashtirish, haydash, meliorativ tadbirlar o‘tkazish orqali ekin maydoniga aylantirilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Sug‘orilmaydigan qo‘riq bo‘z yerlarda yog‘in-sochin tuproq namligining asosiy manbasi hisoblanadi. (Tuproq fizikasi. Isxakova Sh., Mahammadiyev S., Abdukarimov J., Abdullayeva X., 2024)
definition_en: Land that has been left uncultivated for a period of time or has not yet been brought into agricultural use. It may require soil improvement and cultivation before crop production.
example_en: “Reclaiming long-term fallow land into active crop rotation systems necessitates systematic deep plowing to break down the well-established perennial weed root matrices.” (The Nature and Properties of Soils. Brady N.C., Weil R.R., 2008)

definition_uz: O‘zbekiston va Markaziy Osiyoning tog‘oldi hamda tog‘ etaklari hududlarida keng tarqalgan, och tusli, gumus miqdori nisbatan kam, karbonatli tuproq turi. Bo‘z tuproqlar suv va issiqlik rejimiga ko‘ra och bo‘z, tipik bo‘z va to‘q bo‘z tuproqlarga bo‘linadi. Ular sug‘oriladigan dehqonchilik, jumladan bog‘dorchilik va uzumchilikda keng foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Tipik bo‘z tuproqlarda haydalma qatlam plastikligining quyi chegarasi 17–19% ni tashkil etadi, struktura hosil bo‘lish namligi esa 19–20% o‘rtasida o‘zgarib turadi. (Tuproq fizikasi. Isxakova Sh., Mahammadiyev S., Abdukarimov J., Abdullayeva X., 2024)
definition_en: A group of light-colored soils widely distributed in Central Asia, especially in foothill regions. They are characterized by relatively low humus content and are important for irrigated agriculture, including orchards and vineyards.
example_en: “Irrigated serozems of the Fergana Valley require systematic crop rotation schemes to prevent secondary salinization and humus depletion.” (The Nature and Properties of Soils. Brady N.C., Weil R.R., 2008)

definition_uz: Urug‘lik uchun yetishtirilayotgan ekinlarni vegetatsiya davrida bevosita dala sharoitida tekshirib, ularning navga xosligi, nav tozaligi va umumiy holatini baholash jarayoni. Dala aprobatsiyasida navga xos belgilar, boshqa navlar yoki turlar aralashmasi, kasallik va zararkunandalar bilan zararlanish holati hamda urug‘lik ekinining belgilangan talablarga muvofiqligi baholanadi.
etymology_uz: Aprobatsiya — lotincha approbatio (“ma’qullash, tasdiqlash, baholash”) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: “Mevali daraxtlar va rezavorlar hosilining kelgusi ko‘chatchilik uchun yaroqliligini baholashda dala aprobatsiyasi ona bog‘larning genetik fondini soxtalashishdan asrovchi asosiy davlat filtri hisoblanadi.” (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An official inspection of seed crops conducted under field conditions during the growing season to determine varietal identity, varietal purity, and the general condition of the crop. Field inspection includes the assessment of varietal characteristics, off-types or admixtures, the presence of diseases and pests, and compliance with established seed certification requirements.
etymology_en: From field, from Old English feld (“open land”), + inspection, from Latin inspectio (“examination”), from inspicere (“to look into, examine”).
example_en: “Official field inspection evaluates standing crops for off-types, noxious weeds, and isolation distance before issuing seed certification clearances.” (Handbook of Precision Agriculture: Principles and Applications. Srinivasan A. (Ed.), 2006)

definition_uz: Tuproqqa ishlov berish, ekish, ekinlarni parvarishlash va hosilni yig‘ib olishda bajarilgan ishlarning belgilangan agrotexnik hamda texnologik talablarga muvofiqligini aniqlash jarayoni. Baholashda ishlov chuqurligi, tekisligi, tuproqning maydalanishi, begona o‘tlarning yo‘q qilinishi va boshqa sifat ko‘rsatkichlari hisobga olinadi.
example_uz: Dala ishlari sifatini baholash, texnologik brakeraj — tuproqqa ishlov berish, ekinlarni parvarish qilish va hosilni yig‘ib olishdagi ish sifatining texnologiya talablariga muvofiqligini aniqlash. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. «Dala ishlari sifatini baholash»)
definition_en: The assessment of agricultural field operations against specified agronomic and technical requirements. It may cover tillage, planting, crop-management and harvesting operations and evaluate such indicators as operating depth, uniformity, completeness and overall work quality.
example_en: Continuous monitoring of operating depth is essential for evaluating field-operation quality and supporting variable-rate management. (Adaptive IGWO-EKF Framework for Real-Time Operating Depth Monitoring and Spatial Analysis in Precision Agriculture. Zhuang W. et al., Smart Agricultural Technology, 2026)

definition_uz: Yarim qattiqqanotlilar (Hemiptera) turkumining Miridae oilasiga mansub zararkunanda polifag hasharot turi. Dala qandalasi o‘simliklarning bargi, novdasi, guli va yosh mevalarini sanchib-so‘ruvchi og‘iz apparati yordamida zararlaydi. Zararlangan joylarda deformatsiya, o‘sishning susayishi va hosil sifatining pasayishi kuzatiladi.
example_uz: No‘xat va nutni, qisman boshqa dukkakli ekinlarni ham qandalalar, ayniqsa dala qandalasi (Lygus pratensis L.) zararlaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A species of plant bug in the family Miridae that damages various agricultural crops by sucking sap from leaves, shoots, flowers, and young fruits, causing deformation and reduced yield quality.
etymology_en: The genus name Lygus comes from Greek lygē (“twilight, dimness”), while pratensis is Latin for “of meadows” from pratum (“meadow”).
example_en: “The economic injury level for the meadow plant bug (Lygus pratensis) on seed alfalfa is heavily dependent on the synchronization of nymph emergence with the budding stage of the crop.” (Pests of Fruit Crops: A Colour Handbook. Alford D.V., 2014)

definition_uz: Oldindan haydalib, ma’lum vaqt davomida ekin ekilmay qoldirilgan va tuproq unumdorligini tiklash maqsadida dam berilgan shudgorlangan yer. Bunday yerda namlik to‘planadi, begona o‘tlar kamayadi, tuproqning fizik xususiyatlari yaxshilanadi va keyingi ekin uchun qulay sharoit yaratiladi.
example_uz: Ekin yerlarining ishlatilishiga qarab ikkala xo‘jaliklarda ham ziroatchilikning har xil usullari quriq, partov yoki bo‘z va dam berilgan shudgor va paykalli yerlarga bir xil ekish qo‘llanilgan. (Surxondaryo etnografiyasi. Tursunov S., 2020.)
definition_en: A cultivated field that has been ploughed and then left uncropped for a period of time to restore soil fertility, conserve moisture, and control weeds.
example_en: “Amounts of moisture remaining after the harvest of the first-year crop were in the order: bare fallow > cowpea > sorghum.” (Jones M.J., Sinclair J. Effects of bare fallowing, previous crop and time of ploughing on soil moisture conservation in Botswana. Tropical Agriculture, 1989, 66(1))

definition_uz: Danakli mevalarda urug‘ni o‘rab turuvchi qattiq, yog‘ochlashgan meva ichki qavati — endokarp. U o‘rik, shaftoli, olxo‘ri, gilos va olcha kabi danakli mevalarda urug‘ni himoya qiladi. Danak odatda ichida bitta urug‘ saqlaydi.
etymology_uz: Danak so‘zi fors tilidan (دانک / dānak) o‘zlashgan bo‘lib, “meva danagi, qattiq urug‘ qobig‘i” ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Payvandtag yetishtirish uchun ekiladigan meva danak va urug‘lari mahalliy sharoitga yaxshi o‘rgangan hamda mos keladigan daraxtlardan olinishi tavsiya etiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The hard, woody or stony endocarp of a drupe that surrounds and protects the seed. It occurs in stone fruits such as apricot, peach, plum, cherry, and other drupes and usually encloses a single seed.
example_en: “We treat the fruits of this group uniformly as drupes with a single hard endocarp or ‘stone’ (sclerocarp) representing one or more carpels.” (Herrera F. et al. Fruit Morphology and Anatomy of the Spondioid Anacardiaceae. The Botanical Review, 2018)

definition_uz: Ichki qismida bitta qattiq danak bilan o‘ralgan urug‘i bo‘ladigan mevalar guruhi. Danakli mevalarga asosan o‘rik, shaftoli, olxo‘ri, gilos, olcha, tog‘olcha kabi Prunus turkumiga mansub o‘simliklarning mevalari kiradi. Ularning mevasi botanik jihatdan danakli meva (drupe) hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Danakli mevalar, xususan ularning to‘la pishib yetilganlari juda ham nozik bo‘ladi va bu holda tashish qiyin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A group of fruits containing a single seed enclosed in a hard inner shell (stone). Common examples include peach, apricot, plum, cherry, and other fruits of the genus Prunus. Botanically, these fruits are called drupes.
example_en: “Global trade in stone fruits is highly sensitive to shelf-life constraints, demanding strict atmospheric control during the post-harvest transport of peaches and plums.” (Temperate and Subtropical Fruit Production. Jackson et al., 2011)

definition_uz: Mevasining ichki qismida qattiq danak bilan himoyalangan urug‘i bo‘ladigan daraxtlar guruhi. Asosan Prunus turkumiga mansub o‘rik, shaftoli, olxo‘ri, gilos, olcha kabi mevali daraxtlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Bu daraxtlar mevachilikda muhim ahamiyatga ega bo‘lib, yangi iste’mol qilish, qayta ishlash va quritilgan mahsulotlar olish uchun yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Yangi intensiv bog‘larni barpo etishda danakli meva daraxtlari uchun pakana va yarim pakana payvandtaglar tanlash hosildorlikni ikki barobar oshirish imkonini beradi.” (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A group of fruit trees that produce fruits with a single seed enclosed in a hard stone. They mainly include species of the genus Prunus, such as apricot, peach, plum, cherry, and sour cherry trees.
example_en: “The vegetative propagation of stone fruit trees requires meticulous choice of clonal rootstocks to ensure resilience against phytoplasma infections and soil salinity.” (Temperate and Subtropical Fruit Production. Jackson et al., 2011)

definition_uz: Yog‘ochlashgan poyaga (tana) ega bo‘lgan, odatda ko‘p yillik va baland bo‘yli o‘simlik. Daraxtlar asosiy tana, shox-shabba, barg, gul va meva hosil qiluvchi vegetativ hamda generativ organlardan tashkil topadi. Bog‘dorchilikda mevali, manzarali va xo‘jalik ahamiyatiga ega daraxt turlari yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: V asrdan boshlab mevali daraxtlar haqidagi ilk ma’lumotlar to‘planganligi ma’lum bo‘lgan. Bu davrda mevali daraxtlar asosan yovvoyi holda o‘sgan. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A perennial woody plant with a main stem or trunk that usually grows taller than shrubs and produces branches, leaves, flowers, and fruits. Trees are important components of orchards, forests, and landscapes.
etymology_en: The word tree comes from Old English trēow, related to Proto-Germanic *trewan and referring to a woody plant.
example_en: “The structural longevity of a fruit tree depends heavily on establishing a strong skeletal framework during its initial training years.” (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Daraxt va butalarning po‘stlog‘i yoki shoxlaridan ajralib chiqadigan, havoda qotib qoluvchi yopishqoq modda. Daraxt yelimi ko‘pincha mexanik shikastlanish, sovuq urishi, noto‘g‘ri parvarish yoki ayrim kasalliklar ta’sirida hosil bo‘ladi. U o‘simlikning himoya reaksiyasi sifatida ajralib chiqadigan polisaxarid tabiatli moddalardan iborat bo‘ladi. Mevali daraxtlarda, ayniqsa o‘rik, olcha, gilos kabi danakli mevalarda ko‘p uchraydi.
example_uz: “Daraxt yelimlari patologik shilliq moddalarning o‘simlik to‘qimalaridan oqib chiqib, po‘stloqning yaralangan joyini qoplab, qotishidan hosil bo‘ladi.” (Farmakognoziya, I qism, Xolmatov H.X., Ahmedov O‘.A., 2008.)
definition_en: A sticky substance exuded from the bark, trunk, or branches of trees, especially stone fruit trees. It may be produced in response to injury, environmental stress, or disease and consists largely of polysaccharides.
example_en: “Gummosis is a sticky amber ooze or ‘gum’ exuded from lesions on stone fruit tree bark.” (Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Yard and Garden — Gummosis, 2026.)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari navlarini davlat miqyosida sinash, baholash va istiqbolli navlarni ishlab chiqarishga tavsiya etish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi maxsus sinov punktlari va tashkilotlar tizimi. Davlat nav sinash tarmog‘ida yangi navlarning hosildorligi, sifat ko‘rsatkichlari, kasallik va noqulay sharoitlarga chidamliligi turli hududlarda tekshiriladi.
example_uz: “Yangi yaratilgan ekin navlarini ishlab chiqarishga joriy etishdan oldin Davlat nav sinash tarmog‘ining turli mintaqaviy va tuproq-iqlim zonalaridagi shoxobchalarida kamida 2–3 yil davomida sinash majburiy agronomik talab hisoblanadi.” (“Urug‘chilik va urug‘shunoslik asoslari”)
definition_en: A national system of testing stations and organizations responsible for evaluating agricultural crop varieties and recommending promising varieties for official release and cultivation.
example_en: “Data generated by the state variety testing network acts as the legal backbone for approving drought-resistant wheat cultivars for large-scale distribution in arid regions.” (Intellectual Property Law of Plants. Janis et al., 2014)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari urug‘larining nav tozaligi, ekish sifati, biologik va texnologik ko‘rsatkichlarini davlat tomonidan tekshirish hamda nazorat qilish tizimi. Davlat urug‘chilik nazorati urug‘lik materiallarini yetishtirish, tayyorlash, saqlash va realizatsiya qilish jarayonlarida belgilangan standart va talablarga rioya etilishini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: “Respublikada ekilayotgan barcha qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari urug‘larining genetik va ekinboplik sifat ko‘rsatkichlari Davlat urug‘chilik nazorati hamda davlat inspeksiyasi laboratoriyalari xulosasi asosida sertifikatlanadi.” (“Urug‘chilik va urug‘shunoslik asoslari”)
definition_en: A system of official inspection and control of the varietal identity, purity, sowing quality, and other quality characteristics of agricultural seed. Official seed control is carried out to ensure compliance with established seed standards and requirements during seed production, processing, storage, and marketing.
example_en: “The rules on official seed control ... provide for an official field inspection to be carried out during the period of seed production.” (Council Decision 2003/17/EC, Council of the European Union, 2002)

definition_uz: Tuproq, o‘simlik qoplami yoki tabiiy resurslarning unumdorligi va ekologik xususiyatlarining yomonlashuvi, sifat jihatdan pasayishi jarayoni. Qishloq xo‘jaligida tuproq degradatsiyasi eroziya, sho‘rlanish, zichlashish, organik moddalarning kamayishi va noto‘g‘ri foydalanish natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: “Degradatsiya” lotincha degradatio (“pasayish”, “yomonlashish”, “quyi darajaga tushish”) so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Sug‘oriladigan yerlarning sho‘rlanishi va strukturasining buzilishi oqibatida yuzaga keladigan tuproq degradatsiyasi intensiv bog‘dorchilikni rivojlantirish yo‘lidagi eng jiddiy ekologik to‘siqlardan biridir.” (Tuproq fizikasi. Isxakova Sh. va boshq., 2024)
definition_en: The process of deterioration or decline in the quality, productivity, or ecological condition of soil, vegetation, or natural resources. In agriculture, soil degradation may result from erosion, salinization, compaction, and loss of organic matter.
etymology_en: The word degradation comes from French dégradation, from Latin de- (“down, away”) and gradus (“step, degree”), referring to a decline in status or quality.
example_en: “Anthropogenic soil degradation, characterized by organic matter depletion and secondary salinization, poses an immediate threat to high-density pomological installations in arid river basins.” (Soil Degradation, Conservation and Remediation. Osman K.T., 2014)
