definition_uz: Bezak, ko‘rkamlik va estetik qiymatga ega bo‘lgan; asosan manzaraviy maqsadlarda foydalaniladigan o‘simlik, nav yoki belgilarni ifodalovchi sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda dekorativ o‘simliklar bog‘, xiyobon, park va yashil hududlarni bezatish uchun yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Dekorativ so‘zi fransuzcha décoratif (“bezatuvchi, ko‘rk beruvchi”) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan. U lotincha decorare (“bezamoq, ziynatlamoq”) fe’liga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: “Shahar ekotizimlarini barpo etishda nafaqat tabiiy iqlimga chidamlilik, balki daraxtlarning arxitekturaviy shakli va dekorativ xususiyatlari ham birlamchi mezon hisoblanadi.” (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Having aesthetic or ornamental value; used primarily for decoration, beauty, or landscape improvement rather than for food or industrial production.
etymology_en: The word decorative comes from French décoratif, from Latin decorare (“to adorn, beautify”), derived from decor (“beauty, elegance”).
example_en: Ornamental flowering plants are more than attractive, they can also help to clean up water pollution. (Plantwatch: How ornamental plants can help clean up waterways. The Guardian, 2024)

definition_uz: Daraxt va butalarning tur, nav va shakllari ilmiy tadqiqot, ta’lim, introduksiya, saqlash hamda namoyish etish maqsadida to‘planib o‘stiriladigan maxsus botanika bog‘i yoki dendrologik kolleksiya. Dendrariylarda mahalliy va introduksiya qilingan yog‘ochsimon o‘simliklar o‘rganiladi, saqlanadi va sistematik, geografik yoki ekologik tamoyillar asosida joylashtirilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha déndron (δένδρον) — “daraxt” so‘zidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Denov dendrariysida lavrdan katta alleya va bargini to‘plash maqsadida plantatsiya tashkil etilgan. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A specialized botanical garden or living collection devoted to the cultivation, study, conservation, and display of trees and shrubs. Arboreta maintain native and introduced woody plants and are used for scientific research, education, plant introduction, conservation, and landscape purposes.
etymology_en: Arboretum comes from New Latin arboretum, meaning “a place planted with trees”, derived from Latin arbor (“tree”) + the suffix -etum, denoting a plantation or garden.
example_en: “The establishment of the experimental arboretum in the late nineteenth century allowed researchers to evaluate how non-native coniferous trees would adapt to local soil conditions before widespread forestation began.” (Annals of Forest Science, 2021)

definition_uz: Botanikaning daraxtlar, butalar va boshqa yog‘ochsimon o‘simliklarning kelib chiqishi, sistematikasi, morfologiyasi, biologiyasi, ekologiyasi, geografik tarqalishi va xo‘jalik ahamiyatini o‘rganadigan bo‘limi. Dendrologiya manzarali bog‘dorchilik, o‘rmonchilik va ko‘kalamzorlashtirish ishlarining ilmiy asoslarini yaratishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha δένδρον (déndron) — “daraxt” va λογία (logia) — “ta’limot”, “fan” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “O‘rmonchilik poydevori hisoblangan dendrologiya fani o‘lkamizning qurg‘oqchil hududlarida yashillik zonalarini barpo etish uchun ekologik mos daraxt turlarini tanlab berish imkonini yaratadi.” (Dendrologiya va o‘rmonchilik asoslari)
definition_en: A branch of botany concerned with the study of trees, shrubs, and other woody plants, including their taxonomy, morphology, biology, ecology, distribution, and economic importance. Dendrology provides a scientific basis for forestry, ornamental horticulture, and landscape management.
etymology_en: From Greek dendron (“tree”) + -logy, from logos (“study”, “science”). The term entered English through modern scientific Latin and French in the 19th century.
example_en: “A profound understanding of dendrology is crucial for choosing structural tree species that can effectively mitigate the urban heat island effect.” (Textbook of Dendrology. Harlow et al., 2001)

definition_uz: Mahalliy hamda turli geografik va iqlimiy hududlardan introduksiya qilingan ko‘p yillik yog‘ochsimon o‘simliklar — daraxtlar, butalar va lianalar — kolleksiyasi asosida landshaft-kompozitsion tamoyillar bo‘yicha tashkil etilgan ommaviy park. Dendropark o‘simliklarni saqlash, o‘rganish va namoyish etish kabi ilmiy-ma’rifiy vazifalar bilan birga, rekreatsiya, madaniy dam olish va estetik muhit yaratish vazifalarini ham bajaradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha déndron (δένδρον) — “daraxt” va inglizcha park (“park”) so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Yangi barpo etilgan dendropark hududida nafaqat Markaziy Osiyo, balki Sharqiy Osiyo va O‘rta dengiz iqlimiga xos bo‘lgan manzarali butalar landshaft dizayni kompozitsiyalariga muvaffaqiyatli singdirildi.” (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A landscaped public park established around a collection of native and introduced woody plants, including trees, shrubs, and woody vines. In addition to the conservation, study, and display of woody plants, a dendrological park serves educational, recreational, and aesthetic purposes and is designed according to landscape-planning principles.
etymology_en: The term dendrological comes from Greek dendron (“tree”) and logos (“study”), while park comes from Old French parc, meaning an enclosed area.
example_en: “The integration of a designated dendrological park within the master plan of the new ecocity significantly mitigates the urban heat island effect while fostering community eco-literacy.” (Greening Cities: Forms and Functions. Tan P.Y., Jim C.Y. (Eds.), 2017)

definition_uz: O‘simlik to‘qimalarini quritish va namligini kamaytirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladigan kimyoviy moddalar. Qishloq xo‘jaligida desikantlar hosilni yig‘ib olishdan oldin barg va poyalarni tez quritish, urug‘larning pishishini tezlashtirish hamda yig‘im-terim ishlarini yengillashtirish uchun ishlatiladi.
etymology_uz: “Desikant” lotincha desiccare — “quritmoq, namlikni yo‘qotmoq” fe’lidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Kuzgi yog‘ingarchilik boshlanishidan oldin tovarlik kungaboqar maydonlariga desikantlar purkash urug‘ namligini me’yoriy o‘n foizgacha tushirish va hosil nobudgarchiligining oldini olish imkonini beradi.” (O‘simlikshunoslik)
definition_en: Chemical agents used to accelerate the drying of plant tissues before harvest. They reduce plant moisture content, promote uniform maturation, and facilitate harvesting operations. Desiccants are widely used in crop production to improve harvest efficiency and post-harvest handling.
etymology_en: Derived from Latin desiccare (“to dry up”), through the English term desiccant.
example_en: “The timely application of contact desiccants to indeterminate legume fields significantly reduces seed coat fracturing during subsequent high-speed mechanical threshing.” (Latest Research Trends in Agrochemical Fungicides. Lamberth, 2022)

definition_uz: Hosilni yig‘ishtirib olishni osonlashtirish, ekinlarning yetilishini bir xillashtirish va o‘simliklarning yer ustki qismlarini tez quritish maqsadida hosil yig‘imidan oldin desikantlar qo‘llash orqali amalga oshiriladigan agrotexnik tadbir.
etymology_uz: Desikatsiya termini lotincha desiccare — ‘quritmoq, namligini yo‘qotmoq’ so‘zidan kelib chiqqan; uning asosida de- va siccus (‘quruq’) elementlari yotadi.
example_uz: “Desikatsiya hosil yetilishini tezlashtirib, yig‘im-terim ishlarini barvaqt tugallash maqsadida o‘tkaziladi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Desikatsiya” maqolasi.)
definition_en: The pre-harvest drying of crop plants or their above-ground parts, usually by applying chemical desiccants, to promote uniform crop maturity or drying and facilitate harvesting.
etymology_en: Desiccation derives from Latin desiccare, meaning ‘to dry up’, from de- and siccus (‘dry’).
example_en: “For direct harvest, desiccation of the crop may be necessary beforehand.” (Colorado State University Extension, “Black-Eyed Pea Production for Eastern Colorado”.)

definition_uz: Madaniy o‘simliklar, ayniqsa mevali daraxtlar va boshqa qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarida uchraydigan parazit organizmlar, zararkunandalar yoki kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilarini maqsadli ravishda yo‘q qilishga qaratilgan tadbirlar majmui. Devastatsiya usullari biologik, kimyoviy, agrotexnik va karantin choralarini o‘z ichiga olishi mumkin. U o‘simliklarni himoya qilishning muhim yo‘nalishlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha devastatio — “vayron qilish, xarob etish” so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Respublikamiz bog‘dorchilik xo‘jaliklarida uchraydigan karantin va o‘ta xavfli qo‘ziqorin hamda virusli kasalliklarga qarshi kurashda eng radikal usul bu — devastatsiya hisoblanadi.” (O‘simliklar fitopatologiyasi)
definition_en: The deliberate elimination of a pest, pathogen, or other harmful organism from a defined area through coordinated control measures. In plant protection, eradication aims to completely remove the target organism and prevent its re-establishment or spread.
etymology_en: Eradication derives from Latin eradicare (“to root out, uproot”), formed from e- (“out”) and radix, radicis (“root”).
example_en: “Eradication: Application of phytosanitary measures to eliminate a pest from an area.” (EPPO Bulletin, Introduction to PM 9 Standards on National regulatory control systems, 2025.)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub, barg to‘kuvchi yoki yarim doimiy yashil, manzarali buta. Bo‘yi odatda 2–5 m gacha yetadi. Barglari tuxumsimon, gullari oq rangli bo‘lib, shingilsimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevasi qora rangli rezavor-simon danakli meva. Devorgul asosan tirik devorlar, yashil to‘siqlar va landshaft bezagida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Magistral yo‘llar atrofida shovqin va changni to‘sish, shuningdek, ixcham hududlarni ajratish uchun Ligustrum (odatiy devorgul yoki biryuchina) butalaridan keng foydalaniladi.” (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A deciduous or semi-evergreen ornamental shrub of the family Oleaceae. It is widely used for hedges, green fences, and landscape planting due to its dense growth and decorative flowers and fruits.
example_en: “Due to its high tolerance to severe pruning and rapid lateral branch growth, common privet remains the backbone of formal hedgerows in modern urban green zoning.” (Manual of Woody Landscape Plants. Dirr, 2009)

definition_uz: Pechakdoshlar (Convolvulaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik, xlorofillsiz obligat parazit o‘simlik. Uning yo‘g‘onroq, sarg‘ish yoki qizg‘ish chirmashuvchi poyasi xo‘jayin o‘simlikka gaustoriyalari orqali birikib, undan suv va oziq moddalarni oladi. Devpechak mevali daraxtlar, tok, manzarali o‘simliklar, butalar va ayrim o‘tsimon o‘simliklarni zararlaydi.
example_uz: Leman zarpechagi — Cuscuta lehmanniana. Deyarli hamma mamlakatlarda, jumladan O‘zbekistonda ham tarqalgan, yo‘g‘on poyali yoki devpechak deb ham ataladi. (Karantin begona o‘tlar va ularga qarshi kurash choralari. Kojevnikova A.G., Pattayev A.A., 2012)
definition_en: An annual holoparasitic plant of the family Convolvulaceae. Its twining stems attach to the above-ground parts of host plants by haustoria and obtain water and nutrients directly from the host’s vascular tissues. It parasitizes woody plants, shrubs, fruit trees, grapevines and some herbaceous plants.
example_en: Within the genus Cuscuta, the spread of field dodder (Cuscuta campestris), Lehmann’s dodder (Cuscuta lehmanniana), Mediterranean tree dodder (Cuscuta epithymum), and hop dodder (Cuscuta lupuliformis) has been observed. (Spread of Quarantine Weeds in Ukraine. Holiachuk Y., Kosylovych H., 2025)

definition_uz: O‘rikning hali pishib yetilmagan, yashil, eti qattiq va nordon mevasi. Dovuchcha o‘rik mevasining rivojlanish va yetilish jarayonidagi dastlabki bosqichlaridan birini ifodalaydi hamda ayrim hududlarda yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi.
example_uz: “Dastlabki tukkan mevasi – dovuchcha vitaminga boy bo‘lib, iste’mol qilinadi.” (Biologiya. Pratov O‘. va boshq., 2020.)
definition_en: An immature, green apricot fruit with firm flesh and a sour taste. It represents an early stage in the development and ripening of the apricot fruit and is consumed fresh in some regions.
example_en: “Green apricots are the young versions of the fruit harvested before they have changed colors and developed their concentrated sugar content.” (Specialty Produce, Green Apricots.)

definition_uz: Tok (Vitis spp.)ning yosh barglari, novdalari, barg bandlari, gajaklari, to‘pgullari va mevalarini zararlaydigan zamburug‘ kasalligi. Kasallikni Elsinoë ampelina zamburug‘i qo‘zg‘atadi. Zararlangan organlarda dastlab mayda qo‘ng‘ir yoki qoramtir dog‘lar paydo bo‘lib, keyinchalik ular kengayib, markazi kulrang yoki oqish, chetlari to‘q rangli botiq nekrotik yaralarga aylanishi mumkin. Kuchli zararlanish barglarning erta to‘kilishi, mevalarning zararlanishi hamda tokning o‘sishi va hosildorligining pasayishiga olib keladi.
example_uz: Dog‘li antraknoz kasalligi ko‘klam faslining seryog‘in bo‘lgan yillarida may oyida juda kuchayib ketadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A fungal disease of grapevines (Vitis spp.) caused by Elsinoë ampelina. It affects young leaves, shoots, petioles, tendrils, inflorescences, and berries, producing brown to dark, often sunken necrotic lesions that may develop grayish or whitish centers with dark margins. Severe infection may cause premature defoliation, berry damage, reduced vine vigor, and yield loss.
etymology_en: From grapevine + anthracnose; anthracnose derives from Greek anthrax (“coal”) + nosos (“disease”).
example_en: E. ampelina infects young and tender tissues of grapevine, including leaves, petioles, stems, tendrils, rachises, and berries. (Current status and future prospects of grapevine anthracnose caused by Elsinoe ampelina. Li et al., Molecular Plant Pathology, 2021)

definition_uz: Mevalarning ta’mi kirib qolgan, ammo hali to‘liq yetilib pishmagan holati. Bu bosqichda meva o‘ziga xos ta’m va hidga ega bo‘la boshlaydi, biroq biologik va iste’mol pishganlik darajasiga to‘liq yetmagan bo‘ladi. Bog‘dorchilikda mahsulotning oraliq yetilish bosqichini ifodalovchi termin hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha “to‘liq pishmagan don, dukkak”.
example_uz: Uzoq joylarga yuboriladigan olchalarni dumbulroq, ya’ni eti hali qattiqroq vaqtida terish kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A stage of development in fruits when flavor has begun to develop, but full physiological or commercial maturity has not yet been reached. It represents an intermediate stage between unripe and fully ripe conditions.
example_en: Underripe fruit will retain its shape and texture better after pickling. (Oregon State University Extension)

definition_uz: Mevalarning pishmagan, xom yoki g‘o‘r holati. Dumbullik davrida mevalar hali to‘liq biologik va iste’mol pishganlikka yetmagan bo‘ladi, tarkibida qand miqdori kamroq, kislotaligi yuqoriroq va eti nisbatan qattiq bo‘ladi. Bu holat mevaning yetilish jarayonidagi oraliq bosqichni ifodalaydi.
etymology_uz: Forscha dumbul (“chala yetilgan, to‘liq pishmagan”) so‘ziga -lik qo‘shimchasi qo‘shilgan.
example_uz: Danakli mevalar, xususan ularning to‘la pishib yetilganlari juda ham nozik bo‘ladi va bu holda tashish qiyin. Shuning uchun jami danakli mevalar dumbulligi (yashilligi)da teriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The condition of a fruit being unripe, immature, or not fully developed. During this stage, the fruit has not yet reached full physiological or eating maturity and typically contains lower sugar levels and firmer flesh.
example_en: The level of underripeness as determined by this method is relative and subjective. (Scott Laboratories, 2025)

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki ota-ona shakli — individ, nav, liniya yoki turni chatishtirish natijasida olingan avlod. Qishloq xo‘jaligi seleksiyasida duragaylar yuqori hosildorlik, kasallik va noqulay muhit omillariga chidamlilik, mahsulot sifati kabi foydali belgilarni birlashtirish maqsadida yaratiladi.
example_uz: Duragay ko‘chatlar bitta avloddan vujudga keltirilganidan qat’iy nazar, ularning har biridagi irsiy xususiyatlar har xil bo‘lishi mumkin. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: An offspring produced by crossing two genetically distinct parents, such as plant individuals, cultivars, breeding lines, or species. In horticulture and plant breeding, hybrids are developed to combine desirable traits such as high yield, disease resistance, fruit quality, and adaptation to environmental conditions.
etymology_en: The word hybrid comes from Latin hybrida (“offspring of mixed origin, crossbreed”). It entered English through Latin and French scientific terminology.
example_en: Tart cherries are hybrids between sweet cherry and ground cherry via non-reduced gametes. (The Origins of Fruits, Fruit Growing, and Fruit Breeding. Janick, 2005)

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki o‘simlik individi, navi, liniyasi yoki turini chatishtirish orqali duragay (gibrid) avlod olmoq. Bu usul seleksiyada yangi navlar yaratish, foydali xo‘jalik belgilarini birlashtirish hamda o‘simliklarning mahsuldorligi va noqulay omillarga chidamliligini oshirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Duragaylash va tanlashning genetiklar yaratgan usullaridan seleksiyada keng foydalanish orqali qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlarining hozirgi vaqtdagi keng tarqalgan navlari yaratildi. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: To cross two genetically distinct plant individuals, cultivars, breeding lines, or species in order to produce hybrid offspring. In plant breeding, hybridization is used to develop new cultivars, combine desirable agronomic traits, and improve plant productivity and resistance to adverse conditions.
etymology_en: Derived from the noun hybrid (via Latin hybrida) with the addition of the productive verbalizing suffix -ize (originating from Greek -izein, denoting an action or process).
example_en: Breeders systematically hybridize distinct tomato genotypes to identify optimal parental combinations for enhanced post-harvest shelf life. (Genetic diversity and hybridization studies in tomato genotypes. Kumar et al., 2021)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki ota-ona shaklini — o‘simlik individi, nav, liniya yoki turni — chatishtirish orqali duragay avlod olish jarayoni. Duragaylash o‘simliklar seleksiyasida hosildorlik, mahsulot sifati, kasalliklarga va noqulay muhit omillariga chidamlilik kabi foydali belgilarni birlashtirish hamda yangi seleksion material yaratish uchun qo‘llaniladigan asosiy usullardan biridir.
example_uz: Payvandlash, ayniqsa, tokning sovuqqa chidamli navlarini yetishtirishda, nav sifatini yaxshilashda, vegetativ duragaylash yo‘li bilan yangi navlarni yaratishda qo‘llaniladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The process of crossing two genetically distinct parental forms, such as plant individuals, cultivars, breeding lines, or species, to produce hybrid offspring. Hybridization is a fundamental plant-breeding method used to combine desirable traits and develop improved cultivars.
etymology_en: The term hybridization is derived from hybrid, which comes from Latin hybrida (“offspring of mixed origin”), with the suffix -ization indicating a process.
example_en: Natural hybridization between wild species and primitive cultivars has played a fundamental role in shaping the genetic architecture of modern perennial fruit crops. (From forest to field: Perennial fruit crop domestication. Miller & Gross, 2011)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Duragaylash natijasida olingan urug‘lar yoki yosh o‘simliklar ekilib, ularning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilarini baholash uchun tashkil etilgan maxsus ko‘chat maydoni. Bunday ko‘chatzorlarda seleksiya jarayonining dastlabki bosqichlarida duragay avlodlar o‘rganiladi, saralanadi va istiqbolli shakllar tanlab olinadi.
example_uz: Meva va rezavor meva ekinlarining serhosil duragay navlarini ommaviy ko‘paytirish va ularni iqlim sharoitiga moslashtirish ishlari bevosita ixtisoslashtirilgan duragaylar ko‘chatzorida amalga oshiriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A nursery established for growing and evaluating hybrid seedlings obtained through hybridization. It is used in plant breeding programs to observe, select, and assess progenies for desirable agronomic and horticultural traits.
example_en: Recent research has investigated the viability of introducing hybrid nursery stock to forestry plantations in Vietnam as a strategy to meet the increased demand for forest products. (Forest plantation owners' willingness to pay for hybrid nursery stock: The case of Acacia hybrids in Central Vietnam. Nguyen et al., 2020)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Irsiy jihatdan farqlanuvchi navlar, turlar yoki turkumdosh o‘simliklarni sun’iy yoki nazorat ostida chatishtirish natijasida olingan urug‘. Birinchi avlod (F₁) duragay urug‘lari odatda geterozis xususiyatiga ega bo‘lib, yuqori hosildorlik, bir xillik va ayrim kasalliklarga chidamlilik bilan tavsiflanadi.
example_uz: Bu yerda eng yaxshi mahalliy navlarning urug‘idan va chetdan keltirilgan olmalarni Sibir mahalliy olmasi bilan chatishtirish natijasida olingan duragaylarning urug‘idan yetishtirilgan meva daraxtlari o‘stirilar edi. (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi: o‘quv qo‘llanma. Ribakov A.A., Ostrauxova S.A., 1981)
definition_en: Seed produced by the controlled cross-pollination of two genetically distinct parent lines to combine desirable traits. First-generation (F₁) hybrid seeds are valued for uniformity, vigor, yield, and resistance to diseases or environmental stress.
example_en: It is often possible to combine two closely or even distantly related species and obtain viable hybrid seed. Many garden flowers and some vegetables are of hybrid origin. (Corpus of Contemporary American English (COCA))
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Olma (Malus domestica (Suckow) Borkh.) uchun qo‘llaniladigan yarim pakana vegetativ (klonal) payvandtag. Dusen G‘arbiy Yevropada tanlab olingan va keyinchalik East Malling payvandtaglari tizimida standartlashtirilgan payvandtaglar guruhiga mansub. U mevali daraxtlarning o‘sish kuchini cheklaydi, hosilga erta kirishini ta’minlaydi, hosildorligini oshiradi hamda intensiv bog‘larda daraxtlarni zich joylashtirish imkonini beradi. Payvandtag daraxtning bo‘yi, ildiz tizimining rivojlanishi, hosildorligi va qurg‘oqchilik hamda shamol kabi noqulay tashqi muhit omillariga chidamliligiga sezilarli ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. Asosan intensiv olma bog‘larida navlarni payvand qilish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha doucin so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Birinchi marta pakana dusen va paradizka (Rayka) tipidagi olma payvandtaglari kolleksiyasi Angliyadagi East Malling tajriba stansiyasi tomonidan tashkil qilingan bo‘lib, 1936-yili 70 xil vegetativ usulda ko‘payadigan payvandtaglar o‘sish xususiyatiga qarab bir necha guruhlarga bo‘lib chiqilgan. (Olma o‘simligi ko‘chatlarini vegetativ ko‘paytirishning morfo-biologik va xo‘jalik xususiyatlarining tasnifi. Anvarbekova Ch.A., Academic Research in Educational Sciences, 2021)
definition_en: A semi-dwarf vegetative (clonal) rootstock used for apple (Malus domestica (Suckow) Borkh.) cultivation. Dusen belongs to a group of rootstocks originally selected in Western Europe and later standardized within the East Malling rootstock series. It restricts tree vigour, promotes early bearing, increases productivity, and allows high-density planting in intensive orchards. As a rootstock, it significantly influences tree size, root system development, yield performance, and tolerance to environmental stresses such as drought and wind. It is primarily used for grafting apple cultivars in intensive orchard production.
etymology_en: French doucin, derived from French doux (“sweet”).
example_en: In 1912, the research program started in East Malling Research Station in Kent, England, with the objective of collecting rootstocks “Paradise” and “Doucin” from around the world and confirming their identity. (History of Today’s Rootstocks. Bulatovic-Danilovich, 2023)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtning vegetatsiya davrida ikkinchi marta hosil qilgan mevasi. Bog‘dorchilikda bu hodisa ayrim mevali daraxtlarda vegetatsiya sharoitlari yoki biologik xususiyatlar tufayli kuzatiladi.
etymology_uz: Forscha “ikkinchi marta”, “takror” ma’nolarini bildiradi.
example_uz: Bir yillik novdalarda yetilayotgan uzum boshlari bilan bir qatorda bachki novdalarda duvarak paydo bo‘lishi mumkin. (“Fan va turmush” jurnali)
definition_en: A term used in pomology to describe fruit trees (especially fig trees) that produce two crops of fruit in a single growing season. It also refers specifically to the second main crop produced on current season's wood.
etymology_en: Bifera — Latin bifer / bifera (“bearing fruit twice a year”), from bi- (“twice”) + ferre (“to bear, carry”).
example_en: “Most common fig cultivars are bifera types, yielding a small breba crop on last year's wood followed by the main crop on current growth.” (Fruit & Nut Research & Information Center. University of California ANR)

definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub, Tagetes turkumiga kiruvchi gultojibarglari yumshoq, baxmalsimon va yorqin rangli (sariq, zargaldoq, to‘q qizil) bo‘lgan bir yillik manzarali gul. Gulzorlarda, xiyobon va bog‘larni bezashda keng qo‘llaniladi. Turlari orasida tik o‘suvchi (Tagetes erecta), oddiy yoki yoyiq (Tagetes patula) hamda nozik bargli (Tagetes tenuifolia) shakllari mavjud.
example_uz: “Xiyobon va bog‘larni bezatishda gultojixo‘roz, duxobagul, petuniya hamda xrizantemalardan keng foydalaniladi.” (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An annual ornamental flowering plant belonging to the Asteraceae family and the genus Tagetes. It is characterized by its soft, velvety petals and bright-colored flowers, including yellow, golden-orange, and deep red. It is widely used in flower beds, parks, gardens, and landscape plantings. Common species include African marigold (Tagetes erecta), French marigold (Tagetes patula), and signet marigold (Tagetes tenuifolia).
etymology_en: The word marigold comes from late Middle English marygolde, combining Mary (referring to the Virgin Mary) and gold (referring to the flower's bright yellow and orange color).
example_en: Marigolds are easy-to-grow bedding plants that provide bright colour throughout the summer. (Growing marigolds. Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), 2026)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, tikanli buta yoki kichik daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 3–10 m gacha yetadi. Barglari oddiy, patsimon bo‘lakli yoki kertikli, gullari oq yoki pushti rangda bo‘lib, qalqonsimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevasi mayda, sharsimon yoki tuxumsimon, qizil, sariq yoki to‘q binafsha rangli soxta meva bo‘lib, tarkibida 1–5 ta danak bo‘ladi. Mevalari yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, qayta ishlanadi hamda dorivor xususiyatlari tufayli xalq va ilmiy tabobatda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Yovvoyi meva daraxtlari ichida olma, do‘lana, yong‘oq, bodom, tog‘olcha ko‘proq uchraydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A thorny shrub or small tree belonging to the family Rosaceae. It usually grows 3–10 m tall. The leaves are simple, lobed or serrated, and the flowers are white or pink, arranged in corymb inflorescences. The fruit is a small, spherical or ovoid pome, red, yellow, or dark purple in color, usually containing one to five stones (pyrenes). Hawthorn fruits are eaten fresh, processed into various food products, and widely used in both traditional and modern medicine because of their medicinal properties.
etymology_en: Old English haga-þorn, composed of haga (“hedge, enclosure”) + þorn (“thorn”), referring to its traditional use as a thorny hedge plant.
example_en: “Hawthorns are widely planted as ornamental trees and hedge plants, offering late-summer berries that are valuable for wildlife and traditional medicine.” (RHS Plant Guide. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Do‘lana (Crataegus L.) daraxtining soxta meva (pome) tipiga mansub mevasi. Mevasi yumaloq yoki tuxumsimon bo‘lib, sariq, qizil yoki to‘q qizil rangda bo‘ladi, tarkibida 1–5 ta danak mavjud. U yangi iste’mol qilinadi, qayta ishlanadi hamda dorivor xomashyo sifatida ham foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Do‘lana mevasini daraxtlaridan zaxa qilmasdan terib olinsa, uni 20–30 kungacha saqlash yoki quritib qoqi qilish mumkin. (O‘zbekistonda bog‘dorchilik. Mirzayev M.M., Sobirov M.K., 1980)
definition_en: A small pome fruit produced by species of the genus Crataegus (family Rosaceae), typically containing one to five seeds and used for food, herbal medicine, and wildlife forage.
example_en: “Hawthorn fruit has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to support cardiovascular health and lower blood pressure.” (Herbal Medicine: Biomolecular and Clinical Aspects. Benzie & Wachtel-Galor, 2011)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, balandligi odatda 60–125 sm ga yetadigan ko‘p yillik butalar guruhi. Ular asosan atir-upa, farmatsevtika, kosmetika va oziq-ovqat sanoati uchun efir moyi hamda gul suvi olish maqsadida yetishtiriladi. Efir moyli atirgullar kuchli va yoqimli hidi, serbarg gullari hamda efir moyiga boy gultojbarglari bilan ajralib turadi. Bu guruhga asosan Rosa damascena, Rosa gallica, Rosa centifolia kabi turlar va ularning navlari kiradi.
example_uz: Jahon dehqonchiligida efir moyli ekinlardan atirgul, yorongul, lavanda, yalpiz asosiy ahamiyatga ega. (Efir moyli ekinlar. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: A group of perennial shrubs belonging to the Rosaceae family, typically reaching 60–125 cm in height. They are cultivated primarily for the production of rose essential oil and rose water used in the perfume, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and food industries. Essential oil roses are distinguished by their strong fragrance, double flowers, and petals rich in aromatic compounds. This group mainly includes Rosa damascena, Rosa gallica, Rosa centifolia, and their cultivars.
example_en: The essential oils and extracts of oil-bearing roses are high-value natural products with a broad range of applications. (Dobreva A. et al. Subcritical Extracts from Major Species of Oil-Bearing Roses—A Comparative Chemical Profiling. Molecules, 2021, 26(16), 4991)

definition_uz: Plug, kultivator yoki boshqa tuproqqa ishlov berish qurollari yordamida hosil qilinadigan to‘g‘ri va uzun ariqcha; jo‘yakning bir turi. Bog‘dorchilikda egatlar mevali daraxtlar, tok va ko‘chatzorlarni sug‘orish, ortiqcha suvni chiqarish hamda qator oralari ishlovini tashkil etishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Birinchi egat daraxt tanasidan 0,75–1,0 m oraliqda o‘tkaziladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A long, narrow channel or depression formed in the soil by a plough, cultivator, or other tillage implement. In horticulture, furrows are used for irrigating fruit trees, grapevines, and nursery plants, as well as for drainage and the management of inter-row cultivation.
example_en: “Furrow irrigation is one of the oldest methods of applying water to crops, where water flows down small trenches between crop rows.” (Irrigation and Drainage Paper. FAO)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Egatlar orqali suvni tuproq yuzasidan oqizib, ekin qatorlari yoki daraxt qatorlari bo‘ylab namlikni taqsimlash usuli. Bunda suv maxsus ochilgan egatlar bo‘ylab harakatlanadi va tuproqning kapillyar hamda gravitatsion namlanishi hisobiga o‘simlik ildiz zonasiga yetib boradi. Bog‘dorchilikda qator oralari va daraxt atrofi egatlari orqali sug‘orish an’anaviy yuzaki sug‘orish usullaridan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Bog‘larda egat olib sug‘orish usuli tuproq namligini saqlash va daraxtlarning suvga bo‘lgan ehtiyojini qondirish uchun qo‘llaniladi. (O‘zbekistonda bog‘dorchilik. Mirzayev M.M., Sobirov M.K., 1980)
definition_en: A surface irrigation method in which water is applied in small channels or furrows between crop rows and moves along the field by gravity, infiltrating into the soil to supply water to plant roots.
example_en: “Furrow irrigation is widely used in row-crop production as it reduces leaf wetness and lowers the risk of foliar fungal diseases.” (Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 45. FAO, 1989)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Tuproqda sug‘orish, ekish yoki agrotexnik tadbirlarni bajarish maqsadida maxsus ariqcha (egat) hosil qilish jarayoni. Bog‘dorchilikda egat ochish daraxt qatorlari oralig‘ida sug‘orish tarmoqlarini tashkil etish, ko‘chat ekish joylarini tayyorlash va tuproq yuzasida suv harakatini boshqarish uchun amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Bog‘larda daraxt qatorlari oralig‘ida sug‘orishdan oldin egatlar ochiladi. (O‘zbekistonda bog‘dorchilik. Mirzayev M.M., Sobirov M.K., 1980)
definition_en: To create narrow channels or grooves in the soil using agricultural implements for planting, irrigation, drainage, or other field operations.
example_en: Farmers make furrows before planting crops to guide irrigation water and improve field management. (National Engineering Handbook, Part 652: Irrigation Guide. USDA NRCS, 2020)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Urug‘ yoki boshqa ekish materialini unib chiqishi, ildiz otishi va yangi o‘simlik rivojlanishi uchun tuproqqa yoki boshqa o‘stirish muhitiga joylashtirmoq. Bog‘dorchilikda ekish urug‘larni sepish yoki ma’lum chuqurlikka joylashtirish, shuningdek piyozbosh, tuganak va ayrim vegetativ ko‘paytirish materiallarini o‘stirish muhitiga joylashtirishni o‘z ichiga oladi.
example_uz: Qalamchalarni ekishga tayyorlashdan maqsad ularda ildiz otish jarayonini tezlashtirish hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To place or scatter seeds in soil or another growing medium so that they can germinate and develop into new plants. In horticulture, sowing may involve broadcasting seeds or placing them individually at an appropriate depth and spacing under suitable growing conditions.
example_en: “Farmers sow crop seeds in early spring to take advantage of natural soil moisture for optimal germination.” (Principles of Plant Production and Crop Management Manual. FAO)

definition_uz: Perikarpning eng tashqi qavati. Urug‘lanishdan keyin urug‘chi tugunchasi devorining tashqi qismidan rivojlanadi va mevaning po‘stini hosil qiladi. Ekzokarp meva ichki qismlarini tashqi muhit ta’siridan, mexanik shikastlanishdan, nam yo‘qotishdan hamda kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qiladi. Uning tuzilishi meva turiga qarab yupqa, qalin, silliq, tukli yoki mumsimon bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Ekzokarp yunoncha exo («tashqarida») va karpos («meva») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan bo‘lib, «mevaning tashqi qavati» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Danakli mevalilarda ekzokarp — yumshoq, mezokarp — suvli va endokarp qattiq bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The outermost layer of the pericarp that develops from the outer wall of the ovary after fertilization. It forms the fruit skin and protects the inner tissues from mechanical injury, water loss, pests, and pathogens. Depending on the fruit type, the exocarp may be thin, thick, smooth, hairy, or waxy.
etymology_en: Exocarp derives from the Greek exo (“outside”) and karpos (“fruit”).
example_en: “The exocarp forms the protective outer skin of the fruit and varies considerably among different fruit types.” (Botany: An Introduction to Plant Biology. Mauseth J.D., 2019)

definition_uz: Seleksiya yo‘li bilan olingan va kelajakda ko‘paytirish uchun mo‘ljallangan eng yaxshi, saralangan urug‘ yoki o‘simlik navi, turi. O‘simliklar seleksiyasida yangi nav chiqarish uchun populatsiyadan, urug‘chilikda ekilayotgan navdan tanlab olinadigan eng sara o‘simliklar avlodi elita deyiladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha élite — “tanlangan, saralangan, eng yaxshi qism”.
example_uz: “Elita urug‘lar va klon payvandtagli ko‘chatlar maxsus urug‘chilik va ko‘chatchilik xo‘jaliklarida qat’iy agrotexnik nazorat ostida yetishtiriladi.” (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A superior, carefully selected seed, plant, or animal variety obtained through breeding and intended for future propagation. In plant breeding, an elite refers to the progeny of the best plants selected from a population or from a cultivated variety during seed production, which are used as the initial material for developing new varieties.
etymology_en: From French élite, meaning “choice, selected, best part”.
example_en: “Elite seed stock must meet rigorous phytosanitary and genetic purity standards before being distributed for commercial seed production.” (Seed Schemes Guidelines. OECD, 2023)

definition_uz: Seleksiya va urug‘chilikda navning irsiy va biologik xususiyatlarini to‘liq saqlagan, yuqori nav tozaligi, hosildorligi va sifat ko‘rsatkichlariga ega bo‘lgan urug‘lik yoki ko‘chat materiali. Elita reproduksiyalari keyingi urug‘chilik bosqichlari uchun asos bo‘lib xizmat qiladi va sertifikatlangan urug‘lik hamda ko‘chat yetishtirishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: “Elita urug‘chilik xo‘jaliklarida yetishtirilgan urug‘lik materiallar majburiy tartibda davlat nav sinovi va sertifikatlash ko‘rigidan o‘tkaziladi.” (O‘simlikshunoslik. Atabayeva X.N., Xudayqulov J.B., 2018)
definition_en: In plant breeding and seed production, elite refers to seed or planting material that fully retains the genetic and biological characteristics of a cultivar and possesses high varietal purity, productivity, and quality. Elite material serves as the source for further seed multiplication and the production of certified seeds and nursery stock.
example_en: “Foundation seed farms play a crucial role in maintaining the genetic purity and health standards of newly released crop varieties before large-scale commercial multiplication.” (OECD Seed Schemes: Manual for Seed Certification. OECD, 2024)

uzbek: Eman (Quercus robur L. va Quercus spp.)
definition_uz: Qayindoshlar (Fagaceae) oilasiga mansub uzoq umr ko‘ruvchi daraxtlar turkumi. Emanlar kuchli ildiz tizimi, qalin tanasi va mustahkam yog‘ochi bilan ajralib turadi. Mevasi yong‘oqcha (zholud) bo‘lib, kosachasimon g‘ilof ichida joylashadi. Eman manzarali daraxt sifatida, o‘rmon xo‘jaligida va yog‘och mahsuloti olish uchun keng ekiladi.
etymology_uz: “Eman” qadimgi turkiy tillarda daraxt nomi sifatida qo‘llanib kelgan. So‘z ko‘plab turkiy xalqlar tillarida o‘xshash shaklda uchraydi.
example_uz: Emanning shox-shabbasi piramidasimon shakldagi turi ham bo‘lib, u nihoyatda chiroyli daraxt. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
english: Oak (Quercus robur L. and Quercus spp.)
definition_en: A genus of long-lived hardwood trees in the Fagaceae family, valued for their strength, durability, and ecological importance. Oaks produce acorns and are widely used in forestry, landscaping, and timber production.
etymology_en: Derived from Old English āc (“oak tree”). The scientific name Quercus is the classical Latin name for oak.
example_en: “The high concentration of tyloses in white oak timber blocks the natural vascular pathways of the wood, making it uniquely waterproof and ideal for tight cooperage.” (Textbook of Dendrology. McGraw-Hill, 1996)

definition_uz: Perikarpning eng ichki qavati bo‘lib, urug‘ni bevosita o‘rab turadi. Urug‘lanishdan keyin urug‘chi tugunchasi devorining ichki qismidan rivojlanadi. Meva turiga qarab endokarp qattiq (shaftoli, o‘rik, olxo‘ri kabi danakli mevalarda danakni hosil qiladi), yupqa pardasimon yoki shirali bo‘lishi mumkin. Uning asosiy vazifasi urug‘ni mexanik shikastlanishdan va tashqi omillardan himoya qilishdir.
etymology_uz: Endokarp yunoncha endo («ichki») va karpos («meva») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan bo‘lib, «mevaning ichki qavati» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: O‘rik, shaftoli, gilos va olcha kabi mevalarning yeyiladigan qismi mezokarpdan, sitrus o‘simliklariniki endokarpdan iborat; bodom, yong‘oq, funduk va xandon pistaning mag‘zi iste’mol qilinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The innermost layer of the pericarp that surrounds the seed or seeds. It develops from the inner wall of the ovary after fertilization. Depending on the fruit type, the endocarp may be hard and stony, membranous, or fleshy. In drupes such as peach, apricot, and plum, it forms the stone (pit) enclosing the seed.
etymology_en: Endocarp derives from the Greek endo (“within, inside”) and karpos (“fruit”), meaning “the inner layer of the fruit wall.”
example_en: “In stone fruits, the endocarp hardens during development to form the protective pit around the seed.” (Botany: An Introduction to Plant Biology. Mauseth J.D., 2019)

definition_uz: Hasharotlar yordamida changlanadigan o‘simliklar. Bunday o‘simliklarda gul changi bir guldan ikkinchi gulga asosan asalari, kapalak, qo‘ng‘iz va boshqa hasharotlar orqali ko‘chiriladi. Ko‘pgina mevali daraxtlar (olma, nok, olcha, gilos, o‘rik va boshqalar) hamda ko‘plab manzarali o‘simliklar entomofil o‘simliklar guruhiga kiradi.
example_uz: Olma, nok va gilos kabi mevali daraxtlarning ko‘pchiligi entomofil o‘simliklar bo‘lib, ularning hosildorligi asalarilar va boshqa changlatuvchi hasharotlar faoliyatiga bog‘liq. (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi. Mirzayev M.M., Sobirov M.K., 1980)
definition_en: Plants whose flowers are pollinated by insects. In entomophilous plants, pollen is transferred from one flower to another mainly by insects such as bees, butterflies, and beetles.
example_en: “Entomophilous plants, including most orchard fruit trees, rely heavily on honeybees and native solitary bees for efficient fruit set.” (Pollinators and Pollination: Nature and Society. Ollerton, 2021)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilik ekinlari, jumladan mevali daraxtlar, tok, sabzavot va manzarali o‘simliklarga zarar yetkazuvchi hamda foydali hasharotlarni o‘rganuvchi fan sohasi. Entomologiya hasharotlarning tuzilishi, rivojlanishi, hayot kechirishi, tarqalishi va o‘simliklar bilan o‘zaro munosabatlarini o‘rganadi. Ushbu fan asosida zararkunandalarga qarshi biologik, agrotexnik va kimyoviy kurash usullari ishlab chiqiladi.
etymology_uz: Entomologiya atamasi yunoncha éntomon — “hasharot” va logos — “ta’limot, fan” so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan.
example_uz: Umumiy entomologiyaning vazifasi hasharotlarning tashqi va ichki tuzilishini, fiziologik xususiyatlarini hamda tashqi muhitning ularga ta’sirini o‘rganishdan iborat. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The branch of agricultural science that studies beneficial and harmful insects associated with horticultural crops, including fruit trees, grapevines, vegetables, and ornamental plants. Horticultural entomology investigates insect morphology, development, life cycles, distribution, and plant–insect interactions, providing the basis for biological, cultural, and chemical pest management strategies.
etymology_en: The term entomology originates from Greek éntomon (“insect”) and logos (“study” or “science”).
example_en: “Modern agricultural entomology emphasizes non-chemical population suppression methods, integrating entomopathogenic organisms and pheromone monitoring into crop protection schemes.” (Entomology and Pest Management. Pedigo & Rice, 6th ed., Waveland Press, 2014)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning yuqumli kasalliklari muayyan vaqt davomida katta hududlarda (xo‘jalik, tuman, viloyat yoki mamlakat miqyosida) keng tarqalishi hodisasi. Epifitotiya o‘simlik kasalliklarining ommaviy epidemiyasi bo‘lib, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilari (zamburug‘, bakteriya, virus va boshqa patogenlar) ta’sirida ko‘plab o‘simliklarning zararlanishi bilan tavsiflanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda epifitotiyalar mevali daraxtlar, tok va manzarali o‘simliklarda hosilning kamayishi yoki nobud bo‘lishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha epi- (“ustida, yoyilish”) + phyton (“o‘simlik”) so‘zlarining birikishidan shakllangan.
example_uz: Ekzotik kasalliklar ham epifitotiya rivojiga asos bo‘lishi mumkin — ya’ni patogen ilgari bo‘lmagan hududlarga kirib kelganda (import qilingan o‘simliklar orqali yoki boshqa yo‘llar bilan) e’tiborga olinadi. (Epifitotik turdagi favqulodda vaziyatlarda to‘g‘ri harakatlanish. Nurmatov R.E., “Science and Education” Scientific Journal, 2025)
definition_en: The widespread occurrence and rapid spread of an infectious plant disease over a large geographical area during a certain period of time. It is the plant disease equivalent of an epidemic in animals or humans.
etymology_en: Epiphytoty comes from Greek epi- (“upon, among”) + phyton (“plant”), referring to a disease occurring among plants.
example_en: “An epiphytotic of late blight destroyed potato crops across Ireland in the mid-19th century, resulting in severe famine.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios, 2005)

definition_uz: Urug‘ unib chiqishi davrida urug‘palla (kotiledon) tuguni bilan birinchi haqiqiy barglar orasida joylashgan poyaning yuqori qismi. Epikotil urug‘palladan yuqorida joylashadi va niholning yer ustki qismining shakllanishida ishtirok etadi. Ikki pallali o‘simliklarda epikotil rivojlanib, yosh novda va barglarning hosil bo‘lishiga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Epikotil yunoncha epi- — “ustida, yuqorisida” va kotyledon — “urug‘palla” so‘zlaridan tashkil topgan. Ma’nosi — “urug‘palla ustidagi poya qismi”.
example_uz: Ildiz bo‘ynidan urug‘palladan hosil bo‘lgan barggacha bo‘lgan qism gipokotil, undan birinchi barggacha bo‘lgan qismi epikotil deyiladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The portion of the embryonic axis above the cotyledons. During germination, the epicotyl develops into the upper shoot of the seedling and bears the first true leaves.
etymology_en: Epicotyl derives from Greek epi- (“upon, above”) + kotyledon (“seed leaf”).
example_en: “In dicots, the shoot has three main parts: the cotyledons (seed leaves), the section of shoot below the cotyledons (hypocotyl), and the section of shoot above the cotyledons (epicotyl).” (Seed and Seedling Biology. Penn State Extension)

definition_uz: Muayyan o‘stirish sharoitida shu turga mansub boshqa navlarga nisbatan mevasi yoki hosili mavsumning ertaroq muddatida pishib yetiladigan o‘simlik yoki navga xos belgi. Bog‘dorchilikda ertapishar navlar hosilining asosiy pishish mavsumidan oldin yetilishi bilan tavsiflanadi.
example_uz: Gamlin — apelsinning eng serhosil, ertapishar navi bo‘lib, O‘rta dengiz guruhiga kiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Describing a plant or cultivar whose fruits or crop reach harvest maturity earlier than those of other cultivars of the same species under similar growing conditions.
example_en: “Early-ripening peach cultivars are highly valued by fruit growers for securing high market returns before the main season influx.” (Plant Breeding with Farmers: A Technical Manual. Ceccarelli, 2012)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Xalq seleksiyasida yaratilgan o‘rtapishar xo‘raki uzum navi. Sharqiy ekologik-geografik navlar guruhiga mansub. Tupi kuchli o‘sadi, guli funksional urg‘ochi. Uzum boshi yirik, g‘ujumlari cho‘zinchoq oval, to‘q qizil rangli, eti tig‘iz, sershira va qarsildoq. Mevasi 135 kunda, avgustning ikkinchi yarmida pishadi. Hosildorligi 100–120 ts/ga. Antraknoz va oidium (rag‘a) kasalligiga nisbatan chidamli.
example_uz: Echkiemar qanddorligi: to‘liq pishganda 20–22%, kislotaliligi — 4,0–4,5 g/l. (Uzum navlarining tavsifi. Abdikayumov Z.A., 2023)
definition_en: A mid-season table grape cultivar developed through folk selection. It belongs to the Eastern ecological-geographical group. The vine is vigorous with functionally female flowers. Clusters are large, bearing large elongated-oval dark red berries with firm, crisp, and juicy flesh. The fruit ripens in about 135 days, usually during the second half of August. The cultivar yields 100–120 centners per hectare and shows resistance to anthracnose and powdery mildew.
example_en: “The Echkemar grape is a valuable indigenous Central Asian table variety prized for its attractive red elongated berries and excellent shelf life.” (Vitis International Variety Catalogue. VIVC, 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: O‘simlik poyasi yoki boshqa vegetativ organlarining qing‘ir-qiyshiq, lentasimon yoki yassilashgan holda g‘ayritabiiy rivojlanishi. Ba’zan fassiatsiya natijasida bir necha shoxlar o‘zaro qo‘shilib, yiriklashgan poya yoki novda hosil qiladi. Bu hodisa sachratqi, marjondaraxt, shuvoq, shumtol, qoraqat kabi o‘simliklarda uchraydi. Ayrim o‘simliklarda (masalan, gultojixo‘rozda) fassiatsiya irsiy belgi sifatida urug‘ orqali keyingi avlodga ham o‘tishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Fassiatsiya — lotincha fascia (“tasma, bog‘ich, boylama”) so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Fassiatsiyalarning shakllanishi yoz boshida, gullar va kurtaklar rivojlanayotgan vaqtda havo nisbiy namligining past bo‘lishi fonida iliq havo haroratining keskin ko‘tarilishi bilan bog‘liq. (Qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligida innovatsion texnologiyalar. Xolmurodova G.R. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A developmental abnormality in plants in which the growing point (apical meristem) becomes elongated, producing flattened, ribbon-like, fused or crested stems, branches, flowers or fruits.
etymology_en: Latin fascia (“band, strip, ribbon”) + -ation (noun suffix denoting process or state).
example_en: “Fasciation can be caused by hormonal imbalances, genetic mutations, bacterial infections, or environmental damage to the growing tip of the plant.” (Plant Pathology. Agrios, 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va mavsumiy o‘zgarishida kurtak yozish, barg chiqarish, gullash, meva tugish va meva yetilishi kabi muayyan biologik hamda morfologik xususiyatlar bilan ajralib turadigan davr yoki bosqich (fenologik faza).
etymology_uz: Faza termini fransuzcha phase so‘zidan o‘zlashgan bo‘lib, u yunoncha phásis — “ko‘rinish, paydo bo‘lish” so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Bog‘larni sug‘orishda meva daraxtlarining o‘suv davridagi fazalar hisobga olinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A distinct stage or period in the seasonal developmental cycle of a plant, such as bud burst, flowering, fruit set, or maturity, characterized by specific morphological and physiological changes.
etymology_en: French phase, from New Latin phasis, from Greek phásis (“appearance, aspect”), derived from phaínein (“to show, bring to light”).
example_en: “Pecan trees and most other woody plants have two distinct growth phases relative to the time the plants begin to bear fruit.” (Herrera E. Juvenile and Adult Phases of Pecan Trees. New Mexico State University, Guide H-616)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning rivojlanish fazalari (fenofazalari)ning boshlanishi, davom etishi va tugash muddatlarini muntazam kuzatish hamda qayd etish jarayoni. Bog‘dorchilikda fenologik kuzatishlar kurtak bo‘rtishi, kurtak yozilishi, gullash, meva tugishi, meva pishishi, barglarning sarg‘ayishi va to‘kilishi kabi fenofazalarning boshlanish muddatini aniqlash, navlarni baholash va agrotexnik tadbirlarni belgilash uchun o‘tkaziladi.
example_uz: “Bog‘dorchilikda fenologik kuzatishlar o‘tkazish orqali turli navlarning vegetatsiya davri davomiyligi va bahorgi qashshoq sovuqlarga chidamliligi aniqlanadi.” (O‘simlikshunoslik. Atabayeva X.N., Xudayqulov J.B., 2018)
definition_en: Systematic observations and recording of the timing of recurring plant developmental stages, such as bud break, flowering, fruit development, fruit ripening, leaf colouring, and leaf fall, in relation to seasonal and climatic conditions.
example_en: “The phenological observations were recorded from the day the seedlings were planted.” (Investigation of Rain-Fed Horticulture Productivity in the Namangan Region, Uzbekistan. Water, 2023, 15(13), 2399)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda yil fasllari hamda iqlim sharoiti ta’sirida muntazam takrorlanib turadigan mavsumiy biologik hodisalarni, ularning boshlanishi, davom etishi va tugash muddatlarini o‘rganadigan fan. Bog‘dorchilikda fenologiya mevali va manzarali o‘simliklarning kurtak bo‘rtishi, barg yozishi, gullashi, meva tugishi, meva pishishi, barg to‘kilishi va tinim davri kabi fenofazalarini kuzatish hamda baholash bilan shug‘ullanadi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha phainō (φαίνω) — “paydo bo‘lmoq, namoyon bo‘lmoq” va logos (λόγος) — “ta’limot, fan” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Tekshirish obyektiga binoan, fenologiya umumiy va xususiy fenologiyaga bo‘linadi. (Fenokuzatuvning maqsadi va uni o‘tkazishning tashkil etish asoslari. Ismoilov O.I., Research Focus, 2023)
definition_en: The branch of science that studies the timing of recurring biological events, such as bud break, flowering, fruiting, leaf fall, and other seasonal stages of plants and animals, and their relationship with climate and environmental conditions.
etymology_en: From Greek phainō (“to appear, to show”) + -logy (“study, science”).
example_en: “Phenology is the study of seasonally-recurring biological events (such as leaf-out, fruit production, and animal reproduction and migration) and how these events are influenced by environmental change.” (Kish G.R. Hydrology, Phenology and the USA National Phenology Network. U.S. Geological Survey Fact Sheet 2010-3083, 2010)

definition_uz: Organizmning genotipi bilan tashqi muhit omillarining o‘zaro ta’siri natijasida shakllanadigan barcha kuzatiladigan morfologik, anatomik, fiziologik, biokimyoviy va xo‘jalik belgilarining yig‘indisi. Bog‘dorchilikda fenotip meva rangi, shakli, hajmi, ta’mi, hosildorligi, kasalliklarga chidamliligi, pishish muddati va boshqa belgilar orqali namoyon bo‘ladi hamda seleksiya ishlarida muhim mezon hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Fenotip termini yunoncha phainein (“namoyon bo‘lmoq, ko‘rinmoq”) va typos (“shakl, tip”) so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan. Termin XX asr boshlarida genetika faniga kiritilgan.
example_uz: “Bir xil genotipga ega bo‘lgan mevali daraxt parvarishlash va iqlim sharoitiga qarab turlicha fenotip namoyon etishi, ya’ni mevasining hajmi va rangi o‘zgarishi mumkin.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Fenotip” maqolasi)
definition_en: The set of observable morphological, anatomical, physiological, biochemical, and agronomic characteristics of an organism resulting from the expression of its genotype in interaction with environmental factors. In horticulture, phenotype includes traits such as fruit colour, shape, size, flavour, yield, disease resistance, and ripening time and is an important criterion in plant breeding and selection.
etymology_en: From German Phänotypus, introduced by Wilhelm Johannsen in 1909, and ultimately derived from Greek phainein (“to show, appear”) and typos (“type, form”).
example_en: “The phenotype of a plant is a term used to describe observable characteristics, such as height, biomass, leaf shape and so on.” (What is a Phenotype? Warwick Crop Centre, University of Warwick, 2016)

definition_uz: Fillokserasimonlar (Phylloxeridae) oilasiga mansub mayda, shiraga o‘xshash so‘ruvchi hasharot. Tokning eng xavfli zararkunandalaridan biri bo‘lib, asosan ildiz va barglarini zararlaydi. Ildizlarda shish va zararlanishlar, barglarda esa gallar (bo‘rtmalar) hosil qiladi. Kuchli zararlanish tokning zaiflashishi va nobud bo‘lishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Filloksera — yunoncha phyllon (“barg”) va xēros (“quruq”) so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Hozirgi aksariyat uzum navlarining sovuqdan, ayniqsa filloksera hamda zamburug‘ kasalliklari (oidium, mild, antraknoz, kulrang chirish va h.k.) zararlanishi tufayli har yili hosilning anchagina qismi nobud bo‘lmoqda. (Uzumchilik asoslari, Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: A small aphid-like insect of the family Phylloxeridae that feeds on grapevines. It damages both roots and leaves, causing root swellings and leaf galls, and is particularly destructive to susceptible Vitis vinifera vines.
etymology_en: Phylloxera derives from Greek phyllon (“leaf”) and xēros (“dry”).
example_en: “Grape phylloxera (Daktulosphaira vitifoliae syn. Viteus vitifoliae) is a destructive pest to grapevines (Vitis sp.) and is native to eastern and central North America.” (Skinkis P.A. et al. Soil and Climate Geographic Information System Data-Derived Risk Mapping for Grape Phylloxera in Washington State. Frontiers in Plant Science, 2022, 13:827393)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar yoki ularning tirik to‘qimalari bilan oziqlanadigan organizmlar. Entomologiyada fitofaglar asosan o‘simliklarning ildiz, poya, barg, gul, meva va urug‘lari bilan oziqlanadigan hasharotlarni anglatadi. Ular oziqlanish doirasiga ko‘ra monofag, oligofag va polifaglarga bo‘linadi. Bog‘dorchilikda ko‘plab fitofag hasharotlar mevali daraxtlar va tokning muhim zararkunandalari hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Fitofag yunoncha phyton — “o‘simlik” va phagos — “yeyuvchi, oziqlanuvchi” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Masalan, faqat o‘simliklar bilan oziqlanadigan hasharotlar fitofaglar deb ataladi. Bularga uzun mo‘ylovli qo‘ng‘izlar, bargxo‘rlar, uzunburunlilar, po‘stloqxo‘rlar, chigirtkasimonlar va boshqalarni misol qilib ko‘rsatish mumkin. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Insects that feed on living plants or plant tissues. They may feed on roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits, or seeds and may be classified according to host range as monophagous, oligophagous, or polyphagous.
etymology_en: Phytophagous derives from Greek phyton (“plant”) and phagein (“to eat”), literally meaning “plant-eating.”
example_en: “The sexual behavior of phytophagous insects is often integrated in a variety of ways with their host plants.” (Landolt P.J., Phillips T.W. Host Plant Influences on Sex Pheromone Behavior of Phytophagous Insects. Annual Review of Entomology, 1997, 42: 371–391)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda juda kam miqdorda hosil bo‘ladigan va ularning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi hamda fiziologik jarayonlarini boshqaradigan biologik faol signal moddalar. Fitogormonlar hujayra bo‘linishi va cho‘zilishi, ildiz hosil bo‘lishi, gullash, meva tugishi, meva pishishi, urug‘ning unishi, tinim davri hamda tashqi muhit ta’sirlariga javob reaksiyalarini tartibga soladi. Klassik fitogormonlarga auksinlar, gibberellinlar, sitokininlar, abssiz kislotasi va etilen kiradi.
etymology_uz: Fitogormon yunoncha phyton — “o‘simlik” va hormao — “harakatga keltirmoq, qo‘zg‘atmoq” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Fitogormonlar o‘simlik hujayralarida juda kam miqdorda sintez qilinishiga qaramay, fiziologik va biokimyoviy jarayonlarni boshqarishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi. (Fitogarmonlar va ularning o‘simlik organizmidagi ahamiyati. Usmonjonova M., Ahmedova G., Axmadjonova A., Tuxtaboyeva F.M., Universal xalqaro ilmiy jurnal, 2025)
definition_en: Naturally occurring signaling molecules produced in plants at very low concentrations that regulate growth, development, reproduction, physiological processes, and responses to environmental stimuli. The five classical phytohormones are auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid, and ethylene.
etymology_en: From phyto- (Greek phyton, “plant”) + hormone (Greek hormao, “to excite, set in motion”).
example_en: “Phytohormones, which are also known as plant hormones, are small, naturally occurring organic compounds that significantly influence the growth, development, defense, productivity, and physiological mechanisms of plants.” (Biosynthetic Pathways of Hormones in Plants. International Journal of Molecular Sciences, 2023, 24(13), 10907)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar tomonidan hosil qilinadigan biologik faol modda bo‘lib, bakteriyalar, zamburug‘lar va boshqa mikroorganizmlarning o‘sishi hamda rivojlanishini to‘xtatishi yoki ularni nobud qilishi mumkin. Fitonsidlar o‘simliklarning tabiiy himoya tizimida muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Piyoz, sarimsoq, evkalipt va boshqa ko‘plab o‘simliklar fitonsid xususiyatiga ega moddalar hosil qiladi.
etymology_uz: Fitonsid yunoncha phyton — “o‘simlik” va lotincha caedere — “o‘ldirmoq” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan. Termin Boris P. Tokin tomonidan XX asrning birinchi yarmida fanga kiritilgan.
example_uz: “Sarimsoq, piyoz, archa, ignabargli daraxtlar hamda yalpiz ajratadigan fitonsidlar bog‘ va xiyobonlar havosidagi patogen mikroorganizmlarni zararsizlantirib, sanitariya-gigiyena muhitini yaxshilaydi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Fitonsidlar” maqolasi)
definition_en: A biologically active substance of plant origin with antimicrobial properties that can inhibit the growth or activity of microorganisms. Phytoncides form part of the natural chemical defence mechanisms of plants.
etymology_en: From Greek phyton (“plant”) + Latin caedere (“to kill”). The term phytoncide was introduced by Boris P. Tokin.
example_en: “Phytoncides are volatile organic compounds released from trees and plants and are well known for their natural antibacterial activity.” (Shin J., Lee S. Encapsulation of Phytoncide in Nanofibers by Emulsion Electrospinning and their Antimicrobial Assessment. Fibers and Polymers, 2018, 19(3), 627–634)

definition_uz: O‘simlik kasalliklari, ularning kelib chiqish sabablari, qo‘zg‘atuvchilari, rivojlanish qonuniyatlari, diagnostikasi, oldini olish va ularga qarshi kurash usullarini o‘rganadigan fan. Umumiy fitopatologiya kasalliklarning umumiy qonuniyatlarini, xususiy fitopatologiya esa alohida ekinlar kasalliklarini o‘rganadi. Bog‘dorchilikda fitopatologiya mevali daraxtlar, tok va manzarali o‘simliklar kasalliklarini aniqlash hamda ularga qarshi kurash choralarini ishlab chiqishga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Fitopatologiya yunoncha phyton — “o‘simlik”, pathos — “kasallik, azob” va logos — “ta’limot, fan” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: O‘simliklarni himoya qilish chora-tadbirlarining samaradorligini baholashda fitopatologiya ko‘p iqtisodiy va matematik tadqiq qilish metodlarini qo‘llaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The scientific study of plant diseases, including their causes, development, diagnosis, prevention, and control. It encompasses diseases caused by fungi, bacteria, viruses, nematodes, phytoplasmas, and environmental factors.
etymology_en: From Greek phyton ("plant") + pathos ("disease, suffering") + -logy ("study, science").
example_en: "Advances in molecular phytopathology allow fruit breeders to identify disease-resistant genes and develop cultivars with enhanced immunity." (Plant Pathology. Agrios, 2005)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari urug‘lari va o‘simliklarida kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi mikroorganizmlarni aniqlash maqsadida o‘tkaziladigan laboratoriya va dala tekshiruvi. Fitopatologik ekspertiza orqali urug‘ yoki o‘simlikning zamburug‘, bakteriya va viruslar bilan zararlanish darajasi, qo‘zg‘atuvchilarning tur tarkibi aniqlanadi hamda ularni zararsizlantirish va oldini olish bo‘yicha tavsiyalar ishlab chiqiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda bu ekspertiza mevali daraxtlar, tok va ko‘chat materialining fitosanitar holatini baholashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Vilt bilan zararlangan o‘simliklar fitopatologik tahlil qilinganda fuzarium oksisporumdan tashqari boshqa fuzarium turlari ham ajralib chiqishi mumkinligi aniqlangan, lekin bu kasallikni qo‘zg‘atuvchisi faqat fuzarium oksisporum deb tan olingan. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The laboratory and field examination of seeds or plants to detect, identify and assess plant pathogens, determine the level of infection, and support disease prevention, quarantine and control measures. Seed health testing includes standardized methods for detecting seed-borne fungi, bacteria and viruses.
example_en: "A thorough phytopathological expertise of imported rootstocks is required to prevent the introduction of latent viral pathogens into commercial stone-fruit orchards." (EPPO Standards on Plant Quarantine & Pathology. EPPO, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni sun’iy boshqariladigan muhitda o‘stirish va ilmiy tadqiqotlar olib borish uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus bino yoki kameralar majmuasi. Fitotronda harorat, yorug‘lik, havo va tuproq namligi, karbonat angidrid (CO₂) miqdori hamda boshqa ekologik omillar qat’iy nazorat qilinadi. Bog‘dorchilikda fitotron seleksiya, o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi, kasalliklarga chidamlilik, navlarni sinash va agrotexnik tadqiqotlarda keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha phyto- — “o‘simlik” va -tron — “qurilma, joy” ma’nolarini bildiruvchi qo‘shimchadan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: "Seleksionerlar yangi meva va sabzavot navlarining qurg‘oqchilik hamda sovuqqa chidamliligini baholash uchun fitotron kameralarida sun’iy ekstremal sharoitlarni hosil qiladilar." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Fitotron" va "O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi" maqolalari)
definition_en: A laboratory or enclosed research greenhouse with facilities for growing plants under precisely controlled environmental conditions, including temperature, humidity, light, carbon dioxide concentration and other growth factors.
etymology_en: From phyto- ("plant") + -tron, modeled after the word cyclotron.
example_en: "Phytotrons allow horticultural scientists to simulate different climate change scenarios and evaluate crop physiological responses year-round." (Handbook of Plant and Crop Physiology. Pessarakli, 2020)

definition_uz: Polemoniyadoshlar (Polemoniaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik yoki bir yillik manzarali o‘simliklar turkumi. Flokslar tik yoki yoyilib o‘suvchi poyalari, qarama-qarshi joylashgan barglari va turli rangdagi (oq, pushti, qizil, binafsha va boshqalar) xushbo‘y gullari bilan ajralib turadi. Ular gulzorlar, rabatkalar, bordyurlar va landshaft kompozitsiyalarida keng ekiladi. Ayrim turlari tuproq qoplovchi manzarali o‘simlik sifatida ham foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha phlox (“alanga, olov, chaqnash”).
example_uz: "Manzarali bog‘dorchilikda va shahar xiyobonlarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda floks o‘simligining panikulata (Phlox paniculata) turi o‘zining sergulligi hamda sovuqqa chidamliligi bilan alohida qadrlanadi." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Gulchilik" va "Manzarali o‘simliklar" maqolalari)
definition_en: A genus of annual and perennial ornamental plants belonging to the family Polemoniaceae. Phlox species are characterized by erect or creeping stems, opposite leaves, and clusters of brightly colored, often fragrant flowers including white, pink, red, and purple forms. They are widely cultivated in gardens, flower beds, borders, and landscape designs. Some species are used as ground-cover plants.
etymology_en: Phlox — Latin phlox, from Greek phlox (flame, blaze), referring to the intense, fiery red color of some species' blossoms. Named by Carl Linnaeus in 1753.
example_en: "Perennial phlox (Phlox paniculata) is a staple in temperate herbaceous borders, providing vibrant blooms and fragrance throughout the mid-to-late summer months." (RHS Encyclopedia of Garden Plants. Royal Horticultural Society, 2016)

definition_uz: Shisha yoki shaffof materialdan tayyorlangan yopiq (yoki yarim yopiq) idishda manzarali o‘simliklarni o‘stirish uchun mo‘ljallangan miniatyura kompozitsiyasi. Unda namlik va mikroiqlim saqlanib turadi, shu sababli tropik va subtropik o‘simliklarni parvarish qilish uchun qulay sharoit yaratiladi. Bog‘dorchilik va interyer fitodizaynida florarium dekorativ maqsadlarda keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Florarium lotincha flora (“o‘simliklar, gullar”) va -arium (“saqlash yoki joylashtirish joyi”) qo‘shimchasidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: "Xonadon va ofislar interyeri dizaynida florariumlardan foydalanish xonaga estetik xushnudlik bag‘ishlabgina qolmay, maxsus mikroiqlim talab qiluvchi tropik o‘simliklarni o‘stirish imkonini beradi." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Manzarali gulchilik" va "Fitodizayn" maqolalari)
definition_en: A glass or transparent enclosed container used to cultivate and display ornamental plants under controlled humidity and environmental conditions; essentially a planted terrarium.
etymology_en: Derived from Latin flora (“flowers; plant life”) + the suffix -arium, meaning “a place for keeping or displaying something.”
example_en: "A closed florarium creates its own self-sustaining water cycle, making it an ideal low-maintenance option for indoor landscaping." (Terrarium Craft. Aiello et al., 2011)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub, bo‘yi 2–3 metrgacha yetadigan bargto‘kar buta yoki kichik daraxt turi. Barglari qarama-qarshi joylashgan, lansetsimon (ingichka-uzun), to‘q yashil. Gullari mayda, oqish-sarg‘ish tusli, serhosil va xushbo‘y bo‘lib, barg qo‘ltiqlarida shingilsimon to‘pgullarda yig‘iladi. Qurg‘oqchilikka, sovuqqa hamda tuproq sharoitiga juda chidamli bo‘lgani sababli ihota daraxtzorlari va manzarali bog‘dorchilikda (jonli devorlar hosil qilishda) ko‘p foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ushbu turkum Xitoy va O‘rta yer dengizi botanikasini tadqiq etgan fransuz botanigi va professori René Louiche Desfontaines (1750–1833) sharafiga nomlangan.
example_uz: "Fontaneziya o‘zining tez o‘sishi, qurg‘oqchilik va sho‘rlanishga chidamliligi sababli ihota va landshaft dizaynida yashil devorlar barpo etishda qimmatli tur hisoblanadi." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Zaytundoshlar" hamda Dendrologiya darsliklari)
definition_en: A deciduous shrub or small tree in the olive family (Oleaceae), native to the Mediterranean region and Western Asia, characterized by slender upright branches, lanceolate leaves, and small greenish-white fragrant flowers, widely used for hedges and erosion control due to its drought tolerance.
etymology_en: The genus Fontanesia was named in honour of the French botanist René Louiche Desfontaines (1750–1833).
example_en: "Due to its dense growth habit and extreme hardiness, Fontanesia phillyreoides is frequently utilized for windbreaks and ornamental screening hedges in dry climates." (Dirr's Encyclopedia of Trees and Shrubs. Dirr, 2024)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub, bo‘yi 3 metrgacha yetadigan bargto‘kar manzarali buta turi. Bahorda hali barg chiqarmasdan turib, novdalari bo‘ylab mo‘l-ko‘l yorqin sariq gullar ochishi bilan ajralib turadi. Novdalari egiluvchan va osilib tushuvchi (suspensa) bo‘lgani sababli osma forzitsiya deb ham ataladi. Manzarali bog‘dorchilikdan tashqari, uning mevalari tabobatda (xususan, sharq tabobatida) shamollashga qarshi shifobaxsh vosita sifatida keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Forzitsiya nomi XVIII asr ingliz bog‘boni William Forsyth (1737–1804) sharafiga berilgan.
example_uz: Ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda egiluvchan forzitsiya (Forsythia suspensa Vahl.) turidan ham keng foydalaniladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M., 2014)
definition_en: A deciduous flowering shrub in the olive family (Oleaceae), native to China. It is valued for its bright yellow flowers that bloom on bare branches in early spring before the leaves emerge. It is widely planted in parks and gardens as an ornamental landscape shrub.
etymology_en: Named after the Scottish horticulturist William Forsyth (1737–1804).
example_en: "Weeping forsythia (Forsythia suspensa) is widely planted along retaining walls and slopes, where its trailing branches produce a dramatic cascading golden display in early spring." (Dirr's Encyclopedia of Trees and Shrubs. Dirr, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar uchun zarur bo‘lgan asosiy mineral oziq elementlardan biri. Fosfor o‘simliklarda ildiz tizimining rivojlanishi, energiya almashinuvi, fotosintez jarayonlari, gullash, urug‘ hosil bo‘lishi va mevalarning yetilishida muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Tuproqda fosfor yetishmasligi o‘simliklarning o‘sishini susaytiradi, barglarda to‘q yashil yoki binafsha tusli belgilar paydo bo‘lishiga va hosildorlikning kamayishiga olib keladi.
etymology_uz: Fosfor atamasi yunoncha phōs/phōtos (“yorug‘lik”) va phoros (“eltuvchi, olib keluvchi”) so‘zlaridan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Meva daraxtlarining guli, tugunchalari va barglarida azot, fosfor hamda kaliy eng ko‘p, qari tanasi va yo‘g‘on ildizlarida kamroq bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A major mineral nutrient element essential for plant growth and development. Phosphorus plays an important role in root system formation, energy transfer, photosynthesis, flowering, seed formation, and fruit ripening. Phosphorus deficiency in soil reduces plant growth, may cause dark green or purplish coloration of leaves, and decreases crop productivity.
etymology_en: The word phosphorus comes from Greek phōs (“light”) and phoros (“bearing, carrying”), meaning “light-bearer.”
example_en: "Adequate phosphorus availability during early growth stages stimulates root elongation and enhances crop tolerance to environmental stresses." (Principles of Plant Nutrition. Mengel et al., 2001)

definition_uz: Fosfat yoki fosfor birikmalarini o‘z ichiga olgan, fosfor bilan boyitilgan. Bog‘dorchilikda termin asosan fosfatli o‘g‘itlar (superfosfat, fosforit uni va boshqalar) hamda fosfatli tuproqlarni ifodalash uchun qo‘llanadi. Fosfatli o‘g‘itlar ildiz tizimining rivojlanishini, gullashni, meva tugishini va hosildorlikni oshirishga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha phōs (“yorug‘lik”) + phoros (“tashuvchi, keltiruvchi”) so‘zlaridan olingan.
example_uz: "Kuzgi shudgorlash paytida tuproqqa fosfatli o‘g‘itlar (superfosfat, ammofos) solish mevali daraxtlarning ildiz tizimini mustahkamlaydi va qishki sovuqlarga chidamliligini oshiradi." (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Of, relating to, or containing phosphates or phosphoric acid. In horticulture, the term is commonly used in expressions such as phosphatic fertilizers, referring to fertilizers that supply phosphorus for plant growth.
etymology_en: From phosphate + -ic. First recorded in English in the early 19th century (1820–1830).
example_en: "The application of phosphate fertilizers during early spring enhances root vigor and promotes early flower bud differentiation in stone fruit orchards." (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers. Havlin et al., 2016)

definition_uz: Tarkibida o‘simliklar o‘zlashtira oladigan fosfor bo‘lgan mineral o‘g‘itlar. Fosforli o‘g‘itlar ildiz tizimining rivojlanishini, gullashni, meva hosil bo‘lishini va pishishni jadallashtiradi, o‘simliklarning qurg‘oqchilik hamda sovuqqa chidamliligini oshiradi. Bog‘dorchilikda superfosfat, qo‘sh superfosfat, ammofos va fosforit uni eng ko‘p qo‘llaniladigan fosforli o‘g‘itlardir.
example_uz: Fosforli o‘g‘it tayyorlash uchun 1 l fosforli suvda 5 g superfosfat eritiladi va eritma 30 daqiqa qaynatiladi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Mineral fertilizers that supply phosphorus, usually in the form of calcium, ammonium or potassium phosphates, to support root development, flowering, fruit formation and crop production.
example_en: "The application of phosphate fertilizers during deep autumn tillage ensures that phosphorus is available in the root zone during early spring growth." (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers. Havlin et al., 2016)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning sutkadagi yorug‘lik va qorong‘ilik davrlarining davomiyligiga nisbatan fiziologik javob reaksiyasi. Bog‘dorchilikda fotodavriylik gullash, vegetativ o‘sish, meva tugish, kurtaklarning tinim holati va urug‘larning unishiga ta’sir etuvchi muhim ekologik omildir. Fotodavriylikka ko‘ra o‘simliklar uzun kun, qisqa kun va kun uzunligiga befarq o‘simliklarga bo‘linadi.
etymology_uz: Foto- (yunoncha phōs, phōtos — “yorug‘lik”) + davr + -iylik.
example_uz: "Fotodavriylik hodisasi sababli shimoliy kengliklardan keltirilgan uzun kun ekinlarini janubiy hududlarda o‘stirishda ularning gullash va meva berish muddatlari o‘zgaradi." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Fotoperiodizm" va "O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi" maqolalari)
definition_en: The physiological response of plants or other organisms to the relative lengths of day and night (photoperiod). In horticulture, photoperiodism regulates flowering, dormancy, seed germination and other developmental processes.
etymology_en: Greek phōs/phōtos (“light”) + periodos (“cycle, period of time”) + -ism (suffix forming abstract nouns). Coined by W. W. Garner and H. A. Allard in 1920.
example_en: "Understanding photoperiodism is essential in commercial greenhouse horticulture to control the precise flowering time of seasonal ornamental crops like Chrysanthemums." (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Yashil o‘simliklar, suvo‘tlar va ayrim mikroorganizmlarda xlorofill ishtirokida quyosh nuri energiyasi yordamida karbonat angidrid (CO₂) va suvdan organik moddalar sintez qilinishi hamda kislorod ajralib chiqishi jarayoni. Bog‘dorchilikda fotosintez mevali daraxtlar, tok va manzarali o‘simliklarning o‘sishi, gullashi, meva hosil qilishi va hosildorligini belgilovchi asosiy fiziologik jarayon hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha phōs/phōtos (“yorug‘lik”) + synthesis (“birikish, biriktirish, hosil qilish”) so‘zlarining birikuvidan hosil bo‘lib, “yorug‘lik yordamida biriktirish / hosil qilish” degan ma’noni anglatadi.
example_uz: Ko‘pgina mevali daraxtlarda fotosintez jarayonlarining yaxshi o‘tishi uchun daraxtlarning shox-shabbasiga tushgan yorug‘lik miqdori 70–80 foiz (ochiq joyga nisbatan qaraganda) bo‘lishi zarur va bu jarayon daraxtlarning yaxshi o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va hosildorligiga ijobiy ta’sir etadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The process by which green plants and certain other organisms use light energy to convert water and carbon dioxide into carbohydrates, releasing oxygen as a by-product.
etymology_en: From Greek phōs (“light”) + synthesis (“putting together”). The term photosynthesis was introduced by Charles Reid Barnes in the 1890s.
example_en: "Optimal canopy architecture in fruit orchards maximizes light interception, thereby accelerating photosynthesis and enhancing sugar accumulation in developing fruit." (Plant Physiology and Development. Taiz L. et al., 2015)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilik ekinlari zararkunandalari sonini kamaytiradigan, o‘simliklarni changlatadigan hamda inson uchun bevosita yoki bilvosita foyda keltiradigan hasharotlar. Ular changlatuvchilar, yirtqich va parazit entomofaglar, shuningdek asal, mum, ipak kabi mahsulotlar beruvchi hasharotlarga bo‘linadi. Bog‘dorchilikda foydali hasharotlar biologik kurashning asosiy omillaridan hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Sabzavot va poliz ekinlari zararkunandalarini biologik himoya qilishda quyidagi foydali hasharotlardan foydalanish mumkin. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Insects that provide direct or indirect benefits to agriculture, horticulture, or humans by pollinating plants, suppressing pest populations, decomposing organic matter, or producing useful products such as honey, wax, and silk. They include pollinators, predators, parasitoids, decomposers, and other economically useful insects.
example_en: “Many insects are considered ‘beneficial’ because they have natural behaviors that benefit humans.” (Encouraging Beneficial Insects in the Garden. Oregon State University Extension)

definition_uz: (C₆H₁₂O₆) — monosaxarid, ketozalar guruhiga mansub oddiy uglevod. Tabiiy holda mevalar, rezavorlar, uzum, asal va gul nektarida uchraydi.
