Bog‘dorchilikda fruktoza mevalarning asosiy eruvchan shakarlaridan biri bo‘lib, u mevaning shirinligi, ta’mi, pishish darajasi va sifat ko‘rsatkichlarini belgilaydi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha fructus (“meva”) so‘zidan va kimyoviy -ose qo‘shimchasidan hosil bo‘lgan. Termin 1857-yilda ingliz kimyogari William Allen Miller tomonidan kiritilgan.
example_uz: Uzum tarkibida yaxshi o‘zlashtiriladigan shakar (glyukoza va fruktoza), organik kislotalar va boshqa moddalar bo‘lishi va tarkibiy qismlarining bir-biriga mos ravishda birikkanligi tufayli ular davolash xususiyatiga ega. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A simple sugar (monosaccharide) naturally found in fruits, honey and plant nectar. Fructose is the sweetest naturally occurring sugar and is one of the principal sugars contributing to fruit quality and flavor.
etymology_en: From Latin fructus (“fruit”) + the chemical suffix -ose. The name fructose was coined by the English chemist William Allen Miller in 1857.
example_en: "The accumulation of fructose during fruit ripening directly influences the sweetness index and flavor characteristics of sweet cherries and apples." (Biochemistry of Fruit Ripening. Seymour et al., 1993)

definition_uz: Zararkunandalar, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilari va ayrim hollarda begona o‘t urug‘larini yo‘q qilish maqsadida o‘simliklar, ko‘chatlar, mevalar, urug‘lar, omborlar, issiqxonalar yoki boshqa obyektlarga gazsimon pestitsidlar (fumigantlar) bilan ishlov berish usuli. Bog‘dorchilikda fumigatsiya ko‘chat materiallari, mevalar va o‘simlik mahsulotlarini karantin zararkunandalaridan xoli qilish hamda saqlash davridagi zararlanishning oldini olishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha fumigatio (“tutatish, tutun tutish”) so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Urug‘lik chigitni dorilash, tuproqni fumigatsiya qilish, fungitsidlarni tuproqqa solish yoki o‘suv davrida purkash kiradi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The treatment of a commodity, enclosure, or other regulated article with a chemical agent that reaches the pest wholly or primarily in a gaseous state in order to kill or control pests.
etymology_en: From Latin fumigare (“to smoke, fumigate”).
example_en: "Soil fumigation prior to planting young orchard saplings significantly reduces root-knot nematode populations and soil-borne fungal pathogens." (Biorational Tree Fruit Pest Management. Aluja et al., 2009)

definition_uz: Zararkunandalar, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi mikroorganizmlar va boshqa zararli organizmlarni yo‘qotish uchun gaz yoki bug‘ holida ta’sir etadigan kimyoviy moddalar. Fumigantlar tuproq, omborxonalar, issiqxonalar va saqlanayotgan qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini zararsizlantirishda qo‘llaniladi. Ularning zaharli bug‘lari yoki gazlari nishon organizmlarga kirib, hayotiy jarayonlarini buzadi. Fumigantlardan foydalanishda xavfsizlik qoidalariga qat’iy rioya qilish talab etiladi.
etymology_uz: Fumigant atamasi lotincha fumus (“tutun”) va fumigare (“tutatmoq, tutun bilan ishlov bermoq”) so‘zlari bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Kasallikning asosiy manbayi – tuproqni zararsizlantirish maqsadida fumigantlar (karbation, metam, xlorpikrin) va fungitsidlar (nitrafen, benlat, tiabendazol, uzgen, algin) va o‘suv davrida purkash uchun esa benlat sinab ko‘rilgan. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Chemical substances that act in a gaseous or vaporous state to control pests, pathogens, and other harmful organisms. Fumigants are used for treating soil, stored agricultural products, storage facilities, greenhouses, and other enclosed environments.
etymology_en: Fumigant derives ultimately from Latin fumus (“smoke”) and fumigare (“to smoke, fumigate”).
example_en: “Fumigants are pesticides that kill in the gaseous form.” (Practical Fumigation Considerations. Leesch J.G. et al., Kansas State University Agricultural Experiment Station and Cooperative Extension Service)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda zamburug‘lar qo‘zg‘atadigan kasalliklar (kalmaraz/parsha, un-shudring, monilioz, antraknoz, zang va chirishlar)ning oldini olish va ularni davolash hamda urug‘, ko‘chat va tuproqni zararsizlantirish uchun qo‘llaniladigan kimyoviy yoki biologik moddalar guruhi. Ta’sir qilish xususiyatiga ko‘ra himoya qiluvchi (profilaktik) va davolovchi (terapevtik), o‘simlikda harakatlanishiga ko‘ra esa kontakt va sistemali turlarga bo‘linadi.
etymology_uz: Fungitsid termini lotincha fungus — ‘zamburug‘’ va caedere — ‘o‘ldirmoq’ elementlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Tajribada o‘simliklar antraknozdan fungitsidlar bilan himoyalanganda bir tupdan olingan uzum hosili zararlangan nazoratdagi 9,0 kg dan 22–24 kg gacha (2,5–2,7 marta) ko‘paygan. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Chemical or biological agents used to kill or inhibit fungi or fungal spores, particularly those that cause diseases of plants. Fungicides may be classified as protectant or curative and, according to their movement in plants, as contact or systemic fungicides.
etymology_en: Fungicide is formed from Latin fungus (‘fungus, mushroom’) and the suffix -cide (‘killer’), from Latin caedere (‘to kill’).
example_en: “To protect trees from fruit rot, begin fungicide sprays 2 to 3 weeks prior to harvest as fruit is ripening.” (University of Minnesota Extension, Brown Rot of Stone Fruit.)

definition_uz: Ituzumdoshlar (Solanaceae) oilasiga mansub sabzavot qalampiri (Capsicum annuum L.)ning, asosan, achchiq mevali navlariga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan xalq nomi. Bir yillik issiqsevar sabzavot ekini bo‘lib, mevasi yangi, quritilgan yoki maydalangan holda ziravor sifatida ishlatiladi. Bog‘dorchilik va sabzavotchilikda ochiq maydon hamda issiqxonalarda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: "Sabzavotchilikda garmdori ko‘chati tuproq harorati 15 °C dan yuqori bo‘lganda ochiq maydonga o‘tkaziladi, chunki u issiqsevar va sovuqqa o‘ta ta’sirchan ekindir." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Garmdori" va "Sabzavotchilik" maqolalari)
definition_en: The pungent fruit of cultivars of Capsicum annuum and related Capsicum species, grown as a vegetable and spice. Chili peppers are widely cultivated in horticulture for fresh consumption, drying and processing.
example_en: "Chili pepper (Capsicum annuum) requires warm soil conditions and adequate sunlight for optimal fruit set and capsaicin accumulation." (Vegetable Production and Practices. Welbaum, 2015)

definition_uz: Manzarali bog‘dorchilik va landshaft arxitekturasida maxsus ekilgan yoki parvarish qilinadigan, past bo‘yli ko‘p yillik maysazor o‘simliklari bilan qoplangan yer maydoni. Gazon parklar, bog‘lar, xiyobonlar, sport maydonlari va aholi yashash hududlarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda dekorativ fon yaratish, tuproqni eroziyadan saqlash hamda rekreatsion maqsadlarda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha gazon (“maysazor, chimzor”).
example_uz: Birinchi kesish gazon 10–12 sm o‘sganda o‘tkaziladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M., 2014)
definition_en: An area of land covered with closely mown grass, especially in a garden, park, or other landscaped area, maintained for ornamental or recreational purposes.
etymology_en: From Middle English launde (“glade, open space in a forest”), from Old French lande (“heath, barren land”), ultimately of Celtic origin.
example_en: "Establishing a healthy lawn requires proper soil preparation, adequate drainage, and consistent mowing to foster dense tiller development." (Turfgrass Management. Turgeon, 2012)

definition_uz: Geksaxloran (HCH) — bir necha stereoizomerlardan tashkil topgan xlororganik birikma bo‘lib, uning ayrim izomerlari, ayniqsa gamma-HCH (lindane), ilgari insektitsid sifatida qishloq xo‘jaligida qo‘llanilgan. Atrof-muhitda barqarorligi, bioakkumulyatsiya xususiyati va toksik ta’siri sababli undan foydalanish ko‘plab mamlakatlarda taqiqlangan yoki keskin cheklangan.
etymology_uz: Geksaxloran nomi kimyoviy nomenklaturaga asoslangan bo‘lib, hexa- ‘olti’ va chloro- ‘xlor’ elementlari birikma tarkibidagi olti xlor atomiga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: 1940-yilda birinchi marta xlororganik preparatlardan DDT, geksaxloranning sintez qilinishi, 1946-yildan boshlab sanoatda fosfor-organik insektoakaritsidlar ishlab chiqarilishi katta ahamiyatga ega bo‘ldi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Hexachlorocyclohexane (HCH) is an organochlorine compound that exists as several stereoisomers, some of which, particularly gamma-HCH (lindane), were formerly used as insecticides. Because of environmental persistence, bioaccumulation, and toxic effects, its agricultural use has been banned or severely restricted in many countries.
etymology_en: From hexa- (“six”) + chloro- (“chlorine”) + cyclohexane, referring to the six chlorine atoms attached to the cyclohexane ring.
example_en: “Hexachlorocyclohexane is used as an insecticide on fruit, vegetables, and forest crops.” (PubChem, Hexachlorocyclohexane, National Center for Biotechnology Information.)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni zararkunandalar va kasalliklardan himoya qilishning seleksiya va genetika yutuqlariga asoslangan usuli bo‘lib, kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamli navlar, duragaylar hamda payvandtaglardan foydalanishga asoslanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda bu usul mevali daraxtlar, tok va manzarali o‘simliklarda pestitsidlar qo‘llashni kamaytirish, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini oshirishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: "Mevali daraxtlar va sabzavot ekinlarida genetik himoya usulini qo‘llash orqali un-shudring hamda virusli kasalliklarga genetik chidamli yangi nav va duragaylar yaratilmoqda." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Genetika" va "O‘simliklar seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi" maqolalari)
definition_en: A pest management strategy that suppresses pests or diseases by using genetically resistant plant varieties, resistant rootstocks, or by altering the genetic characteristics or reproductive capacity of pest populations. In horticulture, genetic control primarily involves breeding and cultivating resistant cultivars and rootstocks.
example_en: "Utilizing the genetic method of plant protection allows fruit breeders to incorporate scab-resistant genes into apple cultivars, reducing seasonal fungicide applications." (Horticultural Plant Breeding. Orton, 2019)

definition_uz: Begona o‘tlarni yo‘q qilish yoki ularning o‘sishini cheklash uchun qo‘llaniladigan kimyoviy yoki biologik preparatlar guruhi. Gerbitsidlar ta’sir doirasiga ko‘ra yalpi va tanlab ta’sir etuvchi, qo‘llash usuliga ko‘ra esa tuproqqa va barg orqali qo‘llaniladigan turlarga bo‘linadi. Ular bog‘lar, uzumzorlar, dalalar va boshqa ekin maydonlarida begona o‘tlarni nazorat qilishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha herba (“o‘t, maysa, o‘simlik”) + caedo (“o‘ldiraman, yo‘q qilaman”).
example_uz: Kurash choralari: urug‘lik ekinlarga fungitsid va begona o‘tlarga (ayniqsa, surepkaga) qarshi gerbitsid, zararli hasharotlarga qarshi insektitsid purkash. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Chemical substances used to control, suppress, or kill unwanted plants (weeds) in agricultural, horticultural, and managed landscape settings. Categorized by selectivity into non-selective (broad-spectrum, destroying all vegetation) and selective (targeting specific weed families while sparing crops), as well as by timing (pre-emergence vs. post-emergence).
etymology_en: From Latin herba (“grass, herb, vegetation”) + -cide (“killer”, from caedere — “to kill”).
example_en: "Selective post-emergence herbicides are sprayed in orchards to control broadleaf weeds without damaging the deep-rooted fruit trees." (Weed Science: Principles and Practices. Monaco et al., 2002)

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan har xil bo‘lgan ota-ona shakllarini (nav, liniya yoki turlarni) chatishtirish natijasida olingan birinchi bo‘g‘in duragaylarida (F1) o‘sish va rivojlanishning jadal kechishi, hosildorlik, hayotchanlik, kasallik hamda noqulay muhit omillariga chidamlilikning ota-ona shakllariga nisbatan keskin ustun bo‘lishi (gibrid quvvati) hodisasi. Geterozis effekti asosan F1 bo‘g‘inida maksimal darajada namoyon bo‘lib, keyingi bo‘g‘inlarda (F2, F3) ajralishlar tufayli susayib boradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha heteros — “boshqa, turli” va -osis — “holat, jarayon” qo‘shimchasidan hosil bo‘lgan. Termin 1914-yilda amerikalik genetik G.H. Shull tomonidan ilmiy adabiyotga kiritilgan.
example_uz: Yangi navlar yaratishda genetik qonuniyatlardan, jumladan, duragaylash, mutatsiya, poliploidiya, gaploidiya, sitoplazmatik erkak pushtsizligi yoki sterilligi (S.E.S.), geterozis, gen muhandisligi va boshqa usullardan keng foydalanilmoqda. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: The biological phenomenon in which the crossbreeding of two genetically distinct parental lines or cultivars results in offspring (F1 hybrids) that exhibit superior performance in traits such as growth rate, biomass, yield, fertility, and tolerance to abiotic and biotic stresses compared to both parents.
etymology_en: Coined by George Harrison Shull in 1914, from Greek heteroiosis (alteration, change), from heteros (other, different).
example_en: “Commercial vegetable production relies heavily on F1 heterosis hybrids of tomato and pepper to maximize yield uniformity and disease resistance.” (Principles of Plant Breeding. Acquaah, 2012)

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki ota-ona shakli — o‘simlik individi, nav, liniya yoki turni — chatishtirish natijasida olingan duragay avlod. Bog‘dorchilik va o‘simliklar seleksiyasida gibridlar yuqori hosildorlik, meva sifati, ertapisharlik, kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamlilik kabi foydali belgilarni birlashtirish maqsadida yaratiladi. F₁ gibridlari ko‘pincha belgilarning bir xilligi va ayrim hollarda geterozis (gibrid kuchi) namoyon qilishi bilan qadrlanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha hybrida (hibrida) — “chatishma, duragay”.
example_uz: Nav tozaligi elita va I kategoriyali urug‘larda boshqa navlar va turli gibridlar aralashmasiga yo‘l qo‘yilmaydi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An offspring produced by crossing two genetically distinct parental forms, such as plant individuals, cultivars, breeding lines, or species. In horticulture and plant breeding, hybrids are developed to combine desirable traits such as high yield, fruit quality, early maturity, and resistance to diseases and pests. F₁ hybrids are often valued for their uniformity and, in some cases, the expression of heterosis (hybrid vigor).
etymology_en: Latin hybrida (“offspring of mixed parentage; mongrel”).
example_en: “Horticultural plant breeders utilize F1 hybrid seeds to produce uniform crop stands with built-in resistance to common soil-borne fungal pathogens.” (Principles of Plant Breeding. Acquaah, 2012)

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki ota-ona shaklini — o‘simlik individi, nav, liniya yoki turni — tabiiy yoki sun’iy chatishtirish orqali gibrid (duragay) avlod olish jarayoni. Seleksiya va bog‘dorchilikda gibridizatsiya yangi navlar va seleksion material yaratish, hosildorlik, meva sifati, ertapisharlik, kasalliklar hamda noqulay muhit omillariga chidamlilik kabi foydali belgilarni birlashtirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Ayrim chatishtirish kombinatsiyalarida F₁ avlodda geterozis (gibrid kuchi) namoyon bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Lotincha hybrida (“duragay, chatishtirilgan”).
example_uz: Gibridizatsiya, ya’ni yangi, takomillashtirilgan xususiyatlarga ega bo‘lgan navni olish, asosan, mahalliy, ta’mi yuqori bo‘lgan janubiy nav bilan o‘tishi orqali amalga oshirilgan. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: The process of crossing two genetically distinct parental forms, such as plant individuals, cultivars, breeding lines, or species, naturally or artificially to produce hybrid offspring. In plant breeding and horticulture, hybridization is used to develop new cultivars and breeding material and to combine desirable traits such as high yield, fruit quality, early maturity, and resistance to diseases and adverse environmental conditions. In some crosses, heterosis (hybrid vigor) may be expressed in the F₁ generation.
etymology_en: From Latin hybrida (hybrid) + English suffix -ization (denoting a process or action).
example_en: “Interspecific hybridization between wild stone-fruit species and commercial cultivars allows plant breeders to transfer root-knot nematode resistance into sweet cherry rootstocks.” (Principles of Plant Breeding. Acquaah, 2012)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki ota-ona shaklini — o‘simlik individi, nav, liniya yoki turni — tabiiy yoki sun’iy yo‘l bilan chatishtirib gibrid (duragay) avlod olmoq. Bog‘dorchilik va o‘simliklar seleksiyasida gibridlash yuqori hosildorlik, yaxshi meva sifati, ertapisharlik, kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamlilik kabi foydali belgilarni birlashtirish hamda yangi seleksion material va navlar yaratish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha hybrida (hibrida) — “duragay, chatishma” so‘zidan; -lamoq — o‘zbek tilida fe’l yasovchi qo‘shimcha.
example_uz: “Seleksioner olimlar mahalliy va xorijiy olma navlarini o‘zaro gibridlab, qurg‘oqchilikka hamda parsha kasalligiga chidamli yangi istiqbolli navlarni yaratmoqdalar.” (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: To cross two genetically distinct parental forms, such as plant individuals, cultivars, breeding lines, or species, naturally or artificially to produce hybrid offspring. In horticulture and plant breeding, hybridization is used to combine desirable traits and to develop new breeding material and cultivars.
etymology_en: From Latin hybrida (hybrid) + verbal suffix -ize (to cause to become, to perform an action).
example_en: “Plant breeders frequently hybridize wild apple species with commercial varieties to transfer scab-resistant genes into high-yielding cultivars.” (Principles of Plant Breeding. Acquaah, 2012)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni tuproqsiz, suvda eritilgan mineral oziqa eritmasida yoki oziqa bermaydigan inert substratlar (perlit, vermikulit, kokos tolasi, mineral paxta va boshqalar) yordamida yetishtirish usuli. Bog‘dorchilikda gidroponika issiqxonalarda sabzavot, rezavor, ko‘kat, gul va manzarali o‘simliklarni yuqori hosildorlik bilan yetishtirish imkonini beruvchi zamonaviy texnologiya hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Gidroponika yunoncha hydro — “suv” va ponos — “mehnat, ishlov berish” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan. Termin 1937-yilda amerikalik o‘simlik fiziologi William F. Gericke tomonidan ilmiy muomalaga kiritilgan.
example_uz: Yopiq grunt va issiqxonalarda o‘simliklarni tuproqsiz muhitda o‘stirish usulining umumiy nomi gidroponika deyiladi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Hydroponics is the technique of growing plants in a water-based nutrient solution rather than soil, with or without an inert growing medium that provides physical support for the roots.
etymology_en: Hydroponics — coined in 1937 by Dr. William F. Gericke from Ancient Greek hydor (water) + ponos (labor, work) + suffix -ics (study or practice of).
example_en: “High-tech greenhouse production of strawberries and tomatoes increasingly relies on automated hydroponics systems to optimize nutrient delivery and eliminate soil degradation.” (Hydroponic Food Production. Resh, 2022)

definition_uz: Yerlarning suv rejimini tartibga solish orqali ularning meliorativ holatini yaxshilashga qaratilgan muhandislik va agrotexnik tadbirlar majmui. U sug‘orish, zax qochirish (drenaj), sho‘r yuvish, suv chiqarish va namlikni me’yorlashtirish kabi usullarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Bog‘dorchilikda gidromelioratsiya mevali bog‘lar va tokzorlarda ildiz zonasining optimal namligini saqlash, sho‘rlanish va botqoqlanishning oldini olish hamda o‘simliklarning normal o‘sishini ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha hydor — “suv”, melioratsiya lotincha melioratio — “yaxshilash” (melior — “yaxshiroq”) so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: “Tog‘oldi va cho‘l hududlarida yangi mevali bog‘lar barpo etishda gidromelioratsiya tadbirlarini to‘g‘ri yo‘lga qo‘yish yerlarning sho‘rlanishi va botqoqlanishining oldini oladi.” (Manba: O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Gidromelioratsiya” va “Irrigatsiya va melioratsiya” maqolalari)
definition_en: Hydromelioration is the improvement of land by regulating its water regime through irrigation, drainage and other water-management measures to increase soil productivity and create favorable conditions for crop growth.
etymology_en: From Greek hydro- (“water”) + Latin melioratio (“improvement”), from melior (“better”).
example_en: “Comprehensive hydro-melioration systems, including subsurface tile drainage and drip irrigation, prevent soil salinization in high-value fruit orchards.” (Irrigation Scheduling Using Soil Moisture. Jones et al., 2023)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Namligi yuqori bo‘lgan muhitlarda, ya’ni botqoqliklar, nam o‘rmonlar, daryo va ko‘l bo‘ylarida o‘sishga moslashgan quruqlik o‘simliklari. Ular doimiy nam tuproqlarda yaxshi rivojlanadi, ammo suv ostida yashamaydi. Bog‘dorchilikda gigrofit o‘simliklar suv havzalari atroflarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, landshaft dizayni va nam joylarni bezatishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha hygros — “nam, ho‘l” va phyton — “o‘simlik” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Botqoqlashtirilgan va zax joylardagi meva bog‘larida gigrofit guruhiga kiruvchi begona o‘tlarning ko‘payishi tuproqning o‘ta zaxligidan va drenaj tizimining yomon ishlayotganligidan dalolat beradi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Gigrofitlar” va “O‘simliklar ekologiyasi” maqolalari)
definition_en: Hygrophytes are plants that grow in moist habitats and are adapted to soils with abundant moisture but are not completely submerged in water. They are generally intolerant of dry conditions.
etymology_en: From Greek hygros (“wet, moist”) + phyton (“plant”).
example_en: “Because hygrophytes have limited stomatal closure control, exposing them to dry, ambient orchard microclimates leads to rapid desiccation.” (Plant Ecology. Schulze et al., 2019)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, danakli mevalar guruhiga kiruvchi ko‘p yillik mevali daraxt turi. Shirin, danakli meva hosil qiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda gilos yangi iste’mol qilish, qayta ishlash va sanoat bog‘larini barpo etish uchun yetishtiriladigan muhim meva ekinlaridan biridir. Daraxti 15–30 m gacha o‘sishi mumkin, bahorda oq gullaydi va mevalari naviga qarab sariq, pushti yoki to‘q qizil rangda bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Olchaga payvandlangan gilos navlari barvaqt hosilga kirib daraxtlarning umri kuchli payvandtaglarda o‘stirilganga nisbatan birmuncha qisqa bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Sweet cherry (Prunus avium) is a deciduous tree in the family Rosaceae cultivated for its edible sweet fruits. It is one of the principal temperate fruit crops grown commercially throughout the world.
etymology_en: From Old French cerise, from Vulgar Latin *ceresia, from Greek kerasos (cherry tree).
example_en: “The sweet cherry (Prunus avium) is an economically vital temperate fruit crop whose production relies heavily on managing gametophytic self-incompatibility and mitigating rain-induced fruit cracking.” (Cherries: Botany, Production and Uses. Quero-García et al., 2017)

definition_uz: Gilos daraxti (Prunus avium L.) tomonidan hosil qilinadigan danakli meva. Mevasi dumaloq yoki yuraksimon shaklda, po‘sti yupqa va silliq, rangi qizil, to‘q qizil yoki sariq tuslarda bo‘lishi mumkin. Eti shirali, yumshoq yoki zich tuzilishga ega, ta’mi shirin yoki nordon-shirin bo‘ladi. Gilos mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek, murabbo, sharbat, kompot, muzlatilgan va qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Giloslar daraxt ustida to‘la pishganidagina chiroyli rangga kiradi va juda mazali bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The stone fruit produced by the sweet cherry tree (Prunus avium L.). The fruit is round or heart-shaped, with smooth thin skin that may be red, dark red, or yellow. Its flesh is juicy, sweet or sweet-tart, and it is consumed fresh or used for jams, juices, compotes, frozen products, and other processed foods.
example_en: “Sweet cherry fruits are evaluated for fruit weight, soluble solid content (brix), skin color, and pedicel retention during postharvest handling.” (Postharvest Biology and Technology of Temperate Fruits. Mir et al., 2018)

definition_uz: Gilos daraxtlari ekilgan bog‘ yoki gilos yetishtirishga ixtisoslashgan mevali daraxtzor. Bog‘dorchilikda giloszor asosan yangi iste’mol, qayta ishlash yoki boshqa xo‘jalik maqsadlari uchun gilos mevasi yetishtirishga mo‘ljallangan ko‘p yillik mevali bog‘ hisoblanadi.
example_uz: “Bog‘idagi giloszorga eng sara ko‘chatlar ekilgan bo‘lib, ulardan ham serhosil natijalar olinmoqda.” (Jasorat medaliga munosib hayot. Barotov O‘., O‘zbekiston Milliy axborot agentligi — O‘zA, 2025)
definition_en: An orchard planted with sweet cherry trees (Prunus avium) for commercial fruit production or other horticultural purposes. Sweet cherry orchards require suitable site conditions, cultivars, rootstocks, orchard design, irrigation, fertilization, pollination and other management practices for successful fruit production.
example_en: “Regularly producing sustainable yields of high-quality cherries is possible only where site and other conditions are near optimal.” (Sweet Cherry Orchard Establishment in the Pacific Northwest. Long L.E., Kaiser C., Oregon State University Extension Service, PNW 642)

definition_uz: Urug‘ murtagi yoki yosh nihol o‘qining urug‘palla (kotiledon) tuguni bilan birlamchi ildiz (radikula) orasida joylashgan qismi. Epigeal unishda gipokotil cho‘zilib, urug‘pallalarni tuproq yuzasiga olib chiqishda ishtirok etadi. Uning rivojlanishi niholning dastlabki o‘sishi va shakllanishida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Gipokotil yunoncha hypo- (“ostida, pastda”) va kotyledon (“urug‘palla”) elementlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “Ayniqsa gipokotil hujayralari hajmi oshib, buning oqibatida murtak ildizchasi urug‘ po‘stini teshib o‘tadi va yerga qadaladi.” (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Botirova L.A., Ergasheva N.A., 2024)
definition_en: The portion of the embryonic or seedling axis located below the cotyledons and above the radicle. During epigeal germination, the hypocotyl elongates and helps raise the cotyledons above the soil surface.
etymology_en: From hypo- (“under, below”) + cotyledon (“seed leaf”).
example_en: “The hypocotyl is the portion of the seedling between start of the radicle and the cotyledon node.” (Seed Germination: Hypocotyl. Environmental Horticulture Department, University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Sho‘rga chidamsiz yoki faqat tuz miqdori juda kam bo‘lgan tuproqlarda normal o‘sadigan o‘simliklar. Ular tuproq eritmasidagi yuqori tuz konsentratsiyasiga sezgir bo‘lib, sho‘rlangan yerlarda o‘sishi va rivojlanishi susayadi. Madaniy bog‘dorchilik ekinlarining aksariyati glikofitlarga kiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha glykys (“shirin, chuchuk”) + phyton (“o‘simlik”).
example_uz: “Ko‘pchilik mevali daraxtlar glikofitlar guruhiga kirganligi sababli, yerlarning sho‘rlanish darajasi oshganda ularning ildiz tizimi zararlanadi va hosildorlik kutilganidan keskin tushib ketadi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Glikofitlar” va “O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi” maqolalari)
definition_en: Glycophytes are plants that are not adapted to saline soils and cannot tolerate high concentrations of salt. Most cultivated crop and horticultural species are glycophytes.
etymology_en: From Greek glykys (“sweet”) + phyton (“plant”), distinguishing these plants from salt-tolerant halophytes.
example_en: “Most fruit tree species are typical glycophytes, requiring strict soil salinity control and effective drainage systems to prevent sodium toxicity.” (Plant Physiological Ecology. Lambers & Oliveira, 2019)

definition_uz: C₆H₁₂O₆ formulali oddiy uglevod (monosaxarid). U fotosintez jarayonida hosil bo‘ladigan asosiy organik moddalardan biri bo‘lib, o‘simliklarda energiya manbai va kraxmal, saxaroza hamda sellyuloza biosintezining boshlang‘ich mahsuloti hisoblanadi. Mevalarning shirinligi va sifati ko‘p jihatdan glyukoza miqdoriga bog‘liq.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha glykys (“shirin”).
example_uz: Uzum tarkibida yaxshi o‘zlashtiriladigan shakar (glyukoza va fruktoza), organik kislotalar va boshqa moddalar bo‘lishi va tarkibiy qismlarining bir-biriga mos ravishda birikkanligi tufayli ular davolash xususiyatiga ega. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Glucose is a simple sugar (monosaccharide) that serves as the primary product of photosynthesis and an essential source of energy in plants. It is also a precursor for the synthesis of starch, cellulose, and sucrose.
etymology_en: Coined in French (glucose) by Jean-Baptiste Dumas in 1838, derived from Ancient Greek glykys (sweet) + chemical suffix -ose.
example_en: “The accumulation of glucose and fructose during the final swell of sweet cherry fruits determines the total soluble solids (TSS) and overall palatability.” (Plant Biochemistry. Heldt & Piechulla, 2021)

definition_uz: Daraxt tanasi, shoxlari yoki boshqa zararlangan qismlaridan yopishqoq, shaffof, sarg‘ish yoki jigar rang yelim (gum) ajralib chiqishi bilan tavsiflanadigan patologik yoki fiziologik holat. Gommoz ayniqsa danakli mevali daraxtlarda, jumladan o‘rik, shaftoli, gilos, olcha va olxo‘rida ko‘p uchraydi. U mexanik jarohatlanish, sovuq va quyosh ta’siri, noqulay o‘sish sharoitlari, hasharotlar hamda turli kasalliklar natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Gommoz termini fransuzcha gommose so‘zi orqali shakllangan bo‘lib, uning asosi lotincha gummi va yunoncha kommi (“yelim, gum”) so‘zlariga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Gommoz sitrus ekinlarida poya va ildiz bo‘g‘zining zararlanishi, yelim oqishi hamda daraxtlarning zaiflashishiga sabab bo‘ladigan xavfli kasallikdir. (Sitrus ekinlarining gommoz kasalligi: belgilari, sabablari va davolash usullari. Agroxabarlari, 2026)
definition_en: A physiological or pathological condition characterized by the exudation of gum or sap from the bark of a tree. It is particularly common in stone fruit trees and may occur in response to insects, diseases, wounds, winter injury, or unfavorable growing conditions.
etymology_en: From Latin gummi (“gum”), ultimately from Greek kommi (“gum”), with the suffix -osis denoting a condition or pathological process.
example_en: “Gummosis is a general term describing the prolific oozing of sap from a tree.” (Gummosis (Cytospora/Perennial Canker). Utah State University Extension)

definition_uz: Kukunsimon yoki mayda zarrachali materiallarni yirikroq donachalar (granulalar) holiga keltirish jarayoni. Qishloq xo‘jaligida granulyatsiya, ayniqsa, mineral va boshqa o‘g‘itlarni ishlab chiqarishda qo‘llaniladi. Granulyatsiya mahsulotning fizik xususiyatlarini yaxshilash, changlanishni kamaytirish, saqlash va tashishni qulaylashtirish hamda o‘g‘itni bir tekis qo‘llash imkonini beradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha granulum (granum — “dona, donacha” so‘zining kichraytirma shakli) + -atsiya suffiksi.
example_uz: “Bog‘dorchilikda granulyatsiya qilingan mineral o‘g‘itlardan foydalanish tomchilatib sug‘orish va qator aralariga solishda bir tekis taqsimlanishni ta’minlaydi hamda oziq moddalarning o‘zlashtirilish darajasini oshiradi.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Granulyatsiya” va “Mineral o‘g‘itlar” maqolalari)
definition_en: The process of producing granules or enlarging fine solid particles into larger aggregates. In agriculture, granulation is widely used in fertilizer production to obtain products with suitable particle size and physical properties for handling, storage, transportation, and application.
etymology_en: From Latin granulum (“small grain”), diminutive of granum (“grain”), + -ation, denoting a process.
example_en: “Granulation is the process of producing grains (granules), or enlarging existing solid particles.” (Michałek B. et al. Effect of Adding Surfactants to a Solution of Fertilizer on the Granulation Process. Energies, 2021, 14(22), 7557)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasining Citrus turkumiga mansub doim yashil subtropik mevali daraxt. Odatda 5–15 m balandlikda o‘sadi. Shox-shabbasi keng va zich, barglari oddiy, navbatlashgan, yaltiroq, to‘q yashil rangli va xushbo‘y efir moyi bezlariga ega. Gullari oq rangli, yirik, xushbo‘y, ikki jinsli bo‘lib, yakka yoki to‘pgul holida joylashadi. Daraxt issiqsevar va yorug‘sevar bo‘lib, sovuqqa nisbatan sezgir. Unumdor, yaxshi drenajlangan tuproqlarda yaxshi rivojlanadi. Asosan mevasi uchun subtropik va tropik mintaqalarda yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha grape ("uzum") + fruit ("meva")
example_uz: Greypfrut. Sok tayyorlash uchun ekiladi, hosildorligi nihoyatda yuqori. Bir dona mevasining vazni 500 g dan 1 kg gacha. Navlari yo‘q. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An evergreen subtropical fruit tree of the family Rutaceae belonging to the genus Citrus. It typically grows 5–15 m tall and has a dense canopy with glossy evergreen leaves containing aromatic oil glands. The white, fragrant flowers are bisexual and borne singly or in clusters. Grapefruit trees thrive in warm climates and well-drained soils and are cultivated primarily for their edible fruits.
etymology_en: Grapefruit derives from the English words grape and fruit, referring to the grape-like clusters in which the fruits develop.
example_en: "Red-fleshed grapefruit cultivars synthesize high concentrations of lycopene, an antioxidant pigment prized in human nutrition." (Citrus Genetics, Breeding and Biotechnology. Khan I.A., Khan M.A. (Eds.), 2007)

definition_uz: Greypfrut daraxtining ko‘p urug‘li yoki urug‘siz, shirali, ko‘p uyali rezavorsimon (hesperidiy) mevasi. Mevasi yumaloq yoki biroz yassi, po‘sti qalin, sarg‘ish yoki pushti tusli, eti och sariq, pushti yoki qizil rangda bo‘lib, shirin-nordon va biroz achchiq ta’mga ega. Mevasi C vitamini, organik kislotalar, pektin moddalar, flavonoidlar (ayniqsa naringin), likopin (qizil navlarda) hamda mineral moddalarga boy. Yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek sharbat, konsentrat, murabbo va boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha grape ("uzum") + fruit ("meva")
example_uz: Sitrusli mevalar (limon, mandarin, apelsin, greypfrut) respublikamizning barcha hududlari issiqxonalarida parvarish qilinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The hesperidium (a specialized berry) of the grapefruit tree (Citrus paradisi). The fruit is round to slightly flattened with a thick yellow to pink rind and juicy segmented flesh that ranges from pale yellow to pink or red. It has a sweet-tart taste with slight bitterness due to flavonoids such as naringin. Grapefruit is rich in vitamin C, dietary fiber, organic acids, antioxidants, and minerals. It is consumed fresh and processed into juice, concentrates, marmalades, and other food products.
etymology_en: Grapefruit derives from the English words grape and fruit, referring to the grape-like clusters in which the fruits develop.
example_en: "The grapefruit fruit (Citrus paradisi) is anatomically a hesperidium whose commercial quality depends heavily on the flavedo-to-pulp ratio and the balance of naringin bitterness with soluble solids." (Citrus Fruit: Biology, Technology and Evaluation. Ladaniya M.S., 2015)

definition_uz: O‘simlik ildizlari rivojlanadigan tabiiy yoki sun’iy o‘stirish muhiti. Bog‘dorchilikda grunt tabiiy tuproqni, issiqxona tuprog‘ini yoki torf, qum, perlit, vermikulit, kompost va boshqa komponentlardan tayyorlangan substratni anglatishi mumkin. U ildiz tizimini fizik jihatdan tayanch bilan ta’minlaydi hamda suv, havo va oziq moddalarning o‘zlashtirilishi uchun muhit yaratadi.
etymology_uz: Nemischa Grund (“asos, zamin”) so‘zidan ruscha грунт orqali o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Yopiq grunt va issiqxonalarda o‘simliklarni tuproqsiz muhitda o‘stirish usulining umumiy nomi gidroponika deyiladi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A growing medium is any material, natural or synthetic, in which plant roots grow and which provides physical support, water, air, and nutrients. It may consist of soil or soilless substrates such as peat, perlite, vermiculite, bark, or coconut coir.
etymology_en: Growing derives from the verb grow, from Old English grōwan (‘to grow, flourish’); medium derives from Latin medium (‘middle, intervening means’).
example_en: “Growing media have three main functions: 1) supply roots with nutrients, air, and water, 2) allow for maximum root growth, and 3) physically support the plant.” (University of Maryland Extension, Containers and Potting Soil for Indoor Seed Starting.)

definition_uz: Gruntlarning (tuproq va tog‘ jinslarining) tarkibi, tuzilishi, fizik, kimyoviy va mexanik xossalari, hosil bo‘lishi hamda ulardan foydalanish qonuniyatlarini o‘rganuvchi fan. Bog‘dorchilikda gruntshunoslik o‘simlik ildizlari rivojlanadigan muhitning suv-fizik xossalari, havo almashinuvi, unumdorligi va o‘simlik o‘sishiga ta’sirini baholashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Grunt (nemischa Grund — "asos, zamin") + -shunoslik (o‘rganish, fan)
example_uz: "Katta maydonlarda zamonaviy issiqxona majmualari va irrigatsiya inshootlarini qurishdan oldin gruntshunoslik va geotexnika laboratoriyalarida tuproq qatlamlarining zichligi hamda deformatsiyalanish darajasi sinchiklab tahlil qilinadi." (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Gruntshunoslik" va "Muhandislik geologiyasi" maqolalari)
definition_en: The branch of engineering geology that studies the origin, composition, structure, physical and mechanical properties, condition, and behavior of soils and other unconsolidated earth materials, including changes caused by natural and human-induced processes.
etymology_en: From engineering (Latin), soil (Anglo-French), and science (Latin), referring to the scientific study of soils and earth materials for engineering purposes.
example_en: Engineering soil science provides information on the composition, structure, physical properties, and behavior of soils under different environmental and engineering conditions. (The Nature and Properties of Soils (15th ed.). Brady N.C., Weil R.R., 2016)

definition_uz: Gulli o‘simliklarning jinsiy ko‘payishga ixtisoslashgan generativ organi. Tipik gul gul o‘rni (receptacle)da joylashgan gulkosa barglari, gultojbarglar, changchilar va urug‘chilardan tashkil topadi. Changlanish va urug‘lanishdan keyin gulning tegishli qismlaridan urug‘ va meva shakllanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda gullar mevali o‘simliklarning gullash biologiyasi, changlanishi va hosil shakllanishini o‘rganishda, manzarali bog‘dorchilikda esa dekorativ belgi sifatida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Forscha gul (“gul, chechak”) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Rezavor meva o‘simliklarining yer ustki qismi – tanasi, shoxcha, gul, meva va boshqalarini kurtakdan rivojlantiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A specialized reproductive structure of flowering plants, typically consisting of a condensed axis bearing floral organs such as sepals, petals, stamens, and carpels. Flowers function in sexual reproduction and, following pollination and fertilization, are involved in the formation of seeds and fruits.
etymology_en: From Middle English flour, from Old French flour or flor, ultimately from Latin flos, floris (“flower, blossom”).
example_en: “Flower is the reproductive part of the plant in which fruits and seeds develop.” (Plant Reproduction, MSCBOT-509. Uttarakhand Open University)

definition_uz: To‘pguldagi alohida gulni to‘pgul o‘qi yoki boshqa tayanch qismga biriktirib turuvchi band. Gulband gulning fazoda joylashishini ta’minlaydi hamda uning o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalari orqali suv va oziq moddalarining gulga yetkazilishida ishtirok etadi. Urug‘lanishdan keyin ayrim o‘simliklarda gulband rivojlanayotgan mevani tutib turuvchi band vazifasini bajaradi.
example_uz: Pekan daraxti erkak kuchalasi bitta gulbandda uchtadan bo‘lib, novdalarining asosida joylashadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The stalk of an individual flower in an inflorescence, connecting the flower to the main or secondary axis. After fertilization, the pedicel may persist as the stalk supporting the developing fruit.
etymology_en: From Latin pedicellus, a diminutive form ultimately derived from pes, pedis (“foot”).
example_en: “The pedicel (pedicellus) is the stalk of an individual flower in an inflorescence.” (Idžojtić M. Dendrology: Cones, Flowers, Fruits and Seeds. Academic Press, 2019)

definition_uz: Gulning gultojini tashkil etuvchi alohida qismi bo‘lib, odatda rangli va nozik tuzilishga ega. Gulbarglar ko‘pincha changlatuvchilarni jalb qilishda ishtirok etadi. Ularning rangi, shakli, hajmi va boshqa morfologik xususiyatlari o‘simliklarni tavsiflash, gullash biologiyasini o‘rganish hamda manzarali o‘simliklarni baholashda muhim belgi hisoblanadi.
example_uz: “Bahorda gilos va olma bog‘larida gulbarglarning ommaviy yozilishi hamda to‘kilishi fenologik fazalarni to‘g‘ri belgilash va changlatuvchi asalarilarni jalb qilish imkonini beradi.” (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: One of the individual segments of the corolla of a flower, typically coloured or white and often functioning to attract pollinators. Collectively, the petals form the corolla.
etymology_en: From Greek petalon (“leaf, thin plate”), through Latin petalum.
example_en: “Petal: One of the segments of the corolla, generally colored or white and serving to attract pollinators.” (Glossary. Rocky Mountain Research Station, USDA Forest Service, General Technical Report RMRS-GTR-118)

definition_uz: Semizo‘tdoshlar (Portulacaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik manzarali o‘t o‘simlik. Poyasi sersuv, sershox, yotiq yoki yoyilib o‘sadi, barglari ensiz va etli. Gullari yirik, oddiy, yarim qat-qat yoki qat-qat bo‘lib, oq, sariq, pushti, qizil, to‘q sariq, binafsha va boshqa ranglarda uchraydi. Issiq va qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli, quyoshsevar o‘simlik bo‘lib, gulzorlar, bordyurlar, qoya bog‘lari, konteynerlar va osma idishlarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Gulbeor (Portulaca grandiflora), beorgul — semizo‘tdoshlar (semizo‘tgullilar oilasi)ga mansub bir yillik o‘t.” (Gulbeor (Portulaca grandiflora Hook.) ning bioekologik xususiyatlari. Sodiqova D., Ozodjonova S., Perspectives for the Integration of Natural Sciences Respublika ilmiy-amaliy konferensiyasi, 2024)
definition_en: A low-growing annual succulent flowering plant in the family Portulacaceae, native to South America. It has fleshy, narrow leaves and brightly coloured flowers that may be single, semi-double, or double. It is highly tolerant of heat and drought and is widely cultivated as an ornamental bedding, edging, rock-garden, and container plant.
etymology_en: The common name moss rose refers to the plant’s low, mat-forming growth and its rose-like flowers.
example_en: “Moss rose, Portulaca grandiflora, is a drought and heat tolerant annual native to hot, dry plains in Argentina, southern Brazil, and Uruguay.” (Moss Rose, Portulaca grandiflora. Wisconsin Horticulture, University of Wisconsin–Madison Division of Extension)

definition_uz: Karamdoshlar (Brassicaceae) oilasiga mansub ikki yillik sabzavot o‘simligi. Oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadigan qismi zich joylashgan, oq yoki sarg‘ish rangli gul to‘pgulidan iborat. Gulkaram vitaminlar (ayniqsa C vitamini), mineral moddalar va biologik faol birikmalarga boy bo‘lib, sabzavotchilikda keng yetishtiriladi. Mo‘tadil iqlimni xush ko‘radi va unumdor, namligi yetarli tuproqlarda yaxshi o‘sadi.
example_uz: O'rtacha urug'lilar - pomidor, karam, gulkaram, piyoz, qalampir, baqlajon. Ulaming 150-350 dona urug'i I gramm keladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Cauliflower is a cultivated variety of Brassica oleracea grown for its compact, edible, immature flower head (curd). It is an important cool-season vegetable crop valued for its nutritional content and culinary uses.
etymology_en: From Italian cavolfiore, compound of cavolo (cabbage, from Latin caulis) + fiore (flower, from Latin flos).
example_en: "Cauliflower is harvested before the flower buds open to ensure the highest quality of the edible curd." (World Vegetables: Principles, Production, and Nutritive Values. Rubatzky V.E., Yamaguchi M., 1997)

definition_uz: Gulqo‘rg‘onning tashqi qavati bo‘lib, kosachabarglardan tashkil topadi. U gul g‘unchasini tashqi muhitning noqulay omillaridan himoya qiladi, rivojlanayotgan gul qismlarini o‘rab turadi va ayrim o‘simliklarda fotosintezda ham ishtirok etadi. Gulkosa erkin yoki qo‘shilib o‘sgan kosachabarglardan iborat bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Poya qismiga gul bandi va gul o‘rni kirsa, barg kelib chiqishiga ega bo‘lgan qismlariga gulkosabarg, gultojibarg, urug‘chi va changchilar kiradi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The calyx is the outermost whorl of a flower, consisting of sepals. It encloses and protects the developing flower bud and may also contribute to photosynthesis when green.
etymology_en: From Latin calyx, borrowed from Greek kalyx, meaning "bud", "covering", or "cup".
example_en: "The persistent calyx at the apex of apple and pear fruits is a key pomological character used in cultivar identification." (Integrative Plant Anatomy. Dickison, 2000)

definition_uz: Gul yoki gul to‘pgulini hosil qiluvchi generativ kurtak. Gulkurtak ichida gul organlarining boshlang‘ich qismlari shakllangan bo‘lib, vegetatsiya davrida rivojlanib gulga aylanadi. Mevali daraxtlarda gulkurtaklar kelgusi yil hosilini belgilovchi asosiy generativ organ hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Gulkurtaklarning shakllanish davrida oziq moddalar yetishmasligidan ham gullar yaxshi rivojlanmaydi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A reproductive bud that develops into a flower or inflorescence. It contains the primordial floral organs and is responsible for flowering and subsequent fruit production in many perennial plants.
example_en: "Flower buds of apple trees are initiated during the previous growing season." (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T., Kester D.E. Pearson, 2011)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilik, gulchilik va floristikada gul poyalari, qurigan gullar va ingichka novdalarni kesish hamda guldasta tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan qo‘l kesish asbobi. Gulqaychi o‘simlik poyalarini toza va aniq kesishga mo‘ljallangan bo‘lib, kesma gullarni yig‘ish va parvarish qilishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Gul qaychi – 1–2 sm li shox-shabbalarni kesishda ishlatiladi. Manzarasini yo‘qotgan, qarigan, qurigan shox-shabbalar gul qaychi yordamida kesib tashlanadi.” (Manzarali daraxt-buta o‘simliklarni kesish va shakl berish uskunalari, o‘quv materiali)
definition_en: A hand-held cutting tool used in horticulture, floriculture, and floral design for cutting flower stems, removing spent flowers, trimming thin shoots, and preparing cut flowers for floral arrangements. Flower shears are designed to make clean, precise cuts with minimal damage to plant tissues.
example_en: Ultra-light flower shears, ideal for cutting flowers and gardening. (Stocker Garden, Flower Shears 17)

definition_uz: Gulning tashqi qoplovchi qismi (periant) bo‘lib, gulkosa va gultojdan tashkil topadi. Gulqo‘rg‘on gulning generativ organlari — changchi va urug‘chini himoya qiladi hamda changlatuvchi hasharotlarni jalb etishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Ayrim o‘simliklarda gulqo‘rg‘on oddiy (gulkosa va gultojga ajralmagan), boshqalarida esa murakkab (gulkosa va gultojga ajralgan) bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Gulqo‘rg‘onda gulkosa va gultojibargdan biri mavjud bo‘lsa, oddiy gulqo‘rg‘on deyiladi (lola, sho‘ra gullari). (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The perianth is the non-reproductive part of a flower that surrounds the reproductive organs. It consists of the calyx (sepals) and the corolla (petals) when these are distinct, or of tepals when they are not differentiated.
etymology_en: From Greek peri- (around) + anthos (flower, meaning around the flower.)
example_en: "In most Rosaceae fruit crops, a well-developed double perianth serves both to shield delicate embryonic structures and to attract insect pollinators." (Integrative Plant Anatomy. Dickison, 2000)

definition_uz: Sapsardoshlar (Iridaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik manzarali o‘simliklar turkumi. Yerosti poyasi (ildizpoyasi yoki piyozchasi) orqali o‘sadi. Gullari yirik, nafis tuzilishga ega bo‘lib, oq, sariq, ko‘k, binafsha, havorang va boshqa ranglarda uchraydi. Gulsapsar bog‘, park, gulzor va rabatkalarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida keng ekiladi. Ayrim turlari kesma gul sifatida ham yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Soyaga chidamli o‘simliklar - akvilegiya, borets, primula, xushbo‘y va shoxdor binafsha, astilba, gulsapsar – uncha quyuq bo‘lmagan soyada va yoyilib turuvchi yorug‘likda yaxshi o‘sadi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: Iris is a genus of perennial flowering plants in the family Iridaceae, valued for their showy flowers and cultivated extensively in ornamental horticulture. Species grow from rhizomes or bulbs and produce flowers in a wide range of colors.
etymology_en: Iris comes from the Greek word iris, meaning "rainbow," referring to the diversity of flower colors.
example_en: "Irises are popular ornamental perennials grown in gardens for their striking flowers and ease of cultivation." (Plants of the World Online. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 2024)

definition_uz: Gulqo‘rg‘onning ichki qavati bo‘lib, gulbarglar yig‘indisidan tashkil topadi. U odatda yorqin rangli va xushbo‘y bo‘lib, changlatuvchi hasharotlar, qushlar hamda boshqa changlatuvchilarni jalb qilish vazifasini bajaradi. Gultoj erkin yoki qo‘shilib o‘sgan gulbarglardan iborat bo‘lishi mumkin. Uning shakli, rangi va tuzilishi o‘simliklarni aniqlash hamda navlarni tavsiflashda muhim morfologik belgi hisoblanadi.
example_uz: To‘g‘ri gultojilarning hamma tojibarglari bir xil bo‘lib, gul yuzasidan bir nechta teng qismga bo‘ladigan bir qancha simmetrik chiziq o‘tkazish mumkin (g‘o‘za, olma, lola, qovoq gullari). (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The corolla is the collective term for all the petals of a flower. It forms the inner whorl of the perianth and is typically brightly colored to attract pollinators and protect the reproductive organs.
etymology_en: From Latin corolla, meaning "small crown" or "little garland," the diminutive of corona ("crown").
example_en: "In fruit trees of the Rosaceae family, a showy, polypetalous corolla is essential for attracting honeybees during peak bloom." (Apples: Botany, Production and Uses. Ferree & Warrington, 2003)

definition_uz: Gultojixo‘rozdoshlar (Amaranthaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik manzarali o‘t o‘simlik. Uning eng xarakterli belgisi xo‘roz tojiga o‘xshash, yirik, baxmalsimon va burmali to‘pgulidir. Gullari qizil, sariq, pushti, to‘q sariq, binafsha va boshqa ranglarda uchraydi. Gultojixo‘roz gulzorlar, bordyurlar, rabatkalar va konteynerlarda bezak o‘simligi sifatida keng ekiladi. Kesma va quritilgan gul sifatida ham foydalaniladi.
example_uz: "Gultojixo‘roz yoz davomida sergulligi va yorqin ranglari bilan gulzorlarning manzaradorligini oshiradi." (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: Cockscomb (Celosia cristata) is an annual ornamental plant in the family Amaranthaceae, distinguished by its brightly colored, crested flower heads resembling a rooster's comb. It is widely cultivated for ornamental bedding, borders, containers, and cut or dried flowers.
example_en: "Cockscomb is valued in ornamental horticulture for its unusual flower shape and vibrant colors." (Plants of the World Online. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning generativ rivojlanish bosqichiga o‘tib, gul hosil qilishi va gullarining ochilishi jarayoni. Gullash davrida changlanish va urug‘lanish sodir bo‘lib, keyinchalik meva va urug‘ shakllanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda gullash muddati, davomiyligi va jadalligi hosildorlikni belgilovchi muhim biologik ko‘rsatkich hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Pista ikki uyli o‘simlik bo‘lib, mart–aprelda gullaydi va shamol yordamida changlanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To flower (or to bloom) means to produce and open flowers as part of a plant's reproductive cycle, enabling pollination, fertilization, and subsequent fruit and seed development.
etymology_en: From Middle English blome, from Old Norse blóm (flower, blossom), originating from Proto-Germanic *blōmô.
example_en: "Fruit trees bloom sequentially in early spring, requiring optimal thermal accumulation to achieve uniform anthesis and effective bee pollination." (Apples: Botany, Production and Uses. Ferree & Warrington, 2003)

definition_uz: O‘simlikda gullarning ochilishi boshlanib, gullash yakunlangunga qadar davom etadigan fenologik davr. Bu davr changlanish va urug‘lanish jarayonlari uchun muhim bo‘lib, muvaffaqiyatli urug‘lanishdan keyin meva va urug‘larning rivojlanishi boshlanadi. Gullash davrining boshlanishi va davomiyligi o‘simlik turi va naviga, harorat hamda boshqa ekologik sharoitlarga bog‘liq. Bog‘dorchilikda gullash davri changlatuvchi navlarni tanlash, hosil shakllanishini baholash va agrotexnik tadbirlarni rejalashtirishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Anorning gullash davri uzoqqa cho‘zilib, gullari ko‘p, yirik va qizil rangli bo‘lgani tufayli, u ajoyib dekorativ o‘simlik bo‘lishi ham mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The period during which a plant produces and opens its flowers. In fruit crops, the timing and duration of flowering are important for pollination and subsequent fruit set, and may vary according to species, cultivar, temperature, and other environmental conditions.
example_en: “Generally, any cultivar will be pollinated by a different cultivar as long as their bloom period overlaps and pollinating insects, such as honey bees, are active.” (Growing Plums in Florida. Olmstead M. et al., University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Gulxayridoshlar (Malvaceae) oilasiga mansub ikki yillik yoki qisqa umrli ko‘p yillik manzarali o‘simlik. Poyasi tik o‘sib, balandligi odatda 1,5–2,5 m ga yetadi. Gullari yirik, oddiy yoki qat-qat bo‘lib, oq, sariq, pushti, qizil va binafsha ranglarda uchraydi. Gulxayri yoz davomida gullaydi va gulzorlar, devor bo‘ylari hamda rabatkalarda bezak o‘simligi sifatida keng ekiladi.
example_uz: Gulxayri guli dorivor, manzarali o‘simlik, undan bo‘yoq olinadi. (Dorivor gulxayri o‘simligining yetishtirish texnologiyasi va kimyoviy tarkibi. Jo‘rayeva V.T., Mo‘sinova M.T., Acumen: International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research, 2024)
definition_en: A robust biennial or short-lived perennial ornamental plant in the family Malvaceae, typically growing 1.5–2.5 m tall. It produces tall erect racemes of large, showy flowers that may be single or double and occur in shades of white, yellow, pink, red, and purple. Hollyhock is widely cultivated in flower borders, beds, cottage gardens, and along walls.
example_en: “Hollyhocks are fully hardy and flower in the second year after sowing.” (How to grow hollyhocks, Royal Horticultural Society, RHS)

definition_uz: Manzarali gulli o‘simliklar ekilib, dekorativ maqsadda tashkil etiladigan va parvarish qilinadigan maxsus maydon yoki landshaft kompozitsiyasi. Gulzorlar bog‘, park, xiyobon, ko‘cha va turar joy hududlarini bezash uchun barpo etiladi. Ularda bir yillik, ikki yillik va ko‘p yillik gulli, piyozboshli hamda boshqa manzarali o‘simliklardan foydalaniladi. Gulzorlar shakli, tarkibi va joylashishiga ko‘ra klumba, rabatka, bordyur, parter, miksborder va boshqa turlarga ajratilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Gulzorlarni loyihalashda bosh tamoyilga tayanish kerak, ya’ni gulli bezak berilgan ko‘kalamzorlashtirish obyektining umumiy maqsadiga bo‘ysunishi zarur, bunda gulzorning qanday obyekt oldida — madaniyat saroyi, memorial, xiyobon, ma’muriy binolar oldida joylashganligi hisobga olinadi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An area or landscape composition established and maintained with ornamental flowering plants for decorative purposes. Flower gardens are created in gardens, parks, public spaces, streetscapes, and residential landscapes and may contain annual, biennial, perennial, bulbous, and other ornamental plants. They may be arranged in various forms, including flower beds, borders, parterres, mixed borders, and other floral displays.
etymology_en: Flower derives from Old French flor/flour, ultimately from Latin flos (“flower”), and garden from Old North French gardin (“enclosed cultivated ground”).
example_en: "The flower garden was planted with annual and perennial ornamental species to provide continuous bloom throughout the growing season." (Royal Horticultural Society (RHS). Garden design and flower beds.)

definition_uz: Changchi (antera)da hosil bo‘ladigan mikroskopik chang donachalari (polen) bo‘lib, o‘simlikning erkak gametofitini o‘zida saqlaydi. Chang donachalari changlanish jarayonida urug‘chi tumshuqchasiga tushib, chang naychasini hosil qiladi va urug‘lanishni ta’minlaydi. Gul changi o‘simliklarning jinsiy ko‘payishida asosiy biologik birlik hisoblanadi.
example_uz: "Meva bog‘larida navlarni to‘g‘ri tanlash va mos changlatuvchi navlarni yonma-yon ekish gul changining unuvchanligini ta’minlab, mo‘l hosil tugilishiga zamin yaratadi." ("O‘simliklar embriologiyasi" maqolalari)
definition_en: Pollen is a fine powder consisting of microscopic pollen grains produced in the anthers of flowering plants. Each pollen grain contains the male gametophyte and plays a crucial role in pollination and fertilization.
etymology_en: From Latin pollen, meaning fine flour or fine dust.
example_en: Evaluating pollen viability and germination capacity under variable spring temperatures is crucial for selecting effective pollinizer cultivars in apple orchards. (Cherries: Botany, Production and Uses. Quero-García et al., 2017)

definition_uz: Manzarali, kesma, gultuvak va boshqa bezak o‘simliklarini ko‘paytirish, yetishtirish, parvarish qilish, seleksiya qilish hamda ulardan landshaft dizayni va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda foydalanishni o‘rganuvchi va amalda qo‘llovchi bog‘dorchilik tarmog‘i. Gulchilik gul o‘simliklarining biologiyasi, agrotexnikasi, navshunosligi, himoyasi va iqtisodiy samaradorligini ham qamrab oladi.
example_uz: Gulchilik bizning respublikamizga Uzoq Sharqdan, Xitoy va Hindistondan Buyuk Ipak yo‘li orqali kirib kelgan va birinchi bo‘lib Samarqandda, so‘ngra Buxoro, Qo‘qon va boshqa shaharlarda tarqalgan. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: Floriculture is the branch of horticulture concerned with the propagation, cultivation, breeding, marketing, and use of flowering and ornamental plants for gardens, landscapes, interiors, and the cut-flower industry.
etymology_en: Latin flos, floris (flower) and cultura (cultivation), meaning the cultivation of flowers.
example_en: "Commercial floriculture uses automated hydroponic greenhouses to optimize environmental variables for high-yield cut flower production." (Principles of Horticulture. Adams et al., 2019)

definition_uz: Tarkibida gumin moddalar, jumladan gumin kislotalari, fulvo kislotalar va ularning hosilalari mavjud bo‘lgan o‘g‘itlar yoki o‘g‘itlovchi preparatlar guruhi. Ular tuproq xususiyatlari va unumdorligini yaxshilash, o‘simliklarning oziqa elementlarini o‘zlashtirishini kuchaytirish, ildiz tizimining o‘sishi va rivojlanishini rag‘batlantirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Gumin moddalar torf, qo‘ng‘ir ko‘mir, kompost va boshqa organik manbalardan olinishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Gumin termini lotincha humus (“yer, tuproq”) so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: “Ochiq va yopiq gruntda gumin o‘g‘itlaridan foydalanish mineral o‘g‘itlar me’yorini kamaytirish bilan birga hosildorlikni va mahsulot sifatini sezilarli darajada oshiradi.” (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Fertilizers or fertilizing products containing humic substances, including humic acids, fulvic acids, and their derivatives. They are applied in agriculture to improve soil properties and fertility and may enhance nutrient uptake, root development, plant growth, and crop productivity.
etymology_en: Humic derives from Latin humus (“earth, soil”), while fertilizer derives from fertile, ultimately from Latin fertilis (“fruitful, productive”).
example_en: “Humic fertilizers influence the growth, development, and productivity of agricultural crops and enhance soil fertility.” (Influence of Organic Humic Fertilizer “Tumat” on the Productivity of Sugar Beet. Agronomy, 2024, 14(6), 1100)

definition_uz: Tuproq organik moddasining yaxshi parchalangan va nisbatan barqaror qismi bo‘lib, o‘simlik, hayvon va mikroorganizmlar qoldiqlarining biologik hamda kimyoviy o‘zgarishi natijasida shakllanadi. Gumus tuproq agregatlarining barqarorligi, oziqa elementlarini ushlab turish, nam saqlash qobiliyati va tuproq unumdorligini ta’minlashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Lotincha humus — “yer, tuproq”.
example_uz: Gumus ko‘p tuproqlar kam ta’minlangan tuproqlarga nisbatan yuqori potensial unumdorlikka, oziqa moddalari va ayniqsa azot bilan ta’minlanganligi yuqori bo‘ladi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The well-decomposed and relatively stable fraction of soil organic matter formed through the biological and chemical transformation of organic residues. Humus contributes to soil aggregate stability and improves the water- and nutrient-holding capacity of soils.
etymology_en: From Latin humus (“earth, soil, ground”).
example_en: “Humus is important in binding soil aggregates and improves the water and nutrient-holding capacity of soils.” (Soil Health – Organic Matter. USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service, 2014)

definition_uz: Havodagi suv bug‘lari miqdorini ifodalovchi meteorologik va agrobiologik ko‘rsatkich. U odatda nisbiy namlik (foiz, %) ko‘rinishida ifodalanadi va havodagi haqiqiy suv bug‘i miqdorining shu haroratdagi maksimal mumkin bo‘lgan suv bug‘i miqdoriga nisbatini bildiradi. Havo namligi o‘simliklarning transpiratsiyasi, fotosintez jarayoni, changlanishi, kasalliklarga chidamliligi va hosildorligiga katta ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston sharoitida havo namligi past, urug‘mevalilarning urug‘i quritilgandan keyin 4–9% namlikka ega bo‘ladi, ularning unuvchanligi esa uch yil davomida saqlanib qoladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Air humidity is the amount of water vapor present in the atmosphere. It is commonly expressed as relative humidity, which represents the ratio of the actual water vapor content of the air to the maximum amount it can hold at a given temperature. Air humidity affects plant transpiration, photosynthesis, pollination, disease development, and crop productivity.
etymology_en: Latin humiditas ("moisture"), from humidus ("moist, wet").
example_en: "Monitoring relative air humidity inside automated greenhouses is essential for regulating crop transpiration and preventing fungal disease outbreaks." (Controlled Environment Agriculture. Kozai et al., 2019)

definition_uz: Havo, tuproq yoki o‘simlik to‘qimalarining issiqlik holatini ifodalovchi fizik kattalik va o‘simliklarning o‘sishi hamda rivojlanishiga ta’sir etuvchi muhim ekologik omil. Harorat fotosintez, nafas olish, transpiratsiya, urug‘larning unishi, gullash, meva tugishi va boshqa fiziologik jarayonlarga ta’sir qiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda harorat vegetatsiya davri, sovuqqa va issiqqa chidamlilik, gullash va meva tugishi hamda hosildorlikni belgilovchi muhim agroiqlimiy ko‘rsatkichlardan biridir.
etymology_uz: Arabcha harārah — “issiqlik, issiq darajasi, harorat”.
example_uz: Yuqori harorat mevali daraxtlarga katta zarar yetkazishi mumkin, past harorat ham ularga jiddiy zarar yetkazadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A measure of the thermal state of the air, soil, or plant tissues and an important environmental factor affecting plant growth and development. Temperature influences photosynthesis, respiration, transpiration, germination, flowering, fruit set, dormancy, and other physiological and developmental processes.
etymology_en: From Latin temperatura (“moderation, proper mixture”), from temperare (“to regulate, moderate”).
example_en: “Temperature influences most plant processes, including photosynthesis, transpiration, respiration, germination and flowering.” (Environmental Factors Affecting Plant Growth. Oregon State University Extension Service)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning bargi, poyasi, novdasi, ildizi, guli, mevasi yoki urug‘i bilan oziqlanishi yoxud boshqa faoliyati natijasida ularga zarar yetkazadigan hasharotlar. Zararkunanda hasharotlar o‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanishini susaytirishi, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini pasaytirishi, ayrim turlari esa o‘simlik kasalliklari qo‘zg‘atuvchilarini tarqatishi mumkin. Bog‘dorchilikda ularga qarshi agrotexnik, mexanik, biologik va kimyoviy usullarni uyg‘unlashtiruvchi integratsiyalashgan zararkunandalarga qarshi kurash tizimi qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Har yili zararkunanda hasharotlar qishloq xo‘jaligiga katta  zarar yetkazadi.” (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Insects that cause harmful or economically significant damage to plants or crops through feeding or other activities. Insect pests may damage leaves, stems, roots, flowers, fruits, or seeds, reduce crop yield and quality, and in some cases transmit plant pathogens. They can be managed through integrated pest management using cultural, mechanical or physical, biological, and chemical control methods.
example_en: “Insects can devastate a crop of fruit in an unsprayed orchard.” (Insect Pests. Cooperative Extension: Tree Fruits. University of Maine Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni kasalliklar, zararkunandalar, begona o‘tlar va noqulay tashqi muhit omillaridan himoya qilish uchun qo‘llaniladigan moddalar, usullar va texnik vositalar majmui. Bog‘dorchilikda himoya vositalariga kimyoviy preparatlar (insektitsidlar, fungitsidlar, gerbitsidlar), biologik vositalar, agrotexnik tadbirlar hamda mexanik kurash usullari kiradi.
example_uz: "Meva bog‘larida bahorgi kurtak yozish davrida fungitsidlar va insektitsidlar bilan profilaktik ishlov berish bo‘lajak hosilni kasallik va zararkunandalardan samarali himoya qiladi." (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Plant protection agents are substances, biological materials, or methods used to protect plants from pests, diseases, weeds, and other harmful factors. They include pesticides, biological control agents, and other protective measures applied in crop production and horticulture.
example_en: "Integrated use of biological plant protection products reduces reliance on chemical pesticides while maintaining high fruit yield quality." (Crop Protection. Matthews, 2018)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari, mevali daraxtlar, tok va boshqa madaniy o‘simliklardan ma’lum davr davomida olinadigan mahsulot miqdori. Bog‘dorchilikda hosil bir tup daraxt, o‘simlik yoki butun bog‘dan olinadigan meva, rezavor, yong‘oq va boshqa foydalaniladigan mahsulotlarning umumiy miqdorini bildiradi. Hosil miqdori navning biologik xususiyatlari, agrotexnika, tuproq-iqlim sharoiti va parvarish darajasiga bog‘liq.
etymology_uz: Arabcha ḥāṣil — “yig‘ilgan narsa, natija, yetishgan mahsulot, foyda”.
example_uz: Yovvoyi holda o‘sayotgan pistaning bir tupi 3–5 kg, ekib o‘stirilganda esa 40–80 kg gacha hosil beradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The amount of agricultural or horticultural produce obtained from a plant, crop, orchard, vineyard, or other cultivated area. In horticulture, yield refers to the quantity of fruits, berries, nuts, vegetables, or other usable products produced under particular growing conditions.
etymology_en: From Old English gieldan, meaning “to give, render, pay, or produce”.
example_en: “Yield is the amount of produce harvested per unit of land.” (Encyclopaedia Britannica, “Agricultural technology”)

definition_uz: Mo‘l hosil beradigan, yuqori mahsuldorlik xususiyatiga ega bo‘lgan o‘simlik, nav, daraxt, tok yoki ekin. Bog‘dorchilikda hosildorlik o‘simlikning ma’lum maydon yoki bir tupdan olinadigan hosil miqdori bilan baholanadi.
example_uz: Hosildor novdalar bargining hammasi meva kurtaklari yozilishidan oldin shakllanadi, vegetativ kurtaklarda esa kuzatilmaydi, hosildor va vegetativ novdalarning o‘sishi, gul kurtaklarining oldin-ketin hosil bo‘lishi va shakllanishi bir vaqtga to‘g‘ri keladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: High-yielding describes a plant, cultivar, or crop capable of producing a large quantity of marketable produce under suitable growing conditions. In horticulture, the term refers to varieties with consistently high productivity.
example_en: "Adopting high-yielding and drought-tolerant crop cultivars is essential for enhancing agricultural productivity under changing climate conditions." (Crop Protection. Matthews, 2018)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilik ekinlaridan ma’lum maydon birligi yoki bitta o‘simlik hisobiga olinadigan hosil miqdorini ifodalovchi ko‘rsatkich. Hosildorlik odatda gektar hisobiga (t/ga, s/ga), ko‘p yillik mevali ekinlarda esa bir tup daraxt yoki o‘simlikdan olinadigan mahsulot miqdori bilan ham ifodalanadi. U navning biologik xususiyatlari, tuproq unumdorligi, iqlim sharoiti, agrotexnik tadbirlar, sug‘orish va o‘g‘itlash darajasiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Nimrang navi yuqori hosildorlikka ega bo‘lib, o‘rtacha hosildorligi 220–250 s/ga ni tashkil etadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The amount of crop production obtained per unit of cultivated or harvested area. In perennial horticultural crops, crop yield may also be expressed as the amount of produce obtained per individual tree or plant. It is influenced by cultivar characteristics, soil fertility, climatic conditions, crop management, irrigation, and fertilization.
etymology_en: Crop derives from Old English cropp (“top, head or cluster of a plant”), while yield derives from Old English gieldan (“to give, render or produce”).
example_en: “Crop yield varied from 10 to 144 Mg ha−1.” (Responses of Apple Fruit Size to Tree Water Status and Crop Load. Naor A. et al., Tree Physiology, 2008, 28(8))

definition_uz: Hosil beradigan yoki hosilga kirgan o‘simlik, daraxt, nav yoxud ekinni ifodalovchi sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda hosilli atamasi meva yoki boshqa hosil berayotgan, shuningdek hosil berish xususiyatiga ega bo‘lgan o‘simliklarga nisbatan qo‘llanadi.
example_uz: May oxirida hosilli daraxtlarning tanasiga va yo‘g‘on butoqlariga 3 foizli tiofos emulsiyasi singdirilgan qanor to‘qimadan ushlash belbog‘lari o‘raladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Describing a plant, tree, cultivar, or crop that bears fruit or produces a harvest. In horticulture, the term is used for plants that are producing fruit or other harvestable products, as well as those that have the capacity to bear a crop.
example_en: "The fruit-bearing apple trees produced an abundant crop this season." (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T., Kester D.E. Pearson, 2011)

definition_uz: Hosil bermaydigan yoki hosil hosil qilmagan o‘simlik, daraxt, tok yoxud ekin holatini bildiruvchi sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda o‘simlikning hosilsiz bo‘lishi meva tugmasligi, changlanish yoki urug‘lanishning muvaffaqiyatsiz kechishi, noqulay ekologik sharoit, kasallik va zararkunandalar ta’siri yoki agrotexnik tadbirlarning noto‘g‘ri bajarilishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Tokda bachki novdalar ko‘payib ketib, sersoya bo‘lib ketmasligi uchun hosilsiz ortiqcha bachki novdalar olib tashlanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Non-bearing describes a plant, tree, vine, or crop that does not produce fruit or a harvest. In horticulture, a plant may be non-bearing because of its juvenile growth stage, unsuccessful pollination or fertilization, unfavorable environmental conditions, diseases, pests, or improper horticultural practices.
example_en: "Non-bearing fruit trees should be examined for nutritional deficiencies, diseases, or pollination problems." (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T., Kester D.E. Pearson, 2011)

definition_uz: Yetishtirilgan qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilik mahsulotlarini tegishli yetilish bosqichida o‘simlikdan, daladan, bog‘dan yoki tokzordan yig‘ib olish jarayoni. Bog‘dorchilikda hosil yig‘imi meva, rezavor, uzum, sabzavot va boshqa mahsulotlarni qo‘lda yoki mexanizatsiyalashgan usulda terib yoki uzib olishni o‘z ichiga oladi. Hosilni o‘z vaqtida va ehtiyotkorlik bilan yig‘ish mahsulot sifati va keyingi saqlanishiga muhim ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.
example_uz: Hosilni yig‘ish, tashish va saqlashda standart tagliklarga moslangan, balandligi 700 mm, hajmi 250 kg ga mo‘ljallangan konteynerlardan (yig‘iladigan va yaxlit) tobora keng foydalanilmoqda. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The process of removing or collecting a crop from the plant or field when it has reached an appropriate stage of maturity. In horticulture, harvesting includes the picking or removal of fruits, vegetables, grapes, berries, nuts, and other horticultural products by hand or mechanical means. Proper harvest timing and careful handling are important for maintaining produce quality after harvest.
etymology_en: From the verb harvest, ultimately from Old English hærfest (“autumn, harvest time”).
example_en: “Harvesting your vegetables at the right time is an important part of gardening success.” (Harvesting and Storing Vegetables. University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning xo‘jalik uchun foydali, yig‘ib olinadigan hosili (masalan, meva, don, urug‘ yoki tuganak) massasining uning umumiy biologik hosili yoki biomassasiga nisbatini ifodalovchi ko‘rsatkich. Hosil indeksi o‘simlikda hosil bo‘lgan biomassaning iqtisodiy jihatdan foydali qismga qanday ulushda taqsimlanganini ko‘rsatadi. Ko‘pchilik ekinlarda biologik hosil sifatida yetilish davridagi umumiy yer ustki quruq biomassa olinadi. Hosil indeksi nisbat yoki foiz ko‘rinishida ifodalanadi. Formula: Hosil indeksi (%) = iqtisodiy hosil massasi / umumiy biologik hosil massasi × 100.
etymology_uz: Hosil (arabcha ḥāṣil — “olingan mahsulot, natija”) + indeks (lotincha index — “ko‘rsatkich, belgi”)
example_uz: “Hosil tarkibi — hosilning shakllanishiga ta’sir qiladigan tarkibiy qismlar, masalan: o‘simlikning tup soni, tuplanish darajasi, mahsuldor tuplanish, boshoqchalar soni, don soni, bir boshoqdagi don vazni, hosil indeksi (donni poyaga nisbati) tushuniladi.” (O‘simlikshunoslik. Atabayeva H., Qodirxo‘jayev O., 2006)
definition_en: The ratio of economic yield, or the harvested and economically useful portion of a plant, to its total biological yield or biomass. For many crops, biological yield is represented by the total above-ground dry biomass at maturity. Harvest index indicates the proportion of accumulated plant biomass allocated to the harvestable product and is commonly expressed as a ratio or percentage. Formula: Harvest index (%) = Economic yield / Total biological yield × 100.
etymology_en: Harvest comes from Old English hærfest (“gathering of crops”), and index comes from Latin index (“indicator, sign”).
example_en: “HI describes the proportion of total annual biomass allocated into harvestable sinks.” (van Hooijdonk B.M. et al., Harvest Index of Apple and Kiwifruit – How High Can We Go by Optimising Plant Architecture and Canopy Management? Acta Horticulturae, 2018, 1228.)

definition_uz: Kelgusi vegetatsiya davrida gul, gul to‘pguli va meva hosil qiluvchi generativ yoki aralash kurtak. Hosil kurtaklari o‘simlikning hosildorligini belgilovchi asosiy organlardan biri bo‘lib, mevali daraxtlarda odatda vegetatsiya davrining ikkinchi yarmida shakllanadi.
example_uz: "Olma daraxtida hosil kurtaklari yoz oxirida shakllanib, keyingi bahorda gullab meva beradi." (Mevachilik. Bo‘riyev X.Ch., 2016)
definition_en: A bud that contains floral structures and has the potential to produce flowers and subsequently fruit. Depending on the species, a fruit bud may be a flower bud or a mixed bud containing both floral and vegetative tissues. In fruit trees, the number and condition of fruit buds influence potential crop production.
example_en: “Apple flower buds are formed in June and July for most varieties.” (Enhancing Return Bloom of Apple. Cowgill W.P. Jr., Autio W.R., UMass Extension, F-131R, 2009)

definition_uz: Barcha tirik organizmlarning tuzilish, rivojlanish va hayot faoliyatining eng kichik asosiy birligi. O‘simlik hujayrasi hujayra devori, plazmatik membrana, sitoplazma, yadro, vakuola, xloroplastlar va boshqa organoidlardan tashkil topadi. Hujayrada fotosintez, nafas olish, modda almashinuvi, o‘sish va ko‘payish kabi muhim biologik jarayonlar amalga oshadi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha ḥujra — xona, kichik bo‘lim
example_uz: O‘simlik hujayralarida suv yetarli darajada bo‘lganda organik moddalar sintezi kuchayadi, suv yetishmaganda esa gidroliz jarayoni jadallashadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A cell is the basic structural, functional, and biological unit of all living organisms. Plant cells contain specialized structures such as a cell wall, plasma membrane, nucleus, chloroplasts, and vacuoles, which enable processes including photosynthesis, growth, metabolism, and reproduction.
etymology_en: Cell derives from Latin cella (“small room, chamber”). The term was introduced into biology by Robert Hooke in 1665 after his microscopic observations of cork.
example_en: “Cells are the structural and functional units of life.” (Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, Extension Gardener Handbook, Chapter 1: Botany.)

definition_uz: O‘simlik hujayrasining tashqi qismida joylashgan, hujayraga shakl va mustahkamlik beruvchi qattiq himoya qavati. U asosan sellyuloza, gemisellyuloza, pektin va ayrim hollarda lignindan tashkil topadi. Hujayra devori hujayrani mexanik ta’sirlardan himoya qiladi, suv almashinuvi va hujayralararo aloqalarda ishtirok etadi hamda o‘simlik to‘qimalarining mustahkamligini ta’minlaydi.
etymology_uz: Hujayra (arabcha ḥujra — "kichik xona, bo‘linma") + devor (fors-tojikcha devor — "to‘siq, chegara")
example_uz: "Mevalarni saqlash davrida pektinaza fermenti ta’sirida hujayra devori strukturasining bo‘shashishi meva etining yumshashiga sabab bo‘ladi." (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The cell wall is a rigid outer layer surrounding plant cells that provides structural support, protection, and mechanical strength. It is mainly composed of cellulose, hemicellulose, pectin, and sometimes lignin.
