The cell wall maintains cell shape and plays important roles in growth, water regulation, and communication between plant cells.
etymology_en: Cell derives from Latin cellula — "small chamber", while wall comes from Old English weall — "barrier, enclosure".
example_en: "Enzymatic breakdown of the pectin-rich middle lamella in the cell wall leads to loss of fruit firmness during postharvest ripening." (Plant Cell Biology: From Astronomy to Zoology. Taiz & Zeiger, 2015)

definition_uz: Hujayralarni ajratish, o‘stirish, qayta tashkil etish, gibridlash va ulardan amaliy maqsadlarda foydalanishga asoslangan biotexnologiya yo‘nalishi. O‘simliklarda hujayra injineriyasi hujayra va to‘qima kulturasi, protoplastlarni ajratish va qo‘shish, somatik gibridizatsiya, in vitro regeneratsiya hamda seleksiya uchun yangi genetik material yaratish kabi usullarni o‘z ichiga oladi.
etymology_uz: Hujayra (arabcha ḥujra — “kichik xona, bo‘linma”) + injineriya (fransuzcha ingénierie — “muhandislik”).
example_uz: “Hujayra injeneriyasi usullari yordamida kasalliklarga chidamli va yuqori hosilli o‘simlik navlari yaratish mumkin.” (O‘simlik biotexnologiyasi va genetikasi bo‘yicha ilmiy adabiyotlar)
definition_en: A field of biotechnology involving the manipulation, culture, modification, and fusion of cells for biological and agricultural applications. In plant biotechnology, cell engineering includes techniques such as cell and tissue culture, protoplast isolation and fusion, somatic hybridization, and plant regeneration for crop improvement.
etymology_en: Cell derives from Latin cella (“small room, chamber”), while engineering derives from engineer, ultimately related to Latin ingenium (“ability, invention”).
example_en: “Several somatic hybrids have been produced through either symmetric or asymmetric fusion.” (Citrus Germplasm Enhancement via Cell Engineering and Genetic Engineering – Progress Report. Liu J.-H. et al., Acta Horticulturae 829, 2009)

definition_uz: Uzumning (Vitis vinifera L.) qadimiy xo‘raki navlaridan biri. Bu nav yirik yoki o‘rtacha kattalikdagi shingillari, cho‘ziq-tuxumsimon donalari, yupqa po‘sti, shirador va yoqimli ta’mli eti bilan ajralib turadi. Husayni uzumi asosan yangi iste’mol qilish uchun yetishtiriladi va O‘zbekiston hamda Markaziy Osiyo hududlarida keng tarqalgan mahalliy navlardan hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha Husayn (حُسَيْن) atoqli otidan kelib chiqqan. Uzum navi Hazrati Alining ikkinchi o‘g‘li Husayn nomi bilan atalgan.
example_uz: O‘zbekistondan tajriba tariqasida yetkazilgan “Husayni” navli uzumining ta’mi va ko‘rinishi amerikalik xaridorlar o‘rtasida katta qiziqishga sabab bo‘ldi. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: Husayni is a traditional table grape cultivar (Vitis vinifera L.) widely cultivated in Central Asia. It is characterized by elongated berries, attractive clusters, thin skin, juicy flesh, and pleasant flavor, making it suitable mainly for fresh consumption.
etymology_en: Husayni originates from the Arabic personal name Husayn, referring to the second son of Ali ibn Abi Talib.
example_en: In this paper was conducted a multi-year periodic analysis of the transition dates of the growth phases of the Husayni grape variety in Uzbekistan in 2010–2020, based on agroclimatic conditions and agroclimatic resources. (Husayni Grape Growth in Different Regions of Uzbekistan. Shermuxamedov U., Arziqulov M., ACTA NUUz, 3(3.1.1), 2025)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Ignaga o‘xshash uzun, ingichka va odatda uchli barg shakli. Ignabarglar ayniqsa qarag‘ay, qoraqarag‘ay, pixta va boshqa ko‘plab ignabargli daraxtlarda uchraydi. Ularning tor yuzasi, qalin kutikulasi va boshqa anatomik xususiyatlari suv yo‘qotilishini kamaytirishga hamda noqulay muhit sharoitlariga moslashishga yordam beradi.
example_uz: “Qarag‘ayning ignabarglari novdada bog‘lam bo‘lib joylashadi va qalin kutikula qatlami evaziga sovuq qish kunlarida ham suv muvozanatini saqlab qoladi.” (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M., 2014)
definition_en: A narrow, elongated leaf form resembling a needle, typically with a small width relative to its length. Needle leaves are common in conifers, although this leaf form also occurs in some angiosperms. In botanical terminology, a needle-shaped leaf may also be described as acicular.
etymology_en: Needle derives from Old English nǣdl, while leaf derives from Old English lēaf.
example_en: “Needle leaves, also common in conifers, they are attached to twigs in several ways.” (Plant Identification: Examining Leaves. Oregon State University)

definition_uz: Asosan daraxt va butalardan iborat ochiq urug‘li o‘simliklar guruhi bo‘lib, barglari ignasimon yoki tangachasimon shaklda bo‘ladi va urug‘lari odatda qubbalarda (shishkalarda) rivojlanadi. Ko‘pchilik ignabargli o‘simliklar doimiy yashil, ayrimlari esa barg to‘kuvchi hisoblanadi. Ularga qarag‘ay, qoraqarag‘ay, pixta, kedr, archa, sarv va boshqa o‘simliklar kiradi. Ignabargli o‘simliklar o‘rmon xo‘jaligi, ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, landshaft dizayni va manzarali bog‘dorchilikda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Shahar va aholi yashash joylarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda ignabargli o‘simliklardan (archa, tuya, qarag‘ay) foydalanish yil davomida havoni fitonsidlar bilan tozalab turadi.” (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M., 2014)
definition_en: Gymnospermous trees and shrubs typically characterized by needle-like or scale-like leaves and seed-bearing cones. Most coniferous plants are evergreen, although some species are deciduous. Conifers include pines, spruces, firs, cedars, junipers, cypresses, and related plants.
etymology_en: Coniferous derives from Latin conifer, from conus (“cone”) + ferre (“to bear”), literally meaning “cone-bearing”.
example_en: “Trees with needles or scalelike leaves, mostly evergreens, bearing cones.” (U.S. Department of Agriculture, Bulletin 863, The Coniferous Trees)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi maydoni, bog‘, tokzor yoki boshqa hududni kuchli shamol va uning salbiy ta’siridan himoya qilish uchun barpo etilgan daraxt va butalar qatori yoki tasmasi. Bog‘dorchilikda ihota shamol tezligini kamaytirish, o‘simliklarni shamol shikastlanishidan himoya qilish, tuproqning shamol eroziyasini kamaytirish va qulay mikroiqlim yaratish maqsadida tashkil etiladi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha iḥāṭa (إحاطة) — “o‘rab olish, qurshash”.
example_uz: “Intensiv meva bog‘lari atrofida terak va tut daraxtlaridan ihota tasmalarining barpo etilishi bahorgi kuchli shamollarda mevalarning mexanik shikastlanishini oldini oladi.” (“Ihota o‘rmonchiligi” va “Ixota daraxtzorlari” maqolalari)
definition_en: A barrier established to reduce wind speed and protect crops, soil, orchards, livestock, or other areas from the harmful effects of wind. Agricultural windbreaks commonly consist of one or more rows of trees or shrubs and may be used to reduce wind erosion, protect growing plants, modify the microclimate, and improve crop production.
etymology_en: Wind + break, referring to a barrier that breaks or reduces the force of the wind.
example_en: “Windbreaks are linear plantings of single or multiple rows of trees or shrubs or sets of linear plantings.” (Land Judging Handbook. USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekin maydonlari, bog‘lar, tokzorlar va boshqa hududlarni kuchli shamol hamda uning salbiy ta’siridan himoya qilish uchun ekiladigan daraxt va butalar. Ihota daraxtlari shamol tezligini kamaytiradi, tuproqning shamol eroziyasini cheklaydi, tuproq namligini saqlashga yordam beradi, mikroiqlimni yaxshilaydi va ekinlarni shamol shikastlanishidan himoya qiladi.
example_uz: Shahar yonidagi mintaqalarda shamol yo‘nalishiga to‘sqinlik qiladigan perpendikulyar tarzda ihota daraxtzorlari barpo etiladi, shaharlarda esa keng yashil hiyobonlar ventilyatsiya yo‘laklari vazifasini bajaradi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: Trees and shrubs planted in rows or belts to reduce wind speed and protect agricultural fields, orchards, vineyards, soil, and other areas from the adverse effects of wind. Windbreak trees can reduce wind erosion, protect crops from wind damage, conserve soil moisture, and improve microclimatic conditions.
etymology_en: Windbreak is formed from wind + break, referring to a barrier that reduces the force or speed of wind; tree derives from Old English trēow.
example_en: “Windbreaks are linear plantings of single or multiple rows of trees or shrubs or sets of linear plantings.” (Land Judging Handbook. USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service)

definition_uz: Urug‘ embrionida odatda ikkita urug‘palla (kotiledon) bo‘lgan yopiq urug‘li o‘simliklarning an’anaviy botanika guruhi. Ular ko‘pincha to‘rsimon tomirlangan barglari, o‘q ildiz tizimi, poyada kambiy mavjudligi va gul qismlarining to‘rt yoki besh karrali bo‘lishi bilan tavsiflanadi. Ikki pallali o‘simliklarga olma, o‘rik, uzum, gilos, atirgul, dukkakdoshlar va ko‘plab boshqa madaniy hamda yovvoyi o‘simliklar kiradi.
example_uz: Ikki pallali o‘simliklardan loviya, soya, beda, qovun, tarvuz, qovoqda urug‘pallalar yerning ustki qismiga o‘sib chiqadi va fotosintez jarayonida ishtirok etadi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Flowering plants traditionally characterized by an embryo with two cotyledons. They commonly have leaves with reticulate venation, floral parts arranged in multiples of four or five, and vascular cambium that may permit secondary growth. The traditional dicotyledon group includes many important horticultural plants, such as apple, peach, grape, cherry, and rose.
etymology_en: Dicotyledonous derives from New Latin Dicotyledones, based on Greek di- (“two”) + kotyledon (“cotyledon, seed leaf”).
example_en: “Sometimes called monocots and dicots for short, these plants have several important distinguishing characteristics.” (Botany Basics. Oregon State University Extension Service)

definition_uz: Erkak va urg‘ochi gullari alohida individlarda joylashgan o‘simliklar. Bunday o‘simliklarning ayrim tuplarida faqat changchi (erkak) gullar, boshqalarida esa faqat urug‘chi (urg‘ochi) gullar hosil bo‘ladi. Jinsiy ko‘payish uchun erkak o‘simlikdan urg‘ochi o‘simlikka chang ko‘chishi talab etiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda pista va kivi kabi ikki uyli ekinlardan hosil olish uchun urg‘ochi o‘simliklar bilan birga yetarli miqdorda erkak changlatuvchi o‘simliklar ham ekiladi.
example_uz: Gullari to‘g‘ri, bir yoki ikki uyli o‘simliklar, barg qo‘ltig‘idagi guli yakka yoki to‘pgul hosil qiladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Plants in which male and female reproductive structures occur on separate individuals. In dioecious flowering plants, one individual bears staminate (male) flowers and another bears pistillate (female) flowers. Pollination between male and female plants is therefore necessary for sexual reproduction and for fruit and seed production on female plants.
etymology_en: Dioecious derives from Greek di- (“two”) + oikos (“house”), literally meaning “two houses”, in reference to male and female reproductive structures occurring on separate plants.
example_en: “Dioecious species have male and female flowers on separate plants.” (Biology 2e. OpenStax, Rice University)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning odatda tuproq ostida joylashgan, o‘simlikni tuproqqa biriktiruvchi, suv va mineral moddalarni shimib oluvchi vegetativ organi. Ildiz o‘simlikda oziq moddalarni to‘plash, moddalarni o‘tkazish, vegetativ ko‘payish va tashqi muhit omillariga moslashish kabi vazifalarni bajaradi. Mevali daraxtlar va ko‘p yillik ekinlarda ildiz tizimi o‘simlikning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi hamda hosildorligiga bevosita ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.
example_uz: Tok ildiz tizimining baquvvat rivojlanganligi, so‘rish kuchining kattaligi va yashash sharoitiga qarab o‘zining anatomik, fiziologik tuzilishiga ko‘ra qurg‘oqchilikka nisbatan chidamli bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A vegetative organ of a plant, usually located below the soil surface, that anchors the plant and absorbs water and mineral nutrients. Roots also conduct water and dissolved substances and, in some plants, may function in nutrient storage and vegetative propagation. In fruit trees and perennial crops, root system development plays an important role in plant growth, water and mineral nutrition, and productivity.
example_en: "The root system of fruit trees absorbs water and minerals and provides mechanical support." (Biology of Plants. Raven P.H. et al., 2013)

definition_uz: Oziq moddalar to‘planishi natijasida yo‘g‘onlashgan ildiz yoki ildiz bilan poyaning pastki qismi ishtirokida shakllangan, oziq-ovqat sifatida foydalaniladigan yer osti zaxira organi. Ildizmevali sabzavotlarga sabzi, lavlagi, turp va sholg‘om kabi ekinlar kiradi. Ildizmevalarda uglevodlar, vitaminlar, mineral moddalar va boshqa oziq moddalar to‘planadi.
example_uz: Rediska urug‘lari unib chiqqanidan 30–35 kun o‘tgach, uni iste’mol qilish mumkin bo‘ladi. Ammo ildizmevasi g‘ovaklashib qolgandan so‘ng poya chiqaradi va urug‘ hosil qiladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A crop grown primarily for its enlarged underground storage organ, particularly a fleshy root or a structure formed partly from the root and lower stem. Root crops include carrots, beets, radishes, and turnips, which store carbohydrates and other nutrients in their enlarged underground organs.
etymology_en: Root derives from Old English rōt, while crop derives from Old English cropp, originally referring to the top or head of a plant.
example_en: “Root crops include beets, carrots, radishes, rutabagas, turnips, and others.” (University of Minnesota Extension, Growing root vegetables in the home garden)

definition_uz: Iste’mol qilinadigan qismi ildizida shakllanadigan, sershira va oziq moddalar to‘plangan ildizmevasi uchun yetishtiriladigan sabzavot ekinlari guruhidir. Ularning ildizida uglevodlar, vitaminlar va mineral moddalar to‘planadi. Ko‘pgina ildizmevalilar oziq-ovqat hamda yem-xashak ekini sifatida foydalaniladi. Bir yillik ildizmevalilarga rediska, ikki yillik ildizmevalilarga esa sabzi, lavlagi, sholg‘om, bryukva, petrushka, selderey va turp kiradi.
example_uz: Sabzi ildizmevalilar ichida namga eng talabchan ekinlardan biridir. U, albatta, qurg‘oqchilikka ham chidamli, ammo tuproqda namlik kam bo‘lsa, ildizmevasi quruq, ta’msiz, yog‘ochsimon bo‘lib qoladi va yorilib ketadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A major group of biennial or annual horticultural and industrial crops cultivated primarily for their edible, nutrient-dense underground storage roots (modified taproots combined with hypocotyl tissues). Annual root crops include radish, while biennial root crops include carrot, beetroot, turnip, swede (rutabaga), parsley root, celery root, and radish.
example_en: "Root crops such as carrots and table beets are essential staple vegetables requiring light, deep soils for optimal taproot development." (Vegetable Production and Practices. Maynard & Hochmuth, 2007)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning odatda tuproq ostida gorizontal yoki qiya yo‘nalishda o‘sadigan, poyaga xos bo‘g‘im, bo‘g‘im oralig‘i, kurtak va tangachasimon barglarga ega bo‘lgan o‘zgargan poyasi. Ildizpoyadan qo‘shimcha ildizlar va yangi yer ustki novdalar rivojlanishi mumkin. U oziq moddalarni to‘plash, noqulay sharoitni o‘tkazish va vegetativ ko‘payish vazifalarini bajaradi. Tashqi ko‘rinishi ildizga o‘xshasa-da, morfologik jihatdan poya hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Ildizpoya shox (novda) kabi uchi kurtak bilan tugaydi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik: darslik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A modified stem that usually grows horizontally at or below the soil surface. It has nodes, internodes and buds, may bear scale-like leaves, and produces roots and new shoots from its nodes. Rhizomes commonly function in food storage, survival and vegetative propagation and are distinguished from true roots by the presence of nodes and buds.
etymology_en: From New Latin rhizoma, from Greek rhizōma (“mass of roots”), ultimately derived from rhiza (“root”).
example_en: “A rhizome is a specialized stem structure in which the main axis of the plant grows horizontally at or just below the ground.” (University of Florida IFAS, Environmental Horticulture, “Other Geophytes: Rhizomes”)

uzbek: Ildiz tukchalari (Pilus radicalis, pl. pili radicales)
definition_uz: Ildizning so‘ruvchi zonasida joylashgan, epidermis hujayralaridan hosil bo‘ladigan juda mayda, bir hujayrali o‘simtalar. Ildiz tukchalari ildizning tuproq bilan aloqa yuzasini kengaytirib, tuproqdan suv va unda erigan mineral moddalarni o‘zlashtirishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Ular odatda qisqa umr ko‘radi va ildizning o‘sishi davomida yangi ildiz tukchalari muntazam hosil bo‘lib turadi.
example_uz: Bir tup kuzgi bug‘doy ildizi uzunligi 600 km, yon va ildiz tukchalari bilan birgalikda 10000 km uzunlikni, 200 m² yuzani tashkil qiladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Microscopic, unicellular extensions of root epidermal cells that develop in the root hair zone. Root hairs greatly increase the surface area of the root in contact with the soil and play an important role in the absorption of water and dissolved mineral nutrients.
etymology_en: Root derives from Old English rōt, while hair derives from Old English hǣr.
example_en: “Root hairs are extensions of the epidermal cells of the root.” (Biology 2e. OpenStax, Rice University)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning ildizi va ildiz bo‘g‘zini zararlaydigan zamburug‘ kasalligi. Rizoktonioz ko‘pincha Rhizoctonia solani tomonidan qo‘zg‘atiladi. Kasallangan ildiz va ildiz bo‘g‘zida qo‘ng‘ir yoki qoramtir zararlangan joylar, to‘qimalarning chirishi va yemirilishi kuzatiladi. Kuchli zararlanish nihollarning so‘lishi va nobud bo‘lishiga, katta o‘simliklarda esa o‘sishning susayishi va hosildorlikning kamayishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: Kartoshka nihollari rizoktoniozi va unga qarshi kurash choralari. Rhizoctonia solani zamburug‘i tuproqda vegetativ shaklda, odatda o‘simlik qoldiqlarida saprotrof sifatida yashaydi. Ammo kasallikka moyil ekin turlarining ildizlari tuproqning zararlangan qismiga kirganda, zamburug‘ kuchli parazitga aylanadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A soilborne fungal disease caused primarily by Rhizoctonia solani that affects the roots and lower portions of susceptible plants. Typical symptoms include brown to reddish-brown lesions, root decay, reduced root development, stunting, and, in severe cases, damping-off or plant death.
example_en: “Rhizoctonia root rot is caused by the soilborne fungus Rhizoctonia solani.” (Rhizoctonia Root Rot. Washington State University Extension)

definition_uz: Kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilari (virus, bakteriya, zamburug‘ va boshqa patogenlar) ta’siriga genetik jihatdan chidamli yoki zararlanmaydigan darajada barqaror xususiyatga ega bo‘lgan o‘simlik navi. Bunday navlar patogen bilan zararlanganda kasallik belgilarini namoyon qilmaydi yoki juda kam darajada zararlanadi. Immunli navlar o‘simliklarni himoya qilishda, hosildorlikni saqlashda va ekologik xavfsiz dehqonchilikda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Immunli termini lotincha immunis (“ozod, xoli”) so‘ziga borib taqaladi; nav — muayyan irsiy belgilarga ega madaniy o‘simliklar guruhi.
example_uz: "Olmaning qorasotir kasalligiga immunli navlarini barpo etish bog‘dorchilikda fungitsidlar sarfini 80–90 foizgacha qisqartirish imkonini beradi." ("Seleksiya" va "O‘simliklar immuniteti" maqolalari)
definition_en: An immune variety is a plant variety that possesses genetic ability to resist infection by pathogens such as fungi, bacteria, or viruses and does not develop disease symptoms under pathogen exposure. Immune or highly resistant cultivars are important in plant breeding and integrated pest and disease management.
etymology_en: Immune derives from Latin immunis (“exempt, free”), while cultivar is a contraction of “cultivated variety.”
example_en: Immune apple cultivars lower crop loss and cut down chemical use, targeting major fungal problems like apple scab (Venturia inaequalis), powdery mildew, and cedar apple rust. (Apples: Botany, Production and Uses. Ferree & Warrington, 2003)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning tirik tabiat omillari ta’sirida vujudga keluvchi yuqumli kasalliklari. Bularga o‘simliklardagi virusli kasalliklar – mozaika kasalliklarining turli xillari, sariq kasal, pakanalik, g‘umbaklanish va b.; bakterial kasalliklar – gommoz, yopishqoq bakterioz, bakterial chirishlar va b.; zamburug‘li kasalliklar – un-shudring, vilt va aspergillyoz, shuningdek, antofitozlar, gelmintofitozlar va b. kiradi. Infeksion kasalliklarga parazit hasharotlar va kanalar (ayniqsa, o‘rgimchakkana) sababchi bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Infeksion kasalliklar qatoriga o‘simlikdan o‘simlikka yuqadigan kasalliklar kiradi. Ularni zamburug‘lar, bakteriyalar, viruslar, viroidlar, fitoplazmalar, nematodalar va gulli parazit o‘simliklar qo‘zg‘atadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Infectious diseases are diseases caused by living pathogens such as fungi, bacteria, viruses, phytoplasmas, nematodes, and other infectious agents. In plants, these diseases affect roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits, and seeds, causing reduced growth, yield losses, and deterioration of product quality.
example_en: "Infectious plant diseases caused by fungal pathogens account for the majority of crop losses in wet agricultural ecosystems." (Plant Pathology. Agrios, 2005)

definition_uz: Jiydadoshlar (Elaeagnaceae) oilasiga mansub daraxt yoki yirik buta. Bo‘yi odatda 3–7 m gacha yetadi. Barglari ingichka, cho‘ziq, kumushsimon tusda bo‘lib, shoxlari ko‘pincha tikanli. Gullari mayda, xushbo‘y, sarg‘ish rangli; mevalari cho‘zinchoq, sarg‘ish-jigarrang, shirali va iste’mol qilinadi. Ingichka barg jiyda qurg‘oqchilikka, sho‘rlanishga va noqulay tuproq sharoitlariga chidamliligi bilan ajralib turadi. U to‘qayzorlarda, himoya daraxtzorlari, yo‘l bo‘yi ekinlari hamda manzarali ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: "Ingichka barg jiyda sho‘rchali va sho‘rlangan tuproqlarda ihota o‘rmon zonalarini barpo etishda hamda sho‘rlanish darajasini pasaytirishda eng samarali daraxt turlaridan biridir." ("Jiyda" va "Dendrologiya" maqolalari)
definition_en: A tree or large shrub belonging to the family Elaeagnaceae, usually reaching 3–7 m in height. It has narrow, elongated, silvery leaves, fragrant yellowish flowers, and edible yellow-brown fruits. The species is highly tolerant of drought, salinity, and poor soils and is used in shelterbelts, riparian forests, roadside plantings, and ornamental landscaping.
example_en: Public and private agencies have continued to advocate planting Elaeagnus angustifolia (Russian olive) for windbreaks and other horticultural purposes. (Biology, Ecology and Management of Elaeagnus angustifolia L. (Russian Olive) in Western North America. Katz & Shafroth, 2003)

definition_uz: Zararli hasharotlarni yo‘q qilish yoki ularning faoliyati va sonini cheklash uchun qo‘llaniladigan pestitsidlar guruhi. Insektitsidlar qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari, bog‘lar, tokzorlar va issiqxonalarda o‘simliklarni zararkunanda hasharotlardan himoya qilishda qo‘llaniladi. Ular ta’sir mexanizmiga ko‘ra hasharotlarning nerv tizimi, o‘sishi, rivojlanishi yoki boshqa hayotiy jarayonlariga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Lotincha insectum (“hasharot”) + caedere (“o‘ldirmoq”).
example_uz: Kimyoviy kurashda yosh nihollarga, ko‘chatlar gullashidan oldin insektitsidlar sepish tavsiya etiladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Pesticides used to control harmful insects by killing them or interfering with their normal biological processes. Insecticides are widely used in agriculture and horticulture to protect crops from insect pests and may act on the insect nervous system, growth and development, or other physiological processes.
etymology_en: From Latin insectum (“insect”) + caedere (“to kill”).
example_en: “Insecticides are chemicals used to control insects by killing them or preventing them from engaging in undesirable or destructive behaviors.” (U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, “Insecticides”)

definition_uz: Yuqori darajadagi, kuchaytirilgan, samaradorlikni oshirishga qaratilgan jarayon yoki usulni ifodalovchi termin. Qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilikda intensiv texnologiyalar mavjud resurslardan samarali foydalanish, yuqori hosil olish, ekinlarni zich joylashtirish, zamonaviy agrotexnik tadbirlar va mexanizatsiyadan foydalanishga asoslanadi. Intensiv bog‘dorchilikda kichik maydondan ko‘proq va sifatli hosil olish maqsad qilinadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha intensus — kuchaytirilgan, zo‘raytirilgan, jadal
example_uz: Intensiv olma bog‘larida 3–4 yildan so‘ng novdalar yiliga 25–30 sm uzunlikda o‘ssa yetarli hisoblanadi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Intensive refers to a high-input, highly concentrated, or accelerated approach aimed at achieving greater productivity and efficiency. In agriculture and horticulture, intensive systems involve advanced technologies, efficient resource use, improved management practices, and higher yields from a limited area.
etymology_en: Latin intensus — stretched, strained, strengthened, intensified.
example_en: “Orchard intensification is motivated by the desire to produce fruit early in the life of the orchard to rapidly recover establishment costs.” (Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, Training and Pruning Apple Trees in Intensive Orchards, Publication 422-024.)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtlar nisbatan yuqori zichlikda ekiladigan, erta hosilga kirish, maydon birligidan yuqori va sifatli hosil olish hamda parvarish ishlarini samarali tashkil etishga yo‘naltirilgan zamonaviy bog‘lar. Bunday bog‘larda odatda pakana yoki o‘sishi cheklangan payvandtaglar, maxsus daraxt shakllantirish va butash tizimlari, tayanch konstruksiyalari, samarali sug‘orish va oziqlantirish usullari qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Intensiv — lotincha intensivus (“kuchaytirilgan, jadal”) + bog‘lar.
example_uz: Intensiv bog‘larga sifatli, baland bo‘yli ko‘chatlar ekilishi natijasida ajratilgan joy simbag‘azda qisqa vaqt ichida to‘ldiriladi va natijada daraxt umrining birinchi yillarida juda ko‘p miqdorda quyosh nurlari tutiladi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Orchard production systems characterized by a relatively high number of trees per unit area, usually combined with precocious dwarfing rootstocks, specialized training and pruning systems, permanent tree support, and intensive crop management. These systems are designed to promote early fruit production, efficient light interception, high productivity, and improved orchard management.
example_en: “Besides having an increased number of trees per acre, a high density orchard must come into bearing within 2-3 years after planting.” (High Density Apple Orchard Management. NC State Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simlik turlari, navlari yoki duragaylarini ularning tabiiy tarqalgan yoki yetishtirilayotgan geografik hududidan boshqa, yangi tuproq-iqlim sharoitlariga keltirish, sinash va iqlimlashtirish jarayoni.
etymology_uz: Lotincha introductio — kiritish, olib kirish
example_uz: Toshkent Botanika bog‘i tomonidan o‘simliklarni introduksiya qilish, iqlimga moslash, biologik xilma-xillikni saqlash [...] bo‘yicha muayyan ishlar amalga oshirilmoqda. (Toshkent Botanika bog‘i. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Fanlar akademiyasi, 2021)
definition_en: The deliberate or accidental transfer of plant species, cultivars, or germplasm from their native habitat or region of origin into a new geographical area or climatic zone for evaluation, cultivation, adaptation, or breeding.
etymology_en: Latin introductio — a leading in, bringing in, admission
example_en: Pre-breeding and plant introduction and role of plant genetic resources in plant breeding. (Principles of Plant Breeding. Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Boshqa hududlardan keltirilgan (introduksiya qilingan) o‘simlik turlari, navlari yoki shakllarini yetishtirish, sinash va mahalliy tuproq-iqlim sharoitiga moslashuvini baholash uchun tashkil etilgan tajriba ko‘chatzori. Bunday ko‘chatzorlarda introduksiya qilingan o‘simliklarning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi, mahsuldorligi, noqulay muhit sharoitlariga chidamliligi, kasalliklarga bardoshliligi va xo‘jalik uchun istiqbolliligi o‘rganiladi.
etymology_uz: Introduksiya (lotincha introductio — “kiritish”) + ko‘chatzor.
example_uz: Introduksiya ko‘chatzori va kolleksiya maydonlarida introdutsentlarni zararkunandalar va kasalliklariga qarshi kurashni tashkil etish osonroq bo‘ladi. (O‘simliklar introduksiyasi. Islomov B.S., Hasanov M.A., 2022)
definition_en: An experimental nursery established for the preliminary evaluation of introduced plant species, cultivars, or other plant material under local environmental conditions. Plants are grown and observed to assess their adaptation, growth, productivity, resistance to diseases, and potential suitability for further testing or cultivation.
etymology_en: Introduction derives from Latin introductio (“a bringing in”), while nursery derives from Old French nourricerie, referring to a place where young plants are raised.
example_en: “The introduction nursery is intended only as a very coarse screen to eliminate those plants which are obviously unsuited to conditions in the area.” (Some Thoughts on the Collection, Introduction and Evaluation of Pasture Legumes in Zimbabwe. FAO)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni vegetativ ko‘paytirishda qo‘llaniladigan payvandlash usuli bo‘lib, bunda payvandtag kesilib, uning o‘rtasidan yoriq ochiladi va pona shaklida tayyorlangan payvandust shu yoriqqa joylashtiriladi. Payvandning muvaffaqiyatli tutishi uchun payvandust va payvandtag kambiy qatlamlarining bir-biriga tegishi muhim. Iskanapayvand mevali daraxtlarda navni almashtirish, mavjud daraxtlarni qayta payvandlash va vegetativ ko‘paytirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning o‘ziga xos yana bir xususiyati shundan iboratki, deyarli hamma mevali daraxtlar kurtak va iskana payvand qilish yo‘li bilan ko‘paytiriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A grafting method in which the stock is split and one or more wedge-shaped scions are inserted into the cleft. The scions are positioned so that their cambial layers contact those of the stock, allowing a graft union to form. Cleft grafting is commonly used for topworking established fruit trees and changing an existing cultivar to another cultivar.
etymology_en: Cleft derives from the verb cleave, meaning “to split”; grafting refers to joining a scion to a stock so that their tissues unite and grow together.
example_en: “Cleft grafting is used to change over (rework) an established fruit (scion) variety to a new (more desirable) variety.” (Cleft Grafting. Cornell University, Department of Horticulture)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi, gullashi, meva tugishi va hosil yetilishiga ta’sir qiluvchi asosiy ekologik omil. Issiqlik o‘simlik hujayralaridagi biokimyoviy jarayonlar, modda almashinuvi, fotosintez va nafas olish jadalligiga ta’sir qiladi. Har bir o‘simlik turi uchun ma’lum harorat chegaralari mavjud bo‘lib, mevali daraxtlar va ekinlarning normal rivojlanishi uchun maqbul issiqlik rejimi talab etiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda issiqlik sharoiti hudud tanlash, navlarni joylashtirish, vegetatsiya davrini aniqlash va hosildorlikni boshqarishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Agar issiqlik haddan tashqari ko‘tarilib ketsa, o‘simlikda o‘tadigan biokimyoviy jarayonlar, shu jumladan, fotosintezning kamayishiga olib keladi va pirovard natijada o‘simlik o‘sishdan qoladi hamda ayrim holatlarda to‘liq nobud bo‘lishi ham mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A form of energy transferred between objects or systems because of a temperature difference. In plant science, heat is an important environmental factor affecting plant growth, development, metabolism, flowering, fruit set, and ripening. In horticulture, thermal conditions influence crop distribution, cultivar selection, growing-season length, and crop productivity.
example_en: Plants on such slopes experience not only different levels of light and heat, but also different water regimes; south-facing slopes can be less favourable for some plants because they are too dry. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Early M.P., Brook J., Bamford K.M., 7th ed., Routledge, 2015)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni yil davomida yoki vegetatsiya davrini uzaytirgan holda yetishtirish uchun mo‘ljallangan, ichki muhit sharoitlari, jumladan harorat, namlik, yorug‘lik va havo almashinuvi boshqariladigan yoki o‘zgartiriladigan himoyalangan inshoot. Issiqxonalarda sabzavotlar, manzarali o‘simliklar, ko‘chatlar va boshqa qimmatli ekinlar yetishtiriladi. Issiqxona o‘simliklarni noqulay tashqi muhit sharoitlaridan himoya qilish va ularning o‘sishi uchun qulay mikroiqlim yaratish imkonini beradi.
example_uz: Issiqxonalarda isitish tizimi mavjudligi sababli yilning sovuq davrida sitrus o‘simliklarini parvarish qilishning termik sharoitlarini tartibga solish mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A protected structure used for growing plants under controlled or modified environmental conditions. Greenhouses enable growers to regulate factors such as temperature, ventilation, light, water, and plant nutrition and are widely used for the commercial production of vegetables, flowers, and other horticultural crops.
example_en: Greenhouse production involves the management of greenhouse construction, heating, cooling, environmental control systems, watering, fertilization, light and temperature. (Greenhouse Operation and Management. Nelson P.V., 7th ed., Prentice Hall, 2011)

definition_uz: Sabzavotlar, gullar, manzarali o‘simliklar, ko‘chatlar va boshqa qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini issiqxonalarda boshqariladigan yoki o‘zgartiriladigan muhit sharoitida yetishtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi bog‘dorchilik yo‘nalishi. Issiqxona xo‘jaligida harorat, namlik, yorug‘lik, shamollatish, sug‘orish va oziqlantirish kabi omillar boshqarilib, yil davomida yoki mavsumdan tashqari davrlarda sifatli mahsulot yetishtirish imkoniyati yaratiladi.
example_uz: Respublikamizda zamonaviy issiqxona xo‘jaliklarini rivojlantirish va gidroponika usulini keng joriy etish qishki-bahorgi mavsumda aholini sersuv va vitaminli sabzavot mahsulotlari bilan kafolatli ta’minlash imkonini beradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The production of horticultural crops in greenhouses under controlled or modified environmental conditions. Greenhouse production involves the management of factors such as temperature, ventilation, water, plant nutrition, and other growing conditions and is used for the production of vegetables, ornamental plants, flowers, and transplants throughout or beyond the normal growing season.
example_en: “Greenhouse production may be year-round and can provide valuable cash flow throughout the year.” (Greenhouse Production. Penn State Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Harorat, namlik, yorug‘lik va boshqa ekologik omillar sun’iy boshqariladigan issiqxonalarda yetishtiriladigan sabzavot, meva, gul hamda manzarali o‘simliklar guruhi. Bu o‘simliklar ochiq maydondagi noqulay iqlim sharoitidan himoyalangan holda yil davomida yoki mavsumdan tashqari davrda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Issiqxona o‘simliklarini oziqlantirishni yaxshilash usullari, ochiq hamda himoyalangan yer uchun ko‘chat tayyorlash va sabzavotlarni yetishtirish texnologiyasi o‘rganiladi. (Issiqxonalarda sabzavot va manzarali ekinlarni yetishtirish texnologiyasi. Zuev V.I. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: Plants cultivated in greenhouses under controlled or modified environmental conditions. Greenhouse crops include vegetables, fruits, ornamentals, and flowering plants grown to optimize growth, extend production seasons, and protect crops from adverse weather.
example_en: Bryobia mite (e.g. Bryobia rubrioculus) attacks fruit trees, and may cause damage to greenhouse crops, e.g. cucumbers, if blown in from neighbouring trees. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams et al., 2019)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining na’matak (Rosa) turkumiga mansub ko‘p yillik yovvoyi buta turi. Bo‘yi odatda 1,5–3 m gacha yetadi, shoxlari qayrilgan o‘tkir tikanlarga ega. Gullari oq yoki och pushti, mevalari esa kuzda yetiladigan, qizil tusli va C vitaminiga boy soxta mevalardir. Itburun na’matagi dorivor, manzarali va ayrim hollarda payvandtag sifatida foydalaniladigan o‘simlikdir.
example_uz: Madaniy atirgullar uchun asosiy payvandtag hisoblanadi, manzarali buta sifatida ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda keng foydalaniladi. (Oddiy yoki itburun na’matak (Rosa canina L.). Akademik F.N. Rusanov nomidagi Toshkent Botanika bog‘i, O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Fanlar akademiyasi)
definition_en: Dog rose (Rosa canina L.) is a perennial thorny shrub belonging to the family Rosaceae. It produces pinkish-white flowers and red-orange accessory fruits known as rose hips, which are rich in vitamin C, carotenoids, flavonoids, and other bioactive compounds. The fruits are widely used in herbal medicine, food products, and vitamin preparations.
example_en: “Rosa canina L. is used as a rootstock for roses.” (Variability of Some Rosa canina L. Genotypes from Southern Area of Oltenia. Stoenescu A.-M., Cosmulescu S.N., Scientific Papers. Series B, Horticulture, 2021, Vol. LXV, No. 1)

definition_uz: Sigirquyruqdoshlar (Plantaginaceae) oilasiga mansub, ko‘p yillik, ammo ko‘pincha bir yillik sifatida yetishtiriladigan manzarali o‘simlik. Poyasi tik o‘suvchi, bo‘yi 20–100 sm gacha yetadi. Barglari cho‘ziq yoki lansetsimon, gullari ikki labli, turli ranglarda bo‘lib, boshoqsimon to‘pgul hosil qiladi. Itog‘iz gulzorlarda, bog‘larda va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda bezak o‘simligi sifatida keng yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Itog‘iz o‘simligi bahordan kuzgacha uzluksiz gullashi sababli manzarali bog‘dorchilikda eng ko‘p ekiladigan gullardan biri hisoblanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An ornamental plant belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. It is a perennial commonly cultivated as an annual or biennial, with erect stems and narrow to lance-shaped leaves. Its distinctive two-lipped flowers occur in racemose inflorescences and are available in a wide range of colors. Snapdragon is widely grown in flower beds, borders, gardens, and landscaping.
etymology_en: The English name snapdragon refers to the flower shape, which resembles a dragon’s mouth that appears to open and close when pressed.
example_en: "Snapdragons are widely grown as ornamental bedding plants because of their long flowering period and wide range of flower colors." (Plants of the World Online (POWO). Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 2017–present)

definition_uz: Tok novdalarini tayanchga ko‘tarib, yuqoriga va yon tomonlarga yoyib o‘stirish uchun quriladigan so‘risimon konstruksiya. Ishkom tok novdalarini tartibli joylashtirish, ularning quyosh nuridan foydalanishi va havo almashinuvini yaxshilash, tokni parvarish qilish hamda hosilni yig‘ishni qulaylashtirish uchun xizmat qiladi. An’anaviy uzumchilikda ishkom yog‘och, metall yoki boshqa materiallardan tayyorlangan ustun va gorizontal tayanchlardan tashkil topadi.
example_uz: Kasallik so‘riga ko‘tarilmagan hamda ishkomga olinib o‘stirilgan toklarni ko‘proq shikastlaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A raised framework or arbor constructed to support grapevines and allow their shoots and canes to spread over an elevated or overhead support. It provides structural support for vine training and may facilitate canopy management, fruit production, and shade.
example_en: As the vine begins to grow, select the strongest cane and train it up the arbor post. (Grape Arbors – New Interest in an Old Tradition. Texas A&M AgriLife Extension)

definition_uz: Jiydadoshlar (Elaeagnaceae) oilasiga mansub daraxt va butalar turkumi. Ushbu turkum vakillarining barglari va yosh novdalari ko‘pincha kumushsimon yoki jigarrang tangachalar bilan qoplangan, gullari mayda va xushbo‘y, ayrim turlarining mevalari esa iste’mol qilinadi. Jiyda turlari orasida mevali, dorivor va manzarali o‘simliklar mavjud. O‘zbekistonda ingichka barg jiyda (Elaeagnus angustifolia L.) keng tarqalgan.
example_uz: Jiyda issiqqa chidamli, −30 °C va undan ham past haroratga chiday oladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A genus of trees and shrubs in the family Elaeagnaceae. Members of the genus commonly have leaves and young shoots covered with silvery or brownish scales, small fragrant flowers, and fleshy fruits, which are edible in some species. Several Elaeagnus species are cultivated for their fruits or used as ornamental and landscape plants.
example_en: The genus Elaeagnus includes trees and shrubs distributed naturally from eastern Europe through Asia and northeastern Australia, as well as parts of North America. (Plants of the World Online. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)

definition_uz: Gulli o‘simliklarning daraxt va butalardan tashkil topgan oilasi. Bu oilaga jiyda (Elaeagnus L.), chakanda (Hippophae L.) va Shepherdia kabi turkumlar kiradi. Jiydadoshlar vakillari barg va novdalarining ko‘pincha kumushsimon tangachalar bilan qoplanganligi, qurg‘oqchilik va sho‘rlanishga chidamliligi hamda ayrim vakillarining ildizlarida azot fiksatsiyalovchi mikroorganizmlar bilan simbioz hosil qilishi bilan ajralib turadi.
example_uz: Jiydadoshlar oilasi — Elaeagnaceae. Bu oila 3 turkumga mansub, 40 ga yaqin turni o‘z ichiga oladi. (Jiydadoshlar oilasining asosiy turkum va turlari. Tarqalishi va ahamiyati. Abdusamatova G., "Zamonaviy dunyoda tabiiy fanlar: nazariy va amaliy izlanishlar" onlayn konferensiyasi, 2024)
definition_en: Elaeagnaceae is a family of flowering plants consisting mainly of trees and shrubs. Members of this family commonly have silvery or scaly leaves and shoots and include species adapted to drought and saline soils. Important genera include Elaeagnus, Hippophae, and Shepherdia; members of the family may form nitrogen-fixing root symbioses.
example_en: "Species belonging to the Elaeagnaceae family are key ecological pioneers for soil phytoremediation and shelterbelt creation in arid ecosystems." (APG IV System. Angiosperm Phylogeny Group, 2016)

definition_uz: Seleksiyada ikki xil nav, liniya, shakl yoki genetik jihatdan farqli o‘simliklarni o‘zaro chatishtirish usuli. Bunda bitta ona va bitta ota shakl tanlanib, ularning irsiy belgilarini birlashtirish orqali duragay avlod olinadi. Juft chatishtirish seleksiya jarayonida hosildorlik, sifat, kasalliklarga va noqulay muhit sharoitlariga chidamlilik kabi foydali belgilarni bir genotipda birlashtirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: "Meva ekinlari va bog‘dorchilik seleksiyasida mahalliy serhosil navlarni xorijiy kasalliklarga chidamli navlar bilan juft chatishtirish orqali istiqbolli yangi duragaylar olinadi." ("Gibridizatsiya" va "O‘simliklar seleksiyasi" maqolalari)
definition_en: A cross in plant breeding in which two parents are crossed to produce the F₁ generation. The resulting F₁ may subsequently be selfed to produce the F₂ generation or used in a backcross programme.
example_en: In a simple cross, two parents are crossed to produce the F1. The F1 is selfed to produce F2 or is used in a backcross programme. (Principles of Plant Breeding, ANGRAU)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Ekinlarni tuproqda oldindan olingan jo‘yaklar (egatlar) bo‘ylab ekish usuli. Bu usulda urug‘ yoki ko‘chatlar jo‘yakning ma’lum qismiga joylashtiriladi, natijada o‘simliklar qatori tartibli bo‘ladi va sug‘orish ishlari qulaylashadi. Jo‘yaklab ekish kartoshka, poliz va sabzavot ekinlari hamda ayrim boshqa ekinlarni yetishtirishda qo‘llaniladi. Usul sug‘orish va mexanizatsiyalashgan parvarish ishlarini tashkil etishni osonlashtiradi.
example_uz: "O‘rta Osiyoning sug‘oriladigan va sho‘rlanishga moyil tuproqlarida sabzavot hamda poliz ekinlarini jo‘yaklab ekish urug‘larning bir tekis va unuvchan unib chiqishini ta’minlaydi." ("Ekish usullari" va "Sug‘oriladigan dehqonchilik" maqolalari)
definition_en: Furrow planting is a cultivation method in which seeds, planting material, or seedlings are planted in or along prepared furrows in the soil. The method facilitates row arrangement, irrigation, moisture management, and subsequent crop care.
example_en: Potato is commonly planted using furrow planting. Seed potato pieces are placed in prepared furrows 3–5 inches deep and covered with soil to allow proper sprout emergence and tuber development. (Potatoes. Relf P.D., McDaniel A., Olsen E., Virginia Cooperative Extension, VCE Publications, SPES-685, 2025)

definition_uz: Kaktusdoshlar (Cactaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik shirali (sukkulent) o‘simliklarning umumiy nomi. Kaktuslar asosan qurg‘oqchil hududlarga moslashgan bo‘lib, suvni poya va boshqa to‘qimalarida to‘plash xususiyatiga ega. Ko‘pchilik kaktuslarda barglar tikanlarga aylangan, yashil poya esa fotosintez vazifasini bajaradi. Kaktuslar manzarali o‘simlik sifatida xonadonlar, issiqxonalar va botanika bog‘larida keng yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha kaktos — tikanli o‘simlik
example_uz: Bizning sharoitda esa kaktusning ba’zi turlari, xona yasmini, geran, pankritsium, piyozning manzarali navlari, manjetkalar urug‘ bog‘lamaydi. (Introduksiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A cactus is a perennial succulent plant belonging to the family Cactaceae. Cacti are adapted to dry environments by storing water in succulent tissues, especially their stems. In most species, leaves are highly reduced or modified into spines, while the green stems perform most photosynthesis. Cacti are widely cultivated as ornamental plants in gardens, greenhouses, and indoor collections.
etymology_en: Greek kaktos — "a spiny plant".
example_en: Cacti exhibit extreme xerophytic adaptations, relying on extensive shallow root systems and expandable succulent stems to absorb rainfall rapidly. (Plants of the World Online (POWO). Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 2017–present)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun zarur bo‘lgan asosiy makroelementlardan biri. Kaliy suv almashinuvi va osmotik boshqaruvda, fermentlar faollashuvida, fotosintez mahsulotlarining tashilishida va uglevodlar almashinuvida muhim rol o‘ynaydi hamda meva sifati va o‘simliklarning ayrim stress omillariga chidamliligiga ta’sir qiladi. Kaliy yetishmovchiligi ko‘pincha barg chetlarida xloroz va nekroz, o‘sishning sustlashishi hamda hosildorlikning pasayishi bilan namoyon bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Kaliy atamasi lotincha kalium orqali shakllangan; kalium nomi arabcha al-qalyah — "o‘simlik kuli" bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston tuproqlarining ko‘pchiligida kaliy yetarli miqdorda bo‘ladi, shuning uchun o‘simliklar unga ehtiyoj sezmaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An essential plant macronutrient involved in osmotic regulation, stomatal function, enzyme activation, photosynthate transport, carbohydrate metabolism, crop quality, and plant responses to environmental stress. Potassium deficiency commonly causes marginal chlorosis or necrosis of older leaves and may reduce crop yield and quality.
etymology_en: Potassium derives from potash, while the chemical symbol K comes from Latin kalium, a name associated with Arabic al-qalyah — "plant ashes".
example_en: "Adequate potassium nutrition improves fruit quality, stress tolerance, and crop productivity." (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin J.L. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni kaliy bilan oziqlantirish uchun qo‘llaniladigan mineral o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Ular o‘simliklarning suv rejimini tartibga solish, fermentlar faoliyatini qo‘llab-quvvatlash, fotosintez mahsulotlarining tashilishini yaxshilash, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini oshirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Kaliyli o‘g‘itlarga kaliy xlorid, kaliy sulfat va boshqa kaliy saqlovchi o‘g‘itlar kiradi.
example_uz: Go‘ng va fosforning asosiy qismi kuzgi haydash oldidan, qolgan qismi va azotli hamda kaliyli o‘g‘itlar esa o‘simliklarning o‘sish davrida qo‘shimcha oziq tariqasida beriladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Potassium fertilizers are fertilizers used to supply potassium as an essential plant nutrient. They support plant water relations, enzyme activity, assimilate transport, crop yield, product quality, and stress tolerance. Common potassium fertilizers include potassium chloride and potassium sulfate.
example_en: Some 15 percent to 20 percent of the total potash is in the form of chlorine-free potassium fertilizers, essentially potassium sulphate, used for tobacco, grapes, potato and citrus. (FAO, Fertilizer Use by Crop in Uzbekistan)

definition_uz: Kuchaladoshlar (Araceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik, ildizpoyali yoki tuganakli manzarali o‘simliklar turkumi. Kalla o‘simliklari yirik barglari hamda so‘ta (spadix) va uni o‘rab turuvchi yirik qoplovchi barg — spata (spathe)dan tashkil topgan o‘ziga xos to‘pguli bilan ajralib turadi. Ular issiqxonalarda, gulzorlarda va xonalarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida yetishtiriladi hamda kesma gulchilikda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Issiqxonalarda va ochiq maydonlarda manzarali floristika uchun kalla (Zantedeschia aethiopica) o‘simligini yetishtirishda tuproq unumdorligi hamda havo namligini mo‘tadil saqlash hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega. (Manzarali gulchilik va fitodizayn asoslari. Yevsyukova va Berdiyev, 2015)
definition_en: A common name for perennial ornamental plants of the genus Zantedeschia in the family Araceae. Their characteristic inflorescence consists of a central spadix surrounded by a conspicuous spathe. Calla lilies are cultivated in gardens, greenhouses, and indoor environments and are widely used as cut flowers.
example_en: “Calla lily (Zantedeschia spp.) is an herbaceous flowering plant that belongs to the Araceae family, with worldwide distribution.” (Micropropagation and phytopathology of calla lily (Zantedeschia spp.). Martínez-Hernández A., Rodríguez-Delao J.L., Cruz-Castillo J.G. et al., Revista Colombiana de Ciencias Hortícolas, 18(2), 2024)

definition_uz: Daraxt tanasi yoki shoxining muntazam ravishda bir xil balandlikdan kesilishi natijasida shakllanadigan yo‘g‘onlashgan bosh qismi. Bog‘dorchilik va tutchilikda bunday qismdan yangi novdalar qayta-qayta o‘sib chiqadi; u daraxtga shakl berish, yoshartirish yoki barg va novda hosilini boshqarish bilan bog‘liq.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha kalla — "bosh" so‘ziga -k kichraytirish qo‘shimchasining qo‘shilishi bilan shakllangan.
example_uz: Kallak — tananing ustki keng va yo‘g‘onlashgan qismi, novdalarni muntazam kalta kesish natijasida shakllanadi. Asosan, undan ko‘p yillik (zang) tok rivojlana boshlaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The enlarged head or knuckle that develops on a tree after branches are repeatedly cut back to approximately the same point during pollarding. New shoots arise repeatedly from this structure.
example_en: Over a number of years, a swollen 'pollard head' forms where new shoots grow each year. (Pollarding: Pruning for Size Control. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Ko‘p yillar davomida muntazam kallaklab borilishi natijasida kesish joylarida yo‘g‘onlashgan kallaklar hosil qilgan daraxtga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bunday holat, ayniqsa, tut, tol va chinor kabi muntazam kallaklanadigan daraxtlarda kuzatiladi.
example_uz: "Tutchilik va pilla yetishtirishda baland kallakdor tut daraxtlaridan olingan sersuv va ozuqaga boy barglar ipak qurtining tez va sog‘lom rivojlanishini ta’minlaydi." ("Tutchilik" va "Daraxtlarni butash" maqolalari)
definition_en: Describing a tree that has been subjected to pollarding, in which the upper branches are repeatedly cut back to promote the production of new shoots from established pollard heads.
example_en: "Pollarded trees are systematically managed in agroforestry to maximize annual leaf biomass without killing the primary root system." (Forestry Papers. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilik va tutchilikda daraxtning yuqori tana qismi yoki asosiy shoxlarini muayyan balandlikdan muntazam kesib, shu joylardan yangi novdalar hosil bo‘lishini rag‘batlantirmoq. Bu usul daraxtga shakl berish, uni yoshartirish, barg yoki yosh novda hosilini ko‘paytirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Kallaklangan yon shoxlar meva tuguvchi yangi shoxlarni rivojlantiradi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: To cut back the upper branches of a tree to a predetermined height, usually repeatedly over time, in order to encourage the production of a dense head of new shoots.
example_en: “The best time to pollard many trees and shrubs is in late winter or early spring.” (Pollarding. The RHS Advice Team, Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik, ildizpoyali manzarali va dorivor o‘simlik. Tik poyali bo‘lib, mayda sariq gullari ko‘plab savatchalardan tashkil topgan shoxlangan to‘pgullar hosil qiladi. Shimoliy Amerikaga xos tur bo‘lib, ko‘plab mamlakatlarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida introduksiya qilingan, ayrim hududlarda esa invaziv tur hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Kanada solidagosi tarkibidagi flavonoidlar buyrak va siydik yo‘llari kasalliklarini davolashda ishlatiladigan farmatsevtik preparatlar uchun muhim xomashyo hisoblanadi. (Qoqio‘tdoshlar oilasiga mansub dorivor o‘simliklarning xalq xo‘jaligidagi ahamiyati. Zamonaviy dunyoda tabiiy fanlar: nazariy va amaliy izlanishlar, ilmiy onlayn konferensiya materiallari)
definition_en: A rhizomatous perennial herb of the family Asteraceae, native to North America. It bears numerous small yellow flower heads in large branched inflorescences. It is widely cultivated as an ornamental plant but has become invasive in many regions because of vigorous vegetative spread and abundant seed production.
example_en: Canadian goldenrod (Solidago canadensis L.) is a rhizomatous plant of the Asteraceae family. (Phytochemical and Pharmacological Research in Galenic Remedies of Solidago canadensis L. Herb. Hrytsyk Y. et al., Phyton—International Journal of Experimental Botany, 2024, 93(9): 2303–2315)

definition_uz: Qrim bilan bog‘liq qadimiy qishki olma navi. Daraxti kuchli o‘sadi, mevasi o‘ziga xos cho‘ziq-silindrsimon shaklda bo‘lib, po‘sti och sariq, quyosh tushgan tomonida qizg‘ish tus hosil qilishi mumkin. Eti oq, sersuv, nordon-shirin ta’mli. Mevalari yaxshi saqlanish xususiyatiga ega.
example_uz: Kandil Sinap navli olmaning o‘rtacha vazni ikki marta sug‘orilganda oshadi, mevalar yirikroq bo‘ladi (lekin ma’lum chegaragacha). Sug‘orishlar mevaning rangini ham yaxshilaydi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Kandil Sinap is an old winter apple cultivar associated with Crimea and known for its distinctive elongated, narrow fruit shape and good keeping quality. The fruit typically has pale yellow skin, often with a reddish blush on the sun-exposed side, and white, juicy flesh with a sweet-tart flavor.
example_en: “Harvest of the locally grown winter apple sorts ‘Renet Simirenko’ and ‘Kandil Sinap’ are preserved in storages annually.” (The Storage Technology of Local Winter Apples in Controlled Atmosphere Storage. Merganov A., Abdullaev Z., Halimboev A., European Journal of Technical and Natural Sciences, No. 3–4, 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Shilvidoshlar (Caprifoliaceae) oilasiga mansub, chirmashib o‘suvchi ko‘p yillik manzarali liana. Poyasi tayanchlarga o‘ralib o‘sadi, uzunligi 5–6 m gacha yetishi mumkin. Barglari tuxumsimon yoki ellipssimon, ayrim yuqori barglari poyani o‘rab turadi. Gullari xushbo‘y, oq, sarg‘ish yoki pushti ranglarda bo‘lib, juft yoki to‘pgul holida joylashadi. Mevasi qizil yoki to‘q sariq rangli rezavor meva. Kaprifol shilvisi bog‘lar, devorlar, ayvonlar, pergolalar va landshaft kompozitsiyalarida bezak o‘simligi sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Kaprifol shilvi (Lonicera caprifolium L.) chirmashib yoki sudralib o‘sadigan buta.” (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A perennial climbing ornamental vine belonging to the family Caprifoliaceae. Its stems twine around supports and may reach 5–6 m in length. The leaves are oval or elliptical, with some upper leaves surrounding the stem. The flowers are fragrant, white, yellowish, or pink and are arranged in pairs or clusters. The fruit is a red or orange berry. Italian honeysuckle is widely cultivated on walls, pergolas, arbors, and other supporting structures in landscape horticulture.
example_en: “We conducted bioassays to determine the toxicity of Italian honeysuckle (Lonicera caprifolium) essential oil and its fractions against larvae of the yellow fever mosquito, Aedes aegypti.” (Honeysuckle essential oil as a potential source of ecofriendly larvicides for mosquito control. Muturi E.J. et al., Pest Management Science, 2019)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar va o‘simlik mahsulotlarini karantin ahamiyatiga ega zararli organizmlardan himoya qilish, ularning yangi hududlarga kirib kelishi va tarqalishining oldini olishga qaratilgan fitosanitariya tadbirlari tizimi. O‘simliklar karantini import qilinadigan o‘simliklar, o‘simlik mahsulotlari va boshqa nazorat qilinadigan materiallarni tekshirish, karantin zararkunandalarini aniqlash, ularning kirib kelishi, tarqalishi va o‘rnashib qolishining oldini olish bilan bog‘liq tadbirlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.
etymology_uz: Italyancha quarantina — “qirq kun”.
example_uz: Bog‘ zararkunandalariga qarshi agrotexnik, biologik, kimyoviy, fizik, mexanik usullarda kurashiladi va karantin choralari ko‘riladi. Bu kurash usullari birlashtirilgan tadbir shaklida xo‘jaliklarning ishlab chiqarish rejasiga kiritilgan. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A system of phytosanitary measures and procedures intended to prevent the introduction and spread of quarantine pests associated with plants, plant products, and other regulated articles. Plant quarantine may include inspection, testing, treatment, confinement, restrictions on movement, and other official phytosanitary actions.
etymology_en: Quarantine derives from Italian quarantina, meaning “forty days”.
example_en: Post-entry quarantine stations hold imported consignments of plants, mainly plants for planting, in confinement in order to verify whether or not they are infested with quarantine pests. (ISPM 34: Design and operation of post-entry quarantine stations for plants. International Plant Protection Convention, FAO)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar, o‘simlik mahsulotlari va boshqa nazorat qilinadigan materiallarda karantin ahamiyatiga ega zararkunandalar, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilari, begona o‘tlar hamda boshqa tartibga solinadigan zararli organizmlarni aniqlash, identifikatsiya qilish va fitosanitariya ekspertizasini o‘tkazishga ixtisoslashgan laboratoriya. Bunday laboratoriyalar import, eksport va ichki fitosanitariya nazorati uchun diagnostik va laboratoriya tahlillarini amalga oshiradi.
example_uz: Hozir O‘zbekistonda Davlat o‘simliklarning karantin xizmati mavjud bo‘lib, uning viloyat va tumanlardagi bo‘limlari karantin sinash laboratoriyalaridan tashkil topgan. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A specialized laboratory responsible for the detection and identification of quarantine pests and other regulated pests in plants, plant products, and other regulated articles for phytosanitary purposes. Plant quarantine laboratories may use morphological, molecular, serological, and other diagnostic methods to support official phytosanitary control.
example_en: In most of the countries a plant quarantine laboratory does not exist or unequipped. (Report on the Regional Workshop on International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures, International Plant Protection Convention, FAO)

definition_uz: Tarkibida taxminan 46% azot saqlaydigan, suvda yaxshi eriydigan oq kristalli azotli o‘g‘it. Karbamid qishloq xo‘jaligi va bog‘dorchilikda o‘simliklarni azot bilan oziqlantirish uchun keng qo‘llaniladi. U tuproqqa asosiy yoki qo‘shimcha o‘g‘it sifatida berilishi, shuningdek, tegishli konsentratsiyada bargdan oziqlantirish uchun qo‘llanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Bargidan oziqlantirish uchun eng yaxshi azotli o‘g‘it turi karbamid o‘g‘iti hisoblanadi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A white, crystalline, water-soluble organic nitrogen compound containing about 46% nitrogen. Urea is widely used as a concentrated nitrogen fertilizer and may be applied to soil or used for foliar application. In soil, it is hydrolysed by the enzyme urease to form ammonium, which can subsequently be converted to nitrate.
etymology_en: From French urée, derived from urine, referring to the substance from which urea was originally isolated.
example_en: Urea is the most important and widely used N fertilizer in the world today. (Plant Nutrition for Food Security: A Guide for Integrated Nutrient Management. FAO Fertilizer and Plant Nutrition Bulletin 16, FAO, 2006)

definition_uz: Pechakguldoshlar (Convolvulaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik yoki ko‘p yillik, ko‘pincha chirmashib o‘suvchi o‘simliklar turkumi. Ko‘plab manzarali turlarining gullari karnaysimon yoki voronkasimon bo‘lib, oq, pushti, binafsha, ko‘k va boshqa ranglarda uchraydi. Ayrim Ipomoea turlari vertikal ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda devor, panjara, pergola va boshqa tayanchlarni bezash uchun yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Karnaygul (Ipomoea purpurea) — poyasi uzun, ilashib o‘suvchi, manzarali bir yillik o‘simlik.” (Yalpizkabilar-Labiadae sinfcha (ajdodcha)si. Arxiv.uz, 2023)
definition_en: A common name applied to plants of the genus Ipomoea in the family Convolvulaceae. The genus includes annual and perennial herbs, climbers, shrubs, and other growth forms, with stems often twining or prostrate and flowers usually funnel-shaped. Many species are cultivated as ornamental climbers for their conspicuous flowers.
example_en: Many species in this genus will require a trellis, arbor, or other structure to support its vertical climbing habit. (Morning Glory — Ipomoea. North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox, North Carolina State University)

definition_uz: Karotinoidlar tarkibiga kiruvchi, kislorod saqlamaydigan sariq, to‘q sariq yoki qizg‘ish rangli uglevodorod pigmentlar guruhi. Karotinlar o‘simliklarning fotosintetik to‘qimalarida uchraydi va fotosintez hamda fotosintetik apparatni ortiqcha yorug‘lik ta’siridan himoya qilishda ishtirok etadi. α-karotin va β-karotin kabi ayrim karotinlar A vitaminining provitaminlari hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha carota — "sabzi".
example_uz: Sabzi o‘z tarkibida A vitamini va karotin moddasini ko‘p saqlaydi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Any of a group of hydrocarbon carotenoid pigments occurring in plants and other photosynthetic organisms. Carotenes participate in photosynthesis and photoprotection, and some members, particularly alpha-carotene and beta-carotene, have provitamin A activity.
etymology_en: From Late Latin carota, meaning "carrot".
example_en: Provitamin A carotenoids, such as β-carotene and α-carotene, are the dietary precursors of vitamin A. (Plant carotenoids: recent advances and future perspectives, 2023)

definition_uz: Ituzumdoshlar (Solanaceae) oilasiga mansub tuganak hosil qiluvchi ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon o‘simlik bo‘lib, dehqonchilik va sabzavotchilikda asosan bir yillik ekin sifatida yetishtiriladi. Yer osti stolonlarining uchida kraxmalga boy tuganaklar hosil qiladi. Kartoshka oziq-ovqat, urug‘lik, kraxmal va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar ishlab chiqarishda muhim ekin hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Nemischa Kartoffel so‘zidan, ruscha картофель / картошка shakllari orqali o‘zbek tiliga o‘zlashgan. Nemischa nom italyancha tartufolo — "trufel" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Kartoshka ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon o‘simlik, ammo insonlar o‘z ehtiyojlaridan kelib chiqib, bu ekinni bir yillik o‘simlik sifatida yetishtirishga moslashtirganlar. U odatda vegetativ yo‘l bilan ko‘payadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A tuber-bearing herbaceous perennial of the family Solanaceae, cultivated agriculturally as an annual crop for its edible underground stem tubers. Potato is one of the world's major food crops and is grown primarily for its starch-rich tubers, which are used for human consumption, seed production, and industrial processing.
etymology_en: From Spanish patata, historically associated with Taíno batata ("sweet potato") and Quechua papa ("potato").
example_en: Potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) is one of the world's most important food crops. (Response of potato growth and yield to potassium fertigation with a subsurface drip system. Agronomy Journal, 2025)

definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub tuganak ildizli ko‘p yillik manzarali o‘tsimon o‘simlik. Poyasi tik o‘sadi, to‘pguli savatcha shaklida bo‘lib, tilsimon va naychasimon gullardan tashkil topadi. Kartoshkagul yirik, rang-barang va xilma-xil shakldagi to‘pgullari tufayli gulzorlar, bordyurlar va boshqa manzarali kompozitsiyalarda keng yetishtiriladi. Tuganak ildizlarini bo‘lish, qalamcha va urug‘ orqali ko‘paytirilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Bunday ildiz tugunagi batat (Ipomoea batatas), kartoshkagul (Georgin), (Dahlia pinnata), shirach (Eremurus regelii) kabi o‘simliklarga xos bo‘ladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Botirova L.A., Ergasheva N.A.)
definition_en: A tuberous-rooted perennial ornamental plant in the family Asteraceae. It is cultivated for its showy flower heads and is associated with the development of numerous ornamental garden dahlias. It may be propagated by division of tuberous roots, cuttings, or seed.
etymology_en: The genus Dahlia was named in honour of the Swedish botanist Anders Dahl.
example_en: Dahlia are tuberous rooted perennials with pinnately divided leaves and showy flowerheads, double in many cultivars, in summer and autumn. (Royal Horticultural Society, Dahlia pinnata)

definition_uz: Kartoshka (Solanum tuberosum L.) yetishtirish, nav va ekish materiallarini tanlash, urug‘chiligini tashkil etish, agrotexnologiyasini ishlab chiqish, hosilni yig‘ish, saqlash va undan foydalanish bilan bog‘liq sabzavotchilik yo‘nalishi.
example_uz: Sabzavotchilik, polizchilik va kartoshkachilik tarmoqlarida kelajakda yalpi mahsulot ishlab chiqarishni ko‘paytirish, asosan, dehqon va fermer xo‘jaliklarining salmog‘ini yanada oshirish hamda hosildorlikni ko‘paytirish hisobiga amalga oshiriladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: The cultivation and management of potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) as a crop, including cultivar and seed-tuber selection, planting, crop management, harvesting, seed production, storage, and postharvest handling.
example_en: Use only certified seed tubers. Potato production costs are too great to risk using non-certified seed. (Potato Production. Brandenberger L., Shrefler J., Damicone J., Rebek E., Oklahoma State University Extension, HLA-6028, 2016)

definition_uz: Bog‘ va park landshaftlarida suvning bir necha pog‘ona, zina yoki sath bo‘ylab ketma-ket pastga oqib tushishi asosida yaratiladigan dekorativ suv inshooti. Kaskad sharsharalar landshaft kompozitsiyasiga harakat, tovush va estetik joziba kiritish hamda diqqat markazini yaratish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Kaskad (fransuzcha cascade — "pog‘onama-pog‘ona tushish, sharshara") + sharshara
example_uz: Zinapoyasimon (terrasali) bog‘larda pog‘onali sharshara (kaskad)lar ham hosil qilingan. (Zohidov P., Rasulov M. “Bog‘ tuzish san’ati”. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: An ornamental water feature in which water flows successively over a series of steps, levels, rocks, or basins, producing a sequence of small drops. Cascading waterfalls are used in gardens and parks to provide visual interest, movement, and the sound of flowing water.
example_en: The cascading waterfall overflows from one basin to the next on its long step-by-step descent to a lower-level collection pool. (Meridian Hill Park, Delta Fountains)

definition_uz: Karamdoshlar (Brassicaceae) oilasiga mansub Brassica oleracea turining zich bargli bosh hosil qiluvchi madaniy shakllari guruhi. Biologik jihatdan ikki yillik bo‘lsa-da, sabzavotchilikda birinchi vegetatsiya yilida hosil bo‘ladigan karam boshi uchun odatda bir yillik ekin sifatida yetishtiriladi. Karam boshi bir-birini qoplab joylashgan zich barglardan tashkil topadi. Oq boshli va qizil boshli karam kabi shakllari mavjud bo‘lib, yangi yoki qayta ishlangan holda iste’mol qilinadi.
example_uz: Karamning yosh maysalarini sabzavot va yer burgasi yeb qo‘yadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A group of cultivated forms of Brassica oleracea in the family Brassicaceae grown for their dense heads of overlapping leaves. Cabbages are biologically biennial but are generally cultivated as annual vegetable crops and harvested during the first growing season. The heads vary in shape, leaf texture, and colour and are consumed raw, cooked, or processed.
etymology_en: From Middle English caboche, from Old French caboche ("head"), ultimately associated with Latin caput ("head").
example_en: Use the following rotation guidelines for reducing potential disease problems for fields that have recently been used for growing crucifers. (New Jersey Cabbage IPM Guidelines. Rutgers New Jersey Agricultural Experiment Station)

definition_uz: Gulli o‘simliklarning asosan bir yillik, ikki yillik va ko‘p yillik o‘tlardan, ayrim hollarda butacha yoki yarim butalardan tashkil topgan oilasi. Gullari odatda ikki jinsli bo‘lib, to‘rtta erkin gultojbargga va oltita changchiga ega; changchilarning to‘rttasi uzun, ikkitasi qisqa bo‘ladi. Mevasi ko‘pincha qo‘zoq yoki qo‘zoqcha tipida bo‘ladi. Bu oilaga karam, rediska, sholg‘om, turp, xantal, raps va boshqa ko‘plab iqtisodiy ahamiyatga ega o‘simliklar kiradi.
example_uz: Karamdoshlar (Brassicaceae) oilasi 380 ta turkum va 3000 ga yaqin turni birlashtirib, gulli o‘simliklarning eng qadimiy, shu bilan polimorf oilalaridan biri hisoblanadi. (Dorivor o‘simliklar florasi va sistematikasi. Babadjanova S.X., Bobojonova X.M., 2021)
definition_en: A family of flowering plants consisting mainly of annual, biennial, and perennial herbs. The flowers typically have four free petals and six stamens, with four long and two short stamens. The fruit is commonly a siliqua or silicula. The family includes numerous economically important vegetable, oilseed, and condiment crops, including cabbage, radish, turnip, mustard, and rapeseed.
etymology_en: Brassicaceae is formed from the genus name Brassica and the botanical family suffix -aceae. The alternative family name Cruciferae refers to the characteristic cross-shaped arrangement of the four petals.
example_en: Flowers bisexual, cruciferous (cross-shaped); sepals 4, usually free ... petals 4 ... stamens usually 6. (Plants of the World Online, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, “Brassicaceae Burnett”)

definition_uz: Sovundoshlar (Sapindaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi manzarali daraxt. Barglari patsimon, gullari mayda sariq rangli bo‘lib, yirik ro‘vak to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevasi shishgan, qog‘ozsimon ko‘sak bo‘lib, pishish jarayonida rangini o‘zgartiradi. Qurg‘oqchilikka va shahar sharoitiga moslashganligi sababli ko‘cha, bog‘ va parklarda manzarali daraxt sifatida ekiladi.
etymology_uz: Koelreuteria turkumi nemis botanigi Joseph Gottlieb Kölreuter (1733–1806) sharafiga nomlangan.
example_uz: Qator qilib ekilganda, daraxtlar orasidagi optimal masofa sekin o‘sadigan va uzoq yashaydigan daraxtlar (eman, kashtan va b.) uchun 8–12 m, tez o‘suvchi va uzoq yashamaydigan daraxtlar (shumtol, zarang, kelreyteriya, sofora va b.) uchun – (5) 6–8 m. (Manzarali o‘simliklar. Yoziyev L.H., Samatova Sh.A., 2022)
definition_en: A deciduous ornamental tree of the family Sapindaceae, valued for its conspicuous panicles of yellow flowers and papery inflated seed capsules. It is widely cultivated as a landscape and street tree and is tolerant of relatively dry and urban growing conditions.
etymology_en: The genus Koelreuteria was named in honour of the German botanist Joseph Gottlieb Kölreuter (1733–1806).
example_en: "Koelreuteria paniculata, commonly called golden raintree, is a small, open-branching, irregularly-shaped, deciduous tree with a rounded crown." (Koelreuteria paniculata. Plant Finder, Missouri Botanical Garden)

definition_uz: Tuproqni yumshatish, chopiq qilish, begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotish, egat yoki jo‘yak ochish hamda o‘simliklar atrofidagi tuproqqa ishlov berishda foydalaniladigan dastali qishloq xo‘jaligi qo‘l asbobi. Ketmon odatda metall tig‘ va unga biriktirilgan uzun dastadan tashkil topadi. Bog‘dorchilik, sabzavotchilik va dehqonchilikda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Halqasimon ariqchalar va tana atrofidagi tuproq qurigandan keyin ketmon bilan yumshatiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A long-handled agricultural or horticultural hand tool with a metal blade, used for cultivating and loosening soil, removing weeds, working around plants, and, depending on the type, making furrows.
example_en: "A common hoe, also called a square-blade hoe, works for most garden jobs." (Extension Gardener Handbook: Appendix D. Garden Tools. NC State Extension)

definition_uz: Mevasi yoki hosili boshqa navlarga nisbatan kech muddatda pishib yetiladigan o‘simlik navi yoki ekinga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Kechpishar navlar odatda nisbatan uzoq vegetatsiya yoki meva rivojlanish davriga ega bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Aprobatsiya avval ertapishar, keyin o‘rtapishar, oxirida kechpishar navlarda o‘tkaziladi, hosil terishdan 15–20 kun oldin to‘xtatiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Describing a cultivar, variety, or crop whose fruit ripens relatively late in the growing or harvest season compared with early- or mid-ripening cultivars.
example_en: "In general, Fuji is a late-ripening variety with a very long shelf life." (Important Apple Cultivars in the Mid-Atlantic Region. University of Maryland Extension, 2023)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni zararkunandalar, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilari va begona o‘tlardan himoya qilish maqsadida pestitsidlar, jumladan insektitsidlar, fungitsidlar va gerbitsidlarni qo‘llashga asoslangan himoya usuli. Integratsiyalashgan o‘simliklarni himoya qilish tizimida kimyoviy vositalar zaruratga qarab va boshqa himoya usullari bilan uyg‘un holda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Kimyoviy himoya usulida faqatgina xo‘jalik hamda sanitariya-gigiyena jihatdan aprobatsiyadan o‘tgan va Davlat komissiyasi ruxsat etgan pestitsidlar qo‘llaniladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Kimyoviy himoya usuli”. S. Alimuhamedov)
definition_en: A pest management method involving the use of pesticides to control harmful organisms such as insect pests, plant pathogens, and weeds. In integrated pest management (IPM), chemical control is used when needed and is combined with appropriate nonchemical management methods.
example_en: "Chemical control involves the use of pesticides." (An Introduction to Integrated Pest Management. Wycoff S.B., Frank D., Virginia Tech, 2020; reviewed 2026)

definition_uz: Asosan urug‘siz uzum navlari hamda ulardan quritib tayyorlangan mayiz mahsulotiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan nom. Kishmishbop uzum navlari yangi iste’mol qilish va quritish uchun yetishtiriladi. O‘zbekistonda Oq kishmish, Qora kishmish va boshqa kishmishbop uzum navlari tarqalgan.
example_uz: Tokning Oq kishmish navi butun yillik o‘suv davrida bir gektar yerdan 11 ming metr kubgacha suvni parlatadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A term used for seedless grape varieties, particularly those traditionally cultivated in Central Asia and neighbouring regions, and associated with both fresh consumption and raisin production. Different kishmish cultivars belong to Vitis vinifera L. and vary in berry colour, ripening time, and horticultural characteristics.
example_en: This article presents scientific-analytical data based on the results of the research carried out within the framework of the propagation of kishmish varieties of grapes from cuttings in the conditions of the Tashkent region. (Cultivation of Kishmish Varieties of Grapes from Cuttings in Conditions of Tashkent Region. Topilov Kh.A., Obidov Sh.Sh., 2022)

definition_uz: Bitta ona o‘simlikdan vegetativ ko‘paytirish (qalamcha, payvandlash, parxish, tuganak, piyozbosh yoki in vitro usullari) orqali olingan, irsiy jihatdan bir xil xususiyatlarga ega o‘simliklar guruhi. Klonlar navning qimmatli belgilarini saqlab qolish va bir xilda ko‘paytirish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha klōn — "novda, shox".
example_uz: Bitta duragay o‘simlikdan vegetativ (payvandlash, qalamcha, bachki novdasini ekish) yo‘li bilan ko‘p ming nusxada yangi o‘simlik hosil qilish mumkin. Ularning barchasi birgalikda klon deb ataladi; klonni tashkil etuvchi ayrim o‘simliklar esa individlar deb yuritiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A group of genetically identical plants derived from a single parent through vegetative propagation or tissue culture. Clones are used to preserve desirable genetic characteristics in horticultural and agricultural crops.
etymology_en: Ancient Greek klōn, meaning "twig" or "branch".
example_en: "Asexual propagation, vegetative propagation, results in clones of the parent plant." (Horticulture Newsletter. Kansas State University Research and Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning meristema, kurtak, poya uchi yoki boshqa kichik eksplantlarini steril oziqa muhitida in vitro sharoitida o‘stirish orqali genetik jihatdan bir xil o‘simliklarni qisqa muddatda ko‘p miqdorda olish usuli. Klonal mikroko‘paytirish mevali, rezavor, uzum va manzarali o‘simliklarning qimmatli genotiplari hamda navlarini tez va ommaviy vegetativ ko‘paytirishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Ushbu maqolada ekologik va farmakologik ahamiyatga ega ignabargli o‘simliklar uchun mikroklonal ko‘paytirish optimallashtirildi. (In vitro sharoitida ignabargli o‘simlik turlarini mikro klonal ko‘paytirish. Xazratov A.T., Juraeva H.K. va boshq. Xorazm Ma’mun akademiyasi axborotnomasi, № 11/1, 2025)
definition_en: The rapid in vitro propagation of genetically uniform plants from small explants such as shoot tips, meristems, or axillary buds under aseptic culture conditions. Clonal micropropagation is widely used for the rapid multiplication of selected genotypes and cultivars of fruit, berry, grapevine, and ornamental crops.
example_en: "Clonal micropropagation is an effective, modern method of accelerated vegetative propagation of plants and obtaining healthy, virus-free planting material."
