(Clonal Micropropagation of Moringa oleifera Lam. Vardanyan A., Ghalachyan L., Mairapetyan K., Tadevosyan A., Journal of Innovative Solutions for Eco-Environmental Sustainability, 2025)

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan aynan bir xil nusxalarni vegetativ ko‘paytirish yoki in vitro biotexnologik usullar orqali hosil qilish jarayoni. O‘simliklarda klonlash qimmatli navlarning irsiy belgilarini saqlash, viruslardan xoli ekish materialini olish va qisqa muddatda ko‘p miqdorda ko‘chat yetishtirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: O‘simliklarni sog‘lomlashtirish va mikroko‘paytirish hamda in vitro usuli yordamida o‘simliklarni klonlash uchun sharoitlar yaratish. (Qishloq xo‘jalik biotexnologiyasi va mikrobiologiyasi. Akramboyev R., 2024)
definition_en: The process of producing genetically identical copies of plants, cells, or organisms through vegetative propagation or modern biotechnological techniques. In horticulture, cloning is widely used to preserve desirable traits and produce uniform, disease-free planting material.
example_en: "The biological process is known as cloning and the resulting population is called a clone." (Genetic Selection, Clones. University of Florida IFAS, Plant Propagation, 2023)

definition_uz: Vegetativ ko‘payadigan o‘simliklarda bir nav tarkibidagi klonlar orasidan qimmatli xo‘jalik belgilari (yuqori hosildorlik, meva sifati, kasalliklarga chidamlilik, bir xillik va barqarorlik)ga ega klonlarni aniqlash, baholash va ko‘paytirish uchun saralash usuli. Klon tanlash mevali daraxtlar, uzum va rezavor ekinlar seleksiyasida keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Seleksiya ishida quyidagi tanlash usullari qo‘llaniladi: yakka tanlash, bir martali va ko‘p martali yakka tanlash; klonli tanlash; negativ tanlash.” (Qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi, Abdukarimov D.T., 2005)
definition_en: A selection method used in vegetatively propagated crops to identify, evaluate, and propagate superior clones with desirable genetic and agronomic characteristics. Clonal selection is widely applied in fruit trees, grapevines, and other perennial horticultural crops.
example_en: "Clonal selection endeavours to identify single individuals with positively modified characteristics as defined by the objectives of the selection process within the particular variety." (OIV Process for the Clonal Selection of Vines. Resolution OIV-VITI 564A-2017. International Organisation of Vine and Wine (OIV), 2017)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Bog‘, park, xiyobon va boshqa ko‘kalamzorlashtirilgan hududlarda manzarali o‘simliklar ekish uchun ajratilgan, aniq chegaralangan va odatda geometrik shaklda — yumaloq, oval, to‘rtburchak yoki boshqa shakllarda tashkil etiladigan gulzor turi. Klumbalarda bir yillik, ikki yillik va ko‘p yillik gulli o‘simliklar rang, balandlik va gullash muddatiga ko‘ra dekorativ kompozitsiya hosil qiladigan tarzda joylashtiriladi.
etymology_uz: O‘zbek tiliga ruscha клумба so‘zi orqali o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Klumbalar atrofidagi maysazor yoki yo‘lakchalardan yuqoriroq qilib hosil qilinadi va manzarali o‘simliklar ekiladi. Klumbalar odatda maysazor fonida joylashtiriladi, ochiq maydonlarda esa ularning chetlari ajriq bilan hoshiyalanadi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A type of flower garden consisting of a clearly defined area in a garden, park, or other landscaped space, usually arranged in a geometric shape such as circular, oval, or rectangular, and planted with ornamental flowering plants. Annuals, biennials, and perennials may be arranged according to color, height, and flowering period to create a decorative composition.
example_en: Annuals typically are used in flowerbeds or borders to add interest and color to the landscape. (Flowering Annuals: Characteristics and Culture. University of Missouri Extension, 2022)

definition_uz: Palmadoshlar (Arecaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil tropik palma. Odatda 20–30 m gacha o‘sadi, barglari yirik va patsimon. Mevasi yirik tolali danakmeva bo‘lib, tashqi qavat, qalin tolali mezokarp, qattiq endokarp va oq endospermdan iborat; yetilmagan meva bo‘shlig‘idagi suyuq endosperm kokos suvi deb ataladi. Kokos oziq-ovqat, yog‘, tola va boshqa mahsulotlar olish uchun yetishtiriladigan muhim tropik ekin hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Portugalcha coco — "tirjaygan yoki yuzga o‘xshash qiyofa"; nom kokos mevasining qattiq qobig‘idagi uchta chuqurchaning yuzga o‘xshash ko‘rinishi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Ushbu markazdan, sholi, shakarqamish, bodring, baqlajon, dukkakli va boshoqli ekinlarning ko‘pchiligi, nut, mosh, limon, apelsin, mandarin, mango, banan, kokos palmasi, qora murch, tut kabi madaniy o‘simliklar kelib chiqqan. (O‘simliklar introduksiyasi. Islomov B.S., Hasanov M.A., 2022)
definition_en: A tall tropical palm of the family Arecaceae, widely cultivated for its edible fruit, coconut water, oil, fibre, and other useful products. It is one of the most economically important tropical crops.
etymology_en: From Portuguese coco, referring to a grinning or grimacing face, in reference to the face-like appearance of the three depressions on the coconut shell.
example_en: "As a portable source of both food and water, the coconut played a critical role in the ability of humans to voyage, establish trade routes, and colonize lands in the Pacific Rim and regions throughout the Old World tropics." (Independent Origins of Cultivated Coconut (Cocos nucifera L.) in the Old World Tropics. Gunn B.F., Baudouin L., Olsen K.M., PLOS ONE, 2011, 6(6): e21143)

definition_uz: Malvadoshlar (Malvaceae) oilasiga mansub, asosan tropik Afrikada tarqalgan doim yashil daraxtlar turkumi. Ayrim turlarining, xususan Cola nitida va Cola acuminataning urug‘lari kola yong‘og‘i deb ataladi. Bu urug‘lar kofein va teobromin kabi alkaloidlarni saqlaydi hamda an’anaviy ravishda stimulyator sifatida, shuningdek oziq-ovqat va ichimliklar ishlab chiqarishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: “Kola daraxti (Cola Schott et Endl.) – sterkuliyadoshlar oilasiga mansub daraxt. Afrika o‘rmonlarida 50 ga yaqin turi uchraydi.” (Qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid atamalarning izohli lug‘ati. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qishloq xo‘jaligi vazirligi, 2023)
definition_en: A genus of evergreen tropical trees in the family Malvaceae, native mainly to tropical Africa. The seeds of some species, particularly Cola nitida and Cola acuminata, are known as kola nuts and contain caffeine and theobromine. They have traditionally been used as stimulants and as ingredients in food and beverages.
example_en: “Kola nut extract is derived from the seeds of primarily two tropical Cola species (Cola nitida or Cola acuminata).” (Burdock G.A., Carabin I.G., Crincoli C.M. Safety assessment of kola nut extract as a food ingredient. Food and Chemical Toxicology, 2009, 47(8), 1725–1732)

definition_uz: Aktinidiyadoshlar (Actinidiaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi, chirmashib o‘suvchi ko‘p yillik liana. Barglari mavsum davomida yashil, oq va pushti ranglarga kirishi bilan ajralib turadi. Gullari oq, xushbo‘y, mevalari mayda, yashil rangli, C vitaminiga boy va iste’mol qilinadi. Sovuqqa chidamliligi yuqori bo‘lgani sababli mo‘tadil iqlimli hududlarda mevali va manzarali o‘simlik sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Kolomikta aktinidiyasi (A. colomikta) Rossiyaning Amur viloyatida, Saxalin va Kuril orollarida, Koreya, Yaponiya va Xitoyda tabiiy o‘sadi. Ushbu o‘simlik ham mevali-vitaminli o‘simlik sifatida o‘stiriladi.” (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Berdiyev E.T., 2019)
definition_en: A deciduous climbing vine of the family Actinidiaceae, valued for its edible vitamin C-rich fruits, exceptional cold hardiness, and ornamental variegated foliage. It is cultivated as both a fruit and ornamental plant in temperate regions.
example_en: “Actinidia kolomikta is an Arctic kiwi. The male is often used as an ornamental because of the pink and white variegation of its younger leaves.” (Kiwifruit Production in Oklahoma. Oklahoma State University Extension)

definition_uz: Manzarali bog‘dorchilik va landshaft arxitekturasida gulzor, bog‘ yoki park kompozitsiyasini yaratishda ranglarning o‘zaro mutanosibligi va uyg‘unligi. Kolorit ranglar uyg‘unligiga ko‘ra iliq (qizil, sariq, zarg‘aldoq) yoki sovuq (ko‘k, yashil, binafsha), shuningdek, sokin yoki jiddiy, yorug‘ yoki to‘q, yorqin yoki xira bo‘lishi mumkin. Ranglarning uyg‘unligi, kontrasti va o‘zaro to‘ldirilishiga asoslangan holda estetik jihatdan yaxlit kompozitsion yechim hosil qilinadi.
etymology_uz: Italyancha colorito, lotincha color — "rang, bo‘yoq".
example_uz: "Ochiq maydonlardagi gulzorlarni rejalashtirishda sovuq va iliq tonlarning to‘g‘ri nisbatda tanlanishi umumiy landshaft kompozitsiyasining muvozanatli koloritini ta’minlaydi." (Ranglar koloriti ustida ishlash. ZiyoNET elektron kutubxonasi)
definition_en: The harmonious arrangement and balance of colours used in flower beds, gardens, and landscape compositions. Colour harmony may be warm or cool, bright or muted, light or dark, depending on the combination, contrast, and visual balance of colours.
etymology_en: From colour, ultimately from Latin color ("colour, hue"), + scheme, from Greek skhēma ("form, figure, appearance").
example_en: "Using a red, white and blue color scheme around your patio or deck could add a festive, energizing ambiance." (Red, White and Blue for the Green Thumb. Geist L., University of Missouri Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Daraxt, buta yoki boshqa ko‘p yillik o‘simlikning ildizlarini o‘rab turgan va ko‘chirib o‘tkazishda ildizlar bilan birga saqlanadigan tuproq bo‘lagi. Ko‘chatlarni kovlab olish va ko‘chirib o‘tkazishda komning saqlanishi ildizlarning shikastlanishi va qurishini kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
example_uz: Doim yashil daraxt va butalar ildiz komini buzmasdan kovlab olinadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Mirzayev M.M., 2010)
definition_en: The mass of roots and soil surrounding the roots of a plant, especially when retained together during digging and transplanting. Keeping the root ball intact helps protect the root system and facilitates successful establishment after transplanting.
etymology_en: From root, Old English rōt, ultimately from Old Norse rót ("root"), + ball, from Old Norse bǫllr ("ball, round object").
example_en: "Move the tree by lifting and carrying the root ball or carry grasping the material wrapped around the root ball rather than grasping the trunk." (How to Transplant Small Trees. Jauron R., Steil A., Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, reviewed 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simlik qoldiqlari, go‘ng, torf, oziq-ovqat va boshqa organik chiqindilarning mikroorganizmlar ishtirokida biologik parchalanishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan organik material. Kompost tuproqning fizik, kimyoviy va biologik xossalarini yaxshilaydi, unumdorligini oshiradi hamda o‘simliklarni oziq moddalar bilan ta’minlashga yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha compositus — "aralashtirilgan, birlashtirilgan".
example_uz: Tokzorlarga go‘ng 3–4 yilda bir marta gektariga 20–40 t, kompost esa 2–3 yilda bir marta 40 t dan solinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R., Umarov K., Karimov B., 2016)
definition_en: A stable organic material produced through the controlled biological decomposition of plant residues, manure, and other organic materials. Compost improves soil structure, fertility, water-holding capacity, and microbial activity and may be used as a soil amendment and source of plant nutrients.
etymology_en: Latin compositus, meaning "put together" or "composed".
example_en: Compost is the product of a biological decomposition process under aerobic conditions. (Glossary. HortiCert, 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simlik qoldiqlari, go‘ng, barg, oziq-ovqat chiqindilari va boshqa organik materiallarni mikroorganizmlar ta’sirida nazorat qilinadigan biologik parchalanishga uchratib, kompost tayyorlamoq. Kompostlash natijasida tuproq xususiyatlarini yaxshilashda va o‘simliklarni oziqlantirishda foydalaniladigan organik material hosil bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Umuman olganda, kompostlash jarayoni qishloq xo'jaligida barqaror rivojlanish va ekologik muvozanatni saqlashda muhim ahamiyatga ega. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi chiqindilarini maxsus kompostlash va uning ahamiyati. Yusupova R., Gulimboyeva Z., Journal of International Scientific Research, 2024, Vol. 1, Issue 3)
definition_en: To convert organic materials such as plant residues, leaves, manure, and food waste into compost through biological decomposition under suitable environmental conditions.
etymology_en: From Old French compost, from Latin compositum, meaning "a mixture" or "something put together".
example_en: "You can compost many kinds of organic materials." (Composting in Home Gardens. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Manzarali bog‘dorchilik va landshaft arxitekturasida bir necha elementlardan tashkil topgan yaxlit tuzilma yoki badiiy yechim. Gullarning turli turlari, ranglari, shakllari va balandliklarini uyg‘unlashtirish orqali klumba, rabatka, alpinariy va boshqa gulzor kompozitsiyalari yaratiladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha compositio — "tuzish, birlashtirish, joylashtirish".
example_uz: Kompozitsiyalar uchun xona o‘simliklarini tanlashda ularning ekologiyasini hisobga olish kerak va sukkulentlar bilan namsevar o‘simliklarni, yorug‘sevar bilan soyaga chidamli o‘simliklarni birga ekmaslik zarur. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: The artistic arrangement of plants and landscape elements into a unified design. In ornamental horticulture, compositions are created by combining plant species of different colours, forms, textures, and heights to achieve aesthetic harmony.
etymology_en: Latin compositio, from componere, meaning "to put together" or "to arrange".
example_en: "Creating an effective landscape composition requires selecting plants with complementary flower colors, contrasting leaf textures, and staggered blooming periods." (Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) Landscape Design Principles / Journal of Environmental Horticulture)

definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik va ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon o‘simliklar turkumi. Poyalari odatda tik va shoxlangan, barglari qarama-qarshi joylashgan, ko‘pincha patsimon yoki chuqur bo‘lingan, gullari savatcha to‘pgul hosil qiladi. Turkumning Cosmos bipinnatus va Cosmos sulphureus kabi turlari rang-barang va uzoq muddat gullashi tufayli gulzorlar, klumbalar va boshqa manzarali kompozitsiyalarda hamda kesma gul sifatida yetishtiriladi. Ayrim turlari nektar va gulchang manbai sifatida changlatuvchi hasharotlarni jalb qiladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha kosmos — "tartib, uyg‘unlik, go‘zallik".
example_uz: "Shaharlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda va ixcham park kompozitsiyalarida ikki marta patsimon kosmeya (Cosmos bipinnatus) o‘zining uzoq muddatli gullashi va parvarish talab qilmasligi bilan keng qo‘llaniladi." ("Manzarali gulchilik" manbalari)
definition_en: A genus of annual and perennial herbaceous flowering plants in the family Asteraceae. The plants typically have erect, branching stems, opposite, often pinnately or deeply divided leaves, and flower heads arranged in capitula. Species such as Cosmos bipinnatus and Cosmos sulphureus are widely cultivated in flower gardens, flower beds, and other ornamental plantings and are also grown as cut flowers for their colorful and long-lasting blooms. Some species provide nectar and pollen for pollinating insects.
etymology_en: From Greek kosmos, meaning “order, harmony, or ornament”.
example_en: "Cosmos bipinnatus and Cosmos sulphureus are widely grown as ornamental bedding plants and cut flowers." (RHS A–Z Encyclopedia of Garden Plants. Brickell C. (ed.), Dorling Kindersley, London, 2016)

definition_uz: Tarkibida bir yoki bir nechta asosiy o‘simlik oziq elementlari yuqori miqdorda bo‘lgan mineral o‘g‘itlar. Konsentrlangan o‘g‘itlarga karbamid, diammoniy fosfat, yuqori konsentratsiyali NPK o‘g‘itlari, polifosfatlar va boshqa yuqori oziq elementli o‘g‘itlar kiradi. Oziq elementlari miqdorining yuqoriligi ularni tashish, saqlash va qo‘llashda bir birlik oziq moddasiga to‘g‘ri keladigan material miqdorini kamaytirishi mumkin.
example_uz: "Ekinlarni ekish oldidan va oziqlantirishda karbamid hamda ammofos kabi konsentrlangan o‘g‘itlarni me’yorida solish transport xarajatlarini tejaydi va hosildorlikni keskin oshiradi." ("Agrokimyo" va "Mineral o‘g‘itlar" manbalari)
definition_en: Fertilizers containing a high concentration of one or more major plant nutrients. High-analysis fertilizers include urea, diammonium phosphate (DAP), high-analysis NPK fertilizers, polyphosphates, and other fertilizers with a high nutrient content. Their high nutrient concentration can reduce the amount of material required for transportation, storage, and application per unit of plant nutrient supplied.
example_en: "Concentrated fertilizers are commonly used as basal and top-dressing fertilizers in modern crop production." (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers: An Introduction to Nutrient Management. Havlin et al., 8th ed., Pearson, 2014)

definition_uz: Tuproqqa ishlov berish, begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotish, tuproqni yumshatish, qatqaloqni buzish va ekin qator oralariga ishlov berishga mo‘ljallangan qishloq xo‘jaligi mashinasi. Kultivatorlar osma, tirkama yoki o‘ziyurar bo‘lishi mumkin hamda bog‘ va dalalarda agrotexnik tadbirlarni bajarishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha cultivare — “ishlov bermoq, parvarish qilmoq”.
example_uz: Tuproqning namini yaxshiroq saqlash uchun sug‘organdan keyin kunora sug‘orish egatlari tuproq bilan yopiladi, tuproq qurigandan keyin esa (2–3 kundan keyin) egatlarning tagi va ikki yoni panjali kultivator bilan yumshatiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A farm implement used to loosen soil, control weeds, break soil crusts, and cultivate between crop rows. Cultivators may be mounted, trailed, or self-propelled and are widely used in horticulture and agriculture for inter-row cultivation.
etymology_en: From cultivate + -or; ultimately from Latin cultivare, meaning “to cultivate or till”.
example_en: "The cultivator was used to control weeds and loosen the soil between orchard rows." (Principles of Horticulture. Adams et al., 2019)

definition_uz: Ekin qator oralari yoki tuproqning ustki qatlamiga kultivator yordamida sayoz ishlov berish agrotexnik usuli. Kultivatsiya jarayonida tuproq yumshatiladi, begona o‘tlar yo‘q qilinadi, yuzadagi qatqaloq buziladi va tuproq yuzasidan namlikning ortiqcha bug‘lanishi kamaytiriladi. Bog‘dorchilikda kultivatsiya bog‘ va ko‘chatzor qator oralarini parvarish qilishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha cultivatio — “ishlov berish, parvarish qilish”.
example_uz: "Vegetatsiya davrida bog‘ qator oralari bir necha marta kultivatsiya qilinadi." (Mevachilik. Bo‘riyev X.Ch., 2016)
definition_en: A shallow tillage operation performed with a cultivator on the soil surface or between crop rows to loosen the soil, control weeds, break surface crusts, and reduce excessive moisture loss from the soil surface. In horticulture, cultivation is commonly used for inter-row soil management in orchards and nurseries.
etymology_en: From Latin cultivatio (“cultivation”), from cultivare (“to cultivate, till”).
example_en: "Inter-row cultivation helps suppress weeds and improves soil aeration in orchards." (Soil Management: Building a Stable Base for Agriculture. Hatfield J.L., Sauer T.J., ASA-CSSA-SSSA, Madison, 2011)

definition_uz: Tuproq, kompost, qum va boshqa sochiluvchan materiallarni ko‘tarish, ag‘darish yoki ko‘chirishda foydalaniladigan dastali qo‘l asbobi. Bog‘dorchilikda tuproqqa ishlov berish, ko‘chat ekish, organik materiallarni aralashtirish va boshqa xo‘jalik ishlarida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Stratifikatsiyalangan urug‘larni har safar ko‘zdan kechirishda, albatta, kurak bilan ag‘dariladi, bu esa ularga havo kirishini yaxshilaydi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A hand tool consisting of a handle and a broad metal blade, used for lifting, turning, and moving soil, compost, sand, and other loose materials in gardening and agricultural activities.
etymology_en: Shovel derives from Old English scofl.
example_en: "Broad-bladed shovels are primary manual tools utilized for uniform distribution of organic compost and bulk substrate media in agricultural nurseries." (The Biology of Apples and Pears. Jackson J.E., 2003)

definition_uz: Poya, novda yoki ildizpoyada joylashgan, yangi novda, barg yoki gul hosil qiluvchi embrional o‘sish organi. Kurtaklar vegetativ, generativ (gulli) va aralash turlarga bo‘linadi. Ular o‘simlikning o‘sishi, shoxlanishi, gullashi va meva hosil qilishida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Olma daraxtlarining gul kurtaklari yozilganida birinchi galda 5–7 bargdan iborat to‘pbarg, so‘ngra esa g‘unchalar paydo bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An undeveloped embryonic shoot or flower, often enclosed by protective scales or young leaves. Buds may develop into vegetative shoots, flowers, or mixed shoots and play a key role in plant growth, branching, and reproduction.
example_en: "Pruning encourages lateral bud break by removing apical dominance, producing a bushier plant architecture." (Esau's Plant Anatomy / Royal Horticultural Society Dictionary of Plant Sciences)

definition_uz: Bir o‘simlikdan olingan bitta kurtakni payvandtagga ulash orqali amalga oshiriladigan vegetativ ko‘paytirish usuli. Kurtak payvandda kerakli navga mansub sog‘lom ona o‘simlikdan olingan kurtak payvandtag to‘qimasiga joylashtirilib, ularning birikib o‘sishi ta’minlanadi. Ayrim kurtak payvand usullari po‘stloq yog‘ochdan oson ajraladigan davrda bajariladi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxt ko‘chatlari to‘g‘ri ekilganda uning ildiz bo‘g‘zi, ya’ni kurtak payvand qilingan qismi yer betiga tarqalgan holda tuproq ustida yerga zich tegib turadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A vegetative propagation technique in which a single bud taken from one plant is inserted or attached to a rootstock so that their tissues unite and grow together. The bud is selected from a healthy mother plant of the desired cultivar. Some budding methods are performed when the bark separates readily from the wood.
example_en: Budding is inserting a single bud from a desirable plant into an opening in the bark of a compatible rootstock. (Propagating Fruit Trees by Budding. Carroll B., Oklahoma State University Extension, 2017)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organlarining yuqori yoki past harorat, kuchli quyosh nuri, kimyoviy moddalar va boshqa noqulay omillar ta’sirida zararlanishi natijasida to‘qimalarning nekrozga uchrashi, qorayishi yoki qurishi. Kuyish barg, gul, meva, novda va po‘stloqda kuzatilishi mumkin. Yuqumli kasalliklar sababli tez nobud bo‘lish holatlari esa fitopatologiyada odatda kuyish (blight) kasalliklari sifatida alohida tavsiflanadi.
example_uz: “Kuyish (qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari va daraxtlarda) — quyosh nurining to‘g‘ri tushishi (oftob urishi) yoki ob-havoning keskin almashinuvi (issiq urishi, issiqqa chalinishi) ta’sirida yuzaga keladigan shikastlanish.” (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. Ashmuhamedov S.)
definition_en: In horticulture, burn refers to injury and necrosis of plant tissues caused by heat, sunlight, frost, chemicals, or other abiotic factors. For rapidly spreading infectious diseases producing similar necrotic symptoms, the term blight is commonly used.
example_en: "Over-application of nitrogen fertilizers during dry spells can cause severe root and marginal leaf burn in young orchards." (Agrios' Plant Pathology / RHS Encyclopedia of Gardening Diseases)

definition_uz: Kuz fasliga oid yoki kuz mavsumida ekiladigan, pishadigan, yig‘ib olinadigan yoki bajariladigan o‘simlik, nav yoki agrotexnik tadbirni bildiruvchi sifat. Bog‘dorchilik va dehqonchilikda kuzgi ekinlar, kuzgi navlar, kuzgi ekish, kuzgi butash va kuzgi ishlov kabi birikmalarda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Zaxlatib sug‘orish bog‘lardagi daraxtlarning kuzgi o‘sishini kechiktirib yuboradi va ularning sovuqqa chidamliligini kamaytiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Relating to autumn or occurring during the autumn season. In horticulture, the term describes crops, cultivars, or agricultural practices associated with autumn, such as autumn-sown crops, autumn-ripening cultivars, and autumn planting.
example_en: "Autumn apple cultivars ripen from September to October under temperate climatic conditions." (The Biology of Horticulture: An Introductory Textbook. Preece & Read, 2nd ed., Wiley, 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda kuzatiladigan noinfeksion fiziologik so‘lish holati bo‘lib, turgorning yo‘qolishi, o‘simlik qismlarining egilishi va kuchli stress holatlarida nobud bo‘lish bilan tavsiflanadi. Bunday so‘lish noqulay agroiqlim sharoitlari, suv rejimining buzilishi yoki boshqa fiziologik stress omillari bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: "Kuzgi so‘lish o‘simliklarda noqulay muhit sharoitlari va fiziologik stress bilan bog‘liq holda kuzatilishi mumkin." ("O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi" va "Botanika" manbalari)
definition_en: A non-infectious physiological wilting condition associated with loss of turgor and adverse environmental or physiological stress during the autumn period.
example_en: "Autumn wilting may develop when plants experience severe water or temperature stress late in the growing season." (Plant Physiology sources)

definition_uz: Hosil yig‘ib olingandan so‘ng kuz faslida yerga asosiy ishlov berish maqsadida bajariladigan chuqur haydash. Kuzgi shudgor tuproqning suv-havo rejimini yaxshilash, namlikni to‘plash va saqlash, begona o‘tlarni kamaytirish hamda bahorgi ekish uchun qulay tuproq sharoitini yaratishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Bunday tuproqlarda har gektariga 2000 chelak miqdorida (15 tonnaga yaqin) ikki muddatda: kuzda kuzgi shudgor oldidan va bahorda qo‘shimcha oziqlantirish sifatida najas (fekaliy) solish ham yaxshi natijalar beradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Primary tillage carried out in autumn, usually after crop harvest, in which the soil is plowed to prepare it for the following growing season. Autumn plowing helps improve soil physical conditions, increase water infiltration and moisture storage, and facilitate subsequent spring field operations.
example_en: "The experimental fields were conventionally farmed with regular autumn ploughing to a depth of 18–22 cm before the start of this experiment." (Effects of tillage on the root length and depth distribution of stubble cover crops. Scientific Reports, 2025)

definition_uz: Aholi yashash joylari, sanoat hududlari, yo‘l bo‘ylari, istirohat bog‘lari va boshqa hududlarda daraxt, buta, gul, maysazor hamda boshqa o‘simliklarni ekish, parvarish qilish va yashil hududlarni barpo etishga qaratilgan tadbirlar majmui. Ko‘kalamzorlashtirish ekologik muhit va mikroiqlimni yaxshilash, hududning estetik qiyofasini boyitish hamda rekreatsion sharoit yaratishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda ko‘p yillik o‘simliklar sifatida chiroyli gullaydigan o‘tsimon o‘simliklar yoki bir joyda o‘sib, bir necha yillar davomida o‘z manzaraviyligini yo‘qotmaydigan, nihoyatda bezakli bargli o‘simliklar tushuniladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: The establishment, enhancement, and maintenance of vegetation and green spaces in urban and built environments through the planting and management of trees, shrubs, lawns, flowers, and other plants. Urban greening is undertaken to improve environmental quality and microclimatic conditions, enhance the aesthetic value of urban landscapes, support biodiversity, and provide recreational and other ecosystem benefits.
etymology_en: From urban, from Latin urbanus ("of or belonging to a city"), and greening, from green + the suffix -ing, referring to the process of increasing or establishing vegetation and green space.
example_en: "Most IAPS in nurseries were introduced for socio-economic, medicinal, ornamental, and urban greening purposes." (Role of the plant nurseries in spread of invasive alien plant species in Pakistan’s subtropical region: A threat for urban greening. Urban Forestry & Urban Greening, 2025, Vol. 105, 128688)

definition_uz: Yosh barglari, barg bandlari, yosh poyalari, novdalari yoki boshqa yashil vegetativ qismlari oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadigan sabzavot ekinlari guruhi. Ular odatda yangi holda yoki taomlarga ko‘kat va ziravor sifatida ishlatiladi. Bu guruhga salat, ismaloq, shivit, kashnich, petrushka, ko‘k piyoz, selderey va boshqa ko‘kat ekinlari kiradi.
example_uz: "Ko‘kat sabzavot ekinlari vegetatsiya davrining qisqaligi va sovuqqa chidamliligi sababli takroriy ekin sifatida yuqori iqtisodiy samaradorlik beradi." ("Sabzavotchilik" va "O‘simlikshunoslik" manbalari)
definition_en: Vegetable crops whose young leaves, petioles, stems, shoots, or other green vegetative parts are consumed as food. They are commonly eaten fresh or used as culinary greens and herbs. This group includes lettuce, spinach, dill, coriander, parsley, green onions, celery, and other edible greens.
example_en: "Green leafy vegetables require consistent nitrogen fertilization and soil moisture management to prevent bolting and leaf bitterness." (Decoteau's Vegetable Crops / FAO Horticultural Manual)

definition_uz: Murakkabguldoshlar (Asteraceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik o‘tsimon manzarali va dorivor o‘simlik. Gullari odatda to‘q ko‘k rangda bo‘lib, gulzorlar, rabatkalar va tabiiy uslubdagi kompozitsiyalarda ekiladi. Asalarilar va boshqa changlatuvchilar uchun nektar manbai hisoblanadi.
example_uz: "Ko‘k bo‘tako‘z gullari may–iyul oylarida yig‘ib olinadi va ko‘lankada quritilib, yallig‘lanishga qarshi choylar tarkibiga qo‘shiladi." ("Bo‘tako‘z" va "Dorivor o‘simliklar" manbalari)
definition_en: An annual flowering plant of the family Asteraceae, valued for its bright blue flowers. It is widely grown as an ornamental plant, attracts pollinators, and is also used as a cut flower and in wildflower meadows.
example_en: "Cornflower is commonly included in wildflower seed mixtures to attract pollinators and enhance biodiversity." (Encyclopedia of Garden Plants. Brickell C. (ed.), Dorling Kindersley, London, 2014)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub danakli mevali daraxt. Mevalari dumaloq, ko‘kimtir-binafsha rangli va danakli bo‘lib, yangi iste’mol qilinadi hamda qayta ishlashda foydalaniladi. O‘simlik danakli meva ekinlarining genofondini saqlash, seleksiya va genetik tadqiqotlarda ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: "Farg‘ona vodiysi va Toshkent viloyati bog‘dorchilik xo‘jaliklarida Ko‘ksulton navi ertapisharligi va xaridorgir ta’mi sababli asosiy tijoriy olxo‘ri navlaridan biri hisoblanadi." ("Olxo‘ri" va "Pomologiya" manbalari)
definition_en: A plum-type fruit tree in the family Rosaceae producing bluish-purple drupes and valued as a genetic resource for plum breeding and conservation.
etymology_en: Koksulton (Prunus domestica L.), a locally known plum in the Pamir region, is used for preparing jams, pickles, juices, and compotes. (Adapted from Khan A.A., Effect and Impact of Indigenous Knowledge on Local Biodiversity and Social Resilience in Pamir Region of Tajik and Afghan Badakhshan, Ethnobotany Research and Applications, 2021, Vol. 22)
example_en: "The 'Koksulton' plum is extensively cultivated in Central Asian irrigated oases due to its superior eating quality and high demand for fresh market consumption." (Flora of Uzbekistan / Central Asian Horticultural Research Institute Reports)

definition_uz: Ikki yildan ortiq yashaydigan va vegetatsiya davrini bir necha yil davomida takrorlaydigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Ularning yer ustki qismi ayrim turlarda har yili nobud bo‘lishi mumkin, ammo yer ostki organlari saqlanib qoladi; yog‘ochli turlarda esa poya va shoxlar ko‘p yillar yashaydi.
example_uz: "Beda va esparset kabi ko‘p yillik yem-xashak ekinlari almashlab ekish tizimida tuproq strukturasi va gumus miqdorini tiklashda muhim rol o‘ynaydi." ("Botanika" va "O‘simlikshunoslik" manbalari)
definition_en: Plants that live for more than two years, growing and reproducing over multiple growing seasons. Perennial plants may be herbaceous or woody.
example_en: "Perennial forage crops like alfalfa improve soil organic carbon sequestration and nutrient cycling efficiency compared to annual monocultures." (Strasburger’s Plant Sciences / FAO Agronomy Handbook)

definition_uz: Urug‘dan yoki vegetativ usulda yetishtirilgan, ma’lum darajada shakllangan ildiz tizimi va yer ustki qismiga ega hamda doimiy o‘sish joyiga ko‘chirib o‘tqazish uchun mo‘ljallangan yosh o‘simlik. Ko‘chatlar ko‘chatzorlarda yetishtiriladi va mevali, manzarali, o‘rmon hamda boshqa ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarni barpo etishda ekish materiali sifatida foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Malina ko‘chatini ko‘paytirishda ildizdan o‘sib chiqqan novdalar ildizi bilan ona tupdan sekin-asta ajratib olib ekiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A young plant produced from seed or by vegetative propagation, with a sufficiently developed root system and above-ground parts, and intended for transplanting to a permanent growing site. Planting stock is typically produced in nurseries and used as planting material for establishing fruit crops, ornamental plants, forest trees, and other perennial plantings.
example_en: "Planting stock prepared from seedlings raised in nursery beds for 10–12 months is sometimes used for plantation establishment in Viet Nam." (Improved Silviculture of Styrax tonkinensis. FAO, 2001)

definition_uz: Ko‘chatlarni undirish, parvarish qilish va doimiy ekish joyiga ko‘chirishgacha yetishtirish uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus yopiq yoki yarim yopiq inshoot. Ko‘chatxona issiqxona, parnik yoki boshqa himoyalangan ko‘paytirish inshooti ko‘rinishida bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: "Ilmiy-amaliy markazning ko‘chatxonasida kasalliklardan xoli bo‘lgan kassetali va yopiq ildiz tizimiga ega uzum va olma ko‘chatlari yetishtirilmoqda." ("Ko‘chatxona" manbasi)
definition_en: A protected structure designed for germinating, propagating, rearing, and hardening young plants until they are ready for transplanting.
example_en: "Plant nurseries provide controlled environmental conditions for rooting cuttings and raising young nursery plants." (Nursery Practice sources)

definition_uz: Mevali, manzarali, o‘rmon va boshqa daraxt hamda buta turlarining ko‘chatlari ochiq maydonda yetishtiriladigan maxsus yer uchastkasi. Ko‘chatzorda urug‘ ekish, qalamchalarni ildizlantirish, payvandlash, ko‘chatlarni parvarish qilish va standart ekish materiallarini tayyorlash ishlari amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Doimiy joyga ekish uchun ko‘chatzordan olinadigan sitrus o‘simliklarning standart ko‘chat tupining diametri 0,7–1 sm bo‘lishi va yaxshi rivojlangan 3–4 ta birinchi tartibda shoxi bo‘lishi kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A designated outdoor area where young trees, shrubs, and other plants are propagated, grown, and maintained until they are ready for transplanting or sale.
example_en: "Fruit tree rootstocks are lined out in the nursery field early in spring to ensure adequate root establishment before summer chip-budding." (Principles of Nursery Management / USDA Agricultural Handbook)

definition_uz: Mevali, manzarali, o‘rmon va boshqa ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarning urug‘ va vegetativ usullar orqali ko‘chatlarini ko‘paytirish, yetishtirish, parvarish qilish hamda realizatsiya qilish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi ishlab chiqarish va agrotexnik faoliyat. Asosiy vazifasi sog‘lom, navdor va standart talablariga javob beradigan ekish materiallarini tayyorlashdan iborat.
example_uz: "Mamlakatimizda sertifikatlangan va virussiz ko‘chatchilikni rivojlantirish intensiv bog‘dorchilikning hosildorligini oshirishdagi eng ustuvor vazifalardan biridir." ("Ko‘chatchilik" va "Bog‘dorchilik" manbalari)
definition_en: The production of nursery plants through seed and vegetative propagation, including growing, maintaining, and supplying healthy planting material for horticulture, forestry, and landscaping.
example_en: "Advances in micropropagation and tissue culture have revolutionized commercial nursery production by enabling rapid clonal multiplication of pathogen-free rootstocks." (Plant Propagation: Principles and Practices. Hartmann H.T., Kester D.E., Pearson, 2011)

definition_uz: Relyef, tuproq, suv, iqlim, o‘simlik va hayvonot dunyosi kabi tabiiy komponentlar hamda inson faoliyati natijasida vujudga kelgan elementlarning o‘zaro bog‘langan yaxlit hududiy majmui. Bog‘dorchilik va landshaft arxitekturasida tabiiy yoki sun’iy shakllantirilgan ochiq makonni ham anglatadi.
etymology_uz: Nemischa Landschaft — "hudud, manzara".
example_uz: Ko‘kalamzorlashtirish ishlarida landshaftning asosiy unsurlari bo‘lgan yer (relyef), havo, suv va flora olamidan to‘g‘ri foydalanilganda, yaratilayotgan manzara yaxlit bir butun holatga keltirilib, to‘liq kompozitsion manzara hosil qilinadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: An area composed of interacting natural and human-made features, including landforms, vegetation, water bodies, soils, and built structures. In landscape architecture and horticulture, it also refers to the visual and functional arrangement of outdoor environments.
etymology_en: From Dutch landschap, meaning "region" or "tract of land".
example_en: "Landscape ecology analyzes how habitat fragmentation impacts biodiversity and nutrient cycling within mountain ecosystems." (Principles of Physical Geography / International Association for Landscape Ecology (IALE))

definition_uz: Amarantdoshlar (Amaranthaceae) oilasiga mansub ikki yillik o‘simlik. Birinchi yili yo‘g‘onlashgan ildiz va barglar to‘pini, ikkinchi yili gul poyasi, gullar va urug‘ hosil qiladi. Beta vulgaris tarkibiga oziq-ovqat uchun yetishtiriladigan qizil lavlagi, qand ishlab chiqariladigan qand lavlagi hamda yem-xashak uchun yetishtiriladigan shakllar kiradi.
example_uz: Qizil lavlagining ildizmevasida qizil rang beruvchi pigmentlar mavjud bo‘lib, ular hatto lavlagi barglarida ham ko‘rinadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A biennial plant of the family Amaranthaceae. Cultivated forms include table beet, sugar beet, and fodder beet and are used for food, sugar production, and animal feed.
example_en: "Sugar beet cultivation requires deep, well-drained loamy soils to allow unhindered vertical expansion of the taproot." (Principles of Crop Production / FAO Agricultural Plant Manual)

definition_uz: Lavlagi yetishtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi dehqon, fermer yoki mutaxassis. Lavlagikor lavlagini ekish, parvarish qilish, o‘simliklarni kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish hamda hosilni yig‘ishtirish kabi agrotexnik ishlarni amalga oshiradi.
example_uz: Qand lavlagi yetishtirishda usta qand lavlagikorlar har xil agrotexnik usullarni qo‘llab, turli miqdordagi hosil yetishtirish yo‘llarini tajribalar asosida ko‘rsatib berdilar. (Beta L. turkum turlarining biomorfologik xususiyatlari. Saparova D., 2012)
definition_en: A farmer, producer, or agricultural specialist engaged in growing beets, including the establishment, management, and harvesting of the crop.
etymology_en: Beet derives from Old English bēte, from Latin beta ("beet"); grower is formed from grow + the agentive suffix -er, denoting a person who grows or produces something.
example_en: "Sugar beet growers in Michigan and the Great Lakes region face a unique set of disease and abiotic stresses that in combination are not experienced on a regular basis in other sugar beet growing areas." (Sugarbeet Breeding. McGrath J., USDA Agricultural Research Service, 2002)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil sitrus daraxt yoki buta va uning nordon mevasi. Mevasi odatda yumaloq yoki tuxumsimon, po‘sti yupqa, yashil, yetilganda sarg‘ish-yashil yoki sariq tusga kiradi; eti sersuv, nordon va xushbo‘y. Laym mevasi oziq-ovqat va ichimliklar tayyorlashda, shuningdek, efir moyi olishda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha lime bilan bog‘liq xalqaro nom; lime ispancha lima orqali arabcha līma/līm ("sitrus mevasi")ga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi Braziliya va Hindistonda Rangpur laymi payvandtaglarida o‘stirilgan haqiqiy laymda kuzatilgan. (Agro kimyo himoya va o‘simliklar karantini. Xolmurodov E.A. va boshq., 2024)
definition_en: A small evergreen citrus tree or shrub of the family Rutaceae and its small, highly acidic, aromatic fruit. The fruit typically has a thin green rind that becomes yellowish at maturity and is widely used for its juice, flavour, and essential oil.
etymology_en: The word lime entered English through French and Spanish or Portuguese, ultimately deriving from Arabic līma and Persian līmū, referring to citrus fruit.
example_en: "Key lime should be planted in the warmest possible location in your landscape, protected from cold winds and in full sun, as it does not tolerate shade." (Key Lime — Citrus × aurantiifolia. North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox, NC State University)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil subtropik mevali daraxt va uning mevasi. Daraxti odatda kichik yoki o‘rtacha bo‘yli, barglari yashil, gullari oq, tashqi tomoni ko‘pincha binafsha yoki qizg‘ish tusli va xushbo‘y bo‘ladi. Mevasi odatda tuxumsimon yoki cho‘zinchoq, yetilganda sariq rangli, eti sersuv va nordon bo‘lib, oziq-ovqat, ichimlik va boshqa mahsulotlar tayyorlashda keng foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Limon xalqaro nom bo‘lib, arabcha laymūn/līmūn orqali forscha līmū/līmun — "limon, sitrus mevasi" so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Limonanj navi limon bilan apelsinning tabiiy duragayi hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A small evergreen citrus tree of the family Rutaceae and its aromatic, acidic fruit. The fruit is typically oval to oblong, yellow when ripe, and contains juicy, acidic pulp. Lemons are widely cultivated for fresh use, juice, flavouring, and other food products.
etymology_en: From Middle English lymon, via Middle French limon, from Arabic laymūn/līmūn, ultimately from Persian līmū/līmun ("lemon, citrus fruit").
example_en: "Lemons are typically propagated by grafting or budding onto rootstocks." (Lemon Growing in the Florida Home Landscape. University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Limon daraxtining (Citrus limon (L.) Osbeck) sersuv, xushbo‘y va nordon ta’mli mevasi. Mevasi odatda tuxumsimon yoki cho‘zinchoq, yetilganda sariq rangli bo‘lib, po‘sti efir moylariga, eti esa organik kislotalar, jumladan limon kislotasi va C vitaminiga boy. Botanika nuqtai nazaridan limon mevasi gesperidiy (hesperidium), ya’ni sitruslarga xos rezavorsimon meva tipiga kiradi.
etymology_uz: Limon xalqaro nom bo‘lib, arabcha laymūn/līmūn orqali forscha līmū/līmun — "limon, sitrus mevasi" so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Sitrus mevalar, jumladan limon, sovuqqa unchalik chidamli emas. Shu boisdan, O‘zbekiston sharoitida uni faqat transheyalarda, issiqxonalarda yoki sun’iy mikroiqlim sharoiti yaratilgan joylarda yetishtirish mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The fruit of the lemon tree (Citrus limon (L.) Osbeck), typically oval to oblong and yellow when ripe, with an aromatic rind and juicy, highly acidic pulp. Botanically, the lemon fruit is a hesperidium, a specialized berry characteristic of citrus fruits.
etymology_en: From Middle English lymon, via Middle French limon, from Arabic laymūn/līmūn, ultimately from Persian līmū/līmun ("lemon, citrus fruit").
example_en: "Lemon fruit has a strong commercial value for the fresh products market and food industry." (Natural Bioactive Compounds of Citrus limon for Food and Health. González-Molina E., Domínguez-Perles R., Moreno D.A., García-Viguera C., Journal of Pharmaceutical and Biomedical Analysis, 2010, 51(2): 327–345)

definition_uz: Limon va boshqa sitrus o‘simliklarini yetishtirish, ko‘paytirish va saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan, ularning o‘sishi va hosil berishi uchun zarur mikroiqlim sharoitlari yaratiladigan maxsus issiqxona yoki yopiq inshoot. Limonariyda harorat, namlik, yorug‘lik va boshqa agroekologik omillar sitrus o‘simliklarining biologik talablariga muvofiq boshqariladi.
etymology_uz: Limon + -ariy; ruscha лимонарий termini bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Tashkil qilingan limonchilik xo‘jaligi “Limonariya”da yaratilgan limonning yangi navlari butun Sobiq Sovet ittifoqi respublikalarida ommalashdi. (Issiqxonalarda limon yetishtirish. Kichik biznesni rivojlantirish jamg‘armasi, 2024)
definition_en: A greenhouse or other protected structure used for growing lemon trees, particularly in climates where outdoor conditions are unsuitable for their year-round cultivation. Such structures provide protection from low temperatures and allow environmental conditions to be managed for citrus production.
etymology_en: Formed from lemon + house; house is used in horticultural compounds to denote a protected structure in which particular plants are grown.
example_en: "The lemon houses (limonaie) at Lake Garda enable the cultivation of lemon trees in a climate that is not optimally suited for the purpose." (Ecological Prototypes: Initiating Design, Journal of Landscape Architecture)

definition_uz: Inson tomonidan xonakilashtirilgan, tanlab ko‘paytirilgan yoki ma’lum maqsadlarda muntazam yetishtiriladigan o‘simlik yoki organizmga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bog‘dorchilik va o‘simlikshunoslikda yovvoyi shakllardan farqli ravishda inson tomonidan ekib-parvarish qilinadigan o‘simlik, tur, shakl yoki navni ifodalaydi.
example_uz: Olma daraxtlarini yetishtirishda madaniy olma navlaridan Rozmarin, Qandil sinap, Parmen zimniy zolotoy kabi daraxtlarning mevasidan tayyorlangan urug‘lar kuchli payvandtag hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Grown, domesticated, or developed by humans through cultivation and selection, as opposed to occurring naturally in the wild.
example_en: "The genetic diversity of cultivated wheat varieties is continuously enriched by crossing with wild relatives." (Plant Breeding & Agronomic Terminology / FAO Glossary)

definition_uz: Inson tomonidan oziq-ovqat, yem-xashak, texnik xomashyo, dorivor mahsulot yoki manzarali maqsadlarda foydalanish uchun xonakilashtirilgan, tanlab ko‘paytirilgan va muntazam parvarish qilinadigan o‘simliklar. Madaniy o‘simliklar seleksiya, introduksiya va agrotexnik tadbirlar ta’sirida xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilarga ega bo‘lgan nav va shakllarni o‘z ichiga oladi.
example_uz: Yovvoyi holda o‘sadigan meva daraxtlari o‘zlarining xususiyatlarini duragay nasliga yaxshi o‘tkazadi va shuning uchun madaniy o‘simliklarning yangi tur va navlarini yaratishda qimmatli manba bo‘lib xizmat qilishi mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Plants that have been domesticated, selected, and intentionally cultivated by humans for food, feed, fibre, medicine, ornamental, or other economic purposes.
example_en: "The domestication syndrome in cultivated plants is driven by artificial selection for non-shattering seed heads and reduced seed coat thickness." (Principles of Crop Plant Evolution / Cambridge University Press)

definition_uz: Muayyan hudud, mintaqa yoki geografik joyga xos bo‘lgan, shu yerda tabiiy ravishda uchraydigan yoki uzoq vaqt davomida o‘sha sharoitga moslashgan. Bog‘dorchilik va o‘simlikshunoslikda ma’lum hududda tabiiy o‘sadigan yoki uzoq yillardan beri yetishtirilayotgan o‘simlik, nav yoki populyatsiyaga nisbatan qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha mahall (محلّ) — "joy, maskan, hudud" so‘zidan yasalgan bo‘lib, "muayyan joyga oid" ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: O‘rik navlari uchun mahalliy xashaki o‘rik yaxshi payvandtag hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Belonging to, originating in, or well adapted to a particular region or locality. In horticulture and plant science, the term may refer to plant species, cultivars, or populations associated with a specific geographic area.
etymology_en: From Latin localis, meaning "relating to a place".
example_en: "Local fruit cultivars are often better adapted to regional climatic conditions than introduced ones." (Allaby M. A Dictionary of Plant Sciences. 3rd ed., Oxford University Press, 2019)

definition_uz: Muayyan hududda o‘sadigan, yetishtiriladigan yoki uzoq vaqt davomida shu hududning tuproq-iqlim sharoitiga moslashgan o‘simliklar. Mahalliy o‘simliklar tarkibiga hududga tabiiy xos o‘simliklar bilan birga, mahalliy sharoitga moslashgan ayrim introduksiya qilingan o‘simliklar ham kirishi mumkin. Bog‘dorchilik va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda ular mahalliy sharoitga moslashganligi sababli qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Ilgari faqat mahalliy o‘simliklar, odamlar yashagan joy oldida ekilgan bo‘lsa, keyinchalik qo‘shni qishloq qabilalar o‘rtasida urug‘ almashtirish o‘tkazilib, sifati va hosildorligi past o‘simliklar siqib chiqarilgan.” (Qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., Ergashev I.T., Elmuradov A.A., Lukov M.K., Bekmuradova X.K., 2024)
definition_en: Plants that grow or are cultivated in a particular area, or that have become adapted over time to its local soil and climatic conditions. Local plants may include both plants native to the area and certain introduced plants that have adapted to local conditions. In horticulture and landscaping, they are valued for their adaptation to the local environment.
example_en: "Develop lists of local plants that benefit wildlife, and decide what is most appropriate for your yard." (U.S. National Park Service)

definition_uz: O‘simlik turi, navi yoki boshqa biologik obyektni yangi hududning tuproq-iqlim va ekologik sharoitlariga moslashtirib, shu hududda muvaffaqiyatli o‘stirish va foydalanishga joriy etmoq. Mahalliylashtirish seleksiya, introduksiya va o‘simliklarni yangi agroekologik sharoitlarga moslashtirish jarayonlarida muhim tadbir hisoblanadi.
example_uz: “Dehqonlarimizning tajribalari asosida avval qulupnay va limon mahalliylashtirildi.” (Avval import qilingan sitrus mevalar endi tomorqalarda yetishtirilyapti. Xudoyberdiyev O‘., Zarnews.uz, 2024)
definition_en: To adapt a plant species, cultivar, or other biological material to the climatic, soil, and ecological conditions of a new region so that it can be successfully cultivated and utilized.
etymology_en: From French acclimater, formed from climat ("climate").
example_en: "Agronomists succeeded in acclimatizing high-yielding Mediterranean citrus varieties to protected trench greenhouse conditions in Central Asia." (Agricultural Introduction & Acclimatization Manual / FAO Journal)

definition_uz: Bevosita xo‘jalikning o‘zida yoki unga yaqin hududlardagi mahalliy resurslardan olinadigan yoki tayyorlanadigan, asosan organik kelib chiqishga ega o‘g‘itlar. Ularga go‘ng, kompost, torf, qush axlati, yashil o‘g‘it, kul va boshqa mahalliy o‘g‘it materiallari kiradi. Mahalliy o‘g‘itlar tuproq unumdorligini oshirish, uning fizik, kimyoviy va biologik xossalarini yaxshilash hamda o‘simliklarni oziq moddalar bilan ta’minlashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: "Kuzgi shudgorlash oldidan har gektar maydonga 20–30 tonna chirigan mahalliy o‘g‘it solish tuproqning gumus balansini tiklaydi va mineral o‘g‘itlar samaradorligini oshiradi." ("O‘g‘itlar" va "Tuproqshunoslik" manbalari)
definition_en: Fertilizers produced on a farm or obtained from nearby local resources, mainly from organic materials. They include farmyard manure, compost, peat, poultry manure, ash, green manure, and fertilizers prepared from other locally available resources. Local fertilizers improve soil fertility and its physical, chemical, and biological properties while supplying plants with essential nutrients.
example_en: "The systematic application of farmyard manure improves soil aggregation and mitigates the degradation caused by continuous synthetic nitrogen fertilization." (Soil Fertility and Fertilizers / Pearson Agricultural Series)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, Rubus turkumiga kiruvchi ko‘p yillik buta. Ildiz tizimi ko‘p yillik, poyalari odatda ikki yillik bo‘lib, birinchi yili vegetativ o‘sadi, ikkinchi yili gullab meva beradi. Mevasi ko‘plab mayda danakchalardan tashkil topgan murakkab meva. Barglari murakkab, odatda 3–5 bargchali, ostki tomoni oqish tusli.
etymology_uz: Ruscha малина (malina) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Malina soyaga chidamli o‘simlik. Devor oldida, ko‘pincha meva daraxtlarining tagida o‘sadi va hosil beradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial shrub of the family Rosaceae and genus Rubus. It has a perennial root system and usually biennial canes, which grow vegetatively in the first year and generally flower and fruit in the second. Its edible fruit is an aggregate of numerous drupelets.
example_en: ‘Kokanee’ is a new primocane-fruiting red raspberry (Rubus idaeus L.) from the U.S. Department of Agriculture–Agricultural Research Service breeding program. (USDA Agricultural Research Service)

definition_uz: Malina butasining (Rubus idaeus L.) iste’mol qilinadigan murakkab mevasi. U ko‘plab mayda danakchalarning birikishidan hosil bo‘ladi, yumaloq yoki cho‘zinchoq shaklda bo‘lib, qizil, pushti, sariq yoki to‘q ranglarda uchraydi. Tarkibida qandlar, organik kislotalar, vitaminlar, mineral moddalar va biologik faol birikmalar mavjud. Yangi iste’mol qilinadi hamda murabbo, sharbat, jem va boshqa mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Malinaning mevasi o‘zining ajoyib mazasi va xushbo‘y hidi bilan ajralib turadi, u iste’mol qilinuvchi mahsulot sifatidagina qimmatli bo‘lmay, balki shifobaxsh ne’matdir. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: The edible aggregate fruit of the raspberry plant (Rubus idaeus L.). It consists of numerous small drupelets forming a single aggregate fruit and is valued for its sugars, organic acids, vitamins, minerals, and bioactive compounds.
example_en: "The raspberry (Rubus idaeus L.) fruit is characterized by its richness in functional molecules and high nutritional value, but the high rate of fruit softening limits its quality during postharvest." (Abscisic Acid Synthesis and Signaling during the Ripening of Raspberry (Rubus idaeus ‘Heritage’) Fruit. Plants, 2023)

definition_uz: Malina (Rubus idaeus L.) butalari ekilgan va parvarish qilinadigan plantatsiya yoki bog‘ maydoni. Malinazorlar rezavor meva yetishtirish maqsadida tashkil etilib, muntazam sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, butash va zararkunandalarga qarshi himoya tadbirlari orqali parvarish qilinadi.
example_uz: Kuzda malinazorning qator oralari haydaladi va tuplarning atrofi chopib yumshatiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An area or plantation where raspberry (Rubus idaeus L.) plants are cultivated for fruit production. Commercial raspberry plantations require regular irrigation, fertilization, cane management, support systems, and pest control.
etymology_en: Raspberry originates from Middle English raspe; plantation derives from Latin plantare, meaning "to plant".
example_en: "The red raspberry plantation was established in August 2019." (Population of Weeds in a Plantation of Red Raspberries (Rubus idaeus L.). Proceedings of the Latvian Academy of Sciences, Section B, 2022, 76(4): 551–554)

definition_uz: Ekin yoki navning alohida bir o‘simligidan olinadigan hosil miqdorini ifodalovchi ko‘rsatkich. Mahsuldorlik odatda bir o‘simlik hisobiga gramm yoki kilogrammda ifodalanadi va navning genetik xususiyatlari, o‘simlikning rivojlanishi, muhit sharoitlari hamda agrotexnik tadbirlarga bog‘liq. Mahsuldorlik hosildorlikdan farq qiladi: hosildorlik muayyan yer maydonidan olinadigan hosil miqdorini bildiradi.
example_uz: O‘rtacha bitta o‘simlikdan olinadigan hosil ekinning (navning) mahsuldorligi, yer maydonidan olinadigan hosil uning hosildorligi deb ataladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2005, 131-bet)
definition_en: The amount of yield or economically useful product produced by an individual plant under specified environmental and management conditions. Plant productivity is influenced by genetic characteristics, physiological processes, environmental conditions, and cultivation practices.
etymology_en: From productive + -ity; productive is ultimately derived from Latin producere, meaning "to bring forth, produce".
example_en: Discuss specific ways in which growers may manipulate physiological processes for increased plant productivity and quality. (Horticulture: Principles and Practices, Plant Physiology chapter)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Sarvdoshlar (Cupressaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil, ignabargli, nihoyatda yirik va uzoq umr ko‘ruvchi daraxt turi. Tabiiy holda AQShning Kaliforniya shtatidagi Syerra-Nevada tog‘larining g‘arbiy yonbag‘irlarida uchraydi. Balandligi 90 m dan, poya diametri esa 8–11 m dan ortishi mumkin. Manzarali bog‘dorchilik, dendrologiya va botanika bog‘larida noyob introduksiya qilingan daraxt sifatida qadrlanadi.
example_uz: Turkumda bitta yagona tur bo‘lib, u gigant sekvoyyadendron (Seguoiadendron gigenteum, Lindl.) yoki mamont daraxti deb ataladi. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A massive evergreen conifer of the family Cupressaceae, native to the western slopes of the Sierra Nevada in California. It is among the largest and longest-lived tree species on Earth and is cultivated as an ornamental and specimen tree.
example_en: "Giant sequoia is a famously massive and long-lived tree endemic to the Sierra Nevada of California, whose persistence is threatened by a changing climate and an altered disturbance regime." (Cox L.E., York R.A., Battles J.J. Growth and form of giant sequoia (Sequoiadendron giganteum) in a plantation spacing trial after 28 years. Forest Ecology and Management, 2021, 488:119033)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasiga mansub, Citrus turkumiga kiruvchi doim yashil subtropik mevali daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 2–6 m gacha yetadi. Barglari yaltiroq, to‘q yashil, gullari oq va xushbo‘y. Mevasi dumaloq yoki yassiroq, po‘sti yupqa va oson archiladi. Mandarin vegetativ usullar, asosan kurtak payvand va payvandlash orqali ko‘paytiriladi.
etymology_uz: Portugalcha mandarim, ispancha mandarín shakllari bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Yangi sitrus mevazorlarini barpo etishda navlarni ishlab chiqarish uchun tavsiya etiladigan nisbatda tanlash, ya’ni 70 foiz limon, 15 foiz apelsin, 10 foiz mandarin hamda boshqa sitrus mevalardan 5 foiz miqdorida ekish kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An evergreen subtropical fruit tree of the family Rutaceae and genus Citrus, cultivated for its sweet, easily peeled fruits. Mandarin trees are commonly propagated by budding or grafting onto suitable rootstocks.
etymology_en: From Portuguese mandarim, historically referring to Chinese officials.
example_en: "Mandarin can be propagated by seed, cuttings, layering, grafting or budding." (Standardization of Grafting Time of Mandarin (Citrus reticulata Blanco) in Central Mid Hill of Nepal, International Journal of Fruit Science, 2021)

definition_uz: Mandarin daraxtining (Citrus reticulata Blanco) shirali, xushbo‘y va shirin yoki nordon-shirin ta’mli mevasi. Mevasi dumaloq yoki yassiroq bo‘lib, po‘sti yupqa, oson archiladi va bo‘lakchalarga ajraladi. Botanika nuqtai nazaridan sitruslarga xos gesperidiy (hesperidium) tipidagi rezavorsimon meva hisoblanadi. C vitamini, karotinoidlar, kaliy va boshqa biologik faol moddalarga boy.
example_uz: Ba’zi mevalar (apelsin, limon, mandarin va boshqalar) changlanmasdan hosil beradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible hesperidium of the mandarin tree (Citrus reticulata Blanco), characterized by a thin, easily peeled rind and sweet, juicy segments. It is rich in vitamin C, carotenoids, and antioxidants.
example_en: "The thin albedo of the mandarin fruit allows for effortless manual peeling, making it a staple fresh-market commodity worldwide." (Recent Advances in Citrus Fruits. Purewal et al., 2023)

definition_uz: Pistadoshlar (Anacardiaceae) oilasiga mansub, Mangifera turkumiga kiruvchi doim yashil tropik mevali daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 10–30 m, qulay sharoitda 40 m gacha yetadi. Barglari oddiy va yaltiroq, gullari mayda bo‘lib, ro‘vak to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevasi yirik, shirali danakmeva bo‘lib, yangi iste’mol qilinadi va qayta ishlanadi.
etymology_uz: Malayalam tilidagi māṅṅa so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Mangoning gullashi va mevalarining pishishi naviga va o‘stirish sharoitiga qarab har xil bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An evergreen tropical fruit tree of the family Anacardiaceae, native to South Asia and cultivated worldwide for its edible fleshy drupes. Mango is one of the most economically important tropical fruit crops.
etymology_en: Ultimately from Malayalam māṅṅa.
example_en: "The mango tree is extensively cultivated throughout tropical and subtropical regions for its high-quality fruit." (Litz R.E. (ed.). The Mango: Botany, Production and Uses. 2nd ed., CAB International, 2009)

definition_uz: Mango daraxtining (Mangifera indica L.) yirik, shirali, bir urug‘li danakmevasi. Mevasi yumaloq, tuxumsimon yoki cho‘zinchoq bo‘lib, po‘sti yashil, sariq, to‘q sariq yoki qizg‘ish ranglarda uchraydi. Eti sarg‘ish yoki to‘q sariq, xushbo‘y, shirador va shirin ta’mli. A va C vitaminlari, karotinoidlar, pektin, kaliy va antioksidant moddalarga boy.
example_uz: "Mango mevasi yetilish darajasiga ko‘ra kletchatka va shakar miqdorining o‘zgarishi bilan ajralib turadi hamda yangiligicha iste’mol qilishdan tashqari konservalash va sharbat ishlab chiqarishda keng qo‘llaniladi." (Tropik meva tovarshunosligi va sifat ekspertizasi)
definition_en: The edible fleshy drupe of the mango tree (Mangifera indica L.). It typically contains one large seed and has juicy yellow to orange flesh rich in vitamins, carotenoids, dietary fibre, and antioxidants.
example_en: "The mango fruit is harvested at full maturity to ensure optimal mesocarp sweetness and flavor volatile development during postharvest ripening." (Postharvest Biology and Technology of Tropical Fruits)

definition_uz: Dalachoydoshlar (Clusiaceae) oilasiga mansub, Garcinia turkumiga kiruvchi doim yashil tropik mevali daraxt va uning mevasi. Mevasi dumaloq, po‘sti qalin va to‘q binafsha, eti oq, shirador, xushbo‘y va shirin-nordon ta’mli. Mangustan tropik mintaqalarda qimmatbaho mevali ekin sifatida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Malaycha manggis so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Mangustan o‘ta nozik tropik iqlim o‘simligi bo‘lib, past haroratga sezgir. Uning meva po‘stida ksantonlar kabi biologik faol birikmalar mavjud. (Tropik va subtropik o‘simliklar botanikasi)
definition_en: An evergreen tropical fruit tree of the family Clusiaceae and its edible fruit. The fruit has a thick purple rind and sweet, juicy white flesh and is highly valued for its distinctive flavour and aroma.
etymology_en: From Malay manggis or manggustan.
example_en: "Garcinia mangostana, widely hailed as the 'queen of fruits', is highly valued both for its delicate aril flavor and the bioactive xanthones extracted from its rind." (Encyclopedia of Tropical Crops / Academic Press)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilikning manzarali daraxtlar, butalar, gullar, gazon o‘simliklari va boshqa bezak o‘simliklarini yetishtirish, ko‘paytirish, parvarish qilish hamda bog‘lar, xiyobonlar, parklar va boshqa hududlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirish va bezatish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi tarmog‘i. Manzarali bog‘dorchilik gulchilik, landshaft bog‘dorchiligi va ko‘kalamzorlashtirish bilan chambarchas bog‘liq.
example_uz: Manzarali o‘simliklarning turlari, ularning hayotiy shakllari, bu o‘simliklarni manzarali bog‘dorchilikda qo‘llay olish ko‘nikmalariga ega bo‘lishi kerak. (Manzarali o‘simliklar. Yoziev L.H., Samatova Sh.A., 2023)
definition_en: The branch of horticulture concerned with the propagation, cultivation, maintenance, and use of ornamental trees, shrubs, flowers, turfgrasses, and other decorative plants for landscaping and beautification.
etymology_en: Ornamental derives from Latin ornamentum (“decoration, ornament”), from ornare (“to adorn”); horticulture derives from Latin hortus (“garden”) + cultura (“cultivation”).
example_en: "Ornamental horticulture concerns the production and use of woody and herbaceous plants." (Horticulture and Ornamental Horticulture. Paiva P.D.O., 2018)

definition_uz: Gullari, barglari, mevalari, tanasi, shox-shabbasi yoki umumiy tashqi ko‘rinishi bilan estetik qiymatga ega bo‘lgan va bog‘lar, xiyobonlar, parklar, ko‘chalar, turar joylar hamda interyerlarni bezash va ko‘kalamzorlashtirish maqsadida yetishtiriladigan o‘simliklar. Ularga daraxtlar, butalar, chirmashuvchi o‘simliklar, gullar, gazon o‘tlari va xona o‘simliklari kiradi.
example_uz: Manzarali o‘simliklarning turlari, ularning hayotiy shakllari, bu o‘simliklarni manzarali bog‘dorchilikda qo‘llay olish ko‘nikmalariga ega bo‘lishi kerak. (Manzarali o‘simliklar. Yoziev L.H., Samatova Sh.A., 2023)
definition_en: Plants cultivated primarily for their aesthetic value, including attractive flowers, foliage, fruits, stems, or overall form. They are widely used in gardens, parks, streetscapes, landscapes, and indoor environments.
example_en: "Selecting drought-tolerant ornamental plants is vital for sustainable urban landscaping in arid and semi-arid climate zones." (Principles of Horticulture / Routledge)

definition_uz: Tarkibida marganes (Mn) bo‘lgan mikroo‘g‘itlar. Ular o‘simliklarda fotosintez, fermentlar faolligi, nafas olish va azot almashinuvi jarayonlarida muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Marganes yetishmovchiligini bartaraf etish uchun tuproqqa yoki barg orqali qo‘llaniladi. Asosiy shakllariga marganes sulfat, marganes oksidi va marganes xelatlari kiradi.
example_uz: Marganesli o‘g‘itlar. Marganes sulfat — MnSO₄·4H₂O — 24,6%. (Tuproqshunoslik va agrokimyo fanidan amaliy-laboratoriya mashg‘ulotlari. Mashrabov M.I., Xayitov M.A., Maxmatmurodov A.O‘., 2022)
definition_en: Micronutrient fertilizers containing manganese (Mn), used to correct manganese deficiency in plants. They support photosynthesis, enzyme activation, nitrogen metabolism, and healthy plant growth and may be applied to soil or as foliar sprays.
example_en: "Manganese fertilizers are commonly used to correct Mn deficiencies." (Influence of Manganese on Growth and Yield of Wheat. Pakistan Journal of Botany, 2011, 43(1): 607–616)

definition_uz: Adoksadoshlar (Adoxaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik buta yoki kichik daraxtlar turkumi. Barglari murakkab, patsimon; gullari mayda, oq yoki sarg‘ish bo‘lib, to‘pgullar hosil qiladi. Mevalari mayda, sharsimon va rezavorsimon bo‘lib, qora, to‘q binafsha yoki qizil ranglarda uchraydi. Ayrim turlari manzarali, oziq-ovqat va dorivor maqsadlarda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Qora va qizil marjondaraxt o‘rmonlarning meliorativ holatini yaxshilash maqsadida ko‘p ekiladi. O‘zbekiston sharoitida marjondaraxtning 8 turi o‘stiriladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A genus of perennial shrubs and small trees belonging to the family Adoxaceae. Sambucus species have compound pinnate leaves, clusters of small flowers, and berry-like fruits. Several species are cultivated for ornamental, culinary, or traditional medicinal uses.
example_en: "These easy-to-grow shrubs and trees produce frothy white flowerheads in May and June, then heavy clusters of small black berries." (Sambucus. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS Plant Guide)

definition_uz: Tutdoshlar (Moraceae) oilasiga mansub oq tutning (Morus alba L.) mahalliy navi. Mevalari mayda, oq yoki och sarg‘ish, juda shirin va shirador bo‘lib, yangi iste’mol qilish va quritishga yaroqli. Barglari yirik, qalin va to‘q yashil bo‘lib, ipak qurti boqishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Sayil davomida marvarak, balx tuti kabi shirin va yirik tut mevalari qoqilib, shinni va qoqi tayyorlangan. (O‘zbek xalqi an’anaviy xo‘jaligida bog‘dorchilikka oid an’analarning saqlanish darajasi (XXI asr misolida). Ro‘ziqulova L.A., Sherzodova A.Sh., xalqaro ilmiy anjuman materiallari, 2025)
definition_en: A local cultivar of white mulberry (Morus alba L.) in the family Moraceae. Its fruits are small, pale in colour, sweet and juicy, and suitable for fresh consumption and drying. Its leaves are also used for silkworm feeding.
example_en: "The 'Marvarak' white mulberry is historically preferred across Central Asian oases for sun-drying and high-grade syrup production due to its elevated Brix levels." (Central Asian Ethnobotany & Pomology Review)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Yalpizdoshlar (Lamiaceae) oilasiga mansub, Vitex turkumiga kiruvchi barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta yoki kichik daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 2–6 m gacha yetadi. Barglari panjasimon murakkab, gullari ko‘k, binafsha, pushti yoki oq ranglarda bo‘lib, to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevalari mayda danakmeva bo‘lib, o‘simlik manzarali va dorivor maqsadlarda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Vitex agnus castus L – Maryam daraxti. Bo‘yi 4–6 (10) metrgacha yetadigan buta yoki daraxt. Chiroyli gulli manzarali o‘simlik. (Farg‘ona shahar Al-Farg‘oniy nomli istirohat bog‘ining dendroflorasi. Vahobov D.Q., 2013)
definition_en: A deciduous ornamental shrub or small tree of the family Lamiaceae and genus Vitex. It bears palmately compound leaves and spikes or panicles of blue, violet, pink, or white flowers and is cultivated both ornamentally and medicinally.
example_en: “Easy-to-grow, drought resistant, and attractive to butterflies and bees, Vitex agnus-castus is a multi-stemmed small tree with fragrant, upwardly-pointing lavender blooms and gray-green foliage.” (Summer Blue Flowers Enjoyed by People and Bees. Dunning S., University of Florida IFAS Extension, 2016)

uzbek: Mauley behisi (Chaenomeles japonica (Thunb.) Lindl. ex Spach; sin. Chaenomeles maulei)
definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, Chaenomeles turkumiga kiruvchi tikanli, barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta. Erta bahorda qizil, to‘q sariq, pushti yoki oq gullar bilan qoplanadi. Mevalari mayda, xushbo‘y, qattiq va nordon bo‘lib, qayta ishlashda foydalaniladi. Manzarali bog‘dorchilikda guruhlab ekish, rokariylar va tirik devorlarda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Mauley behisi, yoki xenomeles (Chaenomeles Maulei (Mast) Schneid.). Mauley bexisi — bargini to‘kuvchi, va yarim doimiy yashil, balandligi 0,3 metrdan 1 metrgacha bo‘lgan chiroyli gullovchi butasimon o‘simlik hisoblanadi. (Manzarali daraxtlarni ko‘paytirish. Berdiyev E.T., Gulamxodjayeva Sh.F., 2020)
english: Maule's quince (Chaenomeles japonica (Thunb.) Lindl. ex Spach; syn. Chaenomeles maulei)
definition_en: A thorny deciduous ornamental shrub of the family Rosaceae and genus Chaenomeles, valued for its abundant spring flowers and small aromatic fruits. It is commonly used in ornamental planting, rock gardens, and hedges.
example_en: "It also infects decorative landscape or forest plants such as hawthorn, Callery pear, firethorn (aka Pyracantha), raspberry (Rubus spp.), mountain ash, serviceberry (Amelanchier spp.), Cotoneaster spp., loquat, Chaenomeles spp. (Maule's quince), and other Rosaceae family species." (Fire Blight Fact Sheet. Aćimović S.G., Cornell University, 2020)
synonyms_en: Japanese quince; Japanese flowering quince; Dwarf quince

definition_uz: Yilning iqlim va ob-havo sharoitlari, shuningdek, o‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanish bosqichlari bilan tavsiflanadigan muayyan davri. Bog‘dorchilikda mavsum ekish, ko‘chat o‘tqazish, gullash, meva tugish, hosil yig‘ish, butash, payvandlash va boshqa agrotexnik tadbirlar amalga oshiriladigan davrni bildiradi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha mawsim (موسم) — "fasl, muayyan vaqt, davr".
example_uz: Olma mevasining mavsum boshidagi uzunligi uning diametridan katta bo‘ladi. Mavsum o‘rtalariga kelib esa, issiq hududlarda mevaning diametri uzunligi bilan tenglashadi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A period of the year characterized by particular climatic conditions or plant developmental stages. In horticulture, the term may refer to the appropriate period for planting, propagation, flowering, fruiting, harvesting, and other cultivation practices.
etymology_en: From Old French saison, ultimately from Latin satio, meaning "sowing".
example_en: “Plants produce large, good-quality fruits throughout the season.” (Growing Strawberries in a Home Garden. University of Maryland Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Yilning muayyan mavsumiga xos yoki faqat ma’lum faslda sodir bo‘ladigan hodisa, jarayon yoki holatni bildiruvchi sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda ekish, gullash, meva tugish, hosil yig‘ish, butash, o‘g‘itlash va boshqa agrotexnik tadbirlarning ma’lum mavsum bilan bog‘liqligini ifodalaydi.
example_uz: Meva ekinlarini sug‘orish samaradorligi sug‘orish me’yori, mavsumiy sug‘orish me’yori hamda 1 tonna mahsulot yetishtirish uchun sarflangan suv miqdoriga bog‘liq. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Occurring, available, or performed during a particular season of the year. In horticulture, the term refers to biological processes or cultivation practices associated with a specific growing or climatic season.
example_en: "Understanding seasonal growth cycles of blackberries and raspberries is necessary for proper training and pruning of caneberry plants." (Southeast Regional Caneberry Production Guide: Plant Growth. NC State Extension, 2023)

definition_uz: Jo‘kadoshlar (Malvaceae, avvalgi tasniflarda Tiliaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt. Barglari oddiy, yuraksimon asosli va chetlari tishli. Gullari mayda, sarg‘ish yoki sarg‘ish-oq, xushbo‘y bo‘lib, to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Gullari nektarga boy bo‘lib, asalarilar uchun muhim oziqa manbai hisoblanadi. Manzarali va soya beruvchi daraxt sifatida bog‘lar, xiyobonlar va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda ekiladi.
example_uz: Mahsulot jo‘ka (lipa) daraxtining ikki turidan tayyorlanadi: mayda bargli (yoki yuraksimon) jo‘ka (lipa) — Tilia cordata Mill. (Tilia parvifolia Ehrh.) va yirik bargli jo‘ka (lipa) — Tilia platyphyllos Scop. (Farmakognoziya)
definition_en: A deciduous tree of the family Malvaceae, formerly placed in Tiliaceae, with relatively small, heart-shaped, serrated leaves and fragrant yellowish flowers rich in nectar. It is widely valued as an ornamental and shade tree and as a nectar source for bees.
etymology_en: The specific epithet cordata is Latin for "heart-shaped", referring to the shape of the leaves.
example_en: This medium tree has wonderfully fragrant flowers in June and is tolerant of adverse conditions. (Littleleaf Linden (Tilia cordata). Niemiera A.X., Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, 2009)
synonyms_en: Littleleaf linden; Little-leaf linden; Small leaf lime tree

definition_uz: Mayizbop uzum (Vitis vinifera L.) navlarining mevalarini oftobda, soyada yoki maxsus quritgichlarda quritish orqali olinadigan quruq meva mahsuloti. Quritish usuliga ko‘ra avlon, bedona, garmiyon, sabza, soyaki va boshqa turlarga bo‘linadi. Mayiz oziq-ovqat sanoati, qandolatchilik va pazandachilikda keng qo‘llaniladi hamda uzoq muddat saqlanadigan uzum mahsuloti hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Forscha maviz (مویز) — "quritilgan uzum".
example_uz: Mayiz uzumdan tayyorlangan oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari orasida tarkibida eng tabiiy qand miqdori yuqori bo‘lgan, to‘yimli, energetik qiymati yuqori bo‘lgan quruq mahsulot hisoblanadi. (Uzumni soyaki usulda quritib mayiz tayyorlash texnologiyasi. Maxmudov I.R., Abdurazoqova M.B., 2024)
definition_en: A dried grape product obtained by drying suitable grape cultivars (Vitis vinifera L.) in the sun, shade, or specialized drying facilities. Raisins are widely used in food processing, confectionery, and cooking and have a considerably longer storage life than fresh grapes.
etymology_en: From Old French raisin ("grape"), ultimately from Latin racemus ("cluster of grapes").
example_en: “This study was carried out to determine the effects of different dipping solutions on the drying performances and raisin qualities of Akkişmiş and Karakişmiş grape cultivars, which are evaluated as drying in Semerkant (Uzbekistan) province.” (Determination of the Effects of Some Application and Drying Methods of Grape Varieties Grown in Samarkand (Uzbekistan) Region on Raisin Quality. Barin H., Kurt H., Doğan A., Polat Y., 2023)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Rubus turkumiga mansub, tikanli yoki ayrim madaniy shakllarida tikansiz poyaga ega ko‘p yillik buta. Poyalari odatda ikki yillik rivojlanish sikliga ega: birinchi yili vegetativ novdalar rivojlanadi, ikkinchi yili esa shu novdalardagi yon shoxchalar gullab, meva beradi va keyinchalik quriydi. Poyalari tik, yoyilib yoki yer bag‘irlab o‘suvchi bo‘lishi mumkin. Barglari murakkab, gullari oq yoki och pushti, pishgan mevalari qora yoki to‘q binafsha rangli va sershira bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Maymunjon O‘zbekistonning barcha tog‘li tumanlarida keng tarqalgan bo‘lib, ayniqsa, daryo vodiylari bo‘ylab hamda past tepaliklarda yakka holda va o‘tib bo‘lmaydigan tikanli chakalakzorlar hosil qilib o‘sadi. Bo‘yi 1,5 m gacha yetadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial fruiting shrub of the genus Rubus in the family Rosaceae. Its canes typically follow a biennial cycle: vegetative canes develop during the first year and produce fruiting lateral shoots during the second year, after which they die back. The canes may be erect, spreading, or trailing and may be thorny or, in cultivated forms, thornless. The mature aggregate fruits are usually black or dark purple and juicy.
etymology_en: From Middle English blakberie, from black + berry, referring to the dark colour of the ripe fruit.
example_en: "Most blackberry and some raspberry cultivars are floricane-fruiting, which means that they will bear fruit in their second and subsequent years of their life." (Southeast Regional Caneberry Production Guide. Fernandez G., McWhirt A., Bradish C., 2023)

definition_uz: Maymunjonning (Rubus fruticosus L.) pishgan murakkab mevasi. U ko‘plab mayda danakchali mevachalar — drupeletlarning birikishidan hosil bo‘lib, pishganda qora yoki to‘q binafsha rangga kiradi. Shirador, xushbo‘y va nordon-shirin ta’mga ega. Tarkibida C va K vitaminlari, antosianlar, flavonoidlar, organik kislotalar, mineral moddalar hamda oziq tolalari mavjud. Yangi iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek, murabbo, jem, sharbat, sirop va qandolatchilik mahsulotlari tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi. Maymunjonning malinadan asosiy pomologik farqi shundaki, meva uzilganda gul o‘rni meva bilan birga ajraladi, malinada esa u o‘simlikda qoladi.
example_uz: "Maymunjon mevasi nozik va sersuv bo‘lgani sababli, hosil yig‘ib olingach tezda qayta ishlanadi yoki past haroratda saqlash texnologiyasiga yo‘naltiriladi." (Rezavor mevasozlik va saqlash texnologiyasi)
definition_en: The edible aggregate fruit of blackberry (Rubus fruticosus L.). It consists of numerous small drupelets attached to a common receptacle and becomes black or dark purple when mature. The fruit is juicy, aromatic, and sweet-tart and contains vitamins, anthocyanins, flavonoids, organic acids, minerals, and dietary fibre. Unlike raspberry, the receptacle remains attached to the blackberry fruit when it is picked.
example_en: "Blackberry (Rubus sp.) fruit contains high levels of anthocyanins and other phenolic compounds, mainly flavonols and ellagitannins, which contribute to its high antioxidant capacity and other biological activities."
