(The Blackberry Fruit: A Review on Its Composition and Chemistry, Metabolism and Bioavailability, and Health Benefits. Kaume L., Howard L.R., Devareddy L., 2012)

definition_uz: Gulli o‘simliklarda odatda urug‘lanishdan so‘ng urug‘chi tugunchasidan, ayrim hollarda esa gulning boshqa qismlari ham ishtirok etgan holda rivojlanadigan generativ organ. Meva urug‘larni himoya qiladi va ularning yetilishi hamda tarqalishiga yordam beradi. Tuzilishiga ko‘ra mevalar quruq va shirali, hosil bo‘lishiga ko‘ra oddiy, murakkab va to‘pmevalarga ajratiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda mevalar oziq-ovqat va qayta ishlash sanoati uchun muhim mahsulot hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha mīva — "meva, yemish, o‘simlik hosili".
example_uz: Meva va rezavor meva oziq-ovqat hamda sanoat uchun xomashyo hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The seed-bearing structure of a flowering plant that develops primarily from the ovary after fertilization, sometimes with the participation of accessory floral tissues. Fruits protect developing seeds and assist in their dispersal. They may be classified as dry or fleshy and as simple, aggregate, or multiple fruits.
etymology_en: Fruit derives from Old French fruit, from Latin fructus, meaning "produce, fruit, result".
example_en: "A fruit is a ripened ovary that contains one or more seed. The fruit functions as protection for the seed until it is ready for dispersal." (Extension Gardener Handbook: Botany. NC State Extension, 2022)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilikning mevali daraxtlar, butalar va boshqa meva beruvchi o‘simliklarni ko‘paytirish, yetishtirish, parvarish qilish, hosilini yig‘ish, saqlash hamda undan foydalanish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi tarmog‘i. Mevachilik mevali ekinlar biologiyasi, navshunoslik, seleksiya, ko‘chatchilik, agrotexnika, o‘simliklarni himoya qilish va hosildan keyingi ishlov berish masalalarini qamrab oladi.
example_uz: Hozir respublikamizda meva va uzum yetishtirishga ixtisoslashgan 50 ta mevachilik va tokchilik xo‘jaliklari tashkil etilgan. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The branch of horticulture concerned with the study, propagation, cultivation, improvement, production, harvesting, storage, and utilization of fruit crops. It includes fruit crop biology, breeding, cultivar evaluation, orchard management, plant protection, and postharvest handling.
example_en: "Fruit growing is a high-risk venture, and Penn State Extension offers budgets and spreadsheet programs to assist you in business planning." (Beginning Grower: Planning and Planting an Orchard. Penn State Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Yopiq urug‘li o‘simliklar gulining ginetseyini tashkil etuvchi, urug‘kurtaklarni saqlovchi urg‘ochi reproduktiv birlik. Mevabarg morfologik jihatdan shakli o‘zgargan barg hisoblanadi. Ginetsey bitta yoki bir nechta alohida yoxud o‘zaro qo‘shilgan mevabarglardan tashkil topishi mumkin.
example_uz: Guldagi mevabarglarning yig‘indisi ginetsey deb ataladi. (Botanika. Matkarimova A.A., Mahkamov T.X. va boshq., 2018)
definition_en: The individual unit of the gynoecium of an angiosperm flower, typically comprising an ovary containing one or more ovules, a style, and a stigma. A gynoecium may consist of one carpel or multiple separate or fused carpels.
etymology_en: From New Latin carpellum, diminutive of Greek karpos, meaning "fruit".
example_en: A carpel is the individual unit of the gynoecium and has a stigma, style, and ovary. (Biology 2e. Clark M.A., Douglas M., Choi J., OpenStax, 2018)

definition_uz: Meva hosil qiladigan, meva berishga qodir yoki mevaga oid o‘simlik, daraxt, buta yoxud novdaga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda mevali daraxtlar va butalar meva yetishtirish uchun parvarish qilinadigan o‘simliklarni anglatadi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlardan olma, nok va behi ko‘proq tarqalgan bo‘lib, anchagina maydonni egallaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Bearing or producing fruit. In horticulture, the term describes plants, trees, shrubs, or shoots that produce fruit during their reproductive stage.
example_en: "Fruit-bearing plants should be pruned in March and April, after the deep cold has passed but before the plants phase out of their winter dormancy." (It's Pruning Season. University of New Hampshire Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Meva hosil qilmaydigan, meva tugmagan yoki muayyan davrda meva bermayotgan o‘simlik, daraxt, buta yoxud novdaga xos belgi. Bog‘dorchilikda yosh, hali hosilga kirmagan, bepusht yoki noqulay sharoitlar tufayli meva bermagan o‘simliklarga nisbatan qo‘llanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Mevasiz daraxtlar past haroratga chidamsiz bo‘lib, ular uchun zarur bo‘lgan biologik minimumdan harorat past bo‘lsa, ularni sovuq uradi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Not bearing or producing fruit. In horticulture, the term may describe plants, trees, branches, or shoots that remain without fruit because of immaturity, sterility, environmental conditions, or other biological factors.
example_en: "Alternation of reproductive years with fruitless, vegetative years appears to be one of the strategies devised by nature for balancing trees’ sexual reproduction with the required perpetuation of vegetative growth." (The Evolution of Fruit Tree Productivity: A Review. Goldschmidt E.E., 2013)

definition_uz: Meva yoki rezavorlardan presslash, siqish, sentrifugalash va boshqa fizik usullar yordamida olinadigan, manba mevaning o‘ziga xos ta’mi, hidi, rangi va asosiy oziqaviy xususiyatlarini saqlovchi suyuq oziq-ovqat mahsuloti. Tarkibida mevaning eruvchan quruq moddalari, organik kislotalari, vitaminlari, mineral moddalari va boshqa biologik faol birikmalari bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Meva sharbati — meva va sabzavotlardan olinadigan shirin suyuqlik; meva suvi. Asosan, olma, uzum, shaftoli, olxo‘ri, o‘rik, anor, sabzi va boshqalardan olinadi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Meva sharbati”. Alimov O.)
definition_en: The liquid product obtained from fruit by suitable physical processes and retaining the characteristic physical, chemical, sensory, and nutritional properties of the fruit from which it is derived.
example_en: "Fruit juice is produced by extracting juice from ripe, high-quality fruits." (Handbook of Fruits and Fruit Processing. Hui Y.H. (ed.), 2nd ed., Wiley-Blackwell, 2012)

definition_uz: Meva va sabzavotlarning sifatini, oziqaviy qiymatini va iste’mol xususiyatlarini imkon qadar saqlab qolish maqsadida ularni belgilangan harorat, nisbiy namlik, atmosfera tarkibi va sanitariya sharoitlarida saqlash usullari hamda texnologiyalari majmui. Saqlash jarayonida nafas olish, namlik yo‘qotilishi, fiziologik va biokimyoviy o‘zgarishlar boshqarilib, chirish va boshqa postharvest buzilishlari kamaytiriladi.
example_uz: "Mevalar va sabzavotlarni saqlashda harorat hamda nisbiy namlik rejimiga qat’iy rioya qilish mahsulot sifatini uzoq muddat saqlash imkonini beradi." (Meva va sabzavotlarni saqlash hamda ularga dastlabki ishlov berish. Bo‘riyev X.Ch., Jo‘rayev R.J., Alimov O.A., 2002)
definition_en: The science and technology of storing fruits and vegetables under controlled temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric composition, and sanitary conditions in order to maintain quality, nutritional value, and marketability and to reduce postharvest losses.
example_en: "The estimated storage is then shown to the user who can use this information to manage fruit and vegetable storage and distribution." (Integration of IoT and Sensors to Monitor Storage Condition of Fruits and Vegetables. Pavithiraa D., FoodTech Today, 2025)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtlarda mustahkam va maqsadga muvofiq shox-shabba tuzilishini hosil qilish, yorug‘likdan samarali foydalanish, hosildorlik va meva sifatini yaxshilash hamda parvarish va hosil yig‘ishni yengillashtirish maqsadida shoxlarni kesish, egish, bog‘lash, yo‘naltirish va joylashtirish orqali daraxt tojini shakllantirish agrotexnik usuli.
example_uz: Daraxtlarga to‘g‘ri shakl berish va kesish orqali quyosh nurlarining daraxt ichki qismida bir xilda tarqalishiga erishish, natijada bog‘dan yuqori iqtisodiy foyda olish mumkin. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The horticultural practice of developing a desired framework and canopy in fruit trees through pruning, branch positioning, bending, tying, and other training operations. Proper training improves light interception, air circulation, fruit quality, yield, and orchard management.
example_en: "Why train fruit trees? Training develops a strong tree structure that can support heavy crops without limb breakage." (Training and Pruning Your Home Orchard. Olsen J.L., Bell N., Oregon State University Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Qarigan yoki hosildorligi pasaygan mevali daraxtlarning vegetativ o‘sishini qayta faollashtirish, yangi novda va shoxlar hosil bo‘lishini rag‘batlantirish hamda mahsuldorligini tiklashga qaratilgan agrotexnik tadbirlar majmui. Yoshartirish odatda eski va samarasiz shoxlarni bosqichma-bosqich kesish, tojni siyraklashtirish va tegishli parvarish tadbirlarini qo‘llash orqali amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Daraxtlarni 5–6 yoshida kesishda o‘rinbosar shoxlarni shakllantirish kerak. Bu shoxlar daraxtni yoshartirish maqsadida kesiladigan eski shoxlarning o‘rnini bosishi uchun oldindan rivojlantirilishi zarur. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A set of horticultural practices aimed at restoring the vigour and productivity of ageing or declining fruit trees. It commonly includes rejuvenation pruning, removal of old unproductive branches, canopy thinning, and management practices that stimulate new shoot growth.
example_en: "Fruit tree rejuvenation is largely a matter of careful and selective pruning." (Reviving An Old Fruit Tree: How To Rejuvenate Old Fruit Trees. Spengler T., 2023)

definition_uz: Inson iste’moli yoki sanoat maqsadlari uchun foydalaniladigan meva hosil qiluvchi daraxtlar, butalar, chala butalar, lianalar va ayrim ko‘p yillik o‘t o‘simliklari majmui. Mevali o‘simliklar oziq-ovqat, vitaminlar va biologik faol birikmalarning muhim manbai bo‘lib, urug‘li, danakli, rezavor, sitrus, subtropik, tropik, yong‘oqmevali va boshqa guruhlarga ajratiladi.
example_uz: Butalar mevali o‘simliklar bo‘lib, katta tup shaklida o‘sadi. Ularning deyarli bir xil yo‘g‘onlikdagi bir nechta novdalari bo‘ladi. Krijovnik, smorodina va boshqa o‘simliklar shu guruhga kiradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Plants cultivated or growing for edible or commercially valuable fruits. Fruit plants include trees, shrubs, vines, and some perennial herbaceous species and encompass groups such as pome fruits, stone fruits, berry crops, citrus fruits, subtropical fruits, tropical fruits, and nut crops.
example_en: "Fruit plants should be fertilized based on soil test results and plant needs." (Fruit Plant Care. University of Maryland Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: Perikarpning ekzokarp va endokarp oralig‘ida joylashgan o‘rta qavati. U urug‘chi tugunchasi devorining o‘rta qismidan rivojlanadi. Meva turiga qarab mezokarp etli, shirali, tolali, g‘ovaksimon yoki quruq bo‘lishi mumkin. Shaftoli, o‘rik va olxo‘ri kabi danakli mevalarda u mevaning asosiy yeyiladigan etli qismini tashkil etadi.
etymology_uz: Mezokarp yunoncha mesos ("o‘rta") va karpos ("meva") so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lib, "meva devorining o‘rta qavati" ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Shaftoli, o‘rik va olxo‘ri kabi danakli mevalarda mezokarp mevaning shirali va etli, iste’mol qilinadigan asosiy qismini tashkil etadi. (Chin va soxta mevalarning tuzilishi, xilma-xilligi va klassifikatsiyasi. Nimadillayev O., 2025)
definition_en: The middle layer of the pericarp, located between the exocarp and endocarp. Depending on the fruit type, it may be fleshy, succulent, fibrous, spongy, or dry. In drupes such as peaches and apricots, the mesocarp forms the edible fleshy part of the fruit.
etymology_en: Mesocarp derives from Greek mesos ("middle") + karpos ("fruit"), meaning "the middle layer of the fruit wall".
example_en: "The mesocarp, which is found between the epicarp and the endocarp, is the fleshy middle layer of the pericarp." (Morphology and Anatomy. Carrillo-López A., Yahia E.M., in Postharvest Physiology and Biochemistry of Fruits and Vegetables, Elsevier, 2019)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning normal o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va modda almashinuvi uchun juda oz miqdorda zarur bo‘ladigan mineral oziq elementlari. Ular fermentlar faolligi, fotosintez, nafas olish, xlorofill va oqsil sintezi hamda boshqa fiziologik jarayonlarda muhim vazifalarni bajaradi. O‘simliklar uchun zarur mikroelementlarga temir (Fe), marganes (Mn), rux (Zn), mis (Cu), bor (B), molibden (Mo), xlor (Cl) va nikel (Ni) kiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha mikros — "kichik" + lotincha elementum — "tarkibiy qism, unsur".
example_uz: Tuproqda mikroelementlar yetishmaganda daraxt barglari va mevalarida turli dog‘lar paydo bo‘lib, ularning shakli buzilishi mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Essential mineral nutrients required by plants in very small quantities for normal growth and development. They participate in enzyme activation, photosynthesis, respiration, chlorophyll formation, protein synthesis, and other metabolic processes. Essential plant micronutrients include iron, manganese, zinc, copper, boron, molybdenum, chlorine, and nickel.
etymology_en: Micro- derives from Greek mikros ("small"), while nutrient derives from Latin nutrire ("to nourish").
example_en: "Micronutrients like boron, chlorine, copper, iron, manganese, molybdenum, nickel, and zinc are required in much smaller amounts than the other essential nutrients by vegetables and small fruit crops." (Foliar Fertilization and its Role in Vegetable Production. Penn State Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: Tarkibida o‘simliklar uchun zarur mikroelementlar (bor, rux, mis, marganes, temir, molibden, nikel va boshqalar) bo‘lgan o‘g‘itlar. Mikroo‘g‘itlar o‘simliklarning mikroelementlarga bo‘lgan ehtiyojini qondirish, ularning o‘sishi va rivojlanishini yaxshilash, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini oshirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Ular tuproqqa solish, bargdan oziqlantirish yoki urug‘larga ekish oldidan ishlov berish yo‘li bilan qo‘llanishi mumkin.
example_uz: Mikroo‘g‘itlarni turli usullarda qo‘llashning g‘o‘za organlaridagi mikroelementlar miqdoriga ta’siri. (Roziqova K., Abdumalikov D., O‘zMU xabarlari, 2025, 3(3.1.1))
definition_en: Fertilizers containing one or more essential micronutrients required by plants in small quantities, such as boron, zinc, iron, manganese, copper, molybdenum, and nickel. They are used to prevent or correct micronutrient deficiencies, improve plant growth, increase crop yield, and enhance product quality. Micronutrient fertilizers may be applied to soil, foliage, or seeds.
example_en: "The farmers of the region use mineral micronutrient fertilizers, but it leads to phytotoxicity due to unoptimized fertilizer application dose." (Optimizing the Zn, Mn, and Fe Mineral Dose as Tank Mix Foliar Application for Improvement of Fruit Yield, Quality, and Uptake of Nutrients in the Kinnow Mandarin. Singh S., Singh J., Dhaliwal S.S., 2023)

definition_uz: Bir yillik, ikki yillik va ko‘p yillik gullar, manzarali butalar hamda ayrim past bo‘yli daraxtlardan balandligi, gullash muddati, barg rangi va dekorativ xususiyatlari uyg‘unlashtirilgan holda tashkil etiladigan aralash gulzor. Miksborder bog‘ va parklarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda yo‘laklar, devorlar yoki to‘siqlar bo‘ylab barpo etilib, vegetatsiya davrining katta qismida uzluksiz manzaradorlikni ta’minlaydi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha mixed border — "aralash chegara, aralash gulzor".
example_uz: Pastak bo‘yli antirrinum himoya va tuvak o‘simligi sifatida ishlatiladi, o‘rta va baland bo‘yli navlari esa kesma gul sifatida, klumbalar, rabatkalar, ayvonlar hamda miksborderlarni bezashda qo‘llaniladi. Suvga solinganda gul g‘unchalari ochiladi va 10–12 kungacha saqlanadi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A planting design consisting of a mixture of annuals, biennials, perennials, shrubs, and sometimes small trees arranged according to height, colour, texture, and flowering season. Mixed borders are widely used in landscape design to provide continuous ornamental interest throughout the growing season.
example_en: "You could also consider using evergreen shrubs in a mixed border with Ribes as this will help provide some winter interest." (How to Grow Ribes. Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning hayot faoliyati uchun zarur bo‘lgan mineral oziq elementlarini o‘zlashtirishi, ularni o‘simlik bo‘ylab tashishi, metabolik jarayonlarga jalb qilishi va ulardan foydalanishi bilan bog‘liq fiziologik jarayonlar majmui. O‘simliklar uchun zarur makroelementlarga azot (N), fosfor (P), kaliy (K), kalsiy (Ca), magniy (Mg) va oltingugurt (S), mikroelementlarga esa temir (Fe), marganes (Mn), bor (B), rux (Zn), mis (Cu), molibden (Mo), nikel (Ni) va xlor (Cl) kiradi.
example_uz: O‘simliklarning mineral oziqlanishi ularning ildiz apparati va fermentativ tizimlarining faolligiga bog‘liq bo‘lib, makro- hamda mikroelementlarning maqbul nisbati fotosintez mahsuldorligini belgilaydi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi va agrokimyo)
definition_en: The set of physiological processes by which plants acquire, transport, assimilate, and utilize essential mineral nutrients. Essential mineral nutrients include the macronutrients nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), calcium (Ca), magnesium (Mg), and sulfur (S), and the micronutrients iron (Fe), manganese (Mn), boron (B), zinc (Zn), copper (Cu), molybdenum (Mo), nickel (Ni), and chlorine (Cl).
example_en: "Mineral nutrition plays a crucial role in plant growth and development." (Research Progress and Prospects on Plant Mineral Nutrition and Diseases. Wang M., Peng D., Zeng J., Wang S., Zhu L., Guo S., 2024)

definition_uz: Tarkibida o‘simliklar uchun zarur oziq elementlari mineral shaklda bo‘lgan, sanoat jarayonlari orqali ishlab chiqariladigan yoki tabiiy mineral xomashyodan olinadigan o‘g‘itlar. Mineral o‘g‘itlar o‘simliklarning oziq elementlariga bo‘lgan ehtiyojini qondirish, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini yaxshilash maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Ularga azotli, fosforli, kaliyli, murakkab va mikroelementli o‘g‘itlar kiradi.
example_uz: Bog‘dorchilik amaliyotida mevali daraxtlar meva tugishi bilan organik va mineral o‘g‘itlar solish tavsiya qilinadi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: Fertilizers containing essential plant nutrients in mineral form and produced from inorganic materials through industrial processes or obtained from mineral sources. They are applied to supply plants with essential nutrients and support crop growth and productivity.
example_en: "Mineral fertilizers are one of the main important sources of elements in agricultural soils." (Organomineral Fractions as a Way to Assess the Chemical Transformation of Elements in Soils of Different Cultivation. Soil and Tillage Research, 2024)

uzbek: Mirzaterak (Populus pyramidalis Roz. syn. Populus nigra var. italica)
definition_uz: Toldoshlar (Salicaceae) oilasi, terak (Populus) turkumiga mansub, tez o‘suvchi manzarali daraxt. Tanasi tik, shoxlari yuqoriga qarab zich o‘sishi natijasida piramidasimon yoki ustunsimon toj hosil qiladi. Ko‘cha, xiyobon, bog‘ va parklarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda, shamoldan himoya polosalari barpo etishda hamda manzarali daraxt sifatida ekiladi.
example_uz: Yaponiyada avtomobillar harakatlanadigan yo‘llar atrofida mirzateraklardan himoya daraxtzorlari barpo etilgan. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A fast-growing deciduous poplar of the family Salicaceae, distinguished by its narrow, columnar growth habit and steep, upright branches. It is cultivated as an ornamental tree and is also used for screens and windbreaks.
etymology_en: The name Lombardy poplar refers to Lombardy in northern Italy, the region associated with the origin of this distinctive columnar form.
example_en: "Lombardy poplar (P. nigra var. italica) exhibits a distinctive columnar growth habit, characterised by steep, upright branching." (Elucidating the Genetic Basis of Columnar Upright Architecture in Populus Through CRISPR Disruption of TILLER ANGLE CONTROL1, 2025)

definition_uz: Tarkibida mis (Cu) elementi bo‘lgan mikroo‘g‘itlar. Misli o‘g‘itlar o‘simliklarda mis tanqisligini bartaraf etish, fermentlar faolligini oshirish, fotosintez va nafas olish jarayonlarini me’yorlashtirish hamda hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini yaxshilash maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Ular tuproqqa solish, bargdan oziqlantirish yoki urug‘larga ekish oldidan ishlov berish yo‘li bilan qo‘llanadi. Asosiy turlariga mis sulfati (CuSO₄·5H₂O), mis oksidi va xelatlangan mis preparatlari kiradi.
example_uz: Misli o‘g‘itlar faqatgina hosildorlikni oshirish uchungina emas, balki o‘simlik va tirik organizmlarni kasalliklardan saqlash uchun ham xizmat qiladi. (Mineral o‘g‘itlar ishlab chiqarish nazariyasi va texnologik hisoblari. Erkayev A.U., Reymov A.M., Nurmurodov T.I., Umirov F.E., 2021)
definition_en: Micronutrient fertilizers containing copper (Cu) used to prevent or correct copper deficiency in plants. Copper fertilizers support enzyme activity, photosynthesis, respiration, and reproductive development. They may be applied to the soil, foliage, or seeds. Common forms include copper sulfate, copper oxide, and chelated copper fertilizers.
example_en: "Comparison between Effects of Two Copper Fertilizers Forms on Onion Plant Quality Grown in Sandy Soil." (El-bialy R.A., Abd El-Razik E.M., Mahmoud A.W.M., Current Science International, 2024, 13(4))

definition_uz: Tuproq yoki yer yuzasini tekislash va silliqlash, yirik kesaklarni maydalash hamda ekish uchun bir tekis yuza hosil qilish maqsadida qo‘llaniladigan qishloq xo‘jaligi agregati. Mola odatda shudgorlash va boshqa tuproqqa ishlov berish tadbirlaridan keyin, ekish oldidan yoki ayrim hollarda ekishdan keyin qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Erta bahorda tuproqlar ekishdan oldin boronalanishi, kultivatsiya qilinishi va mola bosilib, yerni yaxshilab tekislash kerak. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: An agricultural implement used to level, smooth, and prepare the soil surface. It redistributes soil, reduces surface irregularities and clods, and helps create an even seedbed suitable for sowing and subsequent crop establishment.
example_en: "The Freedom Land Leveler will smooth, pulverize and level the soil surface to create the most receptive seedbed possible." (Land Leveler Freedom 3pt Implement. Unverferth Manufacturing Co.)

definition_uz: Tuproq yuzasiga mola yordamida agrotexnik ishlov berib, uni tekislash va silliqlash, yirik kesaklarni maydalash hamda tuproq namligini saqlashga yordam beradigan tekis yuza hosil qilmoq. Molalash odatda shudgorlashdan keyin va ekish oldidan, ayrim hollarda esa ekishdan keyin amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Erta bahorda tuproqlar ekishdan oldin boronalanishi, kultivatsiya qilinishi va mola bosilib, yerni yaxshilab tekislash kerak. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: To make the soil surface even and smooth with a leveling implement as part of soil or seedbed preparation. The operation helps break down surface clods, produce a uniform soil surface, and reduce excessive moisture loss before or after sowing.
example_en: "Just before you level the soil for the last time, spread a balanced analysis fertilizer evenly over the garden area." (Vegetable Gardening for Beginners. Purdue University Extension, 2021)

definition_uz: Hayoti davomida faqat bir marta gullab, meva va urug‘ hosil qiladigan, shundan so‘ng hayot siklini tugatadigan o‘simliklar. Monokarpik o‘simliklarga bir yillik, ikki yillik hamda ayrim ko‘p yillik turlar kiradi. Ular generativ rivojlanish bosqichini bir marta o‘tab, undan keyin nobud bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha monos — "bir, yagona" va karpos — "meva" so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Monokarp o‘simliklar — bir marta meva beradigan, so‘ngra hayot faoliyatini tugatadigan o‘simliklar. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: Plants that flower, fruit, and produce seeds only once during their lifetime, after which they die. Monocarpic plants include annuals, biennials, and some perennial species that complete reproduction in a single reproductive event.
etymology_en: Greek monos ("single, one") + karpos ("fruit").
example_en: "Semelparous (also called ‘monocarpic’) plants, which pay the ultimate cost of reproduction (flowering is fatal), have provided powerful empirical models for studying selection on life-history strategies." (Evolutionary Demography of Iteroparous Plants: Incorporating Non-lethal Costs of Reproduction into Integral Projection Models, 2012)

definition_uz: Bir xil tur yoki navga mansub qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinini bir maydonda uzoq yillar davomida yoki katta hududda ketma-ket yetishtirish tizimi. Monokultura mahsulot yetishtirishni ixtisoslashtirish va mexanizatsiyalashni osonlashtiradi, biroq tuproq unumdorligining pasayishi, oziq elementlarining bir tomonlama sarflanishi, kasallik va zararkunandalarning ko‘payishi hamda biologik xilma-xillikning kamayishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha monos — "bir, yagona" va lotincha cultura — "parvarish qilish, yetishtirish".
example_uz: Monokulturada ekinlar hosili va sifatining pasayishiga dehqonchasiga tuproqning charchashi deb atash qabul qilingan. (Tuproq melioratsiyasining regional muammolari. Altmishev A.Sh., 2020)
definition_en: The agricultural practice of growing a single crop species or cultivar on the same land over a prolonged period or across a large area. Although monoculture facilitates mechanization and management, it may reduce biodiversity, deplete soil nutrients, and increase the risk of pests and diseases.
etymology_en: Greek monos ("single") + Latin cultura ("cultivation").
example_en: "Monoculture: the cultivation of a single crop in a given area—as small, medium or large fields." (Crop Diversity in Agroecosystems for Pest Management and Food Production. Lenné J., Wood D., 2024)

definition_uz: Gidroliz natijasida undan ham sodda uglevodlarga parchalanmaydigan eng oddiy uglevodlar. Monosaxaridlar murakkabroq uglevodlar — disaxaridlar, oligosaxaridlar va polisaxaridlarning asosiy tarkibiy birliklari hisoblanadi. O‘simliklarda ular energiya almashinuvi, nafas olish va boshqa organik birikmalarning hosil bo‘lishida muhim ahamiyatga ega. Keng tarqalgan monosaxaridlarga glyukoza, fruktoza va galaktoza kiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha monos — "bir, yagona" va sakcharon — "shakar" so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Monosaxaridlarning fosforli efirlari o‘simliklardagi modda almashinuvida muhim rol o‘ynaydi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: The simplest carbohydrates, consisting of single sugar units that cannot be hydrolyzed into simpler carbohydrates. Monosaccharides serve as the basic building blocks of more complex carbohydrates, including disaccharides, oligosaccharides, and polysaccharides. Common monosaccharides include glucose, fructose, and galactose.
etymology_en: From Greek monos ("single, one") + saccharide, referring to a single sugar unit.
example_en: "Monosaccharides (mono- = ‘one’; sacchar- = ‘sweet’) are simple sugars, the most common of which is glucose." (Biology 2e. Clark M.A., Choi J., Douglas M., OpenStax, 2018)

definition_uz: Rangi, tuzilishi yoki shakli turlicha bo‘lgan materiallarni umumiy tayanch asosiga joylashtirish orqali tasvir yoki bezak yaratish usuli. Manzarali bog‘dorchilik va landshaft dizaynida mozaika turli rangdagi gullar, bargli o‘simliklar yoki boshqa dekorativ elementlardan geometrik yoki badiiy kompozitsiyalar hosil qilishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha mosaïque, italyancha mosaico, lotincha (opus) musivum — "mozaika usulida ishlangan bezak".
example_uz: Har xil gul turlaridan gilamsimon mozaika ko‘rinishidagi gulzorlar barpo etish kompozitsiyasi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A decorative design or pattern created by arranging materials of different colours, shapes, or textures on a common surface. In ornamental horticulture and landscape design, mosaics are formed using flowers, foliage plants, or other decorative materials to create artistic floral displays and patterns.
etymology_en: French mosaïque, from Italian mosaico, ultimately from Late Latin (opus) musivum, meaning decorative mosaic work.
example_en: "Seasonal flowers were arranged into a colourful mosaic in the botanical garden." (RHS A–Z Encyclopedia of Garden Plants. Brickell C., 2016)

definition_uz: Mochevina (karbamid) va formaldegidning kimyoviy reaksiyasi natijasida olinadigan, sekin ta’sir etuvchi azotli mineral o‘g‘itlar. Oqartusli kukun ko‘rinishida bo‘lib, tarkibida odatda 37–40% azot, shundan 4–12% suvda eriydigan azot mavjud. Tuproqda azotning asta-sekin minerallashuvi tufayli o‘simliklar uzoq muddat azot bilan ta’minlanadi, azotning yuvilib ketishi va gaz holida yo‘qolishi kamayadi. Shu sababli bu o‘g‘itlarni nisbatan yuqori me’yorlarda mevali bog‘lar, manzarali o‘simliklar va boshqa ko‘p yillik ekinlarda qo‘llash mumkin.
example_uz: Ochiq maydondagi manzarali daraxtlar va intensiv bog‘larda mochevina-formaldegid o‘g‘itlarini bir marta qo‘llash o‘simliklarni bir vegetatsiya mavsumi davomida azot bilan bir maromda ta’minlash imkonini beradi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Slow-release nitrogen fertilizers produced by the reaction of urea and formaldehyde. They are usually white powdery materials containing about 37–40% nitrogen, including 4–12% water-soluble nitrogen. Their nitrogen is mineralized gradually in the soil, providing a long-term nitrogen supply while reducing nitrogen losses through leaching and volatilization. They are commonly used in orchards, ornamental horticulture, and other perennial crops where prolonged nitrogen availability is desirable.
example_en: “Urea-formaldehyde fertilizers offer good physical properties and slow release rates; they can promote the formation of an aggregated soil structure, improve soil permeability, and increase penetrating power into crop roots.” (Modeling and Optimizing the Synthesis of Urea-formaldehyde Fertilizers and Analyses of Factors Affecting these Processes. Guo Y., Zhang M., Liu Z., Tian X., Zhang S., Zhao C., Lu H., Scientific Reports, 8, 2018, Article 4504)

definition_uz: Tuproq yuzasini organik yoki noorganik materiallar bilan qoplash agrotexnik usuli. Mulchalash uchun somon, torf, chirindi, kompost, yog‘och qipig‘i, barg, po‘stloq, polimer plyonka va boshqa materiallardan foydalaniladi. Mulchalash tuproq namligining bug‘lanishini kamaytiradi, tuproq haroratini me’yorlashtiradi, eroziyadan himoya qiladi, begona o‘tlar o‘sishini cheklaydi hamda tuproq sharoitini yaxshilashga yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha mulch — "tuproq yuzasini qoplash uchun ishlatiladigan material" so‘zi asosida hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Daraxtlarning tanasi atrofini bir-ikki yilgacha 10–15 sm qalinlikdagi somon yoki quruq xashak bilan mulchalab turish tavsiya etiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The horticultural practice of covering the soil surface around plants with organic or inorganic materials. Organic mulches include straw, compost, wood chips, bark, leaves, and similar plant-derived materials, while inorganic mulches may include plastic film, gravel, or other non-plant materials. Mulching is used to conserve soil moisture, suppress weeds, moderate soil temperature, reduce erosion, and improve growing conditions.
etymology_en: Derived from mulch; the word is related to Middle English molsh, referring to soft or decaying material.
example_en: "Mulching is a long-established horticultural practice that involves spreading a layer of material on the ground around plants to protect their roots from heat, cold, or drought or to keep the fruit clean." (Easy Gardening: Mulching. Masabni J., Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, 2014)

definition_uz: Tuproq yuzasini yoki o‘simliklar atrofidagi tuproqni somon, barg, yog‘och qipig‘i, po‘stloq, kompost, torf, polimer plyonka kabi organik yoki noorganik materiallar bilan qoplamoq. Mulchalash tuproq namligini saqlash, begona o‘tlar o‘sishini cheklash, tuproq haroratini me’yorlashtirish, eroziyani kamaytirish va o‘simliklarning o‘sishi uchun qulay sharoit yaratish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha mulch — "tuproq yuzasini qoplash uchun ishlatiladigan material" so‘zi asosida hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Tuproqda nam saqlash maqsadida, iyun oyida terrasa oralig‘i 5–6 sm qalinlikda mulchalanadi. Mulcha sifatida shu yerda o‘sib turgan o‘tdan foydalanish mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: To cover the soil surface or the soil around the roots of plants with a layer of organic or inorganic material in order to conserve moisture, suppress weeds, moderate soil temperature, protect plant roots, and improve growing conditions.
etymology_en: From mulch; probably from dialect mulch meaning "soft", ultimately related to Old English melsc or mylsc.
example_en: "Established beds containing trees, shrubs, annuals, and perennials should be mulched as well." (Garden Mulches. University of New Hampshire Cooperative Extension, 2018)

definition_uz: Tarkibida o‘simliklar uchun zarur bo‘lgan asosiy oziq elementlaridan kamida ikkitasi — azot (N), fosfor (P) va kaliy (K) — mavjud bo‘lgan mineral o‘g‘itlar. Murakkab o‘g‘itlarga ikki oziq elementli NP, NK va PK hamda uch oziq elementli NPK o‘g‘itlar kiradi. Ular o‘simliklarni bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta oziq elementlari bilan ta’minlash imkonini beradi.
example_uz: Murakkab o‘g‘itlar: ammofos, ammofosfat, diammoniyfosfat, diammofoska, nitroammofoska va boshqa o‘g‘itlar. (Mineral o‘g‘it ishlab chiqarish nazariyasi va texnologik hisoblari. G‘afurov Q., Shamshidinov I., 2010)
definition_en: Mineral fertilizers containing a declarable amount of more than one of the three primary plant nutrients: nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. They may include two-nutrient NP, NK, or PK fertilizers and three-nutrient NPK fertilizers.
example_en: "A compound fertilizer is typically a solid product that contains multiple nutrients within each granule." (Common Fertilizers Used in Corn Production. South Dakota State University Extension, 2019)

definition_uz: Asosiy o‘qida alohida gullar o‘rniga ikkilamchi shingillar joylashadigan tarmoqlangan to‘pgul turi. Bunda asosiy o‘q va undan chiqqan yon o‘qlar shingilsimon tuzilishga ega bo‘lib, gullar ikkilamchi yoki undan yuqori tartibli o‘qlarda joylashadi.
example_uz: Olmaniki soyabonsimon, smorodinaniki oddiy shingil, tokniki murakkab shingil, nokniki qalqonsimon deyiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A compound inflorescence in which flowers are borne on secondary or higher-order racemose branches rather than directly on the main axis. It may also be referred to as a double raceme when the branching pattern consists of secondary racemes.
etymology_en: Compound + raceme; raceme derives from Latin racemus, meaning "cluster of grapes".
example_en: "An example of a compound inflorescence is the compound or double raceme present in many Leguminosae species, such as pea (Pisum sativum), Medicago truncatula or Lotus japonicus." (Floral Initiation and Inflorescence Architecture: A Comparative View. Benlloch R., Berbel A., Serrano-Mislata A., Madueño F., Annals of Botany, 2007)

definition_uz: Urug‘ tarkibidagi embrional yosh o‘simlik bo‘lib, urug‘ unishi jarayonida rivojlanib yangi o‘simlikni hosil qiladi. Murtakning asosiy qismlariga murtak ildizchasi (radikula), murtak o‘qi, urug‘palla yoki urug‘pallalar (kotiledonlar) va murtak kurtakchasi (plumula) kiradi. Murtak o‘qida urug‘pallalardan pastdagi qism gipokotil, ulardan yuqoridagi qism esa epikotil deb ataladi.
example_uz: Murakkab zaxira moddalar fermentativ jarayonlar natijasida murtak oson o‘zlashtira oladigan holatga keladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The young developing plant contained within a seed. A typical seed embryo comprises an embryonic axis with a radicle and plumule, one or more cotyledons, and regions of the embryonic axis such as the hypocotyl and epicotyl.
etymology_en: From Greek embryon, meaning "young one" or "that which grows within".
example_en: A seed constitutes three basic parts: the embryo, food storage tissues, and seed coats. (Multi-Institutional Distance Learning Course on the Ex Situ Conservation of Plant Genetic Resources. CGIAR, 2007)

definition_uz: O‘ziga xos kuchli xushbo‘y, gulli va muskat aromasiga ega bo‘lgan uzum navlari guruhi. Muskat navlarining xarakterli hidi mevalarda monoterpenlarning, jumladan linalool, geraniol va nerol kabi aromatik birikmalarning nisbatan yuqori miqdorda mavjudligi bilan bog‘liq. Muskat guruhiga mansub uzumlar yangi iste’mol qilish va vino ishlab chiqarishda keng foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha muscat so‘zi italyancha moscato orqali lotincha muscus — "mushk" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, nom uzumlarning o‘ziga xos xushbo‘y hidiga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: O‘rtacha o‘suvchi Pushti Muskat, Saperavi va Aleatiko vinobop uzum navlarida kurtaklar soni 150–180 tagacha bo‘lganda, hosildorlik yuqori va mahsulot sifati yaxshi bo‘ladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari, Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: A group of grape varieties characterized by a distinctive sweet, floral and muscat aroma associated particularly with relatively high concentrations of monoterpenoids such as linalool, geraniol and nerol. Muscat grapes are used for fresh consumption and the production of aromatic wines.
etymology_en: From French muscat, from Italian moscato, ultimately related to Latin muscus ("musk"), referring to the characteristic musky fragrance of the grapes.
example_en: "Muscat vines are thought to be one of the oldest domesticated grapevines (Vitis vinifera L.) and they are now widely distributed all over the world." (A candidate gene association study on muscat flavor in grapevine (Vitis vinifera L.). Emanuelli F. et al., BMC Plant Biology, 2010)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt yoki buta. Barglari oddiy, gullari oq va odatda yakka joylashadi. Mevasi yumaloq yoki noksimon bo‘lib, yetilganda dastlab qattiq va taxir bo‘ladi; saqlash va yumshash jarayonidan keyin eti jigarrang tusga kirib, yumshoq va iste’molga yaroqli holga keladi. Mushmula qadimdan mevali ekin sifatida yetishtiriladi va manzarali ahamiyatga ham ega.
etymology_uz: Mespilus nomi lotincha mespilus orqali qadimgi yunoncha mespilon — "mushmula" so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Bu turkumda ikkita oddiy mushmula (Mespilus germanica L.) va yaponiya mushmulasi (Mespilus japonica L.) turlari va bir necha duragay shakllari bor. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree or shrub of the family Rosaceae, traditionally known as Mespilus germanica L. Its fruit is generally subglobose or pyriform and is hard and astringent at harvest. During postharvest softening or bletting, the flesh becomes brown, soft, sweeter, and suitable for consumption.
etymology_en: The English name medlar derives through Old French from Latin mespilum or mespilus, ultimately from Greek mespilon.
example_en: "Mespilus germanica L., commonly known as medlar, is one of two species of the Rosaceae family." (Phytochemistry, nutritional composition, health benefits and future prospects of Mespilus germanica L. (Medlar): A review. Nistor D.I., Marc R.A., Mureșan C.C., 2024)

definition_uz: Muhit, modda yoki material tarkibidagi suv miqdorini ifodalovchi tushuncha. Bog‘dorchilikda namlik, ayniqsa, tuproq va o‘simliklarning suv bilan ta’minlanishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, urug‘larning unishi, o‘simliklarning o‘sishi, oziq moddalarni o‘zlashtirishi, transpiratsiyasi va hosil shakllanishiga ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. Namlikning yetishmasligi suv tanqisligiga, ortiqchaligi esa tuproqning haddan tashqari namlanishi va ildiz zonasida noqulay sharoit yuzaga kelishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Tuproqdagi yetarli namlik mevali daraxtlarning normal o‘sishi va mo‘l hosil berishini ta’minlaydi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Water present in a substance, material, soil, or environment. In horticulture, adequate moisture is essential for seed germination, nutrient uptake, plant growth, transpiration, and crop development. Both insufficient and excessive moisture can adversely affect plant growth and yield.
etymology_en: From moist + -ure; moist ultimately derives through Old French from Latin musteus, meaning "fresh" or "new".
example_en: "Consistent soil moisture is critical to ensuring high yields and preventing physiological problems in fruit and vegetable crops." (Irrigation Strategies for Vegetables. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Namozshomguldoshlar (Nyctaginaceae) oilasiga mansub tuganaksimon ildizli ko‘p yillik manzarali o‘simlik bo‘lib, sovuq iqlimli hududlarda ko‘pincha bir yillik sifatida yetishtiriladi. Xushbo‘y gullari odatda kunning ikkinchi yarmida yoki kechqurun ochiladi. Gullari pushti, qizil, sariq, oq va boshqa ranglarda, ba’zan ola yoki yo‘l-yo‘l bo‘lishi mumkin. Gulzorlar, bordyurlar va boshqa manzarali ekinzorlarda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Quyida namozshomgul o‘simligining ikki irsiy formasini chatishtirish natijalari ko‘rsatilgan. Ulardan birining gullari qizil, ikkinchisiniki – oq. Birinchi avlod duragaylarining hammasi pushti gulli, ya’ni oraliq xarakterda bo‘ladi. (Biologiya. Zikiryayev A., To‘xtayev A., Azimov I., Sonin N., 2019)
definition_en: A tuberous-rooted perennial ornamental plant of the family Nyctaginaceae, often grown as an annual in colder climates. Its fragrant flowers typically open in the late afternoon or evening and occur in a range of colours, including pink, red, yellow, and white, sometimes with mottled or striped patterns.
etymology_en: The common name four-o'clock refers to the tendency of the flowers to open in the late afternoon.
example_en: "Five serine proteinase inhibitors (Mirabilis jalapa trypsin inhibitors, MJTI I and II and Spinacia oleracea trypsin inhibitors, SOTI I, II, and III) from the garden four-o'clock (M. jalapa) and spinach (S. oleracea) seeds were isolated." (Trypsin inhibitors from the garden four o'clock (Mirabilis jalapa) and spinach (Spinacia oleracea) seeds: isolation, characterization and chemical synthesis. Kowalska J. et al., Phytochemistry, 2007)

definition_uz: Chuchmomadoshlar (Amaryllidaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik piyozboshli manzarali o‘simliklar turkumi. Barglari odatda tasmasimon yoki chiziqsimon bo‘lib, gullari yakka yoki to‘pgulda joylashadi va o‘ziga xos kosacha yoki karnaysimon tojga ega. Gullari oq, sariq, to‘q sariq yoki turli ranglar uyg‘unligida bo‘lishi mumkin. Nargislar gulzorlar, bordyurlar, park va bog‘larni bezashda, shuningdek, kesma gul sifatida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha Narkissos — yunon mifologiyasidagi Narkissos nomi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: O‘rta mintaqada usti yopilgan holda qishlaydigan gul o‘simliklariga Genri va Regale liliyalari, gortenziya hamda ayrim nargis turlari kiradi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A genus of perennial bulbous flowering plants in the family Amaryllidaceae. Narcissus plants have linear leaves and leafless flowering stems bearing solitary or clustered flowers with six spreading perianth segments and a characteristic cup- or trumpet-shaped corona. They are widely cultivated as ornamental garden plants and cut flowers.
etymology_en: From Latin Narcissus, from Greek Narkissos, the name associated with the mythological figure Narcissus.
example_en: "While narcissus, tulip and hyacinth dominate the Dutch bulb market there are a number of ‘minor bulb’ species that deserve our consideration." (Minor Bulbs for Early Spring Color. Trinklein D., University of Missouri Extension, 2010)

definition_uz: Ota-ona organizmlardan ko‘payish natijasida hosil bo‘lgan va ularning irsiy belgilarini davom ettiruvchi avlod. O‘simliklar seleksiyasi va genetikasida nasl chatishtirish yoki boshqa jinsiy ko‘payish jarayonlari natijasida olingan o‘simliklar majmuini anglatadi hamda irsiy belgilar, hosildorlik, sifat, kasalliklarga chidamlilik va boshqa seleksion xususiyatlarni baholashda muhim obyekt hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha nasl — "avlod, zurriyot".
example_uz: Yovvoyi holda o‘sadigan meva daraxtlari o‘z xususiyatlarini duragay nasliga yaxshi o‘tkazadi va shuning uchun madaniy o‘simliklarning yangi turlari hamda navlarini yaratishda qimmatli manba bo‘lib xizmat qilishi mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The offspring or descendants produced from parent plants, particularly through sexual reproduction. In plant breeding and genetics, progeny are evaluated to determine the inheritance and expression of genetic traits and to identify individuals with desirable characteristics.
etymology_en: From Latin progenies — "offspring, descendants", from progignere — "to beget, bring forth".
example_en: "Alternatively, EBV of an individual/seedling can be obtained from the performance of its progeny." (Turbocharging introgression breeding of perennial fruit crops: a case study on apple. Kumar S. et al., Horticulture Research, 2020)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta yoki kichik daraxt. Bahorda xushbo‘y gullardan tashkil topgan yirik ro‘vaksimon to‘pgullar hosil qiladi. Gullari oq, pushti, binafsha, lavanda va boshqa ranglarda bo‘lishi mumkin. Nastarin bog‘lar, parklar, xiyobonlar va boshqa ko‘kalamzor hududlarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida keng yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Hududlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda manzarali gullaydigan spireya, shilvi, jasmin, nastarin, deysiya, gullari bejirim yulg‘un, forsitiya, sariq akatsiya kabi ko‘plab butalardan foydalanilmoqda. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A deciduous ornamental shrub or small tree of the family Oleaceae, valued for its highly fragrant flowers borne in large panicles in spring. Numerous cultivars are grown with flowers in shades of white, cream, pink, lilac, lavender, magenta, and purple. It is widely cultivated in gardens and landscapes.
etymology_en: The English word lilac derives through French lilac from Arabic līlak, ultimately from Persian nīlak, referring to a bluish or lilac colour.
example_en: "Easily recognized by their sweet fragrance and cone-shaped clusters of tiny flowers, the common lilac (Syringa vulgaris) has been a part of America’s gardens for much of our country’s history." (For the Love of Lilacs. Benoit D.J., University of Vermont Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Natriy nitratdan (NaNO₃) iborat azotli mineral o‘g‘it. Nitrat kislotaning natriyli tuzi bo‘lib, suvda yaxshi eriydigan kristall modda hisoblanadi. Tarkibida taxminan 16% azot mavjud bo‘lib, azot nitrat shaklida bo‘lgani sababli o‘simliklar tomonidan bevosita o‘zlashtirilishi mumkin. Natriyli selitra fiziologik ishqoriy azotli o‘g‘it hisoblanadi va natriyga ijobiy javob beradigan ekinlarni oziqlantirishda qo‘llanishi mumkin.
example_uz: Natriy nitrat (natriyli selitra) — NaNO₃ — tarkibida 15–16% oziqa elementi bo‘lgan, suvda yaxshi eriydigan azotli o‘g‘it. (Kimyo, 8-sinf. Asqarov I.R., G‘opirov K., To‘xtaboyev N.X.)
definition_en: An inorganic nitrate salt of sodium with the chemical formula NaNO₃, used as a nitrogen fertilizer. It is a highly water-soluble crystalline substance containing approximately 16% nitrogen in nitrate form, which is readily available for plant uptake.
example_en: "Sodium nitrate fertilizer can be dissolved and applied as an aqueous solution, broadcast, drilled, or used as a sidedress." (Supplemental Technical Report: Sodium Nitrate — Crop Production. USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, 2011)
synonyms_en: Chile saltpeter; Soda niter; Nitrate of soda

definition_uz: Muayyan belgi yoki belgilar majmuasi uchun tanlangan, shu belgilariga ko‘ra boshqa o‘simliklardan aniq farqlanadigan, bir xil va barqaror bo‘lgan hamda tegishli usulda ko‘paytirilganda o‘ziga xos xususiyatlarini saqlaydigan madaniy o‘simliklar guruhi. O‘simliklar seleksiyasi va navshunoslikda navlar hosildorlik, mahsulot sifati, morfologik va biologik xususiyatlari, kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamliligi hamda muayyan muhit sharoitlariga moslashuvchanligi kabi belgilariga ko‘ra tavsiflanadi.
example_uz: Sitrus mevalarda urug‘lar miqdori har xil bo‘ladi. Ayrim navlari urug‘siz, boshqa navlari esa juda serurug‘ bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A group of cultivated plants selected for a particular character or combination of characters, clearly distinguishable from other plants by those characteristics, uniform and stable, and capable of retaining its distinctive characteristics when propagated by appropriate means. In plant breeding and cultivar science, cultivars are characterized by traits such as yield, product quality, morphological and biological characteristics, resistance to diseases and pests, and adaptation to particular environmental conditions.
etymology_en: A contraction of cultivated variety; the term cultivar was introduced in the twentieth century to designate cultivated plant varieties.
example_en: A cultivar is an assemblage of plants that has been selected for a particular attribute or combination of attributes and that is clearly distinct, uniform, and stable in these characteristics and that retains those characteristics when propagated. (Virginia Cooperative Extension Gardener Handbook. Virginia Tech)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Ishlab chiqarishda foydalanib kelinayotgan eski navlarni hosildorligi, mahsulot sifati va boshqa qimmatli xo‘jalik belgilari bo‘yicha ustun bo‘lgan yangi navlar bilan almashtirish jarayoni. Yangi navlar nav sinovlari natijalariga ko‘ra hosildorligi, mahsulot sifati, mexanizatsiyalashgan ishlov va yig‘im-terimga mosligi, noqulay muhit sharoitlari, kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamliligi kabi ko‘rsatkichlar bo‘yicha mavjud navlardan ustun bo‘lganda ishlab chiqarishga joriy etiladi.
example_uz: Nav almashtirish deb, biror ekinning foydalanib kelinayotgan eski navlarini serhosil va mahsulotining texnologik sifatlari ancha yaxshi bo‘lgan, yangi mahalliylashtirilgan navlar bilan almashtirishga aytiladi. (G‘o‘za genetikasi, seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2024)
definition_en: The process of replacing older cultivars used in production with newer cultivars that have superior yield, product quality, or other desirable agronomic and horticultural characteristics. Cultivar replacement may involve the introduction of cultivars with improved adaptation to environmental conditions and greater resistance to diseases and pests.
example_en: Cultivar replacement programs in horticulture orchards that substitute older varieties for more heat- and drought-resilient varieties have enterprise values that are highly sensitive to the timing of such investments. (West J., Agricultural Systems, 2018)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Muayyan navga mansub yoki seleksiya yo‘li bilan yaratilgan va nav belgilari barqaror saqlanadigan madaniy o‘simlikka oid. Navli sifati o‘simlik, urug‘, ko‘chat yoki hosilning ma’lum bir navga tegishli ekanligini bildiradi.
example_uz: Sof navli ko‘chatlar ekilishiga alohida e’tibor beriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Relating to or characteristic of a particular cultivated variety or cultivar. The term may describe plants, seeds, planting material, or produce associated with a defined cultivar.
example_en: "Sowing certified varietal seeds ensures crop uniformity and high resistance against prevailing environmental stressors." (Journal of Seed Science)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Navning haqiqiyligi, nav tozaligi hamda belgilangan xususiyatlarining saqlanishini tekshirish va nazorat qilishga qaratilgan tadbirlar majmui. Nav nazorati urug‘ va ko‘paytirish materialining muayyan navga muvofiqligini aniqlash, navga xos bo‘lmagan o‘simliklarni aniqlash hamda navning belgilangan xususiyatlarini ko‘paytirish jarayonida saqlash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi. Bunda dala inspeksiyasi, nazorat maydonlarida sinash va laboratoriya usullaridan foydalanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Nav nazoratini o‘tkazish tartibi quyidagi jarayonlarni o‘z ichiga oladi: ekish uchun mo‘ljallangan urug‘liklarni yig‘ish yoki chet eldan olib kelish; laboratoriya tahlillarini o‘tkazish; ekishgacha saqlash; ekish; o‘rmon xo‘jaligi ekinlari vegetatsiyasi davrida parvarishlash. (O‘rmon xo‘jaligi ekinlari urug‘liklarining genetik (nav) va urug‘ nazoratini amalga oshirishga doir Qoidalar. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi O‘rmon xo‘jaligi davlat qo‘mitasi, 2019)
definition_en: The control procedures used to verify varietal identity and purity and to ensure that the characteristic properties of a variety are maintained during propagation. Variety control may involve field inspection, control plot testing, laboratory varietal control, and comparison of plant or seed material with a standard sample or the official variety description.
example_en: "The study found that plot (soil) variety control is a mandatory component of the seed certification system, which ensures confirmation of varietal purity and detection of inconsistencies at the stages of production, storage and sale." (Plot (soil) variety control as part of the varietal quality confirmation of soft wheat seed. Zakharchuk O.V., Hryniv S.M., Tahantsova M.M., Kurochka N.V., 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Nav sinovlari natijalariga asoslanib, muayyan o‘simlik navining biologik xususiyatlari, hosildorligi, mahsulot sifati hamda mahalliy tuproq-iqlim sharoitlariga moslashuvchanligini hisobga olgan holda uni ma’lum hududlarda yetishtirish uchun tavsiya etish jarayoni. Navni rayonlashtirish muayyan hudud sharoitiga yaxshi moslashgan navlardan samarali foydalanish va barqaror hosil olish imkonini beradi.
example_uz: Bu kengash keyingi yilda navlarni rayonlashtirish loyihasini ishlab chiqadi va eski navlarni ishlab chiqarishdan olib tashlash to‘g‘risida taklif tayyorlab Respublika Davlat nav sinash komissiyasiga kiritadi (yuboriladi). (Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2005)
definition_en: The process of determining and recommending suitable geographical regions for the cultivation of a plant variety on the basis of its adaptation and performance under particular environmental conditions. Variety regionalization takes into account climatic and other environmental factors in order to identify areas in which particular varieties are best suited for cultivation.
example_en: "An additional element of the variety testing system is phenotyping for variety regionalization." (Towards recommendations for metadata and data handling in plant phenotyping. Krajewski P. et al., Journal of Experimental Botany, 2015)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Yangi yaratilgan yoki joriy etilayotgan o‘simlik navlarining hosildorligi, mahsulot sifati, biologik va xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilari, kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamliligi hamda muayyan tuproq-iqlim sharoitlariga mosligini baholash maqsadida o‘tkaziladigan ilmiy-amaliy sinovlar majmui. Nav sinash natijalari navlarni tanlash, rasmiy ro‘yxatga kiritish va muayyan hududlarda yetishtirish uchun tavsiya etishda asos bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Standart navga nisbatan yuqori ko‘rsatkichga ega bo‘lgan ekinlarning urug‘i nav sinashga beriladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2005)
definition_en: The systematic testing of new or existing plant varieties to evaluate their yield, product quality, biological and agronomically valuable characteristics, resistance to diseases and pests, and adaptation to particular soil and climatic conditions. The results of variety testing may be used for variety selection, official listing, and recommendation for cultivation in particular regions.
example_en: "Plant science researchers at Texas A&M University conduct crop variety testing trials to determine which varieties of that crop have higher yields or are more drought tolerant, heat tolerant, disease resistant, or display some other desirable characteristics." (Variety Testing. Texas A&M AgriLife Research, Texas A&M University)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Xalq seleksiyasi yo‘li bilan yetishtirilgan nok navlari guruhi. O‘zbekistonda qadimdan ekib kelinadi. Qishki Nashvati, kuzgi oq Nashvati, chillaki Nashvati va yozgi Nashvati kabi navlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Daraxti odatda 4–6-yili hosilga kiradi. Mevalari naviga qarab iyun oxiridan oktabr boshigacha pishadi, sersuv va nordon-shirin bo‘lib, kechpishar navlari uzoq muddat saqlanishi mumkin.
example_uz: Nokning 60 ga yaqin yovvoyi turi uchraydi. Shulardan mevachilikda jaydari nok, O‘rta Osiyo noki, Turkman noki, Ussuri noki, nashvati noki, tol bargli nok va Regel noki kabi turlar muhim ahamiyatga ega. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A group of pear cultivars developed through traditional folk selection and cultivated in Uzbekistan since ancient times. The group includes winter, autumn and summer-ripening Nashvati cultivars. The trees generally begin bearing fruit 4–6 years after planting. Depending on the cultivar, the fruits ripen from late June to early October and are juicy and sweet-tart; late-ripening cultivars can be stored for an extended period.
example_en: Zimnay (Nashvati-2) is listed among selected pear cultivars of Uzbekistan. (The Schroeder Institute in Uzbekistan: Breeding and Germplasm Collections. Mirzaev M.M. et al., 2004)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Rosa turkumiga mansub yovvoyi yoki yarim madaniy tikanli butalarning umumiy nomi. Gullari oq, pushti yoki qizg‘ish ranglarda bo‘ladi. Soxta mevalari — na’matak mevalari — C vitamini va boshqa biologik faol moddalarga boy. Na’matak turlari oziq-ovqat, dorivor va manzarali maqsadlarda, ayrim turlari esa madaniy atirgullar uchun payvandtag sifatida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Na’matak O‘zbekistonning tog‘ yonbag‘irlari va tog‘li hududlarida keng tarqalgan bo‘lib, balandligi 1–2 m gacha yetadigan tikanli buta holida o‘sadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A general term for wild or semi-wild shrubs of the genus Rosa in the family Rosaceae. Their accessory fruits, known as rose hips, are rich in vitamin C and other bioactive compounds. Wild roses are used for food, medicinal and ornamental purposes, and some species are also used as rootstocks for cultivated roses.
example_en: Rose hips from different Rosa species contain vitamin C and other antioxidant compounds. (Chemical composition of rosehips from different Rosa species: an alternative source of antioxidants for the food industry. Jiménez S. et al., 2017)

definition_uz: Gul yoki boshqa o‘simlik organlaridagi nektar bezlari tomonidan ajratiladigan shirin suyuqlik. Asosan suv va shakarlar (saxaroza, glyukoza va fruktoza), shuningdek, kam miqdorda aminokislotalar va boshqa organik moddalarni saqlaydi. Gul nektari changlatuvchilarni jalb qilib, changlanishga yordam beradi hamda asalarilar uchun asal hosil qilishning asosiy manbalaridan biri hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha néktar (νέκταρ) — "xudolar ichimligi".
example_uz: Havo quruq bo‘lganda guldagi nektar (gulasal) yaxshi ajralmaydi va asalarilar gullarga kam uchib keladi. Natijada o‘simliklar yaxshi changlanmasligi mumkin. (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi. Ribakov A.A., Ostrauxova S.A., 1981)
definition_en: A sweet liquid secreted by floral or extrafloral nectaries. It consists mainly of water and sugars, particularly sucrose, glucose and fructose, and may also contain amino acids and other organic compounds. Floral nectar attracts pollinators and is an important source used by honeybees in the production of honey.
etymology_en: From Latin nectar, from Greek néktar, meaning "drink of the gods".
example_en: Nectar serves as an important floral reward for pollinators and contains carbohydrates, amino acids, and organic acids. (Floral attractants and rewards to pollinators in Mangifera indica L., 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning gul qismlarida yoki guldan tashqari vegetativ organlarida joylashgan, nektar hosil qilib ajratuvchi maxsus bezli to‘qima yoki tuzilma. Gul nektarniklari changlatuvchilarni jalb etib, changlanishga yordam beradi, guldan tashqari nektarniklar esa ko‘pincha o‘simlikning boshqa hayvonlar bilan ekologik munosabatlarida ishtirok etadi.
example_uz: Ba’zan tok navlarida qat-qat yaproqli gullar ham uchraydi. Bunday gullar urug‘chi, changchi va nektarniklarning gulbarglarga aylanishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari, Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: A specialized gland, tissue, or structure that produces and secretes nectar. Nectaries may occur within flowers or on vegetative organs. Floral nectaries commonly function in attracting pollinators, whereas extrafloral nectaries are often involved in other plant-animal interactions.
etymology_en: Nectary derives from New Latin nectarium, formed from Latin nectar and the suffix -arium.
example_en: The floral nectary of Borago officinalis was investigated in relation to its ultrastructure, development, and nectar production. (Ultrastructure and development of the floral nectary from Borago officinalis L. and phytochemical changes in its secretion, 2024)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub shaftolining tuksiz, silliq po‘stli meva hosil qiluvchi madaniy shakli. Nektarin shaftoli bilan bir turga — Prunus persica (L.) Batschga mansub bo‘lib, undan asosan meva po‘stida tuklarning yo‘qligi bilan farqlanadi. Mevalari naviga qarab oq yoki sariq etli, danagi etidan oson ajraladigan yoki ajralmaydigan bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Nektarin nomi nektar so‘zi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, mevaning shirinligiga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: Nektarin oddiy shaftolidan ko‘ra ko‘proq kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamli. (Shaftoli danak mag‘zi tarkibidagi elementlar tahlili. Dehqonov R.S., Muminova M.R., International Journal of Advanced Technology and Natural Sciences, 2022)
definition_en: A smooth-skinned cultivated form of peach (Prunus persica) in the family Rosaceae. Nectarines belong to the same species as peaches and are distinguished primarily by the absence of trichomes on the fruit skin. Depending on the cultivar, the flesh may be white or yellow and the stone may be clingstone or freestone.
etymology_en: From an earlier adjective nectarine, meaning "of or like nectar", ultimately derived from nectar.
example_en: Nectarine fruits have a smooth skin because of the lack of trichomes and show subtle differences in flavour and size compared with fuzzy peaches. (Evaluation of the Fruit Quality and Phytochemical Compounds in Peach and Nectarine Cultivars, 2023)

definition_uz: Nektarinning (Prunus persica) tuksiz va silliq po‘stli danakli mevasi. Shaftoli mevasiga juda yaqin bo‘lib, undan asosan po‘stida tukchalarning bo‘lmasligi bilan farqlanadi. Meva po‘sti turli darajada qizil, sariq yoki boshqa tuslarda, eti esa naviga qarab oq yoki sariq bo‘lishi mumkin. Mevasi shirali va xushbo‘y bo‘lib, tarkibida shakarlar, organik kislotalar, vitaminlar, karotinoidlar va fenolik birikmalar mavjud. Yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda turli qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Nektarin nomi nektar so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Quyosh nurlarining to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri mevalarga tushishi olma, nok, shaftoli, nektarin va o‘rik mevalarida qizil pigmentlarning hosil bo‘lishi uchun juda zarurdir. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The smooth, hairless stone fruit of the nectarine, a cultivated form of Prunus persica. It differs from a typical peach primarily in the absence of trichomes on the fruit skin. Depending on the cultivar, the flesh may be white or yellow, while the skin varies in coloration. Nectarine fruits contain sugars, organic acids, vitamin C, carotenoids, phenolic compounds, and other constituents that contribute to their nutritional and sensory qualities.
etymology_en: The name nectarine is associated with nectar, ultimately from Greek nektar.
example_en: Nectarines are climacteric stone fruits with a lignified endocarp enclosing the seed, a fleshy mesocarp, and a thin epicarp, and their skin lacks trichomes. (Metabolite Profiling Reveals the Effect of Cold Storage on Primary Metabolism in Nectarine Varieties with Contrasting Mealiness, 2023)

definition_uz: Urug‘ning unishi natijasida murtakdan rivojlanadigan yosh o‘simlik. Nihol rivojlanishining dastlabki bosqichida murtak ildizcha o‘sib chiqib birlamchi ildizni hosil qiladi, keyinchalik poya, urug‘pallalar va haqiqiy barglar rivojlanadi. O‘sish davomida nihol urug‘dagi oziqa zaxiralariga bog‘liqlikdan asta-sekin fotosintez orqali mustaqil oziqlanishga o‘tadi.
etymology_uz: Forscha nihāl — "yosh daraxt, yangi o‘stirilgan o‘simlik" ma’nosidagi so‘zdan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Urug‘dan ko‘paytirilgan nihollarga asosiy standart olma daraxtlaridan qalamcha tayyorlab kurtak payvand qilinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A young plant that develops from a seed following germination. During early seedling development, the embryonic root develops into the primary root, while the shoot and leaves subsequently develop. As the seed reserves are depleted and true leaves develop, the young plant becomes increasingly dependent on photosynthesis for its growth.
example_en: "Apple and pear seedlings get off to a slower start, and should be dug and whip grafted the winter following seeding, or budded in the original row during July of the second year." (Propagating Deciduous Fruit Plants Common to Georgia. University of Georgia Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: Azoti asosan nitrat (NO₃⁻) shaklida bo‘lgan mineral azotli o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Ular suvda yaxshi eriydi va tarkibidagi nitrat azoti o‘simliklar tomonidan bevosita o‘zlashtirilishi mumkin. Nitrat ioni tuproqda harakatchan bo‘lgani sababli, ayniqsa ortiqcha sug‘orish yoki yog‘ingarchilik sharoitida yuvilib ketish xavfi yuqori. Bu guruhga natriyli selitra, kalsiyli selitra va kaliyli selitra kabi o‘g‘itlar kiradi.
example_uz: Dukkakli ekinlar, aksincha, tuproqda azot to‘playdi va ular haydab yuborilgandan (shudgorlangandan) keyin meva daraxtlari nitratli azot bilan ta’minlanadi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A group of mineral nitrogen fertilizers in which nitrogen is supplied primarily in nitrate (NO₃⁻) form. They are generally highly water-soluble and provide nitrogen that is readily available for plant uptake. Because nitrate is highly mobile in soil, it is susceptible to leaching, particularly when water movement through the soil is high. Examples include sodium nitrate, calcium nitrate, and potassium nitrate.
example_en: Nitrate fertilizers contain nitrogen in the form of NO₃⁻, and nitrate ions are readily lost by leaching because of their high mobility in soil. (Nutrient Management: Fertilizers. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University)

definition_uz: Urug‘dan endigina unib chiqayotgan o‘simlik yoki yorilib, o‘sa boshlagan kurtakning ko‘rinib turgan yosh qismi. Nish o‘simlik o‘sishining dastlabki bosqichini ifodalaydi va urug‘ning unishi yoki kurtakning uyg‘onishi natijasida paydo bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Nish urgan kurtaklar bahorda daraxtning po‘stlog‘i tanasidan ko‘chadigan vaqtda payvand qilinadi. (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi. Ribakov A.A., Ostrauxova S.A., 1981)
definition_en: A newly emerging plant part produced during seed germination or bud break. Depending on the context, Uzbek nish may refer to a young sprout emerging from a germinating seed or to a new shoot beginning to emerge from a breaking bud.
example_en: After the green tip extends further, the new shoot emerges from the bud, indicating the beginning of active growth for the season. (Growth and Development Stages of Four Japanese Persimmon Varieties in North Florida. Iqbal S., Shahid M., UF/IFAS Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Pyrus turkumiga mansub mevali daraxt va butalarning umumiy nomi. Madaniy noklar muhim urug‘li meva ekinlari bo‘lib, daraxtining o‘sish kuchi payvandtag, nav va parvarish sharoitiga qarab farqlanadi. Gullari odatda oq, ba’zan pushti tusli; mevalari esa tur va naviga qarab shakli, rangi, o‘lchami, ta’mi va pishish muddati jihatidan xilma-xil bo‘ladi. Nok asosan mo‘tadil iqlimli hududlarda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Nok uchun yovvoyi o‘rmon nokidan tashqari madaniy noklarning urug‘idan chiqqan niholchalardan foydalaniladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A common name for fruit trees and shrubs belonging to the genus Pyrus in the family Rosaceae. Cultivated pears are important pome fruit crops, particularly in temperate regions. Their fruits vary widely among species and cultivars in shape, size, colour, texture, flavour, and season of maturity.
etymology_en: From Middle English pere, from Old English pere or peru, ultimately related to Latin pirum, meaning "pear".
example_en: Pear trees require adequate sunlight to produce high-quality fruit and should be trained and pruned to develop a strong framework. (Growing Pears in the Home Garden. University of Minnesota Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: Nok (Pyrus) turlarining iste’mol qilinadigan shirali urug‘li mevasi. Botanika jihatidan pome tipidagi soxta meva bo‘lib, naviga qarab yumaloq, cho‘ziq yoki noksimon shaklda, po‘sti esa yashil, sariq, qizg‘ish yoki qo‘ng‘ir tusda bo‘lishi mumkin. Eti odatda sershira, shirin yoki nordon-shirin ta’mli. Nok mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek qoqi, sharbat, murabbo va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Urug‘li mevalilarga olma, nok, behi kabilar misol bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible pome fruit produced by trees of the genus Pyrus. Pear fruits vary among species and cultivars in shape, size, skin colour, texture, and flavour. They typically have juicy flesh and are consumed fresh or processed into dried products, juice, preserves, and other foods.
etymology_en: Pear derives from Middle English pere, from Old English pere or peru, ultimately related to Latin pirum, meaning "pear".
example_en: Pears are typically consumed fresh, but they can also be canned, dried, or processed into products such as juice. (Pear Production. Penn State Extension)

definition_uz: Nok daraxtlari (Pyrus spp.) ekilgan mevali bog‘ yoki plantatsiya. Nokzor meva yetishtirish maqsadida barpo etilib, unda nokning bir yoki bir necha navi o‘stiriladi. Bunday bog‘larda sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, butash, shakl berish va o‘simliklarni himoya qilish kabi agrotexnik tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda akademik R.R. Shreder past bo‘yli payvandtaglarga ulangan ko‘chatlardan tashkil topgan bog‘larni ko‘paytirish tashabbuskori bo‘lgan. U 1909-yilda Toshkent atrofi hududida ikki gektar yerda sekin o‘suvchi olma va nokzor barpo etgan. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: An orchard planted with pear trees (Pyrus spp.) for commercial or domestic fruit production. A pear orchard may contain one or multiple cultivars and requires appropriate irrigation, fertilization, pruning, training, and plant protection.
example_en: The sensor network was designed, hydrologically, and agronomically validated in a commercial pear orchard during four growing seasons (2019–2022). (Design and validation of a soil moisture-based wireless sensors network for the smart irrigation of a pear orchard. Hamouda F. et al., 2024)

definition_uz: Nordon ta’mga ega bo‘lgan meva, sabzavot yoki boshqa o‘simlik mahsulotiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Nordon ta’m asosan mahsulot tarkibidagi organik kislotalar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, bog‘dorchilikda meva va boshqa mahsulotlarning ta’m xususiyatini tavsiflashda ishlatiladi.
example_uz: Muddatidan ilgari uzilgan mevalar nordon, shirasiz, rangi xunuk va tez zaharlanadigan bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Having a sharp, acidic taste. In horticulture and fruit quality assessment, sour describes a sensory characteristic associated primarily with the presence and concentration of organic acids in fruits and other plant products.
etymology_en: From Old English sūr, meaning "sour, tart, or acid in taste".
example_en: Apples that are not mature will taste sour and have a coarse texture. (Cultural Tips for Growing Apple. University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources, UC IPM)

definition_uz: O‘simlik poyasining barglar va kurtaklar joylashgan, odatda faol o‘sayotgan yosh qismi. Novda bo‘g‘im va bo‘g‘im oraliqlaridan tashkil topadi hamda vegetativ yoki generativ organlarni hosil qilishi mumkin. Bog‘dorchilikda novdalar yoshi, joylashishi, o‘sish kuchi va hosil berish xususiyatiga ko‘ra farqlanadi hamda butash va shakl berishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Tokning ustki qismi — tana va uning har xil yoshdagi novdalari hamda bir yillik novdalaridan iborat bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A young, actively growing stem or stem system that bears leaves and buds and may also bear flowers or fruits. In horticultural plants, shoots vary in position, vigour, age, and reproductive function and are important in pruning and training.
etymology_en: From Old English scēotan, meaning "to shoot, move quickly, or project forth".
example_en: Grape shoots are very tender when they first emerge and become more stiff as they reach about one-foot in length. (Fruit Update – May 14, 2026. Wimmer M., University of Minnesota Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Ko‘kalamzorlashtirish va landshaft kompozitsiyasida elementlar o‘rtasidagi keskin bo‘lmagan, nozik farqlar va o‘tishlarga asoslangan kompozitsion tamoyil. Rang yechimida nyuans bir-biriga yaqin ranglar, tuslar yoki tonal qiymatlarning uyg‘unlashtirilishi orqali silliq o‘tish va estetik yaxlitlik hosil qilishga xizmat qiladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha nuance — "nozik farq, tus, mayin o‘zgarish".
example_uz: Landshaft kompozitsiyalari farq qilish (kontrast) yoki nyuans tamoyili bo‘yicha shakllanadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A subtle distinction or variation in the visual qualities of a landscape composition. In planting and colour design, nuance may be expressed through slight differences in colour, tone, texture, form, or the positioning of plants, contributing to a harmonious and finely differentiated composition.
etymology_en: From French nuance, meaning "shade" or "subtle distinction", originally derived from nuer, "to shade or vary in colour".
example_en: Mind you, the smaller the scale, the more finely tuned the nuance and detail of plant selection and positioning become. (Wild-ish at Heart: Naturalistic Planting Design. The New Perennialist, 2025)

definition_uz: O‘rtapishar mahalliy uzum navi. Tupi o‘rtacha o‘sadi, uzum boshlari yirik, konussimon va tig‘iz; g‘ujumlari tuxumsimon, seret, sershira, qizil yoki pushti rangli. Iyul oxirida pisha boshlaydi va sentabr boshlarida to‘liq yetiladi. Mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda vino tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha ob — "suv" asosidan hosil bo‘lib, dastlab "suvdor, sersuv" ma’nosini bildirgan.
example_uz: Tokzorlardagi vino uchun ishlatiladigan toklar olib tashlanib, ular boshqalari bilan almashtirildi. Bu maqsad uchun ishlatiladigan toklarning qimmatbaho navlari (Baxtiyoriy, Obaki, Vasarga va boshqalar) saqlanib qolingan. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A traditional mid-season grape cultivar grown in Uzbekistan. It produces large, compact, conical clusters with oval, fleshy and juicy red or pink berries. The grapes begin to ripen in late July and reach full maturity in early September. The fruit is consumed fresh and may also be used for wine production.
etymology_en: The Uzbek name Obaki is of Persian-Tajik origin and is associated with ob, meaning "water", referring to the juicy character of the grape.
example_en: The following varieties were taken as the object of research: Bayan Shirey, Risling, Kuljinsky, Soyaki, Saperavi, Hindogni, Obaki, Buvaki, Husseini bride finger. (Physicochemical Indicators of Bekmes (Shinni) Obtained from Local Grape Varieties. Narkabulova N. et al., Agro Ilm, 2022)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Qarag‘aydoshlar (Pinaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 20–40 m gacha yetadi. Tanasi tik, po‘stlog‘i pastki qismida qalin va kulrang-qo‘ng‘ir, yuqori qismida esa sarg‘ish yoki to‘q sariq-jigarrang tusli bo‘ladi. Ignalari juft-juft joylashadi, qubbalari tuxumsimon yoki konussimon. Yog‘ochi qurilish va boshqa maqsadlarda ishlatiladi, daraxtning o‘zi esa o‘rmonchilik va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda ekiladi.
example_uz: Sovuqqa chidamli o‘simliklarga Sibir tilog‘ochi, Daur tilog‘ochi, oddiy qarag‘ay, Sibir qarag‘ayi, oddiy archa, tog‘terak, Turkiston archasi, oq qayin, chetan va xushbo‘y hidli teraklar kiradi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An evergreen coniferous tree of the family Pinaceae, typically reaching 20–40 m in height. It is characterized by needles borne in pairs, distinctive orange-brown bark on the upper trunk, and ovoid to conical cones. Scots pine is an important timber and forestry tree and is also planted for ornamental and landscape purposes.
etymology_en: Scots refers to Scotland, while pine derives from Old English pīn, ultimately from Latin pīnus, meaning "pine tree".
example_en: Scotch pine is the most widely distributed pine in the world. (Pinus sylvestris L. — Scotch Pine. USDA Forest Service, Silvics of North America)

definition_uz: Qarag‘aydoshlar (Pinaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 30–50 m gacha yetadi. Tanasi tik, shox-shabbasi konussimon, ignalari to‘rt qirrali va to‘q yashil. Qubbalari uzun, silindrsimon va osilib turadi. Yog‘ochi qurilish, mebelsozlik va qog‘oz sanoatida, daraxtning o‘zi esa o‘rmonchilik va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Shamoldan saqlash va hududni soya qilish uchun zich shox-shabbali o‘simliklar tanlanadi: kashtan, o‘tkir bargli zarang, oddiy qoraqarag‘ay, bandli eman, kam bargli jo‘ka va boshqalar. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A large evergreen conifer of the family Pinaceae. It typically reaches 30–50 m in height and has a straight trunk, a conical crown, dark-green four-sided needles, and long pendulous cones. Its timber is widely used in construction and paper production, and the species is also important in forestry and ornamental planting.
