etymology_en: Norway refers to the country name Norway, while spruce derives from an older English term associated with Prussia and Prussian commodities.
example_en: Norway spruce Picea abies is an economically important tree species in Europe, actively managed for forestry. (Risk factors for bark stripping damage on Norway spruce by red deer. Unsgård E., Wildlife Biology, 2026)

definition_uz: Sapindoshlar (Sapindaceae) oilasiga mansub, bo‘yi odatda 20–30 m gacha yetadigan barg to‘kuvchi manzarali daraxt. Barglari yirik, panjasimon murakkab, gullari oq, pushti yoki sarg‘ish belgili bo‘lib, tik to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Mevasi tikanli ko‘sak bo‘lib, ichida yirik, yaltiroq jigarrang urug‘lar mavjud. Park, xiyobon va ko‘chalarda ko‘kalamzorlashtirish uchun keng ekiladi.
example_uz: Soxta kashtan soyasevar o‘simlik. U unumdor, nam tuproqli yerlarni xohlaydi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A large deciduous ornamental tree of the family Sapindaceae. It has large palmately compound leaves, upright clusters of white flowers with coloured markings, and spiny capsules containing large, glossy brown seeds. It is widely cultivated as an ornamental tree in parks, avenues, and other urban landscapes.
example_en: The horse-chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum L.), a popular ornamental tree widely cultivated throughout Europe since the 16th century, has a very limited natural range. (Tracing back the history of introducing horse-chestnut in Europe. Walas Ł. et al., 2025)

definition_uz: Dukkakdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 20–30 m gacha yetadi. Tanasi va shoxlarida yirik, ko‘pincha tarmoqlangan tikanlar hosil qiladi. Barglari patsimon yoki ikki karra patsimon murakkab, gullari mayda va yashil tusli. Mevasi uzun, yassi yoki biroz buralgan dukkak. Qurg‘oqchilik, sho‘rlanish va shahar sharoitlariga chidamliligi tufayli ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Gledichiya tuproqning sho‘rlanishiga va qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli bo‘lib, u shamol eroziyasiga qarshi ihotazorlar barpo etish uchun ham, yashil hududlarni obodonlashtirish uchun ham keng qo‘llaniladi. (Fayzullayev U., Shaydullayeva S. “Gledichaya (tikan daraxt) o‘simligining asosiy hususiyatlari”, Agroinnovatsiya, 2025.)
synonyms_uz: Uch tikanli gleditsiya; Gleditsiya; Tikanli gleditsiya
definition_en: A deciduous tree of the family Fabaceae, generally reaching 20–30 m in height. It is characterized by large, often branched thorns, pinnate or bipinnate compound leaves, small greenish flowers, and long flattened or sometimes twisted pods. Its tolerance of drought, salinity, and urban conditions makes it useful in landscape planting.
etymology_en: The common name honey locust refers to the sweet, honey-like pulp found inside the seed pods.
example_en: It is often planted in urban situations for its finely textured compound leaves and admirable tolerance of both drought and salinity. (Honeylocust — Gleditsia triacanthos. Virginia Tech Dendrology)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta yoki kichik daraxt. Barglari oddiy, ko‘pincha yuraksimon, gullari oq, pushti, binafsha yoki to‘q binafsha ranglarda bo‘lib, xushbo‘y hid taratadi. Bahorda mo‘l gullashi tufayli bog‘lar, xiyobonlar, tirik devorlar va boshqa ko‘kalamzorlashtirish obyektlarida keng ekiladi.
etymology_uz: Siren ruscha сирень so‘zi orqali o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Keng tarqalgani oddiy siren – Syringa vulgaris 6 metr balandlikkacha o‘sib, zich shox-shabbalar hosil qiladi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S., Haydarov X.Q., Norqulov M.M., 2019)
definition_en: A deciduous ornamental shrub or small tree of the family Oleaceae, cultivated for its showy and strongly fragrant spring flowers and widely grown in gardens, hedges, parks, and landscape plantings.
etymology_en: Lilac entered English through French lilac and ultimately derives from Persian lilak.
example_en: The common lilac has been used as a garden plant since the 16th century. (Lilacs. Niemiera A.X., Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, 2010)

definition_uz: Biologik sistematikada o‘zaro qarindosh turkumlarni umumiy morfologik, genetik va evolyutsion belgilariga ko‘ra birlashtiradigan taksonomik birlik. Oila turkumdan yuqori va tartibdan quyi taksonomik pog‘onada joylashadi. Botanika nomenklaturasida ko‘pchilik oila nomlari lotincha -aceae qo‘shimchasi bilan tugaydi.
example_uz: Meva va rezavor mevalarning 50 ga yaqin oila va undan ortiq avlod turlari mavjud. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A taxonomic rank in biological classification that groups related genera. It ranks above genus and below order. In botanical nomenclature, most family names end in -aceae.
etymology_en: From Latin familia, meaning "household, family".
example_en: Theaceae is a family that includes eight accepted genera, including Camellia, Franklinia, Gordonia, Schima and Stewartia. (Plants of the World Online, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasi, Malus turkumiga mansub ko‘p yillik barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt. Bo‘yi nav, payvandtag va o‘sish sharoitiga qarab turlicha bo‘ladi. Barglari oddiy, tuxumsimon yoki ellipssimon, gullari oq yoki pushti rangli. Olma mo‘tadil mintaqalarning muhim urug‘li meva ekinlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Ertapishar olmada kurtaklarning shakllanishi kechpishar olmalarga nisbatan 15–20 kun, nok va shaftolida 5–10 kun ertaroq bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A perennial deciduous fruit tree of the genus Malus in the family Rosaceae. Cultivated apple trees vary in size according to cultivar, rootstock, and growing conditions. Apple is one of the major temperate fruit crops.
example_en: Malus domestica is commonly known as apple in English. (The Biology of Malus domestica Borkh. (Apple), Canadian Food Inspection Agency, 2013)

definition_uz: Olma daraxti (Malus domestica (Suckow) Borkh.) hosil qiladigan shirali urug‘li meva. Botanika nuqtai nazaridan pome tipidagi soxta meva bo‘lib, odatda yumaloq yoki biroz cho‘ziq shaklda, po‘sti esa naviga qarab yashil, sariq, qizil yoki aralash ranglarda bo‘ladi. Eti shirali va xushbo‘y bo‘lib, qandlar, organik kislotalar, vitaminlar, mineral moddalar va biologik faol birikmalarni saqlaydi.
example_uz: Ko‘p yillar davomida olma, nok, behi, yong‘oq, o‘rik, bodom, gilos, shaftoli kabi mevalar ustida seleksiya ishlari olib borildi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible pome produced by the apple tree (Malus domestica). Apple fruits vary in shape and colour and contain sugars, organic acids, dietary fibre, vitamins, minerals, and numerous bioactive compounds.
example_en: The optical properties of isolated cuticle and detached peel of apple fruit (Malus domestica Borkh., cv. Antonovka) have been studied. (Solovchenko A., Merzlyak M. “Optical properties and contribution of cuticle to UV protection in plants: experiments with apple fruit”, Photochemical & Photobiological Sciences, 2003, 2: 861–866.)

definition_uz: Olma mevasini kesib, tabiiy yoki sun’iy usulda quritish orqali olinadigan quritilgan meva mahsuloti. Olmaqoqi odatda olma bo‘laklari yoki halqa shaklidagi kesimlarini quritib tayyorlanadi.
example_uz: Bunday namlikdagi olma qoqi elastik, ezganda ushalib ketmaydigan bo‘ladi. (Olma mevasini quritib qoqi olish va olma qoqisi talqonidan foydali konfetlar tayyorlash texnologiyasi. Usmanova K., O‘ktamova G., Science and Education, 2025)
definition_en: An apple product obtained by removing moisture from ripe apple fruits through natural or artificial drying, typically after the fruits have been cut into segments, slices, or rings.
example_en: The dried sliced apples pre-treated with the 2% CA and 0.1% MOLEP powder water solution were acceptable to consumers with regards to colour, texture and taste. (Storage Stability and Consumer Acceptability of Dried Apple: Impact of Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate and Moringa oleifera Leaf Extract Powder, Foods, 2022, 11(7), 984)

definition_uz: Olma daraxtlari meva yetishtirish maqsadida ekilgan va parvarish qilinadigan bog‘. Olmazorda bir yoki bir necha olma navi yetishtirilishi mumkin. Bunday bog‘larda sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, butash, shakl berish, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish kabi agrotexnik tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Toshkent viloyatining Bo‘stonliq tumanida 1500 gektardan ziyodroq yovvoyi olmazorlar bo‘lib, ular dengiz sathidan 1200–1300 m balandlikda o‘sadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An orchard planted and managed with apple trees for fruit production. An apple orchard may contain one or more cultivars and is managed through practices such as irrigation, fertilization, pruning, training, and protection against pests and diseases.
example_en: An experiment was conducted to investigate the comprehensive influence of planting density, training system and fertigation level on the performance of 'Jeromine'/M.9 apple orchards at Dr. YS Parmar University of Horticulture and Forestry, Solan (India) in two consecutive years. (Optimizing apple orchard management: Investigating the impact of planting density, training systems and fertigation levels on tree growth, yield and fruit quality, 2024)

definition_uz: Olma, nok, behi, yong‘oq va boshqa ayrim mevali ekinlarning muhim zararkunandasi bo‘lgan Cydia pomonella turining o‘zbekcha nomi. Uning lichinkalari rivojlanayotgan mevalar ichiga kirib oziqlanadi va meva hamda urug‘larga zarar yetkazadi. Zararlangan mevalarning sifati pasayadi va ular barvaqt to‘kilishi mumkin. Zararkunandaga qarshi monitoring, agrotexnik, biologik va kimyoviy usullarni uyg‘unlashtirgan kurash choralari qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Olma qurti tushgan mevalarni saqlab bo‘lmaydi, ular ko‘pincha irib ketadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A major insect pest of apple, pear, quince, walnut, and several other fruit crops. Its larvae feed inside developing fruits, damaging the flesh and seeds and potentially causing premature fruit drop and economic losses.
etymology_en: Codling historically refers to a type of apple, while moth derives from Old English moððe.
example_en: The codling moth (Cydia pomonella L.) is one of the most important pests existing in the apple orchards of the Hiran-Iraq northern part. (Cydia pomonella (L.) (Lepidoptera: Tortricidae) Larvae Infestation on Apple Trees According to Canopy Aspects. Sharif G.S., Ali J.I.M., 2019)

definition_uz: Kimyoviy element va o‘simliklar oziqlanishi uchun zarur makroelementlardan biri. Kimyoviy belgisi S, atom raqami 16. O‘simliklarda sistein va metionin kabi aminokislotalar, oqsillar, fermentlar, kofermentlar va ayrim vitaminlar tarkibiga kiradi. O‘simliklar oltingugurtni asosan sulfat (SO₄²⁻) shaklida o‘zlashtiradi. Qishloq xo‘jaligida oltingugurt o‘g‘itlash, tuproq reaksiyasini boshqarish hamda ayrim fungitsid va akaritsid preparatlar tarkibida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Kananing ko‘payishiga qarab 1–2 marta kolloidli yoki ho‘llanuvchi oltingugurt purkaladi (100 litr suvga 0,8–1 kg hisobidan), to‘kilgan barglar yo‘qotiladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A chemical element with the symbol S and atomic number 16 and an essential plant macronutrient. Sulfur is a constituent of the amino acids cysteine and methionine and is required for proteins, enzymes, coenzymes, and other metabolic compounds. Plants absorb sulfur primarily in the form of sulfate (SO₄²⁻).
etymology_en: From Latin sulfur or sulphur, meaning "brimstone".
example_en: Sulfur is a mineral essential for plant and animal growth and reproduction. (Heckman J. Sulfur Nutrition and Soil Fertility Management for New Jersey Crops. Rutgers New Jersey Agricultural Experiment Station, Bulletin E365)

definition_uz: Tarkibida o‘simliklar uchun zarur oziq elementi — oltingugurt (S) bo‘lgan o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Ular tuproqdagi oltingugurt tanqisligini bartaraf etish hamda aminokislotalar, oqsillar va boshqa oltingugurtli organik birikmalar sintezini ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi. Ammoniy sulfat, kaliy sulfat, gips va elementar oltingugurt o‘simliklarni oltingugurt bilan ta’minlaydigan manbalarga misol bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Sho‘rlangan va ishqoriy tuproqlarning meliorativ holatini yaxshilashda oltingugurtli o‘g‘itlar va gips solish eng samarali agrotexnik tadbirlardan biri hisoblanadi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Fertilizers that supply sulfur (S), an essential plant nutrient involved in amino-acid and protein synthesis and numerous physiological and metabolic processes. Sulfur sources used in plant nutrition include ammonium sulfate, potassium sulfate, gypsum, and elemental sulfur.
example_en: The results showed that the use of powdered and dissolved sulfur-containing fertilizers contributed to the early ripeness and increased productivity of wheat. (Influence of new sulfur-containing fertilizers on performance of wheat yield. Suleimenov B. et al., 2021)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Prunus turkumiga mansub ko‘p yillik barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 3–10 m gacha yetadi. Shox-shabbasi keng yoki yumaloq, barglari tuxumsimon va mayda tishli. Erta bahorda oq gullar hosil qiladi. Mevasi shirali danakli meva bo‘lib, yangi iste’mol qilish va qayta ishlash uchun yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Olxo‘ri daraxti unchalik baland bo‘lmay, bo‘yi 3–4 m gacha yetadi, bir tupidan 100 kg va undan ham ortiq hosil olinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree of the genus Prunus in the family Rosaceae, cultivated for its edible stone fruits. Prunus domestica, commonly known as the European or common plum, typically forms a small to medium-sized tree and produces white flowers in spring followed by fleshy drupes that vary in size, shape, and colour among cultivars.
etymology_en: From Old English plūme, ultimately from Latin prūnum, meaning "plum".
example_en: Plums usually need a subtropical and temperate climate, such as those in Europe, Asia and America. (Handbook of Plum Fruit: Production, Postharvest Science, and Processing Technology. Gull A., Nayik G.A., Wani S.M., Nanda V. (eds.), CRC Press, 2023)

definition_uz: Olxo‘ri daraxtining (Prunus domestica L.) iste’mol qilinadigan shirali danakli mevasi. Odatda yumaloq yoki tuxumsimon bo‘lib, po‘sti silliq, rangi naviga qarab yashil, sariq, qizil, ko‘kimtir yoki to‘q binafsha bo‘lishi mumkin. Eti shirali, yumshoq va shirin yoki nordon-shirin ta’mli. Yangi iste’mol qilinadi hamda quritiladi yoki turli mahsulotlarga qayta ishlanadi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda yetishtiriladigan olxo‘ri mevasi tarkibida 14–21% gacha shakar, 0,15–1,35% gacha turli kislotalar, 0,15–1,5% gacha oshlovchi moddalar va C vitamini bor. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The edible fleshy drupe of the European plum tree (Prunus domestica L.). Plum fruits vary in shape, size, and colour according to cultivar and typically contain juicy flesh surrounding a hard stone.
example_en: Many of these plums are consumed fresh. European plums with a sugar content high enough so that they can be dried with the pit intact are referred to as prunes. (Okie W.R. “Prunus domestica—European Plum / Prunus salicina—Japanese Plum.” In: Janick J., Paull R.E. (eds.), The Encyclopedia of Fruit & Nuts. CABI, 2008, pp. 694–705.)

definition_uz: Olxo‘rining (Prunus domestica L.) quritishga yaroqli navlari mevasini tabiiy yoki sun’iy usulda quritish orqali olinadigan mahsulot. Qoqi tayyorlash uchun odatda qand miqdori yuqori va quritishga mos navlardan foydalaniladi. Olxo‘ri qoqi oziq tolalari, qandlar, sorbitol, kaliy va boshqa oziq hamda biologik faol moddalarni saqlaydi.
example_uz: Olxo‘ri qoqi oshqozon-ichak yo‘lining normal ishlashini ta’minlaydi, ichak peristaltikasini yaxshilab, ovqat hazm qilishni osonlashtiradi. (Salomatlik manbai: Quritilgan mevalarning qanday foydali xususiyatlari bor? O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qishloq xo‘jaligi vazirligi, 2026)
definition_en: A dried plum produced from suitable cultivars of Prunus domestica L. Prunes contain dietary fibre, sugars, sorbitol, potassium, phenolic compounds, and other nutrients and bioactive constituents.
etymology_en: From Middle English prune, from Old French prune, ultimately from Latin prūnum, meaning "plum".
example_en: Prunes are dried plums, fruits of Prunus domestica L., cultivated and propagated since ancient times. (Chemical Composition and Potential Health Effects of Prunes: A Functional Food? Stacewicz-Sapuntzakis M. et al., 2001)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Prunus turkumiga mansub ko‘p yillik barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt yoki buta. Odatda 3–10 m gacha o‘sadi. Bahorda oq gullar hosil qiladi, mevasi qizil yoki to‘q qizil rangli, nordon yoki nordon-shirin ta’mli danakli meva. Mevasi yangi iste’mol qilinadi hamda murabbo, sharbat, kompot va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Pishmasdan juda erta terilgan olcha saqlash vaqtida tobiga kelib pishmaydi va mazasi unchalik yaxshi bo‘lmaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree or shrub of the genus Prunus in the family Rosaceae. It produces red to dark-red acidic drupes that are consumed fresh or processed into products such as juice, preserves, frozen fruit, and other fruit products.
example_en: Sour cherry is known to be rich in polyphenolic compounds, such as anthocyanins and procyanidins. (Toydemir G. et al. “Industrial processing effects on phenolic compounds in sour cherry (Prunus cerasus L.) fruit.” Food Research International, 2013, 53(1): 218–225. DOI: 10.1016/j.foodres.2013.04.009)

definition_uz: Olcha daraxtining (Prunus cerasus L.) iste’mol qilinadigan shirali danakli mevasi. Mevasi odatda dumaloq bo‘lib, naviga qarab och qizildan to‘q qizilgacha yoki qoramtir-qizil rangda bo‘lishi mumkin. Ta’mi nordon yoki nordon-shirin. Olcha mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek sharbat, murabbo, kompot, qoqi va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Olcha mevasi tarkibida 8,1–17,5% shakar, 0,92–2,82% organik kislotalar va 0,16–0,36% oshlovchi moddalar mavjud. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The edible drupe of the sour cherry (Prunus cerasus L.). The fruit is generally round and ranges from bright to dark red, depending on the cultivar, with a characteristically acidic or sweet-tart flavour. Sour cherry fruits are consumed fresh to a limited extent and are widely processed into juice, preserves, jams, compotes, dried products, and other foods.
etymology_en: Sour derives from Old English sūr, meaning "sour or acid in taste"; cherry comes through Old French cherise, ultimately from Greek kerasos, referring to the cherry.
example_en: The processed juice (or nectar) of the sour cherry, Prunus cerasus L., is widely consumed in the Balkan region and Turkey. (Industrial processing effects on phenolic compounds in sour cherry (Prunus cerasus L.) fruit. Toydemir G. et al., Food Research International, 2013)

definition_uz: Olcha daraxtlari (Prunus cerasus L.) meva yetishtirish maqsadida ekilgan va parvarish qilinadigan bog‘. Olchazorda bir yoki bir necha olcha navi yetishtirilishi mumkin. Bunday bog‘larda sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, butash, shakl berish hamda kasallik va zararkunandalarga qarshi himoya tadbirlari amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Arslonbobda tabiiy yong‘oqzor, pistazor, olmazor, bodomzor va olchazor ko‘p. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Arslonbob” maqolasi)
definition_en: An orchard planted and managed with sour cherry trees (Prunus cerasus L.) for fruit production. A sour cherry orchard may contain one or more cultivars and is managed through practices such as fertilization, pruning, training, irrigation, and protection against pests and diseases.
example_en: Sour cherry (Prunus cerasus L.) is one of the most important fruit crops in Poland and ‘Łutówka’ is the dominant cultivar in commercial orchards. (Effect of Nitrogen Fertilization in the Sour Cherry Orchard on Soil Enzymatic Activities, Microbial Population, and Fruit Quality. Rutkowski K., Łysiak G.P., Zydlik Z., Agriculture, 2022)

definition_uz: Seleksiya va urug‘chilikda duragaylash jarayonida urg‘ochi ota-ona sifatida foydalaniladigan o‘simlik, nav, liniya yoki shakl. Onalik shakli erkak ota-onadan kelgan changni qabul qiladi va urug‘lanishdan so‘ng duragay urug‘ hosil qiladi.
example_uz: Bunda onalik va otalik shakllari gen va xromosomalarining o‘zaro favqulodda qo‘shilishi evaziga ko‘plab rekombinantlar — yangi belgi va xususiyatlarga ega o‘simliklar F2 va kelgusi avlodda ajralib chiqadi hamda bu seleksiya ishini olib borish uchun katta manba hisoblanadi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Duragaylash” maqolasi)
definition_en: In plant breeding and hybrid seed production, the parent that receives pollen from the male parent and on which hybrid seed is produced.
example_en: Pollen from male parent (pollen parent) pollinates and sets seed in female (seed parent) parent to produce hybrid seed. (Saxena K.B. et al. “Hybrid Seed Production Technology.” In: Fundamentals of Field Crop Breeding. Springer, 2022.)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Verticillium dahliae Kleb. zamburug‘i qo‘zg‘atadigan o‘simliklarning tomir-o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalari kasalligi. Kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchisi ildiz orqali o‘simlikka kirib, o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalarda rivojlanadi. Natijada barglarda sarg‘ayish va so‘lish, o‘sishning susayishi, novda va boshqa qismlarning qurishi kuzatiladi. Kasallik ko‘plab qishloq xo‘jaligi, mevali va manzarali o‘simliklarni zararlashi mumkin.
example_uz: Vertitsillyoz vilt, oqpalak — o‘simliklarda Verticillium dahliae Klebahn zamburug‘i qo‘zg‘atadigan kasallik. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Vertitsillyoz vilt” maqolasi)
definition_en: A vascular wilt disease caused by Verticillium species, particularly Verticillium dahliae. The pathogen infects plants through the roots and colonizes the water-conducting tissues, causing symptoms such as leaf yellowing, wilting, vascular discoloration, stunting, dieback, and reduced plant vigour.
example_en: Verticillium wilt, one of the most widespread and destructive soilborne diseases of plants, affects a large number of herbaceous and woody species throughout the world. (Verticillium Wilt. UC Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program, University of California)

definition_uz: Hemiptera turkumining Aleyrodidae oilasiga mansub mayda so‘ruvchi hasharotlarning umumiy nomi. Voyaga yetgan oqqanotlarning tanasi va qanotlari oq mumsimon modda bilan qoplangan. Nimfa va voyaga yetgan bosqichlari o‘simlik shirasini so‘rib oziqlanadi, natijada o‘simlik zaiflashishi va hosildorlik pasayishi mumkin. Ayrim turlari o‘simlik viruslarining muhim tashuvchilari hisoblanadi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda ularning 4 ta turi aniqlangan. G‘o‘zaga asosan 2 turi zarar keltiradi: issiqxona (Trialeurodes vaporariorum Westw.) va g‘o‘za (tamaki) (Bemisia tabaci Genn.) oqqanotlari. (“Aleyrodidae (oqqanotlar) oilasi ayrim turlari rivojlanishining ekologik omillarga bog‘liqligi.” Agro kimyo himoya va o‘simliklar karantini, 2020, №1, B. 37–39.)
definition_en: A common name for small sap-sucking insects belonging to the family Aleyrodidae in the order Hemiptera. Nymphs and adults feed on plant sap, and several species are economically important pests and vectors of plant viruses.
example_en: Whiteflies are small, phloem-feeding insects that transmit plant viruses and cause extensive crop losses. (Gilbertson R.L., Batuman O., Webster C.G., Adkins S. “Role of the Insect Supervectors Bemisia tabaci and Frankliniella occidentalis in the Emergence and Global Spread of Plant Viruses.” Annual Review of Virology, 2015, 2: 67–93.)

definition_uz: Tropik, subtropik va boshqa issiqsevar yoki sovuqqa chidamsiz o‘simliklarni saqlash, o‘stirish, ko‘paytirish va namoyish etish uchun mo‘ljallangan yopiq inshoot. Botanika bog‘laridagi oranjereyalarda o‘simlik kolleksiyalari saqlanib, introduksiya, parvarish va ilmiy tadqiqot ishlari olib borilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha orangerie — apelsin daraxtlarini saqlash va o‘stirish uchun mo‘ljallangan bino.
example_uz: Hozirgi kunda Botanika bog‘i Oranjereyasida 400 dan ortiq tropik va subtropik o‘simliklar mavjud. (Oranjereya haqida qisqacha ma’lumot. Akademik F.N. Rusanov nomidagi Toshkent Botanika bog‘i)
definition_en: A protected building or structure traditionally used for growing and overwintering orange trees and other frost-sensitive plants. Orangeries may also be used for maintaining collections of exotic or tender plants.
etymology_en: From French orangerie, from oranger, meaning "orange tree".
example_en: The Orangery of the Botanical Gardens was built over 200 years ago and is one of few orangeries in Sweden that is still used for its original purpose. (The Orangery Linneanum. Uppsala University Botanical Garden)

definition_uz: Ko‘p hujayrali organizmda ma’lum biologik vazifani bajarishga ixtisoslashgan va bir necha to‘qimalardan tashkil topgan tana qismi. O‘simliklarning vegetativ organlariga ildiz, poya va barg, reproduktiv organlariga esa gul, meva va urug‘ kiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha organon — "asbob, vosita".
example_uz: Vegetativ organlariga ildiz, zang va barglari; generativ organlariga esa to‘pgul, gullar, shingil, g‘ujum va urug‘lar kiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A part of a multicellular organism composed of different tissues and specialized to perform one or more particular functions. In plants, vegetative organs include roots, stems, and leaves, while reproductive structures include flowers, fruits, and seeds.
etymology_en: From Greek organon ("tool, instrument"), through Latin organum.
example_en: The root is an organ that anchors a vascular plant in the soil, absorbs minerals and water, and often stores carbohydrates. (Encyclopaedia Britannica, “Root: plant”, Plant anatomy)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, hayvon va boshqa organik materiallardan olinadigan o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Ular tuproqni organik modda va oziq elementlari bilan boyitib, uning fizik, kimyoviy va biologik xossalarini yaxshilashga xizmat qiladi. Organik o‘g‘itlarga go‘ng, kompost, vermikompost va boshqa qayta ishlangan organik materiallar kiradi.
etymology_uz: Organik — yunoncha organikos, "organizmga, tirik tabiatga oid" + o‘g‘it.
example_uz: Tuproq aeratsiyasini yaxshilash uchun yer maxsus pluglar bilan haydaladi, tuproq chuqur yumshatiladi, begona o‘tlarga qarshi kurashiladi va organik o‘g‘itlar qo‘llaniladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Fertilizers derived from organic materials of plant, animal, or other biological origin and used to supply nutrients and organic matter to soil. Organic fertilizers include materials such as livestock manure, compost, vermicompost, and other processed organic materials and can improve the physical, chemical, and biological properties of soil.
etymology_en: Organic derives ultimately from Greek organikos, meaning "relating to an organ or organism"; fertilizer derives from fertile, ultimately from Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful".
example_en: Organic fertilizers can partially replace chemical fertilizers to improve agricultural production and reduce negative environmental impacts. (Moderate organic fertilizer substitution for partial chemical fertilizer improved soil microbial carbon source utilization and bacterial community composition in rain-fed wheat fields: current year. Liu X. et al., Frontiers in Microbiology, 2023)

definition_uz: Seleksiya va urug‘chilikda duragaylash jarayonida chang manbai sifatida foydalaniladigan erkak ota-ona shakli. Otalik o‘simlik chang hosil qiladi va onalik shaklini changlatish orqali duragay avlodga otalik genetik materialini beradi.
example_uz: Ilk bor o‘rta tolali g‘o‘za navlarini chatishtirishda tolasi IV-tipga mansub navning otalik shakl sifatida qo‘llanilishi va bu navning dominantligi tola mikroneyri va solishtirma uzilish kuchining yaxshi ko‘rsatkichlariga ega F1 kombinatsiyalarini yuzaga keltirishi aniqlangan. (Allambergenov T.D. “G. hirsutum L. turiga mansub g‘o‘za navlarining F1 va F2 duragaylarida «tola sifati» belgisining irsiylanishi va o‘zgaruvchanligi”. PhD dissertatsiyasi, Genetika va o‘simliklar eksperimental biologiyasi instituti, 2018.)
definition_en: In plant breeding and hybrid seed production, the parent that serves as the source of pollen for pollinating the female parent and contributes paternal genetic material to the hybrid offspring.
example_en: Pollen from male parent (pollen parent) pollinates and sets seed in female (seed parent) parent to produce hybrid seed. (Saxena K.B. et al. “Hybrid Seed Production Technology.” In: Fundamentals of Field Crop Breeding. Springer, 2022.)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simlikning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va modda almashinuvi uchun zarur bo‘lgan oziq elementlarini tashqi muhitdan o‘zlashtirib, ulardan hayotiy jarayonlarda foydalanmoq. Mineral oziqlanishda o‘simlik ildizlari tuproq eritmasidagi mineral oziq elementlarini o‘zlashtiradi.
example_uz: Kartoshka kl.lzgi bug'doyga qaraganda hlproqdan mineral moddalami ko'plab olib, u o'sish davrining boshida oziqa moddalarga talabchan em as, o'zi o'sib rivojlangan ona-tllgunak evaziga oziqlanadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: To absorb nutrients from the surrounding environment, especially mineral nutrients from the soil solution through the roots, and use them for plant growth, development, and metabolism.
example_en: Roots take up nutrients as ions dissolved in the soil’s water. (Plant Nutrition. Colorado State University Extension)

definition_uz: Qovun, tarvuz, bodring, qovoq kabi poliz o‘simliklarining yerda yoyilib yoki tayanchga ilashib o‘sadigan poya va novdalari hamda ularga birikkan barg va mo‘ylovlari majmui.
example_uz: Mevalar pishayotgan paytda palakdagi barglar sarg‘ayib, dag‘allashadi, tarvuzda poyadagi jingalaklar quriydi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: The creeping or trailing stem and shoot system of a cucurbit plant, such as melon, watermelon, cucumber, or squash, bearing leaves, tendrils, and lateral shoots.
example_en: Most varieties of cucumber vines spread from row to row. (Cucumbers, Melons and Squash. Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, Publication 426-406)

definition_uz: Urug‘ undirish, ko‘chat yetishtirish va issiqlik talab qiladigan o‘simliklarni erta mavsumda o‘stirish uchun mo‘ljallangan past bo‘yli, shisha yoki shaffof polimer material bilan yopilgan himoyalangan inshoot. Parnikda zarur issiqlik biologik issiqlik, elektr yoki boshqa qo‘shimcha isitish vositalari yordamida ta’minlanishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Ruscha парник, пар — "bug‘, issiq bug‘".
example_uz: Bodring erta bahordan boshlab parniklarda, bahorning kelishiga va tuproq haroratiga qarab ekiladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A low, covered growing structure supplied with bottom heat and used for seed germination, raising seedlings, and starting plants earlier in the growing season. Heat may be provided by decomposing manure, electric heating cables, or other artificial sources.
etymology_en: From hot + bed, referring to a heated bed used for growing plants.
example_en: The manure-heated hotbed provides a means for starting plants several weeks earlier in the spring than they could be started outdoors. (Building and Using Hotbeds and Cold Frames. University of Missouri Extension)

definition_uz: Urug‘lanish sodir bo‘lmasdan mevaning rivojlanishi va hosil bo‘lishi hodisasi. Partenokarpiya natijasida mevalar odatda urug‘siz bo‘ladi. Hodisa tabiiy ravishda yuz berishi yoki o‘simlik o‘sish regulyatorlari yordamida sun’iy ravishda qo‘zg‘atilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha parthenos — "bokira" + karpos — "meva".
example_uz: Partenokarpiya — urug'siz meva hosil qilish. Masalan, mandarin, apelsin, nok, uzumda. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Botirova L.A., Ergasheva N.A.)
definition_en: The development of fruit without fertilization. Parthenocarpic fruits are generally seedless, and parthenocarpy may occur naturally or be induced artificially.
etymology_en: From Greek parthenos ("virgin") + karpos ("fruit").
example_en: Parthenocarpic fruit develop without fertilization and are seedless. (Seeds: Parthenocarpy. University of Florida IFAS, Plant Propagation)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning normal o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va hosil berishini ta’minlash maqsadida sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, tuproqni yumshatish, begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotish, butash, shakl berish va o‘simliklarni himoya qilish kabi agrotexnik tadbirlarni muntazam amalga oshirmoq.
etymology_uz: Forscha parvarish — "tarbiya qilish, o‘stirish, g‘amxo‘rlik qilish".
example_uz: Baland bo‘yli daraxtlarning shox-shabbalaridan hosilni terib olish, ularni parvarishlash hamda hosilli shoxlari ostiga tirgovuch qo‘yish ancha qiyinlashadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To care for and manage plants by carrying out horticultural practices necessary for their growth and development, such as watering, fertilizing, weeding, pruning, training, and plant protection.
example_en: They will hunt through fruit to find the seeds, plant them, tend them, anticipate them, and then celebrate their growth. (Virginia Cooperative Extension, Grow Your Own: A Guide to Gardening with Children, Publication 426-950)

definition_uz: Novda yoki shoxni ona o‘simlikdan ajratmagan holda ildiz hosil qildirish, so‘ng ildizlangan qismini ona o‘simlikdan ajratib yangi o‘simlik olishga asoslangan vegetativ ko‘paytirish usuli. Parxishda novda tuproqqa egib ko‘milishi yoki boshqa nam ildizlantiruvchi muhit bilan o‘ralishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojik tilidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Parxish usulidan odatda qalamchalari ildiz otishi qiyin kechadigan navlarni ko‘paytirishda foydalaniladi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: A method of vegetative propagation in which adventitious roots are induced to form on a stem while it remains attached to the parent plant. After sufficient rooting, the rooted stem is detached and grown as an independent plant.
example_en: Layering is a method of propagation that encourages adventitious roots to form on stems while they remain attached to the parent or “stock” plant. (Layering. Maynard B., Plant Propagation Concepts and Laboratory Exercises, 2011)

definition_uz: Payvandlash yo‘li bilan hosil qilingan o‘simlik yoki ko‘chat, shuningdek payvandust va payvandtag to‘qimalarining tutashib, bir butun holda o‘sishi natijasida hosil bo‘lgan payvand birikmasi. Bog‘dorchilik va ko‘chatchilikda payvand nav xususiyatlarini saqlagan holda kerakli payvandtagda o‘stiriladigan o‘simlik sifatida qo‘llanadi.
etymology_uz: Forscha peyvand — "biriktirish, ulash, bog‘lash".
example_uz: Ko‘paytirish bo‘limi. Bu bo‘limda payvandlar o‘stirilib, danaklar ekiladi va ikkinchi joyga ko‘chirilib o‘tkaziladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A plant or plant union produced by grafting, in which a scion or bud is joined to a rootstock and the tissues of the two plant parts unite and grow together as one plant.
etymology_en: From Old French graffe, referring to a grafting shoot or stylus, ultimately from Latin graphium.
example_en: A graft consists of the scion which becomes the above ground growth and the rootstock that produces the root system. (Grafting Terminology: Grafting. University of Florida IFAS, Department of Environmental Horticulture)

definition_uz: Payvandlash yo‘li bilan hosil qilingan yoki yetishtirilgan o‘simlik, daraxt yoxud ko‘chatga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Payvandi o‘simlik payvandust va payvandtagning tutashishi natijasida hosil bo‘lib, payvandust navning asosiy xususiyatlarini, payvandtag esa ildiz tizimi bilan bog‘liq ayrim o‘sish va moslashuv xususiyatlarini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Ko‘chatchilik ilmini puxta o‘zlashtirgan sohibkor, shuningdek, payvandi ko‘chatlardan yaxshigina daromad olmoqda. (O‘zA, “Buxoroning Jondorida bir daraxtda ikki xil meva hosil soldi”, 2016)
definition_en: Joined or propagated by grafting, especially referring to a plant or tree in which a scion or bud has been united with a rootstock so that the two parts grow together as one plant.
etymology_en: From graft, from Old French graffe, ultimately from Latin graphium.
example_en: Grafted trees can be identified by two main parts. The scion is most of what you see above ground, this is the fruiting part. (Why We Use Apple Rootstock. North Carolina Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: Bir o‘simlikning qalamchasi, novdasi yoki kurtagini boshqa o‘simlikka ulab, ularning tirik to‘qimalari o‘zaro tutashishi va bir butun o‘simlik sifatida o‘sishini ta’minlaydigan vegetativ ko‘paytirish usuli. Payvandlashda ulanadigan qism payvandust, u ulanadigan ildizli o‘simlik yoki uning qismi esa payvandtag deyiladi. Usul mevachilik va ko‘chatchilikda nav xususiyatlarini saqlash, qimmatli navlarni ko‘paytirish hamda payvandtagning foydali xususiyatlaridan foydalanish uchun keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Mevachilikda daraxtlarni vegetativ usul bilan ko‘paytirishda payvandlash eng yaxshi usullardan biri hisoblanadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A vegetative propagation technique in which a scion or bud from one plant is joined to a rootstock so that their living tissues unite and subsequently grow together as one plant. Grafting is widely used in fruit-tree and nursery production to propagate cultivars and to combine desirable characteristics of scions and rootstocks.
etymology_en: From graft, from Old French graffe, referring to a grafting shoot or stylus, ultimately from Latin graphium.
example_en: Grafting is the act of joining two plants together. (Trinklein D.H. “Grafting.” University of Missouri Extension, Publication G6971, 2022)

definition_uz: Bir o‘simlikning kurtagi, qalamchasi yoki novdasini boshqa o‘simlikning payvandtagiga biriktirib, ularning tirik to‘qimalari tutashishi va bir butun o‘simlik sifatida o‘sishini ta’minlamoq.
example_uz: Ko‘chatlar bahorda kurtak uyg‘onishidan oldin yoki yozda kurtak payvandi usulida payvandlanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To join a scion or bud from one plant to a rootstock so that their living tissues unite and grow together as one plant.
etymology_en: From Middle English graffen, from Old French grafer, meaning "to graft".
example_en: Last spring, I grafted 24 apple scions onto 24 rootstocks. (Frillman N. “Grafting – an important age-old skill for aspiring orchardists.” University of Illinois Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Payvandlashda payvandust biriktiriladigan va payvand qilingan o‘simlikning ildiz tizimini, ba’zan esa poyasining quyi qismini hosil qiladigan o‘simlik yoki uning qismi. Payvandtag payvandustning o‘sish kuchi, hosilga kirish muddati, hosildorligi, tuproq-iqlim sharoitlariga moslashuvi hamda ayrim kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamliligiga ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
example_uz: Past bo‘yli payvandtaglarga ulangan daraxtlar kuchli payvandtaglarga ulangan daraxtlarga qaraganda qurg‘oqchilikka kamroq chidamli bo‘ladi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The plant or lower portion of a grafted plant to which the scion is attached and which provides the root system and sometimes the lower portion of the stem. Rootstocks can influence scion vigour, precocity, productivity, adaptation to soil and environmental conditions, and resistance to certain pests and diseases.
etymology_en: Formed from root + stock; stock in grafting refers to the plant or plant part onto which a scion is grafted.
example_en: Dwarfing rootstocks are available for apple grafts. (Grafting Terminology: Rootstock or Understock. University of Florida, Institute of Food and Agricultural Sciences)

definition_uz: Payvandlashda payvandtagga biriktiriladigan, kerakli navdan olingan kurtak, novda yoki poya qismi. Payvandust payvandlangan o‘simlikning asosan yer ustki qismini hosil qiladi va navga xos belgilarni, jumladan mevaning asosiy xususiyatlarini belgilaydi.
example_uz: Payvandust bilan payvandtag tutashgan joy yerga ko‘mib yuborilganda payvandustdan qo‘shimcha ildizlar hosil bo‘lishi mumkin. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A branch, shoot, bud, or piece of stem taken from a desired plant and grafted onto a rootstock. The scion forms the upper portion of the grafted plant and is selected primarily for the characteristics of the desired cultivar.
etymology_en: From Old French cion, meaning "shoot, twig".
example_en: The upper portion of a grafted tree arises from the scion. (Apple Rootstock Trial. Western Agricultural Research Center, Montana State University)

definition_uz: Yong‘oqdoshlar (Juglandaceae) oilasiga mansub, Shimoliy Amerikada tabiiy tarqalgan yirik barg to‘kuvchi yong‘oqmevali daraxt. Bo‘yi odatda 20–40 m gacha yetishi mumkin. Barglari murakkab patsimon, gullari bir jinsli bo‘lib, shamol yordamida changlanadi. Mevasi tashqi qobig‘i yetilganda yoriladigan, ichida qattiq po‘choq bilan o‘ralgan oziqbop mag‘iz hosil qiladigan meva bo‘lib, pekan asosan shu mag‘zi uchun yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Pekan nomi Shimoliy Amerikaning algonkin tillaridagi qattiq po‘choqli yong‘oqqa nisbatan ishlatilgan so‘zdan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Pekan daraxtining yog‘ochi qattiq va egiluvchan bo‘lib, dub hamda shumtol daraxtlarining yog‘ochiga o‘xshaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A large deciduous nut tree of the family Juglandaceae, native to North America and cultivated primarily for its edible kernels. It has pinnately compound leaves, unisexual flowers, and is wind-pollinated. The fruit has an outer husk that splits at maturity, enclosing a hard-shelled nut-like structure containing the edible kernel.
etymology_en: Pecan derives from an Algonquian word referring to a nut requiring a stone or other implement to crack.
example_en: Pecan trees grow best in a well-drained, deep soil with at least 36 inches of topsoil. (Pecan Trees for the Home or Backyard Orchard. University of Georgia Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: Pekan daraxtining (Carya illinoinensis (Wangenh.) K.Koch) iste’mol qilinadigan mevasi. Botanika jihatidan soxta danak tipidagi meva bo‘lib, tashqi qobig‘i yetilganda yoriladi va ichida qattiq po‘choqli yong‘oqcha joylashadi. Mag‘zi oqish, shirin va seryog‘ bo‘lib, oziq-ovqatda yangi holda hamda qandolatchilik mahsulotlari tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Pekan nomi Shimoliy Amerikaning algonkin tillaridagi qattiq po‘choqli yong‘oqqa nisbatan ishlatilgan so‘zdan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Mevasi soxta danak, yong‘oqchasi (3,5–8 sm) oktabr–noyabrda pishadi, mag‘izi oqish, shirin, yong‘og‘ining 45–60% ini tashkil etadi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Pekan” maqolasi)
definition_en: The edible fruit of the pecan tree (Carya illinoinensis (Wangenh.) K.Koch). It develops within an outer husk that splits at maturity, exposing a hard-shelled structure containing the edible kernel. The kernel is rich in oil and contains various nutritionally important bioactive compounds.
etymology_en: Pecan derives from an Algonquian word referring to a nut requiring a stone or other implement to crack.
example_en: Pecan nuts (Carya illinoinensis) provide a wide range of bioactive compounds (particularly polyphenols) that improve the nutritional quality of diets. (Influence of Ripening Process on Pecan Nut (Carya illinoinensis) Kernel Quality: Phenolic Profile, Antioxidant Activity, and Carbohydrate Composition. Bouali I. et al., Horticulturae, 2023)

definition_uz: Mevaning devori bo‘lib, odatda urug‘chi tugunchasining devoridan rivojlanadi. Perikarp urug‘larni o‘rab turadi va himoya qiladi hamda ko‘pincha ekzokarp, mezokarp va endokarp qatlamlariga differensiallashadi. Meva turiga qarab perikarp quruq yoki shirali bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha peri — "atrofida" + karpos — "meva".
example_uz: Perikarp mevaning tashqi qismi bo‘lib, u tuguncha devorining shakli o‘zgarishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladi. (O‘zbekistonda bog‘dorchilik. Mirzayev M.M., Sobirov M.K., 1980)
definition_en: The wall of a mature fruit, usually developing from the ovary wall. The pericarp may be differentiated into three layers: the exocarp, mesocarp, and endocarp, and may be dry or fleshy depending on the type of fruit.
etymology_en: From Greek peri ("around") + karpos ("fruit").
example_en: The pericarp is commonly differentiated into three distinct layers: the exocarp, mesocarp, and endocarp. (Encyclopaedia Britannica, “Fruit: Anatomy and fruit types”)

definition_uz: Bog‘ va xiyobonlarda soya hosil qilish, chirmashuvchi o‘simliklarni tayanch bilan ta’minlash hamda landshaftni bezash uchun quriladigan, ustunlar va yuqori qismidagi ko‘ndalang to‘sinlardan tashkil topgan ochiq yengil me’moriy-bog‘ inshooti.
etymology_uz: Italyancha pergola, lotincha pergula — "ayvon, chiqib turgan soyabon".
example_uz: Ayvonchalar va pergolalarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirish uchun tok, klematis, kaprifol, aristoloxiya, chirmashuvchi atirgullar va chirmashuvchi gortenziyadan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An open garden structure consisting of vertical posts supporting crossbeams and other horizontal members, commonly used to support climbing plants, provide partial shade, and form an architectural feature in a landscape.
etymology_en: From Italian pergola, from Latin pergula, referring to a projecting roof, covered walk, or similar structure.
example_en: The PER had one cane at 1.8 m above the ground, and all shoots were positioned into catch wires on a pergola trellis. (‘Miguang’ Grape Response to Pergola and Single-Curtain Training Systems. Du W. et al., Horticulturae, 2023)

definition_uz: Zararkunandalar, o‘simlik kasalliklarini qo‘zg‘atuvchi organizmlar, begona o‘tlar va boshqa zararli organizmlarning oldini olish, ularni yo‘q qilish, qaytarish yoki nazorat qilish uchun qo‘llaniladigan moddalar yoki preparatlar guruhi. Pestitsidlarga insektitsidlar, fungitsidlar, gerbitsidlar, akaritsidlar va boshqa turdagi vositalar kiradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha pestis — "zararkunanda, vabo" + -cide, lotincha caedere — "o‘ldirmoq".
example_uz: Pestitsidlarni qo‘llashda zararkunandalarning rivojlanish fenologik kalendarini va ob-havo sharoitlarini ham hisobga olish lozim. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Substances or mixtures intended for preventing, destroying, repelling, or controlling pests, including insects, plant pathogens, weeds, mites, and other organisms harmful to crops.
etymology_en: From pest + -cide; pest ultimately from Latin pestis ("plague, pest"), and -cide from Latin caedere ("to kill").
example_en: Pesticides are substances or mixtures of substances intended for preventing, destroying or controlling any pest. (FAO & WHO, International Code of Conduct on Pesticide Management, 2014)

definition_uz: Zich ekilgan yosh nihollarni rivojlanishining dastlabki bosqichida o‘sib chiqqan joyidan ehtiyotkorlik bilan ajratib, alohida idishlarga yoki kattaroq oziqlanish maydoniga ko‘chirib o‘tqazish agrotexnik usuli. Pikirovka nihollarga yetarli o‘sish maydoni yaratish va ularning keyingi rivojlanishini yaxshilash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha пикировка, fransuzcha piquer — "sanchmoq".
example_uz: Yosh maysani ko‘chirib o‘tkazish pikirovka (siyraklab ko‘chirib o‘tkazish) deyiladi. (Sabzavotchilik va polizchilik. Zuyev V.I., Qodirxo‘jayev O., Adilov M.M., Akramov U.I., 2016)
definition_en: The horticultural practice of carefully transferring very young seedlings from the container or seedbed in which they germinated to individual containers or wider spacing, where they have more room to continue growing.
example_en: If plants have not been seeded in individual containers, they must be potted-up (also called “pricking out” or “transplanting up”) into a larger individual container to give them proper growing space. (Traunfeld J. “Starting Vegetable Seeds Indoors.” University of Maryland Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Pistadoshlar (Anacardiaceae) oilasiga mansub, issiq va quruq iqlim sharoitlariga moslashgan ko‘p yillik barg to‘kuvchi yong‘oqmevali daraxt. O‘simlik ikki uyli bo‘lib, erkak va urg‘ochi gullari alohida daraxtlarda rivojlanadi va shamol yordamida changlanadi. Mevasi danak tipida bo‘lib, ichidagi urug‘ mag‘zi oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadi. Pista Markaziy Osiyo, jumladan O‘zbekiston hududida tabiiy tarqalgan va madaniy holda ham yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Forscha pista so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Pistadan yaxshi hosil olish uchun urg‘ochi daraxtlarni erkak daraxtlardan to‘planadigan chang bilan sun’iy changlash tavsiya etiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A deciduous dioecious tree of the family Anacardiaceae, adapted to relatively hot and dry conditions and cultivated for its edible seeds. Male and female flowers are borne on separate trees, and pollen is dispersed primarily by wind.
etymology_en: From Italian pistacchio, through Latin pistacium and Greek pistakion, ultimately related to an ancient Iranian word for the pistachio.
example_en: The tree is dioecious, with male and female flowers borne on separate trees. (Climate & Cultivars. Kallsen C., University of California Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: Pista daraxtining (Pistacia vera L.) danakmevasi. Meva tashqi etli qism — ekzokarp va mezokarp, qattiqlashgan endokarp (po‘choq) hamda uning ichida joylashgan iste’mol qilinadigan urug‘ (mag‘iz)dan tashkil topadi. Pista mag‘zi yog‘, oqsil, uglevodlar, vitaminlar va mineral moddalarga boy.
example_uz: Odatda yil oralatib mo‘l hosil beradi. Har tup daraxtdan 12–15 kg gacha pista terib olinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The drupe produced by the pistachio tree (Pistacia vera L.). It consists of an outer fleshy hull formed by the exocarp and mesocarp, a hard endocarp or shell, and a single edible seed or kernel enclosed within the shell.
example_en: The pistachio fruit (nut) is a drupe and almost oval shape. (Kashaninejad M., Tabil L.G. “Pistachio (Pistacia vera L.).” In: Postharvest Biology and Technology of Tropical and Subtropical Fruits, Vol. 4, Woodhead Publishing, 2011, pp. 218–246)

definition_uz: Pista daraxtlari (Pistacia vera L.) yetishtiriladigan mevali bog‘ yoki plantatsiya. Pistazorlar pista hosili olish maqsadida barpo etilib, ularda changlanishni ta’minlash uchun urg‘ochi va erkak daraxtlar joylashtiriladi hamda sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, butash, payvandlash va o‘simliklarni himoya qilish kabi agrotexnik tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Mavjud pistazorlarning hosildorligini oshirish maqsadida siyrak joylarga pista ekish va ko‘chat o‘tqazish, payvandlash hamda daraxtlarni muhofaza qilish tavsiya etiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An orchard planted with pistachio trees (Pistacia vera L.) for nut production. Pistachio orchards are managed through practices such as irrigation, fertilization, pruning, pollinizer management, and protection against pests and diseases.
example_en: Most pistachio orchards use drip and microsprinkler irrigation, rather than the surface methods (basin, furrow and border strip) commonly used with other deciduous trees. (Pistachio Production Manual. University of California)

definition_uz: Chuchmomadoshlar (Amaryllidaceae) oilasiga mansub ikki yillik yoki ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon sabzavot o‘simligi. Odatda sabzavot ekini sifatida ikki yillik bo‘lib, birinchi yili piyozbosh va barglar, ikkinchi yili esa gul va urug‘ hosil qiladi. Piyozboshi qisqargan poya va uni o‘rab turuvchi qalinlashgan etli barg asoslaridan tashkil topadi. Barglari yashil, ichi bo‘sh va naychasimon. Piyoz oziq-ovqat va ziravor sifatida keng yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha piyoz so‘zidan.
example_uz: Piyozning qorakuya kasalligi ko‘p hollarda pishib yetilgan bosh piyozlarni zararlaydi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A bulbous herbaceous plant of the family Amaryllidaceae, widely cultivated as a vegetable for its edible bulb. The bulb consists of a shortened stem surrounded by fleshy leaf bases, while the green leaves are hollow and cylindrical.
etymology_en: From Middle English oynoun, from Old French oignon, ultimately from Latin unio.
example_en: Onion (Allium cepa L.) is one of the most important vegetable crops in the world. (Sowing time and temperature influence bulb development in spring-sown onion (Allium cepa L.). Scientia Horticulturae, Elsevier, 2019)

definition_uz: Yer ostida piyozbosh hosil qiladigan o‘simliklarning umumiy morfologik guruhi. Piyozbosh qisqargan poya va oziq moddalar to‘plovchi etli barglar yoki barg asoslaridan tashkil topadi. Piyozlilarga oziq-ovqat va manzarali o‘simliklarning turli vakillari kiradi. Bu atama zamonaviy botanika sistematikasida yagona taksonomik oilani emas, balki piyozbosh hosil qiluvchi o‘simliklarning morfologik guruhini ifodalaydi.
example_uz: Sabzavot ekinlari ishlatilishiga qarab ho‘l mevalilar, barglilar, ildizmevalilar, piyozlilar va tuganak mevalilarga bo‘linadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Plants that produce bulbs as underground storage organs. A true bulb consists of a shortened stem surrounded by fleshy storage leaves or leaf bases. Bulbous plants occur in different botanical families and include both edible and ornamental species.
etymology_en: Bulbous derives from bulb, ultimately from Latin bulbus and Greek bolbos, referring to a bulb or bulbous root.
example_en: Bulbous plants are a group of plants that have underground storage organs, such like corms, rhizomes, tubers and bulbs. (Factors affecting bulblet multiplication in bulbous plants. Zhang J. et al., Scientia Horticulturae, 2023)

definition_uz: Meva, sabzavot yoki boshqa hosil organining rivojlanish jarayonida fiziologik va biokimyoviy o‘zgarishlarga uchrab, pishgan holatga o‘tishi. Mevalarda pishish jarayonida rang, ta’m, hid, tekstura, shakarlar, organik kislotalar va boshqa tarkibiy qismlarda o‘zgarishlar yuz beradi.
example_uz: Yong‘oq sentabrning ikkinchi yarmi oktabr oylarida pishadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To undergo the physiological, biochemical, and developmental changes by which a fruit or other harvestable plant organ reaches a ripe state. In fruits, ripening involves coordinated changes in colour, texture, flavour, aroma, sugars, organic acids, and other constituents.
example_en: Fruit types that have a strong requirement for ethylene to ripen such as tomatoes, peaches, bananas, apples, and melon have previously been labeled climacteric. (A Dynamic Interplay between Phytohormones Is Required for Fruit Development, Maturation, and Ripening. McAtee P. et al., Frontiers in Plant Science, 2013)

definition_uz: Mevali bog‘, tokzor va boshqa ko‘p yillik ekinlar barpo etishdan oldin tuproqni odatdagi haydashdan ancha chuqur qatlamigacha ag‘darib haydash agrotexnik tadbiri. Plantaj tuproqning chuqur qatlamlarini yumshatish, haydalma qatlamni chuqurlashtirish, suv va havo rejimini yaxshilash hamda o‘simlik ildizlarining chuqur rivojlanishi uchun qulay sharoit yaratish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha плантаж, fransuzcha plantage, planter — "ekmoq" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Ko‘chat ekiladigan maydon bir yil oldin 50–60 sm chuqurlikda plantaj plug bilan ag‘darib haydaladi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A deep soil cultivation operation carried out before establishing an orchard, vineyard, or other perennial planting to loosen and modify deeper soil layers, improve soil physical conditions, and provide a more favourable rooting environment.
example_en: Deep ploughing is essential to remove big roots. (Orchard Management. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, TNAU Agritech Portal)

definition_uz: Hayoti davomida bir necha marta gullab, meva va urug‘ hosil qiladigan o‘simliklar. Polikarpik o‘simliklar bir marta reproduktiv rivojlanishdan so‘ng nobud bo‘lmaydi, balki keyingi mavsumlarda yana gullab, meva va urug‘ hosil qilishi mumkin. Bu guruhga ko‘pchilik ko‘p yillik mevali daraxtlar, butalar va ayrim ko‘p yillik o‘t o‘simliklari kiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha poly — "ko‘p" + karpos — "meva".
example_uz: O‘z individual taraqqiyot davrida bir necha marta urug‘ hosil qiluvchi o‘simliklar esa polikarp o‘simliklar deb yuritiladi. (Botanika. Mustafayev S.M., Ahmedov O‘.A., Mustafayeva M.S., Yulchiyeva M.T., 2012)
definition_en: Plants that reproduce more than once during their lifetime. Unlike monocarpic plants, they survive after a reproductive episode and can flower and produce fruits and seeds again in subsequent seasons. Most woody perennial fruit crops exhibit a polycarpic reproductive habit.
etymology_en: From Greek poly-, meaning "many", + karpos, meaning "fruit".
example_en: A plant is considered to be polycarpic if it is able to reproduce more than once before dying. (Comparative Analysis of Flowering in Annual and Perennial Plants. Albani M.C., Coupland G., Current Topics in Developmental Biology, 2010)

definition_uz: Ko‘p sonli monosaxarid birliklarining glikozid bog‘lari orqali birikishidan hosil bo‘lgan yuqori molekulali uglevodlar. O‘simliklarda polisaxaridlar zaxira modda sifatida, masalan, kraxmal shaklida to‘planadi hamda hujayra devorining muhim tarkibiy qismlarini hosil qiladi. Selluloza, gemisellulozalar va pektinlar o‘simlik hujayra devorining asosiy polisaxarid guruhlaridir.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha poly — "ko‘p" + sakcharon — "shakar".
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda yetishtirilgan anissimon tojgul (Lophanthus anisatus Benth.) tarkibidagi suvda eruvchan polisaxaridlar (4%), pektin moddalari (6%) va gemitsellyulozalar (8,3%) mavjudligi ilk bor o‘rganildi. (Ibragimova D.M., Farmanova N.T., Nurmamatova M.O. “Anissimon tojgul (Lophanthus anisatus Benth.) yer ustki qismi tarkibidagi polisaxaridlarni ajratib olish va fizik-kimyoviy xususiyatlarini o‘rganish.” Eurasian Journal of Medical and Natural Sciences, 2025,)
definition_en: High-molecular-weight carbohydrates composed of numerous monosaccharide units linked by glycosidic bonds. In plants, polysaccharides function as storage compounds and as major structural components of cell walls. Cellulose, hemicelluloses, and pectins are major groups of plant cell-wall polysaccharides.
etymology_en: From Greek poly- ("many") + saccharon ("sugar").
example_en: Starting from simple sugars, three groups of polysaccharides, namely, cellulose, hemicelluloses and pectins, with very different physical properties are assembled by the cell to make a strong yet extensible wall. (Cosgrove D.J. “Structure and growth of plant cell walls.” Nature Reviews Molecular Cell Biology, 2024, 25: 340–358)

definition_uz: Ituzumdoshlar (Solanaceae) oilasiga mansub, odatda bir yillik ekin sifatida yetishtiriladigan o‘tsimon sabzavot o‘simligi. Poyasi shoxlangan, barglari bo‘lingan, gullari odatda sariq rangli. Mevasi botanik jihatdan shirali rezavor meva bo‘lib, shakli, rangi va kattaligi naviga qarab farqlanadi. Pomidor mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda turli oziq-ovqat mahsulotlariga qayta ishlanadi.
etymology_uz: Italyancha pomodoro — "oltin olma"; pomo d’oro birikmasidan.
example_uz: Pomidor sabzavotlar ichida eng ko‘p ekiladi va iste’mol qilinadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A herbaceous plant of the family Solanaceae, usually cultivated as an annual vegetable crop. It has branched stems, divided leaves, typically yellow flowers, and fleshy berry fruits that vary considerably in shape, colour, and size according to cultivar.
etymology_en: From Spanish tomate, borrowed from Nahuatl tomatl.
example_en: In terms of acreage, productivity, economic worth, and human nutrition, the tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) has emerged as the most significant vegetable crop. (Prasanna H.C., Rai N., Hussain Z., Yerasu S.R., Tiwari J.K. “Tomato: Breeding and Genomics.” Vegetable Science, 2023, 50(Special Issue): 146–155)

definition_uz: Eriophyidae oilasiga mansub mikroskopik o‘simlikxo‘r kana turi. Asosan ituzumdoshlar (Solanaceae) oilasiga mansub o‘simliklarni, jumladan pomidor, kartoshka, baqlajon va qalampirni zararlaydi. Kana barg, poya va meva hujayralari bilan oziqlanib, zararlangan qismlarning bronza yoki zangsimon tusga kirishi, barglarning qurishi va to‘kilishi hamda mevalarning zararlanishiga sabab bo‘ladi. Zararlanish odatda o‘simlikning pastki qismidan boshlanib, yuqoriga qarab tarqaladi.
example_uz: Pomidor zang kanasi asosan pomidor va kartoshkada tez rivojlanadi. (Pomidor zang kanasiga qarshi samarali kurash usuli. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qishloq xo‘jaligi vazirligi, 2025)
definition_en: A microscopic phytophagous mite of the family Eriophyidae that attacks primarily solanaceous plants, including tomato, eggplant, pepper, and potato. Its feeding causes bronzing or russeting of stems, leaves, and fruits; severely affected leaves may dry and fall, and damaged fruits may become bronzed and cracked. Infestations typically begin near the base of the plant and progress upward.
etymology_en: Russet refers to the brownish or reddish-brown discoloration produced on plant tissues by mite feeding.
example_en: The tomato russet mite also infests eggplant, pepper, potato, petunia, groundcherry, datura, and other solenaceous plant species. (Tomato Russet Mite. Texas A&M AgriLife Extension)

definition_uz: Mevachilikning meva va rezavor mevali ekinlarning turlari hamda navlarini, ularning biologik va xo‘jalik xususiyatlari, kelib chiqishi, tasnifi, hosildorligi va meva sifatini o‘rganadigan sohasi. Pomologiyada meva ekinlari navlarini aniqlash, tavsiflash, baholash va muayyan tuproq-iqlim sharoitlariga mosligini o‘rganish muhim o‘rin tutadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha pomum — "meva, daraxt mevasi" + yunoncha -logia — "o‘rganish, fan".
example_uz: Pomologiya mevali va rezavor mevali ekinlar seleksiyasining tarkibiy qismi hisoblanadi. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X.)
definition_en: The branch of horticulture concerned with the study of fruit crops and their cultivars, including their biological and economic characteristics, origin, classification, productivity, fruit quality, identification, description, evaluation, and adaptation to particular growing conditions.
etymology_en: From New Latin pomologia, based on Latin pomum — "fruit" and Greek -logia — "study".
example_en: The science and practice of fruit production is called pomology. (What Is Horticulture? Louisiana State University)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning asosiy vegetativ organlaridan biri bo‘lib, ildiz tizimi bilan barg, gul va mevalar joylashgan yer ustki qismlarini o‘zaro bog‘laydi. Poya o‘simlikka tayanch bo‘lib xizmat qiladi, suv va mineral moddalarni ildizdan yer ustki organlariga, fotosintez mahsulotlarini esa barglardan o‘simlikning boshqa qismlariga o‘tkazadi. Ayrim o‘simliklarda poya oziq moddalarni to‘plash va vegetativ ko‘payish vazifalarini ham bajaradi.
etymology_uz: Forscha pāyeh — "oyoq, asos, tayanch" so‘zidan.
example_uz: Meva daraxtlarining yer ustki qismi bitta poya — tanadan iborat. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A main vegetative organ of a plant that supports leaves, flowers, and fruits and connects them with the root system. The stem transports water and minerals from the roots to the leaves and other organs, and transports products of photosynthesis from the leaves to other parts of the plant. Some stems also function in storage and vegetative propagation.
etymology_en: From Old English stemn, stefn, meaning "stem or trunk of a plant".
example_en: The stem of the plant connects the roots to the leaves, helping to transport absorbed water and minerals to different parts of the plant. (OpenStax, Biology 2e, “Stems”, Rice University)

definition_uz: Suyuqliklarni mayda tomchilar holida o‘simliklar yoki boshqa nishon yuzalarga purkash uchun mo‘ljallangan qurilma yoki mashina. Bog‘dorchilikda purkagichlar pestitsidlar, fungitsidlar, insektitsidlar, bargdan beriladigan oziq moddalar va boshqa suyuq preparatlarni qo‘llashda ishlatiladi. Tuzilishiga ko‘ra qo‘l, yelka, motorli, traktor agregatiga o‘rnatiladigan va boshqa turlari mavjud.
example_uz: Ishlarni o‘z vaqtida va sifatli bajarish uchun 30–40 gektar meva bog‘iga bitta purkagich, oltingugurt bilan changlatish uchun 70–80 gektar tokzorga bitta changlatkich zarur bo‘ladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A device or machine used to apply liquids in the form of droplets to crops or other target surfaces. In horticulture, sprayers are commonly used for the application of pesticides, fungicides, insecticides, foliar nutrients, and other liquid materials.
etymology_en: From spray + the agent-forming suffix -er.
example_en: Proper calibration of a sprayer helps to ensure accurate pesticide application at the rate per acre specified on the product label. (Sprayer Calibration with Handheld Sprayer Systems for Orchard Crops. Kawabata A. et al., University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, 2022)

definition_uz: Suyuqlikni mayda tomchilar holida o‘simlikka, tuproqqa yoki boshqa yuzaga purkagich yordamida sepmoq. Bog‘dorchilikda purkash o‘simliklarni zararkunandalar va kasalliklardan himoya qilish, suyuq o‘g‘itlarni barg orqali qo‘llash, o‘sishni boshqaruvchi moddalar bilan ishlov berish va boshqa agrotexnik maqsadlarda amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Bahorda va yozda olma qurtiga qarshi purkaladigan preparatlar nok daraxtlariga ham purkaladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: To apply a liquid in the form of small droplets to a plant, soil, or another surface, usually by means of a sprayer. In horticulture, plants may be sprayed with pesticides, foliar nutrients, plant growth regulators, and other liquid treatments.
example_en: If there are only a few trees (five to eight) to spray, along with a few strawberries and brambles, a hand sprayer of the compressed-air type would probably be adequate. (Virginia Cooperative Extension. Home Fruit: Disease and Insects, 2026)

definition_uz: Suyuqlik yoki eritmalarni mayda tomchilar shaklida o‘simliklar, tuproq yoki boshqa nishon yuzalarga tarqatish jarayoni. Bog‘dorchilikda purkash o‘simliklarni kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish, pestitsidlar, bargdan beriladigan oziq moddalar va boshqa biologik faol moddalarni qo‘llash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Purkashdan keyin yomg‘ir yog‘ib o‘tsa, purkash ishlari takrorlanadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The process of applying a liquid in the form of droplets to plants, crops, soil, or other target surfaces. In crop protection, spraying is commonly used for the application of pesticides and other liquid plant-protection products.
example_en: Spraying should be done when wind speeds are low to minimize drift. (Pesticide Application and Safety Training for Applicators of Public Health Pesticides. University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Mevaning tashqi qismini qoplab turuvchi himoya qatlami. Meva po‘sti ichki to‘qimalarni tashqi muhit ta’siridan himoya qilish, suv yo‘qotilishini cheklash va mevaning tashqi ko‘rinishi hamda saqlanish xususiyatlarini belgilashda muhim ahamiyatga ega. Botanik jihatdan meva po‘stining tashqi qismi odatda ekzokarp bilan bog‘liq.
etymology_uz: Forscha pūst — "teri, tashqi qoplama, po‘st".
example_uz: Pishib yetilganini meva po‘stining somon rangga kirishidan, oq o‘rikni esa meva po‘stining yashil rangdan och yashil va oq tusga kirishidan bilsa bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The outer protective covering of a fruit. Fruit skin protects the underlying tissues and contributes to the regulation of water loss, external appearance, and postharvest quality. In botanical terminology, fruit skin is generally associated with the epidermis and exocarp.
example_en: Apple skin was investigated as a source of natural antioxidants. (Huber G.M., Rupasinghe H.P.V. “Phenolic Profiles and Antioxidant Properties of Apple Skin Extracts.” Journal of Food Science, 2009, 74(9): C693–C700)

definition_uz: Daraxt, buta va boshqa yog‘ochli o‘simliklarning poya hamda ildizlarida kambiydan tashqarida joylashgan to‘qimalar majmui. Po‘stloq ichki tirik qism, jumladan ikkilamchi floema hamda tashqi himoya to‘qimalarini o‘z ichiga oladi. U o‘simlikni mexanik shikastlanish, suv yo‘qotish, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchilar va noqulay tashqi muhit ta’siridan himoya qiladi; ichki po‘stloq tarkibidagi floema esa organik moddalarni tashishda ishtirok etadi.
example_uz: Po‘stloq qobiqlari ko‘chayotgan keksa meva daraxtlarida 60–80 ta qurt qishlashi mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. R. Yunusov va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The tissues occurring outside the vascular cambium in the stems and roots of woody plants. Bark includes secondary phloem and periderm and performs important protective functions, while the living phloem is involved in the transport of organic substances.
example_en: Bark is the outermost layer of woody plants (trees, shrubs and woody climbers). (How Plants Grow and Thrive. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Yong‘oq, ayrim urug‘ va mevalarning ichki qismini o‘rab turadigan qattiq yoki nisbatan qattiq himoya qatlami. Po‘choq ichki qismlarni mexanik shikastlanish va tashqi muhit ta’siridan himoya qiladi. Uning kelib chiqishi, tuzilishi va qalinligi o‘simlik turiga qarab farqlanadi.
example_uz: Po‘stining qalinligi va chaqilishiga ko‘ra, yong‘oq yupqa po‘stli, o‘rtacha qalin po‘choqli va qalin yoki qattiq po‘choqli xillarga bo‘linadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A hard or relatively hard protective covering surrounding the kernel, seed, or inner part of certain fruits and nuts. In nuts such as walnut, the shell forms a physical barrier that protects the seed and embryo from mechanical damage and environmental factors.
etymology_en: From Old English scell, meaning "shell, husk, or hard outer covering".
example_en: The walnut shell is a hard and protective layer that provides an essential barrier between the seed and its environment. (From the Soft to the Hard: Changes in Microchemistry During Cell Wall Maturation of Walnut Shells. Xiao N. et al., Frontiers in Plant Science, 2020)

definition_uz: O‘simlikni vegetativ ko‘paytirish uchun ona o‘simlikdan ajratib olinadigan poya, novda, ildiz yoki barg qismi. Qalamcha tegishli sharoitda qo‘shimcha ildiz va/yoki novdalar hosil qilib, yangi mustaqil o‘simlikka rivojlanishi mumkin. Bog‘dorchilikda mevali, rezavor, tok va manzarali o‘simliklarni vegetativ ko‘paytirishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Tok qalamchalardan ko‘paytirilganda bo‘lg‘usi organlar qutblilik asosida, ya’ni qalamchaning yuqori tomonidan novdalar, pastki tomonidan ildiz hosil qiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A vegetative part of a plant, such as a piece of stem, shoot, root, or leaf, removed from the parent plant and used for asexual propagation. Under suitable conditions, a cutting can develop adventitious roots and/or shoots and grow into a new independent plant.
example_en: Cutting propagation uses vegetative portions of a plant (e.g. stem, root, leaf) to produce a new independent plant that is a clone of the parent plant. (USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service. “Dormant Hardwood Stem Cutting Propagation: Selection, Storage, and Preparation.” Plant Materials Technical Note No. MT-29, Rev. 1, 2019)

definition_uz: O‘rikning (Prunus armeniaca L.) Markaziy Osiyoda yetishtiriladigan mahalliy navlaridan biri. Mevalari shirin va qandga boy bo‘lib, yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda quritish uchun foydalaniladi. Qandak quritishga yaroqli mahalliy o‘rik navlaridan biri sifatida qadrlanadi.
example_uz: O‘rik navlari ichida qandak o‘rik o‘ziga xos shirali turi hisoblanadi. (Botanik terminlarni antroposentrik paradigmada o‘rganishning ahamiyati. Ikromov M.T., Namangan davlat universiteti Ilmiy axborotnomasi, 2025, №2)
definition_en: A local apricot cultivar grown in Central Asia. Its fruits are valued for their sweetness and are consumed fresh as well as used for drying.
example_en: In Tajikistan the following varieties are grown: isfarak, khurmoi, tojiboi, subhoni, qandak, boboi, mahtobi, javoni, mirsanjali, etc. (Jafr Old and Tajik Tradition. People and Plants)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Olmaning (Malus domestica Borkh.) Qrimda kelib chiqqan qadimiy navi. Daraxti kuchli o‘sadi, shox-shabbasi nisbatan tor va tik o‘suvchi. Mevalari o‘ziga xos cho‘ziq, baland konussimon yoki silindrsimon shaklli, asosiy rangi och sariq bo‘lib, quyosh tushgan tomonida qizg‘ish tus hosil qiladi. Eti oq, sersuv va mayin bo‘lib, shirin, biroz nordon va xushbo‘y ta’mga ega. Mevalari yaxshi saqlanish xususiyati bilan ajralib turadi.
example_uz: Olma daraxtlarini yetishtirishda madaniy olma navlaridan Rozmarin, Qandil sinap, Parmen zimniy zolotoy kabi daraxtlarning mevasidan tayyorlangan urug‘lar kuchli payvandtag hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An old apple cultivar (Malus domestica Borkh.) of Crimean origin. Its fruit is characteristically elongated, tall-conical to cylindrical, with a pale-yellow ground colour and a reddish blush. The flesh is white and juicy, with a sweet, slightly acidic and aromatic flavour. The fruit is noted for its good keeping quality.
example_en: Winter apple types “Renet Simirenko” and “Kandil Sinap” that have been harvested in the mountainous areas of the Namangan region were analyzed in both pre- and post-harvest period. (Merganov A., Abdullaev Z., Halimboev A. “The Storage Technology of Local Winter Apples in Controlled Atmosphere Storage.” European Journal of Technical and Natural Sciences, 2024, No. 3–4, pp. 3–6)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Ochiq urug‘lilarning Pinales tartibiga mansub ignabargli daraxt va butalar oilasi. Vakillarining ko‘pchiligi doim yashil, ayrimlari, jumladan tilog‘och (Larix), barg to‘kuvchi hisoblanadi. Barglari odatda ignasimon, urug‘lari esa urug‘chi qubbalarda rivojlanadi. Oilaga qarag‘ay (Pinus), qoraqarag‘ay (Picea), pixta (Abies), tilog‘och (Larix), kedr (Cedrus), tsuga (Tsuga) va boshqa turkumlar kiradi.
example_uz: Qarag‘aydoshlar oilasiga mansub turlar O‘zbekistonda, asosan, ko‘kalamzorlashtirish va ihota o‘rmonlari barpo etishda keng qo‘llaniladi. (Qarag‘aydoshlar. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, 2005)
definition_en: A family of coniferous gymnosperms in the order Pinales, comprising trees and shrubs that are mostly evergreen, although some genera, such as Larix, are deciduous. The family includes 11 currently accepted genera, including Pinus, Picea, Abies, Larix, Cedrus, Tsuga, and Pseudotsuga.
etymology_en: Pinaceae is derived from the genus name Pinus, the Latin name for pine, with the botanical family suffix -aceae.
example_en: Pinaceae species often form the dominant component of boreal, coastal, and montane forests in the northern hemisphere. (Lin C.P. et al. “Comparative Chloroplast Genomics Reveals the Evolution of Pinaceae Genera and Subfamilies.” Genome Biology and Evolution, 2010, 2: 504–517)

definition_uz: Urug‘, ko‘chat yoki boshqa ekish materiallarini belgilangan qatorlar bo‘ylab, qator oralig‘i va o‘simliklar orasidagi masofaga rioya qilgan holda joylashtirib ekish usuli. Qatorlab ekish o‘simliklarning tartibli joylashishini ta’minlaydi hamda qator oralari va o‘simliklarni parvarish qilish, begona o‘tlarga qarshi kurashish, mexanizatsiyalashgan ishlov berish va hosilni yig‘ishtirish kabi agrotexnik tadbirlarni yengillashtiradi.
example_uz: Keng qatorlab ekilganda qator orasiga mexanizatsiya yordamida ishlov berish osonlashadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A planting method in which seeds, seedlings, transplants, or other planting materials are arranged in rows at specified distances between rows and, where applicable, between individual plants. Row planting facilitates crop management and can make mechanical seeding, cultivation, weeding, and harvesting more efficient.
example_en: Row planting is generally used for large crops, such as sweet corn and tomatoes, but these crops can also be planted in a double row to save space. (The Pacific Northwest Gardener’s Handbook: Growing for the Future, Chapter 7: Vegetable Gardening. Washington State University Extension)

definition_uz: Qayindoshlar (Betulaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt va butalar turkumi. Barglari oddiy, odatda navbat bilan joylashgan va chetlari tishli. Gullari bir jinsli kuchalalarda joylashadi va shamol yordamida changlanadi. Mevasi odatda mayda, bir urug‘li va qanotli yong‘oqcha. Qayin turlari manzarali ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, o‘rmonchilik va yog‘och mahsulotlari olishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Qayin erta bahorda gullaydi va shu paytda barg ham yozadi. Shamol vositasida changlanadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A genus of deciduous trees and shrubs in the family Betulaceae. Birches have simple, usually serrate leaves and unisexual flowers borne in catkins and are wind-pollinated. Their fruits are small nutlets, typically with membranous wings. Many species are valued as ornamental and forest trees.
etymology_en: From Old English birce, ultimately of Germanic origin.
example_en: The genus Betula consists of about 60 species of deciduous hardwood trees and shrubs native to Europe, Asia and North America. (Thurn M., Lamb E., Eshenaur B. “Disease and Insect Resistant Ornamental Plants: Betula (Birch).” New York State Integrated Pest Management Program, Cornell University, 2019)

definition_uz: Qayrag‘ochdoshlar (Ulmaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi, kamdan-kam hollarda yarim doim yashil daraxtlar va ayrim butalar turkumi. Barglari oddiy, navbatma-navbat joylashgan, odatda tuxumsimon yoki ellipssimon va chetlari tishli. Gullari mayda va ko‘rimsiz. Mevasi odatda yassi, qanotli samara bo‘lib, shamol yordamida tarqaladi. Qayrag‘ochlarning ko‘plab turlari ko‘kalamzorlashtirish, o‘rmonchilik va yog‘ochsozlikda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Quyida turli ekologik omillarga chidamli bo‘lgan o‘simliklar ro‘yxati keltirilgan: qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli — oq akatsiya, oddiy gledichiya, qayrag‘och, jiyda, maklyura, sovun daraxti, oq tut. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A genus of deciduous, rarely semi-evergreen, trees and occasionally shrubs in the family Ulmaceae. Elms typically have alternate, simple, serrated leaves, inconspicuous flowers, and winged fruits known as samaras. Many species are cultivated as ornamental, shade, and landscape trees.
etymology_en: From Old English elm, of Germanic origin.
example_en: Ulmus are deciduous trees, often large, with elliptic or ovate leaves often colouring well in autumn; inconspicuous flowers are followed by winged fruits. (Ulmus — Elm. Royal Horticultural Society)
