definition_uz: O‘simlikning, ayniqsa buta, yashil devor va manzarali o‘simliklarning yosh novdalari yoki tashqi o‘suvchi qismlarini bog‘ qaychisi yoxud maxsus qaychi yordamida kesib, ularning shakli va o‘lchamini tartibga solmoq. Qaychilash ko‘pincha yashil devorlarni belgilangan shaklda saqlash va zich o‘sishni ta’minlash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Qaychi otidan -la fe’l yasovchi qo‘shimchasi orqali hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Katta bo‘lib qolganda o‘tqazishga yaramaydi, shuningdek, shox-shabbalarini kesish va qaychilab bo‘lmaydi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: To cut back the outer growth or new shoots of a plant, especially a shrub or hedge, using shears in order to control its shape and size and promote dense growth.
etymology_en: From Old English scieran, meaning "to cut".
example_en: To obtain a full, thick hedge, prune (shear) the shoots often as they grow back in spring and summer. (Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, “Pruning Large, Overgrown Shrubs”)

definition_uz: Qarag‘aydoshlar (Pinaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxt. Yoshligida shox-shabbasi zich va piramidasimon bo‘lib, yoshi ulg‘aygan sari kengayib, tartibsizroq shaklga kiradi. Ignalari to‘q yashil, qattiq va juft-juft joylashadi; qubbalari tuxumsimon bo‘lib, yetilganda och jigarrang tusga kiradi. Qora qarag‘ay qurg‘oqchilikka va ayrim noqulay shahar sharoitlariga chidamliligi hamda manzarali xususiyatlari tufayli ko‘kalamzorlashtirish va o‘rmonchilikda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Ninabargli daraxt turlari ichida asosiy turlari qora qarag‘ay, mojjevelnik sinfi (archalar); yaproqbargli daraxt turlari ichidan yong‘oq, chinor, eman, qayin, qayrag‘och va boshqalar. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A large evergreen coniferous tree of the family Pinaceae. It develops a dense pyramidal crown when young, becoming broader and more irregular with age. The needles are dark green, stiff, and borne in pairs, and the cones are ovoid and become pale brown at maturity. The species is valued in landscape planting and forestry and shows tolerance of drought and a range of growing conditions.
example_en: A large evergreen tree developing an irregular, dense crown with age. (Pinus nigra — Austrian pine. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Qoraqatdoshlar (Grossulariaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik rezavor mevali buta. Barglari oddiy va kaftsimon bo‘lakli, gullari shingil to‘pgulda joylashadi. Mevasi mayda, qora rangli, xushbo‘y rezavor bo‘lib, C vitamini, antosianlar va boshqa biologik faol moddalarga boy. Mevalari yangi iste’mol qilinadi hamda murabbo, sharbat va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda qorag‘atning oltinsimon, qora, qizil, oq kabi turlari tarqalgan. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: A perennial berry-producing shrub of the family Grossulariaceae. It has simple lobed leaves, flowers arranged in racemes, and aromatic black berries rich in vitamin C, anthocyanins, and other bioactive compounds. The fruits are consumed fresh or processed into juices, jams, and preserves.
example_en: Ribes nigrum L. is an accepted species of the family Grossulariaceae, native from Europe to the Russian Far East and Central Asia. (Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. Plants of the World Online, Ribes nigrum L., accessed 2026)

definition_uz: Qulmoqdoshlar (Cannabaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon chirmashuvchi o‘simlik. Poyalari tayanchlarga o‘ralib o‘sadi, barglari oddiy, qarama-qarshi joylashgan va odatda 3–5 bo‘lakli. O‘simlik ikki uyli bo‘lib, erkak va urg‘ochi gullari alohida o‘simliklarda rivojlanadi. Urg‘ochi to‘pgullari yetilganda g‘uddasimon, konussimon tuzilma hosil qiladi va tarkibida pivo ishlab chiqarishda muhim bo‘lgan achchiq hamda xushbo‘y moddalar mavjud. Qulmoq asosan pivochilikda, shuningdek dorivor va manzarali o‘simlik sifatida foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Oddiy qulmoq ikki pallali, o‘raluvchi o‘simliklar oilasiga mansub bo‘lib, ayniqsa sovuq va nam iqlimli hududlarda keng tarqalgan. (Oddiy qulmoq (Humulus lupulus L.)ning sharq tabobatidagi ahamiyati. Sarsenbaev A.A., PEDAGOGS International Research Journal, 2025(1))
definition_en: A perennial herbaceous climbing plant in the family Cannabaceae. It has twining stems, opposite, usually three- to five-lobed leaves, and separate male and female plants. The female inflorescences develop into aromatic cone-like structures rich in bitter and aromatic compounds. Hop is cultivated primarily for use in the brewing industry and is also used as a medicinal and ornamental plant.
example_en: Humulus lupulus L. (Cannabaceae), commonly named hop, is widely grown around the world for its use in the brewing industry. (Humulus lupulus L., a Very Popular Beer Ingredient and Medicinal Plant: Overview of Its Phytochemistry, Its Bioactivity, and Its Biotechnology. Bocquet L., Sahpaz S., Hilbert J.L., Rambaud C., Rivière C., Phytochemistry Reviews, 2018)

uzbek: Qulupnay (Fragaria × ananassa (Duchesne ex Weston) Duchesne ex Rozier)
definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Fragaria turkumiga mansub ko‘p yillik madaniy gibrid rezavor ekin. Fragaria chiloensis va Fragaria virginiana turlarining duragayi hisoblanadi. Barglari odatda uch bargchali, gullari oq rangli bo‘lib, o‘simlik yer ustida hosil qiladigan sudraluvchi novdalari — mo‘ylovlari orqali vegetativ ko‘payishi mumkin. Iste’mol qilinadigan qizil, shirali qismi kattalashgan gulo‘rnidan hosil bo‘lgan qo‘shimcha (soxta) meva bo‘lib, uning yuzasida haqiqiy mevalar — mayda yong‘oqchalar (achenes) joylashadi. Qulupnay yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi va turli mahsulotlarga qayta ishlanadi.
example_uz: Qulupnayning soxta mevasi guldondan o‘sib chiqqan to‘qimalardan hosil bo‘lib, unda mayda yong‘oqsimon urug‘lar joylashadi. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
english: Garden strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa (Duchesne ex Weston) Duchesne ex Rozier)
definition_en: A perennial cultivated hybrid of the family Rosaceae, derived from Fragaria chiloensis and Fragaria virginiana. Garden strawberry plants typically have trifoliate leaves, white flowers, and runners that enable vegetative propagation. The edible fleshy part is an enlarged receptacle, while the numerous small structures on its surface are the true fruits, known as achenes.
example_en: The anatomy of strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa) fruit, in which the achene is found on the outer part of the fruit, makes it an excellent species for studying the regulation of fruit development. (Fait A. et al. “Reconfiguration of the Achene and Receptacle Metabolic Networks during Strawberry Fruit Development.” Plant Physiology, 2008, 148(2): 730–750)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organi, ayniqsa gulning markaziy o‘qi atrofida simmetrik tuzilish xususiyati bo‘lib, bunda organ markaziy o‘q orqali o‘tuvchi ikki yoki undan ortiq tekislik bo‘yicha o‘zaro o‘xshash qismlarga bo‘linishi mumkin. Radial simmetriyali gullar aktinomorf gullar deb ataladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha radius — "nur, shu’la" + yunoncha symmetria — "mutanosiblik, o‘lchovlarning mosligi".
example_uz: Aktinomorf gullardan bir nechta simmetrik chiziq o‘tkazib teng bo‘lish mumkin. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Hamdamov I.H., Hamdamova E.I., Suvonova G.A., Begmatova M., 2017)
definition_en: A type of symmetry in which a plant organ, especially a flower, can be divided into similar halves by two or more planes passing through its central axis. In floral morphology, radial symmetry is commonly referred to as actinomorphy.
etymology_en: Radial derives from Latin radius, meaning "ray"; symmetry derives from Greek symmetria, meaning "agreement in dimensions or due proportion".
example_en: Two main types of flower symmetry are widely found in nature: zygomorphy (mono-symmetry, i.e. bilateral symmetry) and actinomorphy (poly-symmetry, i.e. radial symmetry). (Citerne S. et al. “Floral symmetry: the geometry of plant reproduction.” New Phytologist, 2022)

definition_uz: Yopiq urug‘li o‘simliklarning Rosales tartibiga mansub yirik oilasi. Oila tarkibiga daraxtlar, butalar va o‘t o‘simliklari kiradi. Barglari odatda navbatma-navbat joylashgan, oddiy yoki murakkab va ko‘pincha yonbargchali. Gullari ko‘pincha ikki jinsli va radial simmetriyali, odatda 5 ta kosachabarg va 5 ta gultojibargga ega. Meva tiplari xilma-xil bo‘lib, danakmeva, olmasimon meva, yong‘oqcha, to‘pmeva va boshqa shakllarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Oilaga ko‘plab muhim mevali, rezavor mevali, dorivor va manzarali o‘simliklar kiradi.
example_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar — Rosaceae oilasi 120 ta turkum va 3000 dan ortiq tur kiradi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Botirova L.A., Ergasheva N.A.)
definition_en: A large family of flowering plants in the order Rosales, comprising trees, shrubs, and herbs. The leaves are usually alternate, simple or compound, and commonly stipulate. Flowers are usually bisexual and actinomorphic, commonly with five sepals and five petals. Fruits are highly diverse and include drupes, pomes, achenes, follicles, and aggregate fruits. The family includes numerous economically important fruit, medicinal, and ornamental plants.
etymology_en: From the type genus Rosa, Latin for "rose", + the botanical family suffix -aceae.
example_en: A cosmopolitan family of 92 genera and ca. 2,805 species, especially diverse in the northern hemisphere. (The Kew Temperate Plant Families Identification Handbook. Bramley G., Trias-Blasi A., Wilford R., Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 2023)

definition_uz: Karamdoshlar (Brassicaceae) oilasiga mansub tezpishar ildizmevali sabzavot ekini. Rediska turpga nisbatan odatda kichikroq ildizmeva hosil qilishi va qisqa vegetatsiya davri bilan ajralib turadi. Ildizmevasi yumaloq, yassi-yumaloq yoki cho‘zinchoq bo‘lib, oq, qizil, pushti, binafsha yoki ikki rangli bo‘lishi mumkin. Eti sersuv, qarsildoq va o‘ziga xos o‘tkir ta’mli. Ildizmevasi odatda yoshligida yig‘ib olinadi va asosan yangi holda, jumladan salatlarda iste’mol qilinadi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha редиска so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; rus tiliga nemischa Radieschen — "kichik turp" so‘zidan kirgan.
example_uz: Rediska urug‘lari unib chiqqaniga 30–35 kun bo‘lganda iste’mol qilish mumkin bo‘ladi, ammo ildizmevasi g‘ovak bo‘lib qolgandan so‘ng poya berib, urug‘ hosil qiladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
english: Salad radish (Raphanus sativus L. var. sativus)
definition_en: A small, fast-growing type of radish in the family Brassicaceae, cultivated for its crisp and succulent edible root. Compared with larger and later-maturing radish types, salad radishes generally have a short growing period and produce smaller round, flattened-round, or elongated roots that may be red, pink, white, purple, or bicoloured. They are typically harvested young and consumed fresh, especially in salads.
etymology_en: Salad refers to its common use as a fresh salad vegetable; radish ultimately derives from Latin radix, meaning "root".
example_en: Salad radishes (also known as spring or summer radishes) are the most popular and widely grown type. They are small and fast growing. (Royal Horticultural Society. “How to Grow Radishes.”)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning shikastlangan yoki yo‘qolgan hujayra, to‘qima va organlarini qayta tiklash, shuningdek ayrim hujayra yoki to‘qimalardan yangi organlar yoki butun o‘simlik hosil qilish qobiliyati va jarayoni. Regeneratsiya o‘simliklarning tabiiy tiklanishida, vegetativ ko‘payishida va to‘qima kulturasida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Lotincha regeneratio — "qayta tug‘ilish, qayta tiklanish", re- — "qayta" + generare — "yaratmoq, tug‘dirmoq".
example_uz: Regeneratsiya jarayonida tashqi muhit sharoiti — harorat, oziqlanish, yorug‘lik va boshqalar, shuningdek, shikastlangan vaqt ham katta ahamiyatga ega. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The process by which plants restore damaged or lost cells, tissues, or organs, or form new organs or whole plants from cells or tissues. Plant regeneration occurs naturally in response to injury and is also fundamental to vegetative propagation and plant tissue culture.
etymology_en: From Latin regeneratio, meaning "rebirth" or "renewal", from re- ("again") + generare ("to produce or create").
example_en: Plant regeneration is the process by which plants repair or replace damaged tissues and organs or generate whole plants from groups of somatic cells. (Plant regeneration: cellular origins and molecular mechanisms. Ikeuchi M., Ogawa Y., Iwase A., Sugimoto K., Development, 2016)

definition_uz: Bir vegetatsiya davrida takroran gullash yoki bir necha marta hosil berish xususiyatiga ega bo‘lgan o‘simlik yoki navga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Remontantlik bog‘dorchilikda qulupnay, malina, atirgul va ayrim boshqa rezavor hamda manzarali o‘simliklarda uchraydi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha remontant, remonter — "qayta ko‘tarilmoq, yana ko‘tarilmoq".
example_uz: Remontant xo‘jag‘at navlari avgustning ikkinchi yarmida ikkinchi marta meva soladi. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: Describing a plant or cultivar capable of flowering or fruiting repeatedly within a growing season. In horticulture, the term is used for repeat-flowering or repeat-fruiting cultivars, particularly in crops such as strawberries and raspberries and in ornamental plants such as roses.
etymology_en: From French remontant, from remonter, meaning "to rise again".
example_en: The cultivars Geneva and Ostara (remontant, everbearing, TB) and Marastil and Selva (day-neutral, DN) were compared with 'Senga Sengana' (June-bearing). (Gwozdecki J. “Fruiting of Remontant (Everbearing) and Day-Neutral Strawberry Cultivars in Poland.” Acta Horticulturae, 1997, 439: 543–544)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Urug‘chilikda navning genetik va nav sofligini saqlagan holda urug‘likni ketma-ket avlodlar bo‘yicha ko‘paytirish bosqichi. Reproduksiya atamasi elita urug‘idan keyingi ko‘paytirish avlodlarini, masalan, birinchi reproduksiya urug‘ligini ifodalashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha reproductio — "qayta hosil qilish, ko‘paytirish".
example_uz: Nav yangilash jarayonida barcha xo‘jaliklarni yangitdan rayonlashtirilgan navlarning elita va 1-reproduksiya urug‘liklari bilan ta’minlashda birlamchi urug‘chilik muhim ahamiyatga ega. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: The successive multiplication of seed through defined generations or seed classes while maintaining the identity and genetic purity of a cultivar.
example_en: Most of the seed production systems in the world follow 3 or 4 generations of seed multiplication starting from pre-basic or breeder seed. (Principles of Variety Maintenance for Quality Seed Production. Springer, 2023)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning ko‘payishi va avlod hosil qilishi bilan bog‘liq organlar, tuzilmalar, jarayonlar yoki rivojlanish bosqichlariga oid. Gulli o‘simliklarda reproduktiv rivojlanish gul hosil bo‘lishi bilan boshlanib, changlanish, urug‘lanish, meva va urug‘ning shakllanishi kabi jarayonlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Gul kurtaklari, gullar, mevalar va urug‘lar reproduktiv tuzilmalarga kiradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha reproductio — "qayta hosil qilish, ko‘paytirish" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Reproduktiv kurtaklarda gullar, so‘ngra esa meva yoki rezavor meva rivojlanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Relating to the organs, structures, processes, or developmental stages involved in plant reproduction. In flowering plants, reproductive development involves the formation of flowers and subsequent processes such as pollination, fertilization, fruit development, and seed formation.
etymology_en: From reproduction, ultimately derived from Latin reproducere, meaning "to produce again".
example_en: The appearance of these inflorescences signals the transition of the plant from vegetative to reproductive stages. (The Science of Plants. University of Minnesota Libraries Publishing)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning vegetativ o‘sishini, ayniqsa poya va bo‘g‘im oralig‘ining cho‘zilishini sekinlashtiruvchi o‘sishni boshqaruvchi fiziologik faol modda. Retardantlar o‘simlik bo‘yini nazorat qilish, bo‘g‘im oralig‘ini qisqartirish, poyani mustahkamlash, yotib qolishni kamaytirish va o‘simlik arxitekturasini boshqarish uchun qo‘llaniladi. Ko‘pchilik retardantlar gibberellinlar biosintezini ingibitsiya qilish orqali ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha retardare — "sekinlashtirmoq, kechiktirmoq".
example_uz: Keyingi yillarda daraxtlarga maxsus moddalar — retardantlarni purkash yo‘li bilan ularning o‘sishini to‘xtatib turishning kimyoviy usuli ishlab chiqildi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A plant growth regulator used to reduce excessive shoot and stem elongation, particularly by limiting internode extension. Plant growth retardants are used to control plant height and architecture, and many of them act by inhibiting gibberellin biosynthesis.
etymology_en: From Latin retardare, meaning "to slow down or delay".
example_en: Plant growth retardants are applied in agronomic and horticultural crops to reduce unwanted longitudinal shoot growth without lowering plant productivity. (Growth Retardants: Effects on Gibberellin Biosynthesis and Other Metabolic Pathways. Rademacher W., Annual Review of Plant Physiology and Plant Molecular Biology, 2000, 51: 501–531)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilikda nisbatan mayda, yumshoq va ko‘pincha shirali mevalar hamda shunday meva beruvchi ekinlarga nisbatan qo‘llanadigan termin. Rezavorlarga qulupnay, malina, maymunjon, qoraqat, krijovnik, chernika va boshqa shu kabi mevalar kiradi. Bog‘dorchilikdagi rezavor tushunchasi botanikadagi rezavor meva tipidan kengroq bo‘lib, qulupnay va malina kabi botanik jihatdan haqiqiy rezavor hisoblanmaydigan mevalarni ham qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha reza — "mayda, kichik, dona-dona".
example_uz: Mevali daraxt va rezavorlar juda qadim zamondan o‘rmonlarda yovvoyi holda o‘sadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: In horticultural usage, a relatively small, soft, and usually juicy fruit belonging to a group that includes strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, currants, gooseberries, and similar fruits. The horticultural category of berry fruits is broader than the botanical definition of a berry, since some fruits traditionally classified as berry fruits, such as strawberries and raspberries, are not true berries botanically.
example_en: Berry fruits, which are commercially cultivated and commonly consumed in fresh and processed forms in North America, include blackberry, black raspberry, blueberry, cranberry, red raspberry and strawberry. (Seeram N.P. “Berry Fruits: Compositional Elements, Biochemical Activities, and the Impact of Their Intake on Human Health, Performance, and Disease.” Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry, 2008, 56(3): 627–629)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilikda odatda hajmi nisbatan kichik, etli va sersuv mevalar yetishtiradigan ekinlarning mevalarini birlashtiruvchi xo‘jalik-bog‘dorchilik guruhi. Bu guruhga qulupnay, malina, maymunjon, qoraqat, krijovnik, chernika, chakanda va boshqa rezavor ekinlarning mevalari kiradi. Rezavor mevalar botanik jihatdan yagona meva tipiga mansub emas: ular orasida haqiqiy rezavor mevalar bilan birga murakkab va soxta mevalar ham mavjud. Ular yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi va qayta ishlashda keng foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha reza — "mayda, kichik, dona-dona".
example_uz: Rezavor mevalari yirik (1,7–4,5 g), yumaloq shaklda, deyarli qora rangda, po‘stlog‘i o‘rtacha yupqa, shirin ta’mga ega. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: A horticultural group comprising relatively small, fleshy fruits from crops such as strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, currants, gooseberries, blueberries, and sea buckthorn. The term is horticultural rather than strictly botanical, since not all berry fruits are botanically classified as berries. They are widely consumed fresh and used for processing.
example_en: Berry fruits, which are commercially cultivated and commonly consumed in fresh and processed forms in North America, include blackberry, black raspberry, blueberry, cranberry, red raspberry and strawberry. (Berry Fruits: Compositional Elements, Biochemical Activities, and the Impact of Their Intake on Human Health, Performance, and Disease. Seeram N.P., Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry, 2008, 56(3): 627–629)

definition_uz: Rezavorfurush, ya’ni ko‘kat, sabzavot va boshqa mayda bog‘dorchilik mahsulotlarini sotish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxs. O‘zbek leksikografik manbalarida rezavorchi ko‘kat va sabzavot ekinlarini yetishtiruvchi hamda sotuvchi kishi, shuningdek ayrim hollarda ziravorlar savdosi bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxs ma’nolarida ham qayd etiladi.
example_uz: Rezavorchi — ko‘kat va sabzavot ekinlari yetishtiruvchi va sotuvchi kishi. (O‘zbek tilida kasb-kor ifodalovchi leksik birliklarning leksikografik talqini. Hasanova D., O‘zbekiston: til va madaniyat. Amaliy filologiya masalalari, 2023, №1(5))
definition_en: A person who sells fresh fruit and vegetables. In this entry, greengrocer is used as the closest functional equivalent of the Uzbek rezavorchi in its traditional sense of a person engaged in selling greens, vegetables, and related horticultural produce.
example_en: Greengrocers may be the most accessible fruit and vegetable retail outlet. (Do Farmers’ Markets Offer Consumers an Available and Affordable Supply of Fresh Fruit and Vegetables Compared to Other Retail Outlets in Australia? Abley S. et al., Journal of Hunger & Environmental Nutrition, 2020, 15(6): 827–834)

definition_uz: Rezavor va boshqa mayda mevali ekinlarni yetishtirish hamda parvarish qilish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi dehqon yoki mutaxassis. Rezaparvar ekinlarni ekish, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, butash, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish hamda hosilni yetishtirish bilan bog‘liq agrotexnik tadbirlarni amalga oshiradi.
example_uz: Dehqonchilik ma’nosini ifodalovchi shaxs nomlari qatorida rezaparvar — mayda ekinlarni parvarishlovchi, dehqon ma’nosida keltiriladi. (Bilingualism, pluralinguism expansion and sociolinguistic analysis in Uzbekistan during the years of independence. Zaripov R.E., Middle European Scientific Bulletin, 2020, Vol. 6, 71–75-b.)
definition_en: A person who grows and manages berry crops such as strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, currants, and gooseberries for commercial or other horticultural production.
example_en: This two-part nursery guide for berry growers cross references scores of cultivars with the nurseries that sell them. (Cornell Fruit Resources: Berries, Cornell University)

definition_uz: Rezavor ekinlarni, jumladan qulupnay, malina, maymunjon, qoraqat, krijovnik, chernika, chakanda va boshqa mayda mevali ekinlarni ko‘paytirish, yetishtirish, parvarish qilish, hosilini yig‘ish va undan foydalanish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mevachilik tarmog‘i.
example_uz: Rezavorchilik tarmog‘i zamonaviy intensiv bog‘dorchilikning eng daromadli yo‘nalishlaridan biri bo‘lib, tomchilatib sug‘orish va bino ichida yetishtirish texnologiyalari orqali yil davomida uzluksiz mahsulot yetkazib berish imkonini yaratadi. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: The branch of fruit production concerned with the cultivation and management of berry crops, including strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, currants, gooseberries, and other small-fruit crops. It encompasses cultivar selection, soil and nutrient management, irrigation, crop protection, harvesting, and post-harvest handling.
example_en: General information about berry crop production, including soil fertility and nutrients, soil management, cover crops, organic production, water management, produce safety, post-harvest handling, and much more. (New England Small Fruit Management Guide, University of Massachusetts Amherst Cooperative Extension, 2024–2025)

definition_uz: O‘simlik ildizlari bevosita ta’sir ko‘rsatadigan, ildiz ajratmalari, tuproq mikroorganizmlari va tuproq komponentlari o‘rtasida faol o‘zaro ta’sir kechadigan tuproq zonasi. Rizosferada bakteriyalar, zamburug‘lar va boshqa mikroorganizmlar bilan o‘simlik ildizlari o‘rtasida murakkab biologik va biokimyoviy jarayonlar sodir bo‘ladi. Bu zona o‘simliklarning mineral oziqlanishi, o‘sishi va sog‘lom rivojlanishida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha rhiza — "ildiz" + sphaira — "shar, sfera". Rhizosphere atamasi 1904-yilda nemis agronomi Lorenz Hiltner tomonidan ilmiy muomalaga kiritilgan.
example_uz: Fitopatogen bakteriyalar ildizmevalarda, tuganaklarda, o‘simlik qoldiqlarida, o‘simlik rizosferasida saqlanadi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The zone of soil immediately surrounding and influenced by plant roots, where root exudates, microorganisms, and soil components interact. The rhizosphere is a biologically active environment in which complex plant–microbe interactions occur and plays an important role in plant nutrition, growth, and health.
etymology_en: From Greek rhiza ("root") + sphaira ("sphere"). The term rhizosphere was coined by the German agronomist Lorenz Hiltner in 1904.
example_en: The rhizosphere encompasses the millimeters of soil surrounding a plant root where complex biological and ecological processes occur. (Bais H.P., Weir T.L., Perry L.G., Gilroy S., Vivanco J.M. “The Role of Root Exudates in Rhizosphere Interactions with Plants and Other Organisms.” Annual Review of Plant Biology, 2006, 57: 233–266)

definition_uz: O‘simlik ildizlari ta’siridagi rizosfera tuprog‘ida yashovchi va ildiz ajratmalari hamda tuproq muhiti orqali o‘simlik bilan o‘zaro ta’sir qiluvchi mikroorganizmlar majmui. Ularga bakteriyalar, zamburug‘lar, aktinomitsetlar va boshqa mikroorganizmlar kiradi. Rizosfera mikroorganizmlari oziq elementlarining aylanishi va o‘zlashtirilishi, organik moddalarning parchalanishi, o‘simlik o‘sishining rag‘batlantirilishi hamda ayrim tuproq patogenlariga qarshi himoyada muhim rol o‘ynaydi.
example_uz: Rizosferada yashovchi mikroorganizmlar orasida fosfatlarning qiyin eriydigan shakllarini mobilizatsiya qilishga qodir bo‘lgan ko‘plab bakteriyalar va zamburug‘lar ma’lum. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: Microorganisms that inhabit the rhizosphere and interact with plant roots through root exudates and soil processes. They include bacteria, fungi, actinomycetes, and other microbial groups and contribute to nutrient cycling and acquisition, organic matter decomposition, plant growth promotion, and protection against soil-borne pathogens.
example_en: The rhizosphere, as the “frontline” of plant life, connects plant roots, rhizosphere microorganisms, and surrounding soil, plays a crucial role in plant growth and health, particularly in sustainable agriculture. (Wang Y., Ding G., Xing X. “Mechanisms of rhizosphere plant-microbe interactions: molecular insights into microbial colonization.” Frontiers in Plant Science, 2024, 15:1491495)

definition_uz: Tuproq yuzasiga sayoz ishlov beradigan, aylanuvchi tishli yoki yulduzsimon ishchi organlarga ega qishloq xo‘jaligi quroli. Rotatsion motiga tuproq yuzasidagi qatqaloqni buzish, tuproqning ustki qatlamini yumshatish, yosh begona o‘tlarni mexanik yo‘qotish va qatorli ekinlarga ishlov berish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Maysalar unib chiqqunga qadar qatqaloq rotatsion motiga yoki tishli borona bilan buziladi, unib chiqqandan keyin qator oralari yumshatiladi. (Lalmi ochiq dalalarga ikki qavatli tonelli plyonka ostiga poliz ko‘chatlarini ekadigan mashina. Irgashev D.B. va boshq., Science and Innovation International Scientific Journal, 2022(5))
definition_en: A shallow soil-cultivation implement equipped with rotating toothed or star-shaped wheels. It is used to break soil crusts, loosen the surface soil, mechanically control young weeds, and cultivate row crops.
example_en: Rotary hoes and cultivators, unlike rotary tillers, are not powered. They are both designed to operate at shallow depth and are used for weed control in row crops, breaking soil crusts for better seedling emergence, and mixing of fertilizer. (Engineering Principles of Agricultural Machines. Srivastava A.K. et al., ASABE)

definition_uz: Vertikal o‘q atrofida aylanadigan tishli yoki pichoqli ishchi organlarga ega tuproq ishlov berish mashinalari. Rotatsion boronalar tuproqning ustki qatlamini yumshatish va maydalash, kesaklarni parchalash, yuzani tekislash hamda ekish yoki ko‘chat o‘tqazish uchun sifatli urug‘ yotqiziladigan qatlam tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Yuqorida ko‘rsatib o‘tilgan mashinalarning konstruktsiyasini takomillashtirish maqsadida keyingi yillarda osma va rotatsion boronalar, tuproqni diskalash va chizellash bilan birga o‘g‘it solish operatsiyalarini birga qo‘shib olib boradigan agregatlar yaratildi. (Tuproq kesaklarini maydalash jarayonida baraban plankalarini uzoq muddat ishlashini baholash. Qo‘chqorov S.K., 2024)
definition_en: PTO-driven soil-cultivation implements equipped with tines or blades rotating around vertical axes. Rotary harrows are used for secondary tillage to loosen and crumble soil, break up clods, level the soil surface, and prepare a suitable seedbed before sowing or transplanting.
example_en: Experimental tests on seed-bed preparation by means of three rotary harrows (with tools rotating on a vertical axe) and three rotary hoes (with tools rotating on an horizontal axe) were performed during 1996 on a loam soil. (Peruzzi A., Raffaelli M., Ginanni M., Fontanelli M. “Seedbed preparation with power take-off powered implements: comparison between rotary hoes and rotary harrows.” 2009)

definition_uz: O‘simlik poyasining bo‘g‘im oralig‘i juda qisqarganligi sababli barglarning bir-biriga yaqin va zich joylashishidan hosil bo‘ladigan morfologik tuzilma. Rozetkalar ko‘pincha o‘simlikning asosida hosil bo‘ladi, ammo boshqa qismlarida ham uchrashi mumkin. Bog‘dorchilik ekinlaridan qulupnay, salat, karam, lavlagi va ayrim manzarali o‘simliklarda rozetka shaklidagi o‘sish kuzatiladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha rosette — "kichik atirgul, gulcha".
example_uz: Barglarning poyada joylashish tiplari: spiralsimon (navbat bilan), qarama-qarshi, halqasimon, tupbargli (rozetka). (Botanika (o‘simliklar morfologiyasi va anatomiyasi). Tursinbayeva G.S., Duschanova G.M., Sadinov J.S., 2018)
definition_en: A compact arrangement of leaves resulting from greatly shortened stem internodes, so that the leaves are clustered closely together around a short stem. Rosettes commonly occur near the base of a plant, although they may also develop in other positions.
etymology_en: From French rosette, meaning "little rose".
example_en: Strawberry is a perennial rosette plant with short internodes in its crown. (Gibberellin mediates daylength-controlled differentiation of vegetative meristems in strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa Duch). Hytönen T. et al., BMC Plant Biology, 2009, 9:18)

definition_uz: Kechpishar qishki olma navi. Daraxti kuchli o‘sadi, shox-shabbasi keng piramidasimon bo‘lib, hosilga nisbatan kech kiradi. Mevasi o‘rtacha kattalikda, silliq po‘stli, cho‘ziq yoki tuxumsimon, och sariq yoki mumsimon-sariq tusli, quyosh tushgan tomonida ba’zan pushti qizillik hosil qiladi. Eti oq, mayin, sersuv, xushbo‘y va yoqimli nordon-shirin ta’mli. Mevalari yaxshi saqlanish xususiyatiga ega bo‘lib, asosan yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi.
example_uz: Rozmarin olma navining yovvoyi olma payvandtagiga ulab o‘stirilgan ko‘chati 8 × 6 m tartibda ekilishi kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A late-ripening winter apple cultivar characterized by vigorous tree growth and relatively late bearing. The fruits are generally medium-sized, elongated to ovoid, with smooth pale-yellow to waxy-yellow skin that may develop a pink blush on the sun-exposed side. The flesh is white, tender, juicy, aromatic, and pleasantly sweet-tart, and the fruits have good keeping quality.
example_en: Rosmarina Bianca, an old Italian cultivar, was found twice at Site 12 and many times as a recent ancestor at Sites 11 and 12. (DNA Profiling with the 20K Apple SNP Array Reveals Malus domestica Hybridization and Admixture in M. sieversii, M. orientalis, and M. sylvestris Genebank Accessions. Frontiers in Plant Science, 2022)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Evolyutsiya yoki rivojlanish jarayonida to‘liq rivojlanmay qolgan yoxud dastlabki vazifasini qisman yoki to‘liq yo‘qotgan organ, uning qismi yoki boshqa biologik tuzilma. O‘simliklarda rudimentlar rivojlanmay qolgan changchi, urug‘chi, urug‘kurtak, barg yoki boshqa organlar ko‘rinishida uchrashi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Lotincha rudimentum — "boshlanish, dastlabki holat, boshlang‘ich shakl".
example_uz: Evolutsiya jarayonida dastlabki ahamiyatini yo‘qotgan va batamom yo‘qolib ketish oldida turgan bunday a’zolar rudiment a’zolar yoki rudimentlar deb ataladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: An incompletely developed organ, part, or structure, including one arrested at an early stage of development or occurring in a reduced or vestigial state. In plants, rudiments may occur as reduced or incompletely developed floral or vegetative structures.
etymology_en: From Latin rudimentum, meaning "beginning, first attempt, or initial stage".
example_en: The rudiments of the stamens occur in certain species; they are two, but sterile, in the throat of the corolla, below the upper lip. (A Grammatical Dictionary of Botanical Latin. Missouri Botanical Garden)

definition_uz: Kimyoviy belgisi Zn bo‘lgan va o‘simliklar uchun zarur mikroelementlardan biri hisoblangan kimyoviy element. Rux ko‘plab fermentlarning tarkibiy qismi yoki faollashuvida ishtirok etib, o‘simliklarning normal o‘sishi va rivojlanishida muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Rux yetishmovchiligida barglar maydalashishi, tomir oralig‘ida xloroz, bo‘g‘im oralig‘ining qisqarishi, rozetkasimon o‘sish va o‘simlik o‘sishining susayishi kuzatilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Rux barglar va poyalardagi uglevodlar miqdorini ko‘paytiradi, o‘simlikning sovuqqa chidamliligini oshiradi, mevalar tugishiga va ularning yiriklashishiga, shirin bo‘lishiga, nordonligining kamayishiga yordam beradi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: An essential plant micronutrient with the chemical symbol Zn. Zinc is involved in the function of numerous enzymes and is required for normal plant growth and development. Zinc deficiency may cause interveinal chlorosis, reduced leaf size, shortened internodes, rosetting, and stunted growth.
etymology_en: The name zinc derives from German Zink.
example_en: Zinc, also involved in enzymes, produces characteristic deficiency symptoms associated with the poor development of leaves, e.g. ‘little leaf’ in citrus and peach, and ‘rosette leaf’ in apples. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Early M.P., Bamford K.M., 5th ed., Routledge, 2008)

definition_uz: Rux va sulfat ionlaridan tashkil topgan noorganik birikma bo‘lib, o‘simliklarni rux bilan ta’minlashda qo‘llaniladigan muhim mikroo‘g‘itlardan biri. Rux sulfat tuproqqa yoki barg orqali qo‘llanib, rux tanqisligini bartaraf etishga yordam beradi. Rux o‘simliklarda ko‘plab fermentlar faoliyati, o‘sishni boshqaruvchi moddalar almashinuvi, xlorofill va oqsil hosil bo‘lishi kabi fiziologik jarayonlarda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Kalsiy arsenati tarkibida rux sulfat bo‘lgan ho‘llovchi poroshok shaklida ishlatilganda unga ohak qo‘shilmaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An inorganic zinc compound widely used as a micronutrient fertilizer to supply zinc to plants and correct zinc deficiency. Zinc sulfate may be applied to the soil or, in appropriate formulations and concentrations, as a foliar treatment. Zinc supplied to plants is involved in enzyme function, growth regulation, chlorophyll formation, and protein synthesis.
example_en: Zinc sulfate (35% zinc) is usually used to supply the needed amount of zinc when dry fertilizer materials are used. (Zinc for Crop Production. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni rux (Zn) bilan ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladigan, tarkibida o‘simlik o‘zlashtira oladigan shakldagi rux mavjud bo‘lgan mikroo‘g‘itlar. Ruxli o‘g‘itlar rux tanqisligining oldini olish yoki uni bartaraf etish hamda o‘simliklarning normal o‘sishi va rivojlanishini ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi. Ular tuproqqa yoki barg orqali berilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Tuproqda o‘zlashtiriluvchi rux miqdori kam bo‘lgan sharoitda ruxli o‘g‘itlarni bargdan oziqlantirish usulida qo‘llash mevali daraxtlar va g‘o‘zada fotosintez jadalligini hamda hosil sifatini keskin oshiradi. (O‘g‘it qo‘llash tizimi. Xayitov M.A. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: Fertilizers that supply plant-available zinc (Zn), an essential micronutrient, to prevent or correct zinc deficiency and support normal plant growth and development. Zinc fertilizers include inorganic sources such as zinc sulfate and zinc oxide as well as chelated zinc sources, and may be applied to the soil or foliage.
etymology_en: Zinc derives from German Zink; fertilizer ultimately derives from Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful, fertile".
example_en: There are many zinc fertilizers, but only zinc sulfate, which contains 35.5% to 36% Zn, and zinc chelates are recommended for use on tree crops. (Commercial Tree Fruit Production Guide: Orchard Nutrition. Rutgers New Jersey Agricultural Experiment Station, 2025)

definition_uz: Sarvdoshlar (Cupressaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil, odatda past bo‘yli va keng yoyilib yoki yer bag‘irlab o‘suvchi ignabargli buta. Barglari yosh novdalarda ignasimon, yetuk novdalarda esa asosan tangachasimon bo‘ladi. Sabina archasi va uning navlari manzarali bog‘dorchilikda yer qoplovchi o‘simlik sifatida, qiyaliklarda, rokariylarda va boshqa landshaft kompozitsiyalarida qo‘llaniladi. O‘simlikning barcha qismlarida zaharli birikmalar, jumladan efir moylari mavjud.
example_uz: Sabina archasining vatani — Rossiya o‘lkasining markaziy hududi, Qrim, Kavkaz va Oltoy. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: An evergreen coniferous shrub of the family Cupressaceae, characterized by a wide-spreading growth habit. Its foliage includes scale-like leaves as well as awl- or needle-like leaves. Savin juniper and its cultivars are used in ornamental landscaping, including as ground cover and in mass plantings.
example_en: Savin juniper is an evergreen shrub with a wide-spreading habit. (Juniperus sabina. University of Connecticut Plant Database)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning o‘sib, unib chiqa boshlashi, yangi yashil o‘suv organlarining paydo bo‘lishi. Urug‘ yoki vegetativ organlardan yosh o‘simta va novdalarning rivojlana boshlashini ifodalashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Endi sabza urib kelayotgan ko‘katlarning, hali ochilmagan o‘rik gulining muattar hidlarini taratib yengil shamol esmoqda. (Bahor kunlaridan birida. Yoqubov O.)
definition_en: To begin to grow or develop new shoots from a seed, bud, bulb, tuber, or other plant organ.
example_en: Seeds need air, moisture and warmth in the correct amounts to sprout. (Starting from Seed. UF/IFAS Gardening Solutions, University of Florida)

definition_uz: Inson iste’moli uchun yetishtiriladigan o‘t o‘simligi yoki uning oziq-ovqat sifatida foydalaniladigan qismi. Sabzavot sifatida o‘simlikning ildizi, tuganagi, piyozboshi, poyasi, bargi, guli, mevasi yoki urug‘i iste’mol qilinishi mumkin. Sabzavot tushunchasi botanik tasnifdan ko‘ra ko‘proq o‘simlikning oziq-ovqat sifatida ishlatilishiga asoslangan; shu sabab pomidor, qalampir va bodring kabi botanik jihatdan meva hisoblangan tuzilmalar ham sabzavotchilikda sabzavot sifatida qaraladi.
etymology_uz: Forscha sabz — "yashil, ko‘k" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Sabzavotlarning barglari, poyalari, mevalari va ildizmevalari insonlar tomonidan iste’mol qilinadi va qayta ishlanadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A herbaceous plant, or an edible part of such a plant, cultivated or used for human food. Depending on the crop, the edible portion may be a root, tuber, bulb, stem, leaf, flower, fruit, or seed. Vegetable is primarily a horticultural and culinary category rather than a botanical one; therefore, some structures botanically classified as fruits, such as tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers, are treated as vegetables in horticulture.
etymology_en: From Middle English vegetable, ultimately from Latin vegetabilis — "growing, flourishing".
example_en: Most vegetables are grown in rows. This helps with many of the activities such as thinning and weed control. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Bamford K.M., Early M.P., 5th ed., Elsevier, 2008)

definition_uz: Inson iste’moli uchun foydalaniladigan sabzavot mahsulotlarini olish maqsadida yetishtiriladigan madaniy, odatda o‘t o‘simliklari guruhi. Sabzavot ekinlari botanik jihatdan turli oilalarga mansub bo‘lib, ularning ildiz, tuganak, piyozbosh, poya, barg, gul, meva yoki urug‘ kabi qismlari oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadi. Bu guruh botanik tasnifdan ko‘ra ekinlarning xo‘jalik va oziq-ovqat maqsadida foydalanilishiga asoslanadi.
example_uz: Sabzavot ekinlarining yorug‘likka talabi ham har xildir, ayrimlari bulutli, ochiq bo‘lmagan havoda ham yaxshi hosil beradi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Cultivated, usually herbaceous plants grown primarily for edible parts used as human food. Depending on the crop, the edible portion may be a root, tuber, bulb, stem, leaf, flower, fruit, or seed. Vegetable crops comprise horticulturally defined crops from diverse botanical families rather than a single botanical group.
example_en: It contains the information that you need to manage your vegetable crops, including which varieties to plant, planting dates, fertilizer recommendations, cover crop selection and conservation tillage options, pesticide selection, grafting, fertigation, plasticulture, postharvest handling, alternative pest management tools and suggestions, as well as many other topics. (2026 Southeastern U.S. Vegetable Growers Crop Handbook. Virginia Tech, 2026)

definition_uz: Sabzavot ekinlarini yetishtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi dehqon, fermer yoki mutaxassis. Sabzavotkor ochiq maydon yoki himoyalangan yer sharoitida sabzavot ekinlarini ekish, parvarishlash va hosilini yig‘ishtirish bilan bog‘liq ishlarni amalga oshiradi.
example_uz: Shuni e’tiborga olgan har bir sabzavotkor va fermer dehqon xo‘jaliklari zararkunanda va kasalliklarni tarqalishini oldini olish maqsadida urug‘ bo‘yicha quyidagi tavsiyalarga amal qilsa maqsadga muvofiq bo‘ladi. (Sifatli tanlangan urug‘ va ko‘chat — mo‘l hosil garovi. Xusanov K., O‘zagroinspeksiya, 2026)
definition_en: A person, farmer, or commercial producer engaged in growing and managing vegetable crops in open-field or protected cultivation systems.
example_en: Vegetable growers prefer pro-tray grown seedlings. (Research Highlights. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University)

definition_uz: Bog‘dorchilikning sabzavot ekinlarini yetishtirish, parvarishlash va ulardan mahsulot olishning ilmiy hamda amaliy asoslarini o‘rganuvchi tarmog‘i. Sabzavotchilik sabzavot ekinlarini ochiq va himoyalangan yer sharoitida yetishtirish, nav tanlash, urug‘ va ko‘chat tayyorlash, sug‘orish, o‘g‘itlash, o‘simliklarni himoya qilish, hosilni yig‘ish, saqlash va qayta ishlash bilan bog‘liq masalalarni qamrab oladi.
example_uz: Sabzavotchilik qayta ishlash sanoatini rivojlantiruvchi asosiy tarmoqdir. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: The branch of horticulture concerned with the science and practice of vegetable production. It encompasses the cultivation and management of vegetable crops and may include their storage, processing, and marketing.
etymology_en: From Latin (h)olus, genitive (h)oleris — "vegetable, kitchen herb" + culture.
example_en: The branch of horticulture which deals with the production, storage, processing, and marketing of vegetables, such as sweet potatoes, lettuce, peppers, and sweet corn, is called olericulture. (Department of Horticulture, Louisiana State University)
synonyms_en: Vegetable growing; Vegetable production; Vegetable cultivation

uzbek: Sabzi (Daucus carota subsp. sativus (Hoffm.) Schübl. & G.Martens)
definition_uz: Soyabonguldoshlar (Apiaceae) oilasiga mansub ikki yillik ildizmevali sabzavot ekini. Birinchi vegetatsiya yilida barglar to‘plami va oziq moddalar to‘plovchi yo‘g‘onlashgan ildiz hosil qiladi, ikkinchi yili esa gul poyasi chiqarib, gullaydi va urug‘ hosil qiladi. Sabzi oziq-ovqat uchun yetishtiriladi, uning ildizmevasi beta-karotinning muhim manbalaridan biri bo‘lib, yangi holda va qayta ishlangan shaklda iste’mol qilinadi.
etymology_uz: Forscha sabzī — "ko‘kat, sabzavot" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Ildizmevalilar: sabzi, sholg‘om tuproq tagida –10–12 °C haroratga chidaydi. Urug‘lari 2–3 °C da una boshlaydi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
english: Carrot (Daucus carota subsp. sativus (Hoffm.) Schübl. & G.Martens)
definition_en: A biennial root vegetable of the family Apiaceae, cultivated for its enlarged edible storage root. During the first year it develops a rosette of leaves and a storage root; if allowed to continue growing, it produces a flowering stem and seeds in the second year. Carrot roots are an important source of beta-carotene and are consumed fresh, cooked, or processed.
etymology_en: From Middle French carotte, from Latin carota, ultimately from Greek karōton.
example_en: Carrot is a cool season crop and will develop a good colour when grown at 15°C to 20°C. The crop needs deep loose loamy soil. It requires a pH ranging from 6.0 to 7.0 for higher production. (Horticulture: Vegetables — Carrot. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University)

uzbek: Sadaqayrag‘och (Ulmus minor subsp. minor; syn. Ulmus densa Litv.)
definition_uz: Qayrag‘ochdoshlar (Ulmaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt. O‘zbekiston va Markaziy Osiyo botanika adabiyotlarida an’anaviy ravishda Ulmus densa Litv. nomi bilan ham uchraydi; zamonaviy taksonomik manbalarda bu nom Ulmus minor subsp. minor sinonimi sifatida qabul qilinadi. Shox-shabbasi zich, barglari oddiy, tuxumsimon yoki ellipssimon, chetlari tishli. Manzarali daraxt sifatida bog‘lar, xiyobonlar va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda ekiladi.
example_uz: Sadaqayrag‘och yoshligida tezroq o‘sadi, lekin qariganda boshqa qayrag‘och daraxti turlariga nisbatan o‘sishda sekinlashadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M., 2014)
english: Sadaqayrag‘och (Ulmus minor subsp. minor; syn. Ulmus densa Litv.)
definition_en: A deciduous elm of the family Ulmaceae traditionally treated in Central Asian botanical literature as Ulmus densa Litv. The name Ulmus densa is currently treated by Plants of the World Online as a synonym of the accepted Ulmus minor subsp. minor, whose native range extends from Europe to Central Asia, including Uzbekistan.
example_en: Ulmus densa has a large crown width and a high dust-adhering capacity per plant, surpassing some exotic plants. (Arid Urban Green Areas Reimagined: Transforming Landscapes with Native Plants for a Sustainable Future in Aksu, Northwest China. Sustainability, 2024, 16(4), 1546)

definition_uz: Sallaguldoshlar (Paeoniaceae) oilasiga mansub ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon va yog‘ochlashgan o‘simliklarni o‘z ichiga oluvchi turkum. Gullari yirik va manzarali bo‘lib, oq, sariq, pushti, qizil va boshqa ranglarda uchraydi. Sallagullar yirik va ko‘zga tashlanadigan gullari tufayli manzarali bog‘dorchilik va gulchilikda keng yetishtiriladi, ayrim turlari esa dorivor ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Yangi ekilgan o‘simlik ekilganidan keyin 2–3-yili may–iyunda gullaydi. Hovli va dala bog‘larda o‘stiriladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Sallagul" maqolasi)
definition_en: A genus of perennial herbaceous and woody plants in the family Paeoniaceae. Peonies are especially valued in horticulture for their large, showy flowers, which occur in a wide range of colours. Some species are also used as medicinal plants.
etymology_en: The name Paeonia is derived from Paeon, the physician of the gods in Greek mythology.
example_en: Peonies (the Paeoniaceae, Paeonia L.) are famous garden flowers, medicinal plants, and edible oil crops. (Out of the Pan-Himalaya: Evolutionary history of the Paeoniaceae revealed by phylogenomics. Zhou S.-L. et al., Journal of Systematics and Evolution, 2021, 59(6))

definition_uz: Kendirdoshlar (Apocynaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil buta yoki kichik daraxt. Barglari qalin, terisimon va nashtarsimon, gullari esa novdalar uchida to‘pgullar hosil qiladi. Yovvoyi shakllarida gullari asosan pushti yoki qizil, madaniy navlarida oq, krem, sariq va boshqa ranglarda ham uchraydi. Issiq va quruq sharoitlarga chidamliligi tufayli bog‘lar, parklar, ko‘chalar va boshqa yashil hududlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda keng qo‘llaniladi. O‘simlik tarkibida yurak glikozidlari, ayniqsa oleandrin mavjud bo‘lib, barcha qismlari zaharli hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Sambitgul urug‘i va qalamchasidan oson ko‘payadi. (Oleandr (Oleander nerium L.)ning dala sharoitida urug‘ unuvchanligi. Saraboyeva I.Sh., Xamroyev X.F., Barqaror o‘rmonchilik IV xalqaro ilmiy-texnik anjuman, 2024)
definition_en: An evergreen ornamental shrub or small tree of the family Apocynaceae, characterized by leathery lanceolate leaves and showy terminal clusters of flowers. It is widely cultivated in warm and dry regions for ornamental and landscape purposes and is tolerant of drought. All parts of the plant are highly toxic because they contain cardiac glycosides, particularly oleandrin.
etymology_en: The name oleander is historically associated with Mediterranean plant names and was influenced by Latin olea, meaning "olive", in reference to the resemblance of its leaves to those of the olive.
example_en: Oleander (Nerium oleander L.) is an evergreen shrub of great ornamental interest which, in recent times, has been increasingly used as a flowering pot plant. (Response to water stress of some oleander cultivars suitable for pot plant production. Lenzi A., Pittas L., Martinelli T., Lombardi P., Tesi R., Scientia Horticulturae, 2009, 122(3): 426–431)

definition_uz: O‘simlik rivojlanishi uchun o‘rtacha sutkalik havo harorati bilan shu o‘simlikning biologik minimum harorati o‘rtasidagi musbat farq. Samarador harorat ma’lum bir kun davomida o‘simlik rivojlanishi uchun foydalaniladigan issiqlik miqdorini ifodalaydi. Kundalik samarador haroratlar yig‘indisi ekinlarning fenologik rivojlanishi va rivojlanish fazalarining boshlanish muddatlarini baholashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Masalan, makkajo‘xori uchun biologik minimum 10°C ga teng. O‘rtacha sutkalik harorat 22°C ga teng bo‘lsa, samarali harorat 22°−10°C=12°C ga teng bo‘ladi. (Agrometeorologiya, 1-qism)
definition_en: The positive difference between the daily average temperature and a base temperature below which crop development does not occur. Daily effective temperature represents the amount of temperature available for crop development, and its accumulation over time is used to describe and model phenological development.
example_en: Thermal time is the integral over time of the daily effective temperature (Te) after crop emergence. (A Gentle Introduction to WOFOST. Wageningen University & Research)

definition_uz: O‘zbekistonda yaratilgan ertapishar yozgi olma navi. Bog‘dorchilik, uzumchilik va vinochilik ilmiy-tadqiqot institutining Samarqand filialida Landsberg reneti va Samarqand ertagisi navlarini chatishtirish orqali V.V. Kuznetsov va A.A. Leplinskaya tomonidan yaratilgan. Daraxti o‘rta bo‘yli, ko‘chati o‘tqazilgandan keyin 4-yili hosilga kiradi. Mevasi o‘rtacha kattalikda, odatda 100–150 g, ba’zan 200 g gacha, yassi-yumaloq. Po‘sti yupqa, pishganda sariq rangli, sirti pushti va taram-taram qizil tusli. Eti oq, muloyim, sersuv, nordon-shirin va xushta’m. Mevasi iyun oyining o‘rtalarida uziladi, yangi iste’mol qilinadi va qoqi tayyorlash uchun ham yaroqli.
example_uz: Saratoniy — ertapishar yozgi olma navi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Saratoniy" maqolasi)
definition_en: An early-ripening summer apple cultivar developed in Uzbekistan by crossing Landsberg Renet and Samarqand ertagisi. The tree is medium-sized and begins bearing approximately four years after planting. The fruits are generally medium-sized, flat-round, with thin yellow skin marked by pink and red stripes. The flesh is white, tender, juicy, sweet-tart, and pleasant in flavour. The fruits are suitable for fresh consumption and drying.
example_en: Saratoni — 120–150 g; light green with slight red flecks; 4–5 years to fruit production; 1–10 July; fresh; acid-sweet with pleasant aroma. (The Schroeder Institute in Uzbekistan: Breeding and Germplasm Collections. Mirzaev M.M. et al., HortScience, 2004, 39(5))
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Chuchmomadoshlar (Amaryllidaceae) oilasiga mansub, oziq-ovqat va ziravor sifatida keng yetishtiriladigan piyozboshli o‘simlik. Yer ostida bir nechta tishchalardan tashkil topgan murakkab piyozbosh hosil qiladi. Barglari uzun va yassi, piyozboshi esa o‘ziga xos kuchli hid va ta’mga ega. Sarimsoq oziq-ovqatda yangi yoki qayta ishlangan holda keng qo‘llaniladi va tarkibida biologik faol oltingugurtli birikmalar mavjud.
example_uz: Piyozning zang kasalligi asosan piyoz va sarimsoq o‘simliklarining barglarini zararlaydi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A bulbous crop of the family Amaryllidaceae widely cultivated for food and flavouring. It produces a compound bulb composed of several smaller units known as cloves and has long, flat leaves. Garlic is widely used fresh or processed and contains biologically active sulfur-containing compounds.
example_en: Turning of tops to yellowish or brownish colour and starts drying is the ideal harvest index for harvesting garlic. (Horticulture: Vegetables — Garlic. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University)

definition_uz: Dukkakdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi buta yoki kichik daraxt. Barglari murakkab, juft patsimon, gullari sariq va kapalakgulsimon, mevasi dukkak. Sovuqqa va qurg‘oqchilikka chidamliligi hamda turli tuproq sharoitlariga moslasha olishi tufayli ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda, tirik devorlar, ihota daraxtzorlari va shamol to‘siqlari barpo etishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: So‘nggi yillarda ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda manzarali gullaydigan spireya va sariq akatsiya kabi ko‘plab butalardan foydalanilmoqda. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A deciduous shrub or small tree of the family Fabaceae. It has compound pinnate leaves, yellow pea-like flowers, and leguminous fruits. Siberian peashrub is a hardy plant used for hedges, shelterbelts, windbreaks, screening, and other landscape purposes.
example_en: It has been planted extensively for shrub buffer strips and windbreaks on farmlands and for hedges and outdoor screening in many towns and cities of the upper mid-West. (Caragana arborescens Lam.: Siberian peashrub. Dietz D.R., Slabaugh P.E., Bonner F.T., The Woody Plant Seed Manual, USDA Forest Service, 2008)

definition_uz: Glyukoza va fruktoza qoldiqlaridan tashkil topgan disaxarid uglevod. Saxaroza o‘simliklarda fotosintez natijasida hosil bo‘lgan uglerod birikmalarining asosiy transport shakllaridan biri bo‘lib, floema orqali barglardan o‘suvchi, rivojlanayotgan va zaxiralovchi organlarga tashiladi. Shakarqamish va qand lavlagida ko‘p miqdorda to‘planadi hamda ko‘plab mevalarning shirinligi va sifat ko‘rsatkichlariga ta’sir qiladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha saccharum — "shakar" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Mevalarning yetilish davrida saxaroza bilan monosaxaridlarning nisbati o‘zgarib turadi: saqlash davrida fruktoza miqdori oshadi, glyukoza va saxaroza miqdori kamayadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A disaccharide composed of glucose and fructose. In plants, sucrose is a major transport form of photosynthetically assimilated carbohydrates. It is synthesized in photosynthetic tissues and transported through the phloem to growing, developing, and storage organs.
etymology_en: From French sucre — "sugar" + the carbohydrate suffix -ose.
example_en: Sucrose represents the major transport form of photosynthetically assimilated carbohydrates in plants. (Sucrose Transport in Higher Plants. International Review of Cytology, Vol. 178, 1997)

definition_uz: Strelitsiyadoshlar (Strelitziaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil, daraxtsimon tropik o‘simlik. Vatani Madagaskar. Barglari juda yirik, uzun bandli bo‘lib, bir tekislikda ikki qator joylashib, yelpig‘ichsimon ko‘rinish hosil qiladi. Barg asoslarida yomg‘ir suvi to‘planishi mumkin. O‘ziga xos me’moriy ko‘rinishi va yirik barglari tufayli issiq iqlimli hududlarda manzarali o‘simlik sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Sayyohlar daraxti (Ravenala madagascariensis) — strelitziyadoshlar oilasiga mansub daraxt. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Sayyohlar daraxti" maqolasi)
definition_en: An evergreen, tree-like tropical plant of the family Strelitziaceae, native to Madagascar. It has very large, long-stalked leaves arranged in two ranks in a single plane, forming a distinctive fan-shaped crown. Rainwater may collect in the enlarged leaf bases. It is widely cultivated as an ornamental plant for its striking architectural form in tropical and subtropical landscapes.
etymology_en: The common name refers to the rainwater that may collect in the enlarged leaf sheaths and was traditionally said to provide water for travellers.
example_en: Travelers-tree is ideal for creating an exotic, tropical effect with its very large, banana-like leaves, each up to ten feet long and held in fan-shaped formation. (Ravenala madagascariensis: Travelers-Tree. Gilman E.F., Hilbert D., Watson D.G., Klein R., Koeser A., McLean D.C., UF/IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Genetika va seleksiyada allellarning gametalar hosil bo‘lishi jarayonida bir-biridan ajralishi va ularning avlodlarga turli kombinatsiyalarda o‘tishi hodisasi. Geterozigot organizmlarda segregatsiya natijasida keyingi avlodlarda turli genotip va fenotiplar yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Segregatsiya Mendelning ajralish qonunining asosini tashkil etadi hamda duragay avlodlarni genetik tahlil qilish va seleksion materialni tanlashda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Lotincha segregatio — "ajratish, alohida qilish".
example_uz: Ushbu maqolada xaritalash populyatsiyalarini asosiy turlari, ularning genetik tuzilishi, segregatsiya xususiyatlari va barqarorlik darajasining ilmiy sharhlari bayon etilgan. (Xaritalash populyatsiyalari. Nurimova Sh.O., Makamov A.X., Ilmiy tadqiqotlar va ularning yechimlari jurnali, Vol. 9, No. 01, 2026, B. 428–430)
definition_en: The separation of paired alleles during gamete formation so that each gamete receives only one allele of a gene. In heterozygous organisms, segregation and subsequent recombination of alleles can result in different genotypes and phenotypes among the offspring and constitute a fundamental principle of Mendelian inheritance and plant breeding.
etymology_en: From Latin segregatio, meaning "separation".
example_en: The law of segregation states that paired unit factors (genes) must segregate equally into gametes such that offspring have an equal likelihood of inheriting either factor. (Biology 2e. OpenStax, 2018)

definition_uz: Daraxt, buta, tok va boshqa bog‘ o‘simliklarining novdalari, poyalari va ingichka shoxlarini kesish uchun ishlatiladigan qo‘l asbobi. Sekator mevali daraxtlarni butash va shakllantirish, quruq yoki zararlangan novdalarni olib tashlash, tok va butalarni parvarish qilishda qo‘llaniladi. Kesish mexanizmiga ko‘ra bypass va sandonli turlari mavjud.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha sécateur, lotincha secare — "kesmoq, qirqmoq".
example_uz: Toklar o‘tkir tok qaychisi (sekator) va bog‘ arra yordamida kesiladi. (Toklarni kesishning ahamiyati, muddatlari, texnikasi va usullari. Sanayev S., Fermerlar Maktabi, 2023)
definition_en: A hand-operated gardening tool used for pruning and cutting plant stems, shoots, and small branches. Secateurs are commonly used for pruning trees, shrubs, vines, and other horticultural plants and are available in different types, including bypass and anvil secateurs.
etymology_en: From French sécateur, ultimately from Latin secare, meaning "to cut".
example_en: Secateur is meant for cutting branches, de-shooting, disbudding, cutting of scion sticks, defoliation of leaves from the sticks, topping-off small trees, etc. (Garden Tools and Equipment, Unit 4)

definition_uz: Seleksiyaga, ya’ni o‘simliklarning yangi nav va duragaylarini yaratish, tanlash, baholash va takomillashtirish ishlariga oid. Seleksion material, seleksion nomer, seleksion ko‘chatzor kabi birikmalarda o‘simlik seleksiyasi jarayonida yaratiladigan, tanlanadigan yoki baholanadigan material va obyektlarning seleksiyaga mansubligini ifodalaydi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha selectio — "tanlash, saralash".
example_uz: Seleksiya ishi jarayonida tanlab olinadigan o‘simliklarning barcha xillari (nomerlari, navlari) seleksion material deb ataladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2005)
definition_en: Relating to plant breeding and used attributively for plant materials, lines, populations, nurseries, trials, or other materials and activities involved in the development, selection, evaluation, and improvement of cultivars.
example_en: The objective was to select breeding lines that are resilient to more than one abiotic stress. (Genetic variation in drought resilience-related traits among wheat multiple synthetic derivative lines: insights for climate resilience breeding. Elbashir A.A.E. et al., Breeding Science, 2021)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning yangi navlari va duragaylarini yaratish, tanlash, sinash va takomillashtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassis. Seleksioner irsiy belgilarni o‘rganadi, istiqbolli shakllarni tanlaydi hamda hosildorlik, mahsulot sifati, kasallik va noqulay muhit omillariga chidamlilik kabi xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilarni yaxshilash bo‘yicha seleksiya ishlarini olib boradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha selectio — "tanlash, saralash".
example_uz: Yovvoyi meva daraxtlarining ikkinchi bir foydali tomoni shundaki, seleksionerlarning ayrim meva shakllarini tanlashida qimmatbaho manba hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A specialist who develops and improves plant cultivars and hybrids through selection, crossing, evaluation, and other plant breeding methods, with the aim of improving economically important traits such as yield, quality, and resistance to biotic and abiotic stresses.
example_en: The plant breeder's skill relies on knowledge of flower biology, cell biology, and genetics. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Bamford K.M., Early M.P., 5th ed., 2008)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning yangi navlari va duragaylarini yaratish, mavjud navlarni takomillashtirish hamda inson ehtiyojlari uchun foydali irsiy belgilarni tanlash va birlashtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi ilmiy-amaliy yo‘nalish. Seleksiyada genetik xilma-xillikdan foydalanish, tanlash, chatishtirish, duragaylash, mutatsion, biotexnologik va molekulyar usullar orqali o‘simliklarning hosildorlik, sifat, chidamlilik va boshqa xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilari yaxshilanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha selectio — "tanlash, saralash".
example_uz: Sistematika bilimlarining genetika va biokimyoda, urug‘chilik va seleksiyada, hattoki ekologiya va biogeografiya fanlarida ham o‘rni beqiyos. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: The science and practice of genetically improving plants by creating, selecting, combining, and evaluating heritable variation to develop new cultivars with desirable characteristics such as improved yield, quality, and resistance to biotic and abiotic stresses.
example_en: Plant breeding now supplies a wide range of plant types to meet growers’ specific needs. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Bamford K.M., Early M.P., 5th ed., 2008, p. 134)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simlik seleksiyasi jarayonida seleksion materialni yetishtirish, kuzatish, baholash va istiqbolli o‘simliklar, oilalar yoki liniyalarni tanlab olish uchun tashkil etiladigan maxsus tajriba maydoni. Seleksiya ko‘chatzorida o‘simliklarning morfologik, biologik va xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilari, jumladan hosildorligi, mahsulot sifati, pishish muddati hamda kasallik va noqulay muhit omillariga chidamliligi baholanadi.
etymology_uz: Seleksiya — lotincha selectio — "tanlash, saralash" + ko‘chatzor.
example_uz: Seleksion ko‘chatzorda fenologik kuzatish maysalar paydo bo‘la boshlagan va 50 % o‘simlik unib chiqqanda, gullaganda va yetilganda o‘tkaziladi. (G‘o‘za seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., Lukov M.Q., 2015)
definition_en: A nursery or experimental field used in plant breeding for growing, evaluating, and selecting plants, progenies, families, lines, or other breeding materials with desirable characteristics for advancement in a breeding programme.
example_en: Small F2 plots are grown in the field and single plants selected from each different plot are then grown as progeny rows in the F3 to F5 generations. (Flax Breeding Process: Selection Nursery at Kernen Crops Research Farm. Crop Development Centre, University of Saskatchewan)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simlik hujayra devorining asosiy strukturaviy polisaxaridlaridan biri. Sellyuloza β-(1→4) glikozid bog‘lari orqali birikkan D-glyukoza qoldiqlarining uzun, tarmoqlanmagan zanjirlaridan tashkil topadi. Sellyuloza zanjirlari birlashib mikrofibrillalarni hosil qiladi va hujayra devoriga mexanik mustahkamlik beradi. U yog‘och, poya, barg, paxta tolasi va boshqa o‘simlik to‘qimalarida keng tarqalgan.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha cellulose so‘zidan; cellule — "kichik hujayra" + -ose. Cellule so‘zi lotincha cellula — "kichik hujayra" so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Sitrus mevalarida epikarp sellyuloza moddasidan tashkil topgan flavedo sifatida tanilgan. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A structural polysaccharide consisting of long, unbranched chains of D-glucose residues linked by β-(1→4) glycosidic bonds. Cellulose is a major structural component of plant cell walls, where its molecules associate to form microfibrils that provide tensile strength and mechanical support.
etymology_en: From French cellulose, from cellule, meaning "small cell", + -ose; cellule ultimately derives from Latin cellula.
example_en: Cellulose molecules are long, unbranched chains of β1,4-linked glucose units. (Molecular Biology of the Cell. Alberts B. et al., 4th ed., Garland Science, 2002)

definition_uz: Urug‘larni unib chiqishi va o‘simlik hosil qilishi uchun tuproq yuzasiga sochmoq yoki tuproqqa ma’lum tartibda joylashtirmoq. Bog‘dorchilikda urug‘ sepish qo‘lda yoki ekish uskunalari yordamida, ekin talabiga muvofiq chuqurlik, qator oralig‘i va ekish me’yoriga rioya qilgan holda amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Sabzi urug‘larini sepishda ularni quritib, qo‘l bilan aralashtirib sepish mumkin. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: To plant or distribute seeds in or on the soil so that they can germinate and grow. In horticulture, seeds may be sown manually or mechanically at an appropriate depth, spacing, and sowing rate.
etymology_en: From Old English sāwan, meaning "to scatter seed upon the ground or plant it in the earth"; ultimately related to the Proto-Indo-European root *sē-, "to sow".
example_en: Many seeds develop dormancy on storage. It is possible to avoid the problem by sowing green seed. (Principles of Horticulture. Adams C.R., Bamford K.M., Early M.P., 5th ed., Butterworth-Heinemann/Elsevier, 2008)

definition_uz: Ko‘p urug‘li yoki ko‘p miqdorda urug‘ hosil qiladigan o‘simlik, meva yoki navga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda meva va navlarning urug‘ hosil qilish xususiyatini tavsiflashda, shuningdek, seleksiya, navshunoslik va o‘simliklarning ko‘payish biologiyasida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Sitrus mevalarda urug‘lar miqdori har xil bo‘ladi. Ayrim navlari urug‘siz, boshqa navlari esa juda serurug‘ bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Containing or producing many seeds; used to describe fruits, plants, cultivars, or other reproductive structures characterized by a relatively large number of seeds.
example_en: Fruit a large globose or ovoid or obovoid hesperidium, many-seeded and usually composed of numerous carpels. (Citrus L., Flora Zambesiaca, Plants of the World Online, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Yaproqlari ko‘p, mo‘l barglangan o‘simlik, daraxt, buta yoki uning poya va shoxlariga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Seryaproqlik o‘simlikning vegetativ-morfologik belgilaridan biri bo‘lib, uning barglanish darajasini ifodalaydi.
example_uz: O‘simlikning tanasi zich barglangan, gullari markaziy o‘qda joylashgan bo‘lib, diametri 8–12 sm gacha yetadi; gullari oq yoki to‘q qizil rangda bo‘lib, iyun oyidan sentabr oyigacha gullaydi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: Having many leaves or abundant foliage; used to describe a plant, tree, shrub, stem, or other vegetative growth characterized by plentiful leaves.
example_en: Tall, leafy trees shade quiet neighbourhoods. (Cambridge Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Cambridge University Press)

definition_uz: Shiradorligi yuqori, shirasi mo‘l bo‘lgan meva yoki boshqa o‘simlik mahsulotiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Mevachilik va navshunoslikda mevaning shiralilik darajasini hamda uning iste’mol va texnologik sifatlarini tavsiflashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Har bir yarusdagi yon shoxlar qanchalik to‘g‘ri joylashsa va baquvvat bo‘lsa, kelgusida meva daraxtlarining shox-shabbalari shamolga chidamli, serhosil bo‘ladi va mevalari rangdor, sershira bo‘ladi. (O‘zbekistonda bog‘dorchilik. Mirzayev M.M., Sobirov M.K., 1980)
definition_en: Containing a particularly large amount of juice; used in pomology and cultivar descriptions to characterize fruits with a high degree of juiciness.
example_en: The flesh is very juicy, and sweet-acid. (Lychee Production in the Asia-Pacific Region: Cultivars and Genetic Improvement. FAO)

definition_uz: Qayrag‘ochdoshlar (Ulmaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt turi. Barglari nisbatan mayda, oddiy, ellipssimon yoki cho‘ziq-nashtarsimon, chetlari tishli. Sibir qayrag‘ochi sovuq qish, uzoq davom etadigan yozgi qurg‘oqchilik, kam namlik va kambag‘al tuproq sharoitlariga chidamliligi bilan ajralib turadi. Ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda, yo‘l bo‘ylarida hamda shamol va ihota daraxtzorlari barpo etishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Ulmus pumila va Morus alba kabi keng bargli daraxtlar shahar havosini zararli zarralardan tozalash va kislorod ishlab chiqarishda yuqori samaradorlikka ega. (Qarshi shahrini ko‘kalamzorlashtirish uchun daraxt turlarini tanlash. To‘xtamurodova N., 2024)
definition_en: A deciduous tree species of the family Ulmaceae, native from Central Asia to southern Siberia and Korea. It has relatively small, serrated leaves and is tolerant of cold winters, prolonged summer drought, low moisture, and poor soils. It is used in windbreaks and landscape plantings.
example_en: Siberian elm (Ulmus pumila) is an introduced, fast-growing, small tree, five to ten meters high. (Plant Guide: Siberian Elm, Ulmus pumila L. USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service)

definition_uz: Tok novdalari va boshqa vegetativ qismlarini ko‘tarib, muayyan tartibda joylashtirish va o‘stirish uchun ustunlar hamda ularga tortilgan simlardan tashkil topgan tayanch konstruksiya. Simbag‘az tok novdalarini vertikal, gorizontal yoki boshqa yo‘nalishlarda joylashtirishga imkon beradi hamda tokni parvarish qilish, kesish, o‘simliklarni himoya qilish va hosilni yig‘ish ishlarini qulaylashtiradi.
etymology_uz: Sim + bag‘az; bag‘az forscha bag‘az — "pona, yog‘och qoziq" ma’nosidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Kuchli o‘suvchi xo‘raki va kishmishbop navlar soyabonli simbag‘az, ishkom, xiyobon so‘rilarida o‘stirilib, ulardan mo‘l hosil olish mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A supporting framework consisting of posts and one or more wires used to support and train grapevines. The wires support the vine and allow its canes, cordons, and shoots to be positioned according to the selected training system.
etymology_en: Wire + trellis; trellis derives from Old French trelis, ultimately from Latin trilix, meaning "three-threaded".
example_en: A wire trellis, using number 9 or 10 gauge galvanized steel wire, can be constructed on 8-foot treated posts set 2 feet in the ground. (The Bunch Grape. University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Turli turlarga mansub ikki organizmning birga yashashi natijasida yuzaga keladigan yaqin va nisbatan uzoq davom etuvchi biologik munosabat. Simbioz keng biologik ma’noda mutualizm, kommensalizm va parazitizm kabi munosabatlarni qamrab olishi mumkin. O‘simliklarda mikoriza zamburug‘lari bilan ildizlar hamda dukkakli o‘simliklar bilan azot fiksatsiyalovchi tuganak bakteriyalari o‘rtasidagi simbiotik munosabatlar muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha symbíōsis — "birga yashash"; syn-/sym- — "birga" + bíos — "hayot".
example_uz: Erkin holda yashovchi bakteriyalar bilan birgalikda ekinlarni biologik azot bilan ta’minlashda dukkakli o‘simliklar ildizida simbioz holida yashovchi tuganak bakteriyalarning ham ahamiyati katta. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: The living together in a close and relatively persistent association of organisms of different species. In its broad biological sense, symbiosis may include mutualism, commensalism, and parasitism. In plants, important examples include mycorrhizal associations between roots and fungi and symbiotic associations between legumes and nitrogen-fixing bacteria.
etymology_en: From Greek symbíōsis, meaning "living together, companionship", from sym- — "together" + bíos — "life".
example_en: The roots of most plants are colonized by symbiotic fungi to form mycorrhiza, which play a critical role in the capture of nutrients from the soil and therefore in plant nutrition. (Mycorrhizal Symbiosis. Smith S.E., Read D.J., 3rd ed., Academic Press, 2008)

definition_uz: Duragaylash va boshqa usullar orqali sun’iy ravishda yaratilgan boshlang‘ich materialdan foydalanib yangi nav va shakllar yaratishga asoslangan seleksiya yo‘nalishi. Bunda genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ota-ona shakllarining qimmatli irsiy belgi va xususiyatlarini yangi genotip yoki populyatsiyada birlashtirish maqsad qilinadi. Sintetik seleksiyada duragaylash, poliploidiya, mutagenez va boshqa seleksiya usullaridan foydalanilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Sintetik — yunoncha synthesis — "birlashtirish, qo‘shish"; seleksiya — lotincha selectio — "tanlash, saralash".
example_uz: Sintetik seleksiyaning turli uslublaridan foydalanish madaniy o‘simliklarni tubdan o‘zgartirish, hatto ularning yovvoyi shakllarining ijobiy xususiyatlarini mujassamlagan navlarni yaratishga keng imkoniyatlar tug‘diradi. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: A plant breeding strategy in which a selected group of genetically distinct parents are intercrossed to form a synthetic population or cultivar. It is particularly used in cross-pollinated crops, where selected parental components are intercrossed and the resulting population is subsequently maintained through open pollination, allowing genetic diversity and heterosis to be exploited.
etymology_en: Synthetic derives from Greek synthesis, meaning "putting together" or "combination"; breeding derives from breed.
example_en: For allogamous forage grasses, the most widely used breeding strategy to produce cultivars is synthetic breeding. (Developing Heterotic Groups for Successful Hybrid Breeding in Perennial Ryegrass. Arojju S.K. et al., Agronomy, 2020, 10(9): 1410)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasiga mansub doimyashil daraxt va butalarni o‘z ichiga oluvchi turkum. Citrus turkumiga apelsin, limon, mandarin, laym, greypfrut, sitron va boshqa madaniy hamda yovvoyi sitrus o‘simliklari kiradi. Ularning ko‘pchiligi oziq-ovqat va mevachilikda muhim ahamiyatga ega bo‘lgan mevalari uchun yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha citrus — "sitron daraxti" so‘zidan.
example_uz: Sitrus avlodi rutedoshlar oilasiga kiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A genus of evergreen trees and shrubs in the family Rutaceae, comprising cultivated and wild citrus plants. The genus includes oranges, lemons, mandarins, limes, grapefruits, citrons, and related plants, many of which are cultivated for their edible fruits.
etymology_en: From Latin citrus, referring to the citron tree.
example_en: Citrus is a genus of flowering trees and shrubs in the rue family, Rutaceae. (Encyclopaedia Britannica, Citrus)

definition_uz: Rutadoshlar (Rutaceae) oilasining Citrus turkumiga mansub, asosan doimyashil daraxt va butalardan iborat o‘simliklar guruhi. Sitrus o‘simliklariga apelsin, limon, mandarin, greypfrut, laym, pomelo, sitron va boshqa sitruslar kiradi. Ular xushbo‘y barglari, gullari va shirali mevalari bilan ajralib turadi hamda asosan tropik va subtropik hududlarda yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Sitrus — lotincha citrus — "sitron daraxti" so‘zidan; o‘simlik — o‘zbekcha o‘smoq fe’li asosida yasalgan.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda sitrus o‘simliklar har xil shakldagi usti yopiq joylarda ekib o‘stiriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Evergreen trees and shrubs belonging to the genus Citrus in the family Rutaceae and cultivated mainly for their fruits. Citrus plants include oranges, lemons, mandarins, grapefruits, limes, pomelos, citrons, and related plants and are primarily adapted to tropical and subtropical climates.
etymology_en: Citrus derives from Latin citrus, referring to the citron tree; plant derives ultimately from Latin planta.
example_en: Most citrus plants are adapted to warmer, tropical or subtropical climates. (Cultural Tips for Growing Citrus. University of California Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program)

definition_uz: Sitrus o‘simliklarini yetishtirish, ko‘paytirish, parvarish qilish, seleksiya qilish, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish, hosilini yig‘ish hamda hosildan keyingi ishlov berishning ilmiy va amaliy asoslarini qamrab oluvchi mevachilik tarmog‘i. Sitruschilik apelsin, limon, mandarin, greypfrut, laym, pomelo va boshqa sitrus ekinlarini yetishtirish bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, subtropik mevachilikning muhim yo‘nalishlaridan biridir.
etymology_uz: Sitrus (lotincha citrus — "sitron daraxti") + o‘zbekcha -chilik — soha yoki faoliyat nomini yasovchi qo‘shimcha.
example_uz: Bog‘dorchilik keng ma’nodagi tushuncha bo‘lib, mevachilik, uzumchilik, sitruschilik, rezavor mevachilik, manzarali bog‘dorchilik va gulchilik kabi turlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
