definition_en: The branch of horticulture concerned with the cultivation and management of citrus fruit trees. It encompasses major aspects of citrus growing, including propagation, orchard management, irrigation, plant protection, harvesting, postharvest management, and genetic improvement.
etymology_en: Formed from citrus + culture, denoting the cultivation of citrus plants.
example_en: Modern citriculture has adopted parthenocarpy and seedlessness for all major citrus types. (The Biology of Citrus. Spiegel-Roy P., Goldschmidt E.E., Cambridge University Press, 1996)

definition_uz: Qattiq yoki suv o‘tkazmaydigan urug‘ po‘stini shikastlash, zaiflashtirish yoki o‘zgartirish orqali uning suv va gazlarni o‘tkazuvchanligini oshirishga qaratilgan ekisholdi ishlovi. Skarifikatsiya urug‘ po‘sti bilan bog‘liq fizik dormantlikni bartaraf etish va urug‘larning unishini rag‘batlantirish uchun qo‘llaniladi. Uning mexanik, kimyoviy va issiq suv bilan ishlov berish kabi usullari mavjud.
etymology_uz: Lotincha scarificare — "tirnamoq, tilmoq".
example_uz: Tadqiqot davomida urug‘ qobig‘ining qattiqligini hamda chuqur fiziologik tinchlik davrini bartaraf etish maqsadida maxsus mexanik skarifikatsiya usuli muvaffaqiyatli qo‘llandi. (Solenanthus turkestanicus (Regel & Smirn.) Kusn. ning laboratoriya sharoitida urug‘ unuvchanligi. Davronqulova F.A., Haydarov X.Q., Abdirasulov F.A., 2026)
definition_en: A pre-sowing treatment that disrupts, weakens, or alters a hard or water-impermeable seed coat to permit water uptake and gas exchange, thereby overcoming seed-coat-imposed physical dormancy and promoting germination.
etymology_en: From Latin scarificare, meaning "to scratch or make incisions".
example_en: Seed scarification involves breaking, scratching, or softening the seed coat so that water can enter and begin the germination process. (Plant Propagation from Seed. Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, 2020)

definition_uz: Dukkakdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub tez o‘suvchi barg to‘kuvchi daraxt turi. Vatani Shimoliy Amerikaning sharqiy va sharqiy-markaziy hududlari bo‘lib, dunyoning ko‘plab hududlariga introduksiya qilingan. Gullari oq, xushbo‘y va osilib turuvchi shingilsimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi, mevasi dukkak. Atmosfera azotini biologik fiksatsiya qilish xususiyatiga ega. Manzarali daraxt sifatida, ihota va shamol to‘siqlari barpo etishda, eroziyaga qarshi kurashish va buzilgan yerlarni tiklashda hamda asal beruvchi o‘simlik sifatida foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Robinia turkum nomi fransuz botaniklari Jean Robin va uning o‘g‘li Vespasien Robin sharafiga nomlangan; pseudoacacia — "soxta akatsiya" ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Ushbu maqolada Termiz shahri sharoitida o‘stirilayotgan soxta akatsiya (Robinia pseudoacacia L.)ning bioekologik xususiyatlari hamda ular ustida olib borilayotgan ilmiy tadqiqot ishlari olingan natijalar asosida yoritilgan. (Termiz shahri sharoitida o‘rganilayotgan soxta akatsiyaning biologiyasi. Egamberdiyeva Sh.S., Ilm-fan va ta’lim, 2022)
definition_en: A fast-growing deciduous tree of the family Fabaceae, native to the eastern and east-central United States and widely introduced elsewhere. It bears fragrant white flowers in pendulous racemes and produces leguminous pods. Black locust is a nitrogen-fixing species and is widely planted for ornamental purposes, shelterbelts, windbreaks, erosion control, land reclamation, and honey production.
etymology_en: The genus Robinia was named in honour of the French botanists Jean Robin and his son Vespasien Robin; the specific epithet pseudoacacia means "false acacia".
example_en: Because it is a nitrogen fixer and has rapid juvenile growth, it is widely planted as an ornamental, for shelterbelts, and for land reclamation. (Black Locust, Robinia pseudoacacia L. Huntley J.C., Silvics of North America, USDA Forest Service, 1990)

definition_uz: Hosil bo‘lishida urug‘chi tugunchasi bilan birga gulning tugunchadan tashqari boshqa qismlari, masalan, gul o‘rni yoki gipantiy to‘qimalari ham ishtirok etadigan meva. Bunday mevalarda etli yoki ko‘zga tashlanadigan qismning muayyan ulushi tugunchadan tashqari gul to‘qimalaridan rivojlanadi. Olma, nok va behi soxta mevalarga misol bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Yong‘oq, nok va behining mevasi soxta meva, anjir va tut mevasi to‘p mevadir. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A fruit that develops from the ovary but also contains a significant portion of tissue derived from floral structures outside the ovary, such as the receptacle or hypanthium. Apples, pears, and quinces are examples of accessory fruits.
etymology_en: Accessory derives ultimately from Latin accessorius, meaning "additional" or "supplementary"; fruit derives from Latin fructus, meaning "fruit, produce".
example_en: One example of a fruit from this type of flower where there is accessory tissue (hypanthium) adhering to the outside of the ovary wall is the pome, examples of which are the apple, pear, and quince. (The Science of Plants: Fruit Morphology. University of Minnesota)

definition_uz: Seleksiya va nav sinash jarayonida yangi navlar, duragaylar yoki seleksion materiallarni qiyosiy baholash uchun etalon sifatida foydalaniladigan nav. Sinalayotgan materiallar hosildorlik, mahsulot sifati, pishish muddati, moslashuvchanlik, kasallik va noqulay muhit omillariga chidamlilik kabi qimmatli xo‘jalik belgilari bo‘yicha standart nav bilan taqqoslanadi.
etymology_uz: Standart — inglizcha standard — "me’yor, namuna, etalon" + nav.
example_uz: Standart navga nisbatan yuqori ko‘rsatkichga ega bo‘lgan ekinlarning urug‘i nav sinashga beriladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2005)
definition_en: A variety used as a standard check in plant breeding and variety trials for the comparative evaluation of candidate varieties, breeding lines, hybrids, or other experimental genotypes. It provides a benchmark against which agronomic and quality traits can be assessed.
etymology_en: Standard means an established reference or basis for comparison; check denotes a reference used for comparison or control; variety refers to a distinct plant variety.
example_en: BARI Sarisha-14 was used as the standard check variety. (Combining ability, gene action and heterosis studies for yield improvement in rapeseed (Brassica napus L.). Discover Plants, Springer Nature, 2026)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Urug‘ dormantligini bartaraf etish va unishini rag‘batlantirish maqsadida urug‘larni ma’lum muddat nam muhitda muayyan harorat rejimida saqlashdan iborat ekisholdi ishlov usuli. O‘simlik turi va urug‘ dormantligining xususiyatiga qarab sovuq, iliq yoki iliq-sovuq kombinatsiyalangan stratifikatsiya qo‘llanilishi mumkin. Bog‘dorchilik va ko‘chatchilikda ko‘plab daraxt va buta urug‘larini ekishga tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha stratum — "qatlam" va facere — "qilmoq, yasamoq" asoslari bilan bog‘liq; termin tarixan urug‘larni nam qum yoki boshqa substrat bilan qatlamlab saqlash usulidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Urug‘lar unib chiqishi uchun ularga taxminan tabiatda kuzatilganidek sharoitlarni yaratib, ularni stratifikatsiya qilish lozim. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sheraliyev A., 2024)
definition_en: A pre-germination seed treatment in which seeds are maintained in a moist medium under specific temperature regimes for a certain period to break seed dormancy and promote germination. Depending on the species and type of dormancy, cold, warm, or combined warm-and-cold stratification may be required.
etymology_en: Stratification derives ultimately from Latin stratum, meaning "layer", and facere, meaning "to make"; in seed propagation, the term reflects the historical practice of placing seeds in layers with moist sand or other substrate.
example_en: Most temperate plant seeds, such as apple and pear, require stratification (moist chilling) treatment to overcome dormancy. (Propagating Plants from Seed. Washington State University Extension)

definition_uz: Tropik mintaqalarga tutash va mo‘tadil mintaqalarga o‘tish xususiyatiga ega subtropik hududlar, ularning iqlimi yoki shu sharoitga moslashgan o‘simliklarga oid. Subtropik hududlar odatda yozi issiq va qishi tropik hududlarga nisbatan salqinroq bo‘lishi bilan tavsiflanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda sitruslar, zaytun, anor, xurmo va boshqa issiqsevar meva ekinlari subtropik sharoitlarda yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha sub- — "ostida, yaqin" + tropik; tropik termini yunoncha tropikos — "burilishga oid" so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Tok mo‘tadil issiq va subtropik iqlim o‘simligi hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Relating to regions bordering the tropics or to their climatic conditions. In horticulture, the term is used for climates and crops occurring between broadly tropical and temperate conditions and includes many important fruit crops adapted to relatively warm climates.
etymology_en: Formed from sub- + tropical; sub- derives from Latin sub, meaning "under, near", while tropical derives ultimately from Greek tropikos, meaning "of or pertaining to a turning".
example_en: Fruit plants grown between temperate and tropical climatic conditions are known as subtropical fruits. (Horticulture Science Series – 3, Fruit Crops)

definition_uz: Subtropik iqlim mintaqalarida tabiiy ravishda o‘sadigan yoki yetishtiriladigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Ularning ekologik talablari turlicha bo‘lsa-da, ko‘pchiligi uzoq vegetatsiya davri va nisbatan yumshoq qish sharoitiga moslashgan. Bog‘dorchilikda sitruslar, zaytun, anor, xurmo, feyxoa va avokado kabi ko‘p yillik o‘simliklar subtropik sharoitlarda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Rezavor meva va subtropik o‘simliklar maydoni bu o‘simliklarning ko‘chatlariga bo‘lgan talabga qarab belgilanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Plants that occur naturally in or are cultivated under subtropical climatic conditions. In horticulture, these include numerous fruit and ornamental plants adapted to relatively warm climates and generally mild winters.
etymology_en: Subtropical is formed from sub- + tropical; sub- derives from Latin sub, meaning "under, near", while tropical derives ultimately from Greek tropikos. Plant derives ultimately from Latin planta.
example_en: Subtropical plants such as citrus and palms have variable levels of cold hardiness; some can withstand mild to moderate subfreezing temperatures. (Protecting Landscapes and Horticultural Crops from Frosts and Freezes. Texas A&M AgriLife Extension)

definition_uz: Markaziy Osiyoda, jumladan O‘zbekistonda tarqalgan mahalliy o‘rta-kechpishar xo‘raki-mayizbop uzum navi. Tupi o‘rtacha kuchli o‘sadi, guli ikki jinsli. Uzum boshi yirik, silindrsimon-konussimon, ba’zan qanotli va o‘rtacha tig‘iz bo‘ladi. G‘ujumi yirik, tuxumsimon, yashil-sariq, to‘liq pishganda qahrabo tusli bo‘ladi. Eti karsillaydigan. Mevasi yangi iste’mol qilish va mayiz tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Uzumning xo‘raki-mayizbop "Oq Sultoni", "Kattaqo‘rg‘on", "O‘zbekiston muskati" va "Muskat Aleksandriyskiy" navlaridan yuqori sifatli mayiz olinadi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: A traditional Central Asian table-raisin grape cultivar of medium-late ripening. It is distributed in Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Azerbaijan. The vines are moderately vigorous and have bisexual flowers. The clusters are large, cylindrical-conical, sometimes winged, and of medium density. The berries are large and ovate, greenish-yellow, becoming amber when fully ripe, with crisp flesh.
example_en: Sultani. It is the Central Asian universal (table-raisin) variety of medium-late ripening period. (Agrobiological Parameters of Some Local, and Introduced Collectible Grape Varieties, Grown in the Conditions of the Absheron District. Salimov V.S., Huseynova A.S., Abdulaliyeva S.Sh., Alekberova M.M., Aslanova F.A., 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science
synonyms_en: Djaus; Okpar; Shakiryak; Ak par; Djaus safet; Shakarak

definition_uz: Fosfat xomashyosini kislota bilan qayta ishlash natijasida olinadigan fosforli mineral o‘g‘it. Oddiy superfosfat tarkibida o‘simliklar o‘zlashtira oladigan monokalsiy fosfat va kalsiy sulfat mavjud bo‘lib, ekinlarni fosfor bilan ta’minlash uchun qo‘llaniladi. Superfosfatning oddiy va konsentrlangan turlari mavjud.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha superphosphate so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; super- — "yuqori, ortiq" + phosphate — "fosfat".
example_uz: Bunday yerlarni kuzda chuqur shudgorlash, har gektariga 20 t gacha go‘ng va 5000 kg gacha superfosfat solinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A phosphorus fertilizer produced by treating insoluble mineral phosphates, such as phosphate rock, with acid to produce more soluble and plant-available phosphate compounds. Single superphosphate principally contains monocalcium phosphate together with calcium sulfate and is used as a source of phosphorus for plant growth.
etymology_en: Formed from super- + phosphate; phosphate derives from French phosphate, from phosphoric acid.
example_en: Superphosphate or triple superphosphate are sometimes incorporated into the substrate as a pre-plant amendment as a phosphorus source. (Substrates, Greenhouse Management, University of Arkansas)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni oziq elementlari bilan ta’minlash uchun suyuq shaklda qo‘llaniladigan o‘g‘itlar guruhi. Suyuq o‘g‘itlar oziq moddalari to‘liq erigan eritmalar yoki erigan va erimagan komponentlarni o‘z ichiga oluvchi suspenziyalar shaklida bo‘lishi mumkin. Ular tarkibida azot, fosfor, kaliy va mikroelementlar bo‘lishi hamda tuproqqa bevosita yoki sug‘orish tizimi orqali fertigatsiya usulida qo‘llanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Suyuq o‘g‘itlar tomchilatib sug‘orish, aerozol shaklidagi qo‘llash yoki shu kabi zamonaviy agrar texnologiyalarda qo‘l keladi. (Fosfat chiqindilarini qayta ishlashning zamonaviy usullari va ularning ekologik samaradorligi. Nabiyeva M., Sultonov B.E., Doliyev G‘.A., Qo‘qon DPI. Ilmiy xabarlar, 2025, 4-son)
definition_en: Fertilizers supplied in liquid form, including fertilizer solutions and suspensions. They may contain one or more plant nutrients, including macronutrients and micronutrients, and may be applied directly to the soil or through irrigation systems as fertigation.
example_en: Liquid fertilizers are fluids in which nutrients are dissolved in a water medium and include both solutions and suspensions. (Fertilizer Facts: Fertilizer Formulations and Application. Montana State University Extension)

definition_uz: Ekinlarning suvga bo‘lgan ehtiyojini qondirish va ularning o‘sishi hamda hosil shakllanishini ta’minlash maqsadida yer yoki tuproqqa suvni sun’iy ravishda berish agrotexnik tadbiri. Bog‘dorchilikda sug‘orish tuproq namligini ekin uchun zarur darajada saqlash va suv tanqisligini bartaraf etish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Payvandlash ishi tugagandan keyin ham ko‘chatzorni sug‘orish tavsiya etiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The artificial or purposeful application of water to land or soil, other than rainfall, to supply crops with water and support their growth and production.
etymology_en: From Latin irrigatio, from irrigare, meaning "to water or irrigate".
example_en: Irrigate immediately after planting; give life irrigation after 4 days; subsequent irrigations are to be given once in a week for garden land bananas and once in 10–15 days for wetlands. (Horticulture: Fruits — Banana. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University)

definition_uz: Bir marta sug‘orishda birlik maydonga beriladigan suv miqdori. Sug‘orish me’yori odatda m³/ga yoki suv qatlami ko‘rinishida mm bilan ifodalanadi va tuproqning suv-fizik xususiyatlari, ekin turi, ildiz tizimining rivojlanish chuqurligi, sug‘orish oldidan tuproq namligi hamda sug‘orish usuliga qarab belgilanadi.
example_uz: Sug‘orish me’yorini m³/ga da olish qulay. (Sug‘orish melioratsiyasi. Xamidov M.X. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: The depth or equivalent quantity of water applied to a unit area during a single irrigation application, commonly expressed in millimetres or as a volume per unit area. The required irrigation depth depends on factors such as soil type, crop rooting depth, soil water status, and irrigation method.
etymology_en: Irrigation derives from Latin irrigatio, from irrigare, meaning "to water"; depth derives from Old English dīepþu, meaning "deepness".
example_en: In practice, in small-scale irrigation projects, usually 40–70 mm of water are applied in basin irrigation, 30–60 mm in border irrigation and 20–50 mm in furrow irrigation. (Irrigation Water Management: Irrigation Methods. FAO)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Ekinlarning vegetatsiya davrida suvga bo‘lgan talabini ta’minlash uchun sug‘orish muddatlari, soni, oralig‘i va sug‘orish me’yorlarini muayyan tuproq-iqlim sharoiti hamda o‘simlikning rivojlanish bosqichlariga muvofiq belgilovchi agrotexnik tartib. Sug‘orish rejimi ekinning biologik xususiyatlari, suvga bo‘lgan talabi, tuproq namligi va iqlim sharoitiga qarab belgilanadi.
example_uz: 70–70–60 % sug‘orish rejimida tup qalinligi va o‘g‘itlarning o‘zaro nisbatiga bog‘liq holda o‘rtacha 35,4–40,5 s/ga hosil olingan bo‘lsa, 75–75–60 % sug‘orish rejimida hosildorlik variantlar bo‘yicha o‘rtacha 33,5–36,5 s/ga ni tashkil etdi. (Agrotexnik omillarni uyg‘unlashgan holda qo‘llashning g‘o‘za hosildorligiga ta’siri. Jumanov D.T., Imomov Ch.M., Tojiyeva S.O., Agroinnovatsiya, 2023, 1(1))
definition_en: The irrigation regime established for a crop under particular soil and climatic conditions, specifying the timing, frequency, intervals, and amounts of irrigation water applied during the growing season according to crop water requirements, soil moisture conditions, and crop development.
example_en: One of the main objectives of the realized project is to determine an irrigation regime for drip irrigation of fruit orchards in 6 regions of our country. (Use of Mobile Photothermic Installation on Application of Drip Irrigation Technology in Orchards of Mountain and Foothill Areas of Uzbekistan. Water, 2025, 17(6), 872)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Sug‘orish manbasi, sug‘oriladigan yerlar hamda suvni olish, tashish, taqsimlash va ekin maydonlariga yetkazib berishga xizmat qiladigan o‘zaro bog‘langan inshoot va vositalar majmui. Sug‘orish tizimining asosiy vazifasi suvni manbadan olib, sug‘oriladigan maydonlarga kerakli muddat va miqdorda yetkazish, uni suv iste’molchilari va dalalar o‘rtasida taqsimlash hamda o‘simliklar uchun zarur tuproq namligini ta’minlashdan iborat.
example_uz: Gyermaniya olimlari sug‘orish uchun suvni teshikli quvurlar asosida berish vositasida boshqariluvchi sug‘orish tizimini ishlab chiqdilar. (Sug‘orish melioratsiyasi. Xamidov M.X. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An interconnected system comprising a water source, irrigated land, and the structures and facilities used to convey, regulate, distribute, and deliver irrigation water to agricultural fields. Its primary function is to supply irrigation water to cultivated land at the required time and in the required amount and to distribute it among fields and water users in order to maintain adequate soil moisture for crop growth.
example_en: The irrigation system consists of a (main) intake structure or (main) pumping station, a conveyance system, a distribution system, a field application system, and a drainage system. (Irrigation Water Management: Irrigation Methods. Brouwer C., Prins K., Kay M., Heibloem M., FAO, 1990)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Sug‘orish suvini bosh suv olish inshootidan sug‘oriladigan hudud va sug‘orish texnikasi elementlariga yetkazib berish hamda taqsimlashga xizmat qiladigan o‘zaro bog‘langan suv o‘tkazuvchi tarmoqlar majmui. Sug‘orish tarmoqlari ochiq, yopiq va kombinatsiyalashgan turlarda bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Sug‘orish tarmog‘ining asosiy vazifasi suvni bosh suv olish inshootidan olib, sug‘orish texnikasi elementlariga yetkazib berishdir. Sug‘orish tarmoqlari ochiq, yopiq va kombinatsiyalashgan turlarga bo‘linadi. (Sug‘orish melioratsiyasi. Xamidov M.X. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: An interconnected network of water conveyance and distribution facilities used to deliver irrigation water from a water source or intake to irrigated land. It may comprise main canals, inter-farm and on-farm distribution canals, pipelines, and associated water distribution structures.
etymology_en: Irrigation derives from Latin irrigatio, from irrigare, meaning "to water"; network is formed from net + work.
example_en: The irrigation network comprises 12 835 km of canals, of which 82 percent are earthen, 17 percent concrete and 1 percent are pipes. (Irrigation in Central Asia in Figures: AQUASTAT Survey – 2012. FAO, 2013)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning suvga bo‘lgan ehtiyojini qondirish va tuproq namligini zarur darajada saqlash maqsadida ekinlar, bog‘lar yoki ular o‘sayotgan tuproqqa sun’iy ravishda suv bermoq.
example_uz: Ko‘chat ekishdan oldin 70 sm li egatlar olinib, keyin sug‘oriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To supply water artificially to crops, plants, or soil in order to meet plant water requirements and maintain adequate soil moisture for growth and development.
etymology_en: From Latin irrigare, meaning "to water, moisten".
example_en: Irrigate to wet at least the top 0.6 m of rootzone. (Deficit Irrigation Practices. FAO)

definition_uz: Tok, qovoq va boshqa chirmashuvchi o‘simliklarni ko‘tarib, tayanchda o‘stirish hamda ularning novda yoki poyalarini muayyan tartibda joylashtirish uchun tik, qiya yoki boshqa shaklda quriladigan tayanch moslama.
example_uz: Yer bag‘irlatib o‘stirilgan tokzorlar va so‘riga ko‘tarilmagan yosh tokzorlar atrofidagi maydon dorilanadi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: A supporting framework used to support and train grapevines and other climbing plants. In viticulture, a trellis is the physical support structure, typically consisting of posts, wires, anchors, brackets, or other supporting components, on which grapevines are trained.
etymology_en: From Old French trelis, ultimately from Latin trilix, meaning "three-ply" or "three-threaded".
example_en: A trellis provides the support needed to train both permanent and semi-permanent grapevine parts. (Trellises for Grapes. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Dala tajribalari o‘tkazish uchun ajratilgan yer maydoni. Tajriba dalasida qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarining biologik va agrotexnik xususiyatlari, ularni turli tabiiy va xo‘jalik sharoitlarida yetishtirish usullari hamda boshqa tajriba omillari ilmiy metodika asosida o‘rganiladi. Tajriba natijalarining aniqligini ta’minlash uchun dalaning tuprog‘i imkon qadar bir xil, relyefi esa tajriba talablariga mos bo‘lishi lozim.
example_uz: Tajriba dalasida ko‘kno‘xat besh marta ekilganda hosildorlik gektariga 20,6 s ni tashkil etgan. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A field or designated area of agricultural land used for conducting field experiments under planned experimental conditions to study crops, treatments, cultivation practices, varieties, or other agronomic factors.
example_en: The experimental field should have a uniform soil, minimum variations and a statistically designed layout. (Fertilizer Use by Crop. FAO Fertilizer and Plant Nutrition Bulletin, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi bo‘yicha ilmiy tadqiqotlar olib boradigan muassasa. Tajriba stansiyalarida qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini yetishtirishning ilmiy asoslangan usullarini ishlab chiqish, navlarni sinash, seleksiya va urug‘chilik ishlarini olib borish hamda agrotexnik usullarni ishlab chiqarishga yaqin sharoitlarda tajribadan o‘tkazish kabi ilmiy-amaliy tadqiqotlar amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Past bo‘yli olma payvandtaglarining mavjud formalari birinchi marta Ist-Molling tajriba stansiyasida Angliyada professor R. Xetton va uning xodimlari tomonidan tizimga solingan. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: A scientific research institution or center established to conduct experiments and research, especially in agriculture, with the aim of improving agricultural production, crop management, cultivars, breeding methods, and related agricultural practices.
example_en: The East Malling Research Station in England created the first official rootstock series, starting in 1912. (All About Apple Rootstocks. University of Maryland Extension, 2022)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi sohasida ilmiy va amaliy tajribalar o‘tkazish, ekin navlari va yetishtirish usullarini sinash, yangi agrotexnologiyalarni dala sharoitida baholash hamda ilmiy natijalarni amaliyotda tekshirish uchun foydalaniladigan maxsus xo‘jalik.
example_uz: Mazkur tajriba xo‘jaligi hududidagi tuproqlarda zamonaviy agrotexnik va agrokimyoviy tadbirlarni ilmiy asosda tashkil etish orqali yuqori agroekologik salohiyatga erishish mumkin. (Tajriba xo‘jaligi tuproqlarining agrokimyoviy xossalari. Imamov F.Z., Agroinnovatsiya jurnali, 2026, 4(2))
definition_en: A farm used primarily for agricultural research and experimentation, including the testing and evaluation of crop varieties, cultivation practices, management methods, and agricultural technologies under field conditions.
example_en: In our research activities, in addition to crops such as paddy rice and wheat, we are conducting various basic and applied research in the fields of crop sciences, fruit horticulture, and animal science. (Experimental Farm. Faculty of Agriculture, Yamaguchi University)

definition_uz: Daraxtning ildiz bo‘g‘zidan yuqoriga davom etadigan asosiy yog‘ochlashgan poyasi bo‘lib, undan asosiy shoxlar ajralib chiqadi va shox-shabba shakllanadi. Tana daraxtning yer ustki qismlarini mexanik tayanch bilan ta’minlaydi hamda ildizlar bilan barglar va boshqa yer ustki organlari o‘rtasida suv, mineral moddalar va organik moddalarning harakatini ta’minlovchi o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalarni o‘z ichiga oladi.
example_uz: Intensiv olma bog‘larida qish mavsumida daraxt tanasining pastki qismi, ayniqsa janubi-g‘arbiy tomoni sovuq ta’sirida ko‘p hollarda zararlanadi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: The main woody stem of a tree, extending upward from the root system and supporting the branches and crown. It contains vascular tissues that conduct water and mineral nutrients from the roots and transport organic substances between different parts of the tree.
etymology_en: From Old French tronc, from Latin truncus, meaning "trunk or stem of a tree".
example_en: As plants grow, their stems get thicker and sturdier to provide support. Soft green shoots gradually become woody and less flexible and tree trunks increase in girth. (How Plants Grow and Thrive. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS)

definition_uz: Seleksiyada irsiy va xo‘jalik jihatdan qimmatli belgilarga ega o‘simliklar yoki boshqa seleksion materialni ajratib olish hamda ulardan keyingi ko‘paytirish va seleksiya ishlarida foydalanish jarayoni. Tanlash o‘simliklarning kerakli belgilarini avlodlarda saqlash va yangi navlar yaratishda qo‘llaniladigan asosiy seleksiya usullaridan biridir.
example_uz: Ko‘chat yetishtirishda olmaning Star Krimson navidan serhosil va kuchsiz o‘sadigan qalamchalarni tanlash muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The process of choosing plants or other breeding materials possessing desirable heritable or agronomic traits for reproduction, propagation, or further use in a plant breeding programme.
etymology_en: From Latin selectio, from seligere, meaning "to choose, select".
example_en: Plants of a given population which show desired traits can be selected and used for further breeding and cultivation, a process called (pure line-) selection. (Methods of Plant Breeding. Centre for Biosafety and Sustainability, 1995)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Nisbatan yuqori harorat sharoitida yaxshi o‘sadigan va rivojlanadigan organizm yoki o‘simlikka nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan ekologik sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda termofil o‘simliklar o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun nisbatan iliq harorat sharoitlarini talab qiladigan hamda past haroratga sezgir bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan o‘simliklarni tavsiflashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha thermē — "issiqlik" + philos — "sevuvchi".
example_uz: Boshqa hollarda I.V. Michurin sovuqqa chidamli mahalliy navlarni tanlab oldi va ularni janubiy termofil navlari bilan chatishtirdi. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: Describing an organism that grows or thrives under relatively warm or high-temperature conditions.
etymology_en: From thermo- ("heat") + -philic ("loving, having an affinity for").
example_en: Tomato is a thermophilic vegetable and sensitive to low temperature. (SSR Mapping of QTLs Conferring Cold Tolerance in an Interspecific Cross of Tomato. Liu B. et al., International Journal of Genomics, 2016)

definition_uz: Pishib yetilgan yoki yig‘ib olish uchun zarur yetuklik darajasiga kelgan meva, sabzavot, uzum, gul yoki boshqa o‘simlik mahsulotini qo‘l bilan yoki tegishli moslama yordamida o‘simlikdan uzib olmoq.
example_uz: O‘rik va shaftoli terishda bir qo‘l bilan shoxchani ushlab, ikkinchi qo‘l bilan mevalar teriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To remove fruit, vegetables, flowers, or other plant products from the plant by hand or with an appropriate tool, especially when they have reached a suitable stage of maturity.
example_en: Fruits should be picked at colour break stage. (Crop Production Guide: Horticulture Crops. Directorate of Horticulture and Plantation Crops & Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, 2020)

definition_uz: Vegetatsiya yoki hosilning shakllanish va yetilish davri nisbatan qisqa bo‘lgan, qisqa muddatda pishib yetiladigan o‘simlik yoki navga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Tezpisharlik navning vegetatsiya boshlanishidan yoki hosil shakllanishidan yetilishigacha bo‘lgan davrining nisbatan qisqaligi bilan tavsiflanadi.
example_uz: Bu navlar qurg‘oqchilikka mumkin qadar chidamli, tezpishar va vegetatsiya davri qisqa bo‘lishi kerak. (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi. Ribakov A.A., Ostrauxova S.A., 1981)
definition_en: Describing a plant or cultivar that reaches maturity relatively early or has a comparatively short period to crop or fruit maturity.
example_en: It is an early-maturing cultivar as indicated by the name 'Daw' meaning early. (Longan Production in Asia. FAO, RAP Publication 2000/20)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Tig‘i dastaga ko‘ndalang o‘rnatilgan, asosan yog‘ochni yo‘nish va chopishda, shuningdek ayrim qishloq xo‘jaligi ishlarida tuproqni yumshatish va ishlashda qo‘llaniladigan qo‘l asbobi.
example_uz: Qator oralari bitta ot qo‘shiladigan otvalsiz plug bilan yumshatilib, orqasidan kultivatsiya qilinadi, qatorlar esa ketmonda, motigada yoki teshada yumshatiladi. (O‘zbekiston mevachiligi. Ribakov A.A., Ostrauxova S.A., 1981)
definition_en: A hand tool with a cutting blade set at right angles to the handle, traditionally used for cutting, shaping, or dressing wood and also used in some agricultural and horticultural work.
etymology_en: From Old English adesa, of uncertain origin.
example_en: Adze. A tool consisting of a thin arched blade with its edge at right-angles to the handle like a hoe, used for slicing off the surface of a piece of wood, e.g., in farming work. (Encyclopaedia of Horticulture. Peter K.V. (ed.), New India Publishing Agency, 2021)

definition_uz: O‘simlik poyasi, novdasi yoki shoxining o‘zgarishidan hosil bo‘lgan, qattiq, o‘tkir uchli va odatda himoya vazifasini bajaruvchi tuzilma.
example_uz: Shoxlari tikanli, nordon anorlarning tikani shirin anorlarnikidan ko‘p bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A hard, sharp-pointed structure formed by the modification of a stem, shoot, or branch, usually functioning in plant defense.
etymology_en: From Old English þorn, meaning "thorn; sharp point on a stem or branch".
example_en: Thorn presence on shoots was detected in 19 genotypes, whereas 28 were thornless. (Morphological and pomological characterizations of pomegranate (Punica granatum L.) to select superior genotypes. Scientific Reports, 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simlik poyasi, novdasi yoki boshqa organining yuzaki to‘qimalaridan rivojlanadigan, qattiq va o‘tkir uchli morfologik tuzilma.
example_uz: Na’matak novdalari tikanlar bilan qoplangan, barglari 5–7 ta lansetsimon, ovalsimon, chekkalari tishchali. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: A hard, sharp-pointed outgrowth arising from the superficial tissues of a plant organ, especially a stem or shoot.
example_en: Rose prickles are small-scale, plant-based anchoring tools of multifunctional biomechanical roles, combining physical defense against herbivores and growth support on surrounding objects. (How do roses build failure-resistant anchoring tools? PNAS Nexus, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlik bargi yoki barg qismining o‘zgarishidan hosil bo‘lgan, qattiq, o‘tkir uchli va odatda himoya vazifasini bajaruvchi morfologik tuzilma.
example_uz: Zirk turlari zirkdoshlar (Berberidaceae) oilasiga mansub bo‘lib, bo‘yi 3–4 m gacha yetadigan tikanli buta. Tikanlari oddiy yoki uch bo‘lakli. (O‘rmon dorivor o‘simliklari. Berdiyev E.T., 2016)
definition_en: A stiff, sharp-pointed structure formed by the modification of a leaf or part of a leaf, usually functioning in plant defense.
etymology_en: From Latin spina, meaning "thorn, spine".
example_en: The spines of Berberis descended from leaves, origins from leaf primordial, are leaf spines, not stem spines. (A New Understanding of the Spines in Genus Berberis: Morphology and Occurrence of Spines in Berberis thunbergii var. atropurpurea. Miao Q., Zhai Q., Qu B., Shi M.M., Yan B.Y., Shao M.N., Bulletin of Botanical Research, 2020, 40(2): 172–176)

definition_uz: Daraxt, tok yoki boshqa o‘simliklarning tanasi, shoxi yoki novdasini tayanch bilan ta’minlash, og‘ir hosil ta’sirida egilish yoki sinishdan saqlash uchun tagiga yoki yoniga qo‘yiladigan yog‘och, metall yoki boshqa mustahkam materialdan tayyorlangan tayanch.
example_uz: Baland bo‘yli daraxt shox-shabbalaridan hosilni terib olish, uni parvarishlash va hosilli shoxlar tagiga tirgovuchlar qo‘yish ham ancha qiyinlashadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A support placed under or against a branch or other plant part to hold it in position and prevent it from bending or breaking, particularly under the weight of a heavy fruit crop.
example_en: Support heavily laden fruit branches with a prop or stake to stop them snapping. (Jobs to do in July. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS)

definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi butalar turkumi. Barglari oddiy, gullari mayda, odatda oq yoki pushti rangli bo‘lib, shoda, ro‘vak yoki qalqonsimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Tobulg‘ining ayrim turlari ko‘p va chiroyli gullashi sababli manzarali o‘simlik sifatida, shuningdek yonbag‘ir va jarliklarni mustahkamlashda ekiladi.
example_uz: Tobulg‘ining ba’zi turlari jarliklar va tog‘ yonbag‘irlarini mustahkamlashda ekiladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Tobulg‘i” maqolasi)
definition_en: A genus of deciduous shrubs in the family Rosaceae, with simple leaves and clusters of small, five-petalled white or pink flowers, many species and cultivars of which are grown as ornamental shrubs in gardens and landscapes.
etymology_en: From Latin Spiraea, from Greek speira, meaning "coil" or "wreath".
example_en: Spiraea are deciduous shrubs, sometimes suckering, with simple leaves and short racemes, panicles or corymbs of small, 5-petalled white or pink flowers in spring or summer. (Royal Horticultural Society, RHS, Spiraea plant profile)

definition_uz: Tokdoshlar (Vitaceae) oilasining Vitis turkumiga mansub ko‘p yillik yog‘ochlashgan chirmashuvchi o‘simlik. Tok mo‘ylovlari yordamida tayanchga ilashib o‘sadi. Madaniy turlari va navlari uzum yetishtirish uchun o‘stiriladi; hosili yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi yoki mayiz, sharbat, vino va boshqa mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston maydonining katta qismida ayrim yillarda qishda havo harorati minus 25–30 °C gacha pasayadi, bu tokni qishda ko‘mishni talab etadi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: A perennial woody climbing plant of the genus Vitis in the family Vitaceae, cultivated for its grapes. Grapevines climb with the aid of tendrils, and their fruit is consumed fresh or processed into raisins, juice, wine, and other grape products.
etymology_en: From grape + vine; grape is from Old French grape, while vine is from Old French vigne, ultimately from Latin vinea.
example_en: Grapevines are vigorous climbers that need regular winter pruning and management through the growing season to produce a good harvest and keep them within bounds. (Grapes: Pruning and Training. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS)

definition_uz: Tokning o‘sishi va shaklini boshqarish, hosil yuklamasini tartibga solish hamda hosildorlik va uzum sifatini ta’minlash maqsadida bir yillik novdalar va keraksiz ko‘p yillik qismlarni belgilangan tartibda kesib tashlash yoki qisqartirishdan iborat agrotexnik tadbir.
example_uz: Tokzorlarda tok kesishni birinchi navbatda erta va o‘rtapishar navlardan boshlash zarur, chunki ularning novdalari tezroq pishadi va kesishga qulay bo‘ladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: The practice of selectively removing or shortening canes and other woody parts of a grapevine to regulate vegetative growth, maintain vine form, control crop load, and promote consistent yield and fruit quality.
example_en: Grapevine pruning is a perennial management practice that retains select one year old grapevine wood to produce next season's crop. (Grapevine Cane and Spur Pruning Fundamentals. Hickey C., Penn State Extension)

definition_uz: Uzum yetishtirish maqsadida toklar ekilgan va muayyan agrotexnik tizim asosida parvarish qilinadigan yer maydoni. Tokzorda xo‘raki, mayizbop, vinobop yoki sharbat tayyorlashga mo‘ljallangan uzum navlari yetishtirilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Uzum quritish yoki uzoq joylarga yuborish uchun mo‘ljallangan tokzorlarni sug‘orish hosilni yig‘ishtirib olishdan 2–3 hafta oldin to‘xtatilishi kerak. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: An area of land planted with cultivated grapevines and managed for the production of grapes for fresh consumption, raisins, wine, juice, or other grape products.
etymology_en: From Middle English vineyard, replacing Old English wīngeard; formed from vine + yard, referring to a plantation of grapevines.
example_en: Vineyard: A land area clearly delineated by a physical barrier (e.g. ranch road, canal, highway, etc.) and planted with cultivated grapevines that produce grapes for consumption, raisins, wine or juice. (United States Department of Agriculture, Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service — USDA APHIS)

definition_uz: Tokni yetishtirish va parvarish qilish, tokzorlar barpo etish, tokka shakl berish va uni kesish, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish hamda uzum hosili yetishtirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi bog‘dorchilik tarmog‘i.
example_uz: Tokchilikda o‘g‘itlarni qo‘llash samaradorligi ko‘pgina omillar bilan belgilanadi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: The science, art, and practice of cultivating grapevines and producing grapes, including vineyard establishment and the management of vine growth, nutrition, irrigation, pruning, pests, diseases, and harvesting.
etymology_en: From Latin vitis, meaning "vine", + culture, ultimately from Latin cultura, meaning "cultivation".
example_en: Viticulture is a complex and dynamic system, where climate is a key environmental component of plant suitability and productivity. (Spatial Complexity and Temporal Dynamics in Viticulture: A Review of Climate-Driven Scales. Neethling E., Barbeau G., Coulon-Leroy C., Quénol H., Agricultural and Forest Meteorology, 2019)

definition_uz: Suvni quvurlar va tomchilatkichlar orqali o‘simliklar yaqinidagi tuproqqa kichik miqdorda va sekin yetkazib berishga asoslangan sug‘orish usuli. Bunda asosan o‘simlik ildizlari joylashgan tuproq qismi namlanadi. Suvning kam miqdorda va tez-tez berilishi ildiz zonasidagi namlikni boshqarish hamda suvdan samarali foydalanish imkonini beradi.
example_uz: Tomchilatib sug‘orish — suvni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri o‘simlik ildizlariga yetkazib berish orqali suv resurslarini samarali va tejamkorona ishlatish usuli hisoblanadi. (Tomchilatib sug‘orish tizimini rivojlantirish istiqbollari. Nurova H.N., Turdaliyev V.M., Development of Science, 2025, 1(4))
definition_en: An irrigation method in which water is applied slowly at very low rates through a system of small-diameter pipes fitted with emitters or drippers, wetting mainly the soil close to the plants and their root zone.
example_en: Drip irrigation is sometimes called trickle irrigation and involves dripping water onto the soil at very low rates (2–20 litres/hour) from a system of small diameter plastic pipes fitted with outlets called emitters or drippers. (Irrigation Water Management: Irrigation Methods. FAO, Training Manual No. 5)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Daraxt va butalarni muntazam kesish, qaychilash va shakllantirish orqali ularga geometrik yoki turli dekorativ shakllar berish san’ati va bog‘dorchilik amaliyoti. Topiar san’atida o‘simliklarga shar, konus, piramida kabi geometrik shakllar, shuningdek hayvon, qush va boshqa murakkab badiiy shakllar berilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Topiar lotincha topiarius — "bezak bog‘dorchiligiga oid, bezak bog‘boni" so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, yunoncha topos — "joy" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Topiar — daraxt va butalarga kesib shakl berish yo‘li bilan sun’iy manzarali yashil kompozitsiyalar, alohida geometrik yoki fantastik shakllar hosil qilish usulidir. (Manzarali daraxtlarni ko‘paytirish. Berdiyev E.T., Gulamxodjayeva Sh.F., Toshkent, 2020)
definition_en: The art and horticultural practice of training and clipping plants, typically shrubs and trees, into clearly defined ornamental, geometric, or figurative shapes and forms.
etymology_en: From Latin topiarius, from topia, meaning "ornamental gardening", ultimately related to Greek topos, meaning "place".
example_en: Topiary is the art of training plants (typically evergreen shrubs and trees) into intricate or stylized shapes and forms. (Topiary. The RHS Advice Team, Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Genetik muhandislik usullari yordamida genomiga boshqa organizmdan olingan bir yoki bir nechta begona gen (transgen) kiritilgan o‘simliklar. Transgenlar o‘simlikka zararkunandalar, kasalliklar yoki gerbitsidlarga chidamlilik, mahsulot sifati yoki boshqa muayyan belgilarni berish maqsadida kiritilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Transgen: lotincha trans — "orqali, narigi tomonga" + gen, yunoncha genos — "kelib chiqish, nasl".
example_uz: Transgen o‘simliklar yetishtirishda T-DNK (transfer DNK) o‘ta muhim ahamiyatga ega bo‘lgan texnologiyalardan biridir. (Transgen o‘simliklar yetishtirishda T-DNKning ahamiyati. Fayzullayev B.A. va boshq., Yangi O‘zbekiston taraqqiyotida tadqiqotlarning o‘rni va rivojlanish omillari, 2024, 13(1))
definition_en: Plants whose genomes contain one or more introduced transgenes, typically incorporated through genetic engineering to confer particular traits or functions.
etymology_en: From trans- ("across, beyond") + gene; gene ultimately derives from Greek genos, meaning "race, kind, offspring".
example_en: A transgenic plant contains one or more genes from other species of plants. (NAL Agricultural Thesaurus. U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Library)

definition_uz: Saraton va Jadiy tropiklari oralig‘idagi tropik mintaqaga, uning iqlimiga yoki shu sharoitga xos organizm va tabiiy hodisalarga oid. Bog‘dorchilikda tropik termini iliq iqlim sharoitiga moslashgan va odatda sovuqqa sezgir o‘simliklarni tavsiflashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha tropikos — "burilishga oid", tropos — "burilish".
example_uz: Anjir turkumiga 1000 ga yaqin tur kiradi. Ularning ko‘pchiligi tropik, kamroq qismi subtropik mamlakatlarda va iqlimi mo‘tadil hududlarda o‘sadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Relating to the tropics or to tropical climatic conditions. In horticulture, the term commonly describes plants adapted to warm climates that are generally sensitive to frost or freezing temperatures.
etymology_en: From Greek tropikos ("of or pertaining to a turn"), from trope ("turning"), in reference to the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn.
example_en: Tropical plants are native to warm, humid, frost-free zones but can provide interest to Pennsylvania gardens during the summer months and even beyond. (Tropical Plants to Overwinter. Penn State Extension, 2023)

definition_uz: Tropik mintaqalarning iliq iqlim sharoitiga moslashgan o‘simliklari. Ko‘pchiligi past harorat va sovuqqa sezgir bo‘lib, tropik hududlardan tashqarida issiqxona, oranjereya, qishki bog‘ yoki interyer sharoitida yetishtirilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Oranjereya o‘simliklarining yorug‘likka bo‘lgan talabi qanchalik qondirilmasin, tropik o‘simliklardagi fotoperiodizm hodisasi muammosi yechimi baribir qiyinligicha qoladi. (O‘zbekistonda tropik va subtropik o‘simliklar introduksiyasi va ularning istiqbollari. Ahmedova M.N., 2013)
definition_en: Plants adapted to tropical climatic conditions and generally requiring warm temperatures. Many tropical plants are sensitive to low temperatures and frost and may require protected or indoor conditions when cultivated outside tropical regions.
example_en: Tropical plants are native to warm, humid, frost-free zones but can provide interest to Pennsylvania gardens during the summer months and even beyond. (Tropical Plants to Overwinter. Penn State Extension, 2023)

definition_uz: Oziq moddalarni zaxira qilish uchun yo‘g‘onlashgan, odatda yer ostida joylashgan o‘simlik organi. Tugunak poya yoki ildizning yo‘g‘onlashishi natijasida hosil bo‘lishi mumkin hamda o‘simlikning noqulay sharoitlarni o‘tkazishi va vegetativ ko‘payishida ishtirok etishi mumkin. Kartoshka tugunagi yo‘g‘onlashgan o‘zgargan poyaga misol bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Urug‘lik uchun ekilgan kartoshkalarni qalinroq ekish lozim, tugunaklar mayda bo‘lsa yaxshi urug‘lik chiqadi. (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Sindarov O.X., 2024)
definition_en: A swollen, usually underground, part of a stem or root used by a plant for food storage. Tubers may also enable plants to survive periods of dormancy or adverse conditions and can function in vegetative propagation.
etymology_en: From Latin tuber, meaning "swelling, lump or protuberance".
example_en: Solanum tuberosum (potato) is a modified stem called a tuber. (Stem Modifications. BIOL/APBI 210 Lab Information, University of British Columbia)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organlari epidermisidan hosil bo‘ladigan bir yoki ko‘p hujayrali tukchasimon o‘simta. Botanika terminologiyasida bunday tuzilmalar trixomalar deb ataladi. Trixomalar tuzilishi va vazifasiga ko‘ra turlicha bo‘lib, o‘simlikni tashqi ta’sirlardan himoya qilish, suv yo‘qotilishini kamaytirish hamda ayrim hollarda turli moddalarni ajratish kabi vazifalarni bajaradi.
example_uz: Behi mevalari limon rangida yoki to‘q sariq, tuk bilan qoplangan bo‘ladi, yetilganda tuki to‘kilib ketadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A unicellular or multicellular epidermal outgrowth of a plant organ. Trichomes vary in structure and function and may provide protection against biotic and abiotic stresses, reduce water loss, or, in glandular forms, produce and secrete substances.
etymology_en: From Greek trichōma, from thrix, trichos, meaning "hair".
example_en: Most plant species have hair-like epidermal structures in their seed coat and aerial parts. Trichomes, originating from epidermal cells, are known to provide protection against various environmental and biotic stresses. (The role, regulation and application of plant fruit trichomes, 2025)

definition_uz: Zirkdoshlar (Berberidaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi, tikanli manzarali buta. Vatani Yaponiya. Barglari mayda, tuxumsimon yoki teskari tuxumsimon bo‘lib, kuzda yorqin qizil va to‘q sariq tuslarga kiradi. Gullari mayda, sariq, mevalari qizil. Manzarali bog‘dorchilikda bordyur, tirik devor va turli landshaft kompozitsiyalarida qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Tur epiteti thunbergii shved tabiatshunosi va botanigi Carl Peter Thunberg (1743–1828) sharafiga berilgan.
example_uz: Tunberg zirki (Berberis thunbergii DC.) balandligi 0,5–1 metrga yetadigan bargini to‘kuvchi eng manzarali zirk turi hisoblanadi. (Manzarali daraxtlarni ko‘paytirish. Berdiyev E.T., Gulamxodjayeva Sh.F., 2020)
definition_en: A deciduous, spiny ornamental shrub of the family Berberidaceae, native to Japan. It has small leaves that develop red and orange autumn colours, small yellow flowers, and red fruits. It is cultivated as an ornamental shrub and used in hedges, borders, and landscape plantings.
etymology_en: The specific epithet thunbergii commemorates the Swedish botanist and naturalist Carl Peter Thunberg (1743–1828).
example_en: Japanese barberry (Berberis thunbergii) is a deciduous flowering shrub native to Japan. (Japanese Barberry. University of Maryland Extension)

definition_uz: Urug‘chining chang donalarini qabul qiladigan qismi. Tumshuqcha yuzasi changning yopishishi, unishi va chang naychasining rivojlanishi uchun moslashgan bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Bu kasallikda zamburug‘ gullarga tushib, gul tumshuqchalari orqali daraxt ichiga qarab kirib boradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The receptive part of the female reproductive structure of a flower on which pollen is deposited and may germinate.
etymology_en: From Greek stigma, meaning "mark, point, puncture".
example_en: The pollinia, which hang on a thread, are blown against the receptive surface of the stigma. (Ophrys apifera — Plants of the World Online, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)

definition_uz: Yer yuzasida shakllangan, mineral va organik moddalar, suv, havo hamda tirik organizmlardan tarkib topgan va o‘simliklarning o‘sishi uchun tabiiy muhit vazifasini bajaradigan tabiiy jism.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlar uchun havo va tuproqning harorati nihoyatda katta ahamiyatga egadir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A natural body at the Earth's surface composed of mineral and organic matter, water, air, and living organisms that serves as a natural medium for plant growth.
etymology_en: From Middle English soil, from Anglo-French soil, meaning "piece of land, ground".
example_en: Soil is the foundation of any successful garden. (The Foundation of Your Garden. Osborn T., N.C. Cooperative Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Tuproqlarni ularning tabiiy unumdorligi, sifat xususiyatlari va qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini yetishtirish imkoniyatini belgilovchi ko‘rsatkichlari asosida qiyosiy ravishda ball bilan baholash jarayoni. Bonitirovkada tuproqning unumdorlikka va ekinlar hosildorligiga ta’sir qiluvchi diagnostik xususiyatlari hisobga olinadi.
etymology_uz: Bonitirovka lotincha bonus — "yaxshi" asosiga borib taqalib, sifat jihatdan baholash ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Suvli maydonlarda tuproq bonitirovkasi o‘tkazishda gumus qatlamining qalinligi hamda sho‘rlanish darajasi asosiy tuzatuvchi koeffitsiyentlar sifatida e’tiborga olinadi. (Tuproq bonitirovkasi va xaritalash. Nomozov X. va boshq., 2016)
synonyms_uz: Tuproqni ball bilan baholash; Tuproq sifatini baholash
definition_en: The comparative assessment of soils according to their quality, natural fertility, and properties related to agricultural productivity, commonly expressed as a numerical score or bonitet grade.
etymology_en: Bonitation ultimately derives from Latin bonus, meaning "good", and denotes comparative evaluation according to quality.
example_en: Soil quality conditions in Uzbekistan are reflected in the so-called soil bonitet. Soil bonitet is a relative score, ranging from 0 to 100, given to indicate the soil quality and natural fertility. (Soils and Soil Ecology in Khorezm, ZEF/UNESCO Khorezm Project)

definition_uz: Tuproq tarkibidagi mineral va organik komponentlar, kimyoviy elementlar hamda ularning miqdori va o‘zaro nisbatlari. Tuproqning kimyoviy tarkibi tuproqning kimyoviy xossalari, oziqa elementlarining mavjudligi, unumdorligi va o‘simliklarning oziqlanish sharoitiga ta’sir qiluvchi muhim omillardan biridir.
example_uz: Yorug‘likning o‘zgarishi bilan o‘simlik, tuproq va havoning harorati, namligi, tuproqning kimyoviy tarkibi hamda mikrobiologik muhit o‘zgaradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The composition and relative proportions of the mineral and organic components and chemical elements present in soil, which influence its chemical properties, nutrient availability, fertility, and conditions for plant growth.
example_en: The soil chemical composition of the experimental vineyard after correction is suitable for planting grapevines. (Maturity of Cabernet Sauvignon berries from grapevines grown with two different training systems in a new grape growing region in Brazil. Chilean Journal of Agricultural Research, 2008, 68(3): 271–278)

definition_uz: Tuproq tarkibida mavjud bo‘lgan suv miqdorini ifodalovchi agrofizik ko‘rsatkich. Tuproq namligi urug‘larning unishi, ildizlarning rivojlanishi, o‘simliklarning suv va oziq moddalarni o‘zlashtirishi, o‘sishi va hosil shakllanishiga ta’sir qiladi hamda sug‘orishni boshqarishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Tuproqning namligi mevalarning sifatiga ham ta’sir qiladi. Kamroq, shuningdek, kechiktirib sug‘orish, ayniqsa, hosil mo‘l bo‘ladigan yillari mevalarning to‘kilib ketishiga sabab bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The amount of water present in soil. Soil moisture influences plant growth, root development, water and nutrient uptake, crop yield, and irrigation management.
example_en: Consistent soil moisture is critical to ensuring high yields and preventing physiological problems in fruit and vegetable crops. (Irrigation Strategies for Vegetables. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Tuproqning o‘z g‘ovaklarida suvni ushlab qolish qobiliyati va ushlab qola oladigan suv miqdori bilan tavsiflanadigan agrofizik xususiyati. Tuproq nam sig‘imi tuproqning mexanik tarkibi, strukturasi, organik modda miqdori va g‘ovaklarining xususiyatlariga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Tuproq nam sig‘imining bu shakli juda muhim gidrologik konstanta bo‘lib, o‘simlik uchun zarur bo‘lgan suv jamg‘armasi hisoblanadi. (Tuproq fizikasi. Isxakova Sh. va boshq., 2024)
definition_en: The capacity of a soil to retain water within its pore system against gravitational drainage. Soil water-holding capacity is influenced by soil texture, structure, organic matter content, and pore characteristics.
example_en: Soil water holding capacity is a term that all farms should know to optimize crop production. (Why is soil water holding capacity important? Curell C., Michigan State University Extension, 2011)

definition_uz: Tuproq eritmasi va tuproqning almashinuv kompleksidagi kislotali holatni ifodalovchi xususiyat. Faol nordonlik tuproq eritmasidagi vodorod ionlari faolligi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, pH orqali ifodalanadi; almashinuvchi nordonlik esa tuproqning almashinuv kompleksidagi kislotali komponentlar bilan bog‘liq. Tuproq nordonligi oziqa elementlarining o‘zlashtirilishi, mikroorganizmlar faoliyati va o‘simliklarning o‘sishiga ta’sir qiladi.
example_uz: Tuproq nordonligi tabiatini o‘rganishda amerikalik olim T.P. Veytcha (1904) va yapon olimi Daykuxara ishlari diqqatga sazovor bo‘lib, nordon tuproqlar bilan osh tuzining o‘zaro ta’sirida eritmaga alyuminiy chiqishi va uning miqdorining kislotalik miqdoriga yaqinligini ochishi hozirda ham muhokama qilinmoqda. (Tuproq kimyosi. Yuldashev G‘., Abdurahmonov T., Ajabbarov Z., 2019)
definition_en: The acidic condition of soil associated with hydrogen ions in the soil solution and acidity held on soil exchange sites. Active soil acidity is expressed by soil pH, while exchangeable acidity represents acidity associated with the soil exchange complex. Soil acidity affects nutrient availability, biological activity, and plant growth.
etymology_en: Acidity derives from Latin acidus, meaning "sour or sharp".
example_en: This publication explains the importance of soil acidity to plant growth and discusses how to modify it to ensure that rhododendrons, blueberries, and other “acid-loving” plants thrive in your garden. (Acidifying Soil for Blueberries and Ornamental Plants in the Yard and Garden. Hart J.M., Horneck D.A., Stevens R.G., Bell N., Oregon State University Extension Service)

definition_uz: Sizot suvlari sathini ko‘tarish yoki boshqarish orqali o‘simlik ildizi joylashgan tuproq qatlamini pastdan namlashga asoslangan sug‘orish usuli. Bunda sizot suvlari tuproq kapillyarlari orqali yuqoriga ko‘tarilib, o‘simlik ildiz zonasini suv bilan ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Tuproq ostidan sug‘orish (subirrigatsiya) – sizot suvlari sathini ko‘tarish orqali sug‘orish bo‘lib, tuproqning o‘simlik ildizi joylashgan qatlamiga sizot suvlari tuproq kapillyarlari orqali ko‘tariladi. (Sug‘orish melioratsiyasi. Xamidov M., Suvanov B., Isabaev K., 2019)
definition_en: An irrigation method in which the groundwater table is artificially raised or regulated so that water reaches the crop root zone from below by capillary action.
etymology_en: From sub- ("under, below") + irrigation.
example_en: Subirrigation is the supply of water to the root zone of crops by artificially regulating the groundwater-table elevation. (Small-scale Irrigation for Arid Zones: Criteria and Options for Appropriate Irrigation Methods. FAO)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Tuproqning o‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanishini ta’minlash uchun zarur oziqa elementlarini yetkazib berish hamda qulay fizik, kimyoviy va biologik sharoitlarni ta’minlash qobiliyati.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarda ildiz tizimining joylashishi va rivojlanishi uning ulangan payvandtaglariga hamda tuproq unumdorligiga bog‘liq. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The ability of soil to sustain plant growth by providing essential plant nutrients and favorable chemical, physical, and biological conditions for plant growth.
example_en: Use soil fertility analysis to ensure that nutrient levels are maintained in adequate ranges. (Tree Fruit Soil Fertility and Plant Nutrition in Cropping Orchards in Central Washington. Sallato B., DuPont T., Granatstein D., Washington State University Extension, revised 2022)

definition_uz: Biologik sistematikadagi asosiy taksonomik birliklardan biri bo‘lib, muayyan umumiy xususiyatlar va evolyutsion yaqinlikka ega organizmlarni birlashtiradi. Jinsiy ko‘payadigan ko‘plab organizmlarda bir turga mansub individlarning o‘zaro chatishib nasl berishi turni ajratishda qo‘llaniladigan mezonlardan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Har bir mevali daraxt turi va navida ularning maqbul o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun o‘ziga mos keladigan past, o‘rtacha va yuqori harorat mavjud. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A taxonomic rank used in the classification of organisms and a basic unit for recognizing biologically and evolutionarily distinct groups. Species are classified on the basis of relevant morphological, molecular, evolutionary, and other taxonomic evidence.
etymology_en: From Latin species, meaning "appearance, kind, form".
example_en: Each species is assigned a two-part scientific name. (Curating a School Museum: Handbook. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)

definition_uz: Biologik sistematikada bir yoki bir nechta o‘zaro yaqin turlarni birlashtiruvchi taksonomik birlik. Turkum turdan yuqori va oiladan quyi taksonomik pog‘onada joylashadi. Ikki nomli ilmiy nomenklaturada turkum nomi tur ilmiy nomining birinchi qismini tashkil etadi va bosh harf bilan yoziladi.
example_uz: Olma turkumining 50 ga yaqin turi bor. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A taxonomic rank above species and below family that comprises one or more related species. In binomial nomenclature, the genus name forms the first part of a species name and is written with an initial capital letter.
etymology_en: From Latin genus (genitive generis), meaning "birth, race, kind".
example_en: Malus is a genus of over 50 species of small flowering deciduous trees or shrubs in the Rosaceae (rose) family. (Apple – Malus. North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox, North Carolina State University)

definition_uz: Karamdoshlar (Brassicaceae) oilasiga mansub ildizmevali sabzavot ekini. Rediskaga nisbatan ko‘plab turp tiplari yirikroq ildizmeva hosil qiladi, uzoqroq vegetatsiya davriga ega bo‘ladi va ayrim navlari yaxshi saqlanish xususiyati bilan ajralib turadi. Ildizmevasi yumaloq, uzunchoq, silindrsimon yoki konussimon bo‘lib, oq, qora, yashil, qizg‘ish, pushti yoki binafsha ranglarda bo‘lishi mumkin. Eti odatda zich, shirali va o‘ziga xos o‘tkir ta’mli.
example_uz: Ildizmevalilar: bularga turp, sabzi, sholg‘om, rediska, lavlagi, pasternak, buyrakva kiradi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A root vegetable crop of the family Brassicaceae. Compared with small, fast-growing spring radishes, many larger radish types mature more slowly, develop considerably larger roots, and may have better storage potential. Their edible roots vary widely in shape, including round, elongated, cylindrical, and conical forms, and may be white, black, green, reddish, pink, or purple. The flesh is generally firm, juicy, and characteristically pungent.
etymology_en: The word radish ultimately derives from Latin radix, meaning "root".
example_en: Winter radishes are slower to develop than spring radishes; grow considerably larger, remain crisp longer, are usually more pungent, and hold in the ground or store longer than spring varieties. (University of Illinois Extension. “Radish.” Home Vegetable Gardening)

definition_uz: Tutdoshlar (Moraceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt va butalar turkumi. Mevasi ko‘plab mayda bir urug‘li mevalarning birlashishidan hosil bo‘ladigan to‘pmeva bo‘lib, tur va naviga qarab oq, pushti, qizil, binafsha yoki qora rangda bo‘lishi mumkin. Mevalari yangi yoki qayta ishlangan holda iste’mol qilinadi. Oq tut (Morus alba L.) barglari ipak qurti uchun muhim ozuqa hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Anjir va tut mevasi to‘p mevadir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A genus of deciduous trees and shrubs in the family Moraceae, producing edible multiple fruits. Mulberries are cultivated for their fruits, while the leaves of white mulberry (Morus alba L.) are used as food for silkworms.
etymology_en: From Middle English mulbere or mulbery, ultimately combining a form derived from Latin morum, meaning "mulberry", with berry.
example_en: Silkworms (that make silk) eat the leaves of the white mulberry. (Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Oxford University Press)

definition_uz: Tut (Morus spp.) daraxtlari maqsadli ravishda ekilgan va parvarish qilinadigan maydon yoki plantatsiya. Tutzorlar, ayniqsa, ipak qurti uchun barg yetishtirish, shuningdek, tut mevasi olish va boshqa xo‘jalik maqsadlarida barpo etiladi.
example_uz: Tutzor buta shaklida o‘stirilganda uchinchi yili gektaridan 90 s gacha barg hosili beradi. (Tut daraxti seleksiyasi. Rahmonberdiev V.K., Mirzayeva Yo.Ya., 2022)
definition_en: An area planted and managed with mulberry (Morus spp.) trees for the production of leaves used in silkworm rearing, as well as for fruit production and other agricultural purposes.
example_en: This finding validates the conclusion that establishing special mulberry plantations on newly reclaimed land areas in the foothills not only enhances the feed base for sericulture but also contributes to the protection of agricultural crops from erosion and other forms of land degradation. (Establishment of seasonal high-quality silk cocoon cultivation based on special nutrient-rich mulberry plantations in areas with high groundwater levels in Uzbekistan. Bekkamov Ch., Kasimova M., Nurutdinova M., Makhamad-Shukhrat, E3S Web of Conferences, 2024, 563:03021)

definition_uz: Tut (Morus spp.) o‘simliklarini ko‘paytirish, yetishtirish, parvarishlash va ularning barg hosildorligi hamda sifatini oshirish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi qishloq xo‘jaligi yo‘nalishi. Tutchilik, ayniqsa, ipakchilikda tut ipak qurti uchun sifatli va yetarli miqdorda tut bargi yetishtirishni ta’minlashga qaratilgan.
example_uz: Tutchilik — ipakchilikning asosiy tarmog‘i bo‘lib, u tut ipak qurtining hayotiy faoliyati va pilla mahsuldorligini ta’minlaydigan sifatli barg biomassasini yetishtirish agrotexnikasini qamrab oladi. (Tutchilik va tut seleksiyasi)
definition_en: The cultivation and management of mulberry plants, particularly for the production of leaves used as food for silkworms in sericulture.
etymology_en: From Latin morus, meaning "mulberry", + culture, meaning "cultivation".
example_en: This section will review the dynamics of sericulture in Indonesia, including the cultivation of mulberry plants (moriculture), rearing of silkworms, products, and social, economic, cultural, and institutional factors. (Lens on Tropical Sericulture Development in Indonesia: Recent Status and Future Directions for Industry and Social Forestry, 2022)

definition_uz: Adaksial va abaksial tomonlari odatiy ikki yuzali barglardagidek farqlanmaydigan, barg plastinkasida asosan abaksial xususiyat ustunlik qiladigan barg turi. Unifatsial yaproqlar ayrim bir urug‘pallali o‘simliklarda uchraydi va ularning barg plastinkasi yassi, qilichsimon yoki silindrsimon shaklda bo‘lishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Lotincha uni- — "bir" + facies — "yuza, tomon".
example_uz: Unifatsial yaproq – har ikkala tomoni bir xil tuzilishli yaproq. (Algologiya va mikologiya. Ergasheva X., Namangan, 2024)
definition_en: A leaf whose blade has predominantly or exclusively abaxial identity rather than the distinct adaxial and abaxial identities characteristic of a bifacial leaf. Unifacial leaf blades may be flattened and ensiform or radially symmetric and cylindrical.
etymology_en: From uni-, meaning "one", + facial, from Latin facies, meaning "face, surface".
example_en: Unifacial leaves, which are characterized by an abaxialized leaf blade, have repeatedly evolved in a number of divergent monocot species. (Genetic Framework for Flattened Leaf Blade Formation in Unifacial Leaves of Juncus prismatocarpus. Yamaguchi T., Yano S., Tsukaya H., The Plant Cell, 2010, 22(7), 2141–2155)

definition_uz: Urug‘ning qulay namlik, harorat va kislorod sharoitida tinim holatidan chiqib, murtagi faol o‘sishni boshlashi, dastlabki ildizcha va novda boshlang‘ichlarining rivojlanishi.
example_uz: Ekiladigan mevalar urug‘i quritilganidan keyin bahorgacha qopda bino ichida saqlansa, urug‘lar to‘liq unib chiqmaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To begin growth from a seed when suitable environmental conditions are provided, with the embryo resuming growth and the radicle emerging.
etymology_en: From Latin germinare, meaning "to sprout or bud", from germen, meaning "sprout".
example_en: Keep the potting soil moist until the seeds germinate. (Can I germinate the seeds from a grapefruit? Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, updated 2024)

definition_uz: Hosil yoki mahsulot yetishtirish uchun qulay xususiyatga ega bo‘lgan. Tuproqqa nisbatan qo‘llanganda o‘simliklarning o‘sishini ta’minlash uchun zarur oziq elementlari hamda qulay fizik, kimyoviy va biologik xususiyatlarga ega ekanligini bildiradi.
example_uz: Tokzor uchun tekis, unumdor va suvli yerlar ajratilgani ma’qul. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Describing soil that is capable of sustaining plant growth by providing essential plant nutrients and favourable chemical, physical, and biological conditions for plant growth.
etymology_en: From Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful, productive", from ferre, meaning "to bear".
example_en: Globe artichoke produces best in deep, fertile, well-drained soil, but will grow in a wide range of soils. (Artichokes. Masabni J., Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning normal o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun zarur oziqa elementlarini yetarli miqdorda ta’minlay oladigan hamda qulay fizik, kimyoviy va biologik sharoitlarga ega bo‘lgan tuproq.
example_uz: Unumdor tuproqlarda payvandlangan shaftoli 2–3-yili hosilga kiradi, 4–5-yildan boshlab mo‘l hosil beradi, 9–10-yildan hosili kamaya boshlaydi, 11–12 yildan keyin hosildan qoladi va kundakov qilinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Soil capable of supplying essential plant nutrients and providing suitable physical, chemical, and biological conditions for healthy plant growth and development.
etymology_en: Fertile derives from Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful, productive".
example_en: Plum trees fruit well when grown in fertile soil in a sheltered, sunny position. (How to Grow Plums. The RHS Advice Team, Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Tuproqning o‘simliklarning normal o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun zarur oziq elementlari, suv, havo hamda qulay fizik, kimyoviy va biologik sharoitlarni ta’minlay olish xususiyati. Tuproq unumdorligi uning oziq moddalar bilan ta’minlanganligi, strukturasi, namligi, havo rejimi, biologik faolligi va boshqa xususiyatlariga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Ekin maydonlarida tok ko‘chatini o‘tqazish qalinligi tuproq-iqlim sharoitiga, uzum navi xiliga, tok novdalarining o‘sish kuchiga, tok o‘stirish usuliga, yerning unumdorlik va sho‘rlanish darajasiga, tuproq strukturasiga bog‘liq bo‘ladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: The capacity of soil to support plant growth by providing essential plant nutrients and favourable physical, chemical, and biological conditions. Soil fertility is influenced by nutrient availability, soil structure, moisture, aeration, organic matter, and biological activity.
etymology_en: From Latin fertilitas, meaning "fruitfulness, fertility", from fertilis, meaning "fruitful, productive".
example_en: Soil fertility is the ability of a soil to sustain plant growth by providing essential plant nutrients and favorable chemical, physical, and biological characteristics as a habitat for plant growth. (Global Soil Partnership – Soil Fertility. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Urug‘larning belgilangan qulay sinov sharoitida ma’lum vaqt davomida unib, normal nihollar hosil qilish qobiliyatini ifodalovchi urug‘ sifati ko‘rsatkichi. Unuvchanlik odatda sinovga olingan urug‘lardan normal nihol hosil qilganlarining foizi bilan ifodalanadi.
example_uz: Urug‘lar to‘la yetilganda va normal rangga kirganda tayyorlanadi; bunday urug‘lar yuqori unuvchanlikka ega bo‘lib, yaxshi o‘sadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The proportion of a seed sample that produces normal seedlings within a specified test period under prescribed favourable conditions, usually expressed as a percentage.
example_en: Germination capacity: Proportion of a seed sample that has germinated normally in a specified test period, usually expressed as a percentage. (A Guide to Forest Seed Handling. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Urug‘li o‘simliklarda urug‘lanishdan keyin urug‘murtakdan rivojlanadigan ko‘payish va tarqalish organi. Urug‘ tarkibida murtak (embrion), uni himoya qiluvchi urug‘ po‘sti va odatda murtakning dastlabki rivojlanishi uchun zarur oziqa zaxiralari mavjud bo‘ladi. Oziqa moddalari o‘simlik turiga qarab endosperm, perisperm yoki urug‘pallalarda to‘planishi mumkin.
example_uz: Olmaning kuchli payvandtaglari asosan urug‘dan ko‘paytiriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A reproductive structure of seed plants that develops from an ovule and contains an embryo enclosed by a protective seed coat, usually with stored food reserves that support germination and early seedling development.
example_en: A seed, in botanical terms, is an embryonic plant enclosed inside its seed coat. (The Science of Plants: Understanding Plants and How They Grow. Michaels T., Clark M., Hoover E., Irish L., Smith A., Tepe E., University of Minnesota, 2022)

definition_uz: Gulning urg‘ochi reproduktiv organi — onalikning pastki, odatda kengaygan qismi bo‘lib, uning ichida bir yoki bir nechta urug‘murtak joylashadi. Urug‘lanishdan so‘ng urug‘murtaklar urug‘larga, urug‘don esa odatda mevaga rivojlanadi. Urug‘don gulning boshqa qismlariga nisbatan joylashishiga ko‘ra yuqori, pastki yoki yarim pastki bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Gulli o‘simliklarda urug‘don onalikning pastki qismida joylashib, uning ichida bir yoki bir nechta urug‘murtak bo‘ladi; urug‘lanishdan keyin urug‘don mevaga, urug‘murtaklar esa urug‘larga rivojlanadi. (O‘simliklar morfologiyasi va sistematikasi)
definition_en: The basal, usually enlarged part of the pistil that contains one or more ovules. After fertilization, the ovules develop into seeds and the ovary usually develops into a fruit. The ovary may be superior, inferior, or half-inferior in relation to the other floral parts.
etymology_en: From Latin ovarium, meaning "ovary", from ovum, meaning "egg".
example_en: The ovary consists of a wall of tissue (eventually the nut shell) and two ovules. (Growing Hazelnuts in the Pacific Northwest: Pollination and Nut Development. Olsen J., Oregon State University Extension Service, EM 9074, 2013)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning gullashdan keyin urug‘ hosil qilishi va urug‘larining rivojlanib yetilishi jarayonini ifodalovchi fe’l. Urug‘lamoq o‘simlikning generativ rivojlanish bosqichlaridan biri bo‘lib, turning urug‘ orqali ko‘payishini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Bo‘yi 80 sm gacha. Aprel-may oylarida gullab urug‘laydi. (O‘simliklar aniqlagichi. Sulaymonov E.S. va boshq., 2015)
definition_en: To produce and develop seeds following flowering and successful reproduction; used of a plant when its flowers develop mature seeds.
example_en: Annuals grow, flower, set seed and die, all in the space of one year. (Annuals & biennials. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS)

definition_uz: Erkak va urg‘ochi gametalarning qo‘shilishi natijasida zigota hosil bo‘lish jarayonini boshdan kechirmoq. Gulli o‘simliklarda urug‘lanish urug‘murtakdagi embrion xaltachasida sodir bo‘ladi va yopiq urug‘li o‘simliklarga qo‘sh urug‘lanish xos.
example_uz: Shox-shabbaning atrofidagi mevalar to‘la urug‘lanadi, yaxshi yoritiladi va to‘la qimmatli urug‘lar beradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: To undergo fertilization through the fusion of male and female gametes. In flowering plants, fertilization takes place within the ovule and results in the formation of a zygote.
example_en: Fertilized ovules develop into seeds, which help promote fruit growth as an endogenous source of phytohormones. (Fruit Set and S-alleles in Pear. Sheick R., Musacchi S., Washington State University Tree Fruit Research and Extension Center, 2020)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning erkak jinsiy hujayrasi. Ochiq urug‘li va gulli o‘simliklarda urug‘ hujayralar spermiy deb ataladi. Gulli o‘simliklarda ikkita spermiy chang naychasi orqali embrion xaltachasiga yetkazilib, qo‘sh urug‘lanish jarayonida ishtirok etadi.
example_uz: Ochiq urug‘li va gulli o‘simliklarning spermiy deb ataladigan urug‘ hujayralari esa xivchinini yo‘qotib, kam harakatchan bo‘lib qolishi tufayli ular chang naychalari orqali tuxum hujayrasiga yetib boradi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Babayeva R.N., 2017)
definition_en: A male gamete of a plant. In flowering plants, two sperm cells are delivered through the pollen tube to the female gametophyte, where they participate in double fertilization.
etymology_en: Sperm derives from Greek sperma, meaning "seed"; cell derives from Latin cella, meaning "small room".
example_en: A mature pollen grain is composed of a large vegetative/tube cell and two sperm cells. (Fruit growth and development in apple: a molecular, genomics and epigenetics perspective. Jahed K.R., Hirst P.M., Frontiers in Plant Science, 2023, 14:1122397)

definition_uz: Gulli o‘simliklar urug‘doni ichida joylashgan, urg‘ochi gametofitni saqlaydigan va urug‘lanishdan keyin urug‘ga rivojlanadigan tuzilma. Urug‘kurtak odatda urug‘bandi orqali platsentaga birikadi hamda nusellus, embrion xaltachasi va uni o‘rab turuvchi bir yoki ikki integumentdan tashkil topadi.
example_uz: Danakli meva daraxtlarida faqat 2 ta urug‘kurtak hosil bo‘ladi, ularning bittasi rivojlanmaydi. Shuning uchun mevada 1 ta, kamdan-kam hollarda 2 ta urug‘ bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A structure within the ovary of a flowering plant that contains the female gametophyte and develops into a seed after fertilization. An ovule typically consists of the nucellus containing the embryo sac, one or two integuments, and a funiculus by which it is attached to the placenta.
etymology_en: From Latin ovulum, meaning "little egg", diminutive of ovum, meaning "egg".
example_en: If fertilization is successful, the ovule develops into a seed. (Reproductive Plant Parts. Oregon State University Extension Service)

definition_uz: Urug‘dan unib chiqib rivojlangan va ko‘chat sifatida yetishtirilayotgan yosh o‘simlik. Bog‘dorchilikda urug‘ ko‘chatlar doimiy joyga ekish, seleksiya ishlarida foydalanish yoki payvandtag sifatida yetishtirish uchun qo‘llanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Bir yil mobaynida tokning urug‘ ko‘chatidan 1 m yoki undan chuqurroq kirib boradigan baquvvat ildiz tizimi hosil bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A young plant grown from seed. In horticulture, seedlings may be raised for planting, breeding purposes, or use as rootstocks in grafting.
example_en: The best rootstocks are two-year-old seedlings, ideally about pencil thickness. (Grafting ornamental plants and fruit trees. The RHS Advice Team, Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Urug‘i mavjud bo‘lgan yoki normal rivojlangan urug‘ hosil qiladigan o‘simlik, meva, nav yoki boshqa reproduktiv tuzilmaga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Meva va navlarni tavsiflashda urug‘siz shakllarga qarama-qarshi ma’noda ishlatiladi.
example_uz: Mayda urug‘li navlar ekilayotganda gektariga 8–10 s, yirik urug‘li navlarida esa 1,2–1,5 s urug‘ sarflanadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Containing seeds or producing normally developed seeds; used especially of fruits, plants, and cultivars in contrast to seedless forms.
