example_en: Seeded grapes show relatively little response. (Growing Table Grapes. Strik B., Oregon State University Extension Service)

definition_uz: Mevachilikda pome tipidagi mevalarni hosil qiluvchi meva daraxtlari guruhi. Bu guruhga asosan olma, nok va behi kiradi. Ularning mevalarida urug‘lar markaziy o‘zak ichidagi urug‘ kameralarida joylashadi.
example_uz: Urug‘li meva daraxtlarida ba’zan meva kurtaklaridan gul va novdalar o‘sib chiqadi, bu kurtaklar aralash kurtaklar deyiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Fruit trees that produce pomes, particularly apple, pear, and quince. Pome fruits characteristically have a fleshy outer portion surrounding a central core that contains the seeds.
etymology_en: Pome derives from Old French pome, ultimately from Latin pomum, meaning "fruit, apple".
example_en: Stone fruit trees (such as peach and plum trees) bloom before leaves appear, while pome fruit trees (including apple and pear trees) generally bloom two weeks to three weeks after leaves appear. (North Carolina Extension Gardener Handbook, 2nd ed. Moore K.A., Bradley L.K. (eds.), NC State Extension, 2022)

definition_uz: Mevachilikda pome tipidagi mevalar guruhi bo‘lib, ularga asosan olma, nok va behi kiradi. Bu mevalarda urug‘lar markaziy o‘zakda joylashadi, etli qismi esa tuguncha va unga tutash gul to‘qimalarining rivojlanishi natijasida shakllanadi.
example_uz: Urug‘li mevalarning yaxshi urug‘lari to‘q va tig‘iz, urug‘palla va murtagi oq rangda bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A horticultural group of fleshy fruits that includes apples, pears, and quinces. Pome fruits are characterized by edible fleshy tissue surrounding a central core containing the seeds.
etymology_en: Pome comes from Old French pome, ultimately from Latin pomum, meaning "fruit".
example_en: Apples and pears, collectively known as pome fruits, have a central core containing seeds surrounded by edible flesh. (Growing Apple and Pear Trees in a Home Garden. University of Maryland Extension, updated 2026)

definition_uz: Ekish uchun mo‘ljallangan va tegishli sifat talablariga javob beradigan urug‘. Urug‘likning sifati navga xosligi va sofligi, fizik tozaligi, unuvchanligi, namligi, zararkunanda va kasalliklardan xoliligi kabi ko‘rsatkichlar bilan baholanadi.
example_uz: Urug‘lik uchun qalin po‘stli yirik urug‘li yong‘oq tanlab olinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Seed intended for sowing and crop establishment. Its quality may be assessed in terms of varietal identity and purity, physical purity, germination, moisture content, and freedom from pests and diseases.
example_en: Maintain a sufficient supply of seed for sowing to produce Basic Seed. (OECD Schemes for the Varietal Certification or the Control of Seed Moving in International Trade. OECD, 2022)

definition_uz: Elita urug‘ini ketma-ket qayta ekish va ko‘paytirish natijasida olinadigan urug‘lik avlodi. Elita urug‘ini birinchi marta qayta ekishdan birinchi reproduksiya, undan olingan urug‘ni qayta ekishdan ikkinchi reproduksiya va keyingi reproduksiyalar olinadi. Reproduksiya soni ortishi bilan navning biologik va mexanik ifloslanishi natijasida urug‘lik sifati pasayishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Urug‘lik + reproduksiya lotincha reproductio — "qayta hosil qilish, ko‘paytirish".
example_uz: Urug‘lik reproduksiyasi ortib borishi bilan navlarning mexanik va biologik ifloslanishi natijasida, populyatsiya navlarida esa tabiiy tanlanish ta’sirida populyatsiya tarkibi o‘zgarishi oqibatida urug‘lik sifati pasayib ketadi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, "Urug‘lik reproduksiyasi")
definition_en: A successive generation in the multiplication of seed of a variety, produced within a seed multiplication system while maintaining varietal identity, genetic purity, and required seed quality.
example_en: SATHI provides information about every seed multiplication generation starting from nucleus seed production and lifting to multiplication in subsequent generation to the distribution of certified seed among farmers through registered dealers for the empowerment of the farmers. (SATHI—An Initiative for Assuring Quality Seed Supply to the Farmers. Choudhary R., Asati R., Tiwari J.K., Singh Y., Chaturvedi S.K., Indian Farming, 2024, 74(12):7–10)

definition_uz: Urug‘larni saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus xona, bino yoki inshoot. Urug‘xonada urug‘larning unuvchanligi va sifatini saqlash maqsadida harorat, nisbiy namlik, urug‘ namligi, shamollatish va saqlash muddati kabi omillar hisobga olinadi.
example_uz: Urug‘lar mikroskopda tekshirilib va nazorat tekshirishdan o‘tkazilgandan so‘ng xaltachalarga solinib, urug‘xonalarda saqlanadi. (Ipak qurti urug‘chiligi. Axmedov N., Navruzov S., Toshkent: Voris-Nashriyot, 2014, 122-bet)
definition_en: A room, building, or storage facility used for storing seeds under suitable environmental conditions in order to preserve their viability and quality until they are required for sowing.
example_en: The correct siting of a seed store may reduce the need for much expensive equipment. (A Guide to Forest Seed Handling. Willan R.L., FAO Forestry Paper 20/2, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 1985)

definition_uz: Gulning urg‘ochi reproduktiv organi. Urug‘chi bir urug‘chibargdan yoki bir nechta qo‘shilib ketgan urug‘chibarglardan tashkil topishi mumkin va odatda tumshuqcha, ustuncha hamda tugunchadan iborat bo‘ladi. Tuguncha ichida urug‘murtaklar joylashadi.
example_uz: Masalan, olma gulini olib ko‘rsak, bu gulda biz gulning qismlarini yashil kosacha, beshta bargdan iborat och pushti rang gultojlarini va shuningdek, urug‘lanish organlari changchi va urug‘chini ko‘ramiz. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The female reproductive structure of a flower, consisting of one carpel or two or more fused carpels and typically comprising a stigma, style, and ovary. The ovary contains the ovules.
etymology_en: From Latin pistillum, meaning "pestle", referring to its shape.
example_en: Pistil: The female part of a flower, consisting of a stigma, a style and an ovary. (Stigma. Grapes Extension, 2019)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarining nav urug‘larini ko‘paytirish va yetishtirish, ularni yig‘ib olish, qayta ishlash, saqlash hamda sifatini nazorat qilish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi ilmiy-amaliy soha. Urug‘chilikning muhim vazifalaridan biri urug‘larni ko‘paytirish jarayonida navning genetik sofligi va biologik xususiyatlarini saqlagan holda sifatli urug‘lik yetishtirishdir.
example_uz: Urug‘chilik seleksiya yaratgan yangi navlarni ishlab chiqarishga joriy etish va shu navlarning sifatli mahsuldor urug‘larini yetishtirish hamda ko‘paytirish bilan shug‘ullanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlari seleksiyasi va urug‘chiligi. Abdukarimov D.T., 2005)
definition_en: The science and practice of producing and multiplying seed while maintaining varietal identity, genetic purity, physical and physiological quality, and seed health through appropriate production, harvesting, processing, storage, and quality-control practices.
example_en: During quality seed production, utmost care is needed for ensuring genetic purity, physical and physiological quality and seed health. (Principles of Quality Seed Production. Kumar S., Sripathy K.V., Udaya Bhaskar K., Vinesh B., in Seed Science and Technology, Springer, 2023)

definition_uz: Gul urug‘chisining tumshuqcha bilan tuguncha orasida joylashgan qismi. U tumshuqchani tuguncha bilan bog‘laydi va chang donasi tumshuqchada ungandan so‘ng hosil bo‘lgan chang naychasining tugunchaga tomon o‘sishi uchun yo‘l vazifasini bajaradi.
example_uz: Ginetsey sinkarp 5(3) mevachibarglardan tuzilgan, ustunchalari mevachibarglar soniga teng. (O‘simliklar sistematikasi (Yuksak o‘simliklar). Haydarov X.Q. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: The part of the pistil situated between the stigma and the ovary, connecting these structures and providing a pathway for pollen-tube growth toward the ovary.
etymology_en: From Latin stilus, meaning "stake, pointed instrument or stylus".
example_en: Pollen grains get caught on the sticky surface of the stigma, germinate and produce a tube that grows down the style and unites with the female cell in the ovary. (Pollinating Fruit Crops. Warmund M.R., University of Missouri Extension, reviewed 2026)

definition_uz: Tok (Vitis L.) turkumiga mansub o‘simliklarning rezavor mevasi. Uzum donalari shingillarda joylashadi va yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi yoki mayiz, sharbat, vino hamda boshqa uzum mahsulotlari tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Uzum mevasi tarkibida A, C, P, PP, B₁, B₂, B₆, B₁₂ kabi vitaminlar ham mavjud. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: The berry fruit of plants of the genus Vitis, typically borne in clusters and consumed fresh or processed into raisins, juice, wine, and other grape products.
etymology_en: From Old French grape, originally referring to a bunch or cluster of grapes.
example_en: A grape is a true berry. (Growing Grapes. UF/IFAS Extension, University of Florida, 2021)

definition_uz: Uzum yetishtirish uchun barpo etilgan, toklar ma’lum ekish sxemasi asosida joylashtirilgan va agrotexnik parvarish qilinadigan qishloq xo‘jaligi maydoni. Uzumzorda toklarni butash, shakl berish, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, o‘simliklarni himoya qilish va hosilni yig‘ib olish kabi agrotexnik tadbirlar amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Tayyor uzum hosilini quritish yoki uzoqqa yuborish uchun mo‘ljallangan uzumzor maydonlarini hosilni yig‘ishtirib olishdan 2–3 hafta oldin sug‘orish ishlarini to‘xtatish tavsiya etiladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: An area of land planted with grapevines and managed for grape production. Vineyard management may include pruning, training, irrigation, fertilization, pest and disease management, and harvesting.
etymology_en: From Middle English vyneȝerd, ultimately combining vine and yard.
example_en: From pruning and irrigation to pest management, there are several ways to reduce vineyard inputs while still maintaining vine health and vineyard viability for the future. (Idling Vineyards in the Pacific Northwest. Moyer M., Keller M., Skinkis P.A., Washington State University Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Tokni ko‘paytirish va yetishtirish, uzumzor barpo etish, toklarni shakllantirish va butash, oziqlantirish, sug‘orish, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish hamda uzum hosili yetishtirishning biologik va agrotexnik asoslari bilan shug‘ullanuvchi bog‘dorchilik tarmog‘i.
example_uz: Uzumchilikda tok kesish muhim agrotexnik tadbirlardan biri bo‘lib, tokning o‘sishi va meva qilishini tartibga soluvchi vositadir. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: The science and practice of cultivating grapevines and producing grapes, including vineyard establishment and management, training, pruning, irrigation, plant nutrition, pest and disease management, and harvesting.
etymology_en: From Latin vitis, meaning "vine", + culture.
example_en: Viticulture looks at the science of cultivating and harvesting grapes while viniculture focuses on the cultivation of grapevines specifically for wine production. (Viticulture Certificate Program: Frequently Asked Questions. University of California, Davis, Continuing and Professional Education)

definition_uz: Tok ekish, uzum yetishtirish va tokzorlarni parvarishlash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassis yoki bog‘bon. Uzumchi toklarni kesish, shakllantirish, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, kasallik va zararkunandalardan himoya qilish hamda hosilni yetishtirish bilan bog‘liq ishlarni amalga oshiradi.
example_uz: Ishtirokchilar uchun Oltiariqning eng tajribali uzumchi oilalari tajribasini o‘rganish, mamlakatimiz va Turkiya olimlari ishtirokida mahorat darslari o‘tkazish, ikki ming gektar yerda sanoatbop uzum yetishtirayotgan “Fergana France” MCHJga enoturistik sayohat uyushtirish singari rang-barang tadbirlar ko‘zda tutilgan. (Uzum yetishtirishda Oltiariq tajribasi mamlakatimiz miqyosida keng ommalashtirilmoqda. Yangi O‘zbekiston, 2021)
definition_en: A specialist in the cultivation and management of grapevines and vineyards, including vine health, pruning, irrigation, pest and disease management, grape development, and harvesting.
etymology_en: From viticulture + -ist; viticulture derives from Latin vitis, meaning "vine", and cultura, meaning "cultivation".
example_en: UC viticulturist George Zhuang in the vineyard harvesting Cabernet Sauvignon clusters in Sonoma. (How Fermentation Begins in the Field. Risser M., UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education, 2025)

definition_uz: Bir tur, nav yoki populyatsiyaga mansub individlar o‘rtasida belgi va xususiyatlarning farqlanishi. Variatsiya genetik omillar, muhit ta’siri hamda genotip va muhitning o‘zaro ta’siri natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin va seleksiya uchun muhim biologik asos hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha variatio — "o‘zgarish, farqlanish", variare — "o‘zgartirmoq, turlicha qilmoq".
example_uz: Bu navning variatsiyasi Murchamiyon Husayni asosiy klonidan farq qilib, g‘ujumlarining o‘rtasi ingichkalashgan bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Differences in characteristics among individuals, clones, or populations that may arise from genetic factors, environmental influences, or genotype-by-environment interactions.
etymology_en: From Latin variatio, from variare, meaning "to change or vary".
example_en: Substantial intra-varietal phenotypic variation was observed across all traits, with moderate to high heritability estimates, confirming that a meaningful proportion of the phenotypic variation can be attributed to the genetic differences among clones. (Exploring intra-varietal variation for complex traits in grapevine (Vitis vinifera L.). Robinson H. et al., Theoretical and Applied Genetics, 2025, 138:305)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning jinsiy yo‘l bilan hosil bo‘lgan urug‘larsiz, vegetativ organlari yoki ularning qismlari yordamida yangi individlar hosil qilishi. Vegetativ ko‘payishda ildiz, poya, barg, ildizpoya, tugunak, piyozbosh, qalamcha, bachki va boshqa vegetativ tuzilmalar ishtirok etishi mumkin.
example_uz: Vegetativ ko‘payishda yangi organizm ona o‘simlikdan olingan ildiz, poya, barg, gajak, piyozbosh, tuganakdan hosil bo‘ladi. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: A form of asexual plant propagation in which new plants are produced from vegetative parts of a parent plant, such as roots, stems, leaves, bulbs, tubers, or other vegetative structures, rather than from sexually produced seeds.
example_en: Vegetative propagation is useful for increasing stock of named cultivars which don’t come true from seed. (Propagation Techniques. The RHS Advice Team, Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning o‘sishi, oziqlanishi va hayot faoliyatini ta’minlaydigan, bevosita jinsiy ko‘payish vazifasini bajarmaydigan organlari. O‘simlikning asosiy vegetativ organlariga ildiz, poya va barg kiradi.
etymology_uz: Vegetativ termini lotincha vegetativus — "o‘stiruvchi, jonlantiruvchi" ma’nosidagi so‘zga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Birinchi avlodning uzoq duragaylaridagi vegetativ organlari odatda yaxshi rivojlangan, ba’zida ular o‘sish kuchi va rivojlanishi bilan farq qiladi. Generativ organlarning faoliyati esa buzilishlar bilan kechadi. (Biologiya va genetika. Sindarov O.X., 2022)
definition_en: The non-reproductive organs of a plant that primarily support plant growth and physiological functions. In seed plants, the primary vegetative organs are the root, stem, and leaf.
etymology_en: Vegetative derives from Latin vegetativus, relating to growth or development.
example_en: The three main types of vegetative organ are the root, stem and leaf. (Anatomy of Flowering Plants: An Introduction to Structure and Development. Rudall P.J., Cambridge University Press, 3rd ed., 2020)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni vegetatsion idishlarda nazorat qilinadigan sharoitda o‘stirib, oziqa elementlari, o‘g‘itlar, tuproq, suv va boshqa omillarning o‘simlikka ta’sirini o‘rganishga asoslangan tajriba usuli. Tajribalar vegetatsion uy, issiqxona, oranjeriya yoki fitotron sharoitida, suvli, qumli yoki tuproqli muhitda o‘tkazilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Vegetatsion termini lotincha vegetatio — "jonlanish, o‘sish" ma’nosidagi so‘zga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Tajriba ishlari issiqxona sharoitida vegetatsion usulda olib borildi. (Kumquvat (Fortunella) ko‘chatlarining o‘sishi va rivojlanishiga organik moddalarning ta’siri. Sultonov K.S., Xamdamov J.K., 2025)
definition_en: An experimental method in which plants are grown in pots or other containers under controlled or semi-controlled conditions to investigate the effects of nutrients, fertilizers, soil properties, water, and other factors on plant growth and development.
example_en: A pot experiment in greenhouse was conducted to study the effects of NPK fertilizers on growth, ornamental quality and optimum fertilizer rates of petunia. (Effects of NPK fertilizer application and recommendation for Petunia hybrida Vilm. in pot experiments. Zhang W., Lu J., Jiang Z., Wang X., Journal of Plant Nutrition and Fertilizers, 2009, 15(5):1147–1153)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning faol o‘sish va rivojlanish davri. Bir yillik ekinlarda vegetatsiya davri odatda unib chiqishdan yetilishgacha, ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarda esa bahorgi faol o‘sishning boshlanishidan kuzgi o‘sishning to‘xtashi yoki tinim davriga kirishigacha bo‘lgan vaqtni qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Vegetatsiya lotincha vegetatio — "o‘sish, rivojlanish" so‘zidan.
example_uz: Navlar shunday tanlanishi lozimki, ular changlanib, butun vegetatsiya davri davomida bog‘dan bir me’yorda hosil berib tura olsin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The period of active plant growth and development. In annual crops, it may be measured from seedling emergence to maturity, while in perennial plants it generally extends from the beginning or renewal of active growth to the end of active growth or the onset of dormancy.
example_en: The length of the vegetation period in days for flax shall be determined from the full stage of seedling until early stage of yellow ripening. (Regulations Regarding the Examination of the Value for Cultivation and Use of Plant Varieties. State Language Centre, 2017)

definition_uz: Bino devorlari, panjaralar, pergolalar, arkalar, ustunlar va boshqa tik konstruksiyalarni chirmashuvchi, tirmashuvchi yoki osilib o‘suvchi o‘simliklar yordamida ko‘kalamzorlashtirish usuli. U estetik bezak yaratish, mikroiqlimni yaxshilash va bino yuzalarini quyosh nuri hamda chang ta’siridan qisman himoya qilishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Vertikal lotincha verticalis — "tik, tik yo‘nalgan".
example_uz: Chirmashib o‘suvchilar — vertikal ko‘kalamzorlashtirish uchun devorlar, ayvonlar, ishkomlar, ravoqlar, piramidalar, ustunlar, naqshinkor panjaralar va hokazolarda keng foydalaniladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: The use of plants on walls, fences, trellises, pergolas, and other vertical structures to provide ornamental, environmental, and microclimatic benefits.
etymology_en: Vertical derives from Latin verticalis, meaning "upright".
example_en: "Vertical greening systems can reduce building surface temperatures and improve urban environmental quality." (Planting Green Roofs and Living Walls. Dunnett N., Kingsbury N., Timber Press, 2008)

definition_uz: Nilufardoshlar (Nymphaeaceae) oilasiga mansub yirik suv o‘simligining tarixiy nomi. Hozirgi botanika nomenklaturasida Victoria regia Lindl. nomi Victoria amazonica (Poepp.) Klotzschning sinonimi hisoblanadi. O‘simlik juda yirik, suv yuzasida suzuvchi doirasimon barglari va dastlab oq rangda ochilib, keyinchalik pushti tusga kiradigan yirik gullari bilan ajralib turadi. Botanika bog‘lari va issiqxonalarda manzarali suv o‘simligi sifatida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Victoria turkumi Buyuk Britaniya qirolichasi Viktoriya sharafiga nomlangan; regia lotincha "qirollik, shohona" ma’nosini anglatadi.
example_uz: Viktoriya regiya issiq va sernam sharoitda o‘sadigan ko‘p yillik ajoyib suv o‘simligidir. (Qiziqarli geografiya. Rafiqov V., Toshkent: Sharq, 2010)
definition_en: A giant aquatic plant of the family Nymphaeaceae, native to tropical South America. It is characterized by enormous circular floating leaves and large fragrant flowers that open white and later turn pink. Victoria regia Lindl. is a taxonomic synonym of the accepted name Victoria amazonica (Poepp.) Klotzsch.
etymology_en: The genus Victoria was named in honour of Queen Victoria; the specific epithet amazonica refers to the Amazon region.
example_en: Victoria amazonica is one of the largest of all waterlilies, with enormous leaves that can reach up to three metres wide and support the weight of a small child. (Giant waterlily – Victoria amazonica. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)
synonyms_en: Victoria regia; Giant waterlily; Amazon waterlily

definition_uz: O‘simlikning suv o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalari kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi organizmlar, asosan zamburug‘lar yoki bakteriyalar tomonidan zararlanishi natijasida suv harakatining buzilishi va o‘simlikning so‘lishi bilan tavsiflanadigan kasalliklar guruhi. Vilt kasalliklarida barglarning sarg‘ayishi va so‘lishi, o‘sishning susayishi, tomir to‘qimalarining rangsizlanishi hamda og‘ir hollarda o‘simlikning nobud bo‘lishi kuzatilishi mumkin. Keng tarqalgan zamburug‘li vilt qo‘zg‘atuvchilariga Fusarium va Verticillium turkumlari vakillari kiradi.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha wilt — "so‘lish" so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Vilt bilan g‘o‘za, pomidor, zig‘ir, o‘rik va ko‘plab boshqa o‘tsimon hamda daraxtsimon o‘simliklar kuchli zararlanadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: A plant disease characterized by wilting resulting from the colonization or impairment of vascular tissues, particularly the water-conducting xylem. Vascular wilts may be caused by fungal or bacterial pathogens; important fungal vascular wilt pathogens include species of Fusarium and Verticillium.
example_en: Vascular wilt diseases caused by Verticillium dahliae Kleb. are difficult to control and lead to increasing losses of many crops worldwide. (Management of the soil-borne fungal pathogen – Verticillium dahliae Kleb. causing vascular wilt diseases. Kowalska B., Journal of Plant Pathology, 2021, 103: 1185–1194)

definition_uz: Asosan uzum sharbatini alkogolli fermentatsiya qilish yo‘li bilan olinadigan ichimlik. Vino ishlab chiqarish texnologiyasi va xususiyatlariga ko‘ra oq, qizil, pushti, quruq, yarim shirin, shirin, ko‘piklanadigan va boshqa turlarga bo‘linadi. Uzumchilikda vino uzumni qayta ishlash mahsulotlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha vinum — "vino, uzumdan tayyorlangan ichimlik".
example_uz: Uzumdan tayyorlanadigan mahsulotlar ishlatilishi va tayyorlanish texnologiyasi bo‘yicha guruhlarga bo‘linadi; ulardan biri vinochilik mahsulotlaridir: vino, konyak, shampan va boshqalar. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: An alcoholic beverage produced primarily by the fermentation of grape juice. Wine may vary in colour, sweetness, composition, alcohol content, and style according to the grapes used and the winemaking methods applied.
etymology_en: From Old English wīn, ultimately from Latin vinum, meaning "wine".
example_en: Wine is defined as being the product of the fermentation of grape juice. (Basics of Home Winemaking. Clemson Cooperative Extension, Clemson University, 2023)

definition_uz: Vino ishlab chiqarish uchun mos yoki shu maqsadda yetishtiriladigan uzum navi yoki uning xususiyatiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Vinobop uzumlarda qand miqdori, kislotalilik, fenolik va aromatik birikmalar kabi ko‘rsatkichlar vino tayyorlash uchun muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Tokdoshlar oilasiga mansub tok mevalari, ya’ni uzum mevalari asosan xo‘raki, kishmishbop va vinobop navlardan iborat bo‘lib, xalq xo‘jaligida turli yo‘nalishlarda keng foydalaniladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: A grape grown primarily for wine production. Wine grape cultivars are selected for characteristics important to winemaking, including sugar concentration, acidity, phenolic composition, aroma, and other fruit-quality traits.
example_en: Optimal ranges for juice Brix levels can vary between wine grape cultivars and the desired wine style and method used. (How to Measure Grape Cluster Ripeness. Wimmer M., University of Minnesota Extension, 2024)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Uzumni qayta ishlab vino tayyorlash, fermentatsiya jarayonlarini boshqarish, vinoni yetiltirish va saqlash, uning kimyoviy hamda organoleptik xususiyatlarini tahlil qilish va sifatini nazorat qilish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi ilmiy-amaliy va texnologik soha.
example_uz: I asr boshlarida greklar O‘rta Osiyoga kelishlaridan oldin bu yerda tokchilik va vinochilik rivojlangani to‘g‘risidagi ma’lumotlar tarixiy manbalarda keltirilgan. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M., 2023)
definition_en: The science and technology of winemaking, encompassing grape and juice processing, alcoholic and malolactic fermentation, wine chemistry, maturation, storage, sensory evaluation, quality control, and related winery practices.
etymology_en: From Greek oinos — "wine" + -logia — "study, science".
example_en: This online course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of winemaking for those interested in enology without requiring hands-on laboratory experience. (Enology Basics for Viticulturists and Enologists. Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service, 2025)

definition_uz: Sarvdoshlar (Cupressaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxt. Toji odatda piramidasimon yoki konussimon bo‘lib, yosh novdalaridagi barglari bigizsimon, yetilgan shoxlarida esa tangachasimon bo‘ladi. Qubbachalari mayda, sharsimon va ko‘kimtir tusli. Turli tuproq va iqlim sharoitlariga moslasha olishi, doim yashil shox-shabbasi va xushbo‘y yog‘ochi tufayli manzarali ekishlarda, himoya daraxtzorlari va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Virgin archasi yaxshi sharoitda yuz yil va undan ham ko‘proq yashaydi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: An evergreen coniferous tree of the family Cupressaceae, native to eastern North America. It has scale-like leaves on older shoots, awl-shaped leaves on young shoots, and small bluish, berry-like seed cones. The species is tolerant of a wide range of environmental conditions and is used in ornamental plantings and shelterbelts.
example_en: Many varieties of eastern redcedar are used as ornamental plantings. (Juniperus virginiana L.: Eastern Redcedar. Lawson E.R., Silvics of North America, USDA Forest Service, 1990)

definition_uz: O‘simlik ontogenezining generativ davrgacha bo‘lgan bosqichi bo‘lib, odatda immigratur holatdan keyin kuzatiladi. Bu bosqichda o‘simlik turga xos yetuk vegetativ tuzilishga ega bo‘ladi, vegetativ organlari faol rivojlanadi, biroq generativ organlar hali shakllanmagan bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Virginil lotincha virgo — "qiz, bokira" so‘zi bilan bog‘liq; lotincha virginalis — "bokiraga oid, bokira".
example_uz: Virginil davr Qizil o‘simligida 4–5 yil davom etadi. (Samarqand viloyatida Cornaceae Dumort. oilasiga mansub o‘simliklarning morfobiologik xususiyatlari. Sag‘diyeva D.S., 2019)
definition_en: An ontogenetic stage of plant development occurring after the immature state and before the reproductive stage, in which the plant has acquired adult vegetative characteristics but lacks generative organs.
etymology_en: Virginile is associated with Latin virgo, meaning "maiden, virgin", referring to the non-reproductive state of the plant.
example_en: "Virginile or vegetative plant (v) ... This age stage is principally distinguished by its leaf shape, which is also characteristic of generative individuals." (Variations in the Life Cycle of Anemone patens L. (Ranunculaceae) in Wild Populations of Canada, 2016)

definition_uz: O‘simlik viruslari keltirib chiqaradigan yuqumli kasalliklar guruhi. Ular mozaika, xloroz, halqasimon dog‘lar, barglarning buralishi va deformatsiyasi, pakanalash, o‘sishning susayishi hamda hosildorlikning kamayishi kabi belgilar bilan namoyon bo‘lishi mumkin. Viruslar hasharot va boshqa vektorlar, zararlangan vegetativ material, ayrim hollarda urug‘ yoki mexanik yo‘l orqali tarqaladi.
etymology_uz: Virus lotincha virus — "zahar".
example_uz: Virus kasalliklari ko‘pincha o‘simlik bo‘yini kuchli darajada pasaytiradi; ular hatto karlik, ya’ni pakana bo‘lib qolishi mumkin. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Plant diseases caused by viruses, commonly producing symptoms such as mosaic patterns, chlorosis, leaf curling, deformation, stunting, and reduced yield.
etymology_en: Virus derives from Latin virus ("poison"); disease derives from Old French desaise ("lack of ease").
example_en: Certain crops are well known to be affected by virus diseases, including geraniums, roses, Easter lilies, dahlias, gladiolus, and tulips. (Virus Diseases. Penn State Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Dukkakdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub, kuchli chirmashib o‘suvchi barg to‘kuvchi yog‘ochlashgan liana. Bahorda uzun osilib turuvchi shingillarda binafsha, ko‘k-binafsha yoki oq rangli xushbo‘y gullar hosil qiladi. Pergola, ayvon, ravoq, devor va panjaralarni vertikal ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Wisteria turkumi nomi amerikalik shifokor va anatom Caspar Wistar nomi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Glitsiniya yoki visteriya yuqori manzarali liana hisoblanadi. (Glitsiniya manzarali o‘simligi va uning tarkibidagi toksik moddalari haqida ma’lumot. Raximov J.R. va boshq., Central Asian Journal of Academic Research, 2025)
definition_en: A deciduous woody climbing vine of the family Fabaceae, native to China. It is valued for its pendulous clusters of fragrant violet, blue-violet, or white flowers and is widely cultivated as an ornamental climber.
etymology_en: The genus Wisteria commemorates Caspar Wistar (1761–1818), an American physician and anatomist.
example_en: Chinese wisteria is a deciduous, climbing, woody vine in the Fabaceae (bean) family and native to China. (Wisteria sinensis. NC State Extension, Plant Toolbox)

definition_uz: Tokni baland tayanch konstruksiyasiga ko‘tarib, uning novdalari va hosil beruvchi qismlarini yuqoridagi keng gorizontal sath bo‘ylab yoyib o‘stirish tizimi. Voishda tokning kuchli o‘suvchi novdalari yuqoridagi tayanch bo‘ylab tarqalib, keng barg-novda qoplami hosil qiladi va uzum boshlari uning ostida osilib turadi. Bu usul, ayniqsa, kuchli o‘suvchi xo‘raki va kishmishbop uzum navlarini o‘stirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Tokning yoshi va o‘sish kuchi, nav xiliga qarab, yenglarida kuchaytirilgan hosilli novdalar qoldirilib, ularning soni novdaning yo‘g‘on va ingichkaligiga qarab, 10–16 tagacha, voish va so‘ritoklarda uzum naviga qarab, 20 tagacha kurtak qoldirib kesiladi. (Uzumchilik asoslari. Yunusov R., Ikramova M.L., 2023)
definition_en: A grapevine training system in which vines are trained upward to an elevated horizontal framework and then spread over a criss-cross network of wires supported by posts. The system is particularly suited to vigorous grape cultivars and forms an overhead canopy on which the vine arms, shoots, and fruiting canes are distributed.
etymology_en: Bower derives from Old English būr, meaning "dwelling, room or shelter"; the word later developed the sense of a leafy shelter or arbor formed by trees or climbing plants.
example_en: The grapevines trained on bower system of training were pruned at 2, 3, 4 and 5-bud level during last week of January. (Effect of pruning intensity on bud fruitfulness, yield and anthocyanin content of grape (Vitis vinifera) hybrid H-516 trained on bower system. Singh G., Arora N.K., Gill M.I.S., Journal of Applied Horticulture, 2014, 16(2): 122–125)

definition_uz: Dehqon va bog‘bonlar tomonidan uzoq vaqt davomida o‘simliklar orasidan qimmatli xo‘jalik belgilariga ega shakllarni tanlash, saqlash va ko‘paytirish orqali mahalliy navlarni shakllantirish jarayoni. Xalq seleksiyasida tanlash amaliy tajriba asosida avloddan-avlodga davom etadi va tabiiy tanlanish bilan birgalikda mahalliy sharoitga moslashgan navlarning vujudga kelishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: Markaziy Osiyoda xalq seleksiyasi asosida o‘rik, bodom, yong‘oq, shaftoli, anor va tut daraxtining ko‘pgina navlari yaratilgan va sanoat ahamiyatiga ega bog‘lar barpo qilingan. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq.)
definition_en: The process by which farmers select and propagate plants or seed with desirable characteristics over successive generations, contributing to the maintenance and development of locally adapted crop populations, landraces, and varieties.
example_en: Farmers' seed systems are key to provide farmers with access to both local varieties developed over millennia of farmer selection and varieties developed by formal breeding programmes. (FAO, 2021)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simlik kasalliklarini davolash yoki patogenlarning rivojlanishini bostirish maqsadida kimyoviy moddalarni qo‘llash usuli. Fitopatologiyada xemoterapiya ayrim zararlangan o‘simlik yoki ko‘paytirish materiallarini patogenlardan sog‘lomlashtirishda qo‘llanilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha chēmeia — "kimyo" va therapeia — "davolash" so‘zlaridan.
example_uz: Xemoterapiya usuli olxo‘ri, gilos, maymunjon, turli gullar va boshqa o‘simliklarga qo‘llanilganda yaxshi natijalar olingan. (Qishloq xo‘jalik biotexnologiyasi. Artikova R., Murodova S., 2010)
definition_en: The use of chemical agents to eliminate, suppress, or inhibit plant pathogens. In plant pathology, chemotherapy may be used to treat infected plant material or assist in the production of pathogen-free propagative material.
etymology_en: Chemo- derives from Greek chēmeia ("chemistry") and therapy from Greek therapeia ("treatment, healing").
example_en: Combining thermotherapy or chemotherapy with shoot tip cryotherapy has further enhanced pathogen eradication efficiency. (Shoot tip cryotherapy for plant pathogen eradication. Wang Q.-C. et al., Plant Pathology, 2022)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub, odatda past bo‘yli, yoyilib o‘suvchi, tikanli, barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta. Bahorda qizil yoki to‘q sariq rangli gullar hosil qiladi. Kuzda yetiladigan mevalari sariq yoki qizg‘ish-sariq, xushbo‘y bo‘lib, ulardan murabbo va jele tayyorlashda foydalanish mumkin. O‘simlik manzarali ekin sifatida, jumladan, guruhlab ekish va past tirik devorlar hosil qilishda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Chaenomeles yunoncha chainein — "ochilmoq, yorilmoq" va melon — "olma" so‘zlaridan kelib chiqqan; nom mevalar yorilib ochiladi degan dastlabki tasavvur bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Behiga yaqin tur yapon behisi yoki xenomeles (Chaenomeles japonica Thunb. Lindl.) chiroyli qizil gullari va limon ko‘rinishidagi sariq mevalari tufayli manzarali buta sifatida ko‘plab o‘stiriladi va ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda foydalaniladi. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A low-growing, spreading, thorny deciduous shrub of the family Rosaceae, cultivated for its showy spring flowers and aromatic fruits. It produces red to orange flowers in spring, followed by yellow or yellow-flushed red fruits in autumn. The fruits can be used for making jams and jellies, and the shrub is grown ornamentally in borders, groups, and low hedges.
etymology_en: Chaenomeles derives from Greek chainein ("to gape, split open") and melon ("apple"), referring to the former mistaken belief that the fruits split open.
example_en: Profuse clusters of red to orange, cup-shaped flowers to 4cm across are produced in spring, followed by aromatic yellow or yellow-flushed red fruits in autumn. (Royal Horticultural Society, Chaenomeles japonica)

definition_uz: Derbendoshlar (Lythraceae) oilasiga mansub issiqsevar buta yoki kichik daraxt. Barglari qarama-qarshi joylashgan, gullari mayda va xushbo‘y. Barglarida tabiiy bo‘yovchi modda — lawsone mavjud bo‘lib, ulardan teri, soch, tirnoq va matolarni bo‘yashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Xina arabcha ḥinnā’ (حنّاء) — "xina".
example_uz: Xina daraxtchasi urug‘idan va qalamchasidan ko‘paytiriladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi, “Xina daraxtchasi” maqolasi)
definition_en: A shrub or small tree of the family Lythraceae, cultivated for its leaves, which contain lawsone, a natural dye traditionally used to colour skin, hair, nails, and textiles.
etymology_en: Henna comes from Arabic ḥinnā’ (حنّاء).
example_en: The henna tree is found all across Asia, as well as northern regions of Africa and Australia. (Henna tree – Lawsonia inermis. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)

definition_uz: Uzumchilikda vegetatsiya davrida tok tupidagi ortiqcha, kuchsiz, hosilsiz yoki noqulay joylashgan yashil novdalarni olib tashlash orqali tok shox-shabbasining zichligini tartibga solish agrotexnik tadbiri. Xomtok tok tupida yorug‘lik tushishi va havo aylanishini yaxshilash, novdalar zichligini kamaytirish hamda vegetativ o‘sish bilan hosil yuklamasi o‘rtasidagi muvozanatni saqlashga yordam beradi.
example_uz: Odatda tok tupi kamida ikki marta xomtok qilinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A viticultural canopy-management practice involving the removal of excess, weak, non-fruitful, secondary, or otherwise unwanted shoots during the growing season to regulate shoot density and improve canopy exposure and air circulation.
example_en: Shoot thinning is the first seasonal canopy management practice. (Vineyard Canopy Management: Shoot Thinning. Coolong T., Hickey C., University of Georgia Cooperative Extension, 2019)

definition_uz: Xurmodoshlar (Ebenaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt. Mevalari naviga qarab turli shaklda bo‘lib, pishganda odatda sariq, to‘q sariq yoki qizg‘ish tusga kiradi. Mevalari shirin va iste’molbop bo‘lib, o‘simlik subtropik hamda iliq mo‘tadil hududlarda meva ekini sifatida yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Xurmo forscha xurmā (خرما) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Subtropik mevalarga anor, anjir, bodom, xurmo kabi o‘simliklar kiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree of the family Ebenaceae, cultivated primarily for its large, sweet, edible fruits. Numerous cultivars are grown for their fruit characteristics, and the fruits typically become yellow-orange, orange, or orange-red as they ripen.
etymology_en: Persimmon derives from an Algonquian word referring to the fruit; kaki is the Japanese name for the species.
example_en: The most common persimmon species that is commercially and garden grown for its fruit is the Japanese persimmon (D. kaki; pronounced ka’kī), the national tree of Japan. (Edible Landscape Species – Trees. Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech)
synonyms_en: Oriental persimmon; Chinese persimmon; Kaki; Kaki persimmon

definition_uz: Sharq xurmosi (Diospyros kaki Thunb.) daraxtining iste’mol qilinadigan mevasi. Mevasi odatda sariq, to‘q sariq yoki qizg‘ish tusda bo‘lib, pishganida shirin bo‘ladi. Tarkibida, jumladan, qandlar, vitamin C, karotinoidlar va polifenol birikmalar mavjud. Mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek quritish va boshqa usullarda qayta ishlanadi.
etymology_uz: Xurmo forscha xurmā (خرما) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; meva — o‘simlikning hosili ma’nosidagi so‘z.
example_uz: Subtropik mevalarga anor, anjir, bodom, xurmo kabi o‘simliklar kiradi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible fruit of the Japanese persimmon (Diospyros kaki Thunb.). The fruit is typically yellow to orange or reddish when ripe and is rich in sugars and contains vitamin C, carotenoids, polyphenols, and other bioactive compounds. It is consumed fresh and may also be dried or processed into various products.
etymology_en: Persimmon derives from an Algonquian word referring to the fruit; fruit derives ultimately from Latin fructus, meaning "fruit, produce, enjoyment".
example_en: Persimmons resulted rich in sugars (about 12.5 g/100 g FW), being fructose, glucose and sucrose the major components, and in total vitamin C. (Giordani E., Doumett S., Nin S., Del Bubba M., Food Research International, 2011)

definition_uz: Yangi holda bevosita iste’mol qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan mahsulot yoki navga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bog‘dorchilikda bu atama meva, uzum, sabzavot va boshqa mahsulotlarning asosan qayta ishlash uchun emas, balki yangi holda iste’mol qilish uchun yetishtiriladigan nav va turlarini bildiradi.
etymology_uz: Forscha xo‘rok (خوراک) — "ovqat, yegulik, taom".
example_uz: Kuchli o‘suvchi xo‘raki va kishmishbop navlar soyabonli simbag‘az, ishkom va xiyobon so‘rilarida o‘stirilib, ulardan mo‘l hosil olish mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Intended primarily for sale and consumption as fresh produce rather than for processing. In horticulture, the term is used for fruits, vegetables, grapes, and cultivars grown mainly for fresh consumption.
etymology_en: A compound of fresh and market, referring to horticultural produce intended for sale and consumption in fresh form.
example_en: Perfectly good fruit from the commercial fresh market cultivars (an average of 20 percent) are used for processing. (Principles and Practices of Small- and Medium-Scale Fruit Juice Processing. FAO)

definition_uz: Poyalarining pastki qismi ko‘p yillik va yog‘ochlashgan, yuqori qismi esa o‘tsimon bo‘lib, odatda vegetatsiya mavsumi oxirida qurib qoladigan ko‘p yillik o‘simliklar hayotiy shakli. Yarim butalar butalar va ko‘p yillik o‘t o‘simliklar o‘rtasidagi oraliq hayotiy shakl hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Yarim — "to‘liq bo‘lmagan, qisman" va buta — "yer sathidan boshlab shoxlanadigan yog‘ochlashgan o‘simlik" so‘zlaridan tuzilgan.
example_uz: Yarim butalarga malinani misol qilib keltirish mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Perennial plants with a persistent woody base and herbaceous upper shoots that typically die back at the end of each growing season.
etymology_en: Subshrub is formed from sub- ("under, below; partially") + shrub.
example_en: Alhagi sparsifolia is a sand-resistant subshrub and food resource for camels in the desert and semi-desert areas of Central Asia. (The complete chloroplast genome of desert spiny semi-shrub Alhagi sparsifolia (Fabaceae) from Central Asia. Wang X. et al., Mitochondrial DNA Part B, 2020)

definition_uz: Zich joylashgan nihol yoki yosh o‘simliklarning ortiqchasini olib tashlab, qolganlarini me’yoriy oraliqda qoldirish orqali siyraklashtirmoq. Yaganalash o‘simliklarning suv, oziqa moddalari, yorug‘lik va maydon uchun o‘zaro raqobatini kamaytirib, qolgan o‘simliklarning yaxshi rivojlanishiga yordam beradi.
example_uz: O‘t bosish darajasiga qarab, piyoz mavsumda 3–4 marta o‘toq qilinadi. Dastlabki o‘tashda o‘simlik oralarini 3–5 sm qoldirib, yagana qilinadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: To remove excess seedlings or young plants that are growing too close together, leaving the remaining plants at an appropriate spacing so that they have sufficient space, water, nutrients, and light for healthy growth.
example_en: Once the seeds have come up, choose the healthiest and ‘thin out’ the others. (Sowing Vegetable Seeds. RHS Advice Team, Royal Horticultural Society)

uzbek: Yapon behisi (Chaenomeles japonica (Thunb.) Lindl. ex Spach)
definition_uz: Ra’noguldoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi, yoyilib o‘suvchi manzarali buta. Poyalari tikanli bo‘lib, qish oxiri yoki erta bahorda, ko‘pincha barglar chiqishidan oldin, to‘q sariq yoki qizg‘ish-to‘q sariq rangli ko‘rkam gullar hosil qiladi. Manzarali bog‘dorchilikda guruhlab ekish, bordyur, tirik devor va landshaft kompozitsiyalarida foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Chaenomeles yunoncha chainein — "ochilmoq, yorilmoq" va mēlon — "olma, meva" so‘zlari bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Yapon behisi — Chaenomeles japonica. Bo‘yi 3 m keladigan buta o‘simligi. 3–4 yoshdan aprelda gullay boshlaydi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
english: Japanese flowering quince (Chaenomeles japonica (Thunb.) Lindl. ex Spach)
definition_en: A deciduous, spreading, thorny ornamental shrub of the family Rosaceae, native to Japan and Korea, valued for its showy orange to orange-red flowers that appear in late winter or early spring, often before the foliage.
etymology_en: The genus name Chaenomeles derives from Greek chainein, meaning "to gape or split", and mēlon, meaning "apple or fruit".
example_en: Japanese Quince (Chaenomeles japonica) is a smaller plant (only 3 feet high), and otherwise similar to flowering quince. (Flowering Quince. Niemiera A.X., Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, 2024)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub, chirmashib o‘suvchi, odatda barg to‘kuvchi manzarali buta. Barglari patsimon murakkab, gullari oq va kuchli xushbo‘y bo‘lib, yoz hamda erta kuzda gullaydi. Xushbo‘y gullari va manzarali xususiyatlari tufayli bog‘larda devor, panjara, pergola va boshqa tayanchlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda yetishtiriladi; yasmin gullarining xushbo‘y hidi parfyumeriya va kosmetika mahsulotlarida ham qadrlanadi.
etymology_uz: Yasmin forscha yāsamīn (یاسمین) — "yasmin" nomidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Xona sharoitida xonaki yasmin 40–50 kundan so‘ng ildiz otadi. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A vigorous, usually deciduous climbing shrub of the family Oleaceae, cultivated for its highly fragrant white flowers. It has pinnate leaves composed of several leaflets and produces clusters of white flowers in summer and early autumn. It is widely grown as an ornamental climber and is valued for its fragrance.
etymology_en: Jasmine ultimately derives from Persian yāsamīn, the name of the fragrant-flowered plant.
example_en: Known all over the world for its fragrant scent, common jasmine has been cultivated for at least 2000 years. (Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Common jasmine — Jasminum officinale)
synonyms_en: Common white jasmine; Jessamine; Poet's jasmine; Poet's jessamine; Summer jasmine; True jasmine

definition_uz: Ekin ekish yoki bog‘ barpo etishga tayyorlash maqsadida tuproqqa mexanik ishlov berish jarayoni. Yerni ishlash haydash, yumshatish, kultivatsiya qilish, boronalash va tekislash kabi agrotexnik tadbirlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Uning asosiy maqsadi tuproqning fizik holati va suv-havo rejimini tartibga solish, begona o‘tlarni nazorat qilish hamda urug‘larning unishi va ildizlarning rivojlanishi uchun qulay sharoit yaratishdir.
example_uz: Tokzor yerini ishlash toklarning sifatli va barqaror mo‘l hosil beradigan bo‘lib, yaxshi o‘sishi uchun qulay sharoit yaratadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The mechanical manipulation of soil for crop production, including operations such as plowing, harrowing and cultivating, to prepare the soil, control weeds, and create suitable conditions for seed germination and plant growth.
etymology_en: Derived from till, meaning to cultivate or prepare land for crops.
example_en: Tillage breaks up soil structure and destroys residue. (University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Dukkakdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik oziq-ovqat va moyli ekin. Urug‘lanishdan keyin gul asosida hosil bo‘lgan ginofor pastga qarab o‘sib, tuproqqa kiradi va uning uchida dukkak yer ostida rivojlanadi. Dukkaklarida odatda bir necha urug‘ bo‘lib, urug‘lari yog‘ va oqsilga boy. Yeryong‘oq urug‘i oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadi hamda undan moy va boshqa mahsulotlar olinadi.
example_uz: Yeryong‘oq dukkakdoshlar oilasiga mansub bir yillik o‘simlik. (O‘simlikshunoslik. Atabayeva H.N., Xudoyqulov J.B., 2018)
definition_en: An annual herbaceous legume of the family Fabaceae cultivated for its edible, oil-rich seeds. After fertilization, the peg elongates and penetrates the soil, where the pod develops underground. The seeds are consumed directly and are also processed for oil and other food products.
example_en: After fertilization, the flower stalk elongates, causing it to bend until the ovary touches the ground. Stalk growth continues and pushes the ovary underground where the mature fruit develops into a legume pod, the peanut. (North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox, Arachis hypogaea)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, meva, urug‘ yoki boshqa o‘simlik organining o‘sish va rivojlanish jarayonida muayyan fiziologik yoki rivojlanish yetukligi bosqichiga erishishi. Meva va urug‘larda yetilish ularning fiziologik yetuklikka erishishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, mevalarda yetilish pishishdan oldin sodir bo‘lishi yoki u bilan qisman ustma-ust kechishi mumkin.
example_uz: Bu muddatda ekilgan urug‘lar erta ko‘klamda barvaqt unib chiqadi va tez avj olib, hosili bahorda ekilganga nisbatan 25–30 kun ilgari yetilib, hosildorligi 15–20 foizgacha yuqori bo‘ladi. (Ertaki mahsulotlar – xalqimiz dasturxoni to‘kinligi garovi. O‘zA, 2023)
definition_en: To reach a stage of physiological or developmental maturity during the growth and development of a plant, fruit, seed, or other plant organ. In fruits and seeds, maturation involves progression toward physiological maturity; in fruits, maturity may precede or partly overlap with ripening.
etymology_en: From Latin maturus, meaning "ripe, timely, mature".
example_en: Biochemical changes take place as seeds mature but relatively little is known for most species. (A Guide to Forest Seed Handling. FAO)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, meva, urug‘ yoki boshqa o‘simlik organining o‘sish va rivojlanish jarayonida muayyan fiziologik yoki rivojlanish yetukligi bosqichiga erishgan holatini bildiruvchi sifat. Yetilgan meva yoki urug‘ fiziologik yetuklikka erishgan bo‘lishi mumkin, biroq mevalarda bu holat har doim to‘liq pishganlikni anglatmaydi.
example_uz: Mevaning yashilligi yo‘qolib, po‘stining qahrabo rangga kirishi yetilganligini ko‘rsatadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Having reached a defined stage of physiological or developmental maturity. In horticulture, the term may describe a plant, fruit, seed, or other plant organ that has attained physiological maturity; in fruits, maturity does not necessarily mean full ripeness.
etymology_en: From Latin maturus, meaning "ripe, timely, mature".
example_en: A mature fruit is dull brown in colour and the colour immediately below the skin when scratched is of lighter shade, while in immature fruits it is green. (Crop Production Guide: Horticulture Crops. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, 2020)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, meva, urug‘ yoki boshqa o‘simlik organining o‘sish va rivojlanish jarayonida muayyan fiziologik yoki rivojlanish yetukligi holatiga erishish jarayoni. Mevalarda yetilish o‘sish va rivojlanishdan pishish bosqichiga o‘tish bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, pishishdan oldin sodir bo‘lishi yoki u bilan qisman ustma-ust kechishi mumkin. Urug‘larda yetilish fiziologik yetuklikka erishish bilan bog‘liq rivojlanish jarayonlarini o‘z ichiga oladi.
example_uz: Shunga asosan hosilni pishib yetilishi: fiziologik yetilishi, biokimyoviy jihatdan to‘la terimbop bo‘lib yetilish, texnik yetilish turlariga bo‘linadi. (Uzumchilik. Isayev S.X., Jumanov A.N., 2020)
definition_en: The developmental process by which a plant, fruit, seed, or other plant organ progresses toward physiological or developmental maturity. In fruits, maturation represents a transition from growth and development toward ripening and may precede or partly overlap with the ripening process.
etymology_en: From Latin maturare, meaning "to make ripe or mature", from maturus, meaning "ripe, mature".
example_en: Fruit maturation, a transitional phase that precipitates ripening, occurs when auxin and GA levels subside with a concurrent rise in abscisic acid (ABA) and ethylene. (Phytohormones in fruit development and maturation. Fenn M.A., Giovannoni J.J., The Plant Journal, 2021)

definition_uz: Sug‘orish suvini bosim ostida quvurlar orqali purkagichlarga yetkazib, mayda tomchilar ko‘rinishida havoga purkash va ekin hamda tuproq yuzasiga sun’iy yomg‘ir tarzida tushirishga asoslangan sug‘orish usuli. Ushbu usul tabiiy yog‘ingarchilikni taqlid qiladi va to‘g‘ri loyihalangan hamda boshqarilgan tizimda suvning maydon bo‘ylab bir tekis taqsimlanishini ta’minlaydi.
etymology_uz: Yomg‘irlatmoq — suvni yomg‘ir singari tomchilar holida yog‘dirish va sug‘orish — suv berish orqali namlash ma’nolaridagi so‘zlardan tuzilgan.
example_uz: Keyingi yillarda O‘zbekiston Respublikasida ham progressiv, ya’ni yomg‘irlatib sug‘orish usuli qo‘llanilmoqda. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A method of irrigation in which water is conveyed under pressure through a system of pipes and sprayed into the air through sprinklers, breaking into small droplets that fall onto the crop and soil in a manner similar to natural rainfall.
example_en: Sprinkler irrigation is a method of applying irrigation water which is similar to natural rainfall. (Irrigation Water Management: Irrigation Methods. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO))
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Yong‘oqdoshlar (Juglandaceae) oilasiga mansub yirik, barg to‘kuvchi, uzoq umr ko‘ruvchi mevali daraxt. Mevasi yashil, etdor tashqi po‘st bilan o‘ralgan bo‘lib, yetilganda bu po‘st yoriladi va ichidan qattiq qobiqli yong‘oq ajraladi. Qobiq ichida oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadigan mag‘iz joylashadi. Yong‘oq meva olish uchun yetishtirilishi bilan birga qimmatli yog‘ochi uchun ham qadrlanadi.
example_uz: Grek yong‘og‘i (Juglans regia L.) bo‘yi 25–30 m ga, diametri 1–2 m ga yetadigan daraxt. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A deciduous tree of the family Juglandaceae cultivated primarily for its edible nuts and also valued for its timber. The fruit consists of a nut enclosed in a smooth green husk that turns brown as it matures; the hard shell encloses an edible kernel.
etymology_en: Walnut derives from Old English wealhhnutu, literally meaning "foreign nut".
example_en: The English walnut, (Juglans regia) also known as Persian walnut, is the most commonly grown walnut for nut production. (Fruit & Nut Research & Information Center, University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources)

definition_uz: Yong‘oq daraxtlari o‘sadigan yoki maxsus ekib barpo etilgan maydon. Yong‘oqzor tabiiy holda shakllangan daraxtzor yoki yong‘oq hosili olish uchun tashkil etilgan madaniy mevali bog‘ bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Madaniy yong‘oqzorlar maydoni umumiy yong‘oqzorlarning 16 foizini tashkil qiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An area planted with walnut trees, especially a managed orchard established for the production of walnuts. In a broader sense, areas dominated by walnut trees may also occur as natural or semi-natural groves.
etymology_en: Walnut derives from Old English wealhhnutu, literally "foreign nut"; orchard derives from Old English ortgeard, referring to an enclosed garden or fruit-growing area.
example_en: Walnut orchards are typically arranged in one of two planting systems that have different methods of management. (Walnut Orchard Establishment. Fruit & Nut Research & Information Center, University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources)

definition_uz: Mevachilikda oziq-ovqat sifatida foydalaniladigan urug‘i yoki mag‘zi qattiq qobiq bilan o‘ralgan ko‘p yillik meva ekinlari guruhi. Bu guruhga yong‘oq, bodom, pista, funduk, pekan va boshqa yong‘oqmevali ekinlar kiradi.
example_uz: Yong‘oq mevalilar. Yong‘oq sentabrning ikkinchi yarmi — oktabr oylarida pishadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A horticultural group of perennial crops cultivated primarily for their edible nuts or kernels, including walnut, almond, pistachio, hazelnut, pecan, and other commercially important nut crops.
etymology_en: Nut derives from Old English hnutu; crop derives from Old English cropp, later developing the sense of agricultural produce.
example_en: The major nut crops grown in California are almond, walnut, pistachio, and pecan. (Fruit & Nut Research & Information Center, University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar seleksiyasida populyatsiyadan nav talablariga mos, kerakli fenotipik belgilarga ega ko‘p sonli eng yaxshi o‘simliklarni tanlab olishga asoslangan seleksiya usuli. Tanlangan o‘simliklardan olingan urug‘lar saralanib, birlashtirilgan holda keyingi avlodni hosil qilish uchun ekiladi. Oddiy yoppasiga tanlashda tanlangan o‘simliklarning nasli alohida baholanmaydi.
example_uz: Yoppasiga tanlash usuli bilan turli ekinlarning xalq seleksiyasida mahalliy navlari ham yaratilgan. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. “Yoppasiga tanlash” maqolasi, Uzoqov Y., 2005)
definition_en: A plant breeding method in which a number of superior plants are selected from a population primarily on the basis of desirable phenotypic characteristics, and their seeds are bulked and used to produce the next generation without separate progeny testing of the selected individuals.
etymology_en: Mass derives from Old French masse, meaning "a large quantity or body"; selection derives from Latin selectio, meaning "a choosing or selecting".
example_en: In mass selection, seeds are collected from (usually a few dozen to a few hundred) desirable appearing individuals in a population, and the next generation is sown from the stock of mixed seed. (Crop Improvement: Breeding Methods in Crop Plants. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: O‘simliklar hayotida fotosintez uchun energiya manbai hamda o‘sish va rivojlanishni boshqaruvchi muhim ekologik omil. Yorug‘likning intensivligi, davomiyligi (fotoperiod) va spektral tarkibi o‘simliklarning fotosintezi, unishi, vegetativ o‘sishi, gullashi, meva tugishi va hosildorligiga ta’sir qiladi.
etymology_uz: Yorug‘ sifatidan -lik qo‘shimchasi yordamida yasalgan.
example_uz: Yaxshi yaruslangan daraxtlarda shox-shabbalarga yorug‘lik yaxshi tushadi, ular uzoq hosil beradi, ildiz bachkilar kam chiqaradi va daraxtning o‘zi ham uzoq yashaydi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An essential environmental factor that provides energy for photosynthesis and acts as a signal regulating plant growth and development. Light intensity, photoperiod, and spectral composition influence photosynthesis, seed germination, vegetative growth, flowering, fruit set, and crop productivity.
etymology_en: Light derives from Old English lēoht, referring to brightness or illumination.
example_en: Light plays a fundamental role in the growth and development of plants. It is the primary energy source of photosynthesis, enabling the process of carbon assimilation in the chloroplast. (Balázs L., Kovács G.P., Effects of Light Quantity and Quality on Horticultural Crops, Horticulturae, 2025)

definition_uz: Yaxshi yoritilgan yoki kuchli yorug‘lik tushadigan sharoitda yaxshi o‘sib-rivojlanadigan o‘simliklarga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Yorug‘sevar o‘simliklar odatda ochiq va quyosh nuri yaxshi tushadigan joylarda yaxshi rivojlanadi.
example_uz: Bodring — issiqsevar, yorug‘sevar va namga talabchan o‘simlik. (O‘zbek tilining izohli lug‘ati, “yorug‘sevar” maqolasi)
definition_en: Growing best or thriving in strong light; used especially of plants that are adapted to well-lit conditions.
etymology_en: Photophilous is formed from photo- ("light") + -philous ("loving, having an affinity for").
example_en: Aside from the photophilous species (P. tabuliformis, P. armandii, and Q. aliena var. acuteserrata), most of the species were shade-tolerant. (Applying foliar stoichiometric traits of plants to determine fertilization for a mixed pine-oak stand in the Qinling Mountains, China. Scientific Reports, 2018)

definition_uz: Kuchli yorug‘lik sharoitida yaxshi o‘sib-rivojlanadigan va soyalanishga nisbatan kam chidamli o‘simliklar ekologik guruhi. Bunday o‘simliklarning yorug‘likka bo‘lgan talabi yuqori bo‘lib, fotosintez jarayoni va normal rivojlanishi uchun yaxshi yoritilgan sharoit zarur.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston sharoitida o‘stiriladigan barcha meva va rezavor meva o‘simliklar yorug‘sevardir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Plants adapted to and requiring relatively high levels of light for optimum growth and development. Heliophytes generally perform best in open, well-lit habitats and are less tolerant of shading than shade-adapted plants.
etymology_en: Heliophyte is formed from Greek hēlios ("sun") and phyton ("plant"), literally meaning "sun plant".
example_en: The heliophytes were characterized by high values of the maximum net photosynthetic rate and light saturation point. (Photosynthetic characteristics of shade-tolerant and heliophilous tree species in a tropical rain forest, Photosynthetica)

definition_uz: Inson tomonidan madaniylashtirilmagan va odatda tabiiy sharoitda o‘sadigan o‘simlik yoki boshqa organizmga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bog‘dorchilik va seleksiyada madaniy ekinlarning yovvoyi qarindoshlari kasallik va zararkunandalarga chidamlilik, qurg‘oqchilikka va boshqa noqulay muhit omillariga bardoshlilik kabi foydali belgilar manbai sifatida muhim ahamiyatga ega.
etymology_uz: Yovvoyi — tabiiy holda yashaydigan yoki o‘sadigan, xonakilashtirilmagan va madaniylashtirilmagan ma’nosidagi sifat.
example_uz: Nok uchun yovvoyi o‘rmon nokidan tashqari madaniy noklarning urug‘idan chiqqan niholchalardan foydalaniladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Growing or occurring naturally rather than being cultivated or domesticated. In plant breeding, wild relatives of cultivated crops are important genetic resources because they may possess useful traits such as resistance to pests and diseases and tolerance to environmental stresses.
etymology_en: Wild derives from Old English wilde, meaning "living in a state of nature, not domesticated".
example_en: Crop wild relatives are valuable genetic resources for crop improvement. (Khoury C.K. et al., Plants, People, Planet, 2019)

definition_uz: Yulg‘undoshlar (Tamaricaceae) oilasiga mansub buta va kichik daraxtlar turkumi. Yulg‘un turlari asosan qurg‘oqchil va sho‘rlangan hududlarda tarqalgan. Barglari juda mayda, odatda tangachasimon, gullari mayda bo‘lib, shingilsimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi. Ayrim turlari sho‘rlanish va qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli bo‘lib, qumli va sho‘rxok hududlarda o‘sadi hamda ihota, eroziyaga qarshi va ko‘kalamzorlashtirish maqsadlarida foydalanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Sho‘rhoq tuproqlarda, qurg‘oqchil yerlarda himoya o‘rmonzorlarini yaratishda va qumlarni mustahkamlashda yulg‘unning ko‘p turlari qo‘llaniladi. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A genus of shrubs and small trees in the family Tamaricaceae, occurring mainly in dry and saline habitats. Tamarisks typically have numerous slender branches, small scale-like leaves, and small flowers borne in racemes. Several species are highly tolerant of drought and salinity and have been cultivated for ornamental planting, windbreaks, and erosion control.
etymology_en: Tamarisk derives through Latin tamariscus, the name used for plants of this group.
example_en: Tamarisk are shrubs or shrub-like trees with numerous large basal branches, reaching 13 to 26 feet (4-8 m) in height, but usually less than 20 feet (6 m). (Zouhar K., Tamarix spp., tamarisk, Fire Effects Information System, USDA Forest Service, 2003)

definition_uz: O‘simlik rivojlanishining urug‘ unishidan keyin boshlanib, o‘simlik gullash qobiliyatiga ega bo‘lguniga qadar davom etadigan dastlabki davri. Yuvenil davrda o‘simlik vegetativ o‘sadi va hatto gullash uchun qulay tashqi sharoit mavjud bo‘lganda ham reproduktiv rivojlanishni boshlashga hali qodir bo‘lmaydi. Bu davrning davomiyligi o‘simlik turiga qarab keskin farq qiladi va ko‘p yillik yog‘ochli o‘simliklarda bir necha yil davom etishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yuvenil lotincha juvenilis — "yosh, yoshlikka oid" so‘zidan.
example_uz: Yuvenil davri — murtakning o‘sishi va vegetativ organlarning hosil bo‘lishi. (Biologiya va Genetika. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2014)
definition_en: The early developmental period during which a plant is not yet competent to flower. It begins after germination and continues until the plant acquires the ability to respond to floral inductive signals and enter the adult phase. Its duration varies greatly among species and may last for several years or even decades in woody perennial plants.
etymology_en: Juvenile derives from Latin juvenilis, meaning "young, youthful"; period derives ultimately from Greek periodos, meaning "cycle, circuit, course".
example_en: Woody perennials typically go through a juvenile period of growth in which they remain vegetative and do not respond to flowering stimuli. (Cold hardiness increases with age in juvenile Rhododendron populations. Frontiers in Plant Science, 2014)

definition_uz: Fungi olamiga mansub, xlorofillsiz, geterotrof oziqlanuvchi eukariot organizm. Zamburug‘lar oziq moddalarni tashqi muhitda parchalab, ularni singdirish orqali o‘zlashtiradi va ko‘pchiligi sporalar yordamida ko‘payadi. Ularning ko‘p turlari tabiatda organik moddalarni parchalashda muhim rol o‘ynaydi, ayrimlari esa o‘simliklarda kasallik keltirib chiqaruvchi patogenlar hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Dog‘li antraknoz kasalligi zamburug‘ning ta’siri bilan boshlanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A eukaryotic heterotrophic organism belonging to the kingdom Fungi that obtains nutrients by external digestion and absorption. Most fungi reproduce by spores. Many fungi function as decomposers of organic matter, while some are important plant pathogens.
etymology_en: From Latin fungus, meaning "mushroom".
example_en: Venturia inaequalis, the apple scab fungus, is one example of a fungal plant pathogen that infects the blossoms, leaves, and fruit of apple. (The Pacific Northwest Gardener’s Handbook: Plant Pathology. Washington State University Extension)

definition_uz: Patogen zamburug‘lar tomonidan qo‘zg‘atiladigan o‘simlik kasalliklari guruhi. Ular o‘simlikning ildizi, poyasi, bargi, guli, mevasi va boshqa organlarini zararlab, so‘lish, chirish, dog‘lanish, zang, unshudring va boshqa kasallik belgilarini yuzaga keltirishi mumkin. Zamburug‘ kasalliklarining rivojlanishi ko‘pincha namlik, harorat, patogen va xo‘jayin o‘simlik o‘rtasidagi munosabatlarga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Bachki novdalardan hosil bo‘lgan daraxtlar urug‘dan o‘sib chiqqan daraxtlarga nisbatan tez o‘sadi. Ular urug‘dan chiqqan yosh o‘simliklarga nisbatan tez rivojlanadi, lekin ko‘p yashamaydi, yog‘ochi yumshoq bo‘lib, zamburug‘li kasalliklar bilan kasallanadi. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: Plant diseases caused by pathogenic fungi. They may affect roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits, seeds, and other plant organs and produce symptoms such as wilting, rots, leaf spots, rusts, and powdery mildews. Their development is influenced by interactions among the pathogen, host plant, and environmental conditions.
etymology_en: Fungal derives from Latin fungus, meaning "mushroom"; disease derives from Old French desaise, literally "lack of ease".
example_en: Warm days, humid nights, and crowded plantings create the perfect environment for these diseases. (Fungal diseases: A mid-summer garden challenge. University of Minnesota Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda zang kasalliklarini qo‘zg‘atuvchi, Pucciniales tartibiga mansub obligat biotrof parazit zamburug‘lar guruhi. Ular faqat tirik o‘simlik to‘qimalarida oziqlanib va rivojlanib, turli o‘simliklarda muhim kasalliklarni keltirib chiqaradi. Zang zamburug‘larining hayot sikli murakkab bo‘lib, ayrim turlari beshtagacha sporali bosqich hosil qiladi va ikki xil xo‘jayin o‘simlikda rivojlanishi mumkin. Uredinales — Pucciniales tartibining tarixiy sinonimik nomi.
etymology_uz: Zang nomi kasallangan o‘simlik organlarida hosil bo‘ladigan zang tusidagi sporali tuzilmalarga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Ana shunday har xil xo‘jayinli turlardan biri donli o‘simliklarning chiziqli zang zamburug‘i bo‘lib (Puccinia graminis), u ko‘pincha bug‘doyga katta zarar yetkazadi. (Botanika, Pratov O‘. va boshq., 2010)
definition_en: Obligate biotrophic plant-pathogenic fungi belonging to the order Pucciniales and causing rust diseases in plants. Rust fungi have complex life cycles that may include up to five different sporulating stages, and many species alternate between two unrelated host plants. Uredinales is a historical synonym of Pucciniales.
etymology_en: Rust refers to the characteristic yellow, orange, reddish-brown, or brown appearance of the spore-producing structures of many rust diseases; fungi is the plural of fungus.
example_en: Rust fungi (Pucciniales, Basidiomycota) are obligate biotrophic pathogens that cause rust diseases in plants, inflicting severe damage to agricultural crops. (Host Adaptation and Virulence in Heteroecious Rust Fungi. Duplessis S. et al., Annual Review of Phytopathology, 2021, 59:403–422)

definition_uz: Sapindaceae oilasiga mansub daraxt va butalar turkumi. Zaranglarning barglari qarama-qarshi joylashgan bo‘lib, ko‘plab turlarida oddiy va panjasimon bo‘laklangan. Mevalari xarakterli qanotli samaralardan iborat. Ko‘plab zarang turlari kuzda barglarining sariq, to‘q sariq yoki qizil rangga kirishi bilan yuqori manzaraviy qiymatga ega bo‘lib, bog‘lar, xiyobonlar va shahar ko‘kalamzorlashtirishida keng ekiladi; ayrim turlari yog‘ochi va boshqa xo‘jalik maqsadlarida ham qadrlanadi.
example_uz: Shovqindan saqlash uchun: oddiy eman, kumushbarg zarang, oddiy qayrag‘och, yirik bargli jo‘ka, oddiy qoraqarag‘ay, tatar zarangi, sariq akatsiya tavsiya qilinadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A member of the genus Acer in the family Sapindaceae, comprising trees and shrubs characterized by opposite leaves and distinctive winged fruits (samaras). Many maple species are valued as ornamental and shade trees, particularly for their attractive autumn foliage.
example_en: Most maples are valued for their spectacular fall leaf colors, which range from muted yellow to bright orange and red. (Maple. Clemson Cooperative Extension, 2013)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar, o‘simlik mahsulotlari yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlariga zarar yetkazuvchi organizm. Bog‘dorchilik va o‘simliklarni himoya qilishda zararkunandalar jumlasiga hasharotlar, kanalar, nematodalar, kemiruvchilar va boshqa zararli organizmlar kiradi. Ular o‘simlik organlari bilan oziqlanishi yoki boshqa yo‘llar bilan zarar yetkazishi natijasida o‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanishini susaytirishi, hosildorlikni kamaytirishi hamda mahsulot sifatini yomonlashtirishi mumkin.
example_uz: Tokzorlarda tok kasalliklari singari tok zararkunandalari ham uchraydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An organism that causes damage to plants, plant products, or agricultural crops. In horticulture and plant protection, pests include insects, mites, nematodes, rodents, and other harmful organisms that can reduce plant growth, crop yield, or product quality.
etymology_en: From French peste, ultimately from Latin pestis, meaning "plague or pestilence".
example_en: Correctly identifying the pest is key to knowing whether a pest is likely to become a problem. (Integrated Pest Management. University of California Statewide IPM Program)

definition_uz: Zaytundoshlar (Oleaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil, uzoq umr ko‘ruvchi mevali daraxt yoki buta. Barglari tor, terisimon, ustki tomoni yashil, ostki tomoni kumushrang tusli; gullari mayda va oqish rangli. Mevasi danakli bo‘lib, qattiq danagini iste’molbop etli qism o‘rab turadi. Mevalari oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadi va ulardan zaytun moyi olinadi. Zaytun qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli bo‘lib, ayniqsa O‘rta dengiz iqlimi sharoitiga yaxshi moslashgan.
etymology_uz: Zaytun arabcha zaytūn (زيتون) so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Mevalarni iste’mol qilishdan tashqari, ba’zi turlari (zaytun daraxti, yong‘oq, bodom va boshqalar) urug‘idan oziq-ovqatda ishlatiladigan va texnik moylar, po‘stlog‘i, barglari hamda mevasi po‘chog‘idan tanin, shuningdek, qimmatbaho o‘simlik bo‘yoqlari olinadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An evergreen tree or shrub of the family Oleaceae, cultivated primarily for its edible fruits and olive oil. It has narrow, leathery leaves that are silvery beneath, small whitish flowers, and drupaceous fruits consisting of a hard stone surrounded by edible flesh. Olive trees are drought-tolerant and are particularly well adapted to Mediterranean-type climates.
etymology_en: Olive derives from Old French olive, from Latin oliva, ultimately from Greek elaia; tree derives from Old English trēow.
example_en: Today olive trees are grown and harvested for their fruits, which are used as a foodstuff and as a cooking oil. (Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Olive – Olea europaea)

definition_uz: Zaytun daraxti (Olea europaea L.)ning danakli mevasi. Mevasi rivojlanishning dastlabki bosqichlarida yashil bo‘lib, yetilish jarayonida naviga qarab binafsha, to‘q binafsha yoki qora tusga kirishi mumkin. Zaytun mevasi yog‘ga va fenolik birikmalarga boy bo‘lib, uning moyida olein kislotasi asosiy yog‘ kislotalaridan biridir. Meva tarkibidagi oleuropein unga achchiq ta’m bergani sababli zaytun odatda qayta ishlangandan so‘ng iste’mol qilinadi; zaytun mevalaridan zaytun moyi ham olinadi.
example_uz: Zaytunning pishgan mevasi etida (25–80%) qurimaydigan moy bor. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. Jo‘rayev R.)
definition_en: The drupe of the olive tree (Olea europaea L.). The fruit is initially green and may become purple to black during ripening, depending on the cultivar. Olive fruit has a relatively high oil content and contains phenolic compounds such as oleuropein. Because of its natural bitterness, the fruit normally requires processing or curing before table consumption and is also used for olive oil production.
example_en: The olive fruit is a drupe, similar in botanical structure to fruits such as cherries or plums. (Table Olives. International Olive Council)

definition_uz: Zaytun daraxtlari ekilgan yer yoki maydon. Mevachilikda zaytunzor zaytun mevasi va zaytun moyi olish maqsadida zaytun daraxtlari ekib barpo etilgan hamda parvarish qilinadigan ko‘p yillik mevali bog‘ni anglatadi.
example_uz: Ozarbayjon, Gruziya, Qrim, Turkmaniston, Rossiyaning Krasnodar o‘lkasida ham zaytunzorlar bor. (Dunyoda zaytun (Olea europaea L.) yetishtirilishi, atrof muhit va insonga foydasi. Komilova N., 2025)
definition_en: An orchard planted with olive trees (Olea europaea L.) and managed primarily for the production of olives for table use or olive oil. Olive orchards are perennial cropping systems widely associated with Mediterranean and other suitable dry or subtropical environments.
etymology_en: Olive derives from Old French olive, from Latin oliva, ultimately from Greek elaia; orchard derives from Old English ortgeard, referring to an enclosed garden or fruit-growing area.
example_en: Sustainable management practices were applied for a 15-year period in a 2-ha olive orchard located in an hilly peri-urban zone of southern Italy. (Mininni A.N., Montanaro G., Dichio B., Fausto C., Xiloyannis C., Acta Horticulturae, 2018, 1215:19–26)

definition_uz: Kartoshka, ildizmevalar va boshqa sabzavotlarni mavsumiy saqlash uchun yerga qaziladigan muvaqqat saqlash joyi. O‘ra xandaqqa nisbatan umumiyroq tushuncha bo‘lib, uning shakli va uzunligi mahsulot turi hamda saqlash hajmiga qarab belgilanadi; mahsulot joylashtirilgach, usti poxol va tuproq bilan yopiladi.
example_uz: Kartoshka O‘zbekistonda sun’iy sovitiladigan omborxona va oddiy omborxona, shuningdek, o‘ralarda saqlanadi. (Mahsulotlarni saralash. Umidov Sh.E., Muqimov Z.M., Odinayev M.I., 2017)
definition_en: An excavation made in the ground for the temporary or seasonal storage of potatoes, root crops, tubers and other vegetables. The produce is commonly protected with layers of straw, grass, leaves, wood ash or soil.
example_en: Pit storage of sweet potatoes is also practiced in Zimbabwe and Malawi, where the tubers are placed in pits with alternate layers of wood ash. (Traditional Post-harvest Technology of Perishable Tropical Staples. Lancaster P.A. and Coursey D.G., FAO, 1984)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Prunus turkumiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt. Bahorda barg yozishidan oldin yoki barg yozishi bilan bir vaqtda oq yoki och pushti gullar hosil qiladi. Mevasi danakli, odatda sariqdan to‘q sariqqacha rangli bo‘lib, yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, quritiladi va turli mahsulotlarga qayta ishlanadi. O‘rik issiq va quruq iqlim sharoitlariga yaxshi moslashgan muhim meva ekinlaridan biridir.
example_uz: O‘rik daraxti kuchli va tez o‘sishi, tez hosilga kirishi, uzoq yashashi, issiqqa va qurg‘oqchilikka chidamliligi bilan Yevropa guruhiga kiradigan navlardan ajralib turadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree of the family Rosaceae and genus Prunus, widely cultivated for its edible stone fruits. It produces white to pale pink flowers in early spring, often before or around leaf emergence, followed by yellow to orange drupes containing a single hard stone. Apricot is an important fruit crop adapted to temperate regions with relatively warm, dry growing conditions.
etymology_en: Apricot entered English through French abricot, ultimately deriving through earlier Romance and Arabic forms from Latin praecoquum, referring to an early-ripening fruit.
example_en: Prunus armeniaca L. is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome. (Plants of the World Online, Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew)

definition_uz: O‘rik daraxti (Prunus armeniaca L.)ning danakli mevasi. Mevasi odatda yumaloq yoki tuxumsimon, po‘sti ko‘pincha mayin tukli bo‘lib, pishganda sariq, to‘q sariq yoki ayrim navlarda qizg‘ish tusga kiradi. Eti shirali, xushbo‘y, shirin yoki nordon-shirin ta’mli. Tarkibida qandlar, organik kislotalar, pektin moddalar, vitaminlar va mineral moddalar mavjud. O‘rik mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, shuningdek quritish, sharbat, murabbo, jem, kompot va boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
example_uz: O‘rik mevasidan har xil kompot, murabbo, jem, povidlo, pastila, marmelad, jeli, sukat, konfet orasiga solinadigan qiyom, sharbat tayyorlanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The drupe of the apricot tree (Prunus armeniaca L.). The fruit is generally round to ovoid, with usually pubescent skin that becomes yellow to orange and sometimes reddish when ripe. Its flesh is juicy and aromatic, with a sweet or sweet-tart flavor. Apricot fruit contains sugars, organic acids, pectic substances, vitamins, and minerals and is consumed fresh or processed into dried fruit, juices, jams, preserves, and other food products.
example_en: The nondestructive assessment of apricot fruit quality (Bora cultivar) was carried out by means of FT-NIR reflectance spectroscopy. (FT-NIR Spectroscopy for the Quality Characterization of Apricots (Prunus armeniaca L.). Berardinelli A. et al., Journal of Food Science, 2010)

definition_uz: Pishgan o‘rik mevasini tabiiy yoki sun’iy usulda quritish orqali olinadigan oziq-ovqat mahsuloti. O‘rik qoqi danagi bilan yoki danagi ajratilgan holda tayyorlanishi mumkin.
