Quritish natijasida mahsulotning namligi kamayib, qandlar, mineral moddalar va boshqa quruq moddalar nisbatan konsentrlanadi. O‘rik qoqi bevosita iste’mol qilinadi yoki turli oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.
example_uz: O‘rik qoqi quritish usuliga ko‘ra turlicha xillari tayyorlanadi. (Oziq-ovqat xomashyolari. Maxmudova D.X., 2023)
definition_en: The product prepared from sound ripe fruit of varieties of Prunus armeniaca L. by drying, either naturally or by other suitable dehydration methods. Dried apricots may be presented whole, with or without stones, or in other permitted forms.
etymology_en: Dried is the past participial form of dry; apricot entered English through French abricot and earlier Romance and Arabic forms, ultimately deriving from Latin praecoquum.
example_en: Dried apricots are the product prepared from sound ripe fruit of varieties of Prunus armeniaca L., by drying in the sun or by other methods recognized as suitable for dehydration purposes. (Codex Standard for Dried Apricots, CXS 130-1981, Codex Alimentarius)

definition_uz: O‘rik daraxtlari (Prunus armeniaca L.) ekilgan va meva yetishtirish maqsadida parvarish qilinadigan bog‘. O‘rikzor barpo etishda hududning tuproq-iqlim sharoiti, nav va payvandtag tanlash, daraxtlarni joylashtirish sxemasi, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, shakl berish, butash va o‘simliklarni himoya qilish tadbirlari muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Shag‘al qatlamlari 50–90 sm chuqurlikda bo‘lgan yerlar mevali bog‘ barpo qilish uchun yaroqli hisoblanadi, shag‘al qatlamlari yer betidan 25–50 sm va undan chuqur bo‘lgan yerlarda o‘rikzor va shaftolizor barpo qilish mumkin. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An orchard planted and managed with apricot trees (Prunus armeniaca L.) for fruit production. Apricot orchard management includes appropriate cultivar and rootstock selection, planting density, irrigation, fertilisation, training, pruning, and plant protection practices.
etymology_en: Apricot + orchard, referring to an orchard planted with apricot trees.
example_en: The trial was set at a four-year-old apricot orchard (Prunus armeniaca L.). (Vascular and Transpiration Flows Affecting Apricot (Prunus armeniaca L.) Fruit Growth. Giovannini D. et al., Agronomy, 2022)

definition_uz: Mavsum o‘rtalarida pishadigan o‘simlik yoki navga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. O‘rtapishar navlar pishish muddati jihatidan ertapishar va kechpishar navlar oralig‘idagi guruhga kiradi. Bog‘dorchilik, sabzavotchilik va boshqa ekinlar navlarini pishish muddatiga ko‘ra tasniflashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Aprobatsiya avval ertapishar, keyin o‘rtapishar, oxirida kechpishar navlarda o‘tkaziladi, hosil terishdan 15–20 kun oldin to‘xtatiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Maturing or ripening during the middle part of the growing or production season. In horticulture, mid-season cultivars mature later than early-season cultivars and earlier than late-season cultivars.
example_en: While, Redhaven was mid-season cultivar with 1502 ± 16.17 GDD, and July Elberta was the late-season cultivar with 1894 ± 6.00 GDD. (Verma P. et al., Annals of Applied Biology, 2023, 182(3):284–294)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Tirik organizmlarning Plantae olamiga mansub guruhi. O‘simliklarning aksariyati xlorofill pigmentlari yordamida fotosintez qilib, yorug‘lik energiyasini kimyoviy energiyaga aylantiradi. O‘simliklar tuzilishi va hayot sikli jihatidan xilma-xil bo‘lib, yuksak o‘simliklarda ildiz, poya va barg kabi vegetativ organlar, urug‘li o‘simliklarda esa reproduktiv tuzilmalar rivojlangan. O‘simliklar ekotizimlarda muhim birlamchi ishlab chiqaruvchilar bo‘lib, inson uchun oziq-ovqat, yem-xashak, tola, yog‘och, dorivor xomashyo va boshqa mahsulotlarning muhim manbai hisoblanadi.
example_uz: O‘simliklarning hujayrasida issiqlik 50°C atrofida bo‘lsa, bu holatda barglar, tana va mevalarni zararlaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Organisms belonging to the kingdom Plantae. Most plants are photosynthetic organisms that use chlorophyll-containing structures to capture light energy and convert it into chemical energy. Plants are highly diverse in structure and reproduction and play fundamental ecological roles as primary producers. They also provide humans with food, feed, fiber, timber, medicines, and numerous other resources.
etymology_en: Plant derives from Latin planta, meaning "sprout, shoot, cutting", through Old French plante.
example_en: Plants are multicellular organisms in the kingdom Plantae that use photosynthesis to make their own food. (Encyclopaedia Britannica, Plant)

definition_uz: Botanikaning o‘simliklarning ichki tuzilishi va tashkil topishini, xususan hujayralari, to‘qimalari va organlarining tuzilishi, joylashuvi, rivojlanishi hamda tuzilish bilan funksiya o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni o‘rganuvchi bo‘limi. O‘simliklar anatomiyasi ildiz, poya, barg, gul, meva va urug‘ning ichki tuzilishini, shuningdek qoplovchi, asosiy, mexanik va o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalarning tuzilishi hamda joylashuvini o‘rganadi.
example_uz: O‘simliklar anatomiyasi o‘simliklarning ichki tuzilishini o‘rganadi. (Botanika. Tursinbayeva G.S., Duschanova G.M., Abdullaeva A.T., Sadinov J.S., 2018)
definition_en: The branch of botany concerned with the internal structure and organization of plants, particularly their cells, tissues, and organs. Plant anatomy examines the structural organization of roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits, and seeds and the relationship between plant structure and function.
etymology_en: Anatomy derives ultimately from Greek anatomē, meaning "dissection", from ana- ("up") and temnein ("to cut").
example_en: Plants are made up of cells which are grouped into tissues, based on similar characteristics. These tissues make up the structures, or organs, of a plant: roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruit, and seeds. (Basic Botany: Plant Anatomy. Washington State University Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda kechadigan hayotiy jarayonlar va fiziologik funksiyalarni hamda ularning tashqi muhit omillariga javob reaksiyalarini o‘rganuvchi biologik fan. O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi fotosintez, nafas olish, suv almashinuvi, mineral oziqlanish, modda almashinuvi, o‘sish va rivojlanish, fitogormonlar ta’siri hamda o‘simliklarning muhit sharoitlariga moslanish mexanizmlarini tadqiq etadi.
etymology_uz: Fiziologiya yunoncha physis — "tabiat" va logos — "ta’limot, fan" so‘zlaridan.
example_uz: Bog‘dorchilik sohasi biologiya, biotexnologiya, tuproqshunoslik, o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi, melioratsiya, agrokimyo va umumiy dehqonchilik tarmoqlari bilan chambarchas bog‘liqdir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The branch of plant biology concerned with the functions and physiological processes of plants, including photosynthesis, respiration, water relations, mineral nutrition, metabolism, growth and development, hormonal regulation, and responses to environmental conditions.
etymology_en: Physiology derives from Greek physis ("nature") and -logia ("study"); plant derives from Latin planta through Old French plante.
example_en: Plant physiology focuses on the chemistry and physics of how plants function. (Botany: Plant Physiology and Regulation. Ha M., Morrow M., Algiers K., ASCCC Open Educational Resources Initiative)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning, ayniqsa daraxt va butalarning poya, shox, novda yoki boshqa organlarida ayrim zamburug‘ va bakterial patogenlar ta’sirida mahalliy nekrotik, yarasimon yoki cho‘kkan zararlanish o‘choqlari hosil bo‘lishi bilan tavsiflanadigan kasalliklar guruhi. Zararlangan joylarda po‘stloq nobud bo‘lishi, yorilishi yoki ko‘chishi mumkin; kuchli zararlanish novda va shoxlarning qurishi, o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalarning zararlanishi va o‘simlikning zaiflashishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: Xanthomonas turkum vakillari o‘simliklar barglarida dog‘lanish, poyasidagi o‘tkazuvchi paylarni kasallantirish, o‘simlik rakini keltirib chiqaradi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: A plant disease symptom or disease type characterized by a localized area of dead or necrotic tissue, particularly on stems, branches, or twigs. Cankers may be caused by fungal or bacterial pathogens and can girdle affected stems or branches, resulting in dieback and, in severe cases, plant death.
etymology_en: From Latin cancer, meaning "crab" and later "malignant growth or ulcer", through Old French chancre.
example_en: Cankers are localized dead areas of bark on stems and branches. (Cankers of Trees. Penn State Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar yoki o‘simlik mahsulotlariga bevosita yoki bilvosita zarar yetkazadigan organizmlar. O‘simliklar zararkunandalariga hasharotlar, kanalar, nematodalar, mollyuskalar, ayrim umurtqali hayvonlar va boshqa zararli organizmlar kirishi mumkin. Keng fitosanitar ma’noda bu tushuncha o‘simliklarga zarar yetkazuvchi patogen agentlar va zararli o‘simliklarni ham qamrab oladi. Zararkunandalar o‘simlik organlarini shikastlashi, hosildorlik va mahsulot sifatini pasaytirishi, ayrim hollarda esa o‘simlik patogenlarini tarqatishi mumkin.
example_uz: O‘simliklar zararkunandalariga qarshi chidamli navlar yaratish ularni himoya qilishning kimyoviy vositalarini qo‘llashni 5–15 martagacha qisqartirishga ham imkon beradi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: Organisms injurious to plants or plant products. In the broad phytosanitary sense, plant pests may include insects, mites, nematodes, mollusks, vertebrates, harmful plants, and pathogenic agents. They may damage plants directly or indirectly, reduce crop yield and quality, and in some cases act as vectors of plant pathogens.
etymology_en: Plant derives from Latin planta; pest derives from Latin pestis, meaning "plague, destructive agent".
example_en: A pest is any species, strain or biotype of plant, animal or pathogenic agent injurious to plants or plant products. (International Plant Protection Convention, Glossary of Phytosanitary Terms, ISPM 5)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning normal o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va fiziologik faoliyatini buzadigan patologik holatlar majmui. O‘simliklar kasalliklari zamburug‘lar, bakteriyalar, viruslar, viroidlar, fitoplazmalar va nematodalar kabi biotik omillar ta’sirida yoki noqulay harorat, namlik, oziqa elementlarining yetishmasligi yoki ortiqchaligi, sho‘rlanish, kimyoviy shikastlanish va boshqa abiotik omillar natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: O‘simlik kasalliklari yuqumli (infeksion) va yuqumsiz (noinfeksion) turlarga ajratilgan holda ko‘rib chiqilgan. (O‘simliklarning zamburug‘li kasalliklarga chidamliligi. Ismoilov I.X., Mukumjonova M.M., Rahmonova Z.R., 2025)
definition_en: Pathological conditions that interfere with the normal growth, development, structure, or physiological functions of plants. Plant diseases may be caused by biotic agents such as fungi, bacteria, viruses, viroids, phytoplasmas, and nematodes, or by adverse abiotic factors such as unfavorable temperature or moisture, nutrient deficiencies or toxicities, salinity, and chemical injury.
etymology_en: Plant derives from Latin planta; disease entered English through Old French desaise, literally referring to a lack of ease.
example_en: Plant diseases are caused by both infectious agents and noninfectious environmental factors. (The Disease Triangle: A Plant Pathological Paradigm Revisited. American Phytopathological Society)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar va o‘simlik mahsulotlarini zararkunandalar, kasalliklar, begona o‘tlar va boshqa zararli organizmlardan himoya qilishga qaratilgan ilmiy-amaliy soha. O‘simliklarni himoya qilish zararli organizmlarning tarqalishi va zararini oldini olish, kamaytirish yoki nazorat qilish uchun agrotexnik, biologik, fizik-mexanik, kimyoviy hamda integratsiyalashgan usullardan foydalanishni qamrab oladi.
example_uz: O‘simliklarni himoya qilish tizimida kimyoviy usul eng oldingi o‘rinlardan birini egallaydi, ammo uning bir qator kamchiliklari mavjud. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The field concerned with the strategies and practices used for the prevention, regulation, and control of pests and other harmful organisms in order to safeguard plant health. Plant protection includes cultural, biological, physical-mechanical, chemical, and integrated approaches to pest management.
etymology_en: Plant derives from Latin planta ("sprout, shoot"); protection derives from Latin protectio ("protection, defence").
example_en: Plant Protection – the strategies and practices used for the regulation, prevention, and control of pests to safeguard and enhance plant health. (EPPO Strategic Framework 2026–2030. European and Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization, 2025)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi fanining madaniy o‘simliklar, ayniqsa dala ekinlarining biologik va ekologik xususiyatlari, o‘sishi va rivojlanishi, hosil shakllanish qonuniyatlari hamda ilmiy asoslangan yetishtirish texnologiyalarini o‘rganuvchi tarmog‘i. O‘simlikshunoslik donli, dukkakli, moyli, yem-xashak, texnik va boshqa dala ekinlarini yetishtirish, ulardan yuqori va sifatli hosil olish masalalarini qamrab oladi.
example_uz: O‘simlikshunoslik — bu madaniy o‘simliklar va ularni yetishtirish to‘g‘risidagi ta’limot. (O‘simlikshunoslik. Atabayeva X.N., Xudayqulov J.B., 2018)
definition_en: A branch of agricultural science concerned with cultivated crops and their production, including their biological and ecological characteristics, growth and development, crop productivity, and scientifically based cultivation and management practices.
example_en: Our crop science research tackles issues such as sustainable intensification of crop production, breeding for climate resilience, and horticultural growing technologies and systems. (Department of Crop Science. University of Reading)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va boshqa fiziologik jarayonlarini juda kichik miqdorlarda rag‘batlantiruvchi, susaytiruvchi yoki boshqa tarzda o‘zgartiruvchi tabiiy yoki sintetik biologik faol moddalar. Bog‘dorchilikda bunday moddalar ildiz hosil bo‘lishi, vegetativ o‘sish, gullash, meva tugishi, meva to‘kilishi, tinim davri va pishish kabi jarayonlarni boshqarishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: O‘simlikshunoslikda o‘sishni boshqaruvchi moddalarni qo‘llash bo‘yicha ilmiy tadqiqotlarning boshlanishi o‘tgan asrning oltmishinchi yillariga to‘g‘ri keladi. (Uzumchilikda innovatsion texnologiyalar. Abdikayumov Z.A., 2022)
definition_en: Natural or synthetic chemical substances that promote, inhibit, or otherwise modify plant growth and development. They may influence processes such as rooting, shoot growth, dormancy, flowering, fruit development, ripening, and other physiological responses.
etymology_en: Plant derives from Latin planta; growth from Old English grōwan; substance derives from Latin substantia.
example_en: Plant growth regulators (PGRs) are chemical compounds that alter plant growth and development by modifying natural hormonal action. (FAO AGROVOC, Plant growth substances)

definition_uz: Gul hosil qilmay, vegetativ novdaga rivojlanadigan kurtak. Unda boshlang‘ich poya, barglar va o‘sish meristemasi mavjud bo‘lib, kurtak yozilganda yangi poya va barglardan tashkil topgan vegetativ novda hosil qiladi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarda kurtaklar yoz davomida shakllanadi, meva kurtaklari dumaloq, uchi to‘mtoq, o‘sish kurtaklari esa yumaloqroq va uchi nayza bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A bud that develops into a vegetative shoot rather than a flower or inflorescence. It contains a shoot meristem and developing leaf and stem tissues and gives rise to vegetative growth.
example_en: Vegetative bud. A type of bud that develops into shoots. (Extension Gardener Handbook: Glossary. NC State Extension, 2021)

definition_uz: O‘simlik yoki uning organining hujayralar bo‘linishi va kengayishi natijasida o‘lchami, hajmi yoki massasi qaytmas ravishda ortmoq. O‘simliklarda o‘sish asosan meristema faoliyati, hujayralarning bo‘linishi va keyinchalik kengayishi hisobiga yuz beradi hamda genetik va tashqi muhit omillari bilan boshqariladi.
example_uz: Bu shoxlar tananing har tomonida belgilangan masofada, biri ikkinchisiga xalaqit bermay o‘sadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To increase irreversibly in size, volume, or mass through processes including cell division and cell expansion. In plants, growth occurs mainly in meristematic regions and is regulated by genetic and environmental factors.
example_en: Most plants grow from their tips, although grass-like plants grow from a meristem at their base. (How Plants Grow. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Ko‘chat, nihol yoki yosh o‘simlikni o‘sishi va rivojlanishi uchun tuproqqa yoki boshqa o‘stirish muhitiga joylashtirmoq. Bog‘dorchilikda o‘tqazish mevali daraxtlar, tok, rezavor, sabzavot va manzarali o‘simliklar ko‘chatlarini tegishli chuqurlik va oraliqda doimiy yoki vaqtinchalik o‘sish joyiga joylashtirishni anglatadi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxt ko‘chatlari oldindan tayyorlangan chuqurlarga belgilangan ekish sxemasi asosida o‘tqaziladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To put a plant, seedling, young tree, or other planting material into the ground or a growing medium so that it can establish and grow. In horticulture, planting involves positioning plants at an appropriate depth and spacing in their intended growing location.
etymology_en: Plant derives through Old English plante and Old French plante from Latin planta, referring to a sprout, shoot, or young plant.
example_en: Plant the tree deep enough so that the graft union is two to three inches above the ground. (Planting and Early Care of Fruit Trees. University of Maine Cooperative Extension, Bulletin #2411)

definition_uz: Poyaning, shu jumladan novdaning markaziy qismida joylashgan, asosan parenxima hujayralaridan tashkil topgan asosiy to‘qima. O‘zak odatda o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalarning ichki tomonida joylashadi. Uning tuzilishi o‘simlik turiga qarab farqlanib, ayrim o‘simliklarda yaxlit, boshqalarida esa bo‘shliqli yoki parchalanishi natijasida kovak bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Poya markazini yirik, yupqa po‘stli parenxima hujayralardan iborat bo‘lgan o‘zak egallaydi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The central region of ground tissue in a plant stem, composed predominantly of parenchyma cells and located internal to the vascular tissue. Depending on the species, the pith may be solid, chambered, or may disintegrate during development, resulting in a hollow stem.
etymology_en: From Old English pitha, referring to the soft or spongy internal substance of a plant stem.
example_en: The pith occupies the central part of the stem and is composed of thin-walled parenchyma cells often with larger intercellular spaces than you would find in the cortex. (Inside Stems. The Science of Plants, University of Minnesota)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni oziq elementlari bilan ta’minlash yoki ularning o‘sishini yaxshilash maqsadida tuproqqa, sug‘orish suviga, gidroponik muhitga yoki tegishli usulda o‘simlikka beriladigan tabiiy yoki ishlab chiqarilgan mineral yoxud organik modda.
example_uz: O‘g‘itlar meva daraxtlarida kechadigan bir qancha jarayonlarga ta’sir etadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016, 99-b.)
definition_en: A natural or manufactured mineral or organic substance applied to soil, irrigation water, or a hydroponic medium to supply plants with nutrients or enhance plant growth.
etymology_en: Fertilizer derives from fertilize, based on fertile, ultimately from Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful, productive".
example_en: Fertilizer: a substance that is used to provide nutrients to plants, usually via application to the soil, but also to foliage or through water in rice systems, fertigation, hydroponics or aquaculture operations. (FAO AGROVOC, Fertilizers)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni oziqa elementlari bilan ta’minlash va ularning oziqlanishini yaxshilash maqsadida tuproqqa, o‘sish muhitiga yoki o‘simlikning o‘ziga organik yoki mineral o‘g‘it bermoq. Bog‘dorchilikda o‘g‘itlash o‘simliklarning o‘sishi va rivojlanishi, hosildorligi hamda mahsulot sifatini yaxshilash uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Ko‘chatlarning ildizi yer yuziga yaqin joylashganidan yerni muntazam o‘g‘itlab, begona o‘tlardan tozalash va o‘z vaqtida sug‘orib turish kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To apply fertilizer to soil, a growing medium, or plants in order to supply nutrients required for plant growth and crop production.
etymology_en: From fertile, ultimately from Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful, productive".
example_en: Spring and summer are the best times to fertilize houseplants. (How often should I fertilize houseplants? Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, 2024)

definition_uz: Mineral yoki organik o‘g‘itlarni belgilangan me’yorda berish, taqsimlash, sepish yoki tuproqqa kiritish uchun ishlatiladigan qishloq xo‘jaligi mashinasi, qurilmasi yoki moslamasi.
example_uz: Avtomobillarga turli asbob-uskunalar (purkagich, changitgich, o‘g‘itlagich, quduq qaziydigan mashina va boshqalar)ni o‘rnatib, ulardan maxsus qishloq xo‘jaligi mashinasi sifatida ham foydalanish mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jalik ishlab chiqarishini mexanizatsiyalashtirish, Obidov A. va boshq., 2018)
definition_en: A machine, device, or implement used to apply fertilizer to soil or crops at a controlled rate. Fertilizer applicators may meter and distribute fertilizer by spreading, placement, injection, or other application methods depending on the type of fertilizer and cropping system.
etymology_en: Fertilizer derives from fertilize, ultimately from Latin fertilis, meaning "fruitful"; applicator derives from apply, ultimately from Latin applicare.
example_en: A field study with a commercial spinner disc fertilizer applicator was conducted to compare application uniformity of ash alone and filler/ash blends. (USDA Agricultural Research Service)

definition_uz: Uzum boshini tashkil etuvchi alohida uzum mevasi. G‘ujum naviga qarab yirik yoki mayda, yumaloq, ovalsimon yoki cho‘zinchoq, turli rangli bo‘lishi mumkin. Uning po‘sti, eti va urug‘lari tuzilishi hamda tarkibi navga qarab farqlanadi.
example_uz: G‘ujumlari mayda yumaloq och yashil rangda. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: An individual fruit of a grape cluster. A grape berry consists principally of the skin, pulp, and seeds and varies among cultivars in size, shape, color, composition, flavor, skin characteristics, and seed content.
example_en: In general, grape berries are composed of three main tissue types; these being the skins, the pulp and the seeds. (Deconstructing Wine Grape Cell Walls with Enzymes During Winemaking: New Insights from Glycan Microarray Technology. Gao Y. et al., Molecules, 2019)

definition_uz: Hali ochilmagan, rivojlanish jarayonidagi yosh gul. G‘unchada gulning asosiy qismlari shakllanib boradi va keyingi rivojlanish natijasida u ochilgan gulga aylanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda g‘unchalarning shakllanishi, rivojlanishi va ochilishi o‘simliklarning generativ rivojlanish jarayonining muhim bosqichlaridan hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Olma daraxtlarning gul kurtaklari yozilganida birinchi galda 5–7 bargdan iborat to‘pbarg, so‘ngra esa g‘unchalar paydo bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016, 41-b.)
definition_en: A developing flower that has not yet opened. A flower bud contains immature floral structures that continue to develop until the bud opens into a flower. In horticultural plants, flower bud development is an important part of reproductive development and subsequent flowering and fruit production.
etymology_en: Flower derives through Old French flour from Latin flos, floris; bud is of uncertain origin.
example_en: Fruit trees form flower buds in the season prior to their bloom, usually in summer. (Pruning: Flowering and Flower Buds. University of Maine Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simlikda gul g‘unchalari hosil bo‘lmoq yoki rivojlanmoq; gullashdan oldingi g‘unchalanish bosqichiga kirmoq. G‘unchalanish gul rivojlanishining gullashdan oldingi bosqichlaridan biridir.
example_uz: O‘simlikning Mahsuldor navi may oyining boshida g‘unchalaydi, 5–6 mayda gulga kiradi. (Burchoqdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub fasol o‘simligining Mahsuldor va Rovot navlari morfologik tavsifi va fenologiyasi. Umirzaqova G.E., 2025)
definition_en: To produce or develop buds; in the context of flowering, to produce or develop flower buds before they open into flowers.
example_en: In early spring the trees begin to bud. (Cambridge Academic Content Dictionary. Cambridge University Press)

definition_uz: Pishib yetilmagan meva, rezavor yoki boshqa hosil organiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. G‘o‘r mevada pishish jarayoniga xos rang, ta’m, hid, tekstura va kimyoviy tarkibdagi o‘zgarishlar hali to‘liq yuz bermagan bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Bitta qurt 2–3 ga g‘o‘r mevaga zarar yetkazadi. (O‘simliklarni himoya qilishning uyg‘unlashgan usullari. Anorbaev A.R., Boltaev B.S., Xolliev A.T., 2022)
definition_en: Not yet ripe; used of fruit or other produce that has not yet reached the stage of ripeness associated with its characteristic eating quality. An unripe fruit may not yet have developed the color, flavor, aroma, texture, and compositional characteristics associated with ripening.
example_en: Some fruits are, however, picked at a mature but unripe stage of development so as to allow them to withstand post-harvest handling conditions when shipped over long-distances. (The role of post-harvest management in assuring the quality and safety of horticultural produce. FAO)

definition_uz: Pishib yetilmagan meva. Atama, xususan, o‘rikning hali pishib yetilmagan yosh mevasiga nisbatan qo‘llanadi, shuningdek umumiy ma’noda boshqa mevalarning pishishdan oldingi holatini ham bildirishi mumkin. G‘o‘ra mevaning rangi, qattiqligi, ta’mi va kimyoviy tarkibi meva turi hamda rivojlanish bosqichiga qarab farqlanadi.
example_uz: Kanalar barglarni, bir yillik yosh novdalarni, o‘suv nuqtalarini hamda yosh g‘o‘ra mevalarni so‘rib zarar yetkazadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A fruit that has not yet reached the ripe stage of development. Its physical and chemical characteristics, such as firmness, color, sugar content, and acidity, may differ from those of ripe fruit depending on the species and stage of development.
example_en: Unripe fruit, in contrast, is frequently high in starch and low in sugars. (Fruit and Vegetable Processing. FAO)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasining Prunus turkumiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt yoki buta. Shaftoli asosan iste’mol qilinadigan danakli mevasi uchun yetishtiriladi. Uning ko‘plab madaniy navlari mavjud bo‘lib, mevachilikda muhim danakli meva ekinlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
example_uz: Shaftoli daraxtining o‘ziga xos xususiyati tez hosilga kirishi hamda qisqa umr ko‘rishidir. Shaftoli navlari ikki guruhga bo‘linadi: tukli shaftoli va luchchak (tuksiz) shaftoli. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree or shrub of the genus Prunus in the family Rosaceae, widely cultivated for its edible stone fruits. Numerous cultivars are grown for fruit production in temperate and suitable subtropical regions.
etymology_en: Peach derives through Old French pesche from Latin persica, referring historically to the fruit as Persian.
example_en: The open-center system is suggested for peaches, nectarines, and Japanese-type plums. (Training Fruit Trees. University of Illinois Extension)

definition_uz: Shaftoli daraxtining (Prunus persica (L.) Batsch) iste’mol qilinadigan shirali danakli mevasi. Mevasi odatda yumaloq yoki yassi-yumaloq bo‘lib, po‘sti naviga qarab tukli yoki silliq, eti oq, sariq yoki qizg‘ish tusli bo‘lishi mumkin. Mevaning markazida bitta qattiq danak joylashadi. Shaftoli mevasi yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda sharbat, murabbo, kompot va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Boshqa joylarga yuborish uchun mo‘ljallangan shaftoli qattiqligini hali yo‘qotmagan vaqtda terib olinadi. Shu kezda mevalar to‘la yetilgan va ularga rang kira boshlagan bo‘lishi kerak. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The edible fleshy drupe of the peach tree (Prunus persica (L.) Batsch). Peach fruits vary among cultivars in shape, skin pubescence, flesh color, firmness, flavor, acidity, and soluble solids content. The fruit contains a single hard stone and is consumed fresh or used for processing.
etymology_en: Peach derives through Old French pesche from Late Latin persica, referring to the Persian fruit; fruit derives from Latin fructus.
example_en: Soluble solids content is an important element of peach fruit quality, and it can be a suitable marker of ripeness. (Evaluation of the Fruit Quality and Phytochemical Compounds in Peach and Nectarine Cultivars, 2023)

definition_uz: Shaftoli daraxtlari (Prunus persica (L.) Batsch) ekilgan va asosan shaftoli mevasi yetishtirish uchun foydalaniladigan bog‘ yoki maydon. Shaftolizorni barpo etish va parvarishlashda joy va nav tanlash, ekish, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, butash, shakl berish hamda o‘simliklarni himoya qilish tadbirlari muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Shaftolizorlar barpo qilish uchun joy tanlashda ushbu o‘simlikning issiqsevarligini hisobga olish kerak. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: An orchard planted and managed with peach trees (Prunus persica) primarily for fruit production.
example_en: A peach orchard can be a profitable enterprise or a financial failure, depending to a large extent on how well the grower has planned ahead in choosing the site and cultivars, and prepared for the essential cultural operations involved. (Planting and Early Care of the Peach Orchard. Carroll B., Oklahoma State University Extension, 2017)

definition_uz: Danagi olib tashlangan shaftoli mevasini quritish orqali tayyorlanadigan quritilgan meva mahsuloti. Quritish jarayonida mevaning namligi sezilarli darajada kamayadi va mahsulotning saqlanish muddati uzayadi.
example_uz: Shaftoli albatta naviga qarab quraga sifatida quritiladi. Qoqi qilish texnologiyasi quyidagilardan iborat: uzish, tashish, saqlash, saralash, kalibrlash, yuvish, to‘g‘rash, po‘stini ajratish, tukli navlarni yuvish, blanshirlash, dudlash, quritish, namini qochirish, joylash va saqlash. (Meva-sabzavotchilikda innovatsion texnologiyalar. Shaumarov X.B., 2021)
definition_en: A dried fruit product consisting of peach fruit from which a substantial portion of its moisture has been removed, typically after the fruit has been halved and pitted.
etymology_en: Dried is the past participle of dry; peach derives through Old French pesche from Late Latin persica.
example_en: Dried peaches are the halved and pitted fruit of the peach tree (Prunus persica) from which the greater portion of moisture has been removed. (Dried Peaches Grades and Standards. USDA Agricultural Marketing Service)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxt, tok yoki manzarali o‘simlikning shox-shabbasi, asosiy skeleti va o‘sish yo‘nalishini muayyan shakl yoki tizimga keltirish jarayoni. Shakl berishda kesish, shoxlarni egish, bog‘lash, tirgak yoki shox ajratgichlardan foydalanish kabi usullar qo‘llanadi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning shox-shabbasiga bir xil darajada yorug‘lik tushmaydi, daraxtlarning ko‘proq yorug‘lik bilan ta’minlanishi shox-shabbalarini kesish va shakl berish usullariga bog‘liq. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The horticultural practice of directing plant growth to develop a desired shape, form, and structural framework. In fruit trees and other horticultural plants, training may involve pruning, bending, tying, spreading, or otherwise positioning branches and shoots.
etymology_en: Training derives from train, ultimately from Old French trainer, meaning "to draw, drag".
example_en: Training and pruning newly-planted deciduous fruit trees is one of the most important steps in developing trees with a strong framework (scaffold branches). (Training and Pruning Newly Planted Deciduous Fruit Trees. DeGomez T., University of Arizona Cooperative Extension, 2015)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxt, tok yoki boshqa o‘simlikning shox-shabbasi, asosiy skeleti va o‘sish yo‘nalishini muayyan shakl yoki tizimda rivojlantirmoq. Bunda shoxlarni kesish, egish, bog‘lash, yoyish yoki tayanchga yo‘naltirish kabi agrotexnik usullardan foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Kelasi yili erta ko‘klamda payvand qilingan joyning ustki qismi kesib tashlanadi, kurtakdan ko‘kargan novdaga shakl beriladi. (Ko‘chatzor. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: To direct and manipulate the growth of a tree, vine, or other plant in order to develop a desired form or structural framework, using techniques such as pruning, bending, tying, spreading, or supporting shoots and branches.
etymology_en: Train derives from Old French trainer, ultimately referring to drawing or dragging.
example_en: Continue to train the leader to the stake and eliminate any oversized branches that develop. (Growing Fruit: Training and Pruning Young Apple and Pear Trees. University of New Hampshire Extension)

definition_uz: Meva, rezavor meva yoki sabzavotning iste’mol qilinadigan qismlaridan tegishli texnologik usullar orqali olinadigan suyuq oziq-ovqat mahsuloti. Meva sharbati odatda sog‘lom va tegishli darajada yetilgan mevalardan olinadi hamda olingan mevaning asosiy fizik, kimyoviy, organoleptik va oziqaviy xususiyatlarini saqlaydi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha sharbat — "ichimlik" ma’nosidagi so‘zdan.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston sharoitida mevalardan pyure, pavidlo, murabbo, djem, uzumlardan esa sharbat, shinni, kompot, pastila va sukatalar tayyorlanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A liquid food product obtained from the edible parts of fruits, berries, or vegetables by suitable processing methods. Fruit juice is an unfermented but fermentable liquid obtained from sound, appropriately mature fruit and retains the essential characteristics of the fruit from which it is obtained.
etymology_en: Juice derives from Old French jus, ultimately from Latin jus, meaning "juice, liquid".
example_en: Fruit juice is the unfermented but fermentable liquid obtained from the edible part of sound, appropriately mature and fresh fruit or of fruit maintained in sound condition by suitable means. (Codex Alimentarius, General Standard for Fruit Juices and Nectars, CXS 247-2005)

definition_uz: Sarvdoshlar (Cupressaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil ignabargli daraxt yoki buta. Shox-shabbasi zich, novdalari yassi tizimda joylashgan, barglari mayda va tangachasimon. Manzarali ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda bog‘lar, parklar, guruhli ekinlar va tirik devorlar yaratishda qo‘llaniladi. Biota orientalis (L.) Endl. va Thuja orientalis L. uning ilmiy sinonimlaridir.
etymology_uz: Platycladus yunoncha platys — "keng, yassi" va klados — "shox" so‘zlaridan; orientalis lotincha "sharqiy" ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Qurg‘oqchilik yer maydonlariga chidamli bo‘lgan sharq biotasining vatani — Xitoyning shimoliy qismi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: An evergreen coniferous tree or shrub of the family Cupressaceae, accepted botanically as Platycladus orientalis (L.) Franco and widely cultivated as an ornamental plant in gardens and landscapes.
etymology_en: Arborvitae derives from Latin arbor vitae, meaning "tree of life"; orientalis is Latin for "eastern".
example_en: Oriental arborvitae grows moderately fast in full sun or very light shade and tolerates drought well once established. (Platycladus orientalis: Oriental Arborvitae. Gilman E.F., Watson D.G., Klein R.W., Koeser A.K., Hilbert D.R., McLean D.C., UF/IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Chinordoshlar (Platanaceae) oilasiga mansub yirik, barg to‘kuvchi va uzoq umr ko‘ruvchi daraxt turi. Shox-shabbasi keng yoyilgan, barglari yirik va chuqur panjasimon bo‘lingan. Sharq chinori ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda, jumladan park, xiyobon va boshqa landshaftlarda soya beruvchi manzarali daraxt sifatida keng o‘stiriladi.
example_uz: Sharq chinori soya beruvchi daraxt sifatida shahar va qishloqlarni ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda uzoq o‘tmishdan boshlab keng foydalanib kelingan. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A large, long-lived deciduous tree of the family Platanaceae, characterized by a spreading crown, deeply palmately lobed leaves, and flaking bark. It is widely cultivated in temperate regions as an ornamental and shade tree.
etymology_en: Plane derives from Greek platanos; the Latin specific epithet orientalis means "eastern".
example_en: Oriental planes are very hardy and long-lived trees, growing up to 30 metres tall. They are often grown in temperate regions, as they are ideal for providing shade. (Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Meet Kew's Old Lions)

definition_uz: Uzumchilikda uzum g‘ujumlari umumiy band va uning tarmoqlarida joylashib hosil qiladigan uzum boshi. Botanika terminologiyasida shingil, shuningdek, asosiy o‘q bo‘ylab gulbandli gullar joylashgan to‘pgul turini bildiradi.
example_uz: Shingil (shoda) — bitta gulpoya uchida yaqinlashgan sari qisqarib boradigan, bandli gullardan tashkil topgan to‘pgul. Masalan, uzum shingili. (Botanika. Mustafayev S.M., Ahmedov O‘.A., Mustafayeva M.S. va boshq., 2012)
definition_en: A group of grape berries borne together on a branched rachis. Grape clusters vary in architecture, size, berry number, shape, and compactness, which are important characteristics in viticulture and grapevine cultivar evaluation.
example_en: Grape cluster compactness is a key trait that influences fruit quality, yield, and disease susceptibility. (Leveraging foundation models to dissect the genetic basis of cluster compactness and yield in grapevine. Sharma S. et al., Scientific Reports, 2025)

definition_uz: Tut, uzum va boshqa shakarli mevalarning shirasini qaynatish yoki bug‘latish yo‘li bilan quyuqlashtirib tayyorlanadigan shirin oziq-ovqat mahsuloti.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston sharoitida mevalardan pyure, pavidlo, murabbo, djem, uzumlardan esa sharbat, shinni, kompot, pastila va sukatalar tayyorlanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A thick, sweet food product obtained by concentrating the juice of sugar-rich fruits, such as grapes or mulberries, usually by heating or evaporation.
etymology_en: Molasses derives through Portuguese melaço from Late Latin mellaceum, ultimately related to Latin mel, meaning "honey".
example_en: Fruit molasses, known as “Pekmez” in Türkiye, is a traditionally produced and widely consumed food product in Anatolia. (Nutritional Profile and Functional Characteristics of Various Types of Traditionally Produced PEKMEZ—Part I. Dilek et al., 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simlik tanasida, xususan uning o‘tkazuvchi to‘qimalarida mavjud bo‘ladigan yoki harakatlanadigan suyuqlik. Ksilema shirasi asosan suv va mineral moddalarni, floema shirasi esa qandlar, aminokislotalar va boshqa erigan moddalarni tashishda ishtirok etadi.
etymology_uz: Fors-tojikcha shīra — "sharbat, o‘simlik suvi".
example_uz: Yangi o‘sayotgan novda kesilsa, suyuqlik ajraladi, bu modda o‘simlik shirasi bo‘lib, u mineral va organik moddalar eritmasi ekanligi ko‘rinadi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: The fluid present in or transported through plant vascular tissues. Xylem sap consists mainly of water, mineral nutrients, and other dissolved substances, whereas phloem sap is rich in sugars and also contains minerals, amino acids, plant growth regulators, and other solutes.
example_en: Phloem sap is an aqueous solution that contains up to 30 percent sugar, minerals, amino acids, and plant growth regulators. (Biology. OpenStax, 2016)

definition_uz: Yarim qattiqqanotlilar (Hemiptera) turkumining Sternorrhyncha kenja turkumiga mansub Aphidoidea katta oilasiga kiruvchi mayda, o‘simlik shirasi bilan oziqlanuvchi hasharotlar guruhi. Shiralar o‘simliklarning barg, novda, kurtak va boshqa yosh qismlaridan shira so‘rib oziqlanadi, o‘simlikni zaiflashtirishi va deformatsiyalashi, shirin ajratma (honeydew) chiqarishi hamda ko‘plab o‘simlik viruslarini tarqatishi mumkin.
example_uz: Shiralar ozuqa o‘simligi tanasidagi to‘qima suyuqligi hisobiga yashaydi. (Shiralarda (Homoptera, Aphidoidea) “parazit-xo‘jayin” munosabatlar tizimi haqida. Zokirova G.M., Gʻaniyev K.H., Asqaraliyeva S.A., Hamidov Sh.T., 2023)
definition_en: Small sap-feeding insects belonging to the superfamily Aphidoidea within the order Hemiptera. Aphids feed on plant sap, often produce honeydew, and many species are important vectors of plant viruses.
etymology_en: Aphid derives from Modern Latin Aphis.
example_en: Aphids are small soft-bodied insects, usually 1-10 mm in length, with pear-shaped bodies and long antennae. (SuperFamily Aphidoidea. NC State University, General Entomology)

definition_uz: Tarkibida shirasi bor yoki shirasi ko‘p bo‘lgan meva yoxud boshqa o‘simlik organiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Mevachilikda shiralilik meva etining muhim sifat belgilaridan biri bo‘lib, uning naviga, pishganlik darajasiga va yetishtirish sharoitiga bog‘liq holda farqlanadi.
example_uz: Ranggi och, to‘q, sariq, yashil, mevasining eti suvli, shirali, to‘q sariq, och sariq, tarkibida 4–6% qand bor. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: Containing a large amount of juice; used especially of fruits and fruit flesh that contain abundant juice.
example_en: The fruit is a near spherical coenocarp drupe, dark violet when ripe, 5-8 mm in length and 4-5 mm in diameter, with a fleshy and very juicy pulp. (Cambridge English Corpus)

definition_uz: Karamdoshlar (Brassicaceae) oilasiga mansub, ildizmevasi va barglari uchun yetishtiriladigan sabzavot ekini. Odatda ikki yillik o‘simlik bo‘lib, birinchi yili etli ildizmeva va barglar, keyingi reproduktiv bosqichda esa gul va urug‘ hosil qiladi. Ildizmevasi oziq-ovqat sifatida, yosh barglari esa ko‘kat sifatida iste’mol qilinishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Forscha shalgham (شلغم) — "sholg‘om, ildizmevali sabzavot".
example_uz: Fosforli o‘g‘itlarni pomidor, baqlajon, qalampir, sholg‘om, rediska ko‘p talab qiladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y. va boshq., 2008)
definition_en: A cool-season vegetable crop of the family Brassicaceae, cultivated primarily for its swollen edible storage root and also for its edible young leaves.
example_en: Turnips are relatively fast-maturing crops that produce both edible greens and large edible roots. (Growing Turnips and Rutabagas in the Home Garden. Iowa State University Extension and Outreach)

definition_uz: Tutdoshlar (Moraceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi mevali daraxt turi. Mevalari pishganda to‘q qizil-binafsha yoki deyarli qora rangga kiradi, shirali va o‘ziga xos nordon-shirin ta’mga ega. Mevalari yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi hamda sharbat, murabbo, marmelad va boshqa qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Respublikamizda 2 ta turi keng tarqalgan. Shotut (Morus nigra), Oq tut yoki balx tut (Morus alba). (O‘simliklar sistematikasi (Yuksak o‘simliklar). Haydarov X.Q., Tashpulatov Y.Sh., Jalov X.X., Mukumov I.U., 2019)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree of the family Moraceae, cultivated for its edible dark purplish-red to black fruits. The fruits have a distinctive sweet-acid flavor and are consumed fresh or processed into juices, jams, marmalades, and other food products.
etymology_en: Mulberry derives from Middle English mulbery; the specific epithet nigra is Latin for "black".
example_en: In Türkiye, black mulberry is consumed fresh and processed into black mulberry juices, black mulberry jam, black mulberry marmalade, black mulberry yogurt, black mulberry wine, black mulberry galette, and fresh fruit cakes. (Black mulberry (Morus nigra L.) fruits: As a medicinal plant rich in human health-promoting compounds, 2023)

definition_uz: Daraxt yoki butaning tanasi yoxud yirikroq shoxidan o‘sib chiqadigan yog‘ochlashgan yon qismi. Shoxlar barg, kurtak, gul va mevalarni tutib turadi hamda daraxt shox-shabbasining strukturaviy qismlarini hosil qiladi. Bog‘dorchilikda shoxlarning o‘sishi, joylashuvi va burchagi daraxtga shakl berish, butash va hosildorlikni boshqarishda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
example_uz: Ona shoxlarida ko‘p yillik shoxlar bilan bir yillik novdalar joylashadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A woody lateral structure arising from the trunk or from a larger branch of a tree or shrub. Branches support leaves, buds, flowers, and fruits and form part of the structural framework of the plant canopy.
etymology_en: From Old French branche, ultimately from Late Latin branca.
example_en: At planting, if the tree has branches, choose four to six of them, starting about 18 to 24 inches above the ground and spaced as equally as possible around the tree, to form the first tier of scaffold branches. (Growing Stone Fruits in the Home Garden. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning asosiy poyasi, tanasi yoki mavjud shoxlaridan yon shoxlar hosil qilmoq, shox chiqarib rivojlanmoq. Shoxlanish o‘simlikning arxitekturasi, shox-shabba tuzilishi va yorug‘likdan foydalanishiga ta’sir etadi.
example_uz: Ildizlar uzunasiga 8–10 sm gacha o‘sib shoxlay boshlaydi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To produce or develop lateral branches from a main stem, trunk, or existing branch.
example_en: When we pinch just the tippy tops of the stems, we are forcing the plant to send signals to produce multiple lateral meristems that will branch out. (Prune Blooms and Pinch Me Please! Eason H.W., UF/IFAS Extension, 2021)

definition_uz: Shoxlari mavjud bo‘lgan yoki shoxlar hosil qilgan o‘simlik, uning poyasi yoxud boshqa qismiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Ko‘p shoxli o‘simliklarda asosiy poya yoki tanadan ko‘plab yon shoxlar rivojlanadi.
example_uz: Anor bo‘yi 2 m dan 5 m gacha bo‘lgan ko‘p shoxli kichikroq daraxt yoki buta hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: Having branches or divided into branches; in botany, used to describe a plant, stem, or other structure that bears lateral branches.
example_en: “A stem may be unbranched, like that of a palm tree, or it may be highly branched, like that of a magnolia tree.” (General Biology. Chapter 30.2: Stems. University of Central Florida, adapted from OpenStax Biology)

definition_uz: Yerni plug yoki boshqa haydash qurollari yordamida haydab, tuproq qatlamini ag‘darish va yumshatish orqali ekishga tayyorlamoq. Shudgor qilish tuproqning havo va suv rejimini yaxshilash, o‘simlik qoldiqlari hamda o‘g‘itlarni tuproqqa aralashtirish va begona o‘tlarni nazorat qilish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Kuzda shudgor qilingan yerlar bahorda boronalanadi, agar tuproq qattiq zichlanib qolgan bo‘lsa, chizellanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: To turn and loosen soil with a plow in preparation for planting or as part of soil cultivation.
example_en: The steps to obtaining a good seedbed include: 1) plowing the soil to 5 inches (12.7 centimeters) in depth. (Establishment and Renovation. Forage Information System, Oregon State University)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt yoki buta. Barglari tuxumsimon, chetlari tishli; bahorda oq, xushbo‘y gullari osilib turuvchi shingilsimon to‘pgullarda ochiladi. Mevalari mayda, pishganda qora rangli bo‘ladi. Manzarali daraxt sifatida ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda o‘stiriladi.
example_uz: Soliter o‘tkazmalar uchun butalar, odatda, shoxsiz poya shaklida foydalaniladi (oddiy siren, shumurt (cheremuxa), qor mevasi va boshqalar). (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: A deciduous tree or shrub of the family Rosaceae, bearing fragrant white flowers in pendulous racemes followed by small black fruits. It is grown as an ornamental tree in landscape plantings.
example_en: Prunus padus, commonly called European birdcherry, is a deciduous ornamental cherry tree that typically grows 20–40 feet tall with a rounded crown. (Missouri Botanical Garden, Plant Finder, Prunus padus)
synonyms_en: European bird cherry; Common bird cherry

definition_uz: Chang donasi urug‘chi tumshuqchasida unib chiqqandan so‘ng hosil bo‘ladigan ingichka naychasimon tuzilma. Chang naychasi urug‘chining ustunchasi bo‘ylab urug‘kurtak tomon o‘sib, erkak gametalar (spermiylar)ni urug‘lanish joyiga yetkazadi va urug‘lanish jarayonida muhim vazifani bajaradi.
example_uz: Urug‘lanish jarayonidan avval urug‘chi tumshuqchasiga tushgan chang una boshlaydi, ya’ni bo‘rtib chang naychasini hosil qiladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: A tubular outgrowth formed when a pollen grain germinates on a compatible stigma. The pollen tube grows through the style toward the ovule and provides a pathway for the male gametes (sperm cells) to reach the female gametophyte for fertilization.
example_en: Once the pollen grains have germinated, the pollen tubes grow down the style into an ovule where fertilization of the egg cell (to form a zygote) and polar nuclei of the egg sac (to form the endosperm) occur. (The Biology of Malus domestica Borkh. (Apple). Canadian Food Inspection Agency, 2013)

definition_uz: Changchining changchi ipi uchida joylashgan, gul changi hosil qiluvchi qismi. Changdon odatda ikki bo‘lakdan tashkil topadi va unda chang donalari rivojlanadigan mikrosporangiylar (chang xaltachalari) joylashadi. Yetilganda changdon ochilib, chang donalarini tashqariga chiqaradi.
example_uz: Changchi eng muhim organ bo‘lib, qo‘shaloq xaltacha — changdonlardan, urug‘chi urug‘ kurtakni o‘z ichiga olgan tugunchadan iborat. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The pollen-producing part of a stamen, usually borne at the tip of the filament and containing microsporangia in which pollen grains develop.
etymology_en: From Greek anthēros, meaning "flowery", through New Latin anthera.
example_en: “The androecium has stamens with anthers that contain the microsporangia.” (Biology 2e. Clark M.A., Douglas M., Choi J., OpenStax, 2018)

definition_uz: Boshqa navni changlantirish uchun biologik jihatdan mos va hayotchan gul changi beradigan o‘simlik yoki nav. Bog‘dorchilikda changlatuvchi navning gullash davri asosiy nav bilan mos kelishi va uning changi biologik jihatdan mos bo‘lishi lozim.
example_uz: Har qaysi nav meva daraxti 3–10 gektarli alohida maydonlarga o‘tqaziladi va 6–8–10 qator asosiy nav orasiga 1–2 qator changlatuvchi nav ekiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A plant or cultivar that provides compatible, viable pollen for another plant or cultivar. In horticulture, a pollinizer is planted to provide an adequate source of compatible pollen, particularly for self-incompatible fruit cultivars.
etymology_en: Derived from pollinize + -er; pollinize ultimately derives from Latin pollen.
example_en: For maximum pollen effectiveness, fully compatible pollinizers should be provided to pollinate commercial cultivars of interest. (Cross-compatibility of apple cultivars and pollinizers. Sheick R., Serra S., Musacchi S., Washington State University Tree Fruit, 2019)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Gul changini changdondan urug‘chi tumshuqchasiga ko‘chirmoq; gulni chang bilan ta’minlab, changlanish jarayonini yuzaga keltirmoq.
example_uz: Urug‘li meva ekinlarida bitta gul changi bilan 4–8 ta ona o‘simlik gullarini changlash mumkin. (Meva va rezavor meva ekinlari seleksiyasi va navshunosligi. Ergashev I., 2007)
definition_en: To transfer pollen to the stigma of a flower, thereby bringing about pollination.
etymology_en: From Latin pollen, meaning "fine flour, dust", with the verbal suffix -ate.
example_en: Many fruit trees have self-incompatible flowers, meaning that they need another different cultivar of the same fruit that flowers at the same time growing nearby to pollinate their flowers. (Royal Horticultural Society, Fruit pollination)

definition_uz: Gul changining changdondan urug‘chi tumshuqchasiga ko‘chish jarayoni. Changlanish o‘simliklarning jinsiy ko‘payishidagi muhim bosqich bo‘lib, urug‘lanishdan oldin sodir bo‘ladi va ko‘plab mevali ekinlarda meva tugishi hamda urug‘ hosil bo‘lishi uchun zarur.
example_uz: Gullarning g‘o‘raga aylanishi ularning normal sharoitda changlanishiga bog‘liq. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma, either within the same flower or between flowers. Pollination precedes fertilization and is essential for fruit set and seed development in many horticultural crops.
etymology_en: Derived from pollinate + -ion; ultimately from Latin pollen, meaning "fine flour, dust".
example_en: Pollination is the transfer of pollen from the male part (anther) of a flower to the female part (pistil) of the same or another flower of the same sort. (Pollination Requirements for Various Fruits and Nuts. Crassweller R., Penn State Extension, updated 2024)

definition_uz: Gulning erkak generativ organi bo‘lib, changchi ipi va changdondan tashkil topadi. Changdon gul changini hosil qiladi, changchi ipi esa uni gul ichida tutib turadi.
example_uz: Olma, nok, olchaning gullari ikki jinsli, ularda urug‘chi hamda changchi organi bo‘ladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: The male reproductive organ of a flower, typically consisting of a filament and an anther.
etymology_en: From Latin stamen — “thread, warp”.
example_en: "The stamen is the male reproductive organ. Each stamen consists of an anther, containing one to several pollen-producing chambers, and a long, supporting stalk called the filament." (Extension Gardener Handbook: Botany. NC State Extension)

definition_uz: O‘zbekistonda yetishtiriladigan xo‘raki uzum navlaridan biri. Shingillari konussimon, mevalari qora rangli, yumaloq yoki ovalsimon va mumsimon g‘ubor bilan qoplangan. Eti sersuv, po‘sti nisbatan qalin bo‘lib, xo‘raki sifatlari bilan qadrlanadi.
example_uz: Tokning ba’zi navlari — Kattakurg‘on, Nimrang, Charos va boshqalarning guli urg‘ochi tipda bo‘ladi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: A table grape cultivar grown in Uzbekistan, producing dark-coloured berries and valued for fresh consumption.
example_en: "Grape varieties with different disease resistance - Toifi, Charos, Black Chilgi, Huseini, Mercedes and Rizamat ota - were selected as the object." (Sirdaryo viloyati hududida tok o‘simliklarida tarqalgan kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi mikroorganizmlar tahlili. Turabekova D.B., Salomova S.S., Xo‘jamshukurov N.A., 2022)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Cultivar Science

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki o‘simlik individi, navi, liniyasi yoki boshqa seleksion shaklini jinsiy yo‘l bilan chatishtirib, ota-ona shakllarining irsiy belgilarini birlashtirgan duragay avlod olmoq.
example_uz: Bu o‘simlikning gullari oq ikki irqi o‘zaro chatishtirilganda, olingan F₁ duragay o‘simliklarning gullari qizil rangda bo‘lgan. (Genetika va seleksiya asoslari, Musayev D.A. va boshq., 2012)
definition_en: To breed or pollinate two genetically different plants in order to produce hybrid offspring combining genetic material and traits from both parents.
etymology_en: From Old French croiz, ultimately from Latin crux, meaning "cross".
example_en: By crossing selected plants with different but desirable features, they produce a plant that has the best features of both parents. (Royal Horticultural Society, F1 Hybrids)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Genetik jihatdan farqlanuvchi ikki o‘simlik individi, navi, liniyasi yoki turini o‘zaro changlatish orqali yangi irsiy kombinatsiyaga ega avlod olishga qaratilgan seleksiya jarayoni. Chatishtirish kerakli belgilarni bir avlodda birlashtirish, genetik xilma-xillik yaratish va yangi seleksion material olishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Erkin changlantirish yo‘li bilan meva o‘simliklari urug‘idan olingan urug‘ ko‘chatlar hamda har xil nav yoki turga mansub ikki xil o‘simlikni sun’iy chatishtirish natijasida olingan urug‘dan o‘stirilgan duragay urug‘ ko‘chatlar bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The process of crossing two genetically different plant individuals, cultivars, lines, or species to produce offspring with new combinations of inherited traits. Crossing is used in plant breeding to combine desirable traits, create genetic variation, and develop new breeding material.
example_en: The hybridization, or crossing, mimics cross pollination that occurs in nature - except that the breeders specifically control the parents being crossed. (Fruit Breeding. University of Minnesota Landscape Arboretum)
field_en: Plant Breeding and Genetics → Plant Breeding

definition_uz: Tokchilikda yashil operatsiyalardan biri bo‘lib, haddan tashqari o‘sayotgan tok novdalarining uchki qismini qisqartirish yoki kesib tashlash usuli. Chekanka vegetativ o‘sishni cheklash, shox-shabbaning haddan tashqari zichlashishini kamaytirish, yorug‘lik va havo almashinuvini yaxshilash hamda tokzor parvarishini yengillashtirish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha чеканка atamasidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Odatdagi chekanka uzum naviga qarab, iyul oxiri – avgust boshida qilinadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A grapevine canopy-management practice involving the removal or shortening of the growing tips of excessively long shoots to control vegetative growth and reduce canopy shading.
example_en: Topping of Cabernet Sauvignon reduced variability of shoot Diameter and increased lateral shoot growth. (Effect of Tipping and Topping on Shoot Uniformity: Preliminary Results on Single Cordon Trained Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. Pisciotta A. et al., 2007)

definition_uz: Erikadoshlar (Ericaceae) oilasiga mansub past bo‘yli ko‘p yillik butacha. Mevalari ko‘k-qora rangli, iste’mol qilinadigan rezavor mevalar bo‘lib, oziq-ovqat va qayta ishlashda foydalaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha черника so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Chernika bargi tarkibida 20% gacha tanidlar (pirokatexin guruhi), 1,6% arbutin va 1% mirtilin glikozidlar, 1% gidroxinon, flavonoidlar, 250 mg% vitamin C, triterpen, saponinlar va boshqa moddalar bor. (Rezavor mevachilik. Normuratov I.T., Janakova D.U., Berdiev E.T., 2020)
definition_en: A low-growing perennial subshrub of the family Ericaceae that produces edible blue-black berries. It is a wild berry species native across much of temperate Eurasia and other parts of the Northern Hemisphere.
example_en: Bilberry (Vaccinium myrtillus) is a commercially important wild berry species, which accumulates high amounts of polyphenols, particularly anthocyanins, in the skin and flesh. (Dare A.P. et al., Food Chemistry, 2022)

definition_uz: Ra’nodoshlar (Rosaceae) oilasiga mansub daraxt va butalar turkumi. Turkum vakillari asosan Shimoliy yarimsharning mo‘tadil hududlarida tarqalgan. Ko‘plab turlari manzarali gullari, barglari va rangdor mevalari tufayli bog‘ va landshaftlarda o‘stiriladi.
example_uz: Chetan (Sorbus) turkumi. Bu turkumga daraxtlar kiradi. Ularning shox-shabbasi yoyiq, shoxlari va tanasining po‘stlog‘i silliq, barglari yonbargchali, navbat bilan joylashadi, kuzda to‘kilib ketadi. (Dendrologiya. Qayimov A.Q., Berdiyev E.T., 2012)
definition_en: A common name for trees and shrubs of the genus Sorbus in the family Rosaceae. Members of the genus occur mainly in temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere, and many species are cultivated for their ornamental flowers, foliage, and fruits.
etymology_en: Rowan is a word of Germanic origin; Sorbus is the Latin botanical genus name.
example_en: Varying from tiny mountain shrubs to tall trees, there is a rowan suitable for every garden. (The Genus Sorbus: Mountain Ash and Other Rowans. McAllister H.A., Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, 2005)

definition_uz: Jiydadoshlar (Rhamnaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi, ko‘pincha tikanli mevali daraxt yoki buta. Barglari oddiy, yaltiroq va navbat bilan joylashgan. Mevasi yumaloq yoki cho‘zinchoq danakli meva bo‘lib, pishishi davomida yashil rangdan qizg‘ish-jigarrang yoki to‘q rangga o‘tadi. Mevalari yangi holda iste’mol qilinadi, quritiladi va qayta ishlanadi. O‘simlik issiq va nisbatan qurg‘oqchil sharoitlarga yaxshi moslashgan.
example_uz: Chilonjiyda shoxlari tirsakli bo‘lib, 10–15 yilgacha shoxlarining egilgan joylarida tikanlari bo‘lib, ular keyinchalik yo‘qolib ketadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A deciduous fruit tree or shrub of the family Rhamnaceae, often with thorny branches and cultivated for its edible fruits. The fruits mature from green to reddish-brown and may be consumed fresh, dried, or processed. Jujube is well adapted to warm and relatively dry climates.
etymology_en: Jujube derives through French jujube from Latin zizyphum, ultimately from Greek zizyphon.
example_en: Jujube (Ziziphus jujuba Mill), also called chinese date, red date, or tsao (zao), is native to China. (Past, Present, and Future of Jujubes—Chinese Dates in the United States. Yao S., 2013)
synonyms_en: Chinese jujube; Chinese date; Red date; Common jujube

definition_uz: O‘simlikning yosh novdasi uchidagi o‘sish nuqtasini, odatda barmoq bilan yoki asbob yordamida olib tashlamoq. Chilpish novdaning bo‘yiga o‘sishini cheklash, apikal dominantlikni kamaytirish va yon novdalarning rivojlanishini rag‘batlantirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladigan agrotexnik tadbirdir.
example_uz: Bu novda kech kuzgacha yaxshi chiniqib yetilishi uchun uning uchi chilpib qo‘yilishi zarurdir. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To remove the growing tip of a plant, usually with the finger and thumb, in order to restrict apical growth and encourage the development of side shoots.
example_en: In early summer, pinch out the shoot tips after five leaves. (Royal Horticultural Society, Figs: pruning and training)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning yosh novdasi uchidagi o‘sish nuqtasini olib tashlashdan iborat agrotexnik tadbir. Tokchilikda chilpish novdalarning kuchli o‘sishini vaqtincha cheklash, oziq moddalar va assimilatlarning generativ organlarga yo‘nalishini yaxshilash hamda yon novdalarning rivojlanishini boshqarish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi. Gullash oldidan yoki gullash davrida bajarilganda ayrim sharoitlarda meva tugishiga ijobiy ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
example_uz: Yozning boshlarida yashil novdalarning (70–80 sm uzunlikka yetganda) uchini chilpish ikkilamchi novdalarning o‘sishiga yordam beradi. (Uzum yetishtirish va mayiz quritishning zamonaviy texnologiyasi. Abdullayev R.M. va boshq., 2013)
definition_en: A horticultural practice involving the removal of the growing tip of a young shoot. In grapevines, shoot pinching is used to temporarily restrict shoot elongation and modify the balance between vegetative and reproductive growth.
example_en: Simultaneously, lateral shoots were managed by pinching, with only a single leaf retained on each. (Metabolomic and Transcriptomic Analysis Reveal the Impact of Delayed Harvest on the Aroma Profile of ‘Shine Muscat’ Grapes, Horticulturae, 2026)

definition_uz: Faqat urug‘chi tugunchasidan rivojlanadigan meva. Chin mevada meva devori — perikarp tuguncha devoridan hosil bo‘ladi, gulning boshqa qismlari esa mevaning hosil bo‘lishida ishtirok etmaydi.
example_uz: Chin meva — bu mevani hosil qilishda faqat urug‘chi tugunchaning o‘zi ishtirok etadi (o‘rik, shaftoli, gilos mevalari). (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Hamdamov I.H., Hamdamova E.I., Suvonova G.A., Begmatova M.X., 2017)
definition_en: A fruit that develops solely from the ovary of a flower, without the participation of accessory floral tissues. The pericarp of a true fruit develops from the ovary wall.
example_en: A fruit developed solely from the ovary and its contents is known as a true fruit. (Fruit Types, Department of Botany, Serampore College)

definition_uz: Chinniguldoshlar (Caryophyllaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik, ikki yillik va ko‘p yillik o‘tlar hamda ayrim butachasimon o‘simliklarni o‘z ichiga oluvchi turkum. Ko‘plab vakillari chiroyli va ko‘pincha xushbo‘y gullari tufayli manzarali bog‘dorchilikda yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Ikki yillik o‘simliklar gulzorlarni bahorgi bezashda ishlatiladi: chinnigul, nasperstyanka, o‘rta qo‘ng‘iroqgul kabilar. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A genus of mostly perennial and some annual or biennial herbs or subshrubs in the family Caryophyllaceae. Many species and cultivars are grown in ornamental horticulture for their showy and often fragrant flowers.
etymology_en: Dianthus derives from Greek dios and anthos, literally referring to a divine or god-associated flower.
example_en: Dianthus consists of mostly perennial and a few annual or biennial herbs or shrubs with oblong to ovate or linear and grass-like leaves. (Fassou G. et al., PhytoKeys, 2022)

definition_uz: O‘sish jarayonida boshqa o‘simliklar yoki sun’iy konstruksiyalardan tayanch sifatida foydalanib yuqoriga ko‘tariladigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Ular poyasining chirmashishi, mo‘ylovlari, barg yoki barg bandlari, havo ildizlari va boshqa moslanishlar yordamida tayanchga tirmashib yoki yopishib o‘sishi mumkin. Chirmashib o‘suvchilar orasida bir yillik va ko‘p yillik o‘tsimon o‘simliklar hamda yog‘ochlashgan lianalar mavjud. Manzarali bog‘dorchilikda ular devor, panjara, pergola va arkalarning vertikal ko‘kalamzorlashtirilishida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Chirmashib o‘suvchilar — vertikal ko‘kalamzorlashtirish uchun devorlar, ayvonlar, ishkomlar, ravoqlar, piramidalar, ustunlar, naqshinkor panjaralar va hokazolarda keng foydalaniladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalanov M., 2014)
definition_en: Plants that use other plants or artificial structures for support as they grow upwards. They may climb by twining stems, tendrils, leaf petioles, aerial roots, adhesive pads, or other specialized structures. Climbing plants include annual and perennial herbaceous climbers as well as woody climbers.
example_en: Climbing plants that cover building walls (indirect green façades) are a nature-based solution for urban greening in dense urban areas. (Nature-Based Solutions, 2023)

definition_uz: Araliyadoshlar (Araliaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil yog‘ochlashgan chirmashuvchi o‘simliklar turkumi. Hedera vakillari poyasida hosil bo‘ladigan havo ildizchalari yordamida daraxtlar, devorlar va boshqa tayanchlarga yopishib o‘sadi. Ayrim turlari manzarali bog‘dorchilikda chirmashuvchi va yer qoplovchi o‘simlik sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: Hedera helix L. — oddiy chirmovuq. Bo‘yi 1 metrdan 30 metrgacha boradi. Ko‘p yillik liana, soya va namlikni yoqtiradi. (Manzarali daraxtlarni ko‘paytirish, Berdiyev E.T. va boshq., 2020)
definition_en: A genus of evergreen woody climbing or creeping plants in the family Araliaceae. In their juvenile climbing stage, Hedera species attach to supporting surfaces by means of aerial rootlets and are widely cultivated as ornamental climbers and ground-cover plants.
example_en: Hedera are evergreen climbing shrubs clinging by aerial roots. (Hedera helix: Common Ivy. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Tuproqni ag‘darmasdan nisbatan chuqur yumshatish uchun qo‘llaniladigan bir necha tishli qishloq xo‘jaligi quroli. Chizel tuproqning zichlashgan qatlamlarini yumshatish, uning suv va havo o‘tkazuvchanligini yaxshilash uchun ishlatiladi. Bog‘ va tokzor qator oralariga ishlov berishda ham qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Bahorda qalamchalar o‘tqazilguncha yer chizel yoki og‘ir borona bilan yumshatiladi va keyin bostiriladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: A multi-shank tillage implement used to loosen and fracture soil with relatively little soil inversion. Chisel plows are used for primary or conservation tillage and can help break compacted soil while leaving substantial crop residue on the soil surface.
etymology_en: Chisel derives from Old French cisel, related ultimately to Latin caedere, meaning “to cut”; plow derives from Old English plōh.
example_en: The aim of this study was to determine the effects of different shank types, tine types, and tractor forward speeds on the power and fuel consumption of chisel plows. (Altikat S. et al., Scientific Reports, 2024)

definition_uz: Tuproqqa chizel yordamida ishlov berish jarayoni. Chizellashda tuproq kam ag‘darilgan yoki ag‘darilmagan holda yumshatiladi, zichlashgan qatlamlar buziladi hamda tuproqning suv va havo o‘tkazuvchanligi yaxshilanadi. Bog‘dorchilikda tuproqni yumshatish va ildizlarning rivojlanishi uchun qulay sharoit yaratish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Agar tuproq juda zichlashib, o‘t bosib ketgan bo‘lsa, kultivatsiya o‘rniga boronalash bilan birga chizellash amalga oshiriladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A tillage operation performed with a chisel plow to loosen and fracture soil with relatively little soil inversion. Chisel plowing can reduce soil compaction, improve soil physical conditions, and leave substantial crop residue on the soil surface.
etymology_en: A compound formed from chisel and plowing.
example_en: "Chisel plowing is typically conducted in the fall and is followed by secondary tillage with a field cultivator or tandem disk in the spring before planting." (Tillage Implements: Purpose and Ideal Use. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Ekinlar, mevali daraxtlar va tok qator oralari hamda tup atrofidagi tuproqni yumshatish, begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotish, tuproq yuzasida hosil bo‘lgan qatqaloqni buzish va namlikni saqlash maqsadida ketmon, motiga yoki kultivator yordamida bajariladigan agrotexnik tadbir. Bog‘dorchilikda chopiq ildiz zonasining havo almashinuvini yaxshilaydi va o‘simliklarning o‘sishiga yordam beradi.
example_uz: Har bir sug‘orish me’yori 300–400 m³/ga, qator oralari 12–14 sm chuqurlikda kultivatsiya qilinadi, o‘suv davrida 4–5 marta chopiq qilinib, begona o‘tlar yo‘qotiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The agricultural practice of loosening the soil, removing weeds, and breaking the soil crust around crops, fruit trees, or vines using a hoe or mechanical cultivator.
example_en: "Hoeing removes weeds with minimal soil disturbance, helping to maintain soil health." (Non-chemical Weed Control. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Qator oralari agrotexnik ishlov berishga imkon beradigan kenglikda qatorlab ekiladigan ekinlar guruhi. Vegetatsiya davrida ularning qator oralari kultivatsiya qilinib, tuproq yumshatiladi va begona o‘tlar yo‘qotiladi. Bunday ekinlarga makkajo‘xori, kartoshka, qand lavlagi, kungaboqar, g‘o‘za va ko‘plab sabzavot ekinlari kiradi.
example_uz: Dastlabki yillarda qator oralariga ertaki kartoshka, karam, sabzi yoki piyoz kabi chopiq qilinadigan ekinlar ekish mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Crops planted in rows spaced widely enough to permit inter-row cultivation and other cultural operations with agricultural machinery during the growing season.
example_en: Cultivation of row crops is an effective way to control annual weeds between corn rows. (Cornell University, Weed Management Methods)

definition_uz: Ketmon yoki boshqa chopiq quroli yordamida tuproqqa ishlov bermoq, uni yumshatmoq va begona o‘tlarni yo‘qotmoq. Bog‘dorchilikda daraxt, tok va boshqa ekinlar qator oralari hamda tup atrofidagi tuproqqa ishlov berishni ifodalashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Tok yerda o‘stiriladigan tokzorlarda esa bahorda tok ochilgandan so‘ng yer bir marta yoppasiga chopiladi, yozda sug‘orilgandan keyin ariqlar yumshatiladi va qatorlardagi begona o‘tlar yo‘qotilib, chopiladi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R. va boshq., 2016)
definition_en: To cultivate the soil with a hoe, especially to loosen the surface soil and remove or cut weeds around cultivated plants.
example_en: In addition, hoeing when the weeds are small allows you to hoe shallowly, which prevents bringing more seeds to the soil surface where they can establish. (Manage Weeds on Your Farm. Mohler C.L., Teasdale J.R., DiTommaso A., SARE)

definition_uz: Zamonaviy bog‘ atirgullarining choy atirgullari va remontant atirgullarni chatishtirish asosida shakllangan guruhi. Choy-gibridli atirgullar yirik, nafis va ko‘pincha xushbo‘y gullari, uzun gul poyalari, ranglarining xilma-xilligi va takroriy gullashi bilan ajralib turadi. Manzarali bog‘dorchilik va gulchilikda gulzorlarni bezash hamda kesma gul yetishtirishda keng qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Oranjereya uchun atirgulning barcha turini ishlatish mumkin emas. Choy gibridli, floribunda hamda pernetsiya atirgullarini yetishtirish eng katta natija beradi. (Ko‘chatchilik va gulchilik ishlari. Yuldashov Ya.X., 2013)
definition_en: A major group of modern garden roses originating from crosses involving Hybrid Perpetual and Tea roses. Hybrid tea roses are characterized by large, well-formed flowers, often borne singly on long stems, recurrent flowering, and a wide range of flower colours. They are widely cultivated as garden and cut-flower roses.
etymology_en: The name Hybrid Tea refers to the historical development of the group from crosses involving Tea roses and Hybrid Perpetual roses.
example_en: Hybrid Tea roses used as long-stemmed cut flowers have 50–100 cm stems, large flowers, and one flower per stem. (The Biology of Hybrid Tea Rose (Rosa × hybrida), Australian Government, Office of the Gene Technology Regulator)

definition_uz: Gortenziyadoshlar (Hydrangeaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi manzarali butalar turkumi. O‘simliklari yirik, chiroyli va ko‘pincha xushbo‘y oq gullari bilan ajralib turadi. Barglari qarama-qarshi joylashgan, oddiy, ko‘pincha tuxumsimon bo‘lib, chetlari tishchali. Mevasi ko‘p urug‘li, pishganda yoriladigan quruq ko‘sakdan iborat. Chubushniklar parklar, xiyobonlar, bog‘lar va boshqa yashil hududlarni bezashda keng qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Chubushnik ruscha чубушник so‘zidan o‘zlashgan. Nom o‘simlikning ichi kovak novdalari qadimda tamaki quvurlarining dastasi — чубук tayyorlashda ishlatilgani bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Chiroyli gullovchi butalar — atirgul, nastarin, chubushnik, kalina, buldonej — 20–24 kunda, ko‘pgina ignabargli o‘simliklar 3–4 oydan keyin va hatto 6 oydan keyin ildiz otadilar. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A genus of deciduous ornamental shrubs in the family Hydrangeaceae, valued for their attractive, often strongly fragrant white flowers. The leaves are opposite and simple, and the fruit is a dry, dehiscent capsule containing numerous seeds. Mock oranges are widely cultivated in parks, gardens, and landscapes.
etymology_en: Philadelphus is named after Ptolemy II Philadelphus; the Greek word philadelphos means “loving one's brother.” Mock orange refers to the orange-blossom-like fragrance of its flowers.
example_en: There are about 50 to 65 species of mock orange, occurring primarily in temperate and subtropical areas of the Northern Hemisphere. (The Woody Plant Seed Manual. Shaw N.L., Hurd E.G., Stickney P.F., USDA Forest Service, 2008)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlari juda yuqori zichlikda ekilib, ularning bo‘yi va shox-shabbasi muntazam kuchli kesish orqali past holatda saqlanadigan intensiv mevachilik tizimi. Bu usulda daraxtlar erta hosilga kiradi, yosh meva beruvchi novdalar davriy ravishda yangilanadi va bog‘dagi kesish, parvarishlash hamda hosil yig‘ish ishlarini yerdan turib yoki mexanizatsiya yordamida bajarish imkoniyati yaratiladi.
example_uz: Bu mevachilik yangi turdagi mevachilik bo‘lib, o‘tloq mevachilik (lugovoye plodovodstvo) deb yuritiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: An intensive fruit-growing system in which trees are planted at very high density and maintained as a low canopy through regular severe pruning. Trees bear fruit early, young fruiting shoots are renewed periodically, and pruning, orchard care and harvesting can be performed from the ground or with machinery.
example_en: The present investigation, “Standardization of N, P and K dose for meadow orchard system in guava,” was carried out to evaluate different fertilizer doses. (Effect of Different Level of N, P and K on Growth, Yield and Soil Status of Guava under Meadow Orchard System, International Journal of Research in Agronomy, 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, uning organlari yoki hujayralarida yosh o‘tishi bilan fiziologik funksiyalar susayib, qaytmas yoki qisman qaytar biokimyoviy va tuzilmaviy o‘zgarishlar yuz beradigan tabiiy rivojlanish jarayoni. Qarish davomida hujayra tarkibiy qismlari parchalanadi, oziqa moddalar boshqa organlarga ko‘chiriladi va jarayon hujayra, organ yoki butun o‘simlikning nobud bo‘lishi bilan yakunlanishi mumkin.
example_uz: O‘simlikda qarish bilan bir vaqtda yosharish, ya’ni ayrim hujayra, to‘qima, organlar va butun organizmning yashash qobiliyati vaqtincha oshishi jarayoni ham kechadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A natural phase of plant development in which physiological functions progressively decline and cells, organs, or the whole plant undergo irreversible or partly reversible biochemical and structural changes. During senescence, cellular components are degraded, nutrients are remobilized to other organs, and the process may culminate in the death of a cell, organ, or the entire plant.
etymology_en: From Latin senescere, meaning “to grow old,” derived from senex, meaning “old.”
example_en: Leaf senescence, the final stage of leaf development, is a complex biological process characterized by the degradation of macromolecules and nutrient redistribution. (Transcription Factors-Regulated Leaf Senescence in Major Crops: Insights, Applications, and Challenges, Current Plant Biology, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlik yoki uning ayrim qismlarida hujayralarning bo‘linishi va kengayishi, biomassa to‘planishi hamda yangi hujayra, to‘qima va organlarning hosil bo‘lishi natijasida hajm, uzunlik, yuza yoki quruq massaning odatda qaytmas ortish jarayoni. O‘sish meristemalar faoliyati, modda almashinuvi, fitogormonlar, genetik dastur va tashqi muhit omillari bilan boshqariladi.
example_uz: O‘simliklar hayotining uchinchi davri oxiriga kelib o‘sishdan to‘xtaydi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The usually irreversible increase in the size, length, area, volume, or dry mass of a plant, organ, tissue, or cell through cell division and expansion, biomass accumulation, and the formation of new structures. Growth is regulated by meristem activity, metabolism, phytohormones, genetic programmes, and environmental factors.
example_en: Growth occurs when cells divide, differentiate and elongate. (How Plants Grow and Thrive, Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, uning organlari, to‘qimalari yoki hujayralarida zigota yoxud vegetativ boshlang‘ich hujayralardan boshlab izchil kechadigan sifat o‘zgarishlari jarayoni. Rivojlanish hujayralarning bo‘linishi va differensiallanishi, to‘qima hamda organlarning shakllanishi, morfogenez va hayotiy bosqichlarning almashinishini qamrab oladi hamda genetik dastur, fitogormonlar va tashqi muhit omillari bilan boshqariladi.
