example_uz: Urug‘ ko‘chatlarning turli belgi-xususiyatlari birdaniga paydo bo‘lmaydi va birdaniga mustahkamlanmaydi, balki ular rivojlanish davrlari o‘tishiga qarab vujudga keladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The process of qualitative change in a plant, organ, tissue, or cell involving coordinated cell division and differentiation, tissue and organ formation, morphogenesis, and transitions between successive life-cycle stages. Development is regulated by genetic programmes, phytohormones, intrinsic timing mechanisms, and environmental factors.
example_en: Plant meristems contain pools of dividing stem cells that produce new organs for plant growth and development. (Tipping the Balance: The Dynamics of Stem Cell Maintenance and Stress Responses in Plant Meristems, Current Opinion in Plant Biology, 2024)

definition_uz: Alohida organizmning zigota hosil bo‘lishi yoki vegetativ boshlang‘ich tuzilma shakllanishidan boshlab hayotining oxirigacha davom etadigan individual rivojlanish jarayoni. Ontogenez embrional va embriondan keyingi rivojlanish, o‘sish, differensiallanish, voyaga yetish, ko‘payish, qarish va nobud bo‘lish bosqichlarini qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha on, ontos — “mavjudot, borliq” va genesis — “kelib chiqish, paydo bo‘lish, rivojlanish” so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Ontogenez, asosan, bir-biri bilan bevosita munosabatda bo‘lgan o‘sish, rivojlanish, qarish va yosharish jarayonlari bilan boradi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The individual development of an organism from the formation of a zygote or vegetative initial structure to the end of its life. Ontogeny encompasses embryonic and post-embryonic development, growth, differentiation, maturation, reproduction, senescence, and death.
etymology_en: From Greek on, ontos, meaning “being” or “existing entity,” and -geny, from genesis, meaning “origin” or “development.”
example_en: Ontogeny is the genetically regulated transition of plants through a series of developmental stages. (The Ontogenetic Dimension of Plant Functional Ecology, Functional Ecology, 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlik, organ, to‘qima yoki hujayralarning yetuk yoxud qarigan holatdan nisbatan yosh fiziologik holatga qaytishi va ularning yashovchanligi hamda rivojlanish imkoniyatining tiklanish jarayoni. Yosharish genlar faolligi va epigenetik holatning qayta dasturlanishi, hujayralarning bo‘linish qobiliyati kuchayishi hamda juvenil belgilarning qayta namoyon bo‘lishi bilan kechishi mumkin.
example_uz: O‘simlikda qarish bilan bir vaqtda yosharish, ya’ni ayrim hujayra, to‘qima, organlar va butun organizmning yashash qobiliyati vaqtincha oshishi jarayoni ham kechadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The process by which a mature or ageing plant, organ, tissue, or cell returns to a more juvenile physiological state and regains developmental potential or vitality. Rejuvenation may involve the resetting of gene expression and epigenetic states, renewed cell division, and the restoration of juvenile characteristics.
etymology_en: From Latin re-, meaning “again,” and juvenis, meaning “young,” through the verb rejuvenate.
example_en: During plant rejuvenation, the establishment of transcriptional networks and epigenetic profiles is affected by various factors such as age, developmental stage, and species. (Epigenetic Regulation and Epigenetic Memory Resetting during Plant Rejuvenation, Journal of Experimental Botany, 2024)

definition_uz: Qarigan yoki hosildorligi pasaygan daraxt va butalarning eski shoxlarini qisman yoki kuchli kesish orqali yangi novdalar o‘sishini rag‘batlantirish, shox-shabbasini yangilash, mahsuldorligini tiklash va umrini uzaytirish usuli. Yoshartirish odatda kesishdan keyingi oziqlantirish, sug‘orish va o‘simliklarni himoya qilish tadbirlari bilan birga amalga oshiriladi.
example_uz: Yoshartirishning yengil, kuchli hamda butab yoshartirish xillari bor. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. «Mevali daraxtlarni yoshartirish». Rixsivoy Jo‘rayev.)
definition_en: A pruning practice in which old, declining, or unproductive branches are partially or severely cut back to stimulate vigorous new shoots, renew the canopy, restore productivity, and extend the useful life of a tree or shrub.
etymology_en: Rejuvenation derives from Latin re-, meaning “again,” and juvenis, meaning “young”; pruning derives from the verb prune, meaning to remove unwanted or unproductive plant parts.
example_en: Rejuvenation pruning delays fruit production at least one year, as it is the time the new cladodes need to reach the reproductive stage. (Production Manual for Beles in Eritrea, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations)

definition_uz: Meva o‘simligining individual rivojlanishidagi mahsuldor bosqich bo‘lib, bu davrda o‘simlikning yer ustki va yer ostki qismlari maksimal darajada rivojlanadi, shox-shabbasining strukturasi va hosil qilish tipi shakllanadi hamda o‘simlik faol hosil berish holatiga yetadi.
example_uz: Mahsuldorlik davrida o‘simliklarning yer ustki va yer ostki qismi maksimal darajada kattalashadi, shox-shabbasining strukturasi va hosil qilish tipi shakllanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The stage or period in the life cycle of a perennial fruit plant during which it has reached productive maturity and actively produces crops. The duration and onset of the productive period vary according to species, cultivar, environmental conditions and cultivation practices.
etymology_en: Productive, from Latin productivus, combined with period, from Greek periodos via Latin and French.
example_en: The life cycle of avocado (longevity and productive period) is a long one. (Avocado: Post-harvest Operations. Dorantes L., Parada L., Ortiz A., FAO, 2004, p. 6)

definition_uz: Yer yuzasidan pastdagi birinchi suv o‘tkazmaydigan qatlam ustida to‘planadigan va yuqori chegarasi erkin suv sathidan iborat bo‘lgan bosimsiz yer osti suvlari. Ularning sathi va minerallashuvi tuproqning sho‘rlanishi, botqoqlanishi hamda bog‘ yerlarining meliorativ holatiga ta’sir qiladi.
example_uz: Sizot suvlari yer yuzasiga yaqin joylashgan yerlarda zovurlar qazib, suv sathini pasaytirilgandan keyingina bog‘ barpo qilish mumkin. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Groundwater in an aquifer that is not overlain by a confining layer and whose upper boundary is a freely fluctuating water table at atmospheric pressure. Its depth and salinity can affect the root zone, soil salinization, waterlogging, and the suitability of land for orchards.
etymology_en: Formed from unconfined, meaning ‘not enclosed or restricted’, and groundwater, meaning water occurring beneath the land surface.
example_en: Unconfined groundwater only partly fills an aquifer, and the top surface of the groundwater body is the water table. (Conceptual Model and Numerical Simulation of the Groundwater-Flow System of Bainbridge Island, Washington. U.S. Geological Survey, 2011)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Muayyan ekin yoki bog‘ maydoniga belgilangan muddatda beriladigan o‘g‘it yoxud uning ta’sir etuvchi oziq moddasi miqdori. O‘g‘itning fizik miqdori T = (A × 100) / C formulasi bilan aniqlanadi; bunda T — o‘g‘itlash me’yori (kg/ga), A — ta’sir etuvchi modda hisobidagi me’yor (kg/ga), C — o‘g‘it tarkibidagi ta’sir etuvchi modda miqdori (%).
example_uz: Mevali bog‘larni o‘g‘itlash me’yori bog‘ning yoshiga, daraxtlarning turiga, novdalarning katta-kichikligiga, bog‘dagi tuproqni ishlash tizimi, hosilning oz-ko‘pligiga va tuproq sharoitiga qarab belgilanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The specified quantity of a fertilizer product or plant nutrient applied per unit area during a defined period. The required amount of fertilizer is calculated as T = (A × 100) / C, where T is the fertilizer application rate (kg/ha), A is the required rate of the active nutrient (kg/ha), and C is the nutrient concentration in the fertilizer (%).
etymology_en: Fertilizer derives from fertilize and the agent suffix -er; application rate denotes the measured quantity applied per unit area or period.
example_en: The fertilizer rate shown on the soil test report is for pounds of P₂O₅/acre for establishment, and ounces of P₂O₅ per tree for maintenance. (Soil Test Note 23: Christmas Tree Crops. Virginia Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: Pakana payvandtaglarga ulangan, bo‘yi va shox-shabbasi kichik meva daraxtlaridan barpo etilgan bog‘. Bunday daraxtlar odatda zichroq ekiladi, barvaqt hosilga kiradi hamda ularni butash, himoya qilish va hosilini terish qulay bo‘ladi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda pakana va yarim pakana bog‘larni yetishtirish texnologiyasini yaratish asoschisi O.K. Afanasyev hisoblanadi. (Intensiv mevachilik. Normurodov D.S. va boshq., 2021)
definition_en: An orchard established with fruit trees whose growth is restricted, usually by dwarfing rootstocks. The smaller trees are generally planted at closer spacing, bear fruit early, and facilitate pruning, crop protection, and harvesting.
etymology_en: Dwarf derives from Old English dweorg, denoting a being or organism of unusually small stature; orchard derives from Old English ortgeard, meaning an enclosed fruit garden.
example_en: A ¹⁵N tracer experiment was performed in a young dwarf apple orchard over two growing seasons to determine the fertilizer N transformation and fate. (Tracing the Contribution and Fate of Synthetic Nitrogen Fertilizer in Young Apple Orchard Agrosystems. Science of the Total Environment, 2024)

definition_uz: Irsiy xususiyati, pakana payvandtag yoki maxsus agrotexnik usullar ta’sirida bo‘yi va shox-shabbasi cheklangan meva daraxtlari. Ular odatda barvaqt hosilga kiradi, kam joy egallaydi hamda butash, purkash va hosilni terish ishlarini yengillashtiradi.
example_uz: Pakana meva daraxtlarining unchalik uzoq yashamasligi, ko‘pincha, ularning salbiy tomoni deb hisoblanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
synonyms_uz: Past bo‘yli meva daraxtlari; Pakana meva daraxtlari
definition_en: Fruit trees whose mature size is substantially reduced by genetic traits, dwarfing rootstocks, or specialized training practices. They generally bear earlier, occupy less space, and facilitate pruning, spraying, and harvesting.
etymology_en: Dwarf derives from Old English dweorg, denoting unusually small stature; fruit derives from Latin fructus through Old French; tree derives from Old English trēow.
example_en: Dwarf fruit trees lend themselves admirably to ornamental plantings as well as orchards. (Yuan R. Tree Fruit in the Home Garden. Virginia Cooperative Extension, Publication 426-841, reviewed 2025)

definition_uz: Unga payvandlangan navning o‘sish kuchini susaytirib, daraxtning bo‘yi va shox-shabbasini kichraytiradigan payvandtag. Pakana payvandtaglar daraxtlarning barvaqt hosilga kirishi va zich ekilishini ta’minlaydi, biroq ayrimlari sayoz ildiz tizimi tufayli doimiy tayanch va muntazam sug‘orishni talab qiladi.
example_uz: Ammo daraxtlarning (pakana payvandtaglarga payvandlangan daraxtlarning) o‘sishi payvandga ham kuchli darajada bog‘liqdir. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A rootstock that restricts the vigour and ultimate size of the grafted scion. Dwarfing rootstocks generally promote earlier bearing and allow closer tree spacing, although some produce shallow root systems that require permanent support and regular irrigation.
etymology_en: Dwarfing is formed from dwarf and the suffix -ing, indicating the action of restricting growth; rootstock combines root and stock, denoting the rooted lower part used in grafting.
example_en: Trees grafted onto a dwarfing rootstock can also be grown in a large pot. (How to Grow Apples. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Payvandtag po‘stlog‘ida T shaklidagi kesik ochilib, payvandustdan olingan bitta kurtakli qalqoncha po‘stloq ostiga joylashtiriladigan kurtak payvand usuli. Odatda po‘stloq yog‘ochlikdan oson ajraladigan faol o‘sish davrida bajariladi.
example_uz: T-shakldagi payvand. Payvand joydagi tanadan chuqur kesim qilinadi, uning uzunligi taxminan 1,5 sm bo‘lishi kerak. (Meva-sabzavotchilik: darslik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A budding technique in which a single bud with a small shield of bark is inserted beneath the rootstock bark through a T-shaped incision. It is normally performed when the bark separates readily from the wood during active growth.
etymology_en: The name refers to the T-shaped incision made in the rootstock bark; budding denotes grafting with a single bud.
example_en: T budding or shield budding is a special grafting technique in which the scion piece is reduced to a single bud. (Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, “T or Shield Budding”)

definition_uz: Payvandustdan kurtak, po‘stloq va yupqa yog‘ochlik qatlami bilan birga kesib olingan plastina payvandtagdagi unga mos kesikka o‘rnatiladigan kurtak payvand usuli. Payvandust va payvandtag kambiy qatlamlarining o‘zaro mos tushishi payvandning tutishi uchun muhimdir.
example_uz: O‘rnatma payvandlash T-usulidagi payvandlash tayyorlov jarayonidan hech farq qilmaydi. Ularning farqi kurtakni o‘simlikka o‘rnatish joyini tayyorlayotganingizda boshlanadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik: darslik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A budding technique in which a chip containing a single bud, bark and a thin layer of wood is cut from the scion and fitted into a matching notch cut in the rootstock, with their cambium layers aligned.
etymology_en: The term chip refers to the small piece of bark and wood bearing the bud that is removed from the scion and inserted into the rootstock.
example_en: For chip budding, a bud on a sliver of wood, complete with bark, is inserted into a matching notch on the rootstock. (Royal Horticultural Society, “Chip budding”)

definition_uz: Payvandust o‘simlikdan ajratilgan, bir yoki bir necha kurtakli qalamcha payvandtagning tanasi yoki shoxiga ulanadigan vegetativ ko‘paytirish usuli. Payvandning tutishi uchun payvandust va payvandtag kambiy qatlamlari o‘zaro moslashtiriladi.
example_uz: Qalamcha usulidagi payvandlash juda ko‘p ishlatiladi. Masalan, agar o‘tgan yili payvand qilingan o‘simlikda payvand tutmagan bo‘lsa yoki serhosil, mahsulotlari sifatli mevali daraxt hosil qilinmoqchi bo‘lganda qalamcha payvand qilinadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik: darslik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A grafting method in which a detached section of stem bearing one or more buds is joined to a rootstock so that their cambium layers make contact and unite.
etymology_en: Scion derives from Middle English and Old French terms denoting a young shoot or twig; grafting refers to joining plant parts so that they grow together.
example_en: Scion grafting is normally used in topworking older trees. (North Dakota State University, “Plant Propagation by Grafting”)

definition_uz: Payvandtag po‘stlog‘i yog‘ochlikkacha tik kesilib, ikki tomonga ajratilgach, pastki qismi uzun va qiya yo‘nilgan qalamcha po‘stloq bilan yog‘ochlik orasiga joylashtiriladigan payvandlash usuli. Usul po‘stloq yog‘ochlikdan oson ajraladigan davrda bajariladi.
example_uz: Qobiq payvand usuli. Shoxning yon tomonidan pastga qarab ustki qobig‘ini yog‘ochigacha kesing. Kesimning uzunligi 3,5 sm ga yaqin. So‘ng avaylab qobiqni yog‘ochdan ikki yon tomonga ajrating. (Meva-sabzavotchilik: darslik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A grafting method in which a prepared scion is inserted between the loosened bark and wood of a rootstock, allowing the cambium of the scion to contact that of the rootstock.
etymology_en: Bark refers to the outer protective tissue of a woody stem beneath which the scion is inserted; grafting denotes joining plant parts so that they unite.
example_en: Bark grafting is often used to graft a relatively small scion onto rootstock that is too large for the four flap graft or whip graft. (University of Georgia Cooperative Extension, “Budding and Grafting of Pecan”)

definition_uz: Tinim davridagi qazib olingan payvandtaglar yoki ildiz bo‘laklariga qalamchalar qishda yopiq va mo‘tadil haroratli xonada ulanadigan payvandlash usuli. Payvandlar tutashish to‘qimasi hosil bo‘lguncha nazorat qilinadigan sharoitda saqlanib, bahorda ko‘chatzorga o‘tqaziladi.
example_uz: Qishki payvand qishning ikkinchi yarmida, iliq va yorug‘ xonada qilinadi. Bu esa maydonchadan imkoniyat boricha ratsional foydalanishga yo‘l beradi, novdalarning o‘sishini tezlashtiradi va ishning bir qismini yoz faslidan qishki faslga o‘tkazadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik: darslik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A grafting practice in which dormant scions are joined to bare-root or container-grown rootstocks indoors during winter and maintained under protected conditions until they are planted in the nursery.
etymology_en: Winter indicates the season in which the operation is performed; bench grafting refers to grafting carried out indoors at a workbench rather than on rootstocks growing in the field.
example_en: Bare-root rootstocks are grafted in winter and maintained indoors. This technique is commonly known as “bench grafting.” (Propagation of Plants, Pacific Northwest Extension Publication PNW 496)

definition_uz: Faol vegetatsiya davrida yog‘ochlashib ulgurmagan yashil novda yoki o‘simtalardan foydalanib bajariladigan payvandlash usuli. Bunda odatda 1–2 kurtak va bargga ega yashil payvandust tayyorlanib, uning pastki qismi ponasimon kesiladi va payvandtagning bo‘ylama yorilgan qismiga o‘rnatiladi. Yashil to‘qimalarda suv yo‘qotilishi tez kechgani sababli payvandlash jarayoni tez bajariladi, barg yuzasi kamaytirilishi va payvandlangan o‘simlik nam sharoitda saqlanishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yashil va payvand so‘zlarining birikishidan hosil bo‘lgan; termin payvandlashda yog‘ochlashib ulgurmagan yashil vegetativ qismlardan foydalanilishiga asoslangan.
example_uz: Yashil payvand. Bu usulda yog‘ochi qotmagan 1–2 kurtak bilan va 1–2 barglari mavjud o‘simliklar payvandlanadi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: A grafting method in which actively growing, non-lignified scion material, usually bearing one or more buds and leaves, is joined to a growing rootstock. High humidity and reduced leaf area help prevent the scion from drying before union formation.
etymology_en: Green refers to the actively growing, non-lignified condition of the scion and rootstock; grafting denotes joining plant parts so that they unite.
example_en: Greenwood grafting allows growers to propagate desired fruit and nut varieties during the growing season after the time for grafting with dormant scions has ended. (Texas A&M University, “Green Wood Grafting”)

definition_uz: Yig‘ib olingan meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarining sifatini saqlab, fiziologik buzilish, namlik yo‘qotilishi va mikrobiologik zararlanishni kamaytirish maqsadida ularni muayyan harorat, nisbiy namlik va gaz muhiti sharoitida tutish jarayoni.
example_uz: Meva-sabzavotlar biologik faol mahsulotlar bo‘lib, ular saqlash vaqtida ham nafas olish, transpiratsiya, etilen ishlab chiqarish kabi fiziologik jarayonlarni davom ettiradi. (Meva-sabzavotlarni saqlash jarayonlarida sifatiga ta’sir etuvchi omillar. U. Xodiyev, S. Abduvoitova, Sh. Raxmonqulova, 2025)
definition_en: The postharvest holding of fruits and vegetables under controlled or managed conditions to maintain quality and reduce water loss, respiration, senescence, physiological disorders and microbial spoilage.
example_en: Cold storage is the most important technology in fresh fruit and vegetable storage. (Postharvest Management of Fruits and Vegetables—Series II. Yoshihiro Imahori and Jinhe Bai, 2024)
synonyms_en: Postharvest storage of fruits and vegetables

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarining yig‘imdan keyingi sifati va oziqaviy qiymatini saqlash, nobudgarchilikni kamaytirish hamda saqlanish muddatini uzaytirish uchun harorat, nisbiy namlik, gaz muhiti, sovitish va joylashtirish sharoitlarini boshqarishga asoslangan usul va vositalar tizimi.
example_uz: Hozirgi zamon saqlash texnologiyasi umumiy klassifikatsiyadan tashqari, saqlashda harorat rejimining navga bog‘liqligini nazarda tutadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A system of postharvest methods, equipment and controlled conditions used to maintain the quality of fruits and vegetables, reduce physiological and microbial deterioration, and extend storage life.
example_en: Atmosphere storage technology can significantly reduce postharvest losses. (A Review on the Modified Atmosphere Preservation of Fruits and Vegetables with Cutting-Edge Technologies, Agriculture, 2021)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot xomashyosini saralash, yuvish, tozalash, maydalash, issiqlik bilan ishlash, quritish, muzlatish yoki konservalash kabi izchil jarayonlar orqali xavfsiz, sifatli va saqlashga chidamli mahsulotga aylantirish usullari hamda vositalari tizimi.
example_uz: Meva-sabzavot poliz mahsulotlarini saqlash va ularni qayta ishlash texnologiyalari, shu sohani yanada rivojlantirish, bu yo‘lda chet el tajribasini ham keng joriy etish maqsadga muvofiqdir. (Meva-sabzavot poliz mahsulotlarini saqlash va ularni qayta ishlash texnologiyalari. G.T. Zaripov, Z.Z. Razzoqov, 2024)
definition_en: A system of methods, operations and equipment used to transform harvested fruits and vegetables into safe, stable or value-added products while maintaining their desirable nutritional, sensory and functional properties.
example_en: This step is applied according to specific vegetable and processing technology requirements. (FAO, “Fruit and Vegetable Processing”, Chapter 9: Vegetable Specific Processing Technologies)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini saqlash va tashish jarayonida ularning massasi yoki hajmining fizik va fiziologik sabablar tufayli o‘lchanadigan darajada kamayishi. Bunga namlikning bug‘lanishi, nafas olish, mahsulotning to‘kilishi hamda po‘stloq va boshqa mayda qismlarning ajralishi kiradi.
example_uz: Miqdoriy isrofgarchilik. Meva-sabzavotlarni saqlashda mahsulot miqdorining kamayishi fizik va fiziologik jarayonlar natijasida ro‘y beradi. Fizik isrof misolida mahsulotdagi namlikning bug‘lanishi tushuniladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A measurable reduction in the mass or volume of harvested produce resulting from physical or physiological processes during postharvest handling, transportation or storage.
example_en: Quantitative loss is a physical loss of substance as shown by a reduction in weight or volume. (FAO, “Storage Losses and Their Estimation”)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini saqlashda ularning oziqaviy, organoleptik, texnologik, urug‘lik yoki bozor sifatining pasayishi. Bu isrofgarchilik saqlash muddatining uzayishi, qarish, unish, mikroorganizmlar va zararkunandalar ta’siri, ifloslanish yoki mexanik shikastlanish natijasida yuz beradi.
example_uz: Sifat o‘zgarishidagi isrofgarchilik. Ma’lumki, saqlash to‘g‘ri tashkil etilganda mahsulot sifati buzilmaydi. Isrofgarchilik saqlash muddatining cho‘zilishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, mahsulotning saqlanuvchanlik muddati o‘tganidan keyin ro‘y beradi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A postharvest loss involving a decline in the nutritional, sensory, technological, seed or market quality of harvested produce because of senescence, sprouting, microbial or pest activity, contamination, mechanical damage or excessive storage time.
example_en: Qualitative losses relate to decreases in edibility, nutrition, caloric value, safety issues, consumer acceptability, and subsequently economic value. (Postharvest Technology of Perishable Horticultural Commodities, “Postharvest Losses and Waste”, 2019)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini takroriy yoki uzoq muddat saqlash uchun doimiy konstruksiya asosida qurilgan omborxonalar. Ularning sig‘imi, shamollatish yoki sovitish tizimi, saqlash rejimini boshqarish usuli va ichki tuzilishi saqlanadigan mahsulot turiga muvofiq belgilanadi.
example_uz: Doimiy omborlar bir qavatli to‘g‘ri burchak shaklida yer ustiga yoki yerdan chuqurroq (1,5–2 m) qilib, betondan yoki g‘ishtdan quriladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Fixed, durable facilities constructed for the repeated or long-term storage of horticultural produce. Their design may include systems for ventilation, cooling, humidity control, produce handling and the maintenance of suitable storage conditions.
example_en: Farmers build temporary and permanent storage facilities to protect equipment, materials, produce and end products from the environment. (Farm Practice: Storage of Farm Supplies and Products. Province of British Columbia, 2014)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot, kartoshka va ildizmevalarni muayyan mavsum davomida saqlash uchun odatda dala sharoitida tashkil etiladigan sodda saqlash inshootlari. Ularga uyum, xandaq va o‘ralar kiradi; ulardagi saqlash sharoiti ko‘p jihatdan tashqi muhitga bog‘liq bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Muvaqqat — arabcha «muʼaqqat» so‘zidan olingan bo‘lib, «vaqt bilan cheklangan, vaqtinchalik» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Muvaqqat omborlarga uyum, xandaq, o‘ra va boshqalar kiradi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Simple structures used for the seasonal or short-term storage of horticultural produce, particularly potatoes and root crops. They commonly include clamps, trenches and pits and provide only limited control over storage conditions.
example_en: Various smaller temporary storage structures that may be reusable can be constructed using polyethylene sheeting, reinforced fibre sheeting, wire mesh, and wood or metal panels. (Temporary Grain Storage Considerations. Purdue University Cooperative Extension Service)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini belgilangan past haroratda saqlash uchun sun’iy sovitish tizimi bilan jihozlangan omborlar. Ularda harorat, havo aylanishi va nisbiy namlik mahsulotning saqlash talablariga muvofiq boshqariladi.
example_uz: Meva-sabzavot omborlari mahsulotni saqlash usullariga qarab quyidagi guruhlarga bo‘linadi: sun’iy usulda sovitiladigan sovutgichlar. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Refrigerated facilities for storing perishable horticultural produce under controlled low-temperature conditions in order to preserve its quality and freshness.
example_en: Refrigeration in cold stores is not always used to maximize the postharvest life. (Manual for the Preparation and Sale of Fruits and Vegetables. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 2003)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini gaz tarkibi sun’iy ravishda o‘zgartirilmaydigan odatiy havo muhitida saqlash usuli. Bunda germetik yopilmagan omborlarda havo tabiiy ravishda yoki ventilyatorlar yordamida almashtiriladi; gaz tarkibi boshqarilmagani sababli mahsulotni uzoq vaqt sifatli saqlab bo‘lmaydi.
example_uz: Mahsulotlarni oddiy gaz muhitida saqlashda germetik yopilmaydigan omborxonalardan foydalanish mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A method of storing horticultural produce in ordinary air without intentionally altering or controlling the concentrations of oxygen and carbon dioxide. Air may be circulated naturally or mechanically, but the absence of atmospheric control generally makes the method unsuitable for long-term quality preservation.
example_en: Cold storage, also known as regular atmosphere (RA) storage, is used to store fruit for short periods of time once it’s picked. (Storing Apples. Apple and Pear Australia Limited, 2016)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini tarkibi odatiy havodan farq qiladigan gaz muhitida saqlash usuli. Odatda kislorod miqdorining kamayishi va karbonat angidrid miqdorining ko‘payishi mahsulotning nafas olishi, etilen hosil qilishi, pishishi va qarishini sekinlashtirib, saqlash muddatini uzaytiradi. Gazlarning xavfsiz nisbati mahsulot turi va naviga bog‘liq; kislorodning haddan tashqari kamayishi yoki karbonat angidridning ortishi anaerob nafas olish va fiziologik shikastlanishlarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Modifikatsiya — lotincha «modificatio» so‘zidan olingan bo‘lib, «o‘zgartirish» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Modifikatsiyalangan gaz muhitida saqlash (MGM) — tarkibi havo tarkibidan farq qilgan muhitda. MGM boshqariladigan va boshqarilmaydigan bo‘lishi mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A storage method in which horticultural produce is kept in an atmosphere that differs from normal air but is not continuously and precisely regulated during storage. The modified gas composition, commonly involving reduced oxygen and elevated carbon dioxide, can slow respiration, ethylene activity, ripening and senescence and thereby extend storage life. Safe gas concentrations are commodity- and cultivar-specific.
example_en: Modified atmosphere storage is a well-proven technology for preserving natural quality of food products in addition to extending the storage life. (Modified Atmosphere Storage of Grains, Meats, Fruits and Vegetables. Jayas D.S. and Jeyamkondan S., 2002)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini idish yoki o‘rovga joylashtirish hamda saqlash, tashish va sotishga tayyorlash jarayoni. Qadoqlash mahsulotni bir butun yuk birligiga keltiradi, mexanik shikastlanish, nam yo‘qotish va ifloslanishdan himoya qiladi hamda uni tashish, saqlash va sotishni yengillashtiradi.
example_uz: Bu omborxonalar mevalarni qabul qilish, saqlash, tovar ishlov berish, qadoqlash va sotuvga jo‘natish uchun mo‘ljallanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlari saqlash omborlari. Azizov A.Sh., Islamov S.Ya., 2020)
definition_en: The operations involved in preparing horticultural produce for containment, protection, handling, transport, storage and presentation. Packaging reduces mechanical injury, moisture loss and contamination, facilitates distribution and marketing, and may carry identification and traceability information.
example_en: Packaging protects the produce from mechanical injury, and contamination during marketing. (The Role of Post-harvest Management in Assuring the Quality and Safety of Horticultural Produce. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 2004)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot xomashyosiga qaynoq suv yoki bug‘ bilan qisqa muddat issiqlik ishlovi berib, keyin tez sovitish jarayoni. Asosiy maqsadi fermentlarni faolsizlantirish bo‘lib, rangni saqlash, to‘qimani yumshatish, havoni chiqarish va mikroorganizmlar miqdorini kamaytirishga ham yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha «blanchir» — «oqartirmoq» so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Blanshirlash muddati va harorati turli xil sabzavotlar uchun turlicha. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A short heat treatment in hot or boiling water or steam, followed by rapid cooling, used mainly to inactivate enzymes before freezing, drying or canning. It may also reduce surface microorganisms, expel intercellular air, soften tissues and help preserve colour.
etymology_en: From French «blanchir», meaning «to whiten».
example_en: Blanching is the exposure of the vegetables to boiling water or steam for a brief period of time to inactivate enzymes. (Freezing of Fruits and Vegetables: An Agribusiness Alternative for Rural and Semi-rural Areas. FAO, 2005)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavotlarni diametri, uzunligi, hajmi yoki massasiga qarab bir xil o‘lcham guruhlariga ajratish jarayoni. Kalibrlash mahsulotlarning o‘lcham jihatdan bir xilligini ta’minlab, qadoqlash, qayta ishlash va sotishni yengillashtiradi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha «calibre» — «o‘lcham, qolip» so‘zidan hosil bo‘lgan xalqaro termin asosida o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Tizimda saralanmagan mevalarni to‘kish, saralash, kalibrlash va qutilarni yopish ko‘zda tutiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
synonyms_uz: O‘lchamiga qarab xillash; bir o‘lchamga keltirish
definition_en: The classification of fruits and vegetables into uniform groups according to physical dimensions or mass, such as diameter, length, weight or volume. It is distinct from grading, which classifies produce according to quality.
example_en: Sizing is another basic operation undertaken in a packhouse and can be carried out before or after sorting by colour. (Manual for the Preparation and Sale of Fruits and Vegetables: From Field to Market. FAO, 2004)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini yetishtirilgan yoki saqlanayotgan joyidan qadoqlash, qayta ishlash, sotish yoxud iste’mol qilish manziliga transport vositalari yordamida yetkazish jarayoni. Tashishda mahsulot mexanik shikastlanish, qizib ketish, namlik yo‘qotish va ifloslanishdan muhofaza qilinishi lozim.
example_uz: Sifatli yetishtirilgan mahsulot uni tashish, saqlash va qayta ishlash mobaynida dastlabki xossalarini yo‘qotib, sifatsiz mahsulotga aylanishi mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: The movement of harvested horticultural produce from its place of production or storage to a packhouse, processing facility, market or other destination. Suitable vehicles, packaging and environmental conditions are required to minimize mechanical damage, overheating, moisture loss and contamination.
example_en: Transportation is a big and often the most important factor in the marketing of fresh produce. (Prevention of Post-harvest Food Losses: Fruits, Vegetables and Root Crops—A Training Manual. FAO, 1989)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavotlarni tashqi ko‘rinishi, rangi, yetilganlik darajasi, shakli, butunligi va nuqsonlariga qarab ajratish jarayoni. Unda chirigan, shikastlangan, kasallangan yoki belgilangan talablarga javob bermaydigan mahsulotlar sog‘lom mahsulotlardan ajratiladi.
example_uz: Meva qadoqlash joyi qo‘lda saralash, kalibrlash va joylash uchun xontaxtalar bilan jihozlanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The separation of horticultural produce according to observable characteristics such as colour, maturity, shape, soundness and the presence of defects. Damaged, decayed, diseased or misshapen units are removed from acceptable produce. Sorting differs from sizing, which separates produce by physical dimensions, and grading, which assigns it to established quality classes.
example_en: Sorting for mechanical damage, pest damage, presence of decay or misshapen produce can easily be done in the field. (Good Practice in the Design, Management and Operation of a Fresh Produce Packing-house. FAO, 2012)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot tarkibidagi namlikni quyosh, isitilgan havo yoki maxsus quritgichlar yordamida kamaytirish jarayoni. Namlik va suv faolligining pasayishi mikroorganizmlar rivojlanishi hamda buzilish reaksiyalarini sekinlashtirib, mahsulotning saqlanish muddatini uzaytiradi.
example_uz: Xomashyoni quritish. Meva va uzum aslida ikki marta quritiladi. Birinchi bor meva turiga qarab, 1–2 kundan to 5–6 kungacha quyosh tik tushadigan joyga yoyib qo‘yiladi.(Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq. 2022)
definition_en: The removal of moisture from fruit, vegetables or other horticultural produce by solar heat, heated air or mechanical drying equipment. The resulting reduction in moisture content and water activity inhibits microbial growth, slows deterioration and extends product shelf life.
example_en: Drying involves reducing the amount of water in fruit and vegetables to a low enough level so that the spoilage enzymes and bacteria cannot work. (Home-based Fruit and Vegetable Processing. FAO)

definition_uz: Meva, uzum va boshqa bog‘dorchilik mahsulotlarini ochiq maydonda quyosh nuri va tabiiy havo oqimi ta’sirida quritish usuli. Mahsulot bevosita quyosh radiatsiyasini qabul qiladi; shu jihati bilan yopiq qurilmada isitilgan havo qo‘llanadigan quyosh quritgichida quritishdan farqlanadi.
example_uz: Qaynoq ishqorga botirmay, quyosh tushadigan ochiq maydonda quritish usuli oftobi deb yuritiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A direct drying method in which fruit, vegetables or other produce is exposed to solar radiation and natural air movement under open environmental conditions. It differs from solar drying, in which produce is placed in an enclosed dryer and heated air removes moisture.
example_en: Sun drying is a direct drying process where sunshine and wind are used for drying under circumstances open to the environment. (Code of Practice for the Reduction of Contamination of Food with Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons from Smoking and Direct Drying Processes. Codex Alimentarius, 2009)

definition_uz: Uzumni 0,3–0,4 foizli qaynoq ishqor eritmasiga qisqa muddat botirib, keyin ochiq maydonda oftobda quritish usuli. Ishqor uzum po‘stidagi mumsimon g‘uborni kamaytirib, mayda yoriqlar hosil qiladi va namlikning chiqishini tezlashtiradi. Natijada quritish muddati oftobi usulga nisbatan 3–4 barobar qisqaradi.
example_uz: Qaynoq ishqorga botirib, yoyib quritish usuli objo‘sh deyiladi. Objo‘sh usulida deyarli barcha navlarni quritish mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A grape pretreatment and drying process in which grapes are briefly dipped in a hot dilute sodium hydroxide solution before drying, traditionally in direct sunlight. The treatment modifies the waxy surface and produces fine checks in the skin, thereby accelerating moisture transfer and shortening drying time.
etymology_en: The term «soda-dip» refers to briefly dipping grapes in a hot dilute solution of caustic soda before drying.
example_en: In the soda-dip process, grapes are dipped for 2–3 seconds in a solution of 0.2–0.3% NaOH (caustic soda) at 93.3–100 °C. (Handbook of Fruits and Fruit Processing. «Grapes and Raisins». Bhat N.R., Desai B.B., Suleiman M.K., 2006)

definition_uz: Meva va uzumni quritish uchun mo‘ljallangan, usti yopiq, yon tomonlari to‘liq yoki qisman ochiq inshoot. Bostirma mahsulotni yog‘ingarchilik, chang va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri quyosh nurlaridan himoya qiladi, tabiiy havo aylanishi esa namlikning chiqarilishini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Uzumni plyonka yopilgan bostirmalarda quritish usuli M. Mirzayev nomidagi institut olimlari tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan va sinab ko‘rilgan. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A roofed, fully or partly open-sided structure used for drying grapes, fruit or other horticultural produce. It protects the produce from precipitation, dust and excessive direct sunlight while allowing natural airflow to remove moisture.
example_en: The drying sheds should be composed of covered iron (galvanised wire) racks. (Good Practices for Dried Grape Production Systems. International Organisation of Vine and Wine, OIV)

definition_uz: Meva va uzumni tabiiy havo aylanishida quritishga mo‘ljallangan, usti yopiq, yon tomonlari esa to‘liq yoki qisman ochiq inshoot. Undagi tokchalarga mahsulot solingan padnislar joylashtiriladi; bostirma xomashyoni chang, yog‘ingarchilik va bevosita quyosh ta’siridan himoya qilib, namlikning chiqib ketishini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Yarim ochiq bostirma quyidagi kattalikda bo‘ladi: eni — 4 metr, eng baland qismi — 2,4 metr, yon devorlar balandligi — 1,6 metr, bitta bo‘lim uzunligi 4 metr. Har bo‘limda bir yo‘la 0,6–0,8 tonna ho‘l meva quritish mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch.va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A roofed structure with fully or partly open sides, used for the natural-air drying of fruit, grapes and other horticultural produce. Racks or trays hold the produce above the ground, while natural airflow removes moisture and the roof protects it from precipitation, dust and excessive direct sunlight.
example_en: The simplest drying method is to construct an open-sided drying shed. (Healthy Harvest: A Training Manual for Community Workers in Growing, Preparing and Processing Healthy Food. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlarini diametri, uzunligi, qalinligi yoki massasiga qarab bir xil o‘lcham guruhlariga ajratadigan mashinalar. Ularda teshikli baraban, rolik, tasma, tros, shnek yoki elektron o‘lchash tizimlaridan foydalanilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Kalibrlash mashinalari mevalarning katta-kichikligiga qarab ajratadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: Machines used to separate fruit, vegetables or other horticultural produce into uniform size classes according to dimensions such as diameter, length or thickness, or according to weight. They are distinct from grading machines that may classify produce by broader quality attributes such as colour, defects and maturity.
example_en: Simple sizing machines can be used in small packing houses. (Good Practice in the Design, Management and Operation of a Fresh Produce Packing-House. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlaridagi mikrobiologik, biokimyoviy va fizik-kimyoviy buzilish jarayonlarini to‘xtatish yoki sekinlashtirish orqali ularning xavfsizligini, sifatini va saqlanish muddatini uzaytirish jarayoni. Konservalashga sovitish, muzlatish, quritish, pasterizatsiya, sterilizatsiya, achitish, tuzlash va boshqa usullar kiradi.
example_uz: Meva-sabzavotlarni konservalash va qayta ishlash ulardagi biokimyoviy jarayonlarni tugatish, fitopatogen mikroflorani so‘ndirish va mahsulotni tashqi muhit, ya’ni kislorod va yorug‘likdan muhofaza qilishdir. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch., Merganov A.T.)
definition_en: The application of physical, chemical or biological treatments to prevent or slow food deterioration, control microorganisms and enzymatic changes, and extend shelf life while maintaining safety and acceptable quality. It includes canning, refrigeration, freezing, drying, fermentation and chemical preservation.
example_en: Food preservation may be defined as the set of treatment processes that are performed to prolong the life of foods. (Technical Manual on Small-Scale Processing of Fruits and Vegetables. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarining sifati va muayyan maqsadda foydalanishga yaroqliligini baholash uchun belgilangan ko‘rsatkichlar hamda me’yorlar majmui. Qo‘llanish maqsadiga ko‘ra tayyorlash, urug‘lik, sanoat va eksport konditsiyalari farqlanadi.
example_uz: Agar mahsulotning sifat ko‘rsatkichlaridan biri chegaralangan konditsiyadan yuqori bo‘lsa, yetishtirilgan mahsulotni davlatga topshirishga ruxsat etilmaydi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Established standards containing reference values and requirements for assessing the quality, marketability and fitness for an intended use of agricultural produce. Depending on their purpose, they may apply to procurement, seed material, industrial processing or export.
example_en: UNECE develops internationally agreed commercial quality standards for agricultural produce. (Agricultural Quality Standards. United Nations Economic Commission for Europe, UNECE)

definition_uz: Mahsulotlar, jarayonlar yoki xizmatlarga takroriy qo‘llanadigan me’yor, qoida va talablarni ishlab chiqish, tasdiqlash hamda amaliyotga joriy etish faoliyati. Standartlash mahsulot sifatini bir xilda baholash, xavfsizlikni ta’minlash va savdodagi texnik to‘siqlarni kamaytirishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Standartlarni belgilash va qo‘llash jarayoni standartlash deb yuritiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: The activity of establishing provisions for common and repeated use in relation to actual or potential problems, with the aim of achieving an optimum degree of order in a given context. It includes formulating, issuing and implementing standards.
example_en: Identify the institutions responsible in each country for standardization activities and for quality and safety certification and accreditation systems for fresh fruits and vegetables. (Improving the Quality and Safety of Fresh Fruits and Vegetables: A Practical Approach. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, FAO)

definition_uz: Standartlarni ishlab chiqish, tasdiqlash, joriy etish va ularning bajarilishini nazorat qilish bilan bog‘liq tashkilotlar, me’yoriy hujjatlar, qoidalar va tartib-taomillar majmui. Tizim mahsulot sifati va xavfsizligini bir xilda baholash hamda standartlash ishlarini muvofiqlashtirishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: Mamlakatimizda mahsulotning sifatini nazorat qilish va boshqarish uchun standartlash davlat sistemasi tuzilgan. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: An organized framework of institutions, rules, procedures and resources for developing, approving, implementing and maintaining standards and overseeing their application. A national standardization system coordinates these activities across relevant economic and technical sectors.
example_en: The national standardization system supports the nation's competitiveness and quality of life. (Development of National Standardization 2025. International Organization for Standardization, ISO)

definition_uz: Mamlakat miqyosida standartlarni ishlab chiqish, tasdiqlash, ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish, joriy etish va ularning bajarilishini nazorat qilishni ta’minlaydigan davlat organlari, texnik qo‘mitalar, me’yoriy hujjatlar, qoidalar va tartib-taomillar majmui.
example_uz: Davlat standartlash sistemasi standartlash bo‘yicha xalq xo‘jaligining barcha sohasidagi boshqarish sistemalarini birlashtiradi hamda o‘zaro bog‘langan qoida va nizomlar kompleksini tashkil qiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
synonyms_uz: Davlat standartlashtirish tizimi; Milliy standartlashtirish tizimi
definition_en: A country-level framework of institutions, technical committees, rules, procedures and resources responsible for developing, approving, publishing, implementing and maintaining national standards and coordinating standardization activities.
example_en: The national standardization system is coordinated by an NSB, which acts as a focal point to support industry, government and civil society. (Consultancy Support for ISO Members. International Organization for Standardization, 2024)

definition_uz: Mahsulotdagi hayotiy jarayonlarni va uni buzuvchi mikroorganizmlar faoliyatini to‘liq to‘xtatishga asoslangan konservalash prinsipi. Abioz termik yoki kimyoviy sterilizatsiya, filtrlash va ionlashtiruvchi nurlar bilan ishlov berish kabi usullar orqali amalga oshiriladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha a- — «yo‘q, -siz» va bios — «hayot» qismlaridan hosil bo‘lgan; so‘zma-so‘z ma’nosi — «hayotsiz holat».
example_uz: Moskva qishloq xo‘jalik akademiyasining professori Ya.Ya. Nikitinskiy qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlashning biologik asoslariga tayanib, saqlash usullarini bioz, anabioz, tsenoanabioz va abioz kabi toifalarga bo‘ladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A food-preservation principle based on directly inactivating microorganisms and terminating biological or enzymatic processes in the product by methods such as sterilization, antimicrobial treatment, filtration or irradiation.
etymology_en: Formed from Ancient Greek a- meaning “not” or “without”, bios meaning “life”, and -osis denoting a process or condition.
example_en: Abiosis is the direct inactivation of microorganisms, and the preserved food thus contains fewer microorganisms than before the treatment. (Sterilized Processed Cheese: Principles, Technological Aspects, and Properties: A Review. Foods, 2025)

definition_uz: Mahsulotning tabiiy immuniteti va hayotiy jarayonlarini saqlab turishga asoslangan qisqa muddatli saqlash prinsipi. Meva va sabzavotlar biozning gemibioz turida yig‘ib olinganidan keyin barra va tirik holatda saqlanadi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha biosis — «yashash, hayot kechirish» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; uning asosida bios — «hayot» so‘zi yotadi.
example_uz: Mahsulotlar bioz usulida tirik holda saqlanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A short-term storage principle in which fresh raw materials remain alive and their natural immunity and normal physiological processes are maintained without preservative treatment. In horticultural produce, it chiefly applies to keeping harvested fruits and vegetables fresh before processing or consumption.
etymology_en: From Greek biōsis, meaning “living” or “way of life”, derived from bios, meaning “life”.
example_en: Biosis consists in food storage in a fresh form without any special treatment. (Freezing as a Method of Food Preservation. Ishevskiy A.L. and Davydov I.A., 2017)

definition_uz: Mahsulot va undagi mikroorganizmlarning hayotiy, fiziologik hamda biokimyoviy jarayonlari tashqi omillar ta’sirida qaytar tarzda keskin susayadigan yoki vaqtincha to‘xtaydigan saqlash prinsipi. Sovitish, muzlatish, quritish, osmotik bosimni oshirish va kislotali muhit yaratish anabiozga asoslangan usullardir.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; ana- — «qayta» va bios — «hayot» qismlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Anabioz havo harorati pasaytirilib, mahsulot quritilib, mahsulot hujayrasidagi osmotik bosim o‘zgartirilib, kislotali muhit hosil qilinib va maxsus anestezik moddalar qo‘llanib yaratiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A preservation principle in which the metabolic activity of a product and the growth and activity of microorganisms are reversibly suppressed by physical or physicochemical factors without necessarily killing them. It underlies chilling, freezing, drying, osmotic preservation and acidification.
etymology_en: From Greek anabiōsis, meaning “return to life”, formed from ana- meaning “again” and bios meaning “life”.
example_en: The anabiosis principle is a basis of several preservation methods: cooling, freezing, creation of high concentrations of osmotically active substances, drying, storage in a regulated atmosphere, pickling, alcoholization and others. (Freezing as a Method of Food Preservation. Ishevskiy A.L. and Davydov I.A., 2017)

definition_uz: Foydali mikroorganizmlarning rivojlanishi uchun qulay sharoit yaratib, ular hosil qiladigan sut kislotasi yoki etil spirti yordamida buzuvchi mikroflora faoliyatini susaytirishga asoslangan biologik konservalash prinsipi. Unga sabzavot va mevalarni achitish hamda uzum va meva sharbatlarini bijg‘itish kiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha koinos — «umumiy, birgalikdagi» va anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Mahsulotlarning mikroflorasini boshqarib, ya’ni foydali mikroblar sonini sun’iy usulda ko‘paytirib, zararli mikroblarning ta’sirini susaytirish mumkin. Amalda foydali mikroorganizmlardan sut kislotasi bakteriyalari va achitqilardan keng foydalaniladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A biological preservation principle in which favourable conditions are created for selected beneficial microorganisms, such as lactic acid bacteria or yeasts, whose metabolic products suppress spoilage microorganisms. It includes preservation by lactic acid and alcoholic fermentation.
etymology_en: Formed from ceno-, ultimately derived from Greek koinos meaning “common” or “shared”, and anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”.
example_en: Cenoanabiosis consists in creating optimal conditions for the development of certain microorganisms, such as yeasts and lactic acid bacteria. (Some Aspects Regarding the Food Stability and the Factors That Influence It. Bonciu E. et al., 2021)

definition_uz: Mahsulot tarkibidagi erkin suvni qisman yoki deyarli to‘liq chiqarib, suv faolligini pasaytirish orqali mikroorganizmlar rivojlanishi va biokimyoviy jarayonlarni keskin susaytirishga asoslangan anabioz turi. U tabiiy va sun’iy quritish hamda suvsizlantirish usullarini qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha xēros — «quruq» va anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Kseroanabioz — mahsulotlarni qisman yoki umuman quritib saqlash. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: An anabiotic preservation principle in which water is partially or almost completely removed from a product, reducing water activity sufficiently to inhibit microbial growth and slow enzymatic and biochemical reactions. It is implemented through drying or dehydration.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek xēros, meaning “dry”, and anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”.
example_en: Preservation by drying is based on xeroanabiosis. (Influence of Convective Drying on the Properties of Idared and Božićnica Apples, Cut into Slices. Dobričević N., 1998)

definition_uz: Mahsulot haroratini uning krioskopik nuqtasidan pastga tushirib, tarkibidagi suvning bir qismini muzlatish orqali fiziologik, biokimyoviy va mikrobiologik jarayonlarni keskin susaytirishga asoslangan anabioz turi. Muzlatish mikroorganizmlarni to‘liq yo‘q qilmaydi, ammo ularning rivojlanishini to‘xtatib, mahsulotning saqlanish muddatini uzaytiradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha kryos — «sovuq, muz» va anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Krioanabiozda esa mahsulotlar muzlatilib saqlanadi va bu holatda ular nisbatan uzoq vaqt saqlanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: An anabiotic preservation principle in which a product is cooled below its cryoscopic point so that part of its water freezes, sharply reducing physiological, biochemical and microbial activity. Freezing does not necessarily destroy all microorganisms, but inhibits their growth and extends product storage life.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek kryos, meaning “cold” or “frost”, and anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”.
example_en: The main purpose of this study is to determine the influence of a preservation process based on the use of the cold, of cryoanabiosis. (Research Regarding the Influence of Conservation by Using Deep-Frozen Methodology over the Quality of Some Horticulture Products. Sandu A.-G. et al., 2020)

definition_uz: Mahsulot haroratini pasaytirish orqali uning fiziologik va biokimyoviy jarayonlari hamda mikroorganizmlar faoliyatini qaytar tarzda susaytirishga asoslangan anabioz turi. Termoanabioz sovitib saqlash — psixroanabioz va muzlatib saqlash — krioanabiozni qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha thermē — «issiqlik, harorat» va anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Termoanabioz — bu usulda mahsulotlar havo harorati pasaytirilgan muhitda saqlanadi. Haroratning pasayishi mikroorganizmlarga salbiy ta’sir ko‘rsatadi va mahsulotdagi biokimyoviy hamda fiziologik jarayonlarning faolligini pasaytiradi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: An anabiotic preservation principle in which reduced temperature reversibly slows the physiological and biochemical processes of a product and inhibits microbial activity. It encompasses chilling, or psychroanabiosis, and freezing, or cryoanabiosis.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek thermē, meaning “heat” or “temperature”, and anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”. In food preservation, the term refers specifically to preservation through temperature reduction.
example_en: Principles of osmo- and thermoanabiosis are used to produce sweetened condensed milks. (Effects of Critical Storage Temperatures on Microbiological, Physico-chemical and Sensory Indicators of Sweetened Condensed Milk. Kruchinin A. et al., 2024)

definition_uz: Mahsulotni muzlatmasdan, uning krioskopik nuqtasidan yuqori past haroratda sovitib saqlash orqali nafas olish, biokimyoviy jarayonlar va mikroorganizmlar rivojlanishini qaytar tarzda susaytirishga asoslangan termoanabioz turi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha psychros — «sovuq» va anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Psixroanabiozda mahsulotlar sovitilib saqlanadi. Meva va sabzavotlar uchun havo harorati –1 dan +1 °C gacha sovitilgan hisoblansa, don mahsulotlari uchun +8 °C ham sovitilgan hisoblanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A form of thermoanabiosis in which a product is chilled without being frozen, generally above its initial freezing point, to reversibly slow respiration, biochemical reactions and microbial growth while retaining its fresh state.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek psychros, meaning “cold”, and anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”.
example_en: The effect of preservation by refrigeration—psychroanabiosis preservation procedure; preservation method: cooling of fruit and vegetables. (Principles and Methods of Food Preservation 2. University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine of Cluj-Napoca, 2022)

definition_uz: Mahsulotga ko‘p miqdorda shakar yoki tuz qo‘shib, muhitning osmotik bosimini oshirish va suv faolligini pasaytirish orqali mikroorganizmlar rivojlanishini susaytirishga asoslangan anabioz turi. Bu prinsip meva murabbosi, jem, povidlo, shakarlangan mevalar hamda tuzlangan mahsulotlar tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha ōsmos — «itarish, bosim» va anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Osmoanabiozda mahsulot hujayra muhitida yuqori osmotik bosim hosil qilinadi. Shu usul hujayrada plazmoliz hosil qilish hodisasiga asoslangan. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: An anabiotic preservation principle in which a high concentration of sugar or salt increases the osmotic pressure and lowers water activity, making water less available to microorganisms and thereby inhibiting their growth. It is applied in sugaring, salting, brining and curing.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek ōsmos, meaning “push” or “impulsion”, and anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”.
example_en: The product is canned or packaged in other containers without sterilization in a procedure known as osmoanabiosis. (Concentrated Milk Products. American Dairy Products Institute)

definition_uz: Mahsulotga oziq-ovqat uchun ruxsat etilgan kislota, ko‘pincha sirka kislotasi qo‘shib, muhit pHini pasaytirish va zararli mikroorganizmlar rivojlanishini susaytirishga asoslangan anabioz turi. U meva-sabzavotlarni marinadlash va sirka bilan konservalashda qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha acidus — «nordon, kislotali» va yunoncha anabiōsis — «qayta jonlanish, yashirin hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Atsidoanabiozda mahsulotlar kislotali muhit sharoitida saqlanadi. O‘simlik mahsulotlarini konserva qilishda sirka kislotasidan keng foydalaniladi va bu usul amalda marinadlash deb yuritiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: An anabiotic preservation principle in which a food-grade acid, most commonly acetic acid in vinegar, is added to lower the product pH and inhibit spoilage and pathogenic microorganisms. It is used in artificial acidification, vinegar preservation and marinating.
etymology_en: Formed from Latin acidus, meaning “sour” or “acidic”, and Greek anabiosis, meaning “return to life” or “suspended life”.
example_en: The effect of preservation by artificial acidification on the quality of preserved products—conservation procedure: acidoanabiosis; preservation method: preservation with vinegar. (Principles and Methods of Food Preservation 2. University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine of Cluj-Napoca, 2022)

definition_uz: Mahsulotdagi fiziologik jarayonlar va mikroorganizmlar faoliyatini anestezik ta’sir ko‘rsatuvchi moddalar yoki gazlar yordamida qaytar tarzda susaytirishga asoslangan anabioz turi. Meva-sabzavotlarni saqlashda karbonat angidrid miqdori oshirilgan gaz muhiti shunday ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha narkē — «karaxtlik, uvishish» hamda anabiosis — «hayotga qaytish, jonlanish» so‘zlaridan.
example_uz: Narkoanabioz ayrim moddalarning mahsulotlarga anestezik ta’siriga asoslangan. Bunda xloroform, efir va boshqa moddalardan foydalaniladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A form of anabiosis-based preservation in which the physiological activity of produce and associated microorganisms is reversibly suppressed by substances or gases exerting an anaesthetic effect. In fruit and vegetable storage, this effect may be produced by an atmosphere with an elevated carbon dioxide concentration.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek narkē, meaning ‘numbness or stupor’, and anabiosis, meaning ‘return to life or revival’.
example_en: Legumes and fruits preserved in a CO₂ atmosphere (through narcoanabiosis). (Preservation of Fruits and Vegetables by Freezing. University of Craiova, Faculty of Agriculture and Horticulture, 2012–2013)

definition_uz: Kurtak, tuganak yoki boshqa meristematik organning ichki fiziologik omillar tufayli, tashqi sharoit qulay bo‘lsa ham, o‘sishni boshlay olmaydigan davri. Meva daraxtlari kurtaklarida bu davr odatda muayyan sovuqlik talabi bajarilgandan keyin tugaydi.
example_uz: Fiziologik tinim davrida mahsulotlarning tabiiy yo‘qotilishi juda kam bo‘lib, sifati esa deyarli o‘zgarmaydi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A dormancy state in which the growth of a bud, tuber bud, or another meristematic organ is inhibited by physiological factors arising within the affected organ, even under otherwise favourable growing conditions. In temperate fruit-tree buds, endodormancy is generally released after the chilling requirement is satisfied.
etymology_en: Formed from endo-, from Greek endon meaning ‘within’, and dormancy, denoting a temporary suspension of growth.
example_en: Endodormancy, or true dormancy, is regulated by endogenous signals that prevent growth of the meristems even under growth-promoting conditions. (Physiological and Molecular Mechanisms Associated with Potato Tuber Dormancy. Dogramaci M. et al., 2024)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning kurtaklari hamda poya va ildiz uchlarida joylashgan, hujayralari faol bo‘linib yangi to‘qima va organlarni hosil qiladigan qismlar. Saqlanayotgan tuganak va piyozlarda o‘suv nuqtalarining faollashishi unish boshlanayotganini ko‘rsatadi.
example_uz: O‘suv nuqtalarining tabaqalanishi va tinim davrining tugashi bilan fiziologik jarayonlar jadallashadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Regions at the tips of shoots and roots or within buds where actively dividing meristematic cells produce new tissues and organs. In stored tubers and bulbs, activation of their growing points marks the onset of sprouting.
example_en: All plant growth initiates at growing points called meristems. (Pasture and Grazing Management in the Northwest. Oregon State University Extension Service, 2025)

definition_uz: Tirik hujayralarda kimyoviy reaksiyalarni tezlashtiradigan biologik katalizatorlar. Fermentlarning aksariyati oqsil tabiatli bo‘lib, ayrim katalitik RNK molekulalari ham fermentlik xususiyatiga ega; meva-sabzavotlarda ular nafas olish, pishish, yumshash va boshqa fiziologik jarayonlarni boshqaradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha fermentum — «achitqi, bijg‘ituvchi modda» so‘zidan ruscha фермент termini orqali o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Fiziologik tinim davrida nafas olish tezligi va fermentlarning aktivligi sust bo‘lib turadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Biological catalysts that accelerate specific biochemical reactions without being consumed in the overall process. Most enzymes are proteins, although some catalytic RNA molecules also function as enzymes; in horticultural produce, enzymes regulate respiration, ripening, softening, and other physiological processes.
etymology_en: From German Enzym, formed from Greek en-, meaning ‘in’, and zymē, meaning ‘leaven’.
example_en: Softening is primarily caused by the degradation of cell wall components, such as pectin and hemicellulose, mediated by enzymes including polygalacturonase and pectin methylesterase. (Postharvest Physiology and Physiological Disorders of Persimmon Fruit. Habibi F., Sarkhosh A., University of Florida IFAS Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning birlamchi hujayra devori va hujayralararo o‘rta plastinkasida uchraydigan, asosan galakturon kislota qoldiqlaridan tuzilgan murakkab polisaxarid. Pektin meva to‘qimalarining tuzilishi va qattiqligini saqlashda qatnashadi hamda shakar va kislota ishtirokida gel hosil qiladi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha pectine termini orqali yunoncha pēktos — «quyuqlashgan, qotgan» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Pektin, shakar va organik kislotalar ishtirokida qizdirganda liqildoq hosil qiladi va bundan povidlo, jem, jele kabi konserva mahsulotlari ishlab chiqarishda keng foydalaniladi. (Meva va sabzavot mahsulotlarini konservalash hamda saqlash texnologiyasi. Egamova K., 2004)
definition_en: A complex, galacturonic-acid-rich polysaccharide occurring mainly in the primary cell walls and middle lamellae of plants. It contributes to fruit tissue structure and firmness and is widely used as a gelling agent in jams, jellies, and other processed foods.
etymology_en: From French pectine, ultimately derived from Greek pēktos, meaning ‘congealed or made solid’.
example_en: Softening is primarily caused by the degradation of cell wall components, such as pectin and hemicellulose, mediated by enzymes including polygalacturonase and pectin methylesterase. (Postharvest Physiology and Physiological Disorders of Persimmon Fruit. Habibi F., Sarkhosh A., University of Florida IFAS Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot uyumidagi mahsulot birliklari orasida qolgan havo bo‘shliqlari hajmining uyumning umumiy hajmiga nisbati. G‘ovaklik ε = (Vbo‘shliq / Vuyum) × 100% formula bilan aniqlanadi. U uyumdagi havo almashinuvi, sovitish va issiqlik tarqalishiga ta’sir qiladi.
example_uz: Saqlash davomida mahsulotlar orasida havoning almashinuvi ularning g‘ovakligiga bog‘liq. Odatda g‘ovaklik 30 dan 50 foizgacha bo‘ladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: The ratio of the volume of interparticle voids within a bulk of fruit or vegetables to the total volume occupied by the bulk. It is expressed as ε = Vvoid/Vbulk or as a percentage and influences airflow resistance, ventilation, cooling, and heat transfer during storage.
example_en: Hoang et al. reported that product properties such as bulk porosity, metabolic heat of respiration, and skin mass transfer coefficient may also affect the product temperature and weight loss. (CFD Simulation of Effects of Operating Parameters and Product on Heat Transfer and Moisture Loss in the Stack of Bagged Potatoes. Chourasia M.K., Goswami T.K., Journal of Food Engineering, 2007)
synonyms_en: Void fraction; Bed porosity; Interparticle porosity

definition_uz: Tirik patogenlar emas, balki noqulay harorat, namlik tanqisligi yoki ortiqligi, oziqa elementlari muvozanatining buzilishi, zaharli moddalar, mexanik shikastlanish va boshqa abiotik omillar ta’sirida yuzaga keladigan, o‘simlikdan o‘simlikka yuqmaydigan kasalliklar.
example_uz: O‘simliklarning kasalliklari ikki guruhga bo‘linadi: yuqumsiz (noinfeksion) va yuqumli (infeksion). (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Yunusov X.B., Xodjayeva N.J., Elmurodov A.A.)
definition_en: Plant diseases or disorders caused by nonliving factors, such as temperature or moisture extremes, nutrient imbalances, chemical toxicity, physical injury, or adverse soil conditions; they are not caused by pathogens and do not spread from plant to plant.
etymology_en: Formed from the prefix non-, meaning “not”, infectious, from Latin inficere — “to taint or infect”, and disease, from Old French desaise — “lack of ease”.
example_en: Abiotic diseases are also referred to as non-infectious diseases as they do not spread from plant to plant. (Plants Get Sick Too! Plant Diseases Idea Starter. American Phytopathological Society)

definition_uz: Germetik qadoqlangan mahsulotga belgilangan harorat va vaqt davomida issiqlik bilan ishlov berib, patogen hamda buzilish keltirib chiqaruvchi mikroorganizmlarni yo‘q qilish va mahsulotning odatdagi saqlash sharoitida mikrobiologik xavfsizligini ta’minlash jarayoni.
etymology_uz: Sterilizatsiya lotincha sterilis — «hosilsiz, bepusht» so‘ziga borib taqaladi
example_uz: Avtoklavlarda yuqori bosim va harorat ta’sirida mahsulotni sterilizatsiyalashdan tashqari uni pishirish yoki quyultirish mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A controlled heat treatment applied to food, usually in a hermetically sealed container, to destroy pathogens and spoilage microorganisms and achieve commercial sterility, so that the product remains safe and microbiologically stable under normal non-refrigerated storage conditions.
etymology_en: Sterilization, recorded from 1826, is an action noun formed from sterilize; sterilize derives from French stériliser or from sterile plus -ize, with sterile ultimately from Latin sterilis — “barren or unproductive”. Its bacteriological sense is recorded from 1878. (Merriam-Webster Dictionary; Online Etymology Dictionary)
example_en: Sterilization as a preservation method may be applied to any product having been peeled, cut or having undergone some other preparation procedure, provided that it has been packaged in an appropriate container and sealed hermetically to prevent the penetration of micro-organisms and oxygen. (Technical Manual on Small-Scale Processing of Fruits and Vegetables. FAO)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotlari, sharbatlar va pyurelarni muayyan haroratda belgilangan vaqt davomida qizdirib, kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi hamda mahsulotni buzuvchi mikroorganizmlarning vegetativ shakllarini kamaytirish yoki yo‘q qilish jarayoni. Pasterizatsiyalash sterilizatsiyalashdan yumshoqroq issiqlik ishlovi bo‘lib, odatda bakteriya sporalarini to‘liq yo‘q qilmaydi, biroq mahsulotning saqlanish muddatini uzaytiradi.
etymology_uz: Termin fransuz kimyogari va mikrobiologi Lui Paster (Louis Pasteur, 1822–1895) familiyasidan hosil qilingan fransuzcha pasteuriser — «pasterizatsiya qilmoq» fe’liga borib taqaladi
example_uz: Pasterizatsiyalash sut sanoatida, pivo tayyorlashda, ayrim tur konserva mahsulotlarini tayyorlashda qo‘llaniladi. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A controlled, relatively mild heat treatment applied to food for a specified time and at a specified temperature to destroy pathogenic microorganisms and reduce spoilage microorganisms while minimizing chemical, physical and sensory changes. It inactivates most vegetative microbial cells but does not normally destroy bacterial spores completely.
etymology_en: Pasteurization is derived from pasteurize, a verb formed from the surname of the French chemist and microbiologist Louis Pasteur (1822–1895), after whose work the process was named, together with the suffixes -ize and -ation.
example_en: Pasteurization consists of a thermal treatment that is less drastic than sterilization, but sufficient to inactivate the disease-causing micro-organisms present in the foods. (Technical Manual on Small-Scale Processing of Fruits and Vegetables. FAO)

definition_uz: Germetik yopilgan banka, tunuka idish yoki boshqa qadoqlardagi mahsulotlarni bosim ostidagi bug‘ yoki issiq suv yordamida 100 °C dan yuqori haroratda termik qayta ishlash va tijorat sterilligiga erishish uchun ishlatiladigan bosimli qurilma.
etymology_uz: Avtoklav termini fransuzcha autoclave so‘ziga borib taqaladi. U yunoncha auto- — «o‘zi» va lotincha clavis — «kalit» qismlaridan tuzilgan bo‘lib, dastlab ichki bosim ta’sirida o‘z-o‘zidan mahkam yopiladigan idishni anglatgan. Termin 1820-yilda fransuz ixtirochisi Pierre-Alexandre Lemare tomonidan qo‘llangan.
example_uz: Avtoklavlarda yuqori bosim va harorat ta’sirida mahsulotni sterilizatsiyalashdan tashqari uni pishirish yoki quyultirish mumkin. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A pressure vessel designed for the thermal processing of food packed in hermetically sealed containers, using an appropriate heating medium and, where necessary, additional pressure to achieve commercial sterility.
etymology_en: In its apparatus sense, retort derives from Medieval Latin retorta, referring to something bent or turned back, from Latin retorquēre — “to twist or turn back”; the name originally referred to the vessel’s curved form.
example_en: The filled sealed can must be heated to a high temperature for a sufficient length of time to ensure the destruction of spoilage micro-organisms. This is usually carried out in an autoclave or retort, in an environment of steam under pressure. (Fruit and Vegetable Processing: General Procedures for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation. FAO)

definition_uz: Butun yoki bo‘laklangan meva va rezavorlarni shakar qiyomida qaynatish orqali olinadigan shirin konserva mahsuloti. Tayyor murabboda mevalar ezilmay, o‘z shaklini saqlashi va qiyomdan ajralib turishi kerak.
etymology_uz: Murabbo arabcha مُرَبَّى (murabbā) — «shakar bilan saqlangan meva, murabbo» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Murabbo tarkibida quruq moddalar, shakar, aromatik moddalar, sulfit kislota va og‘ir metallar miqdori me’yordan oshmasligi kerak. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: A sweet preserved fruit product made by cooking whole fruits or identifiable pieces of fruit with sugar or sugar syrup until the required concentration and consistency are reached, while the fruit largely retains its shape.
etymology_en: Preserve derives through Middle English from Medieval Latin praeservare, formed from Latin prae- — “before” and servare — “to keep or guard”. The noun has been used for fruit preserved with sugar since about 1600.
example_en: Preserves and compotes contain the whole fruits and added sugar. (Fruit and Vegetables: Opportunities and Challenges for Small-Scale Sustainable Farming. FAO)

definition_uz: Maydalangan, ezilgan yoki pyure holiga keltirilgan meva va rezavorlarni shakar bilan qaynatib, quyuq yoki jelesimon konsistensiyaga keltirish orqali olinadigan, surtishga mos shirin konserva mahsuloti. Jemda meva bo‘laklari murabbodagidek o‘z shaklini to‘liq saqlashi shart emas.
etymology_uz: Jem inglizcha jam — «meva va shakarni qaynatib tayyorlangan quyuq mahsulot» terminidan o‘zlashgan. Inglizcha jam mevali mahsulot ma’nosida XVIII asrning 1730-yillaridan qayd etilgan va, ehtimol, «siqmoq, ezmoq» ma’nosidagi jam fe’lidan shakllangan.
example_uz: Jemni tayyorlashda mevalar bir-biri bilan qorishib, jelesimon ko‘rinishga kirishi uchun uni albatta uzoq qaynatish talab qilinadi. (Texnologiya ta’limi metodikasi. Akramov X.M., Abdullayeva O.S., Xusayinova G.A., 2024)
definition_en: A thick, spreadable fruit product made by boiling crushed, pulped or puréed fruit with sugar, with pectin and acid naturally present or added as required, until the desired concentration and gel-like consistency are obtained.
etymology_en: Jam in the sense of a fruit preserve has been recorded since the 1730s. It probably developed from the verb jam — “to press or crush tightly”, referring to fruit being crushed during preparation.
example_en: Jam is made from fruit pulp or juice with added sugar and sometimes added pectin or citric acid. (Processed Foods for Improved Livelihoods. FAO)

definition_uz: Meva yoki rezavor meva pyuresini shakar bilan, zarur hollarda pektin va kislota qo‘shib, bir xil, quyuq va surtiluvchan konsistensiya hosil bo‘lguncha qaynatish orqali olinadigan mahsulot. Unda murabbo va jemdagidek alohida meva bo‘laklari bo‘lmaydi.
etymology_uz: Povidlo shakli ruscha повидло terminiga mos keladi; ruscha termin polyakcha powidło so‘zidan o‘zlashgan. Polyak tilida u dastlab mevalarni, ayniqsa olxo‘rini, uzoq qaynatib quyuqlashtirish natijasida olinadigan mahsulotni anglatgan.
example_uz: Povidlo yopishqoq konsistensiyada tayyorlanadi, shuning uchun bir qism qand og‘irligiga 1,25 qism pyure qo‘shiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A thick, smooth and spreadable fruit product made by concentrating fruit purée or pulp, usually with sugar and sometimes with added acid or pectin, until a uniform consistency and the required soluble-solids content are obtained.
example_en: The fruit butters shall be thick, fine grained, smooth and easily spreadable. (Commercial Item Description: Fruit Butters, A-A-20348A. United States Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Marketing Service, 2019)

definition_uz: Meva yoki rezavorlarning tindirilgan sharbati yoxud suvli ekstraktini shakar bilan qaynatib, tabiiy yoki qo‘shilgan pektin va kislota ta’sirida yarim qattiq, jelsimon konsistensiyaga keltirish orqali olinadigan mahsulot. Jeleda meva eti va erimaydigan zarrachalar deyarli bo‘lmaydi; u odatda tiniq yoki shaffof bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Jele termini fransuzcha gelée — «qotirilgan, jellangan modda» so‘ziga borib taqaladi; gelée fransuzcha geler — «muzlamoq, qotmoq» fe’lidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Jele qaysi sharbatdan olingan bo‘lsa, uning rangi, ta’mi va xushbo‘yligini saqlashi zarur. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
