definition_en: A clear or reasonably transparent fruit product brought to a semi-solid gelled consistency and made from the juice or aqueous extract of one or more fruits mixed with sugar or other permitted sweetening ingredients, with or without added water.
etymology_en: Jelly entered English through Middle English gelly and Old French gelée — “a frost or something congealed”, from the verb geler — “to freeze or congeal”, ultimately from Latin gelare.
example_en: Jellies are the products brought to a semi-solid gelled consistency and made from the juice and/or aqueous extracts of one or more fruits, mixed with foodstuffs with sweetening properties, with or without the addition of water. (Standard for Jams, Jellies and Marmalades, CXS 296-2009. Codex Alimentarius Commission)

definition_uz: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotining o‘z xususiyatlari, tarkibi va tuzilishi orqali insonning oziqlanish ehtiyojini qondira olish qobiliyati. Bu tushuncha mahsulotning oziqlanish uchun nechog‘lik yaroqli va mosligini ifodalaydi hamda undan foydalanish yoki uni iste’mol qilish jarayonida namoyon bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Mahsulot yoki xomashyoning iste’mol qiymatiga o‘simliklarning nav xususiyatlari va yetishtirish sharoitlari ta’sir o‘tkazadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The utility of a food product arising from its composition, properties and structure and from its capacity to satisfy human nutritional needs. In food commodity evaluation, use value indicates how suitable and fit the product is for consumption and is realized when the product is used or consumed.
example_en: Use-value refers to the utility of a commodity or its ability to satisfy wants. (Classical Sociological Theory. SAGE Publications, 2021)

definition_uz: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotining inson organizmini energiya va zarur oziq moddalar — oqsillar, yog‘lar, uglevodlar, vitaminlar hamda mineral moddalar bilan ta’minlash xususiyati. Ozuqaviy qiymat mahsulotning kimyoviy tarkibi, oziq moddalar miqdori, hazm bo‘lishi va organizm tomonidan o‘zlashtirilishiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Mahsulotlarning ozuqaviylik qiymati nafaqat quvvatliligini aniqlash bilan, balki ular tarkibidagi vitaminlar, xushbo‘y moddalar bilan hamda ularning inson organizmiga singishi bilan aniqlanadi. (Meva va sabzavot mahsulotlarini konservalash hamda saqlash texnologiyasi. Egamova K., 2004)
definition_en: The capacity of a food to supply energy and essential nutrients, including proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals, taking into account their amounts, digestibility and availability to the body.
example_en: Fruits and vegetables are consumed mainly for their nutritive value as well as by the variety of shapes, colours, and flavors that make them attractive for food preparation. (Manual for the Preparation and Sale of Fruits and Vegetables: From Field to Market. López Camelo A.F., FAO, 2004)

definition_uz: Ayrim mevalarning pishishi boshlanishida nafas olish jadalligi keskin ortib, eng yuqori darajaga yetadigan fiziologik davr. Bu jarayon odatda etilen hosil bo‘lishining kuchayishi bilan kechadi; klimaksdan keyin nafas olish susayib, mevaning qarishi boshlanadi.
etymology_uz: Klimaks — yunoncha klimaktēr — «zina, pog‘ona; muhim yoki eng yuqori bosqich» ma’nolaridagi so‘zdan shakllangan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Keyin keskin rivojlanish kuzatiladi va bu hol ilk bor olmada aniqlanib, klimakterik (klimaks) deb atalgan. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A stage in the ripening of certain fruits characterized by a rapid increase in respiration rate, usually accompanied by autocatalytic ethylene production. Respiration reaches a peak and subsequently declines as ripening progresses toward senescence.
etymology_en: Climacteric ultimately derives from Greek klimaktēr, meaning «rung of a ladder» or «critical stage», from klimax, meaning «ladder».
example_en: The start of ripening is accompanied by a rapid rise in respiration rate, called the respiratory climacteric. (Prevention of Post-harvest Food Losses: Fruits, Vegetables and Root Crops — A Training Manual. FAO, 1989)

definition_uz: Meva va sabzavotlar hujayralarida organik moddalarning fermentlar ishtirokida parchalanib, hayot faoliyati uchun zarur energiya ajratish jarayoni. Kislorodli nafas olishda, asosan, uglevodlar kislorod yordamida karbonat angidrid va suvgacha oksidlanadi; ajralgan energiyaning bir qismi ATFda to‘planadi, bir qismi issiqlik sifatida chiqadi.
example_uz: Barcha moddalar almashinuvi — polimerizatsiya, gidroliz, moddalarning yuzaga kelishi va harakatlanishi, kurtak shakllanishi, urug‘ va mevalarning yetilishi, himoyaga bo‘lgan ta’sirlanish va boshqa jarayonlar uchun zarur plastik moddalar hamda quvvat nafas olish jarayonida yuzaga keladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. ba boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The cellular process by which organic compounds are broken down to release energy. In aerobic respiration, oxygen is consumed and carbohydrates are oxidized to carbon dioxide and water, with part of the released energy conserved as ATP and part liberated as heat.
etymology_en: From Latin respiratio, meaning «breathing», derived from respirare — «to breathe again or breathe out».
example_en: Respiration is the process by which plants take in oxygen and give out carbon dioxide. (Prevention of Post-harvest Food Losses: Fruits, Vegetables and Root Crops — A Training Manual. FAO, 1989)

definition_uz: Kislotali xususiyatga ega organik birikmalar guruhi. Mevalarda asosan olma, limon va vino kislotalari uchraydi; ular nordon ta’m, pH va umumiy sifatning shakllanishida qatnashadi hamda nafas olish jarayonida energiya manbai sifatida sarflanishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Organik termini yunoncha organikos — «a’zoga yoki tirik tuzilishga oid» so‘zidan, kislota esa ruscha кислота — «kislota» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Mevalarda organik kislotalardan olma (urug‘lilarda), limon (sitruslarda), vino (uzumda) ko‘proq bo‘ladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: Organic compounds with acidic properties, most commonly carboxylic acids. In fruits, organic acids such as malic, citric and tartaric acids contribute to acidity, flavour and pH and may serve as respiratory substrates during ripening and storage.
etymology_en: Organic derives through Latin organicus from Greek organikos — «relating to an organ or instrument»; acid derives from Latin acidus — «sour».
example_en: Organic acids (citric, malic, oxalic, tartaric) are the other important components of taste, particularly in their relationship with soluble solids. (Manual for the Preparation and Sale of Fruits and Vegetables: From Field to Market. López Camelo A.F., FAO, 2004)

definition_uz: Yorug‘likning muayyan to‘lqinlarini tanlab yutishi yoki qaytarishi natijasida meva va sabzavotlarga rang beradigan tabiiy birikmalar. O‘simlik mahsulotlaridagi asosiy pigmentlarga xlorofillar, karotinoidlar, antotsianlar va betalainlar kiradi; ularning tarkibi pishish, saqlash va qayta ishlash jarayonlarida o‘zgarishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Lotincha pigmentum — «bo‘yoq, rang beruvchi modda» so‘zidan shakllangan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Mevalar yetilishida yog‘da aralashadigan pigmentlarning o‘zgarishi quyidagicha bo‘ladi: xlorofill miqdori kamayadi, karotinoidlar esa ko‘payadi. Bu jarayon mevalarni saqlash davrida ham davom etadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch., Merganov A.T., Umidov Sh.E., Abdullayev Z.I., 2022)
definition_en: Naturally occurring compounds that impart colour to fruits and vegetables through selective absorption or reflection of light. The principal groups of plant pigments include chlorophylls, carotenoids, anthocyanins and betalains, whose composition and stability may change during ripening, storage and processing.
etymology_en: From Latin pigmentum — «colouring matter or paint», derived from pingere — «to paint».
example_en: These pigments are classified into four major groups which include the chlorophylls, carotenoids, anthocyanins, and anthoanthins. (Fruit and Vegetable Processing. Dauthy M.E., FAO, 1995)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda hosil bo‘ladigan, oqsillar bilan birikish xususiyatiga ega murakkab polifenol birikmalar guruhi. Mevalardagi eruvchan oshlovchi moddalar taxir ta’mni yuzaga keltiradi; yetilish jarayonida ularning kamayishi taxirlikning susayishiga olib keladi.
example_uz: Mevalar yetila borgan sari ular tarkibidagi qandning miqdori ortib, kislota va oshlovchi moddalar kamayib boradi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A group of astringent plant polyphenols capable of binding and precipitating proteins and other organic compounds. Soluble tannins contribute to fruit astringency, which generally declines during ripening as their concentration or solubility decreases.
etymology_en: From French tanin, derived from tan, meaning crushed oak bark used in tanning leather.
example_en: Astringency due to a high level of tannins also tends to decline at this time. (Processing of Fresh-cut Tropical Fruits and Vegetables: A Technical Guide. James J.B., Ngarmsak T., FAO, 2010)

definition_uz: Tirik hujayra va to‘qimalarda fermentlar ishtirokida kechadigan kimyoviy reaksiyalar hamda metabolik o‘zgarishlar majmui. Meva-sabzavotlarda bu jarayonlar nafas olish, moddalarning sintezlanishi va parchalanishi, pishish, qarish hamda saqlash davridagi sifat o‘zgarishlarini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Meva va sabzavotlarni saqlash jarayonida turli xil fizikaviy va biokimyoviy jarayonlar ro‘y berib, ular mahsulotning sifatiga va saqlanuvchanligiga katta ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. (Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari ekspertizasi. Qanoatov X., 2018)
definition_en: Chemical reactions, enzyme activities, and metabolic pathways occurring in living cells and tissues. In fruit and vegetables, these processes underlie respiration, synthesis and degradation of cellular constituents, ripening, senescence, and postharvest quality changes.
example_en: Senescence is the period when synthetic biochemical processes give way to degradative processes, leading to death of tissue. (Good Practice in the Design, Management and Operation of a Fresh Produce Packing-House. FAO, 2012)

definition_uz: O‘simlik va uning organlarining tashqi tuzilishini ifodalovchi kuzatiladigan yoki o‘lchanadigan belgilar majmui. Ularga o‘simlikning o‘sish shakli, bo‘yi, shoxlanishi hamda barg, gul va mevalarning shakli, o‘lchami, rangi, joylashishi va sirt xususiyatlari kiradi; bu belgilar o‘simliklarni tavsiflash, aniqlash va navlarni farqlashda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Biz yuqorida aytib o‘tgan quruq iqlim sharoitida o‘sadigan o‘simliklar uchun tipik bo‘lgan morfologik belgilar bu guruhlarning har qaysisi uchun u yoki bu darajada xosdir. (O‘simliklar ekologiyasi. Yunusov X.B. va boshq., 2024)
definition_en: Observable or measurable features of the external form and structure of a plant and its organs. They include plant habit, height and branching, as well as the shape, size, colour, arrangement and surface features of leaves, flowers and fruits, and are used in plant description, identification and variety differentiation.
example_en: Variety registration and protection in roses is based on morphological characteristics described in the UPOV guidelines. (Microsatellite Markers for Identification and Registration of Rose Varieties. Vosman B., Esselink D., Smulders R., UPOV, 2014)

definition_uz: Meva o‘simligi yoki navining o‘sishi, rivojlanishi, ko‘payishi, hosil berishi va tashqi muhitga munosabatini ifodalovchi belgilar majmui. Mevachilikda ularga daraxtning o‘sish kuchi, kurtaklarning uyg‘onuvchanligi, gullash va pishish muddati, hosilga kirishi, solkashligi hamda sovuq, kasallik va boshqa noqulay omillarga chidamliligi kiradi.
example_uz: Navning biologik belgilari. Ertapishar nav, mevalarining texnik yetilishi 85–95 kun, biologik yetilishi 125–135 kun. (Achchiq qalampir (Capsicum annuum L.)ning himoyalangan joylarda yetishtirish uchun yangi navlarini yaratish. Xushvaqtov N.J., 2024)
definition_en: Characteristics expressing the growth, development, reproduction, productivity, and environmental responses of a fruit plant or cultivar. In pomology, they include growth vigour, budbreak, flowering and ripening time, bearing behaviour, and resistance to cold, diseases, and other adverse factors.
example_en: For instance, in Salvard village, Sisian region, there are many local varieties with different morphological and biological characteristics. (Conservation of Genetic Resources and Their Use in Traditional Food Production Systems by Small Farmers of the Southern Caucasus. FAO, 2010)

definition_uz: Meva yoki sabzavot navi mahsulotining muayyan usulda qayta ishlashga yaroqliligini belgilovchi fizik, kimyoviy va organoleptik xususiyatlar majmui. Ularga quruq modda va eruvchan qattiq moddalar miqdori, kislotalilik, qandlilik, etning qattiqligi, rang, tekstura, ta’m, sharbat yoki mag‘iz chiqimi hamda ishlov berish vaqtida sifatning saqlanishi kiradi.
example_uz: Meva ekinlari xo‘jalik va biologik belgilariga qarab, ekinlarning o‘sish sharoitiga talabi, tuproq-iqlim sharoitiga moslashganligi, mevalarning ozuqa va texnologik xususiyatlari, morfologik o‘xshashligi va qayta ishlashga bo‘lgan munosabatlariga qarab guruhlanadi. (Meva va rezavor meva ekinlari seleksiyasi va navshunosligi. Ergashev I.T., 2007)
definition_en: Physical, chemical, and sensory characteristics that determine the suitability and performance of fruit or vegetable material for a particular processing method. They include dry matter, soluble solids, acidity, sugar content, firmness, colour, texture, flavour, juice or pulp yield, and quality retention during processing.
example_en: Newly developed grape cultivars such as ‘Shine Muscat’ and ‘Oriental Star’ have processing characteristics suitable for our method: they are thin-skinned and the skin does not easily slip off. (Practical Application of Novel Semi-dried Fruit Prepared by Microwave Irradiation Pretreatment and Hot Air Drying. Fujiwara T., Kubo T., Sago T., Yamaoka C., Yamazaki E., Kondo H., 2020)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotining muayyan saqlash sharoitida belgilangan vaqt davomida vazni, tovar ko‘rinishi, oziqaviy va organoleptik sifatini imkon qadar saqlab qolish xususiyati. Saqlanuvchanlik nav, pishganlik darajasi, mahsulotning fiziologik holati, harorat, nisbiy namlik, gaz muhiti va saqlash davomiyligiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Tinim davri qancha uzoq davom etsa, u yoki bu sabzavot navining saqlanuvchanligi shunchalik yuqori yoki aksincha bo‘ladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The ability of fruit or vegetable produce to retain its marketability, mass, firmness, nutritional composition, and sensory quality for a specified period under defined storage conditions. Storability is influenced by cultivar, maturity, physiological condition, temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric composition, and storage duration.
example_en: The first storage experiments conducted with CH201/FRED® showed good storability when kept in a regular atmosphere, comparable to Conference pears stored under controlled atmosphere conditions and harvested at similar firmness levels. (Pruning and Flower Thinning Influence the Storability of CH201/FRED® Pears. Gabioud Rebeaud S. et al., 2025)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavot mahsulotining saqlash davomida fiziologik buzilish, suv va massa yo‘qotilishi, yumshash, qorayish, chirish hamda mikroorganizmlar ta’siriga qarshilik ko‘rsatish xususiyati. U mahsulot turi va naviga xos tabiiy-biologik xususiyat bo‘lib, po‘st va etning tuzilishi, pishganlik darajasi hamda fiziologik holatga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Mahsulotlarning saqlashga chidamliligi ularni qulay sharoitda saqlash muddati bilan aniqlanadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi: ma’ruza matnlari. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: The inherent ability of harvested fruit or vegetable produce to withstand physiological deterioration, water and mass loss, softening, browning, decay, and microbial damage during storage. It is influenced by cultivar, maturity, tissue and peel structure, physiological condition, and storage environment.
example_en: The storage tolerance of each cultivar was evaluated according to the terminal browning index, acid value, and sensory quality. (Differential Responses of Walnut Cultivars to Cold Storage and Their Correlation with Postharvest Physiological Parameters. Yuan X., Huang S., Ma H., Huang N., Ye N., 2019)

definition_uz: Mahsulotning belgilangan saqlash sharoitida sifati, iste’molga yaroqliligi va tovar xususiyatlarini maqbul darajada saqlab turadigan vaqt oralig‘i. Uning davomiyligi mahsulot turi va navi, yetilganlik darajasi, harorat, nisbiy namlik, gaz muhiti, qadoqlash hamda sanitariya sharoitlariga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Meva terish, uzum uzish muddatlari va texnologik talablarga to‘liq rioya qilingan holda o‘tkazilishi mahsulotning nafaqat sifatiga, balki uni saqlash muddatiga ham katta ta’sir etadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The period during which a horticultural product retains acceptable quality, marketability, and fitness for consumption under specified storage conditions. Storage life is affected by the commodity and cultivar, maturity, temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric composition, packaging, and sanitation.
example_en: Lower temperatures slow respiration rates and the ripening and senescence processes, which prolongs the storage life of fruits and vegetables. (Storage Conditions: Fruits and Vegetables. Gast K.L.B., Kansas State University Cooperative Extension Service; University of Maine Cooperative Extension, 2001)

definition_uz: Mahsulot omborga joylashtirilgan paytdan saqlash tugaguniga qadar davom etadigan texnologik jarayon yoki vaqt oralig‘i. Bu davrda mahsulotning harorati, namligi, nafas olishi, massa yo‘qotishi, yetilishi va sifat o‘zgarishlari nazorat qilinadi.
example_uz: Saqlash davrida mahsulotlar orasida havoning almashinuvi ularning g‘ovakligiga bog‘liq. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The interval or operational phase during which harvested produce is kept under specified storage conditions. Product temperature, water loss, respiration, ripening, decay, and other quality changes may be monitored throughout this period.
example_en: Hence, in order to ensure good sensory quality and to fulfill consumer’s preference during distribution, further ripening studies like exogenous ethylene treatment are necessary immediately after harvest or at any time during the storage period. (Harvest Time Affects Quality and Storability of Kiwifruit (Actinidia spp.): Cultivars during Long-Term Cool Storage. Choi H.R., Tilahun S., Park D.S., Lee Y.M., Choi J.H., Baek M.W., Jeong C.S., 2019)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning noqulay abiotik yoki biotik omillar ta’sirida hayotiy faoliyati, o‘sishi va hosildorligini muayyan darajada saqlab, zararni cheklash xususiyati. Chidamlilik omil turiga, o‘simlikning genetik xususiyatlariga, rivojlanish bosqichiga va muhit sharoitiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: O‘simliklarning shunday noqulay omillar ta’siriga nisbatan javob reaksiyasi ularning chidamlilik xususiyatidir. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Xo‘jayev J.X., 2004)
definition_en: The ability of a plant to withstand an adverse abiotic or biotic factor while limiting damage and maintaining an acceptable level of physiological activity, growth, survival, or yield.
etymology_en: From Latin tolerantia, meaning endurance or the capacity to bear.
example_en: Plants’ defenses against herbivores usually include both resistance and tolerance mechanisms. (Wild Strawberry Shows Genetic Variation in Tolerance but Not Resistance to a Generalist Herbivore. Wang M., Muola A., Anderson P., Stenberg J.A., 2020)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning patogen yuqishini, uning to‘qimalarda ko‘payishi va tarqalishini yoki kasallik rivojlanishini to‘liq yoxud qisman cheklash xususiyati. Kasallikka chidamlilik irsiy va fiziologik himoya mexanizmlariga, patogen xususiyatlariga hamda muhit sharoitiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: O‘simliklardagi barcha irsiy belgilar, jumladan, kasalliklarga chidamlilik xususiyatlari genlar vositasida nazorat qilinishini Biffen 1917-yilda birinchi bo‘lib aytgan edi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X. va boshq., 2017)
definition_en: The inherent or acquired ability of a plant to prevent infection or restrict pathogen establishment, multiplication, spread, and subsequent disease development. Disease resistance may be complete or partial and is determined by interactions among the host genotype, pathogen, and environment.
example_en: Research by ARS computational biologist Angela Baldo indicates that these three members of the Rosaceae plant family share key genetic traits for disease resistance. (Fruitful Disease-Resistance Findings. Perry A., USDA Agricultural Research Service, 2009)
synonyms_en: Resistance to disease; host resistance to diseases

definition_uz: Suvning tuproq, ochiq suv yoki boshqa nam sathlardan bug‘ holatiga o‘tib atmosferaga tarqalish jarayoni. Tuproq yuzasida kuchli bug‘lanish namlikning kamayishiga va kapillyar oqim orqali erigan tuzlarning yuqori qatlamlarga ko‘tarilib, to‘planishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Sug‘orilganda suv chiqmagan tepa va do‘ngliklarda bug‘lanishning kuchayishi va bu joyga tuzlar so‘rilib kela boshlashi natijasida tuzli dog‘lar paydo bo‘ladi.(Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The physical process by which liquid water is converted into water vapour and removed from soil, open water or another moist surface. Strong evaporation from soil can promote the upward capillary movement and surface accumulation of dissolved salts.
etymology_en: Derived from Latin evaporare, meaning ‘to disperse in vapour’.
example_en: Evaporation is the process whereby liquid water is converted to water vapour and removed from the evaporating surface. (Crop Evapotranspiration: Guidelines for Computing Crop Water Requirements. Allen R.G. et al., FAO, 1998)
field_en: Agrobiological Foundations → Irrigation and Land Reclamation

definition_uz: Saqlash jarayonida meva-sabzavot to‘qimalaridagi suvning po‘st, kutikula, og‘izchalar va boshqa tabiiy teshiklar orqali bug‘ holida tashqi muhitga chiqishi. Natijada mahsulot massasi va turgori kamayib, u so‘liydi hamda saqlanuvchanligi pasayadi.
example_uz: Saqlash jarayonida mahsulotlar suvni ko‘p miqdorda bug‘latadi, terlaydi va natijada so‘lib qoladi. Bug‘lanish miqdori mevaning turi, navi, morfologik tuzilishi hamda uning kimyoviy tarkibiga bog‘liq. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: The loss of water vapour from harvested fruit and vegetable tissues through the cuticle, stomata, lenticels and other surface structures, resulting in weight loss, loss of turgor and wilting.
etymology_en: Derived from the Latin transpirare, meaning ‘to breathe or pass through’.
example_en: Transpiration rates (water loss from produce) are determined by the moisture content of the air, which is usually expressed as relative humidity. (Storage Conditions: Fruits and Vegetables. Gast K.L.B., Kansas State University Cooperative Extension Service, 2001)

definition_uz: O‘simlik organlari, jumladan meva va sabzavotlar epidermisi yuzasida himoya qatlami hosil qiladigan suvda erimaydigan lipid moddalar majmui. Mum qatlami suv yo‘qotilishi va patogenlarning kirishini kamaytiradi hamda to‘qimalarni ayrim tashqi ta’sirlardan himoya qiladi. Meva yuzasiga sun’iy mum qoplamalari ham saqlash davrida namlik yo‘qotilishini kamaytirish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Mumlar himoya vazifasini bajaradi. Jumladan, o‘simlik organlaridagi namlikning bug‘lanishi va patogen mikroorganizmlarning kirishidan saqlaydi. Saqlash amaliyotida isrofni kamaytirish maqsadida mevalar yuziga mum va moyli emulsiyalar sepilib, maxsus tarkibli gidrofob plyonkalar yopiladi.(Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A water-insoluble lipid material occurring naturally on the epidermal surface of plant organs, including fruits and vegetables. Natural wax forms part of the protective surface barrier and helps restrict water loss and pathogen entry; applied wax coatings may also be used to reduce postharvest moisture loss.
etymology_en: From Old English weax, meaning ‘wax’.
example_en: Fortunately, many fruits and some vegetables have a natural wax coating that slows the loss of water. (Introduction to the Postharvest Engineering for Fresh Fruits and Vegetables: A Practical Guide for Growers, Packers, Shippers, and Sellers. Boyette M. et al., NC State Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Asosan glitserin va yog‘ kislotalaridan tuzilgan triatsilglitserollardan iborat, suvda erimaydigan organik modda. Yog‘lar o‘simliklarda energiya zaxirasi sifatida to‘planadi; ko‘pchilik meva-sabzavotlarning et qismida kam, urug‘, danak mag‘zi va ayrim moyli mevalarda esa ko‘p miqdorda uchraydi.
example_uz: Yog‘lar ko‘p miqdorda urug‘larda uchraydi. Danakli mevalarning mag‘zida, poliz urug‘larida o‘rtacha 20–60 foizni tashkil etadi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: A storage lipid consisting predominantly of triacylglycerols formed from glycerol and fatty acids. Fats serve as concentrated energy reserves in plants and commonly accumulate in seeds, kernels and certain oil-bearing fruits.
etymology_en: From Old English fǣtt, referring to fat or fatty material.
example_en: The fat content in the other examined seeds used as functional products or food ingredients ranged from 20 to over 50 g·100 g−1. (Fatty Acid Composition of Pseudocereals and Seeds Used as Functional Food Ingredients. Czerwonka M., Białek A., 2023)

definition_uz: O‘simlik va uning mahsulotlari tarkibida ionlar yoki turli birikmalar holida uchraydigan noorganik elementlar majmui. Kaliy, kalsiy, magniy va fosfor makroelementlarga, temir, rux, mis va marganes esa mikroelementlarga kiradi. Ular o‘simlikdagi suv almashinuvi, fermentlar faoliyati, hujayra tuzilishi va boshqa fiziologik jarayonlarda qatnashadi.
etymology_uz: Mineral termini lotincha mineralis — «konga oid» so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Mevalar va uzumda bir qator mineral moddalar — fosfor, sulfat, borat, silikat kislota va bir qator organik kislotalarning tuzlari shaklida bo‘ladi. Umuman olganda, mevalarning tarkibida 60 dan ziyod mineral modda borligi ma’lum. (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: Inorganic elements occurring in plant tissues and foods in ionic or combined forms. They include major elements such as potassium, calcium, magnesium and phosphorus and trace elements such as iron, zinc, copper and manganese, which participate in structural, enzymatic and physiological functions.
etymology_en: From Medieval Latin minerale, derived from minera, meaning ‘mine or ore’.
example_en: Vegetables are more rich in mineral substances as compared with fruits. The mineral substance content is normally between 0.60 and 1.80% and more than 60 elements are present. (Fruit and Vegetable Processing: General Properties of Fruit and Vegetables. FAO, 1995)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavotlar po‘sti, eti yoki qayta ishlangan mahsulotlar rangining qo‘ng‘ir yoxud to‘q tusga o‘zgarishi. Qorayish kesilgan yoki shikastlangan to‘qimalarda polifenoloksidaza ishtirokidagi fermentativ oksidlanish; Mayyar reaksiyasi va karamelizatsiya kabi nofermentativ reaksiyalar; past harorat, gaz muhiti yoki modda almashinuvining buzilishi bilan bog‘liq fiziologik shikastlanishlar natijasida yuz berishi mumkin.
example_uz: Tozalangan mevalarni qorayishdan saqlash uchun ular 0,5–1 foizli limon yoki vino kislotasi eritmasida saqlanadi. Yovvoyi olmalar urug‘idan tozalanadi va butun holda qaynatiladi.  (Qishloq xo‘jalik mahsulotlarini saqlash va dastlabki ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: The development of brown or dark discoloration in the skin, flesh or processed products of fruits and vegetables. Browning may result from enzymatic oxidation of phenolic compounds in cut or damaged tissues; non-enzymatic reactions such as the Maillard reaction and caramelization; or physiological disorders caused by chilling, abnormal storage atmospheres and metabolic disruption.
example_en: Enzymatic browning is a widespread color reaction occurring in fruits and vegetables and tea leaves. (Elucidation of the Mechanism of Enzymatic Browning Inhibition by Sodium Chlorite. He Q., Luo Y., Chen P., 2008)

definition_uz: Meva-sabzavotlarni saqlash davomida ularning sifati va saqlanuvchanligiga ta’sir qiladigan tashqi muhit omillari majmui. Saqlash sharoiti, asosan, harorat, havoning nisbiy namligi, gaz tarkibi, havo almashinuvi, yorug‘lik va sanitariya holatini qamrab oladi.
example_uz: Bu mahsulotlarni saqlash sharoiti bir-biridan tafovut qiladi va ularni bir omborda saqlash tavsiya etilmaydi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Saydalov F.M., 2022)
definition_en: The combination of environmental conditions under which harvested produce is kept, particularly temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric composition, ventilation, light and sanitation. Appropriate storage conditions slow physiological deterioration, water loss and microbial decay and help maintain produce quality.
example_en: Proper storage conditions—temperature and humidity—are needed to lengthen storage life and maintain quality once the crop has been cooled to the optimum storage temperature. (Storage Conditions: Fruits and Vegetables. Gast K.L.B., Kansas State University Cooperative Extension Service, 2001)

definition_uz: Saqlash joyiga tashqi havoni kiritish va ichki havoni chiqarish orqali havoni tabiiy yoki mexanik usulda almashtirish jarayoni. Shamollatish mahsulotdan ajralgan issiqlik, ortiqcha namlik, karbonat angidrid va etilenni chiqarib, saqlash muhitini me’yorlashtiradi.
example_uz: Meva va sabzavotlar haroratining oshishini aniqlash orqali qaysi vaqtda shamollatish zarurligini bilishimiz mumkin. (Meva-sabzavotlarni saqlashni axborot-kommunikatsiya tizimlari yordamida boshqarishni tadqiq etish. Sharipova N.R., 2016)
definition_en: The natural or mechanical supply of outside air to, and removal of internal air from, a produce storage space. Ventilation removes respiratory heat and accumulated gases, including carbon dioxide and ethylene, and helps regulate storage temperature and humidity.
etymology_en: From Latin ventilare, meaning ‘to fan’ or ‘expose to the wind’.
example_en: Ventilated storage is ambient air storage which makes use of controlled ventilation for cooling of the produce and maintenance of lower temperatures. (Production Is Only Half the Battle: A Training Manual in Fresh Produce Marketing for the Eastern Caribbean. FAO, 1986)

definition_uz: Kartoshka, ildizmevalar va boshqa sabzavotlarni mavsumiy saqlash uchun yer ustiga yoki sayoz chuqurlikka uzun to‘p qilib joylashtirib, poxol va tuproq bilan yopish orqali hosil qilinadigan muvaqqat saqlash inshootlari. Uyumlar havo kiritish-chiqarish yo‘llari va haroratni nazorat qilish vositalari bilan jihozlanishi mumkin.
example_uz: Uyumlar — uzun shtabellarga to‘kma holda solingan mahsulotlar bo‘lib, yer ustida yoki unchalik chuqur bo‘lmagan kotlavan ko‘rinishidagi joyda poxol va tuproq bilan yopiladi. (Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Buriev X.Ch. va boshq., 2022)
definition_en: Temporary outdoor storage structures formed by heaping potatoes, root crops or other suitable vegetables on the ground or in a shallow excavation and covering them with straw and soil. Ventilation ducts or openings may be incorporated to remove respiratory heat and regulate the storage temperature.
example_en: When storing potatoes, a field storage clamp is a low-cost technology that can be designed using locally available materials for ventilation and insulation. (Small-Scale Postharvest Handling Practices: A Manual for Horticultural Crops. Kitinoja L. and Kader A.A., 2002)

definition_uz: Kartoshka, sabzi va boshqa ildizmevalarni mavsumiy saqlash uchun yerga cho‘ziq va nisbatan tor shaklda qaziladigan muvaqqat saqlash joyi. Xandaqqa mahsulot to‘kma yoki qatlamlab joylashtirilib, usti poxol, qamish va tuproq bilan yopiladi; zarur hollarda havo almashinuvi uchun shamollatish yo‘li o‘rnatiladi.
etymology_uz: Arabcha «xandaq» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; bu so‘z arab tiliga o‘rta fors tilidagi «kandag» — «qazilgan joy» so‘zidan kirgan.
example_uz: Sabzini kichikroq xandaqda saqlash keng tarqalgan. Xandaqlarning o‘lchami eni 40–45 sm, chuqurligi 60–70 sm va uzunligi 2,5–3,0 m bo‘lishi lozim. (Mutaxassislikka kirish fanidan amaliy mashg‘ulotlarni bajarish uchun uslubiy ko‘rsatma. Xudayberdiyev T., 2017)
definition_en: A long, relatively narrow excavation used for the temporary or seasonal storage of potatoes, root crops and other suitable vegetables. The produce is placed in bulk or layers and protected with straw, soil or similar insulating materials.
example_en: Among the outdoor methods for storing produce that they propose are mounds, storage trenches, and wood box safes. (Storing Produce. Clark County Master Gardeners, Washington State University Extension, 2008)

definition_uz: Organizmlarga ta’sir qiladigan jonsiz muhitning fizik va kimyoviy omillari. Ularga harorat, namlik, yorug‘lik, havo harakati, suv, tuproq xususiyatlari va atmosfera tarkibi kiradi; noqulay darajada bo‘lsa, hasharotlar hayot faoliyatini o‘zgartirishi yoki o‘simliklarda noinfeksion kasalliklarni yuzaga keltirishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: «Abiotik» xalqaro termin bo‘lib, yunoncha a- — «yo‘qlik, inkor» va bios — «hayot» qismlaridan shakllangan; «jonsiz, hayotga ega bo‘lmagan» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Abiotik omillardan hayotiy muhit sharoitini yaratishda iqlim omillari — issiqlik, namlik, yorug‘lik va havo harakati muhim rol o‘ynaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Non-living physical and chemical components of the environment that affect the development, distribution and health of organisms. They include temperature, moisture, light, air movement, water, soil properties and atmospheric composition.
etymology_en: Formed from the Greek prefix a- meaning ‘without’ and biōtikos meaning ‘pertaining to life’, ultimately from bios, ‘life’.
example_en: The many reasons for the disruption of the healthy growth of a tree can be divided into two main categories: living biotic and non-living abiotic factors. (An Illustrated Guide to the State of Health of Trees. Boa E., FAO, 2003)

definition_uz: Inson faoliyati natijasida yuzaga kelib, tirik organizmlar va tabiiy muhitga bevosita yoki bilvosita ta’sir ko‘rsatadigan omillar. Ularga yerlarni o‘zlashtirish, sug‘orish tizimlarini qurish, pestitsidlarni qo‘llash, organizmlarni ko‘paytirish va tarqatish kabi faoliyatlar kiradi.
etymology_uz: Antropogen — yunoncha «ánthrōpos» — «inson» va «-genēs» — «hosil bo‘lgan, kelib chiqqan» unsurlaridan tuzilgan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Antropogen omillar — tabiatga va organizmlarga odam faoliyatining ta’siri: qo‘riq yerlarni o‘zlashtirish, irrigatsiya sistemalarini qurish, zararkunandalarga qarshi kurash, entomofaglarni ko‘paytirish, tarqatish va hokazolar. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Factors arising from human activities that directly or indirectly affect living organisms and the natural environment. They include land conversion, irrigation, pest-control practices, pollution, and the introduction or redistribution of organisms.
etymology_en: Anthropogenic is formed from Greek «ánthrōpos», meaning «human», and «-genēs», meaning «produced or originating».
example_en: Climate change and anthropogenic factors play interactive roles under different soil and terrain conditions. (Quantifying Influences of Natural and Anthropogenic Factors on Vegetation Changes Using Structural Equation Modeling. Yang L. et al., 2021)

definition_uz: Suv va tuproqning organizmlar uchun yashash muhiti sifatidagi ta’sirini ifodalovchi ekologik omillar. Ular muhitning namligi, suv rejimi, tuproq tuzilishi va tarkibi orqali hasharotlarning yashashi, rivojlanishi hamda tarqalishiga ta’sir qiladi.
etymology_uz: Gidroedafik — yunoncha «hýdōr» — «suv» va «édaphos» — «tuproq, yer» so‘zlaridan hosil qilingan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Gidro-edafik, ya’ni suv-tuproq omillari — suv va tuproqning organizmga muhim yashash muhiti sifatidagi ta’siri. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Environmental factors associated with water and soil conditions that affect the survival, development, abundance, and distribution of organisms. In insect ecology, they include soil moisture, water regime, soil structure, and related habitat properties.
etymology_en: Hydroedaphic is formed from Greek «hýdōr», meaning «water», and «édaphos», meaning «ground or soil».
example_en: The spread of insects is determined first of all by the specificity of hydroedaphic factors in each biotope type associated, inter alia, with their altitudinal localization. (Species Diversity and Biotopic Distribution of Herpetobiont Coleopterans in the Nether-Polar Urals. Contemporary Problems of Ecology, 2002)

definition_uz: Tirik organizmlar va ular o‘rtasidagi munosabatlarning boshqa organizmlarga ko‘rsatadigan ekologik ta’siri. Hasharotlar ekologiyasida oziqlanish, raqobat, yirtqichlik, parazitizm, kasalliklar va simbioz kabi ta’sirlarni qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Biotik — yunoncha «biōtikós» — «hayotga, tirik organizmlarga oid» so‘zidan kelib chiqqan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Tabiatdagi tirik organizmlar muhitning biotik omili sifatida hasharotlar organizmiga ta’sir etadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Living components of an ecosystem and the interactions through which organisms affect one another. In insect ecology, these factors include host and food availability, competition, predation, parasitism, pathogens, and symbiotic relationships.
etymology_en: Biotic derives from Greek «biōtikós», meaning «pertaining to life», ultimately from «bíos» — «life».
example_en: Their activity is partially regulated by biotic factors, e.g., host abundance, host quality; physical factors, e.g., soil, climate; and disturbances. (Insects and Diseases. Coulston J.W., 2009)

definition_uz: Tirik hayvonlar yoki ularning to‘qimalari hisobiga oziqlanadigan organizmlar. Entomologiyada zoofag hasharotlar, asosan, o‘ljani tutib iste’mol qiluvchi yirtqichlar hamda xo‘jayin organizm hisobiga yashovchi parazit va parazitoidlarga ajratiladi.
etymology_uz: Zoofag — yunoncha «zōion» — «hayvon» va «phagein» — «yemoq» so‘zlaridan hosil qilingan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Zoofaglar faqat hayvonlar bilan oziqlanadigan hasharotlardir. O‘z navbatida, bu hasharotlar yirtqichlar va parazitlarga bo‘linadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Organisms that feed on living animal material. In entomology, zoophagous insects principally include predators that capture and consume prey and parasites or parasitoids that feed on or develop in host organisms.
etymology_en: Zoophage is formed from Greek «zōion», meaning «animal», and «phagein», meaning «to eat».
example_en: Moreover, we classified the non-saproxylic species collected during sampling as either phytophages (herbivores) or zoophages (predators), based on a knowledge of their biology and reference literature. (Stable Isotopes of Saproxylic Beetles Reveal Low Differences Among Trophic Guilds and Suggest a High Dependence on Fungi. Kozel P. et al., 2025)

definition_uz: Har xil turga mansub organizmlar o‘rtasidagi munosabat bo‘lib, bunda bir tur yashash joyi, himoya yoki tashilish imkoniyatiga ega bo‘ladi, ikkinchi tur esa sezilarli foyda ham, zarar ham ko‘rmaydi.
etymology_uz: Termin yunoncha «sýn» — «birga» va «oîkos» — «uy, yashash joyi» unsurlaridan shakllangan «synoikía» — «birga yashash» so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Sinoyya — birga yashovchilar turining biriga foydali va ikkinchisiga foydasiz bo‘lgan hamjihatlik. Masalan, bir indan birga foydalanish yoki yirik turlar mayda turlarni o‘z ustida olib yurishi va ularning tarqalishini osonlashtirishi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: An ecological association between two species in which one species benefits while the other is neither significantly benefited nor harmed. In entomology, it particularly describes tolerated guests living in the nests or shelters of social insects.
etymology_en: Synoecy derives from Greek «synoikía», meaning «living together or community», from «sýn» — «together» and «oîkos» — «house or dwelling».
example_en: Escherich (1917), possibly based on Silvestri’s (1912) observations, qualified the genus Cholovocera as myrmecophilous in a synoecy, a strategy where ants are indifferent to their cohabiting beetles. (A Revision of the Genus Cholovocera Victor, 1838 (Coleoptera: Endomychidae). Delgado J.A., Palma R.L., 2023)

definition_uz: Chala o‘zgarish bilan rivojlanadigan, odatda kemiruvchi og‘iz apparatiga, qalinlashgan oldingi qanotlarga va sakrashga moslashgan kuchli orqa oyoqlarga ega hasharotlar turkumi. Turkumga chigirtkalar, temirchaklar, chirildoqlar va buzoqboshilar kiradi.
example_uz: To‘g‘riqanotlilar (Orthoptera), ninachilar (Odonata), qo‘ng‘izlar, tanga qanotlilar (arrakashlar — Tenthredinidae)ning og‘iz apparati kemiruvchi tipda bo‘ladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Hemimetabolous insects belonging to the order Orthoptera, which includes grasshoppers, locusts, crickets, katydids and their relatives. They typically have chewing mouthparts, leathery forewings called tegmina and hind legs modified for jumping. The order comprises the suborders Caelifera and Ensifera.
etymology_en: Orthoptera is formed from Greek «orthós» — «straight» and «pterón» — «wing».
example_en: Most orthopterans are plant feeders, but they can be predators, scavengers, or omnivores. (Extension Gardener Handbook: Insects. North Carolina State University Extension, 2021)

definition_uz: Ilgari alohida turkum yoki Hemiptera tarkibidagi kenja turkum sifatida qaralgan, asosan o‘simlik shirasini so‘rib oziqlanuvchi hasharotlarning tarixiy guruhi. Unga shiralar, oqqanotlar, qalqondorlar, barg burgachalari, sikadalar va saratonlar kiritilgan. Homoptera parafiletik guruh bo‘lganligi sababli zamonaviy tasnifda mustaqil takson sifatida tan olinmaydi; uning vakillari Hemiptera turkumining, asosan, Sternorrhyncha va Auchenorrhyncha guruhlariga joylashtiriladi.
example_uz: Tengqanotlilar turkumiga mansub hasharotlarning boshi engashib joylashgan, jag‘ va lab paypaslagichlari yo‘q, og‘iz apparati sanchib-so‘ruvchi tipda tuzilgan. O‘simliklar shirasi bilan oziqlanadi, ko‘pchiligi galalashib yashaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Members of the historically recognized insect group Homoptera, which included aphids, whiteflies, scale insects, psyllids, cicadas, leafhoppers and planthoppers. Most feed on plant sap with piercing-sucking mouthparts. Homoptera is now regarded as paraphyletic and is no longer formally recognized; its members are placed mainly in Sternorrhyncha and Auchenorrhyncha within the order Hemiptera.
etymology_en: Homoptera is formed from Greek «homós» — «same or uniform» and «pterón» — «wing», referring to the traditionally recognized uniform structure of the forewings.
example_en: Homoptera is not monophyletic and is no longer formally recognized in classifications. Instead, the entire group of true bugs is considered one order, Hemiptera sensu lato. (Insect Classification Standards for the University of Georgia Entomology Department. University of Georgia, 2025)

definition_uz: Og‘iz apparati sanchib-so‘ruvchi tipda tuzilgan, oldingi qanotlarining asosiy qismi qalinlashgan va terisimon, uchki qismi esa pardasimon bo‘lgan hasharotlar guruhi. Eski tasnifda tor ma’nodagi Hemiptera turkumi deb qaralgan bu guruh zamonaviy tasnifda Hemiptera turkumining Heteroptera kenja turkumiga mos keladi.
example_uz: Yarimqattiqqanotlilar turkumiga tashqi ko‘rinishi xilma-xil, og‘iz apparati sanchib-so‘ruvchi tipda tuzilgan, ko‘proq quruqlikda va qisman suvda hayot kechirishga moslashgan hasharotlar kiradi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Insects belonging to the suborder Heteroptera of the order Hemiptera. They typically possess piercing-sucking mouthparts and forewings called hemelytra, whose basal portion is thickened and leathery while the apical portion is membranous.
etymology_en: Heteroptera is formed from Greek heteros, meaning “different”, and pteron, meaning “wing”, referring to the two differently textured portions of the forewings.
example_en: The Heteroptera, commonly called true bugs, are one of four suborders in the order Hemiptera. (Heteroptera. International Heteropterists’ Society, 2022)

definition_uz: Tanasi mayda va cho‘ziq, og‘iz apparati sanchib-so‘ruvchi, qanotlari ingichka hamda chetlari uzun tuklar bilan hoshiyalangan hasharotlar turkumi. Ko‘pchilik turlari o‘simlik to‘qimalari bilan oziqlanib, ekinlarga zarar yetkazadi va ayrim o‘simlik viruslarini tarqatadi; yirtqich turlari ham mavjud.
etymology_uz: Trips — yunoncha «thrips», ya’ni «yog‘och qurti» ma’nosidagi nomdan shakllangan xalqaro entomologik termin.
example_uz: Tripslar juda mayda (0,5 mm) hasharotlar bo‘lib, tanasi yassilashgan va cho‘ziq ko‘rinishda, og‘iz apparati so‘ruvchi tipda tuzilgan, mo‘ylovlari 6–10 bo‘g‘imli. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Minute, slender insects belonging to the order Thysanoptera. They have asymmetrical piercing-rasping mouthparts and typically possess two pairs of narrow wings fringed with long hairs. Many species feed on plants and some transmit plant viruses, whereas others feed on fungi or prey on small arthropods.
etymology_en: The English name «thrips» derives from Greek «thrips», meaning «woodworm». The name Thysanoptera is formed from Greek «thysanos», meaning «fringe», and «pteron», meaning «wing».
example_en: Thrips are small winged insects ranging in size from 0.5–15 millimetres in length. (Thysanoptera—thrips. Australian National Insect Collection, CSIRO)

definition_uz: Oldingi qanotlari qattiqlashib, ostidagi pardasimon uchish qanotlari va qorinchani himoya qiluvchi ustqanotlarga aylangan, og‘iz apparati kemiruvchi tipda tuzilgan, to‘liq o‘zgarish bilan rivojlanadigan hasharotlar turkumi. Ularning o‘simlikxo‘r, yirtqich, saprofag va boshqa oziqlanish xususiyatiga ega turlari mavjud.
example_uz: Qattiqqanotlilar yoki qo‘ng‘izlar turkumiga kiruvchi hasharotlar oldingi qanotlarining tomirlanishi aniq emas, shoxsimon yoki terisimon ust qanotga aylangan, og‘iz apparati kemiruvchi tipda tuzilgan. Lichinkalari chuvalchangsimon. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Holometabolous insects belonging to the order Coleoptera, characterized by chewing mouthparts and a hardened pair of forewings called elytra. The elytra protect the membranous hindwings and much of the abdomen. The order includes herbivorous, predatory, fungivorous and saprophagous species.
etymology_en: Coleoptera is formed from Greek «koleos», meaning «sheath», and «pteron», meaning «wing», in reference to the hardened forewings that cover the membranous hindwings.
example_en: A Guide to the Beetles of Australia provides a comprehensive introduction to the Coleoptera—a huge and diverse group of insects. (A Guide to the Beetles of Australia. Hangay G., Zborowski P., CSIRO Publishing, 2010)

definition_uz: Ikki juft pardasimon, ko‘p tomirlangan qanotga ega bo‘lgan, to‘liq o‘zgarish bilan rivojlanadigan hasharotlar turkumi. Voyaga yetganlarining og‘iz apparati kemiruvchi, lichinkalarining o‘roqsimon jag‘lari esa o‘ljani tutish va uning suyuq tarkibini so‘rishga moslashgan. Ko‘pchilik turlari yirtqich bo‘lib, o‘simlik zararkunandalarining tabiiy kushandasi hisoblanadi.
example_uz: To‘rqanotlilar — Neuroptera turkumiga mansub turlar yirik va qisman mayda hasharotlardir. Boshi gipognatik tipda, mo‘ylovlari ko‘zlar oralig‘ida joylashgan. Qanoti chetlaridagi tomir shoxlari ko‘pchilik turlarida ikkilangan (ayrisimon). (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Holometabolous insects belonging to the order Neuroptera, typically characterized by two pairs of similarly sized membranous wings with complex net-like venation and chewing mouthparts. Their larvae are usually predators equipped with elongated, sickle-shaped jaws for capturing prey and extracting its body fluids.
etymology_en: Neuroptera is formed from Greek «neuron», meaning «nerve» or «sinew», and «pteron», meaning «wing», referring to the conspicuous network of veins in the wings.
example_en: The order Neuroptera includes the lacewings and antlions. (Unit 3 of Entomology. University of Florida, Department of Entomology and Nematology)

definition_uz: Qanotlari va tanasining ayrim qismlari mayda tangachalar bilan qoplangan, to‘liq o‘zgarish orqali rivojlanadigan hasharotlar turkumi. Voyaga yetganlarining og‘iz apparati odatda nektar va boshqa suyuqliklarni so‘rishga moslashgan xartumchadan iborat; lichinkalari qurt deb ataladi va ko‘pchiligi o‘simliklar bilan oziqlanadi.
example_uz: Tangacha qanotlilar, ya’ni kapalaklar turkumi turli katta-kichiklikdagi hasharotlardir. Ikkala juft pardasimon qanoti tangachalar bilan zich qoplangan. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Holometabolous insects belonging to the order Lepidoptera, characterized by two pairs of membranous wings usually covered with overlapping scales. Most adults possess a coiled proboscis adapted for feeding on liquids, while their larvae, known as caterpillars, typically have chewing mouthparts and feed on plant tissues.
etymology_en: Lepidoptera is formed from Greek «lepis» or «lepidos», meaning «scale», and «pteron», meaning «wing», referring to the scales covering the wings.
example_en: Moths and butterflies are grouped together in the order Lepidoptera, which means ‘scaly wings’. (Lepidoptera—moths and butterflies. Australian National Insect Collection, CSIRO)

definition_uz: Odatda ikki juft pardasimon qanotga ega, to‘liq o‘zgarish orqali rivojlanadigan hasharotlar turkumi. Orqa qanotlari oldingi qanotlariga mayda ilgakchalar yordamida birikadi; og‘iz apparati kemiruvchi yoki kemirib-yalovchi tipda tuzilgan. Urg‘ochilaridagi tuxum qo‘ygich ayrim guruhlarda arra, teshuvchi nayza yoki nishga aylangan. Turkumga arrakashlar, arilar, asalarilar va chumolilar kiradi.
example_uz: Pardaqanotlilarga 2 juft tiniq qanotli hasharotlar kiradi. Orqa juft qanotlari oldingilariga qaraganda kichik, oldingisiga mahkam ilashgan. Og‘iz apparati kemiruvchi yoki so‘ruvchi tipda tuzilgan, lekin yuqorigi jag‘lari rivojlangan bo‘ladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Holometabolous insects belonging to the order Hymenoptera, which includes sawflies, wasps, bees and ants. Winged forms typically possess two pairs of membranous wings, with the smaller hindwings coupled to the forewings by minute hooks. Their mouthparts are usually chewing or chewing-lapping, and the female ovipositor may be adapted for sawing, piercing or stinging.
etymology_en: Hymenoptera is formed from Greek «hymen», meaning «membrane», and «pteron», meaning «wing», referring to the membranous wings characteristic of the order.
example_en: Hymenoptera is a large order of insects, comprising the sawflies, wasps, bees, and ants. (Insect Research: Wasps, Bees and Ants. CSIRO)

definition_uz: Faqat bir juft pardasimon oldingi qanoti rivojlangan, orqa qanotlari esa parvoz vaqtida muvozanatni saqlovchi vizildoq deb ataladigan kichik organlarga aylangan, to‘liq o‘zgarish orqali rivojlanadigan hasharotlar turkumi. Og‘iz apparati yalovchi, so‘ruvchi yoki sanchib-so‘ruvchi tipda bo‘lishi mumkin; lichinkalari odatda oyoqsiz.
example_uz: Ikkiqanotlilar (Diptera), ya’ni pashshalar turkumi. Qo‘shqanotlilarga bir juft pardasimon oldingi qanotli hasharotlar kiradi. Bosh qismi juda harakatchan joylashgan, og‘iz organlari xartumcha shaklida, so‘rishga yoki yalashga moslashgan. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Holometabolous insects belonging to the order Diptera, characterized by a single functional pair of membranous forewings. The hindwings are reduced to small club-shaped balancing organs called halteres. Their mouthparts may be adapted for sucking, sponging or piercing, and their larvae are typically legless.
etymology_en: Diptera is formed from Greek «di-», meaning «two», and «pteron», meaning «wing», referring to the single pair of functional wings.
example_en: The order Diptera, the flies, is one of the largest and most dynamic orders of insects. (Public-Health Pesticide Applicator Training Manual: Flies. University of Florida)

definition_uz: Yog‘och, o‘simlik qoldiqlari va boshqa sellulozali moddalar bilan oziqlanadigan, tabaqalarga bo‘lingan koloniyalarda yashovchi ijtimoiy hasharotlar guruhi. Qanotli jinsiy individlarining oldingi va orqa qanotlari deyarli teng bo‘ladi. Ilgari Isoptera nomli alohida turkum hisoblangan, zamonaviy tasnifda esa Blattodea turkumi tarkibiga kiritiladi.
etymology_uz: Termit so‘zi o‘zbek tiliga ruscha «термит» orqali kirgan bo‘lib, uning manbasi lotincha «termes» — «yog‘och qurti» ma’nosidagi so‘zga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Termitlar (Isoptera) turkumi vakillari to‘liqsiz yoki chala metamorfoz bilan (ontogenezida tuxum, lichinka, yetuk-imago fazalarini o‘tab) rivojlanuvchi hasharotlar hisoblanadi. (Mitti jonzotning katta talofati. Raxmatullayev A.Y., Berdiyev J.X., Ro‘ziyev B.X., 2017)
definition_en: Eusocial, cellulose-feeding insects that live in colonies divided into reproductive, worker and soldier castes. The winged reproductive individuals have two pairs of nearly equal-sized wings. Termites were formerly classified as the order Isoptera but are now placed within the order Blattodea.
etymology_en: The English word «termite» comes through French «termite» from Latin «termes» or «tarmes», meaning «woodworm». Isoptera is formed from Greek «isos», meaning «equal», and «pteron», meaning «wing», referring to the nearly equal forewings and hindwings of winged reproductive termites.
example_en: The termites, formerly recognized in order Isoptera, are now considered a part of order Blattodea. (Integrated Taxonomic Information System, ITIS)

definition_uz: Bargxo‘r qo‘ng‘izlar oilasiga mansub, kartoshka va boshqa ituzumdosh o‘simliklarning barglari bilan oziqlanadigan xavfli zararkunanda. Voyaga yetgan qo‘ng‘izining sariq qanotustlarida o‘ntadan qora bo‘ylama yo‘l bo‘ladi. Qo‘ng‘izlari va lichinkalari barglarni yeb, o‘simlikning bargsizlanishi hamda hosildorlikning keskin kamayishiga sabab bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Yirtqich turlaridan amerika qandalasi — Perillus bioculatus F. kolorado qo‘ng‘izi bilan oziqlanib, foyda keltiradi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A leaf beetle, Leptinotarsa decemlineata, whose adults and larvae feed primarily on potato foliage and also attack other cultivated and wild solanaceous plants. Severe infestations can cause extensive defoliation and substantial yield loss.
etymology_en: The common name refers to Colorado, where the beetle became notorious as a serious potato pest during the nineteenth century. The specific epithet «decemlineata» is derived from Latin «decem», meaning «ten», and «lineata», meaning «lined», referring to the ten dark longitudinal stripes on the elytra.
example_en: The Colorado beetle, Leptinotarsa decemlineata, attacks potatoes and various other cultivated and wild solanaceous plants. (EPPO Datasheet: Leptinotarsa decemlineata. European and Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization, 2021)
synonyms_en: Colorado beetle; Ten-lined potato beetle; Ten-striped spearman

definition_uz: Zararkunandalarni qo‘lda yig‘ish, tutish, to‘sish yoki bevosita yo‘qotish hamda zararlangan o‘simlik qismlarini olib tashlashga asoslangan himoya usuli. Unga tutqich va to‘siqlardan foydalanish, eski po‘stloqni tozalash, qurigan shoxlar hamda zararlangan mevalarni yo‘qotish kiradi.
example_uz: Kartoshkadagi kolorado qo‘ng‘izi va uning tuxumini ham qo‘lda terib va mexanik usulda yo‘qotish taklif etilgan.  (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A pest-management method based on directly removing, trapping, excluding or destroying pests and eliminating infested plant material. It includes hand-picking, traps, barriers, removal of loose bark and the pruning and destruction of infested plant parts.
example_en: Mechanical control, either by physically removing and destroying the pests or by eliminating the alternative hosts, can be effective. (Maintenance of the Plantation. FAO)

definition_uz: To‘g‘riqanotlilar turkumining Acrididae oilasiga mansub, mo‘ylovlari nisbatan kalta va orqa oyoqlari sakrashga moslashgan hasharotlar. Ular asosan o‘simliklar bilan oziqlanadi; ayrim turlari juda ko‘payganda to‘dalar hosil qilib, qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlariga katta zarar yetkazadi.
example_uz: Chigirtkalar burtlarining kaltaligi bilan temirchaklar va chirildoqlardan yaxshi farq qiladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Primarily plant-feeding orthopteran insects belonging to the family Acrididae, characterized by relatively short antennae and enlarged hind legs adapted for jumping. Some species undergo density-dependent phase changes and form migratory swarms; these swarm-forming species are known as locusts.
etymology_en: Acridid is derived from the family name Acrididae, which is based on the genus Acrida and ultimately related to Greek akris or akridos, meaning «grasshopper» or «locust».
example_en: Acrididae are sometimes referred to as the short-horned grasshoppers, a reference to their relatively short antennae. (What Is a Grasshopper? University of Florida, Department of Entomology and Nematology)

definition_uz: Bitlar oilasiga mansub, karam va boshqa butguldosh o‘simliklarning barg shirasi bilan oziqlanadigan zararkunanda hasharot. Koloniyalari barglarning rangsizlanishi, buralishi va o‘sishdan qolishiga, kuchli zararlanish esa yosh o‘simliklarning qurishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.
example_uz: Karam biti o‘simliklarning bargini yoppasiga qoplab olib, uni ifloslantiradi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A sap-feeding aphid, Brevicoryne brassicae, that primarily infests cabbages and other plants of the family Brassicaceae. Colonies develop mainly on leaves and growing points, where feeding can cause discoloration, distortion, reduced growth and contamination with waxy secretions.
example_en: Brevicoryne brassicae is an aphid species that feeds primarily on crucifers in all temperate and tropical regions of the world. (AphID, Identification Technology Program, USDA)
synonyms_en: Mealy cabbage aphid; Grey cabbage aphid

definition_uz: Oq kapalaklar oilasiga mansub, qurtlari karam, sholg‘om va boshqa butguldosh o‘simliklarning barglari bilan oziqlanadigan zararkunanda kapalak. Karam oq kapalagiga o‘xshaydi, ammo undan kichikroq; urg‘ochisi tuxumlarini, odatda, barglarga bittadan qo‘yadi.
example_uz: Sholg‘om oq kapalagi butgulli o‘simliklarning bargini yeydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A small white butterfly, Pieris rapae, of the family Pieridae. Its larvae feed on turnip, cabbage and other brassicaceous plants, damaging the leaves and sometimes contaminating harvested produce with frass.
example_en: The Small White remains the most abundant and widely distributed of the three Pieris species. (Butterfly Report 2025. Butterfly Conservation, Lancashire, Manchester and Merseyside Branch)
synonyms_en: Small white; Small cabbage white; Cabbage white butterfly; European cabbage white

definition_uz: Bitlar oilasiga mansub, asosan olma, shuningdek, nok, behi va do‘lana kabi mevali daraxtlarning kurtaklari, barglari, gullari hamda yosh novdalari shirasini so‘rib oziqlanadigan zararkunanda hasharot. Zararlangan barglar buralib, qorayishi, novdalar o‘sishdan qolishi, meva va barglar esa shira ajratmalari bilan ifloslanishi mumkin.
example_uz: Olma yashil biti tengqanotlilar turkumiga, bitlar oilasiga mansub hasharot. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A sap-feeding aphid, Aphis pomi, that primarily infests apple but also occurs on pear, quince, hawthorn and some other rosaceous hosts. Feeding colonies develop on young shoots and leaves, causing leaf curling, shoot distortion and honeydew contamination of foliage and fruit.
example_en: The green apple aphid, Aphis pomi, which is also an important pest in pear orchards, sucks sap from leaves and young shoots. (Guidelines on Good Plant Protection Practice: Pome Fruits. EPPO Standard PP 2/18(1))

definition_uz: Yarimqattiqqanotlilar turkumiga mansub, o‘simliklarning bargi, novdasi, kurtagi, guli yoki ildizidan shira so‘rib oziqlanadigan mayda, yumshoq tanali hasharotlar oilasi. Ko‘pchilik turlari koloniya hosil qiladi, yopishqoq shira ajratadi, o‘simlik o‘sishini susaytiradi va ayrim virus kasalliklarini tarqatadi.
example_uz: Barg bitlari ko‘chatzorlardagi nihollarga va bog‘lardagi yosh daraxtlarga ko‘p zarar yetkazadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Small, soft-bodied, sap-feeding hemipteran insects belonging to the family Aphididae. Many species form colonies on leaves, shoots, buds, flowers or roots, produce honeydew, reduce plant growth and transmit plant viruses.
example_en: Within the family Aphididae, also known as aphids or plant lice, there are 24 subfamilies, 510 genera, and 5109 species. (Aphididae. Animal Diversity Web, University of Michigan)

definition_uz: Bitlar oilasiga mansub, asosan olma daraxtining ildizi, ildiz bo‘g‘zi, tanasi va novdalaridan shira so‘rib oziqlanadigan zararkunanda hasharot. Tanasi oq mumsimon momiq bilan qoplangan; zararlangan joylarda bo‘rtma va shishlar hosil qilib, daraxtni zaiflashtiradi, kuchli zararlanish esa yosh daraxtlarning qurishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: Voyaga yetgan qon biti va uning lichinkalari ildizda, ildiz bo‘g‘zida, qisman tana va novdalarning yoriqlarida qishlaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A sap-feeding aphid, Eriosoma lanigerum, that primarily infests apple trees. Its colonies occur on roots, trunks, branches and pruning wounds and are covered with conspicuous white waxy filaments; feeding causes swellings, galls, bark injury and weakening of the tree.
example_en: Eriosoma lanigerum is mostly a temperate aphid species and extensively co-distributed with cultivated apple. (AphID, Identification Technology Program, USDA)

definition_uz: Qalqonlilar oilasiga mansub, mevali va manzarali daraxt hamda butalarning shirasini so‘rib oziqlanadigan polifag zararkunanda hasharot. Urg‘ochisining tanasi binafsha tusli bo‘lib, oval qalqoncha bilan qoplangan; lichinkalari novda, barg va mevalarga tarqalib, o‘simlikning zaiflashishi, novdalarning qurishi va meva sifatining pasayishiga sabab bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Binafsha tusli qalqondor urug‘li va danakli meva daraxtlari, tut, anor, terak, oq akatsiya va boshqa ko‘pgina daraxt hamda butalar shirasini so‘radi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A polyphagous armoured scale insect, Parlatoria oleae, that infests olive and numerous fruit, nut and ornamental plants. Nymphs and adult females feed on sap from branches, leaves and fruits, causing discoloration, reduced vigour, shoot dieback and deterioration of fruit quality.
example_en: Parlatoria oleae is a pest of olive but is also found infesting numerous fruit, nut and ornamental plant species. (Final Import Risk Analysis Report for Fresh Apple Fruit from the People’s Republic of China. Australian Government, 2010)

definition_uz: Qalqonlilar oilasiga mansub, olma, nok, behi, o‘rik, shaftoli, olxo‘ri va boshqa ko‘plab daraxt hamda butalarni zararlaydigan polifag karantin hasharoti. Lichinka va urg‘ochilari novda, tana, barg va mevalardan shira so‘radi; zararlangan joylarda qizil dog‘lar, po‘stloqda yoriqlar va novdalarda deformatsiya paydo bo‘lib, kuchli zararlangan daraxt qurishi mumkin.
example_uz: Kaliforniya qalqondori o‘simliklar shirasini so‘rishi natijasida daraxtlar tanasi yorilib ketadi, novdalari qing‘ir-qiyshiq bo‘lib o‘sadi, barglari deformatsiyaga uchraydi, barg va yosh mevalari to‘kilib ketadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A highly polyphagous armoured scale insect, Comstockaspis perniciosa, that attacks apple, pear, peach, plum and many other deciduous fruit and ornamental plants. Feeding on bark, shoots, leaves and fruits causes red discoloration, bark cracking, shoot dieback, reduced fruit quality and, in severe infestations, tree death.
example_en: San Jose scale is a major pest of prune. (San Jose Scale: Prune Pest Management Guidelines. UC Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program, 2026)
synonyms_en: California scale; Californian scale; Pernicious scale

definition_uz: O‘rgimchakkanalar oilasiga mansub, olma, nok, olxo‘ri, olcha, gilos, o‘rik, shaftoli va boshqa mevali daraxtlarning barg hujayralari bilan oziqlanadigan zararkunanda kana. Zararlangan barglarda xol-xol dog‘lar va qo‘ng‘irlashish yuzaga kelib, fotosintez susayadi, daraxt zaiflashadi hamda mevalar maydalashishi mumkin.
example_uz: Qo‘ng‘ir meva kanasi olma, olxo‘ri, olcha, gilos, o‘rik, shaftoli, bodom kabi mevali daraxtlarga ko‘proq zarar yetkazadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A plant-feeding spider mite, Bryobia rubrioculus, that occurs mainly on apple, pear, almond and stone-fruit trees. It feeds by removing the contents of leaf cells, causing mottling, bronzing or browning of foliage, reduced tree vigour and, under heavy infestations, smaller fruit.
example_en: Brown mite feeds by sucking the contents out of leaf cells. Such leaf damage reduces tree vigor and can reduce fruit size. (Brown Mite: Prune Pest Management Guidelines. UC Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program, 2026)
synonyms_en: Brown fruit mite; bryobia mite; pear bryobia; brown apple mite

definition_uz: Barg burgalari oilasiga mansub, nokning kurtaklari, barglari, yosh novdalari va mevalaridan shira so‘rib oziqlanadigan zararkunanda hasharot. Nimfa va voyaga yetganlari ko‘p miqdorda yopishqoq shira ajratib, barg va mevalarning qorayishi, daraxtning zaiflashishi hamda meva sifatining pasayishiga sabab bo‘ladi; tur nok pasayishi fitoplazmasini ham tarqatishi mumkin.
example_uz: Nokning barg burgasi (Psylla pyricola Forst.). Burga va uning lichinkalari kurtak, barg, novda va mevalar shirasini so‘radi hamda o‘zidan yopishqoq va shirin suyuqlik — shira ajratadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A sap-feeding psyllid, Cacopsylla pyricola, that develops primarily on pear trees. Adults and nymphs feed on buds, leaves, shoots and fruits; the nymphs produce abundant honeydew that causes fruit marking, sooty growth, reduced tree vigour and contamination of the crop. The species can also transmit the pear decline phytoplasma.
example_en: Pear psylla, Cacopsylla pyricola (Foërster), is the most economically harmful arthropod pest of pears in the Pacific Northwest. (Biology and Management of Pear Psylla in the Pacific Northwest. Sayles M.W. et al., Journal of Integrated Pest Management, 2025)
synonyms_en: Pear psyllid; pear sucker; common pear psyllid; European pear psylla

definition_uz: To‘rqandalalar oilasiga mansub, asosan nok va olma, shuningdek, ayrim danakli meva daraxtlari barglarining orqa tomonida oziqlanadigan zararkunanda hasharot. Nimfa va voyaga yetganlari barg hujayralaridan shira so‘rib, ustki yuzada oqish dog‘lar, pastki yuzada qora chiqindi izlari hosil qiladi; kuchli zararlanish barglarning qurishi va to‘kilishiga olib keladi.
example_uz: Nok yoki olma qandalasi yarimqattiqqanotlilar turkumiga mansub. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A polyphagous lace bug, Stephanitis pyri, that feeds mainly on the undersides of pear and apple leaves and also attacks several other deciduous fruit trees. Feeding produces pale stippling or discoloration on the upper leaf surface and dark excrement deposits underneath; severe infestations cause leaf necrosis, premature defoliation and reduced tree vigour.
example_en: The pear lace bug, Stephanitis pyri (Fabricius, 1775) (Hemiptera: Tingidae), is an economically important pest of pome fruit trees. (Insecticidal Effect of Diatomaceous Earth Formulation against Pear Lace Bug, Stephanitis pyri. Khalid I., Aysal T., Sağlam Ö., 2026)

definition_uz: Yarimqattiqqanotlilar turkumiga mansub, o‘simliklarning novda, barg va boshqa qismlaridan floema shirasini so‘rib oziqlanadigan hasharotlar oilasi. Urg‘ochilarining ustki qoplami tanasidan ajralmaydi; ko‘pchilik turlari yopishqoq shira ajratib, qora qurum zamburug‘larining rivojlanishi, o‘simlikning zaiflashishi va novdalarning qurishiga sabab bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Soxta qalqondorlar danakli meva daraxtlarining ko‘pchiligi, ayniqsa, olxo‘ri, gilos, shaftolini qattiq zararlaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Sap-feeding hemipteran insects belonging to the family Coccidae. Adult females and settled nymphs have a soft, waxy or leathery body covering that cannot be separated from the insect; many species excrete abundant honeydew, promote sooty mould growth and weaken their host plants.
example_en: Soft scales (Coccidae) infest numerous species of broadleaved perennials. (Soft Scales: Floriculture and Ornamental Nurseries Pest Management Guidelines. UC Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program)

definition_uz: Do‘lana, olma, nok, gilos, olxo‘ri va boshqa mevali daraxtlar bargida oziqlanadigan o‘rgimchakkanalar oilasiga mansub zararkunanda kana. Uning oziqlanishi barglarda mayda dog‘lar, sarg‘ayish yoki qo‘ng‘irlashish, muddatidan oldin to‘kilish hamda daraxtning zaiflashishiga sabab bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Gullaguncha va gullagandan keyin meva o‘rgimchakkanasiga qarshi kurashda ishlatiladigan pestitsidlar ro‘yxati ilovada berilgan. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A plant-feeding spider mite, Amphitetranychus viennensis, in the family Tetranychidae. It feeds mainly on hawthorn and rosaceous fruit trees, including apple, pear, cherry and plum, causing leaf stippling, chlorosis or bronzing, premature leaf fall and reduced plant vigour.
example_en: Amphitetranychus viennensis (hawthorn spider mite) belongs to the mite family Tetranychidae. (Final Import Risk Analysis Report for Fresh Apple Fruit from the People’s Republic of China. Australian Government, 2010)
synonyms_en: Fruit tree spider mite; Sweet-cherry spider mite

definition_uz: Plastinkamo‘ylovli qo‘ng‘izlarning Melolonthinae kenja oilasiga mansub hasharotlar. Voyaga yetganlari daraxt va butalar bargi bilan oziqlanishi, tuproqda yashaydigan oq, yoysimon lichinkalari esa mevali daraxtlar va boshqa o‘simliklarning ildizini kemirib, ularni zaiflashtirishi mumkin.
example_uz: Buzoqboshi qo‘ng‘izlarning lichinkasi daraxtlarning ildizini kemirib, kuchsizlantiradi, ba’zan buzilib o‘rniga ekilgan ekinlarga ham zarar yetkazadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Beetles belonging to the subfamily Melolonthinae of the scarab family Scarabaeidae. Adults commonly feed on the foliage of trees and shrubs, while their soil-dwelling, C-shaped larvae, known as white grubs, feed on plant roots and may damage fruit trees, nursery plants and other crops.
example_en: The Melolonthinae are a large subfamily of beetles that range between 5 and 40 millimetres in length depending on the species. (Scarabaeidae — Scarab Beetles. Australian National Insect Collection, CSIRO)
synonyms_en: May beetles; June beetles; June bugs

definition_uz: Coleophoridae oilasiga mansub, lichinkasi himoya g‘ilofi ichida yashaydigan mevali daraxtlar zararkunandasi. Lichinkalari o‘rik, bodom, behi, olcha, gilos, nok va ayniqsa olmaning bo‘rtayotgan kurtaklari hamda barg eti bilan oziqlanib, barglarning qo‘ng‘irlashishi va qurishiga sabab bo‘ladi.
example_uz: G‘ilofli kuya qurtlari o‘rik, bodom, behi, olcha, gilos, nokning va ayniqsa, olmaning bo‘rtayotgan va yozila boshlagan kurtaklarini yeb zarar yetkazadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A case-bearing moth of the family Coleophoridae whose larvae feed on the swelling buds and leaf tissues of apple, pear, quince, hawthorn and stone-fruit trees. The larvae live in portable protective cases, and severe feeding may cause browning, scorching and loss of foliage.
example_en: Case-bearing moth (Coleophora hemerobiola Fil.). (Main Pests of the Pear Tree and Their Bioecology, 2025)

definition_uz: Lichinkalari mevali daraxtlar, ayniqsa olma barglarining to‘qimasi orasida oziqlanib, mina yoki havol deb ataladigan yo‘llar va dog‘simon kovaklar hosil qiladigan mayda kuyalar. Kuchli zararlanish barglarning fotosintez faoliyati pasayishi, qurishi va muddatidan oldin to‘kilishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
example_uz: Havol (mina) yasovchi kuyalar (Lithocolletis phrifoliella Grsm). Har bir bargda mina (havol) soni uchtadan oshganda kimyoviy kurash choralari qo‘llanadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
synonyms_uz: Bargda mina yasovchi kuyalar; Barg kovlovchi kuyalar
definition_en: A small gracillariid moth whose larvae feed within apple leaves and form blotch-like mines between the epidermal layers. Heavy infestation can reduce the photosynthetic area of leaves and cause browning, drying and premature leaf fall.
example_en: Phyllonorycter gerasimowi is an injurious leaf miner of apple trees in Central Anatolia. (Natural Enemies of Phyllonorycter gerasimowi Hering, an Injurious Leaf Miner of Apple Trees in Central Anatolia. Plant Protection Bulletin, 1983)

definition_uz: Daraxtlarning po‘stlog‘i ostida va floema qavatida yo‘llar ochib yashaydigan mayda qo‘ng‘izlar. Ularning voyaga yetganlari va lichinkalari po‘stloq ostidagi tirik to‘qimalarni zararlab, shoxlarning qurishi, daraxtning zaiflashishi yoki nobud bo‘lishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin; ko‘pincha oldindan zaiflashgan daraxtlar kuchli zararlanadi.
example_uz: Bog‘ to‘g‘ri parvarish qilinmasa hamda ilgari boshqa zararkunandalar ta’sirida kuchsizlangan daraxtlarga po‘stloq osti qo‘ng‘izlari, ayniqsa, qattiq zarar yetkazadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017, 187-b.)
definition_en: Small beetles of the subfamily Scolytinae whose adults and larvae usually live and feed beneath tree bark, particularly in the phloem and cambial region. Their galleries disrupt nutrient transport and may cause branch dieback, tree decline or death, especially in stressed or weakened trees.
example_en: Bark beetles feed on the phloem of their host trees during adult and larval stages. (Introduction to Bark Beetles. USDA Forest Service)

definition_uz: Lichinkasi olxo‘ri va boshqa danakli mevalarning eti bilan oziqlanadigan bargo‘rovchilar oilasiga mansub zararkunanda. Zararlangan mevada kirish teshigi, yelim va chiqindi paydo bo‘ladi; meva muddatidan oldin pishishi, qurishi yoki to‘kilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Olxo‘ri meva qurti olxo‘ridan tashqari, o‘rik, olma, shaftoli, gilosni ham zararlaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A tortricid moth whose larvae develop inside plums and other Prunus fruits, feeding on the flesh, usually near the stone. Infested fruit may show an entry hole, gum and frass and may ripen prematurely or fall before harvest.
example_en: The larvae feed on the fruits of sloe (Prunus spinosa), plum (Prunus domestica) and other Prunus species. (Grapholita funebrana — Plum Fruit Moth. UKMoths)

definition_uz: Soxta lichinkalari olcha, gilos, nok, do‘lana, olxo‘ri va boshqa ra’nodosh o‘simliklarning barglarini skeletlashtirib zararlaydigan arrakashlar oilasiga mansub hasharot. Yosh lichinkalari yashil-qora shilimshiq modda bilan qoplangan bo‘lib, barg etini yeb, asosan tomirlarini qoldiradi.
example_uz: Arrakashlar uchishi va lichinkalari paydo bo‘lishi  davrida ilovada keltirilgan pestitsidlar bilan kimyoviy ishlov beriladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A sawfly of the family Tenthredinidae whose slug-like larvae are covered with dark greenish slime and feed on the upper leaf surface of cherry, pear, plum, hawthorn and other rosaceous plants. Their feeding removes the leaf tissue but leaves the main veins and lower epidermis, producing skeletonized, brown and sometimes prematurely falling leaves.
example_en: Cherry slug sawflies (Caliroa cerasi), also known as pear slugs, are destructive pests that attack cherry, pear, plum, and related ornamental trees. (Cherry Slug Sawflies. Pestipedia, 2026)
synonyms_en: Cherry slug; Pear sawfly; Pear and cherry slugworm
