definition_uz: Lichinkalari anjir barglarining yumshoq to‘qimasini to‘rsimon uya ostida yeb, barglarni skeletlashtiradigan mayda kuya. Kuchli zararlanish barglarning qurishi va anjir daraxtining zaiflashishiga olib keladi; ayrim manbalarda yosh mevalarning ham zararlanishi qayd etilgan.
example_uz: Anjir parvonasi keng tarqalgan kemiruvchi zararkunanda bo‘lib, anjir daraxtining bargi va mevasiga jiddiy zarar yetkazadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017, 191-b.)
definition_en: A small moth of the family Choreutidae whose larvae feed on fig leaves beneath protective silk webbing. They remove the soft leaf tissue while leaving the veins, producing a skeletonized appearance; young fruit may occasionally also be damaged.
example_en: The fig-tree skeletonizer moth, Choreutis nemorana (Hübner, 1799), is a widespread species in the Mediterranean region. (The Fig-tree Skeletonizer Moth, Choreutis nemorana, a New Species for the Algeria Fauna. Belguerri H. et al., 2024)
synonyms_en: Fig-leaf skeletoniser; Fig leaf roller; Fig moth

definition_uz: Lichinkasi anor mevasiga, odatda, meva kosachasi orqali kirib, donlar va ular orasidagi pardalar bilan oziqlanadigan zararkunanda kuya. Zararlangan meva qurt chiqindilari bilan ifloslanadi, ichidan chiriydi, yorilishi va iste’molga yaroqsiz bo‘lib qolishi mumkin.
example_uz: Anor qurti anor mevasini zararlaydi. Ayrim joylarda anorning qurtdan zararlanishi 11,7–92% ga yetadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A pyralid moth whose larvae enter pomegranate fruits, usually through the calyx, and feed on the seeds and internal membranes. Infestation contaminates the fruit with frass and causes internal decay, premature splitting and loss of marketability.
example_en: This article highlights the biological characteristics of the pomegranate fruit moth (Euzophera punicaella), the damage it causes, as well as traditional and advanced methods of control. (Application of Innovative Technologies in the Management of the Pomegranate Fruit Moth. Usmanov M.M., 2025)

definition_uz: Lichinkasi unobi mevasining etli qismi, ayniqsa danak atrofida oziqlanadigan olaqanotli meva pashshasi. Zararlangan mevalar rivojlanishdan to‘xtaydi, burishadi, qo‘ng‘ir tusga kiradi va muddatidan oldin to‘kiladi; voyaga yetgan lichinka mevadan chiqib, tuproqda g‘umbakka aylanadi.
example_uz: Unobi pashshasi mevalarni qattiq zararlaydi, lichinkasi mevaning etli qismi — danak atrofini aylanasiga yeydi, natijada meva burishib, qo‘ng‘ir tusga kiradi va to‘kilib ketadi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017, 193-b.)
definition_en: A tephritid fruit fly whose females lay eggs in jujube fruits and whose larvae feed on the pulp, particularly around the stone. Infested fruits become discoloured and shrivelled, stop developing and frequently fall prematurely; mature larvae leave the fruit and pupate in the soil.
example_en: The ber fruit fly (BFF), Carpomya vesuviana Costa, 1854 (Diptera: Tephritidae), is an important key pest of the jujube, Ziziphus jujuba Miller. (Potential Parasitoids for Biocontrol of the Ber Fruit Fly, Carpomya vesuviana Costa. Amini A. et al., 2024)

definition_uz: Lichinkalari yong‘oq mevasi va yosh novdalarini zararlaydigan Nolidae oilasiga mansub kuya. Birinchi avlod lichinkalari yosh mevalarni nobud qilishi, keyingi avlodlari meva po‘sti va novda o‘zagini kemirishi mumkin; zararlangan meva po‘sti qorayadi, teshiklardan qipiq va chiqindi chiqib turadi.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonda keng tarqalgan yong‘oq qurti yong‘oq mevasini 50–60% gacha nobud qilishi mumkin. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A nolidae moth whose larvae damage Persian walnut fruits and young shoots. Larvae feed in the husk and developing nut, causing darkened areas, frass, deformation and fruit loss; when nuts are scarce, they may bore into shoot pith and cause shoot dieback.
example_en: The Asian walnut moth attacks both wild and cultivated varieties of the Persian or English walnut, Juglans regia. (Forest Health and Biosecurity Working Paper: Forest Pests of the Kyrgyz Republic. FAO)

definition_uz: Qattiqqanotlilar turkumiga mansub qo‘ng‘izlar oilasi. Voyaga yetgan qo‘ng‘izlar chalqancha tushganda tanasidagi maxsus mexanizm yordamida sakrab, qarsillagan tovush chiqaradi. Ularning simqurtlar deb ataladigan qattiq tanali lichinkalari tuproqda yashaydi; ayrim turlari urug‘lar, ildizlar, tuganaklar va poyaning yerosti qismlarini zararlaydi.
example_uz: Qarsildoq qo‘ng‘izlar (Elateridae) qattiqqanotli hasharotlar turkumining ancha yirik oilalaridan biri bo‘lib, hozirgi kunda ushbu qo‘ng‘izlarning 400 ta avlodga mansub 10000 dan ko‘proq turi aniqlangan. (Elateridae oilasi vakillarining taksonomik tarkibi. Alimova L.X., 2023)
definition_en: Beetles of the family Elateridae whose adults can propel themselves into the air with an audible click when overturned. Their larvae are known as wireworms; the plant-feeding species may damage seeds, roots, underground stems and tubers.
etymology_en: The common name click beetle refers to the audible clicking sound produced when an overturned adult snaps its thoracic mechanism and jumps into the air.
example_en: Wireworms are the larval stage of click beetles. (Wireworms and Corn. University of Minnesota Extension)

definition_uz: Bargo‘rovchilar oilasiga mansub, asosan tokka zarar yetkazadigan kapalak turi. Birinchi avlod lichinkalari tokning to‘pgul va g‘unchalarini, keyingi avlodlari esa g‘o‘ra hamda yetilayotgan uzum g‘ujumlarini zararlaydi; shikastlangan g‘ujumlarda chirish rivojlanishi mumkin.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston sharoitida shingil qurti mavsumda to‘rt marta nasl beradi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A polyphagous tortricid moth, Eupoecilia ambiguella, that is an important pest of grapevines. Its first-generation larvae feed on flower buds and inflorescences, while later-generation larvae damage developing berries and fruit clusters and may promote fungal decay.
example_en: The European Grape Berry Moth (Eupoecilia ambiguella) is primarily a pest of grape, but can utilize several other horticultural and native plants as hosts. (European Grape Berry Moth. University of Wyoming)

definition_uz: Bargo‘rovchilar oilasiga mansub, tokning to‘pgul va uzum g‘ujumlarini zararlaydigan kapalak turi. Birinchi avlod lichinkalari g‘uncha va gullar bilan, keyingi avlodlari esa g‘o‘ra va yetilayotgan g‘ujumlar bilan oziqlanadi. Zararlangan mevalarda chirish kasalliklarining rivojlanish xavfi ortadi.
example_uz: Tok barg o‘rovchisi g‘umbaklik shaklida asosan po‘stloq ostida qishlaydi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A polyphagous tortricid moth, Lobesia botrana, and an important pest of grapevines. Its larvae feed directly on flowers and developing berries, reducing yield and quality and increasing the susceptibility of damaged fruit to fungal rots.
example_en: Lobesia botrana, the European grapevine moth, is a significant pest of grapes and reduces both grape yields and quality. (Phytosanitary Import Requirements to Prevent the Introduction of Lobesia botrana. Canadian Food Inspection Agency, 2025)
synonyms_en: European vine moth; Grape fruit moth

definition_uz: O‘simliklar, ombor mahsulotlari yoki hayvonlarda uchraydigan zararli kanalarga qarshi qo‘llanadigan pestitsidlar. Bog‘dorchilikda ular o‘rgimchakkana, zang kanasi, kurtak kanasi va boshqa o‘simlikxo‘r kanalarning tuxum, lichinka, nimfa yoki yetuk bosqichlariga qarshi ishlatiladi; ayrim preparatlar faqat muayyan rivojlanish bosqichiga ta’sir qiladi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha akari — «kana» va lotincha caedere — «o‘ldirmoq» ma’nolarini anglatuvchi termin elementlaridan hosil qilingan.
example_uz: Insektitsidlar  hasharotlarga qarshi, akaritsidlar  meva  o‘rgimchakkanalariga qarshi, fungitsidlar kasalliklarga qarshi  qo‘llaniladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Pesticides used to kill or control mites and ticks. In horticulture, acaricides are applied primarily against plant-feeding mites, and their activity may be directed at eggs, larvae, nymphs, adults or several developmental stages.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek akari, meaning «mite», and the Latin-derived suffix -cide, from caedere, meaning «to kill».
example_en: Miticides (also called acaricides) kill mites that feed on plants and animals. (Types of Pesticide Ingredients. United States Environmental Protection Agency)

definition_uz: Patogen organizm yoki noqulay muhit omilining uzluksiz ta’siri natijasida o‘simlik hujayralari, to‘qimalari va organlarida yuz beradigan o‘zaro bog‘liq fiziologik, biokimyoviy hamda morfologik o‘zgarishlar majmui. Jarayon infeksiyaning kirishi va tarqalishi, moddalar almashinuvining buzilishi hamda kasallik belgilarining paydo bo‘lishini qamrab oladi.
etymology_uz: Patologik termini yunoncha pathos — «azob, kasallik» va logos — «ta’limot, fan» so‘zlariga asoslangan patologiya terminidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Patologik jarayon deb patogen mikroorganizmlar va noqulay ekologik sharoit tufayli o‘simlikdagi normal fiziologik jarayonlarning buzilishi tushuniladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A dynamic sequence of interrelated physiological, biochemical and morphological changes occurring in plant cells, tissues or organs as a result of the continuous action of a pathogen or an adverse environmental factor. It encompasses disease initiation, progression and symptom development.
etymology_en: Pathological derives from pathology, formed from Greek pathos, meaning «suffering or disease», and logos, meaning «study or discourse».
example_en: The pathobiome facilitates the pathological process of host plants, from the onset of the disease to its progression, by coordinating complex interactions at multiple scales. (Plant Pathogenesis: Toward Multidimensional Understanding of the Microbiome. Microbial Biotechnology, 2023)

definition_uz: Kasallik ta’sirida o‘simlikning o‘sishi, tashqi shakli, organlari, to‘qimalari va hujayralari tuzilishida yuz beradigan patologik o‘zgarishlar. Ularga o‘sishning susayishi, pakanalik, organlarning deformatsiyasi, gipertrofiya, giperplaziya, gipoplaziya, degeneratsiya va nekroz kiradi.
etymology_uz: Pato- yunoncha pathos — «kasallik, azob»; morfologik esa yunoncha morphē — «shakl» va logos — «ta’limot» termin elementlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Kasallik tufayli o‘simlikdagi patomorfologik o‘zgarishlar uning o‘sish tezligi va shakli, to‘qima va hujayralarining o‘zgarishiga olib keladi. (Entomologiya va fitopotologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Disease-induced alterations in the growth, external form, organs, tissues or cellular structure of a plant. They include stunting, deformation, hypertrophy, hyperplasia, hypoplasia, metaplasia, degeneration and necrosis.
etymology_en: Pathomorphological combines patho-, from Greek pathos meaning «disease or suffering», with morphological, from Greek morphē meaning «form» and logos meaning «study».
example_en: Pathomorphological changes in diseased plants include hypertrophy, hyperplasia, hypoplasia, metaplasia, degeneration and necrosis. (Pathomorphological Changes in Diseased Plants. Kanchaveli Sh.S., Georgian Engineering News, 2017)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning alohida hujayralari hajmining patologik kattalashishi natijasida to‘qima yoki organning me’yordan ortiq o‘sishi. Gipertrofiya patogenlar, parazitlar yoki ular ajratadigan effektorlar va o‘sishni boshqaruvchi moddalar ta’sirida yuz berib, gall, bo‘rtma va boshqa deformatsiyalar hosil qilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha hyper — «me’yordan ortiq» va trophē — «oziqlanish, o‘sish» so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Buning natijasida hujayraning bo‘linish tezligi ortadi, gipertrofiya ro‘y beradi va odatdagi ko‘rinishi yo‘qoladi. Bu hodisa, ayniqsa, mevalar kasallanganda yaqqol namoyon bo‘ladi. (Botanikadan amaliy mashg‘ulotlar. I.U. Tog‘ayev, A.R. Batoshov, X.E. Ergasheva, 2020)
definition_en: Abnormal or excessive growth resulting from enlargement of individual plant cells rather than an increase in cell number. In plant pathology, hypertrophy may be induced by pathogens, parasites or herbivores and can contribute to the formation of galls, swellings and deformed organs.
etymology_en: Derived from Greek hyper, meaning «over or excessive», and trophē, meaning «nourishment or growth».
example_en: Hypertrophy of host cells is associated with pathogen-induced neoplastic growth. (Plant Susceptible Responses: The Underestimated Side of Plant–Pathogen Interactions. Vladimir Gorshkov and Ivan Tsers, 2022)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning floema to‘qimasida yashaydigan, hujayra devoriga ega bo‘lmagan, juda mayda va pleomorf bakterial patogenlar. Ular ko‘pincha saratonlar, barg burgalari va boshqa floema shirasi bilan oziqlanuvchi hasharotlar orqali tarqalib, sarg‘ayish, pakanalik, fillodiya va «jodugar supurgisi» kabi kasallik belgilarini yuzaga keltiradi.
etymology_uz: Fitoplazma xalqaro ilmiy termin bo‘lib, yunoncha phyton («o‘simlik») va plasma («shakllangan narsa, hosila») qismlaridan tuzilgan.
example_uz: O‘simliklarni zararlovchi bunday organizmlar «fitoplazmalar» nomini olgan. (O‘simliklarni biologik himoya qilish. A.Sh. Xamrayev, B.A. Xasanov, B.A. Sulaymonov, A.G. Kojevnikova, E.A. Xolmuradov, 2013)
definition_en: Obligate, wall-less and pleomorphic bacterial plant pathogens that inhabit the phloem sieve elements of their hosts. They are transmitted primarily by phloem-feeding insect vectors and cause symptoms such as yellowing, stunting, phyllody, virescence and witches’ broom.
etymology_en: Formed from phyto-, derived from Greek phyton (“plant”), and plasma, from Greek plasma (“something formed or moulded”).
example_en: Phytoplasmas are obligate prokaryotic plant pathogens that do not possess cell walls, and they are pleiomorphic in profile, with a mean diameter of 200–800 nm. (DP 12: Phytoplasmas. International Plant Protection Convention, FAO, 2016)

definition_uz: Oqsil qobig‘iga ega bo‘lmagan, kichik halqasimon bir zanjirli RNKdan tashkil topgan subvirus yuqumli agentlar. Viroidlar oqsil kodlamaydi, ammo xo‘jayin o‘simlik fermentlaridan foydalanib mustaqil replikatsiyalanadi; ayrimlari kartoshka, pomidor, sitrus, uzum va boshqa o‘simliklarda kasallik qo‘zg‘atadi.
etymology_uz: Viroid xalqaro ilmiy termin bo‘lib, virus so‘ziga «o‘xshash» ma’nosini bildiruvchi -oid qo‘shimchasini qo‘shish orqali hosil qilingan. Termin 1971-yilda Teodor O. Diner tomonidan taklif etilgan.
example_uz: Viruslar faqat nuklein kislotadan iborat bo‘lib, kapsulaga ega bo‘lmasa viroidlar deyiladi. (Mikrobiologiya, fitopatologiya va qishloq xo‘jalik biotexnologiyasi fanidan laboratoriya mashg‘ulotlarini o‘tkazish bo‘yicha uslubiy ko‘rsatma. I. Qurbonov, 2016)
definition_en: Small, circular, single-stranded, non-protein-coding RNA infectious agents that lack a protein capsid and replicate autonomously in susceptible plant cells by using host enzymes. Some viroids cause plant diseases, whereas others produce symptomless infections.
etymology_en: Coined in 1971 by Theodor O. Diener from virus and the suffix -oid, meaning “resembling” or “like”.
example_en: Viroids are small (a few hundred nucleotides long), circular, single-stranded, non-protein-coding RNAs that replicate autonomously in higher plants. (Subviral Agent: Viroids. Francesco Di Serio, Robert A. Owens, Shi-Fang Li, Jaroslav Matoušek, Vicente Pallás, John W. Randles, Teruo Sano, Jacobus Th. J. Verhoeven, Georgios Vidalakis and Ricardo Flores, ICTV, 2020)

definition_uz: Yadrosi va membrana bilan o‘ralgan organoidlari bo‘lmagan bir hujayrali prokariot organizmlar. Bakteriyalar tabiatda keng tarqalgan bo‘lib, organik moddalarning parchalanishi va oziq elementlarining aylanishida qatnashadi; ayrim turlari foydali, ayrim fitopatogen turlari esa o‘simliklarda dog‘lanish, chirish, so‘lish, kuyish va shish kabi kasalliklarni qo‘zg‘atadi.
etymology_uz: Bakteriya xalqaro ilmiy termin bo‘lib, yangi lotincha bacterium orqali qadimgi yunoncha baktērion — «kichik tayoqcha» so‘zidan olingan. Dastlab kuzatilgan bakteriyalarning ayrimlari tayoqchasimon bo‘lgani uchun shunday nomlangan.
example_uz: Bakteriyalar bir hujayrali xlorofilsiz organizmlardir. (Mikrobiologiya, fitopatologiya va qishloq xo‘jalik biotexnologiyasi. I. Qurbonov, 2016)
definition_en: Unicellular prokaryotic microorganisms whose cells lack a membrane-bound nucleus and other membrane-bound organelles. They have diverse metabolic and ecological functions; many are beneficial or harmless, while some species cause diseases of plants, animals and humans.
etymology_en: From New Latin bacterium, derived from Ancient Greek baktērion (“small staff or cane”), the diminutive of baktēria (“staff”), referring to the rod-like form of some early observed bacteria.
example_en: Bacteria (singular: bacterium) are any of various unicellular prokaryotic microorganisms typically, but not always, having cell walls that contain peptidoglycan. (Microbiology. Nina Parker, Mark Schneegurt, Anh-Hue Thi Tu, Philip Lister and Brian M. Forster, OpenStax, 2016)

definition_uz: Tanasi bo‘g‘imlarga ajralmagan, cho‘zinchoq va ko‘ndalang kesimi yumaloq bo‘lgan chuvalchanglar tipi. Ularning erkin yashovchi, hayvonlarda parazitlik qiluvchi va o‘simlik to‘qimalari bilan oziqlanuvchi turlari mavjud. Fitoparazit nematodalar odatda stilet yordamida o‘simlik hujayralarini teshib oziqlanadi hamda ildiz, poya, barg va urug‘larda zararlanish yoki kasallik belgilarini yuzaga keltiradi.
etymology_uz: Nematoda xalqaro zoologik termin bo‘lib, yunoncha nēma, nēmatos («ip») va -ōdēs («o‘xshash») qismlaridan hosil qilingan; nom ularning ipsimon tana shakliga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: Nematodalar, ya’ni yumaloq chuvalchanglar tuproqda va o‘simliklarda hayot kechiruvchi mikroskopik shaklga ega, rangsiz qurtlardir. (Umumiy va qishloq xo‘jaligi fitopatologiyasi. A. Sheraliyev, 2008)
definition_en: Unsegmented roundworms belonging to the phylum Nematoda. The group includes free-living species and parasites of plants and animals. Plant-parasitic nematodes usually possess a stylet used to pierce plant cells and may feed externally or within roots, stems, leaves, seeds and other plant tissues.
etymology_en: From New Latin Nematoda, based on Greek nēma, nēmatos (“thread”) and -ōdēs (“resembling”), referring to their thread-like bodies.
example_en: Members of the phylum Nematoda (round worms) have been in existence for an estimated one billion years, making them one of the most ancient and diverse types of animals on earth. (Introduction to Plant-Parasitic Nematodes. K. Lambert and S. Bekal, The Plant Health Instructor, 2002)

definition_uz: Hujayraviy tuzilishga ega bo‘lmagan, genomi DNK yoki RNKdan tashkil topgan yuqumli agentlar. Virus genomi odatda oqsil qobiq — kapsid bilan o‘raladi, ayrim viruslarda tashqi lipidli qobiq ham mavjud. Viruslar mustaqil moddalar almashinuviga ega emas va faqat tirik xo‘jayin hujayrasining biosintetik tizimidan foydalanib ko‘payadi; o‘simliklarni zararlaydigan turlari fitopatogen viruslar deyiladi.
etymology_uz: Virus xalqaro ilmiy termin bo‘lib, lotincha virus — «zahar, zaharli modda» so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Viruslar tabiatda keng tarqalgan bo‘lib, o‘simlik, hayvon va insonlarda kasalliklar keltirib chiqaradi. Ular hujayrali tuzilishga ega bo‘lmaydi, faqat tirik organizmlar hujayrasida ko‘payadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. X.X. Kimsanboyev, B.A. Sulaymonov, A.R. Anorbayev, A.A. Rustamov, 2017)
definition_en: Acellular infectious agents whose genomes consist of either DNA or RNA and are generally enclosed in a protein capsid, sometimes with an additional lipid envelope. Viruses lack independent metabolic and reproductive systems and can replicate only by using the molecular machinery of a living host cell.
etymology_en: From Latin virus, meaning “poison” or “venom”.
example_en: A virus is an acellular microorganism, consisting of proteins and genetic material (DNA or RNA), that can replicate itself by infecting a host cell. (Microbiology. Nina Parker, Mark Schneegurt, Anh-Hue Thi Tu, Philip Lister and Brian M. Forster, OpenStax, 2016)

definition_uz: Maxsus so‘rg‘ich organ — gaustoriy orqali boshqa tirik o‘simlikning ildizi yoki poyasiga bevosita birikib, undan suv va oziq moddalar oladigan gulli o‘simliklar. Fotosintez qilish darajasiga ko‘ra yarim parazitlar va to‘liq parazitlarga, xo‘jayin o‘simlikka birikish joyiga ko‘ra esa ildiz hamda poya parazitlariga bo‘linadi.
example_uz: Ana shunday hayotiy faoliyatiga ko‘ra, gulli parazit o‘simliklar ildiz va poya parazitlariga bo‘linadi. (Mikrobiologiya, fitopatologiya va qishloq xo‘jalik biotexnologiyasi fanidan laboratoriya mashg‘ulotlarini o‘tkazish bo‘yicha uslubiy ko‘rsatma. I. Qurbonov, 2016, 60-b.)
definition_en: Flowering plants that attach directly to a living host plant through a specialized structure called a haustorium and obtain water, mineral nutrients or organic compounds from the host. They are classified as hemiparasites or holoparasites and as root or stem parasites.
example_en: These organisms certainly do cause damage to economically important plants, but surprisingly parasitic flowering plants are also important pathogens. (Introduction to Parasitic Flowering Plants. Daniel L. Nickrent and Lytton J. Musselman, The Plant Health Instructor, 2004; updated 2016)

definition_uz: Muayyan patogen irqi, shtammi yoki izolyatining ma’lum xo‘jayin o‘simlikni zararlashi va unda kasallik yuzaga keltirish darajasi. Patogenlik kasallik qo‘zg‘ata olish xususiyatini, virulentlik esa bu xususiyatning muayyan xo‘jayin genotipiga nisbatan namoyon bo‘lish darajasini bildiradi.
etymology_uz: Xalqaro termin bo‘lib, lotincha virulentus («zaharli, zaharga to‘la») so‘ziga borib taqaladi
example_uz: Tabiatda uchraydigan mikroorganizmlar biotiplarida agressivlik va virulentlik xususiyati bilan keskin farq qiladigan turlar mavjud. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: The capacity or relative degree of a pathogen race, strain, or isolate to infect a particular host genotype and cause disease or damage. In plant pathology, pathogenicity denotes the general ability to cause disease, whereas virulence describes its expression in a particular host–pathogen interaction.
etymology_en: Derived from Latin virulentus («poisonous, full of poison»), from virus («poison»).
example_en: We define virulence as the degree of damage caused to a host by parasite infection. (The Evolution of Virulence and Pathogenicity in Plant Pathogen Populations. Sacristán S., García-Arenal F., 2008)

definition_uz: O‘simlikka kirib yoki uning to‘qimalarida rivojlanib, yuqumli kasallik qo‘zg‘ata oladigan biologik agent. Fitopatogenlarga kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchi zamburug‘lar, oomitsetlar, bakteriyalar, fitoplazmalar, viruslar, viroidlar va ayrim nematodalar kiradi.
etymology_uz: Xalqaro termin: fito- yunoncha phyton («o‘simlik»), patogen esa yunoncha pathos («kasallik, azob») va -genes («hosil qiluvchi, tug‘diruvchi») qismlaridan shakllangan.
example_uz: Ayrim tadqiqotlarda o‘simlik ekstraktlarining antimikrob, jumladan antibakterial faolligi qayd etilgan bo‘lib, bu uning fitopatogen mikroorganizmlarga qarshi biologik preparatlar yaratishdagi istiqbollarini ko‘rsatadi. (Azolla caroliniana ning biologik faol moddalari va fitopatogen mikroorganizmlarga qarshi biotexnologik salohiyati. Rahmatova Z.B., 2026)
definition_en: A biological agent capable of infecting a plant and causing infectious disease. Plant pathogens include pathogenic fungi, oomycetes, bacteria, phytoplasmas, viruses, viroids, and certain nematodes.
etymology_en: Plant is derived from Latin planta; pathogen is formed from Greek pathos («suffering, disease») and -genēs («producing or generating»).
example_en: Plant pathogens are very similar to those that cause disease in humans and animals and include viruses, bacteria, fungi, and nematodes. (Things to Do: Purpose and Background. American Phytopathological Society)

definition_uz: Mikroorganizm yoki boshqa biologik agentning moyil xo‘jayin o‘simlikni zararlab, unda kasallik qo‘zg‘ata olish qobiliyati. Patogenlik, odatda, sifat belgisi sifatida qaraladi; virulentlik esa patogenning muayyan xo‘jayin genotipiga ta’siri yoki kasallik keltirib chiqarish darajasini ifodalaydi.
etymology_uz: Patogen xalqaro termini va o‘zbekcha -lik ot yasovchi qo‘shimchasidan tuzilgan. Patogen yunoncha pathos («kasallik, azob») va -genēs («hosil qiluvchi, tug‘diruvchi») qismlariga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Buning uchun kuchsiz patogenlik xususiyatiga ega bo‘lgan virus shtammi bilan kasallantirilgan o‘simliklar kuchli patogenlik xususiyatiga ega bo‘lgan shtammlar bilan kasallanmasligi aniqlangan. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: The ability of a biological agent to infect a susceptible host plant and cause disease. In plant pathology, pathogenicity is generally treated as a qualitative property, whereas virulence describes host-specific expression or the relative disease-causing capacity of a pathogen.
etymology_en: Formed from pathogenic and the noun-forming suffix -ity; pathogenic ultimately derives from Greek pathos («disease, suffering») and -genēs («producing or generating»).
example_en: We use the term pathogenicity to describe the ability of a pathogen to colonize a particular host. (Continua of Specificity and Virulence in Plant Host–Pathogen Interactions: Causes and Consequences. Barrett L.G. et al., 2009)

definition_uz: Patogen shtammi yoki izolyatining sezgir xo‘jayin o‘simlikda kasallikni rivojlantirish va muayyan miqdorda zararlanish hosil qilish xususiyati. Agressivlik infeksiya samaradorligi, yashirin davr davomiyligi, zararlangan to‘qima hajmi, spora hosil qilish va kasallikning rivojlanish tezligi kabi miqdoriy ko‘rsatkichlar bilan baholanadi.
etymology_uz: Xalqaro termin bo‘lib, lotincha aggressio («hujum, tajovuz») so‘ziga borib taqaladi
example_uz: Tabiatda uchraydigan mikroorganizmlar biotiplarida agressivlik va virulentlik xususiyati bilan keskin farq qiladigan turlar mavjud. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: The quantitative capacity of a pathogen strain or isolate to cause disease on a susceptible host. It may be assessed through infection efficiency, latent period, lesion size, sporulation, disease severity, and the rate of disease development.
etymology_en: Formed from aggressive and the noun-forming suffix -ness; aggressive ultimately derives from Latin aggressus, the past participle of aggredi («to approach or attack»).
example_en: One method to identify costs of virulence is to measure the aggressiveness of pathogen strains. (Virulence, Aggressiveness, and Fungicide Sensitivity of Phytophthora spp. Associated with Soybean in Illinois. Cerritos-Garcia D.G., Huang S.-Y., Kleczewski N.M., Mideros S.X., 2023)

definition_uz: Boshqa organizm — xo‘jayinning tanasi ichida yoki yuzasida yashab, undan oziqa va yashash muhiti sifatida foydalanadigan organizmlar. Fitopatologiyada parazitlarga o‘simlikning tirik to‘qimalari hisobidan oziqlanuvchi zamburug‘lar, oomitsetlar, bakteriyalar, nematodalar va gulli parazit o‘simliklar kirishi mumkin. Parazitlarning barchasi ham patogen bo‘lavermaydi; patogen parazit xo‘jayinda kasallik yoki sezilarli zarar keltirib chiqaradi.
etymology_uz: Xalqaro termin bo‘lib, yunoncha parasitos («birovning dasturxonidan oziqlanuvchi») so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Fitopatologiya fanidan dala amaliyotining asosiy maqsadi talabalarni dala sharoitida o‘rmon o‘simliklarida zamburug‘lar, bakteriyalar, viruslar va gullik parazitlar keltirib chiqaradigan kasalliklarning asosiy tiplari bilan tanishtirishdir. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Organisms that live on or in host organisms and obtain nutrients or other essential resources from them. In plant pathology, parasites may include fungi, oomycetes, bacteria, nematodes, and parasitic plants that depend wholly or partly on living plant tissues. A parasite is not necessarily a pathogen unless it causes disease or appreciable damage to its host.
etymology_en: From Latin parasitus, derived from Greek parasitos («one who eats at another’s table»), formed from para- («beside») and sitos («food or grain»).
example_en: A parasite is an organism which lives on or in a larger organism, feeding upon it. (Glossary of Phytosanitary Terms, ISPM 3. FAO, 1995)

definition_uz: Har xil turga mansub ikki organizm o‘rtasidagi biologik munosabat bo‘lib, bunda parazit xo‘jayinning tanasi ichida yoki yuzasida yashaydi, undan oziqa va yashash muhiti sifatida foydalanadi hamda unga zarar yetkazadi. Parazitizm odatda xo‘jayinning darhol nobud bo‘lishiga olib kelmaydi.
etymology_uz: Xalqaro termin bo‘lib, yunoncha parasitos («birovning dasturxonidan oziqlanuvchi») so‘zi va biologik jarayon yoki holatni bildiruvchi -izm qo‘shimchasidan shakllangan.
example_uz: Parazitizm — bir organizm boshqa bir organizmdan yashash joyi va ozuqa sifatida foydalanadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A biological interaction between organisms of different species in which the parasite lives on or in the host, obtains food or other resources from it, and causes harm to the host. Unlike a predator, the parasite does not necessarily kill the host directly.
etymology_en: Formed from parasite and the suffix -ism. Parasite derives through Latin parasitus from Greek parasitos («one who eats at another’s table»), from para- («beside») and sitos («food or grain»).
example_en: Parasitism is a two-species association in which one species, the parasite, lives on or in a second species, the host, and obtains nourishment from it. (Soil Macrofauna Field Manual: Technical Level. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 2008)

definition_uz: Patogen, parazit yoki zararkunandaning yashashi, oziqlanishi, ko‘payishi yoxud hayot siklining muayyan bosqichini o‘tashi uchun sharoit yaratadigan o‘simlik. Fitopatologiyada xo‘jayin o‘simlik patogen tomonidan zararlanishi va unda patogenning rivojlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan o‘simlikni bildiradi.
example_uz: Viruslar xo‘jayin o‘simlik hujayrasida uning oqsilli po‘stlog‘ini parchalab, virusning nuklein kislotasini hosil qiladi va u yangidan hosil bo‘lgan oqsil bilan birlashib, xo‘jayin hujayrasidan tashqariga chiqadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A plant that provides food, shelter, habitat, or breeding sites for another organism or supports the survival, reproduction, or development of a pathogen, parasite, or pest. In plant pathology, it is a plant that can be infected and colonized by a particular pathogen.
example_en: A host plant is a plant that can support the growth, survival, or reproduction of a pathogen, pest, or contaminant. (Host Plant. European Food Safety Authority Glossary)

definition_uz: Hayoti, oziqlanishi yoki ko‘payishi uchun tirik xo‘jayin organizmga majburiy ravishda bog‘liq bo‘lgan parazitlar. Fitopatologiyada ular tirik o‘simlik hujayralaridan oziqlanadi, tabiatda saprotrof hayot kechira olmaydi va odatda hujayrasiz sun’iy oziqa muhitida o‘stirilmaydi. Zang va un-shudring qo‘zg‘atuvchilari obligat parazitlarga misol bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Obligat lotincha obligatus («majburiy, bog‘langan»), parazit esa yunoncha parasitos («birovning dasturxonidan oziqlanuvchi») so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Obligat parazitlar sog‘lom, yaxshi rivojlangan o‘simliklarni afzal ko‘radi va ko‘pincha shikastlanmagan to‘qimalarni, meristemani zararlaydi.(Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Parasites that depend on a living host for growth, nutrition, reproduction, or completion of their life cycle. In plant pathology, they obtain nutrients from living host cells and generally cannot be maintained on cell-free artificial culture media.
etymology_en: Obligate derives from Latin obligatus («bound or made obligatory»); parasite derives through Latin parasitus from Greek parasitos («one who eats at another’s table»).
example_en: An obligate parasite is an organism that can grow only as a parasite in association with its host plant and cannot be grown in artificial culture media. (Illustrated Glossary of Plant Pathology. D’Arcy C.J., Eastburn D.M., Schumann G.L., 2001)

definition_uz: Odatda tirik xo‘jayin organizmda parazit sifatida yashaydigan, ammo xo‘jayin to‘qimasi nobud bo‘lgach yoki boshqa qulay sharoitda o‘lik organik moddalarda saprotrof tarzda oziqlanib, rivojlanishini davom ettira oladigan organizmlar. Olma kalmarazi qo‘zg‘atuvchisi Venturia inaequalis bunga misol bo‘lib, o‘suv davrida tirik barg va mevalarni zararlaydi, keyinchalik to‘kilgan barglarda saprotrof bosqichini o‘taydi.
etymology_uz: Fakultativ lotincha facultativus («ixtiyoriy, muayyan sharoitda mumkin»), saprotrof esa yunoncha sapros («chirigan») va trophē («oziqlanish») qismlaridan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Fakultativ saprotroflar ozuqa muhitlarida ham o‘sa oladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Organisms that normally live as parasites on living hosts but can switch to saprotrophic growth and obtain nutrients from dead host tissues or other nonliving organic matter. In plant pathology, the saprotrophic phase may permit a pathogen to survive on crop residues between periods of infection.
etymology_en: Facultative derives from Latin facultativus («optional or contingent»); saprotroph is formed from Greek sapros («rotten») and trophē («nourishment»).
example_en: In a living plant, we observe obligate parasites, facultative saprotrophs, and much less frequently, facultative parasites. (Overview on Parasitism. Dyakov Yu.T., 2007)

definition_uz: Hujayralari faol bo‘linish qobiliyatini saqlaydigan va keyinchalik turli doimiy to‘qima hamda organlarga differensiatsiyalanadigan o‘simlik to‘qimasi. Meristema o‘simlikning bo‘yiga va eniga o‘sishini, yangi organlar hosil bo‘lishini hamda ayrim jarohatlarning tiklanishini ta’minlaydi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha meristos («bo‘linuvchi, bo‘linishga qodir») so‘zidan olingan xalqaro botanika termini.
example_uz: Meristema to‘qimasi behisob bo‘linish va shu xususiyatini ko‘p vaqt saqlab qoladigan bir qancha initsial hujayralarga ega. (Botanika, Pratov O‘. va boshq., 2010)
definition_en: Plant tissue composed of undifferentiated or partly differentiated cells that retain the capacity for active cell division and subsequently produce specialized tissues and organs. Meristems are responsible for primary and secondary plant growth.
etymology_en: Derived from Greek meristos («divisible»), from merizein («to divide»). The botanical term was introduced by Carl Wilhelm von Nägeli in the nineteenth century.
example_en: Meristem is undifferentiated but determined tissue, the cells of which are capable of active cell division and differentiation into specialized and permanent tissue. (Glossary of Biotechnology for Food and Agriculture. Zaid A., Hughes H.G., Porceddu E., Nicholas F., FAO, 2001)

definition_uz: O‘lik yoki chiriyotgan organik moddalarni tashqi muhitga ajratgan fermentlari yordamida parchalab, hosil bo‘lgan eruvchan birikmalarni so‘rish orqali oziqlanadigan geterotrof organizm. Saprotroflar, ayniqsa zamburug‘ va bakteriyalar, organik qoldiqlarning parchalanishi hamda oziq elementlarining tabiatdagi aylanishida muhim vazifa bajaradi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha sapros («chirigan») va trophē («oziqlanish») qismlaridan tuzilgan xalqaro biologiya termini.
example_uz: Saprotrof zamburug‘lar asosan tuproqda hayot kechirib, undagi o‘simlik qoldiqlarini mineral moddalarga parchalaydi, tuproqda gumus miqdorini orttirib, strukturasining yaxshilanishiga sabab bo‘ladi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A heterotrophic organism that obtains nutrients from dead or decaying organic matter by secreting extracellular enzymes and absorbing the resulting soluble compounds. Saprotrophs, particularly fungi and bacteria, are important decomposers in nutrient cycling.
etymology_en: Formed from Greek sapros («rotten or decayed») and trophē («nourishment»).
example_en: A saprotroph is an organism that obtains nourishment from nonliving organic matter. (Illustrated Glossary of Plant Pathology. D’Arcy C.J., Eastburn D.M., Schumann G.L., 2001)

definition_uz: Bir organizmning boshqa organizm o‘sishi, rivojlanishi, ko‘payishi yoki hayot faoliyatini bostiradigan biologik munosabat. O‘simliklarni biologik himoya qilishda antagonizm raqobat, antibioz, giperparazitizm, litik fermentlar ishlab chiqarish yoki o‘simlik chidamliligini faollashtirish orqali fitopatogenni cheklashi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha antagōnisma («qarshilik, kurash») so‘zidan olingan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: O‘zbekiston sharoitida mahalliylashtirilgan yalpiz o‘simligidan ajratilgan Lactobacillus paraplantarum va golubika mevasidan ajratilgan Lactobacillus plantarum bakteriyalarining fitopatogen mikromitsetlarga nisbatan antagonizm xususiyati faol. (Sut achituvchi bakteriyalarning fitopatogen mikromitsetlarga nisbatan antagonizm xususiyati. Kamolova H., Kutliyeva G., To‘rayeva B., 2021)
definition_en: A biological interaction in which one organism inhibits, damages, or interferes with the growth or activity of another. In biological control of plant diseases, antagonism may operate through competition, antibiosis, hyperparasitism, production of lytic enzymes, or induction of host resistance.
etymology_en: Derived from Greek antagōnisma («opposition or struggle»), from antagōnizesthai («to struggle against»).
example_en: The different mechanisms of antagonism occur across a spectrum of directionality related to the amount of interspecies contact and specificity of the interactions. (Biological Control of Plant Pathogens. Pal K.K., McSpadden Gardener B., 2006)

definition_uz: Boshqa organizm, ayniqsa fitopatogenning o‘sishi, rivojlanishi, ko‘payishi yoki kasallik qo‘zg‘atish faoliyatini bostiradigan organizmlar. Biologik himoyada antagonistlar raqobat, antibioz, giperparazitizm, litik fermentlar ishlab chiqarish yoki xo‘jayin o‘simlik chidamliligini faollashtirish orqali ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha antagōnistēs («raqib, qarshi kurashuvchi») so‘zidan olingan xalqaro termin.
example_uz: Antagonistlarning ko‘pchiligi tuproq mikroorganizmlaridir. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: Organisms that inhibit, damage, or interfere with the growth, reproduction, survival, or pathogenic activity of other organisms. In plant disease control, antagonists suppress pathogens through mechanisms such as competition, antibiosis, hyperparasitism, lytic enzymes, or induction of host resistance.
etymology_en: Derived through Latin antagonista from Greek antagōnistēs («opponent or competitor»), from antagōnizesthai («to struggle against»).
example_en: For plant diseases, biological control is most usually defined as direct or indirect inhibition of a disease, or the pathogen causing the disease, by another organism — an antagonist — or group of organisms. (Biological Control of Plant Diseases: What Has Been Achieved and What Is the Direction? Collinge D.B. et al., 2022)

definition_uz: Bakteriya hujayrasini zararlaydigan va uning ichida ko‘payadigan virus. Virulent bakteriofaglar ko‘payish yakunida bakteriya hujayrasini lizisga uchratadi; mo‘tadil bakteriofaglar esa genomini bakteriya genomiga qo‘shib, profag holatida saqlanishi mumkin. Fitopatologiyada litik bakteriofaglardan bakterial o‘simlik kasalliklarini biologik nazorat qilishda foydalanish mumkin.
etymology_uz: Bakteriofag termini «bakteriya» hamda yunoncha phagein («yemoq») qismlaridan tuzilgan bo‘lib, «bakteriyani yemiruvchi» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Bakteriofag — bakteriyalarni zararlovchi virus. (Mikroorganizmlar biotexnologiyasi. Bo‘riyev S.B., Sharopova Sh.R., Sultonova K.R., 2024)
definition_en: A virus that specifically infects bacteria and replicates within bacterial cells. Virulent bacteriophages reproduce through the lytic cycle and lyse their host cells, whereas temperate bacteriophages may integrate their genetic material into the bacterial genome as a prophage. Lytic bacteriophages can be used as biological control agents against bacterial plant pathogens.
etymology_en: Formed from bacterium and Greek phagein («to eat»), literally meaning «bacteria eater».
example_en: Bacteriophages, the viruses that can infect and kill only target bacteria very specifically, have been demonstrated as potential agents. (Bacteriophage Usage for Bacterial Disease Management and Diagnosis in Plants. Lee C.N. et al., 2020)

definition_uz: Ko‘pchiligi gramm-musbat bo‘lgan, ayrim vakillari shoxlangan ipsimon tuzilmalar hosil qiladigan bakteriyalar guruhi. Ular tuproqda organik qoldiqlarni parchalashda qatnashadi; ayrimlari antibiotik va boshqa biologik faol moddalar ishlab chiqarib, fitopatogenlarni cheklaydi, ayrim turlari esa o‘simliklarda kasallik qo‘zg‘atishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Termin yunoncha aktis, aktinos («nur») va mykēs («zamburug‘») so‘zlaridan shakllangan. Bunday nom ularning zamburug‘ mitseliysiga o‘xshash shoxlangan ipsimon tuzilishi tufayli berilgan.
example_uz: Tuproqdagi antagonistik mikroblar: bakteriyalar, zamburug‘lar, aktinomitsetlar, faglar o‘z rivojlanishining turli bosqichlarida fitopatogen zamburug‘lar va bakteriyalarga ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A diverse group of predominantly Gram-positive bacteria, many of which develop branching filamentous structures resembling fungal hyphae. Soil actinomycetes contribute to organic-matter decomposition, and some produce antibiotics, hydrolytic enzymes and other bioactive compounds that suppress plant pathogens; other species may themselves be plant pathogens.
etymology_en: Derived from Greek aktis or aktinos («ray») and mykēs («fungus»), referring to the radiating, fungus-like filamentous growth observed in many members of the group.
example_en: Actinomycetes are a broad group of bacteria that form thread-like filaments in the soil. (The Importance of Soil Organic Matter: Key to Drought-resistant Soil and Sustained Food Production. FAO, 2005)

definition_uz: Asosan danakli meva daraxtlarida “Wilsonomyces carpophilus” zamburug‘i qo‘zg‘atadigan yuqumli kasallik. Barglarda qizg‘ish yoki binafsharang-qo‘ng‘ir dog‘lar hosil bo‘lib, ularning nekrozlangan markazi tushib ketishi natijasida teshiklar paydo bo‘ladi. Kasallik kurtak, gul, novda va mevalarni ham zararlab, mevalarda po‘kaksimon dog‘lar, novdalarda yara hamda yelim oqishini yuzaga keltirishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Termin kasallik qo‘zg‘atuvchisining ilgari qo‘llangan “Clasterosporium” turkumi nomi va kasallikni bildiruvchi -oz qo‘shimchasidan shakllangan.
example_uz: Danak mevali daraxtlarning “Klyasterosporioz – teshikli dog‘lanish” kasalligi o‘rik, shaftoli, olxo‘ri, olcha yetishtiriladigan hududlarda uchrashi aniqlandi. (Urug‘li va danak mevali daraxtlarning ayrim zamburug‘ kasalliklari (Samarqand shahri sharoitida). Norimova G.K., Umurzakova Z.I., 2024)
definition_en: An infectious fungal disease occurring mainly on stone-fruit trees and caused by “Wilsonomyces carpophilus”. Reddish or purplish-brown spots develop on the leaves, and their necrotic centres subsequently fall out, producing characteristic shot holes. The disease may also affect buds, flowers, shoots and fruits, causing corky fruit lesions, shoot cankers and gumming.
example_en: Shot hole disease affects Prunus spp. (Shot Hole, or Coryneum Blight. University of California Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program)
synonyms_en: Coryneum blight; Shothole blight; Shot-hole of stone fruit

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtlarda “Monilinia” turkumiga mansub zamburug‘lar qo‘zg‘atadigan yuqumli kasallik. Kasallik gullar va yosh novdalarning kuyishga o‘xshab qurishi, mevalarning qo‘ng‘ir chirishi, yuzasida kulrang yoki sarg‘ish-qo‘ng‘ir sporali yostiqchalar paydo bo‘lishi hamda zararlangan mevalarning mumiyolanishi bilan namoyon bo‘ladi. Asosiy qo‘zg‘atuvchilariga *Monilinia fructigena*, *M. laxa* va *M. fructicola* kiradi.
etymology_uz: Monilioz termini “Monilia” zamburug‘i nomidan hosil bo‘lgan. “Monilia” nomi lotincha monile («marjon, munchoqlar tizmasi») so‘ziga borib taqaladi va zamburug‘ konidiyalarining zanjirsimon joylashishiga ishora qiladi.
example_uz: Monilioz kasalligi zararlangan joyda qo‘ng‘ir rangdagi dog‘lanish bilan boshlanadi. Meva mag‘zi qo‘ng‘ir rangga kirib, yumshoq bo‘lib qoladi, mazasi yo‘qoladi. (Fitopatologiya. Xalmuminova G.Q., 2025)
definition_en: An infectious fungal disease of fruit trees caused by species of “Monilinia”. It is characterized by blossom and young-shoot blight, rapidly spreading brown fruit rot, the formation of grey or tan spore masses, and the mummification of infected fruits. Important causal species include *Monilinia fructigena*, *M. laxa*, and *M. fructicola*.
example_en: Brown rot is a fungal disease of tree fruit, caused by the fungi “Monilinia laxa” and “M. fructigena”. (Brown Rot. Royal Horticultural Society)
synonyms_en: Moniliosis; Brown rot of fruit trees; Monilinia brown rot

definition_uz: Olma va nokning barglari, gullari, yosh novdalari hamda mevalarini zararlaydigan zamburug‘ kasalligi. Olmada uni Venturia inaequalis, nokda esa Venturia pyrina qo‘zg‘atadi. Kasallik barglarda zaytunsimon-qoramtir dog‘lar, mevalarda po‘kaksimon qasmoqlar, yorilish va shakl buzilishini keltirib chiqaradi.
example_uz: Olma va nokning parshasi (kalmaraz). Katta yoshli bog‘larda o‘sayotgan mevali daraxtlarning asosiy kasalliklariga parsha (kalmaraz), un-shudring, mevaning chirishi, sitosporoz, bargning dog‘lanishi kabilar kiradi. (Fitopatologiya. Xalmuminova G.Q., 2025)
definition_en: Two closely related fungal diseases affecting apples and pears. Apple scab is caused by Venturia inaequalis and pear scab by Venturia pyrina. The diseases produce olive-green to dark velvety leaf spots and brown or black scabby fruit lesions that may cause distortion, cracking, premature leaf fall, and reduced market quality.
example_en: Apple scab and pear scab are two fungal diseases that cause dark, scabby marks on the fruit and leaves of apples, pears and some other ornamental fruits. (Apple and pear scab. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Shaftolining barglari, yosh novdalari va mevalarini zararlaydigan zamburug‘ kasalligi. Uni, asosan, Podosphaera pannosa qo‘zg‘atadi. Zararlangan qismlarda oqish-kulrang unsimon qoplama paydo bo‘ladi; barglar buralishi, novdalar o‘sishi susayishi, mevalarning dog‘lanishi va tovar sifati pasayishi mumkin.
example_uz: Kasallikni Sphaerotheca pannosa turining Sphaerotheca pannosa var. persicae kenja turi qo‘zg‘atadi. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: A fungal disease of peach affecting fruit, leaves, buds, shoots, and twigs. It is caused mainly by Podosphaera pannosa and produces a superficial white to greyish powdery growth of fungal mycelium and conidia. Severe fruit infection reduces appearance and marketability.
example_en: The fungus Podosphaera pannosa is one of the causal agents of the powdery mildew that occurs on peach, nectarines, and flat fruit. (Marimon N. et al., Plant Disease, 2020)

definition_uz: Olma va nokning kurtaklari, barglari, gullari, yosh novdalari va ba’zan mevalarini zararlaydigan zamburug‘ kasalligi. Asosiy qo‘zg‘atuvchisi Podosphaera leucotricha hisoblanadi. Zararlangan qismlarda oqish-kulrang unsimon qoplama paydo bo‘lib, barglar buraladi, novdalar o‘sishi susayadi, gullar qurishi va mevalarning to‘rsimon zanglanishi kuzatilishi mumkin.
example_uz: Olma va nokning hamma yer ustki organlari — bargi, novdasi, guli va ba’zan mevasi kasallanadi. Kasallikning dastlabki belgilari yosh barglarda va barg bandlarida oqish-kulrang unsimon g‘ubor ko‘rinishida paydo bo‘ladi. (Fitopatologiya. Xalmuminova G.Q., 2025)
english: Powdery mildew of apple and pear
definition_en: A fungal disease affecting the buds, leaves, blossoms, young shoots, and occasionally the fruit of apple and pear trees. It is caused principally by Podosphaera leucotricha. Infected tissues develop a white to light-grey powdery growth, while leaves may curl, shoots become stunted, blossoms fail to set fruit, and infected fruit may develop net-like russeting.
example_en: Podosphaera leucotricha causes powdery mildew of apple, pear, and quince. (Photosynthesis, Transpiration, and Carbohydrate Content of Apple Leaves Infected by Podosphaera leucotricha. American Phytopathological Society, 1981)

definition_uz: Tokning barglari, yosh novdalari, to‘pgullari va g‘ujumlarini zararlaydigan zamburug‘ kasalligi. Uni Erysiphe necator qo‘zg‘atadi. Zararlangan qismlarda oqish-kulrang unsimon qoplama hosil bo‘ladi; kuchli zararlangan g‘ujumlar o‘sishdan qoladi, yoriladi, quriydi yoki chirishga moyil bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Oidium — lotincha ilmiy nom bo‘lib, yunoncha oion («tuxum») so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Un-shudring yoki oidium kasalligi qo‘zg‘atuvchisi Uncinula necator Burrill zamburug‘i bo‘lib, Erysiphales tartibiga mansubdir. (Fitopatologiya. Xalmuminova G.Q., 2025)
definition_en: A fungal disease of grapevine caused by Erysiphe necator. It affects leaves, shoots, inflorescences, rachises, and berries, producing white powdery colonies of mycelium and conidia. Severely infected berries may stop developing, split, dry out, or become susceptible to secondary rots.
etymology_en: Oidium derives from scientific Latin Oidium, formed from Greek oion, meaning “egg”, with the diminutive suffix -idium.
example_en: On fruit and rachises the pathogen appears as white, powdery masses that may colonize the entire berry surface. (Grape Powdery Mildew. University of California Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program)
synonyms_en: Grapevine powdery mildew; Grape powdery mildew; Oidium

definition_uz: Erysiphales tartibiga mansub obligat parazit zamburug‘lar qo‘zg‘atadigan o‘simlik kasalliklari guruhi. Kasallangan barg, novda, gul va mevalar yuzasida zamburug‘ mitseliysi hamda sporalaridan tashkil topgan oqish yoki kulrang unsimon qoplama hosil bo‘ladi. Kuchli zararlanish o‘sishni susaytiradi, organlarni deformatsiyalaydi va hosil miqdori hamda sifatini pasaytiradi.
example_uz: Un-shudring kasalligi poliz ekinlarida keng tarqalgan kasalliklardan biri hisoblanadi. (Fitopatologiya fanidan o‘quv-uslubiy majmua. Xalmuminova G.Q., 2025)
definition_en: A general name for a group of plant diseases caused by obligate biotrophic fungi of the order Erysiphales. They characteristically produce white to grey powdery colonies of superficial mycelium and spores on leaves, shoots, flowers, and sometimes fruit, reducing plant growth, yield, and product quality.
example_en: Powdery mildew is the name given to diseases resulting from infection by fungi that produce a white to gray, powdery growth on plant surfaces. (Powdery Mildew. University of California Statewide Integrated Pest Management Program)

definition_uz: Qoraqayindoshlar (Fagaceae) oilasiga mansub barg to‘kuvchi daraxt va yirik butalar turkumi. Kashtanlarning barglari oddiy va tishli, gullari uzun kuchalasimon to‘pgullarda joylashadi, yong‘oqsimon mevalari esa tikanli o‘rama ichida rivojlanadi. Ayrim turlari mevasi, yog‘ochi va manzarali xususiyatlari uchun yetishtiriladi.
etymology_uz: Kashtan atamasi lotincha Castanea botanik nomi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: Kashtan odatda bir uyli o‘simlik bo‘lsa-da, ikki uyli tuplari ham uchraydi, bu paytda birida faqat erkak, ikkinchisida urg‘ochi gullar bo‘ladi. (Aholi yashash joylarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirish. Qayimov A.Q., 2012)
definition_en: A genus of deciduous trees and large shrubs in the family Fagaceae. Chestnuts have simple toothed leaves, elongated catkins, and nut fruits enclosed in a conspicuously spiny burr. Several species are cultivated for their edible nuts, durable timber, and ornamental value.
etymology_en: Chestnut developed through Old French chastaigne from Latin castanea, the name of the chestnut tree and its nut.
example_en: Castanea are fast-growing and large deciduous trees or large shrubs, with long, toothed leaves and conspicuous yellow catkins followed by spiny fruits. (Castanea plant profile. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: O‘z turining yoki navining odatiy vakillariga nisbatan past bo‘yli va ixcham o‘sadigan o‘simliklar. Pakana bo‘ylilik tabiiy yoki irsiy xususiyat, seleksiya natijasi yoxud payvandtag, shakl berish va o‘sishni boshqarish usullari ta’sirida yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Bunday o‘simliklardan kichik bog‘lar, bordyurlar, konteynerlar va landshaft kompozitsiyalarida foydalaniladi.
example_uz: Pakana (kichkina) o‘simliklar xiliga subtropik ninabargli va oddiy bargli daraxtlar, butalar kiradi. (Samarqand sharoitida istiqbolli manzarali daraxtlarning introduksiyasi. Ochilov U.A., 2016)
definition_en: Plants that attain a substantially smaller mature size than the standard form of their species or cultivar while retaining a normal, healthy growth habit. Dwarf stature may be natural or genetically determined, produced through breeding, or induced by dwarfing rootstocks and horticultural growth-control techniques. Such plants are useful in small gardens, borders, containers, and compact landscape plantings.
example_en: Dwarf plants normally have a compact, dense growth habit and do not need much pruning to control size or shape. (Pruning Landscape Plants. Mississippi State University Extension Service)

definition_uz: Yalpizdoshlar (Lamiaceae) oilasiga mansub bir yillik va ko‘p yillik o‘tlar, yarim butalar hamda butalar turkumi. Barglari odatda qarama-qarshi joylashgan va ko‘pincha xushbo‘y; ikki labli gullari halqasimon guruhlarda to‘planib, boshoq yoki shingilsimon to‘pgul hosil qiladi. Ko‘plab turlari rang-barang gullari uchun gulzor, bordyur va konteynerlarda o‘stiriladi, ayrimlari dorivor, ziravor va efir moyli o‘simlik hisoblanadi.
etymology_uz: Salviya lotincha Salvia turkum nomidan olingan; nom lotincha salvus — «sog‘lom» so‘zi bilan bog‘lanib, o‘simliklarning qadimdan dorivor maqsadlarda ishlatilganini anglatadi.
example_uz: Marmarak (mavrak, shalfey) — ko‘p yillik o‘simlik yoki yarim butalar turkumi. (Mavrak turlarining xalq tabobatida hamda tibbiyotda qo‘llanilishi. Yusupova Z.A., 2025)
definition_en: A large genus of annual or perennial herbs and shrubs in the family Lamiaceae. Salvias commonly have opposite, often aromatic leaves and two-lipped flowers arranged in whorls that form spikes or racemes. Numerous species and cultivars are grown as ornamental flowering plants, while others are used as culinary herbs, medicinal plants, or sources of essential oil.
etymology_en: The botanical name Salvia is Latin and is traditionally associated with salvus, meaning “healthy” or “safe”, in reference to the medicinal use of sage plants.
example_en: Salvias are a wonderfully diverse group of plants with many species and cultivars. (How to Grow Salvias. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Magnoliyadoshlar (Magnoliaceae) oilasiga mansub, vatani Shimoliy Amerikaning sharqiy qismi bo‘lgan yirik barg to‘kuvchi daraxt. Barglari o‘ziga xos to‘rt bo‘lakli va uchi kesilgandek ko‘rinadi; yashil-sariq, ichki qismi to‘q sariq belgili gullari shaklan lolaga o‘xshaydi. Tez o‘sishi, tik tanasi, chiroyli gullari va kuzgi sariq barglari tufayli yirik bog‘, xiyobon va ko‘chalarda manzarali daraxt sifatida ekiladi.
example_uz: Amerika lola daraxti (Liriodendron tulipifera) ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda keng qo‘llaniladi. (Samarqand sharoitida istiqbolli manzarali daraxtlarning introduksiyasi. Ochilov U.A., 2016)
definition_en: A large, vigorous deciduous tree of the magnolia family, native to eastern North America. It has distinctive four-lobed, truncate-tipped leaves and tulip-shaped, greenish-yellow flowers marked with orange. It is planted as a specimen, shade, or street tree in parks and spacious landscapes.
etymology_en: The common name tulip tree refers to the resemblance of its greenish-yellow flowers to tulip flowers.
example_en: A vigorous large deciduous tree with distinctively shaped leaves turning butter-yellow in autumn. (Liriodendron tulipifera Plant Profile. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Toldoshlar (Salicaceae) oilasiga mansub, shox va ingichka novdalari pastga osilib o‘sadigan barg to‘kuvchi daraxt. Barglari uzun, tor va nashtarsimon, gullari kuchalasimon to‘pgullarda hosil bo‘ladi. Nam tuproqlarni xush ko‘rgani sababli hovuz, ariq va boshqa suv havzalari bo‘yida hamda bog‘-xiyobonlarda manzarali daraxt sifatida ekiladi.
example_uz: Majnuntol ko‘cha yoqalariga va suv havzalari bo‘yiga, shuningdek bog‘ va parklarda yakka-yakka va gruppalab ekiladi. (Introduktsiya,landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A medium to large deciduous tree in the family Salicaceae, native to northern and eastern China and Korea. It forms a broad crown of long, slender, pendulous branches and has narrow, finely toothed leaves. It is widely planted as an ornamental tree beside ponds, streams, and other sites with moist soil.
etymology_en: The name weeping willow refers to its long, pendulous branches, which give the crown a drooping or weeping appearance.
example_en: A deciduous tree, to 12 m high and wide, with a spreading crown of weeping branches. (Salix babylonica Plant Profile. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Shumg‘iyadoshlar (Orobanchaceae) oilasiga mansub, xlorofillsiz obligat parazit o‘simliklar turkumi. Shumg‘iya gaustoriyalari orqali xo‘jayin o‘simlik ildiziga birikib, undan suv va oziq moddalarni oladi; barglari tangachasimon, urug‘lari juda mayda bo‘ladi. Ayrim turlari sabzavot, poliz, kungaboqar, tamaki va boshqa ekinlarning xavfli parazit begona o‘tlaridir.
example_uz: Shumg‘iya (Orobanche) turkumi yuksak o‘simliklarga mansub bo‘lib, qishloq xo‘jalik ekinlarining obligat parazitlari hisoblanadi. (Parazit begona o‘tlar bioekologiyasi va ularga qarshi kurash choralari. Sulaymonov B.A., Umurzoqov E.U., Nasirov B.S., Xikmatov Sh.T., 2022)
definition_en: A genus of non-photosynthetic, obligate root-parasitic plants in the family Orobanchaceae. Broomrapes attach to host roots through haustoria and obtain water, minerals and assimilates from the host. Several species are serious parasitic weeds of vegetables, legumes, sunflower, tobacco and other crops.
example_en: Broomrapes (Orobanche spp.) are root parasites in the broomrape family (Orobanchaceae) with approximately 200 species worldwide. (Broomrapes. Canadian Food Inspection Agency)

definition_uz: Pechakdoshlar (Convolvulaceae) oilasiga mansub obligat parazit o‘simliklar turkumi. Zarpechakning ingichka, sarg‘ish, qizg‘ish yoki to‘q sariq chirmashuvchi poyasi xo‘jayin o‘simlikning yer ustki qismlariga gaustoriyalari orqali birikib, undan suv va oziq moddalarni oladi. Yetilgan o‘simlikda ildiz bo‘lmaydi, barglari mayda tangachalarga aylangan; ayrim turlari ekinlar, tok, mevali daraxtlar va manzarali o‘simliklarning xavfli parazit begona o‘tlaridir.
example_uz: Zarpechak eng zararli begona o‘tlardan biri. U madaniy o‘simliklar shirasini so‘rib, qishloq xo‘jaligiga katta zarar keltiradi. (Umumiy va qishloq xo‘jaligi fitopatologiyasi. Sheraliyev A., 2017)
definition_en: A genus of obligate parasitic plants in the family Convolvulaceae. Dodders produce slender, twining, usually yellowish, orange or reddish stems that attach to the above-ground parts of host plants by haustoria and obtain water and nutrients from their vascular tissues. Mature plants lack functional roots and have leaves reduced to minute scales.
example_en: Dodders (Cuscuta spp.) are annual or perennial parasitic vines in the morning glory family (Convolvulaceae). (Dodders. Canadian Food Inspection Agency, 2026)

definition_uz: Yo‘lak, xiyobon, maydon, devor yoki maysazor cheti bo‘ylab barpo etiladigan uzun, ensiz va odatda to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak shakldagi gulzor. Unda gullovchi yoki manzarali bargli o‘simliklar bir yoki bir necha qator qilib ekiladi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha «рабатка» orqali nemischa Rabatte — «uzun, ensiz manzarali o‘simliklar jo‘yagi» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Rabatka — uzun gryadkalar, tasma yoki lenta ko‘rinishidagi chiziqli gulzor bo‘lib, asosan gullovchi yoki yaprog‘i manzarali o‘simliklardan ekiladi. (Landshaft arxitekturasi obyektlarini loyihalash. Raximov K.D., Uralov A.S., 2015, 71-bet)
definition_en: A long, narrow flower bed, usually with parallel sides, laid out along a path, drive, lawn, wall, or other boundary. Flowering or ornamental-foliage plants are commonly arranged in one or more rows to produce a continuous decorative display.
example_en: The Avenue looked good and had plenty of colour and has established well, as has the Ribbon Bed with its blended planting. (2023 Northumbria in Bloom Results. Northumbria in Bloom, 2023)
synonyms_en: Ribbon flower bed; Long narrow flower bed

definition_uz: Bog‘ yoki park hududida ko‘p sonli daraxt va butalarni zich guruhlab ekish orqali hosil qilinadigan yirik o‘simlik kompozitsiyasi. Massiv hududni fazoviy qismlarga ajratish, fon yaratish, manzarani shakllantirish hamda himoya va soyalatish vazifalarini bajaradi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha «массив» orqali fransuzcha massif — «yirik, yaxlit massa» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Massiv — bog‘-park hududining parkni tashkil etuvchi o‘simliklardan tuzilgan yirik elementi bo‘lib, 1–4 gektardan bir necha gektargacha joyni egallaydi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A large, visually unified composition formed by grouping numerous trees, shrubs, or other plants in a landscape. Plant masses are used to define spaces, provide structure and enclosure, form a background, and create a strong visual effect.
example_en: The size of a plant mass will depend on the total size of the yard, the size of the individual plants in the mass, and the emphasis or impact desired from the plant material. (Landscape Design: Ten Important Things to Consider. Hansen G., University of Florida IFAS Extension)

definition_uz: Bino oldida, bog‘ yoki xiyobonning kirish va tantanavor qismlarida tekis maydonda barpo etiladigan geometrik va ko‘pincha simmetrik manzarali gulzor kompozitsiyasi. Parter gul ekiladigan bo‘lmalar, past qirqilgan hoshiyalar, maysazor, shag‘alli yo‘laklar, hovuz va haykallarni o‘z ichiga olishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Ruscha «партер» orqali fransuzcha parterre so‘zidan o‘zlashgan; fransuzcha par terre birikmasi «yerda, yer sathida» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Parter — skverlar, parklarning serhasham joylari, jamoat binolari oldilarini bezovchi manzarali tekis maysazor yoki gulzor maydonlar. Parterda hovuzlar va haykallar ham bo‘lishi mumkin. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A formal ornamental garden composition laid out on a level surface, typically consisting of symmetrical or intricate patterns formed by planting beds, low clipped hedges, lawns, coloured gravel and paths. A parterre is commonly positioned near a building and designed to be viewed from above.
etymology_en: Borrowed from French parterre, from par terre, meaning “on the ground”.
example_en: In June 2024 the garden parterre was completed at Dyrham Park, creating a striking link between house and garden. (Visiting Dyrham Park Garden. National Trust, 2024)

definition_uz: Tog‘ landshaftini kichik ko‘lamda aks ettirish uchun tabiiy yoki sun’iy relyefda toshlar, shag‘al va yaxshi drenajlangan tuproqdan barpo etilib, asosan past bo‘yli tog‘ va qoyatosh o‘simliklari ekiladigan manzarali kompozitsiya.
example_uz: Alpinariy — tabiiy yoki sun’iy relyefda tirgovuchli devor bilan qo‘shilib quriladigan, uncha katta bo‘lmagan suv inshootlari, tog‘ landshaftlari o‘simliklari bilan tanlangan landshaft kompozitsiyasi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A garden or landscape feature constructed with rocks, stones, gravel and freely draining soil to imitate rocky or mountainous habitats and display alpine, low-growing and other rock-adapted plants.
example_en: Rock gardens are a great way to display small plants — especially alpines — to great advantage. (Create a Rock Garden with Alpines. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Landshaft yoki gul kompozitsiyasidagi o‘simliklar va boshqa elementlarning rangi, shakli, o‘lchami yoki teksturasi o‘rtasidagi yaqqol farq. Kontrast muayyan elementni ajratib ko‘rsatish, diqqatni jalb qilish va kompozitsiyaning ifodaliligini kuchaytirish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
etymology_uz: Ruscha «контраст» orqali Yevropa tillaridan o‘zlashgan; atama lotincha contra — «qarshi» va stare — «turmoq» unsurlariga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: O‘simliklarni guruhlab ekish uchun tanlashda ularning me’moriy-badiiy xususiyatlariga: balandligi, tashqi shakli-shamoyili, rangi, barglarining xususiyatlariga, ayniqsa, guruhdagi daraxtlarning bo‘yi va tashqi ko‘rinishlarining o‘zaro kontrast yoki nyuans munosabatlarda bo‘lishligiga asosiy e’tiborni qaratish zarurdir. (Landshaft arxitekturasi. Uralov A.S., Adilova L.A., 2014)
definition_en: A noticeable difference between plants or other landscape elements in colour, form, size, texture, or visual weight. Contrast is used to create emphasis, attract attention, distinguish focal elements, and increase visual interest in a composition.
etymology_en: From French contraste and Italian contrasto, ultimately derived from Latin contra — “against” and stare — “to stand”.
example_en: Emphasis is created through contrast in size, color, form, or texture. (Basic Principles of Landscape Design. Hansen G., University of Florida IFAS Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: Landshaft yoki gul kompozitsiyasidagi rang, shakl, o‘lcham va tekstura kabi elementlarning o‘zaro moslashib, ko‘zga yoqimli hamda yaxlit taassurot hosil qiladigan munosabatini ifodalovchi belgi. Garmonik birikmada alohida elementlar bir-birini to‘ldiradi va kompozitsiyaning umumiy uyg‘unligini ta’minlaydi.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha harmonia — «bog‘lanish, muvofiqlik, uyg‘unlik» so‘ziga asoslangan xalqaro atama
example_uz: Garmonik: dumaloq gulzorda bittadan keyin joylashgan, ya’ni qizil sariq bilan, to‘q sariq yashil bilan, sariq havorang bilan, yashil binafsharang bilan, havorang qizil bilan va shu ranglarning majmuasi jigarrang bilan. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: Describing colours, forms, sizes, textures, or other landscape elements that fit together in a visually pleasing and unified composition. Harmonious relationships create coherence while allowing sufficient variety to maintain visual interest.
etymology_en: Derived from harmony, ultimately from Greek harmonia — “joining, agreement, or concord”.
example_en: A color scheme can also be used to unify the landscape by choosing harmonious colors and repeating them throughout the garden. (Landscape Design with Edibles. Hansen G., University of Florida IFAS Extension, 2024)

definition_uz: Bog‘ va ko‘kalamzor hududlarni tabiiy manzaraga yaqin ko‘rinishda tashkil etish uslubi. Unda daraxt, buta va gullar erkin guruhlanadi, elementlar nosimmetrik joylashtiriladi, yo‘laklar egri chiziqli, suv havzalari va maydonlar esa tabiiy shaklga yaqin qilib loyihalanadi.
example_uz: Peyzaj uslubi hududning noto‘g‘ri shakldagi bo‘laklarga ajratilishi bilan farqlanadi; alohida qismlari nosimmetrik tarzda joylashtiriladi; gullar, butalar va daraxtlar erkin guruhlashtirilgan holda o‘stiriladi; hovuzlar shaklan noto‘g‘ri, yo‘lakchalar ilonsimon shaklda bo‘ladi. (Aholi yashash joylarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirish. Qayimov A., 2012)
definition_en: A landscape design style that imitates the forms, spatial patterns, and visual character of nature. It typically uses asymmetrical layouts, informally grouped plants, curving paths, irregularly shaped water features, and other organic forms while remaining intentionally planned and managed.
example_en: A naturalistic landscape style is meant to replicate how native plants look in the wild, while still being purposeful and planned. (Native Plants in the Landscape: Incorporating Native Plants. Seekford S., Fox L., Niemiera A., Steele M., Virginia Cooperative Extension, 2026)
synonyms_en: Naturalistic garden style; Informal landscape style

definition_uz: Ochiq maydon yoki maysazorda alohida ekilib, o‘zining shox-shabba shakli, gullari, barglari, rangi yoki o‘lchami bilan kompozitsion urg‘u hosil qiladigan manzarali daraxt, buta yoxud yirik o‘t o‘simligi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha «solitaire» — «yakka, alohida» so‘zidan o‘zlashgan.
example_uz: Hozirgi vaqtda soliter kompozitsiyalari uchun kumush archa, Qrim qarag‘ayi, lenkoran akatsiyasi, tyulpan daraxti, magnoliya, ustunsimon tuya daraxti, majnuntut, sharsimon akatsiya, kashtan va piramidasimon dub qo‘llanilmoqda. (Landshaft arxitekturasi. Uralov A.S., Adilova L.A., 2014)
definition_en: An individual ornamental tree, shrub or herbaceous plant selected for its distinctive form, foliage, flowers, bark, size or seasonal character and positioned separately to serve as a focal point or visual accent in a landscape.
example_en: Due to its upright, vertical habit, false aralia is best used as an accent or specimen plant. (Dizygotheca elegantissima: False Aralia. Gilman E.F., Klein R.W. and Hansen G., UF/IFAS Extension, revised 2023)

definition_uz: O‘simliklar va boshqa landshaft elementlari aniq geometrik shakl, o‘q, simmetriya, ritm hamda takrorlanish asosida tartibli joylashtiriladigan kompozitsiyalar. Ularga parter, gulzor, rabatka, bordyur, modulli bog‘cha va guldonli kompozitsiyalar kiradi.
example_uz: Muntazam gulli kompozitsiyalar aniq geometrik tashqi ko‘rinishlarni tasvirlaydi. (Landshaft dizayni. Qalandarov M.M., 61-bet)
definition_en: Landscape compositions in which plants, paths, beds and other design elements are arranged according to a controlled geometric plan, commonly using axes, symmetry, repetition and clearly defined shapes. Parterres, geometrical flower beds, borders and formal planting patterns are typical examples.
example_en: For example, in the 17th-century French style of André Le Nôtre and others, form, as formal composition, not function, was the fundamental driver of landscape design. (Designing (for) Urban Food Webs. Felson A.J. and Ellison A.M., 2021)

definition_uz: Gulzor, kichik bog‘ yoki park qismini muayyan o‘lchamdagi geometrik modullarni ma’lum oraliqda takrorlash asosida tashkil etish usuli. Modullar o‘simliklar, maysazor, suv, manzarali qoplama yoki boshqa landshaft elementlari bilan bir xil yoxud turlicha to‘ldirilishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Modul — lotincha «modulus» so‘zidan kelib chiqqan bo‘lib, «o‘lchov, kichik o‘lcham» ma’nolarini bildiradi.
example_uz: Buning uchun ko‘chuvchi gullardan yoki vazalar hamda modulli tuvaklardan foydalanib bir yillik gulzor, vazalar yoki modulli bog‘-chaman tashkil qilish mumkin. (O‘zbekiston qishloqlarida landshaft arxitekturasini shakllantirish. Balgayeva Sh.A., 2021)
definition_en: A flower garden, small garden space or section of a park organized according to a geometric system of modules repeated at regular intervals. Individual modules may contain plants, lawn, paving, water or other landscape elements.
example_en: Rose considered this challenge as a design-build exercise to develop a modular garden prototype for small American suburban lots. (Modular Gardens Designed by James C. Rose: A 1946 Experiment for the Ladies’ Home Journal. Visilia A.M., CELA Conference Proceedings, 2024)

definition_uz: Bir turkumga mansub o‘simliklarning tur, duragay va navlari yetakchilik qiladigan bog‘ yoki bog‘ning alohida qismi. Monosad muayyan o‘simlik guruhining manzaraviy va nav xilma-xilligini namoyish etadi; rozariy, sirengariy, tulipariy va iridariy uning xususiy ko‘rinishlaridir.
etymology_uz: Mono- — yunoncha «monos» («bir, yagona»), sad — «bog‘» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Monosadga rozariy, tulipariy, georginariy va boshqalar kiradi. (Arxitektura – landshaft dizaynining zamonaviy tendensiyalari. Dobranravova E.A., 2017)
definition_en: A garden or a distinct part of a garden in which species, hybrids and cultivars belonging predominantly to one plant genus are cultivated and displayed. Rose gardens, lilac gardens and iris gardens are examples of monogardens.
etymology_en: Mono- derives from Greek «monos», meaning «one» or «single», combined with «garden».
example_en: In 1985, a monogarden “Syringarium” was created on an area of 0.46 ha and included two species and 29 cultivars of Syringa vulgaris. (Project of Optimization of the Collection and Exposition Area “Syringarium” of the “Olexandria” State Dendrological Park of the NAS of Ukraine. Doiko N., Kryvdiuk L., Dragan N. and Sylenko O., 2024)

definition_uz: Toshlar, shag‘al va ularga mos past bo‘yli o‘t o‘simliklari, yer qoplovchilar hamda pakana butalardan tuziladigan manzarali bog‘ kompozitsiyasi. Rokariy tekis maydon, tabiiy qiyalik yoki kichik tepalikda yaratilishi mumkin; unda toshlar asosiy kompozitsion unsur bo‘lib, faqat alp o‘simliklaridan foydalanish shart emas.
etymology_uz: Inglizcha «rockery» — «toshlar va ular orasida o‘stiriladigan o‘simliklardan tashkil topgan bog‘» atamasi asosida shakllangan.
example_uz: Rokariylar uchun o‘simliklar ranglar uyg‘unligi bilan   birlashgan va landshaftning boshqa elementlari bilan o‘zaro moslashgan holda tanlanadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A garden composition in which rocks, stones or gravel are combined with low-growing herbaceous plants, ground covers and small shrubs. Unlike an alpine garden, a rock garden is not restricted to plants of alpine origin and may be constructed on level ground, a slope or a terrace.
example_en: The ideal location for a rock garden is a natural slope or terrace, such as those found at the side or rear of a house based on a split-level or garden-level design. (Rock Garden Plants. Klett J.E. and Cox R.A., Colorado State University Extension, reviewed 2025)

definition_uz: Dam olish, sayr qilish, estetik zavqlanish va shahar yoki qishloq muhitini sog‘lomlashtirish uchun tashkil etiladigan ko‘kalamzor landshaft obyektlari. Ularning tarkibiga daraxt va butalar, maysazorlar, gulzorlar, xiyobon va yo‘laklar, suv obyektlari, maydonlar hamda kichik me’moriy shakllar kirishi mumkin.
example_uz: Daraxt va butalardan tashkil etilgan bog‘-parklar va xiyobonlar atrofimizdagi olamning o‘ziga xos zaruriy tarkibiy qismi hisoblanadi. (O‘zbekiston qishloqlarida landshaft arxitekturasini shakllantirish. Balgayeva Sh.A., 2021)
definition_en: Designed green spaces intended for recreation, aesthetic enjoyment and environmental improvement. They may incorporate trees, shrubs, lawns, flower beds, paths, water features, open spaces and small architectural elements, although gardens and parks can differ in size, ownership and intensity of public use.
example_en: The text also traces the development of the two most representative types of greenspaces — gardens and parks — by exploring the main steps of planting design history through an interdisciplinary perspective. (Evolution of the Approaches to Planting Design of Parks and Gardens as Main Greenspaces of Green Infrastructure. Ignatieva M., 2021)

definition_uz: Yorug‘lik intensivligi past bo‘lgan soyali muhitda yaxshi o‘sib-rivojlanadigan va kuchli, bevosita quyosh nuridan zararlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan o‘simliklarga xos ekologik xususiyat.
example_uz: Soxta kashtan - soyasevar o‘simlik.(Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: Describing a plant that grows and develops best under low light intensity or shaded conditions and may be adversely affected by strong direct sunlight.
example_en: Shade loving plants grown in the sun may be stunted, show leaf scorch, and will struggle. (Evergreens for the Shade. McConnell J., UF/IFAS Extension, 2015)

definition_uz: Dukkakdoshlar (Fabaceae) oilasiga mansub, vatani Shimoliy Amerikaning sharqiy qismi bo‘lgan kichik barg to‘kuvchi manzarali daraxt. Yuraksimon barglari hamda barg yozilishidan oldin tanasi va eski shoxlarida ochiladigan pushti-binafsha gullari bilan ajralib turadi. Landshaft bog‘dorchiligida alohida ekiladigan manzarali daraxt va rangli aksent sifatida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Kanada bagryannigi (Cercis canadensis) ko‘chatlari ekilib, iqlim sharoitlariga moslashishi bo‘yicha tajribalar o‘tkazildi. (Cho‘lga va qurg‘oqchilikka chidamli manzarali o‘simliklar bog‘ini kengaytirish ishlari. O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Fanlar akademiyasi, 2022)
definition_en: A small deciduous ornamental tree in the family Fabaceae, native to eastern North America. It is distinguished by its rounded to heart-shaped leaves and clusters of pink to purplish flowers borne on bare older branches and sometimes the trunk before the leaves emerge. It is widely planted as a specimen or accent tree in landscape horticulture.
example_en: Eastern redbud is a deciduous, ornamental tree in the bean family (Fabaceae). (Cercis canadensis. North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox)
synonyms_en: American redbud; North American redbud; American Judas tree; Redbud

definition_uz: Sarvdoshlar (Cupressaceae) oilasiga mansub, Sharqiy O‘rta yer dengizi hududidan Erongacha tabiiy tarqalgan doim yashil ignabargli daraxt. Qipiqsimon to‘q yashil barglari, yog‘ochlashgan yumaloq qubbalari va ustunsimon yoki yoyiq shox-shabbasi bilan ajralib turadi. Qurg‘oqchilikka chidamliligi sababli bog‘-parklar, xiyobonlar, tirik to‘siqlar va ihota daraxtzorlarida ekiladi.
example_uz: Ko‘proq doim yashil sarv turining piramidasimon (C. sempervirens) xili ko‘p ekiladi. (O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi. «Sarv». Abdushukur Xonazarov)
definition_en: A medium-sized evergreen coniferous tree in the family Cupressaceae, native from the eastern Mediterranean region to Iran. It has scale-like dark-green leaves, woody rounded cones, and a crown varying from spreading to narrowly columnar. It is widely planted as an ornamental, screening, avenue, and windbreak tree, particularly in dry Mediterranean-type landscapes.
example_en: Cupressus sempervirens L., known as Mediterranean or common cypress, is a medium-sized evergreen coniferous tree. (Cupressus sempervirens in Europe: Distribution, Habitat, Usage and Threats. G. Caudullo and D. de Rigo, European Atlas of Forest Tree Species, 2016)

definition_uz: Magnoliyadoshlar (Magnoliaceae) oilasiga mansub, vatani Sharqiy va Janubiy Xitoy bo‘lgan barg to‘kuvchi buta yoki kichik daraxt. Keng yoyilgan shox-shabbasi hamda barglar yozilishidan oldin ochiladigan yirik, tik, xushbo‘y oq gullari bilan ajralib turadi. Landshaft bog‘dorchiligida alohida ekiladigan manzarali o‘simlik sifatida qadrlanadi.
etymology_uz: Magnoliya turkumi fransuz botanigi Pierre Magnol sharafiga nomlangan.
