example_uz: Siyrak shoxli magnoliya (Magnolia denudata Desr.) manzarali bog‘dorchilikda ekiladigan magnoliya turlaridan biridir. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A deciduous spreading shrub or small tree in the family Magnoliaceae, native to eastern and southern China. It produces large, upright, fragrant, creamy-white to pure-white flowers before the leaves emerge in late winter or spring and is widely cultivated as a specimen ornamental tree.
etymology_en: The generic name Magnolia honours the seventeenth-century French botanist Pierre Magnol; the Latin epithet denudata means “naked”, referring to the flowers appearing on bare branches before the leaves.
example_en: Yulan magnolia is a large, attractive deciduous, early-flowering shrub or tree that has large, showy, upright, fragrant, creamy-white blooms in late winter or early spring. (Magnolia denudata. North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox)
synonyms_en: Yulan; Lily tree; Slender magnolia; Naked magnolia

definition_uz: Shamshoddoshlar (Buxaceae) oilasiga mansub doim yashil daraxt va butalar turkumi. Vakillari mayda, qalin, qarama-qarshi joylashgan barglari, zich shoxlanishi, mayda bir jinsli gullari va uch uyali ko‘sak mevalari bilan ajralib turadi. Shamshodlar sekin o‘sadi, kesib shakl berishga yaxshi moslashadi hamda landshaft bog‘dorchiligida bordyur, yashil to‘siq va topiar shakllar yaratishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Shamshod daraxti mart-aprel oylarida gullaydi.(Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A genus of evergreen shrubs and small trees in the family Buxaceae, characterized by small opposite leathery leaves, dense branching, inconspicuous unisexual flowers, and capsule fruits. Buxus species and cultivars are widely grown for formal hedges, borders, topiary, mass plantings, and ornamental containers.
etymology_en: The botanical name Buxus is the Latin name for the box tree or boxwood.
example_en: Boxwoods, originally from Europe and Asia, are evergreen shrubs. (Buxus — Box, Boxwood. North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox)

definition_uz: Bevosita quyosh nuri kam tushadigan yoki yorug‘lik darajasi pasaygan sharoitda o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va hayot faoliyatini davom ettira oladigan o‘simlik xususiyati. Soyaga chidamli o‘simliklar soyali muhitga bardosh beradi, ammo ularning barchasi soyani afzal ko‘radigan soyasevar o‘simliklar hisoblanmaydi.
example_uz: Soyaga chidamli o‘simliklar guruhiga arg‘uvon, qoraqarag‘ay, temir daraxt, tatar va soxta kashtan, jo‘ka, qora va Manjuriya yong‘og‘i, zarang, chinor, do‘lana, kalina va shilvi kiradi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: Able to maintain growth and physiological activity under reduced light or shaded conditions. A shade-tolerant plant can withstand shade but does not necessarily prefer it, which distinguishes shade tolerance from the stronger ecological preference expressed by shade-loving or sciophilous plants.
example_en: Although north- or east-facing gardens can be cool and shady for much of the year, they can present some creative opportunities with well-chosen shade-tolerant plants. (Shade Planting: Annuals, Bulbs and Perennials. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Past harorat va muayyan darajadagi muzlash sharoitida hujayra, to‘qima va organlari halokatli shikastlanmasdan yashash hamda qulay sharoit qaytganda o‘sishini davom ettirish xususiyatiga ega o‘simlik. Sovuqqa chidamlilik darajasi tur va navning irsiy xususiyatlari, o‘simlik organi, rivojlanish bosqichi va sovuqqa chiniqish holatiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Sovuqqa chidamli o‘simliklarga Sibir va Daur tilog‘ochi, oddiy va Sibir qarag‘ayi, oddiy archa, tog‘terak, Turkiston archasi, oq qayin, chetan va xushbo‘y hidli teraklar kiradi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: Able to survive exposure to low and, within genetically determined limits, subfreezing temperatures without lethal injury and to resume growth when favourable conditions return. Cold hardiness varies with species or cultivar, plant organ, developmental stage, and the degree of cold acclimation.
example_en: They come originally from mountainous regions, so are cold hardy. (How to Grow Alpines. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Tuproqda uzun, tor va ma’lum chuqurlikda qaziladigan sun’iy chuqur. Bog‘dorchilikda ko‘chatlarni qatorlab ekish, yashil to‘siq barpo etish, o‘g‘it va tuproq aralashmalarini joylashtirish, sug‘orish yoki drenaj tizimini tashkil qilish uchun foydalaniladi. Mahsulot saqlashga mo‘ljallangan xandaqdan vazifasiga ko‘ra farqlanadi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha «tranchée» — «uzunasiga qazilgan chuqur» so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Buta va jonli devorlar barpo qiluvchi ko‘chatlarni ekishda maxsus: eni 1,0 metr, chuqurligi 50 sm gacha bo‘lgan transheyalar ekskovator bilan kovlanadi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A long, narrow excavation made in the ground for planting, drainage, irrigation, soil amendment placement or another horticultural operation. Unlike a storage trench, the general term does not specifically indicate a structure used for storing produce.
etymology_en: From Old French «trenche», meaning a cut or excavation.
example_en: Make sure your whole planting area is free of weeds, then dig out a generous planting trench 60–90 cm wide and one spade blade deep. (How to Grow Hedges. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Barglari nina yoki tangachasimon emas, odatda yaproq plastinkasi keng va yassi shakllangan daraxt. Yaproqbargli daraxtlarning aksariyati yopiq urug‘lilarga mansub bo‘lib, ular orasida barg to‘kuvchi va doim yashil turlar mavjud. Terak, qayin, chinor, eman va tol shular jumlasidandir.
example_uz: Maqolada O‘zbekiston hududida keng tarqalgan asosiy yaproqbargli daraxt turlarining — terak, qayin, chinor, eman, tol va boshqalarning bioekologik xususiyatlari yoritilgan. (Asosiy yaproqbarglilar daraxt turlari: ularning bioekologik va o‘rmonchilik xususiyatlari hamda xalq xo‘jaligidagi ahamiyati. Maxammatova S., Abduqahhorova O., Toshpo‘latov N., 2025)
synonyms_uz: Keng bargli daraxt; Keng yaproqli daraxt
definition_en: A tree with relatively broad, flat leaves rather than needle-like or scale-like foliage. Broadleaved trees are principally angiosperms, although Ginkgo biloba is a notable gymnosperm exception, and the category includes both deciduous and evergreen species.
example_en: Broadleaved trees that are harvested, such as fruit or nut trees, are included in this category. (Land Cover Classification System: Classification Concepts and User Manual. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations)

definition_uz: Yilning noqulay mavsumida, odatda kuz-qish yoki qurg‘oqchil davrda barglarini mavsumiy ravishda to‘kib, ma’lum vaqt bargsiz qoladigan daraxt. Qulay sharoit qaytganda yangi barglar hosil qiladi. Bu guruhga ko‘pchilik yaproqbargli daraxtlar bilan birga tilog‘och va metasekvoya kabi ayrim ninabargli daraxtlar ham kiradi.
example_uz: Yurtimiz hududlarini ko‘kalamzorlashtirishda foydalaniladigan barg to‘kuvchi butalar, yashil butalar, chirmovuqlar, igna barglilarning ham ko‘plab tur va navlari ushbu muassasada ko‘paytirilmoqda. (Introduktsiya, landshaft dizayn va gulchilik. Islomov B.S. va boshq., 2019)
definition_en: A tree that seasonally sheds its leaves and remains leafless for a certain period of the year, usually during winter or a dry season, before producing new foliage when favourable conditions return. The category includes many broadleaved trees and a smaller number of needle-leaved trees.
etymology_en: Deciduous derives from Latin «deciduus», meaning “falling off” or “that which falls”.
example_en: Deciduous trees are a valuable permanent feature in a garden and mark the changing seasons with flowers, fruits, new foliage, autumn colour or bare branches. (Deciduous Trees. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Barglarini yil davomida bir vaqtda to‘liq to‘kmaydigan va doimo yashil barg qoplamiga ega bo‘lib turadigan daraxt. Eski barglari davriy ravishda to‘kilsa ham, ular asta-sekin yangilari bilan almashinadi, shu sababli daraxt muayyan mavsumda butunlay bargsiz qolmaydi. Bu guruhga ninabargli va yaproqbargli daraxtlar kirishi mumkin.
example_uz: Doim yashil sarv qurg‘oqchilikka va issiqqa chidamli, doim yashil daraxt. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: A tree that retains living foliage throughout the year and is never completely leafless. Individual leaves are shed and replaced gradually rather than being lost simultaneously during an unfavourable season. Evergreen trees may be needle-leaved or broadleaved.
example_en: These trees carry leaves all year round and are a bold, permanent presence in a garden. (Evergreen Trees. Royal Horticultural Society)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtlar, rezavor mevali o‘simliklar va ayrim hollarda tokning payvandtaglari hamda navdor ko‘chatlarini ko‘paytirish, shakllantirish va ekishga tayyor holga keltirishga ixtisoslashgan yer maydoni yoki xo‘jalik. Unda ona bog‘lar, payvandtag yetishtirish, ko‘paytirish va shakllantirish dalalari kabi bo‘limlar tashkil etiladi.
example_uz: Meva ko‘chatzori mevachilikning holatini, viloyat, tuman, xo‘jalik bog'laridagi o‘simliklarning tur va nav tarkibini belgilaydi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A nursery specializing in the propagation, production and preparation of rootstocks, grafted trees and other planting material of fruit crops. It may include mother blocks, rootstock and propagation sections, nursery fields, and facilities for producing healthy, true-to-type planting stock.
example_en: The fruit tree nursery accreditation scheme implemented by the Philippine Department of Agriculture has been promoted to enhance the supply of high-quality fruit tree planting materials. (Ensuring Seedling Quality through Fruit Tree Nursery Accreditation and Implications for Forest Nursery Accreditation. Edralin D.I. and Mercado A. Jr., 2010)

definition_uz: Meva ko‘chatzorining olma, nok, behi va ayrim danakli meva turlarining urug‘larini ekib, payvandlash yoki keyingi ko‘chatzor dalasiga ko‘chirib o‘tqazish uchun bir yillik urug‘ko‘chat-payvandtaglar yetishtiriladigan bo‘limi. Bu bo‘lim ko‘paytirish dalasining tarkibiy qismi bo‘lib, klon payvandtagli ona ko‘chatzoridan ko‘paytirish usuli bilan farqlanadi.
example_uz: Urug‘ ko‘chatzorida kuchli o‘sadigan payvandtaglar, olma, nok va behi urug‘dan o‘stiriladi va kuzga borib bir yillik urug‘ko‘chat olinadi. (Mevali ko‘chatlar. Abdiyeva O.T., 2024)
definition_en: A nursery or section of a fruit nursery where seeds are sown and seedlings are raised, particularly for use as seedling rootstocks or for subsequent transplanting within the nursery. It is distinguished from a clonal rootstock mother block, in which rootstocks are propagated vegetatively.
example_en: “Two types of nurseries, i.e. seedling or rootstock nurseries to generate rootstocks and budwood or source bush nurseries to harvest budwood are involved in producing budded stumps.” (Handbook of Rubber. Rubber Research Institute of Sri Lanka)

definition_uz: Urug‘, ko‘chat, tuganak, piyozbosh yoki boshqa ekish materialini dalaga ekish uchun belgilangan maqbul vaqt yoki davr. Ekish muddati o‘simlik turi va navi, hudud iqlimi, tuproq harorati, namlik hamda yetishtirish maqsadiga qarab belgilanadi.
example_uz: Ekish muddatlari va chuqurligi. Amaliyotning ko‘rsatishicha, ko‘pgina uzumchilik hududlarida tok ko‘chatlarini ekishning eng yaxshi muddati — kuzda (oktyabr–noyabr), ayozlar va kuchli yog‘ingarchiliklar boshlanmasidan avval. (O‘zbekistonda intensiv mevachilik va uzumchilikning dolzarb muammolari va zamonaviy yutuqlari. Sattorov O.O., Mamatqulov A.V., 2023)
definition_en: The date or period when seeds, seedlings, transplants, bulbs, tubers or other planting materials are planted in the field. It is selected according to crop requirements, climatic conditions, soil temperature and moisture, and the intended production schedule.
example_en: Planting date determines the environmental conditions during crop development and can significantly influence flower stem quality. (Planting Date Affects Quantitative and Qualitative Traits of Freesia Flower Stems. Santilli M., Bas-Nahas S.S. and Medrano N.N., 2025)

definition_uz: Bargi, poyasi yoki ildizidagi maxsus to‘qimalarda suv to‘playdigan, shu sababli organlari ko‘pincha qalin va etdor bo‘ladigan o‘simliklar guruhi. Sukkulentlik turli oilalarda mustaqil shakllangan ekologik moslanish bo‘lib, sukkulentlar alohida taksonomik guruh hisoblanmaydi. Aloe, agava, semizak va kaktuslar ularga misol bo‘ladi.
etymology_uz: Termin lotincha «succulentus» — «sersuv, shirali» so‘ziga asoslangan; u «succus» — «shira, o‘simlik shirasi» so‘zidan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: Sukkulentlar semiz o‘tlar deb ham ataladi. Ularning yer ustki organlari seret va semiz bo‘lib, o‘zlarida ko‘p miqdorda suv saqlaydigan o‘simliklardir. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Beknazarov B.O., 2009)
definition_en: Plants adapted to store water in specialized tissues of their leaves, stems or roots, which commonly gives these organs a thick and fleshy appearance. Succulence has evolved independently in many plant families, so succulents constitute an ecological group rather than a single taxonomic group.
etymology_en: From Latin «succulentus», meaning «juicy» or «full of sap», derived from «succus» — «juice, sap».
example_en: Succulents are ideal for Napa Valley gardens since we live in a drought-prone area. (Not All Succulents Are Cacti! UC Master Gardeners of Napa County, 2023)

definition_uz: Tuproqdagi ortiqcha yerusti yoki sizot suvlarini zovur, quvur va boshqa suv chiqarish inshootlari yordamida yig‘ib, maydondan tashqariga chiqarish jarayoni yoki shu maqsadda qurilgan tizim. Bog‘ va ko‘kalamzorlashtiriladigan maydonlarda drenaj ildiz zonasining botqoqlanishini kamaytirib, tuproqning suv-havo rejimini yaxshilaydi.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha «drainage» — «ortiqcha suvni chiqarish, yerni quritish» terminidan o‘zlashgan. Fransuzcha termin inglizcha «drain» — «suvni oqizib yubormoq» so‘ziga borib taqaladi.
example_uz: Shundan so‘ng maydonlarda drenaj tizimi quriladi, buning uchun yengil-mo‘rt qurilish mahsulotlari: har xil o‘lchamdagi trubalar, graviy, shag‘al va yirik donador qum bo‘laklaridan foydalaniladi. (Manzarali bog‘dorchilik. Qalandarov M.M., 2014)
definition_en: The process of removing excess surface water or groundwater from soil, or the system of ditches, pipes and other conduits installed for this purpose. In gardens and orchards, drainage helps prevent waterlogging and maintains a suitable balance of water and air in the root zone.
etymology_en: Formed from the verb «drain» and the suffix «-age»; «drain» derives from Old English «drēahnian», meaning «to draw off liquid gradually».
example_en: Soil drainage problems should be corrected with subsurface drainage systems or surface modifications such as ridging. (Beginning Grower: Planning and Planting an Orchard. Penn State Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Daraxtning kesilgan yoki ochilib qolgan qismlaridan, shuningdek, yoysimon egilgan shoxlarning ustki tomonidan o‘sib chiqadigan kuchli bir yillik, ba’zan ikki yillik vegetativ novdalar. Ular odatda zich rivojlanib, oziq moddalarni ko‘p sarflaydi, toj ichini soyalaydi va havo aylanishini cheklaydi. Ayrimlari kesilgan shoxlarni almashtirish uchun qoldirilishi va 2–3 yildan keyin hosilga kirishi mumkin, ortiqchalari esa kesib tashlanadi.
example_uz: Natijada daraxtning rivojlanishi uchun keragidan ortiqcha energiya paydo bo‘ladi va bu narsa o‘z navbatida bahorda daraxt shoxlarini avj bilan o‘sishiga va keraksiz «so‘ruvchi» novdalar paydo bo‘lishiga sabab bo‘ladi. (O‘zbekistonda intensiv mevachilik va uzumchilikning dolzarb muammolari va zamonaviy yutuqlari. Sattorov O.O., Mamatqulov A.V., 2023)
definition_en: Vigorous, usually upright vegetative shoots arising from dormant or adventitious buds on cut or exposed parts of a tree and from the upper side of bent branches. They may crowd and shade the canopy, restrict air circulation and compete for resources, although selected shoots can be retained to replace removed branches and may become productive after two or three years.
example_en: Water sprouts are vigorous, usually, upright shoots developing from dormant buds on the trunk or large branches of a tree. (Water Sprouts or Suckers on Trees. University of Maryland Extension, 2023)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlari o‘suv davrida bargli holatda bajariladigan kesish tadbiri. Unda ortiqcha, tik va kuchli o‘suvchi novdalar olib tashlanadi yoki yangi novdalarning uchlari chilpiladi; natijada tojning yorug‘lanishi va havo almashinuvi yaxshilanib, vegetativ o‘sish tartibga solinadi.
example_uz: Yozgi kesish ikki xil bo‘ladi: tinim davrida o‘tkaziladigan butashga o‘xshash odatdagi kesish va yangi novdalarning uchlarini chilpib tashlash. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Pruning performed while a fruit tree is actively growing and carrying leaves. It commonly involves the selective removal or shortening of vigorous, upright or overcrowding shoots to improve light penetration and air circulation and to regulate excessive vegetative growth.
example_en: Summer pruning helps slow overly vigorous growth and opens the center of the canopy to improve air circulation and sunlight penetration. (Summer Tasks for Fruit Tree Orchards. Chernoh E., Oregon State University Extension Service, 2026)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlari bargini to‘kib, tinim holatida bo‘lgan davrda, odatda kuz oxiridan erta bahorgacha bajariladigan kesish tadbiri. Unda shoxlar siyraklashtiriladi yoki qisqartiriladi, qurigan va zararlangan qismlar olib tashlanadi hamda daraxt tojining shakli va hosildorligi tartibga solinadi. Me’yoridan ortiq kesish kuchli vegetativ o‘sish va so‘ruvchi novdalar paydo bo‘lishini kuchaytirishi mumkin.
example_uz: Qishki kesishning me’yoridan orttirib yuborilishi esa daraxt kuchining asosan shox chiqarishga sarflanishiga va mavsumni ozgina hosil bilan, ba’zan esa umuman hosilsiz o‘tkazishiga olib keladi. (O‘zbekistonda intensiv mevachilik va uzumchilikning dolzarb muammolari va zamonaviy yutuqlari. Sattorov O.O., Mamatqulov A.V., 2023)
definition_en: Pruning carried out during winter while a fruit tree is dormant, after leaf fall and before bud break. It involves thinning or shortening branches and removing dead, damaged, diseased or overcrowded growth to maintain tree structure, productivity, canopy light penetration and air circulation.
example_en: Fruit trees should be pruned each winter; however, heavy winter pruning will stimulate excessive growth. (Home Orchards: Why Is There No Fruit on My Tree? Penn State Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarda kasallik va zararkunandalar paydo bo‘lishi, tarqalishi yoki kuchli rivojlanishining oldini olish uchun oldindan amalga oshiriladigan agrotexnik, sanitariya, biologik, karantin va zarur hollarda kimyoviy choralar majmui. Ularga sog‘lom ekish materialidan foydalanish, almashlab ekish, zararlangan qoldiqlarni yo‘qotish, asboblarni zararsizlantirish va muntazam kuzatuv kiradi.
example_uz: Shuningdek, mevalari pishib yetilgunga qadar har 15–20 kunda profilaktik chora-tadbirlar o‘tkazib boriladi. (Bahor oylarida mevali daraxtlar parvarishi. IFODA Agro Kimyo Himoya, 2021)
definition_en: Cultural, sanitation, biological, quarantine and, when necessary, chemical measures taken in advance to prevent the introduction, establishment or damaging development of plant diseases and pests. They include using healthy planting material, crop rotation, sanitation, disinfection and regular crop monitoring.
example_en: Once the pathogen is introduced into the grove, its eradication is almost impossible. Thus preventive measures are quite important to ensure that the disease does not spread to new areas. (China/FAO Citrus Symposium. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, 2001)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning gul va yosh mevalarini qisqa muddatli radiatsion sovuqdan himoyalash uchun bog‘da nam poxol, shox-shabba, barg, qipiq yoki boshqa materiallarni sekin tutatib, tutun va issiqlik hosil qilish usuli. Tutunlatish shamolsiz yoki kuchsiz shamolli kechalarda qo‘llanadi, biroq uning himoya samarasi cheklangan bo‘lib, asosan yonishdan ajraladigan issiqlikka bog‘liq.
example_uz: Bog‘larni anomal sovuqdan saqlash uchun tutunlatish usulidan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi. (Mevali daraxtlarni anomal sovuqdan qanday saqlash mumkin? Mamasoliyev S., Samarqand viloyati agroxizmatlar markazi, 2023)
synonyms_uz: Bog‘ni tutunlatish; Tutun bilan sovuqdan himoyalash
definition_en: A frost-protection practice in which slow-burning fires or smudge pots are used in an orchard to produce smoke and heat during a radiation-frost event. Its protective effect is limited and is attributed mainly to the heat released by combustion rather than to the smoke screen itself.
example_en: Based on information coming out of Florida, orchardists in the West began to use smudging to protect the fruit from frost. (Smudgepot. VanBuskirk P., The Oregon Encyclopedia, 2021)

definition_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning gullari, tugunchalari va yosh mevalarini radiatsion sovuqdan himoyalash uchun bog‘ hududida taqsimlangan isitkichlar, yoqilg‘i briketlari yoki kichik olov manbalari yordamida havo haroratini ko‘tarish usuli. Usulning samarasi ajratilgan issiqlik miqdori, isitkichlarning joylashishi, shamol tezligi va harorat inversiyasiga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Bog‘larni isitish uchun daraxtlar tagiga qizil fosfor yoqish ham tavsiya etiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
synonyms_uz: Bog‘ni isitish; Isitish orqali sovuqdan himoyalash
definition_en: An active frost-protection method in which numerous heaters or small fires are distributed through an orchard to replace heat lost from the orchard environment and keep susceptible flowers, fruitlets and other tissues above their critical injury temperature. It is most effective during radiation frosts with light winds and a temperature inversion.
example_en: At this particular site, frost protection measures such as orchard heating (burning fires) were implemented during the recent freeze event, and these efforts appear to have been largely successful in preventing severe damage, especially in peaches, nectarines, and apples. (Freeze Damage in Peaches and Apples and Other Fruit. Penn State Extension, 2025)

definition_uz: Yilning o‘rtacha sutkalik harorati musbat bo‘lgan bahor yoki kuz davrida yerga yaqin havo qatlami yoxud faol sirt haroratining 0 °C va undan pastga qisqa muddat tushishi. Qora sovuq radiatsion, advektiv yoki aralash sabablar ta’sirida yuzaga kelib, o‘simliklarning gul, tuguncha, barg va yosh novdalarini zararlashi mumkin.
example_uz: O‘simlikni sovuq urganda uning barglari qorayib qoladi. Shuning uchun bahor va erta kuzda bo‘ladigan bunday atmosfera hodisasini dehqonlar qora sovuq deb ataydilar. (Agrometeorologiya. 1-qism. Xolbayev G.X., 2024)
definition_en: The occurrence of an air or near-surface temperature of 0 °C or lower, particularly during the growing season. Frost may result from radiative cooling, the advection of a cold air mass, or a combination of both and may damage susceptible flowers, fruitlets, leaves and young shoots.
example_en: A frost is the occurrence of an air temperature of 0 °C or lower, measured at a height of between 1.25 and 2.0 m above soil level, inside an appropriate weather shelter. (Frost Protection: Fundamentals, Practice and Economics. Snyder R.L., de Melo-Abreu J.P., FAO, 2005)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning tuproq yoki sug‘orish suvidagi eruvchan tuzlar miqdori yuqori bo‘lgan sharoitda unishi, o‘sishi, rivojlanishi va ko‘payish qobiliyatini saqlashi. Agronomik jihatdan sho‘rga chidamlilik o‘simlikning sho‘rlanish ta’sirida ham qoniqarli hosil bera olishi bilan baholanadi.
example_uz: Xorazm va Qoraqalpog‘iston hududlarida o‘sadigan mahalliy o‘rik sho‘rga chidamliligi bilan farq qiladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The ability of a plant to germinate, grow, develop and reproduce under elevated concentrations of soluble salts in the soil or irrigation water. Agronomically, salt tolerance is commonly assessed from the plant’s relative growth or yield under saline conditions compared with non-saline conditions.
example_en: Salt tolerance ratings of plants are based on yield reduction on salt-affected soils when compared with yields on similar non-saline soils. (Salt-affected Soils and Their Management. Abrol I.P., Yadav J.S.P., Massoud F.I., FAO, 1988)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtining yillik o‘sishlarida kuchli yon shoxlarning ayrim qismlarda guruhlanib yaruslar hosil qilishi, ular oralig‘ida esa kalta shoxchalar yoki tinimdagi kurtaklar joylashishi xususiyati. Uning namoyon bo‘lish darajasi daraxt turi, navi, yoshi, o‘sish sharoiti va agrotexnikaga bog‘liq.
example_uz: Yaruslilik ko‘p jihatdan meva daraxtlarining turiga, nav xususiyatlariga, yoshiga tabiiy iqlim-tuproq sharoitiga hamda o‘tkaziladigan agrotexnika darajasiga qarab aniqlanadi. (Meva ekinlari biologiyasi. Yunusov R., Yuldoshov L.T., Ganiyeva F.A., 2023)
definition_en: A branching characteristic in which groups of relatively strong lateral branches develop at intervals along a tree axis and form distinct tiers, while weaker shoots or dormant buds occur between successive tiers.
example_en: In the cherry tree (Prunus avium), growth and branching are strictly monopodial at all stages of growth. Trees have a strong dimorphism between short or long shoots, composed of preformed only or preformed and neoformed organs, respectively, with a strong acrotony, forming tiers of branches just below the annual growth arrest of the bearing shoot. (Bud Structure, Position and Fate Generate Various Branching Patterns along Shoots of Closely Related Rosaceae Species: A Review. Costes E. et al., 2014)

definition_uz: O‘simlik jarohatlanganda yoki kesilganda yara yuzasi yaqinidagi tirik hujayralarning bo‘linishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan, asosan yupqa devorli parenxima hujayralaridan iborat to‘qima. Kallyus yaraning bitishini ta’minlaydi, payvandtag bilan payvandust orasida ko‘prik hosil qiladi hamda ayrim qalamchalarda ildiz va kurtaklarning rivojlanishiga yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Lotincha callus — «qadoq, qalinlashgan to‘qima» so‘zidan olingan.
example_uz: Shuning uchun shoxchalar halqa qilib kesilganda, shikastlangan joyda kallyus bilan bitib keladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E., Narziyeva S.X., G‘ulomov B.X., 2011)
definition_en: A mass of mainly thin-walled parenchyma cells produced in response to plant wounding. Callus covers and protects wounded surfaces and, during graft healing, forms a callus bridge between the rootstock and scion from which new vascular connections can develop.
etymology_en: From Latin callus, meaning «hard skin» or «hardened tissue».
example_en: Within a few days, cell division starts and a callus of undifferentiated cells forms. (Grafts and Wounds. The Science of Plants, University of Minnesota Libraries Publishing)

definition_uz: Ildiz tizimining tuproqdan suv va unda erigan mineral oziq moddalarni o‘zlashtirishga ixtisoslashgan ingichka, odatda birlamchi tuzilishdagi qismi. Ular ko‘pincha ildiz tizimining eng yosh va distal tarmoqlarida joylashadi, qisqa yashaydi hamda ildiz tukchalari yoki mikoriza zamburug‘lari yordamida shimish yuzasini kengaytiradi.
example_uz: So‘ruvchi ildizlar tuproqdan suvda erigan mineral moddalarni so‘rish vazifasini bajaradi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: Fine, usually nonwoody roots whose dominant function is the uptake of water and dissolved mineral nutrients from the soil. They generally occur in the distal, lower-order portion of a root system and commonly interact with root hairs and mycorrhizal fungi.
example_en: Fine feeder roots (absorptive roots) are the primary sites of water and mineral nutrient absorption. (Understanding Tree Roots. Hammond E., Colorado State University Extension, reviewed 2025)

definition_uz: So‘ruvchi ildizlar olgan suv va mineral moddalarni yirik ildizlar, tana hamda yer ustki organlarga o‘tkazadigan ildizlar. Ular shimish vazifasini kam bajaradi; moddalarni tashish bilan birga o‘simlikni mustahkamlash va oziq moddalarni qisman zaxiralashda qatnashadi.
example_uz: O‘tkazuvchi ildizlar oraliq ildizlarning davomi hisoblanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R., Umarov K., Karimov B., 2016)
definition_en: Roots primarily responsible for transporting water and mineral nutrients from absorptive roots towards larger roots, the trunk and above-ground organs. They have reduced absorptive activity and may also perform structural and storage functions.
example_en: Transport roots serve as a continuation of the pipeline carrying water and nutrients from the absorbing (feeder) roots to the root plate root and trunk. (Diagnosing Root and Soil Disorders on Landscape Trees. Hammond E., Whiting D., Wilson C., Moravec C., Reeder J., Colorado State University Extension, 2015; reviewed 2023)

definition_uz: Urug‘ murtagidagi boshlang‘ich ildizdan rivojlanib, tuproqqa tik yo‘nalishda o‘sadigan va yon ildizlarga nisbatan yo‘g‘on hamda yaqqol ajralib turadigan asosiy ildiz. O‘q ildiz, odatda, ikki urug‘pallali o‘simliklarga xos o‘q ildiz tizimining markaziy qismini tashkil qiladi.
example_uz: Ikki urug‘pallali o‘simliklarda asosiy ildiz baquvvat bo‘lib, tuproqqa vertikal holda chuqur kirib boradi. Bunday ildiz o‘q ildiz deb ataladi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Babayeva R.N., 2017)
definition_en: A dominant primary root that develops from the embryonic radicle, grows predominantly downward and remains larger and more conspicuous than the lateral roots arising from it. It forms the central axis of a taproot system.
example_en: Plants with a taproot system, such as dandelions, pecans, and walnuts, have a taproot that grows almost straight down with very little branching. (Basic Botany, Plant Physiology, and Plant Classification. University of Tennessee Extension Master Gardener Program, 2024)

definition_uz: Yaqqol ajralib turadigan asosiy ildiz bo‘lmagan ildiz tizimini hosil qiluvchi, poya asosidan rivojlangan ko‘p sonli, ingichka va bir-biriga yaqin yo‘g‘onlikdagi ildizlar. Ular ko‘pincha tuproqning ustki qatlamida zich tarmoq hosil qiladi va bir urug‘pallali o‘simliklarga xos bo‘ladi.
example_uz: Popuk ildiz — bir-biriga o‘xshash bir to‘da mayda ildizlar yig‘indisidan iborat. Unda asosiy ildiz boshqa ildizlardan farq qilmaydi. (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Babayeva R.N., 2017)
definition_en: Numerous slender roots of approximately similar diameter that collectively form a fibrous root system without a conspicuous dominant primary root. They commonly arise near the base of the stem and form a dense network in the upper soil layers.
example_en: The root system consists of multiple fibrous roots, with no major tap root. (Biology 2e. Clark M.A., Douglas M., Choi J., OpenStax, 2018)

definition_uz: Tuproq qatlamlari bo‘ylab tik yoki tikka yaqin yo‘nalishda chuqur o‘sadigan ildizlar. Mevali daraxtlarda ularga markaziy o‘q ildiz va gorizontal ildizlardan pastga qarab rivojlangan ildizlar kirishi mumkin; ular daraxtni mustahkamlaydi hamda chuqur qatlamlardagi suv va mineral moddalardan foydalanishiga yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Vertikal — lotincha «verticalis» so‘ziga asoslangan xalqaro termin bo‘lib, «tik yo‘nalgan» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning ildizlari o‘qildiz bo‘lib, tuproqqa chuqur ketadi va ular o‘simlikni tuproqdagi suv va oziqa moddalar bilan ta’minlab turish vazifasini bajaradi. O‘simlik turiga qarab ildizlari vertikal va gorizontal tarqaladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: Roots that grow downward or at a steep angle into deeper soil layers. In trees, the category may include a central taproot and sinker roots developing downward from lateral woody roots; these roots contribute to anchorage and access to water and mineral nutrients in deeper soil.
etymology_en: Vertical derives from Late Latin «verticalis», from Latin «vertex», referring to the highest point or an upright direction.
example_en: Fruit trees generally develop fairly shallow root systems with many horizontal roots and a few vertical roots. (Manage Your Soil and Irrigation Water to Contain Root Growth, Control Vigour and Increase Productivity of Deciduous Fruit Trees. Fruit Growers Victoria, 2017)

definition_uz: Tuproq yuzasiga parallel yoki kichik burchak ostida yon tomonlarga tarqalib o‘sadigan ildizlar. Mevali daraxtlarda ular ildiz tizimining katta maydonni egallashini ta’minlaydi, daraxtni mustahkamlash va moddalarni o‘tkazishda qatnashadi hamda ulardan ko‘plab mayda so‘ruvchi va pastga yo‘nalgan ildizlar rivojlanadi.
etymology_uz: Gorizontal — lotincha «horizontalis» so‘ziga asoslangan xalqaro termin bo‘lib, «ufqqa parallel, yotiq yo‘nalgan» ma’nosini bildiradi.
example_uz: Mevali daraxtlarning ildizlari o‘qildiz bo‘lib, tuproqqa chuqur ketadi va ular o‘simlikni tuproqdagi suv va oziqa moddalar bilan ta’minlab turish vazifasini bajaradi. O‘simlik turiga qarab ildizlari vertikal va gorizontal tarqaladi. (Meva-sabzavotchilik. Yormatova D.Y., Ibrohimov M.Y., Yormatova D.S., 2008)
definition_en: Roots that extend outward approximately parallel to the soil surface or at a shallow angle. In fruit trees, they spread through a relatively large area of the upper soil, contribute to anchorage and transport, and give rise to fine absorptive roots and, in some species, downward-growing sinker roots.
etymology_en: Horizontal derives from Latin «horizontalis», based on «horizon», ultimately from Greek «horizōn».
example_en: Fruit trees generally develop fairly shallow root systems with many horizontal roots and a few vertical roots. (Manage Your Soil and Irrigation Water to Contain Root Growth, Control Vigour and Increase Productivity of Deciduous Fruit Trees. Fruit Growers Victoria, 2017)

definition_uz: Asosiy, qo‘shimcha yoki boshqa yon ildizlarning ichki to‘qimalaridan shoxlanib rivojlanadigan ildizlar. Ular ildiz tizimining tuproqda keng tarqalishini, o‘simlikning mustahkamlanishini hamda suv va mineral moddalarni o‘zlashtirish yuzasining kengayishini ta’minlaydi.
example_uz: Nok yosh vaqtida, hali uzun yon ildizlar paydo bo‘lmaguncha suvga talabchan bo‘ladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Roots that develop endogenously from the internal tissues, usually the pericycle, of an existing root and grow outward from it. They increase the branching, soil exploration and absorptive surface of the root system.
example_en: A tap root system has a main root that grows down vertically, and from which many smaller lateral roots arise. (Biology 2e. Clark M.A., Douglas M., Choi J., OpenStax, 2018)

definition_uz: Meva daraxti hayot siklining o‘sish va hosil berish susayib, shoxlar, ildizlar hamda boshqa organlarning asta-sekin nobud bo‘lishi ustunlik qiladigan yakuniy davri. U daraxtning hosil berishdan qolishidan butunlay qurishigacha davom etadi.
example_uz: Shitt daraxt hayotida uchta asosiy davrni: o‘sish, meva berish va qurish davrini aniqladi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: The final period of a fruit tree’s ontogeny, during which growth and fruit production decline or cease, organs progressively die back, and the process ultimately ends with the death of the whole tree.
etymology_en: Senile derives from Latin «senilis», meaning «of old age», from «senex» — «old».
example_en: The latent period lasts for 8 to 9 months; pregenerative (virginile) — 3 to 4 years; reproductive (generative) — 2 to 3 years; and the postgenerative (senile) period lasts for 2 years. (Ontogenesis and Biological Peculiarities of Nymphaea gigantea Hook. Mazur T.P., 1999; indexed in FAO AGRIS)

definition_uz: Daraxt tanasi yoki markaziy poyasidan chiqib, shox-shabbaning asosiy tayanch tuzilishini hosil qiladigan yirik va uzoq yashovchi shoxlar. Ular yarim skelet shoxlar, mayda shoxchalar va hosil organlarini tutib turadi hamda hosil og‘irligini ko‘taradi.
example_uz: Daraxtda skelet shoxlar uning asosini tashkil qilib, ulardan chiqqan ajralgan kichikroq shoxlar yarim skelet shoxlar deyiladi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: Large, permanent branches arising from the trunk or central leader and forming the principal structural framework of a tree. They support secondary branches, fruiting wood, foliage, and the weight of the crop.
example_en: Scaffold branches are the main branches on the tree, attached to the trunk. (Pruning Fruit Trees. University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources)

definition_uz: Asosan vegetativ kurtaklar, barglar va yangi novdalar hosil qilib, daraxt shox-shabbasining o‘sishi va yangilanishini ta’minlaydigan shoxlar. Ular dastlab meva bermaydi, ammo keyinchalik ayrim qismlarida hosil shoxchalari shakllanishi mumkin.
example_uz: Shoxlar o‘suv yoki vegetativ va meva (reproduktiv) shoxlariga bo‘linadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: Branches primarily producing leaves, vegetative buds, and further shoot growth rather than flowers and fruit. They contribute to canopy development and may subsequently develop fruiting shoots or spurs as they mature.
example_en: The sectors of the tree in which floral branches are found produce a larger proportion of the tree’s total fruit number than the sectors of the tree in which vegetative branches are found. (Good Bud, Bad Bud. Krueger R., Lovatt C.J., 2011)

definition_uz: Gul kurtaklari va meva hosil qiladigan, odatda o‘suv shoxlarga nisbatan kalta va sekin o‘sadigan shoxlar. Ularning tuzilishi va yashash muddati meva turi hamda naviga bog‘liq bo‘lib, urug‘li va danakli meva daraxtlarida turli shakllari uchraydi.
example_uz: Meva shoxlari esa kalta bo‘lib, sekin o‘sadi va ularda meva kurtaklari shakllanadi. (Bog‘dorchilik. Yunusov R., Umarov K., Karimov B., 2016)
definition_en: Branches bearing flower buds and subsequently flowers and fruit. They are generally less vegetatively vigorous than growth branches and may occur in several species-specific forms.
example_en: It means home orchardists should train the branches for proper tree structure; this encourages fruit production and allows the fruiting branches to support the fruit load without additional support. (Training Your Apple Tree. Hentschel R., University of Illinois Extension, 2020)

definition_uz: Asosiy skelet shoxlardan chiqib, daraxt shox-shabbasining ikkilamchi tayanch qismini hosil qiladigan nisbatan kichik shoxlar. Ularda mayda o‘suv shoxlari va hosil shoxchalari joylashadi.
example_uz: Daraxtda skelet shoxlar uning asosini tashkil qilib, ulardan chiqqan ajralgan kichikroq shoxlar yarim skelet shoxlar deyiladi. (O‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sagdiyev M.T., Alimova R.A., 2007)
definition_en: Relatively large structural branches arising from the primary scaffold branches of a fruit tree. They form the secondary framework of the canopy and support tertiary branches and fruiting wood.
example_en: For the secondary scaffold branches, it is desirable to have about two per primary scaffold branch, with each secondary pointing up and away, but in different directions if possible. (Pruning Fruit Trees. University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources)

definition_uz: Payvandust bilan payvandtagning anatomik, fiziologik va biokimyoviy jihatdan mos kelib, mustahkam birikishi hamda payvandlangan o‘simlik sifatida normal rivojlanish qobiliyati.
etymology_uz: Fransuzcha «affinité» — «yaqinlik, qarindoshlik, moslik» so‘zidan kelib chiqqan.
example_uz: Payvandust bilan payvandtagning yaxshi birikib tutib ketishi, ularning tutashishi affinitet deb ataladigan botanik jihatdan yaqinligiga bog‘liqdir. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E., Narziyeva S.X., G‘ulomov B.X., 2011)
definition_en: The capacity of a scion and rootstock to form a successful, durable graft union and subsequently function and develop normally as a composite plant.
example_en: Rootstocks are selected based on several traits including graft compatibility, plant vigor, tolerance of different soil conditions, lack of root suckers and resistance to diseases and insects and should be matched to conditions at each orchard location. (Plum Rootstock & Scion Selection. University of California, Davis, Fruit & Nut Research & Information Center)

definition_uz: Barg va boshqa yashil organlarda xlorofill miqdori kamayishi natijasida to‘qimalarning och yashil, sarg‘ish yoki oqish tusga kirishi. Xloroz temir, magniy, marganes yoki azot tanqisligi, tuproqning yuqori pH darajasi, ildizlarning shikastlanishi, namlik rejimining buzilishi, viruslar va boshqa patogenlar ta’sirida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha «chloros» — «och yashil, sarg‘ish-yashil» hamda «-osis» — «holat, patologik jarayon» qismlaridan hosil bo‘lgan xalqaro ilmiy termin.
example_uz: Xloroz, kelib chiqishiga ko‘ra, tuproqda temir, marganes yetishmasligidan va viruslar, mikoplazmalar ta’sirida paydo bo‘lishi mumkin. (Entomologiya va fitopatologiya. Kimsanboyev X.X., Sulaymonov B.A., Anorbayev A.R., Rustamov A.A., 2017)
definition_en: The yellowing or paling of normally green plant tissue resulting from a reduction or loss of chlorophyll. It may be caused by nutrient deficiencies, unsuitable soil pH, impaired root function, poor drainage, environmental stress, pests or infectious plant diseases.
etymology_en: From Greek «chlōros», meaning «pale green or greenish-yellow», combined with the pathological suffix «-osis», denoting a condition or process.
example_en: Chlorosis, or yellowing, of the leaves of plants can have many different causes. (Chlorosis. Royal Horticultural Society, RHS Advice)

definition_uz: Bog‘ yoki tokzordagi daraxt va tok qatorlari orasida qo‘shimcha mahsulot olish uchun yetishtiriladigan ekinlar. Ular asosiy o‘simliklar bilan suv, oziqa moddalari va yorug‘lik uchun kuchli raqobat qilmasligi hamda parvarish ishlariga xalaqit bermasligi kerak.
example_uz: Yurtimizda 331 ming gektar bog‘ va 153 ming gektar tokzor bor. Ularda qator oralaridagi yerlarga piyoz, sarimsoq, sabzi, bahor oylarida yeryong‘oq, kartoshka, pomidor va bodring ekilsa, bozorlarimizga qo‘shimcha mahsulot, aholiga daromad bo‘ladi. (Hududlarda ichimlik suvi ta’minotini yaxshilash choralari belgilandi. O‘zA, 2023)
definition_en: Crops grown in the spaces between rows of orchard trees or grapevines to produce an additional harvest. They are selected and managed to minimize competition with the main perennial crop for water, nutrients and light.
example_en: A simple method, based on the difference of soil water content between inter-row crops and jujube trees, was introduced to judge the possibility of water competition happening. (Soil Water Effects of Agroforestry in Rainfed Jujube Orchards on Loess Hillslopes in Northwest China. Agriculture, Ecosystems & Environment, 2017)

definition_uz: Bog‘ hududining yo‘llar, kanallar, ihota daraxtzorlari yoki boshqa chegaralar bilan ajratilgan va alohida ishlab chiqarish birligi sifatida boshqariladigan qismi. Kvartalda odatda biologik hamda agrotexnik talablari yaqin bo‘lgan meva turlari va navlari joylashtiriladi.
example_uz: Katta-kichikligiga qarab, bog‘ kvartali bir necha qismga bo‘linadi. (Meva-sabzavot va poliz mahsulotlarini yetishtirish, saqlash va qayta ishlash texnologiyasi. Ostonaqulov T.E., Sanaev S.T., Hamdamova E.I., Komilova M.M., 2007)
definition_en: A defined section of an orchard managed as an individual production unit. Trees within a block are generally relatively uniform in cultivar, rootstock, age, planting system or management requirements.
example_en: Before establishing a new orchard block, it is important to carefully assess all the factors that will ultimately affect fruit quality and orchard sustainability. (Beginning Grower: Planning and Planting an Orchard. Penn State Extension, 2026)

definition_uz: Bog‘da meva daraxtlari yoki rezavor meva o‘simliklarining ma’lum yo‘nalish bo‘ylab bir chiziqda ketma-ket joylashtirilgan qatori. Bog‘ qatorlarining yo‘nalishi va ular orasidagi masofa daraxtlarning yorug‘likdan samarali foydalanishi, o‘sishi va rivojlanishi, shuningdek, bog‘da agrotexnik tadbirlarni amalga oshirish va texnika vositalarining harakatlanishiga ta’sir qiladi.
example_uz: “Bog‘ qator oralari shudgor qilib qo‘yilgan bo‘lsa, aprel-may oylarida daraxtlar gullagandan keyin, begona o‘tlar o‘sib chiqishi bilan kultivatsiya qilinadi.” (O‘zbekistonda intensiv mevachilik va uzumchilikning dolzarb muammolari va zamonaviy yutuqlari. Sattorov O.O., 2023, 148-bet)
definition_en: A line or row of fruit trees established within an orchard as part of its planting layout. The orientation and spacing of tree rows are determined according to orchard design, management requirements, equipment access and efficient interception of sunlight.
example_en: “Given a fairly uniform plot without ledge, excessively sloped areas, wet zones, or other features that could impact the uniformity of the planting, tree rows should be straight, equally separated by the preferred drive-row width along their length, and properly oriented to other plantings or to maximize interception of sunlight.” (Planting OrganicA Orchard 4: A High-Density Planting with Scab-Resistant Cultivars. Bradshaw T.L., Berkett L.P., Kingsley-Richards S.L., Griffith M.C., University of Vermont, 2011)

definition_uz: Bog‘ barpo etishda mevali o‘simliklarning qatorlar oralig‘i va qator ichidagi ko‘chatlar oralig‘i uchun belgilangan masofalarni ifodalovchi ekish ko‘rsatkichi. Ekish sxemasi meva turi, nav, payvandtagning o‘sish kuchi va yetishtirish sharoitlariga qarab belgilanadi.
example_uz: “Olmani payvandtaglariga qarab ekish sxemasi kuchli o‘suvchi payvandtagda 6×5 m sug‘oriladigan bo‘z tuproqlarda, 5×5 m shag‘alli qumli tuproqlarda, o‘rta bo‘yli payvandtagda 3×2,5 m bo‘ladi.” (“Mamlakatimizda olma ko‘chatlarini ko‘paytirishning nazariy asoslari tahlili”. Botirov A., Sanayev S., Saidov M. Academic Research in Educational Sciences, Vol. 3, Issue 10, 2022)
definition_en: The prescribed distance between rows and between individual plants within a row when establishing an orchard or other fruit planting. Planting distance may vary according to the fruit crop, cultivar, rootstock, training system and growing conditions.
example_en: “The knowledge of traditionally recommended planting densities in fruit crops is a must. For example most of the mango varieties are recommended to be planted at a distance of 10 m (row to row) x 10 m (plant to plant) under square system of planting.” (Pomology-II. Central Board of Secondary Education, 2015)

definition_uz: Ikki jinsli gulda changchi va urug‘chining turli vaqtda yetilishi hodisasi. Changchilarning urug‘chidan oldin yetilishi protandriya, urug‘chining changchilardan oldin yetilishi esa protoginiya deyiladi. Dixogamiya o‘z-o‘zidan changlanish imkoniyatini kamaytirib, chetdan changlanishga yordam beradi.
etymology_uz: Dixogamiya termini yunoncha dicha («ikki, alohida, ajralgan holda») va gamos («nikoh, qo‘shilish») so‘zlaridan hosil bo‘lgan.
example_uz: “O‘simliklarni chetdan changlanishida dixogamiya va geterostiliya muhim rol o‘ynaydi. Dixogamiya — bu bitta gulda changchi va urug‘chilarning bir vaqtda yetilmasligidir.” (Botanika va o‘simliklar fiziologiyasi. Sheraliyev A.Sh., Belolipov I.V., 2006)
definition_en: The condition in flowering plants in which the stamens and pistil, or the male and female reproductive functions, mature at different times, thereby reducing self-pollination and promoting cross-pollination. Dichogamy occurs as protandry when the male function matures first and as protogyny when the female function matures first.
etymology_en: From Greek dicha («in two, asunder, separately») and gamos («marriage, union»).
example_en: “Dichogamy promotes cross pollination even in the hermaphrodite species. Dichogamy is of two types: viz. i) protogyny and ii) protandry.” (Mode of Pollination. Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Agritech Portal)

definition_uz: Urug‘dan emas, vegetativ usullar bilan ko‘paytiriladigan va shu sababli ona o‘simlikning genetik xususiyatlarini saqlaydigan payvandtag. Klon payvandtaglardan mevali daraxtlarning o‘sish kuchi, hosilga kirish muddati, hosildorligi va ayrim noqulay muhit omillari hamda kasalliklarga chidamliligini boshqarish, shuningdek bog‘dagi daraxtlarning bir xilligini ta’minlash maqsadida foydalaniladi.
example_uz: “Klon payvandtaglar mevalarning sifatini, hosildorligini va kasalliklarga chidamliligini oshirishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.” (Danak mevali ekinlarda klon payvandtaglarning ahamiyati va afzalliklari. Ramazonov O.O., Zoyirov A.H., Journal of New Century Innovations, 2025)
definition_en: A rootstock propagated vegetatively rather than from seed, producing genetically uniform plants with the characteristics of the selected parent material. Clonal rootstocks are used in fruit production to obtain uniform trees and to control characteristics such as tree vigour, precocity, productivity, disease resistance, and adaptation.
etymology_en: Clonal derives from clone, ultimately from Greek klōn («twig, branch»); rootstock is formed from root + stock.
example_en: “Clonal (i.e., vegetatively propagated) rootstocks first became popular for apple more than 150 years ago; clonal rootstocks for other deciduous fruit species were selected more recently.” (Rootstock and interstock effects on deciduous fruit tree vigour, precocity, and yield productivity. Webster A.D., New Zealand Journal of Crop and Horticultural Science, Vol. 23, 1995, pp. 373–382)

definition_uz: O‘simlikni vegetativ ko‘paytirish maqsadida ona o‘simlik ildizidan kesib olinadigan ildiz bo‘lagi. Ildiz qalamchasi qulay sharoitda yangi novda va ildizlar hosil qilib, mustaqil o‘simlikka aylanishi mumkin. Bu usul ildizdan yangi kurtak va novdalar hosil qilish qobiliyatiga ega daraxt, buta va ayrim ko‘p yillik o‘simliklarni ko‘paytirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Diametri 0,5–1,5 sm qalinlikdagi ildizning bir qismiga – ildiz qalamcha deb ataladi.” (Manzarali daraxtlarni ko‘paytirish. E.T. Berdiyev, Sh.F. Gulamxodjayeva, 2015)
definition_en: A section of a plant root that is cut from the parent plant and used for vegetative propagation. Under suitable conditions, a root cutting can regenerate shoots and roots and develop into a new plant.
example_en: “Root cuttings of some species produce new shoots, which then form their own root system, whereas root cuttings of other plants develop root systems before producing new shoots.” (Extension Gardener Handbook: 13. Propagation. Matt Jones and Lucy Bradley (eds.), NC State Extension, 2021)

definition_uz: Vegetativ ko‘paytirish uchun yetilgan va yog‘ochlashgan novda yoki poyadan kesib olinadigan qalamcha. Bunday qalamchalar odatda o‘simlikning tinim davrida tayyorlanadi. Ular ildiz hosil qilishi uchun tegishli sharoitda ekilib, mevali, manzarali va boshqa yog‘ochli o‘simliklarni vegetativ ko‘paytirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Ushbu maqolada intensiv bog‘dorchilikda qo‘llaniladigan istiqbolli klonal payvandtaglar — Evrika-99, Mirobalan 29C, Fortuna va Krimskiy-5 navlarini yog‘ochlashgan qalamcha usulida ko‘paytirish texnologiyasi tadqiq qilingan.” (Yog‘ochlashgan qalamchalarning ko‘karishiga ekish sxemasini ta’siri. Xayitboyev B.T., Ahmatbekova M.R., 2026)
definition_en: A stem cutting made from mature, woody growth, typically collected while the plant is dormant. Hardwood cuttings are commonly used for the vegetative propagation of deciduous shrubs, climbers, fruit plants, and some evergreen woody plants.
example_en: “Hardwood cuttings are taken from dormant mature stems in late fall, winter, or early spring.” (Extension Gardener Handbook: 13. Propagation. Matt Jones and Lucy Bradley (eds.), NC State Extension, 2021)

definition_uz: O‘simlikning o‘suv davrida yosh, bargli, hali yog‘ochlashib ulgurmagan yoki juda kam yog‘ochlashgan novdasidan vegetativ ko‘paytirish uchun tayyorlanadigan qalamcha. Yashil qalamchalar namlikni tez yo‘qotishi sababli odatda yuqori havo namligi ta’minlangan sharoitda ildizlantiriladi. Ular mevali, rezavor, manzarali va boshqa o‘simliklarni vegetativ ko‘paytirishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Qalamchani turli usullarda, jumladan, yashil qalamcha, yog‘ochli qalamcha, ildiz va boshqalardan ko‘paytirishni.” (Manzarali daraxtlarni ko‘paytirish. Berdiyev E.T., Gulamxodjayeva Sh.F., 2015)
definition_en: A young, soft, leafy stem cutting taken from the current season’s growth and used for vegetative propagation. Softwood cuttings are taken while the shoots are still soft and flexible and generally have a high capacity for rooting under suitable conditions.
example_en: “Softwood cuttings are young soft succulent cuttings with leaves (sometimes pruned).” (Vegetative Propagation. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), 1992)

definition_uz: Tuproq unumdorligini oshirish, uni organik modda va oziq elementlari bilan boyitish maqsadida yetishtirilib, yashil massasi tuproqqa haydab yoki aralashtirib yuboriladigan ekin. Siderat ekinlar sifatida ko‘pincha dukkakli o‘simliklardan foydalaniladi; ular tuproqdagi organik modda miqdorini oshirishga, oziq elementlarini aylanishga qaytarishga va tuproq xususiyatlarini yaxshilashga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: “Tadqiqot davomida siderat ekin sifatida mosh, raps, xantal, amarant, perko, yeryong‘oq o‘simliklari tanlab olingan hamda ushbu ekinlarning tuproq unumdorligiga ta’siri va makkajo‘xori ekiniga ta’siri ilmiy jihatdan o‘rganilgan.” (Oraliq va siderat ekinlari yetishtirishning tuproq unumdorligiga ta’sirining dolzarbligi. Nuraliyev E., AGROINNOVATSIYA, 3(2), 2025)
definition_en: A crop grown primarily to produce fresh plant material that is incorporated into the soil to serve as manure and improve soil fertility. Green manure crops, frequently legumes, contribute organic matter and plant nutrients, particularly nitrogen when leguminous species are used.
example_en: “Several legume plants can be used as green manure crops.” (Plant Nutrition for Food Security: A Guide for Integrated Nutrient Management. Roy R.N., Finck A., Blair G.J., Tandon H.L.S., FAO Fertilizer and Plant Nutrition Bulletin 16, 2006)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni vegetativ ko‘paytirish usuli bo‘lib, bunda ona o‘simlik qisqa kesilgandan so‘ng uning asosidan tik o‘sib chiqqan yosh novdalarning pastki qismi bosqichma-bosqich tuproq bilan uyiladi. Tuproq ostida qolgan novda qismlarida qo‘shimcha ildizlar hosil bo‘lgach, ildizlangan novdalar ona o‘simlikdan ajratilib, mustaqil ko‘chat sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Vertikal parxishlash tupni ancha kuchsizlantiradi, shu bois bunday usulda ko‘chat etishtirish 2–3 yilda bir marta qo‘llaniladi.” (Uzumchilikda innovatsion texnologiyalar. Abdikayumov Z.A., 2022)
definition_en: A method of vegetative propagation in which shoots arising from a cut-back mother plant are progressively covered or mounded with soil so that roots develop at their bases; the rooted shoots are subsequently separated from the mother plant and grown as independent plants.
example_en: “The article outlines survey results conducted on implementation of intensive reproduction of grapevine seedlings through horizontal and vertical layering methods.” (Intensive reproduction of grapevine seedlings by vertical and horizontal layering method. Sultonov K.S., Eraliyeva S.F., ISJ Theoretical & Applied Science, 05 (73), 2019)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarni vegetativ ko‘paytirish usuli bo‘lib, bunda ona o‘simlikning yaxshi rivojlangan novdasi gorizontal holatda sayoz ariqcha yoki jo‘yak ichiga yotqizilib, tuproq bilan ko‘miladi. Novdaning tuproq ostida qolgan bo‘g‘imlarida qo‘shimcha ildizlar, kurtaklaridan esa yangi novdalar rivojlanadi. Ildizlangan qismlar keyinchalik ona o‘simlikdan ajratilib, alohida ko‘chat sifatida yetishtiriladi.
example_uz: “Gorizontal parxishlash. Ko‘chatlarni gorizontal parxishlash yo‘li bilan olish uchun ona tuplar atrofida qator bo‘ylab 20–25 sm chuqurlikda ariqlar qazib chiqiladi.” (Uzumchilikda innovatsion texnologiyalar. Abdikayumov Z.A., 2022)
definition_en: A method of vegetative propagation in which a shoot or branch of the parent plant is laid horizontally in a shallow trench and covered with soil so that roots develop at the buried nodes while new shoots grow from the buds. The rooted sections can subsequently be separated from the parent plant to form individual plants.
example_en: “The roots were formed in each node of shoots covered with soil and shoots were formed in each bud in horizontal layering.” (Layering – an effective way of intensive propagation of grapevine seedlings. Sultonov K.S., Eraliyeva S.F., GSC Biological and Pharmaceutical Sciences, 7(2), 2019, 139-p.)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtida ortiqcha hosil yukini kamaytirish maqsadida yosh mevalarning bir qismini olib tashlash agrotexnik tadbiri. Mevalarni siyraklashtirish qolgan mevalarning yirikligi va sifatini oshirish, daraxtning ortiqcha hosil bilan yuklanishini kamaytirish, shoxlarning sinish xavfini pasaytirish hamda ayrim meva turlarida davriy hosil berishni kamaytirishga xizmat qiladi.
example_uz: “Simbag‘azda daraxt shoxlari quyosh nurlari oson tushadigan holda shakllantiriladi. Bu orqali kesish, mevalarni siyraklashtirish va terish ishlari osonlashadi.” (Mevali daraxtlardan bog‘ barpo etish uslublari. To‘rayev H.A., 2019)
definition_en: A horticultural practice in which some developing fruits are deliberately removed from a tree to reduce crop load and improve the size and quality of the remaining fruits. Fruit thinning can also reduce limb breakage and help limit alternate bearing in susceptible fruit trees.
example_en: “Fruit thinning is a method to reduce the number of fruit on a tree and to counteract the negative effect of a heavy crop.” (Tree Fruit Thinning. Moran R., University of Maine Cooperative Extension, 2013)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlarida hosil yukini me’yorlashtirish maqsadida gullarning bir qismini olib tashlash yoki ularning meva tugishiga to‘sqinlik qilish agrotexnik tadbiri. Gullarni siyraklashtirish qo‘lda, mexanik yoki kimyoviy usulda amalga oshirilishi mumkin. Bu tadbir ortiqcha meva tugilishini kamaytirish, qolgan mevalarning yirikligi va sifatini yaxshilash hamda daraxtning hosil yukini boshqarish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Qo‘l bilan gullarni siyraklashtirish ko‘p mehnat talab qilinishi sababli, gullar va mevalarni kimyoviy preparatlar yordamida siyraklashtirish o‘rganilgan.” (Anorchilik. Qo‘shiyev H.H., Ergasheva F.Sh., Sayfutdinov U., 2021)
definition_en: A horticultural practice in which a proportion of blossoms is removed, or treated to prevent fruit set, in order to regulate crop load. Blossom thinning may be carried out manually, mechanically, or chemically and is used in fruit production to reduce excessive fruit set and improve fruit size and crop quality.
example_en: “Chemical blossom thinning in apple orchards is the practice of spraying chemicals during the blossom time to thin the crop.” (Apple Blossom Thinning: General Overview and Updates. Sherif S.M., Virginia Tech, 2020)

definition_uz: O‘simliklarning hujayra shirasida uchraydigan, suvda eruvchan flavonoid pigmentlar guruhiga mansub rang beruvchi moddalar. Antosianlar o‘simliklarning gul, meva, barg va boshqa organlarida qizil, binafsha va ko‘k ranglarning hosil bo‘lishida ishtirok etadi. Ularning rangi muhitning pH darajasiga qarab o‘zgarishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Termin yunoncha anthos — “gul” va kyanos — “ko‘k” so‘zlari bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: “Antotsian pigmentlari o‘simliklardagi biologik jarayonlarning turli bosqichlarida muhim vazifalarni bajaradi.” (O‘simliklarda fiziologik jarayonlarda antotsian pigmentning ahamiyati. Tursunov Y.B., Yo‘ldasheva Sh.L., 2025)
definition_en: Any of a group of water-soluble flavonoid glycoside pigments occurring in plants and responsible for red, purple, and blue coloration in flowers, fruits, leaves, and other plant tissues.
etymology_en: From Greek anthos (“flower”) and kyanos (“dark blue”).
example_en: “Anthocyanin accumulation is responsible for the red color of the skin and flesh of apple fruits (Malus × domestica Borkh.).” (Anthocyanin Biosynthesis in Apple Fruit. Honda C., Moriya S., The Horticulture Journal, 87(3), 2018)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlarida ortiqcha gullar yoki yosh mevalarning bir qismini kamaytirish va hosil yukini me’yorlashtirish maqsadida maxsus kimyoviy preparatlardan foydalanishga asoslangan siyraklashtirish usuli. Kimyoviy siyraklashtirish gullash yoki meva rivojlanishining dastlabki bosqichlarida amalga oshirilishi mumkin hamda qolgan mevalarning yirikligi va sifatini yaxshilash, daraxtning ortiqcha hosil yukini kamaytirish va davriy hosil berishni boshqarishda qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Qo‘l bilan gullarni siyraklashtirish ko‘p mehnat talab qilinishi sababli, gullar va mevalarni kimyoviy preparatlar yordamida siyraklashtirish o‘rganilgan.” (Anorchilik. Qo‘shiyev H.H., Ergasheva F.Sh., Sayfutdinov U., 2021)
definition_en: A horticultural practice in which chemical thinning agents are applied during bloom or early fruit development to reduce excessive flower or fruit set and regulate crop load. Chemical thinning is used particularly in tree-fruit production to improve fruit size and quality and to help reduce alternate bearing.
example_en: “Chemical thinning is the most common practice used by apple growers to reduce crop load and improve fruit size and quality.” (Chemical Thinning in Apples. Sherif S.M., Virginia Cooperative Extension, 2020)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlari va boshqa yog‘ochli o‘simliklarni butashda novda yoki shoxni uning chiqish joyidan to‘liq olib tashlash usuli. Siyraklashtirib kesishda shoxning faqat uchki qismi qisqartirilmaydi, balki u tanadan yoki yirikroq shoxdan chiqqan joyigacha olib tashlanadi. Bu usul shox-shabbaning haddan tashqari zichlashishini kamaytirish, yorug‘likning ichki qismlarga kirishini yaxshilash, daraxtning shakli va hajmini boshqarish hamda ortiqcha yoki noqulay joylashgan shoxlarni olib tashlash uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: O‘tkazilgandan keyingi dastlabki 5–6 yilda pastki qismi yalang‘och qolmasligi uchun shoxlarga siyraklashtirib yoki kaltalashtirib shakl beriladi. (Buxoro viloyati tuproq-iqlim sharoitida yangi intensiv bog‘lar barpo qilish. Fayzullayeva S., 2014)
definition_en: A pruning cut in which an entire branch or shoot is removed at its point of origin. Thinning cuts are used to reduce canopy density, improve light penetration, remove unwanted branches, and help maintain the desired size and shape of fruit trees.
example_en: “Thinning cuts involve the removal of a branch at its point of origin.” (Training and Pruning Apple Trees. Marini R.P., Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech, 2025)

definition_uz: Mevachilikning anor (Punica granatum L.) o‘simligining biologik xususiyatlari, navlari, ko‘paytirish usullari, bog‘ barpo etish, parvarishlash, sug‘orish, oziqlantirish, butash va shakl berish, hosilni yetishtirish hamda zararkunanda va kasalliklardan himoya qilish bilan bog‘liq nazariy va amaliy masalalarni qamrab oladigan yo‘nalishi.
example_uz: Bugungi kunda Respublikamizning Surxondaryo, Qashqadaryo va Sirdaryo viloyatlarida anorchilik jadal rivojlanib bormoqda. (Anorchilik. Qo‘shiyev H.H., Ergasheva F.Sh., Sayfutdinov U., 2021)
definition_en: The branch and practice of fruit production concerned with the propagation, establishment, cultivation, management, protection, and harvesting of pomegranate (Punica granatum L.) plants and orchards.
example_en: “Pomegranate cultivation is increasing considerably worldwide for fresh consumption, juice production and medicinal purposes.” (The Pomegranate: Botany, Production and Uses. Sarkhosh A., Yavari A.M., Zamani Z. (eds.), 2020)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlari yoki tokning tanasi, shoxi yoxud novdasi aylanasidan po‘stloq va floemaning ensiz halqasimon qismini olib tashlash orqali organik moddalarning pastga tomon harakatini vaqtincha cheklash agrotexnik usuli. Halqalash natijasida halqa yuqorisidagi qismlarda fotosintez mahsulotlari ko‘proq to‘planishi mumkin. Mevachilik va uzumchilikda bu usul ayrim hollarda meva yoki uzum g‘ujumlarining yirikligini oshirish, pishishni tezlashtirish va mahsulot sifatiga ta’sir ko‘rsatish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: Tadqiqotning maqsadi uzumning xo‘raki Tayfi rozoviy va Xusayne beliy navlari hosili sifatini oshirishga qaratilgan g‘ujumlarini siyraklashtirish, uzum boshlarini qog‘oz va matoli qopchalar bilan qoplash hamda tokning ikki yillik novdalarini halqalash orqali sifatli eksportbop uzum mahsulotini yetishtirish. (Uzumning (Vitis vinifera L.) eksportbop yirik g‘ujumli Tayfi rozoviy va Xusayne beliy navlarini yetishtirish texnologiyasi ayrim elementlarini takomillashtirish. Boyto‘rayeva F.A., 2026)
definition_en: A horticultural practice involving the removal of a narrow strip of bark, including phloem, completely around the trunk, branch, or cane of a plant. Girdling temporarily interrupts the downward transport of carbohydrates through the phloem and is used in some fruit crops and grapevines to increase fruit or berry size, advance maturity, or modify fruit quality.
example_en: Girdling (removal of a strip of bark tissue) is a practice that has been used on fruit plants for centuries. (Girdling Peach Trees in the Southeast. Powell A.A., Auburn University, 1996)

definition_uz: Daraxt va butalarning sog‘lom holatini saqlash, kasallik va zararkunandalar tarqalishini kamaytirish hamda shox-shabbaning fitosanitar holatini yaxshilash maqsadida qurigan, kasallangan, zararlangan yoki shikastlangan shox va novdalarni kesib olib tashlashga qaratilgan butash turi.
example_uz: “Daraxtlarni sanitariya maqsadida butash – quruq, kasal shoxlarni olib tashlash (qurigan, kasal shoxlar daraxtlar xavfli kasalliklarining manbaasi bo‘ladi).” (Avtomobil yo‘llarini jihozlash. Akbarov I., 2024)
definition_en: A type of pruning carried out to maintain plant health by removing dead, diseased, infected, damaged, or otherwise unhealthy branches and shoots, thereby helping to reduce sources of infection and pest problems.
example_en: “The control with no pruning treatment, where only sanitary pruning was performed.” (Growth and yielding of peach and nectarine trees after intensive regenerative pruning. Radajewska B., Szklarz M., Folia Horticulturae, 21(2), 2009)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlariga shakl berish tizimi bo‘lib, bunda markaziy tana yoki yetakchi shox olib tashlanib, daraxt tanasida turli tomonga yo‘nalgan bir necha asosiy skelet shoxlari qoldiriladi. Natijada shox-shabbaning markaziy qismi ochiq, kosa ko‘rinishidagi shakl hosil qiladi. Bunday shakl shox-shabba ichiga yorug‘lik tushishini va havo almashinuvini yaxshilaydi hamda ayniqsa shaftoli va boshqa ayrim danakli meva daraxtlarida qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Markaziy tananing bo‘lishiga va asosiy shoxlarning joylashish xususiyatiga qarab shox-shabbalar bir-biridan yarusli, yarussiz (lider), vazasimon (kosasimon), yotib o‘sadigan, butasimon shakllarda bo‘lishi bilan farq qiladi.” (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E., Narziyeva S.X., G‘ulomov B.X., 2011)
definition_en: A fruit-tree training system in which the central leader is removed and several main scaffold branches are developed around the trunk, leaving the center of the canopy open. The system improves light penetration into the canopy and produces a low, spreading, vase-shaped tree.
example_en: “Peaches are typically pruned to an open-center, or vase, shape.” (Pruning Peach Trees. Marini R.P., Virginia Cooperative Extension)

definition_uz: Meva daraxtlariga sun’iy shakl berish tizimi bo‘lib, bunda daraxtning asosiy shoxlari qator yo‘nalishi bo‘ylab yassi tekislikda joylashtiriladi va odatda tayanch yoki simbag‘azga bog‘lab o‘stiriladi. Palmetta shaklida shoxlar markaziy tana bo‘ylab ma’lum tartibda va burchak ostida yo‘naltirilib, yassi shox-shabba hosil qilinadi. Bu shakl yorug‘likdan samarali foydalanish, bog‘da daraxtlarni zichroq joylashtirish hamda butash va hosil yig‘ish ishlarini yengillashtirish imkonini beradi.
etymology_uz: Palmetta termini italyancha palmetta so‘zidan olingan bo‘lib, palma bargiga o‘xshash yelpig‘ichsimon bezak yoki shakl ma’nosi bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: “1970-yillardan boshlab O‘zbekistonda Italiyada (prof. Baldosari) kashf etilgan sun’iy shakl berish usullaridan biri — palmetta shakli (past bo‘yli payvandtaglardagi meva daraxtlari — olma, nokni shox-shabbaga yassi shakl berib, so‘ri yoki simbag‘azlarda o‘stirish) sinab ko‘rildi, lekin sermehnatligi tufayli keng yoyilmaydi.” (Daraxtlarga shakl berish. Xolnazarov S., O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: A fruit-tree training system in which the canopy is developed primarily in a flat plane along the tree row, with scaffold branches trained and oriented from a central leader, usually with the support of a trellis. The system is used to form a hedgerow-like canopy and can facilitate light interception, pruning, harvesting, and relatively high planting densities.
etymology_en: Palmette is derived from French palmette, referring to a stylized palm-leaf or fan-shaped form.
example_en: “The palmette system became successful because it improved orchard productivity by inducing earlier bearing and enabling higher planting densities than other contemporary systems.” (The Palmette Training System. Corelli-Grappadelli L., Acta Horticulturae 513, 1998, pp. 329–336)

definition_uz: Mevali o‘simliklarning urug‘idan yetishtirilgan niholdan payvandtag sifatida foydalanish natijasida olinadigan payvandtag turi. Urug‘ payvandtaglar jinsiy yo‘l bilan ko‘paytirilgani sababli genetik jihatdan bir xil bo‘lmasligi va o‘sish xususiyatlari bo‘yicha ma’lum darajada farqlanishi mumkin. Ular meva ko‘chatchiligida madaniy navlarning kurtak yoki qalamchalarini payvandlash uchun qo‘llaniladi. Ko‘pgina meva ekinlarida urug‘ payvandtaglar nisbatan kuchli o‘suvchi va yaxshi rivojlangan ildiz tizimiga ega daraxtlar hosil qiladi.
example_uz: Urug‘ payvandtag yetishtiriladigan bog‘lar. Urug‘, asosan, ko‘chat yetishtirish uchun o‘rmon massivlarida tayyorlanadi. (Mevachilik asoslari. Ostonaqulov T.E. va boshq., 2011)
definition_en: A rootstock produced from seed through sexual propagation and used as the root-bearing plant onto which a desired cultivar is budded or grafted. Because seedling rootstocks originate from sexual reproduction, they may show genetic variation. In many fruit crops, seedling rootstocks generally produce vigorous, well-anchored trees.
example_en: “Seedling rootstock—a rootstock produced from seed via sexual propagation.” (Rootstocks for Fruit Trees in Wisconsin. Roper T.R., University of Wisconsin–Extension, 2001)

definition_uz: Payvandtag bilan payvandust bevosita yaxshi birikmaydigan yoki ularning o‘zaro mosligini ta’minlash zarur bo‘lgan hollarda ular orasiga har ikkala komponent bilan mos keladigan uchinchi o‘simlik qismini joylashtirib payvandlash usuli. Bunda payvandlangan o‘simlik payvandtag, oraliq komponent va payvandustdan iborat bo‘lib, ikkita payvand birikmasi hosil qilinadi. Oraliq payvand payvandtag va payvandust o‘rtasidagi nomuvofiqlikni bartaraf etish, shuningdek, ayrim hollarda o‘simlikning o‘sish kuchi va boshqa xususiyatlarini boshqarish uchun qo‘llaniladi.
example_uz: “Behiga ulangan nok yaxshi tutishi uchun oraliq payvand usuli qo‘llaniladi.” (Mevachilik va sabzavotchilik. Mevachilik. Ostonaqulov T.E., Islamov S.Y. va boshq., 2018)
definition_en: A grafting practice in which an interstock is inserted between the rootstock and the scion, producing a three-part grafted plant with two graft unions: one between the rootstock and interstock and another between the interstock and scion. Double working is used particularly to overcome incompatibility between a scion and rootstock when both are compatible with the interstock, and it may also be used to modify plant characteristics.
example_en: “Double working refers to a three part plant with two graft unions, constructed from a stock and a scion separated by an intermediate shoot piece known as an interstock.” (Grafting and Budding. Cornell University, Department of Horticulture)

definition_uz: Ikki jinsli gulda urug‘chining, xususan tumshuqchaning, changchilarga nisbatan oldin yetilishi va changni qabul qilishga tayyor holatga kelishi bilan tavsiflanadigan dixogamiya turi. Protoginiyada tumshuqcha changchilar changdonlari ochilib chang tarqatishidan oldin faol bo‘ladi. Bu hodisa o‘z-o‘zidan changlanishni cheklashi va chetdan changlanishga imkon yaratishi mumkin.
etymology_uz: Yunoncha protos — “birinchi, oldingi” va gynē — “ayol” so‘zlari bilan bog‘liq.
example_uz: “Changchilarning urug‘chidan oldin etilishi protandriya, urug‘chining changchidan oldin yetilishi protoginiya deb ataladi.” (Dixogamiya. O‘zbekiston Milliy Ensiklopediyasi)
definition_en: A form of dichogamy in which the female reproductive part of a bisexual flower, particularly the stigma, becomes receptive before the anthers mature and shed pollen. This temporal separation can reduce self-pollination and promote cross-pollination.
etymology_en: From proto- (“first, earlier”) + -gyny (“female”).
example_en: “Protogyny: When the stigma is receptive prior to the pollen shedding.” (Glossary of Terms, The Science of Plants. University of Minnesota)
